1 chronicles_1.t: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
Noah, Shem, Ham and Japheth.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.
And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshishah, Kittim and Rodanim.
The sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim, Put and Canaan.
And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raamah and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
And Mizraim fathered the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim,
and the Pathrusim and the Casluhim — from whom the Philistines went out — and the Caphtorim.
And Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
and the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,
and the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,
and the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.
The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arphaxad and Lud and Aram, and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.
And Arphaxad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.
And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Joktan.
And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah,
and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah,
and Ebal and Abimael and Sheba,
and Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram — he is Abraham.
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
These were their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,
Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,
Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These, they were the sons of Ishmael.
And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
And Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah, and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.
And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
The sons of Shobal: Alyan and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Keran.
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishon: Uz and Aran.
And these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned for the people of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanite reigned in his place.
And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck down Midian in the region of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
And Samlah died, and Shaul from Rehoboth-on-the-River reigned in his place.
And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai, and the name of his wife was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.
And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

1 chronicles_2.t: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah — three were born to him from Bath-shua the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the eyes of YHWH, and he put him to death.
And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Kalkol and Dara — all of them five.
And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who acted unfaithfully in the devoted thing.
And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
And the sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.
And Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, leader of the sons of Judah.
And Nahshon fathered Salma, and Salma fathered Boaz,
and Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse,
and Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abshai and Joab and Asahel — three.
And Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
And Caleb son of Hezron fathered with Azubah a wife, and with Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.
And Azubah died, and Caleb took Ephrath for himself, and she bore him Hur.
And Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
And afterwards Hezron went in to the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead, and he had taken her when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
And Segub fathered Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
And Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, with Kenath and its daughter-villages — sixty cities. All these were the sons of Makir the father of Gilead.
And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, and Hezron's wife was Abijah, she bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were: the firstborn Ram, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem, Ahijah.
And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz and Jamin and Eker.
And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. And Seled died with no sons.
And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. And Jether died with no sons.
And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
And Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian slave, and his name was Jarha.
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his slave as a wife, and she bore him Attai.
And Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad,
and Zabad fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed,
and Obed fathered Jehu, and Jehu fathered Azariah,
and Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah,
and Eleasah fathered Sismai, and Sismai fathered Shallum,
and Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn — he was the father of Ziph — and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.
And Shema fathered Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem fathered Shammai.
And the son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran fathered Gazez.
And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.
Maacah, Caleb's concubine — he bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
And she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
These were the sons of Caleb. The son of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
And the clans of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrite and the Puthite and the Shumathite and the Mishraite; from these came out the Zorathite and the Eshtaolite.
The sons of Salma: Bethlehem and the Netophathite, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathite, the Zorite.
And the clans of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez: Tirathites, Shimeathites, Sucathites. These were the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

1 chronicles_3.t: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;
the third, Absalom son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah son of Haggith;
the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
Six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon — four, by Bath-shua daughter of Ammiel.
And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet,
and Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia,
and Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet — nine.
All were the sons of David, besides the sons of concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
And the son of Solomon: Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
And the sons of Jeconiah, a prisoner: Shealtiel his son,
and Malkiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the son of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister.
and Hashubah and Ohel and Berekiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed — five.
And the descendant of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat — six.
And the son of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam — three.
And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani — seven.

1 chronicles_4.t: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron and Carmi and Hur and Shobal.
And Reaiah son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathite.
And these were the father of Etam: Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrath, the father of Bethlehem.
And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah bore him Ahuzzam and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
And the sons of Helah: Zereth and Zohar and Ethnan.
And Koz fathered Anub and Zobebah, and the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
And Jabez was more honoured than his brothers; and his mother had called his name Jabez, saying: Because I gave birth in pain.

And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying: If you will indeed bless me and enlarge my territory, and your hand will be with me, and you will act away from harm so as not to hurt me! And God brought what he had asked.
And Kelub the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir; he was the father of Eshton.
And Eshton fathered Beth-rapha and Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
And Meonothai fathered Ophrah; and Seraiah fathered Joab the father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.
And the sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. And the sons of Elah: and Kenaz.
And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

And the son of Ezrah: Jether and Mered and Epher and Jalon. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took; and she conceived Miriam and Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
And his Judahite wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socoh, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the clans of the house of the workers of fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
and Jokim and the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the words are ancient.
They were the potters and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they dwelt there with the king, in his service.
The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; and his brothers had not many sons, and all their clan did not increase as far as the sons of Judah.
And they dwelt in Beersheba and Moladah and Hazar-shual,
and in Bilhah and in Ezem and in Tolad,
and in Bethuel and in Hormah and in Ziklag,
and in Beth-marcaboth and in Hazar-susim and in Beth-biri and in Shaaraim. These were their cities until David reigned.
And their villages were Etam and Ain, Rimmon and Tochen and Ashan — five cities,
and all their villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their dwelling places, and they had their genealogical record.
And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah son of Amaziah,
and Joel, and Jehu son of Joshibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel,
and Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah,
and Ziza son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah.
These who came by names were leaders in their clans, and the house of their fathers spread out to abundance.
And they went to the entrance of Gedor, to the east of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
And they found fertile and good pasture, and the land was broad of both hands and at peace and at ease; for those who dwelt there before were from Ham.

And these written by names came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and struck down their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and totally destroyed them to this day, and dwelt in their place; for there was pasture there for their flocks.
And some of them, of the sons of Simeon, went to Mount Seir — five hundred men — with Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.
And they struck down the remnant of the escaped remnant of Amalek, and they have dwelt there to this day.

1 chronicles_5.t: And the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel — for he was the firstborn, but when he profaned his father's bed his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, and he was not to be enrolled by the birthright;
for Judah prevailed among his brothers, and a leader came from him; but the birthright belonged to Joseph —
the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria took into exile; he was a leader of the Reubenite.
And his brothers by their clans, when the genealogical record of their generations was made: the chief Jeiel, and Zechariah,
and Bela son of Azaz son of Shema son of Joel. He dwelt in Aroer, and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
And to the east he dwelt as far as the entrance of the wilderness, from the river Euphrates; for their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, and they fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east of Gilead.
And the sons of Gad dwelt opposite them in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:
Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan.
And their brothers by their ancestral houses: Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber — seven.
These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri son of Jaroah son of Gilead son of Michael son of Jeshishai son of Jahdo son of Buz.
Ahi son of Abdiel son of Guni was chief of their ancestral house.
And they dwelt in Gilead, in Bashan and in its daughter-villages, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon to their limits.
All of them were enrolled by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

The sons of Reuben and the Gadite and the half-tribe of Manasseh, from the sons of valour — men bearing shield and sword and bending the bow, and trained for war — were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty going out to the army.
And they made war with the Hagrites, and Jetur and Naphish and Nodab.

And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were given into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried out to God in the battle, and he was entreated by them, because they trusted in him.
And they took captive their livestock: their camels fifty thousand, and sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and donkeys two thousand; and of human beings, a hundred thousand.
For many fell slain, because the battle was from God. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
And the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and Mount Hermon; they multiplied.
And these were the chiefs of their ancestral houses: Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel — men mighty in valour, men of names, chiefs of their ancestral houses.
And they acted unfaithfully against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God had destroyed before them.

And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and he took them into exile — the Reubenite and the Gadite and the half-tribe of Manasseh — and brought them to Halah and Habor and Hara and the river of Gozan, to this day.

1 chronicles_6.t: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.
And the children of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Eleazar fathered Phinehas; Phinehas fathered Abishua;
and Abishua fathered Bukki; and Bukki fathered Uzzi;
and Uzzi fathered Zerahiah; and Zerahiah fathered Meraioth;
Meraioth fathered Amariah; and Amariah fathered Ahitub;
and Ahitub fathered Zadok; and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz;
and Ahimaaz fathered Azariah; and Azariah fathered Johanan;
and Johanan fathered Azariah — he is the one who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem;
and Azariah fathered Amariah; and Amariah fathered Ahitub;
and Ahitub fathered Zadok; and Zadok fathered Shallum;
and Shallum fathered Hilkiah; and Hilkiah fathered Azariah;
and Azariah fathered Seraiah; and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
And Jehozadak went when YHWH sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath and Merari.
And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the clans of the Levite, by their fathers.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
Elkanah. The sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
And the sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
The sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
And these are the ones whom David appointed over the hands of song in the house of YHWH, from the resting of the ark.
And they were ministering before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting with song, until Solomon built the house of YHWH in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their custom over their service.
And these are the ones who stood, and their sons: of the sons of the Kohathite, Heman the singer, son of Joel, son of Samuel,
son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand: Asaph son of Berekiah, son of Shimea,
son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malkijah,
son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,
son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
And the sons of Merari, their brothers, were at the left hand: Ethan son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,
son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
And their brothers the Levites were assigned to all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

And Aaron and his sons were making smoke on the altar of the burnt offering and on the altar of the incense, for all the work of the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
And these were their dwelling places, by their encampments in their territory: to the sons of Aaron, of the clan of the Kohathite — for the lot was theirs —
and they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it.
And the field of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah and its pasture lands, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa and its pasture lands,
and Hilez and its pasture lands, Debir and its pasture lands,
and Ashan and its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh and its pasture lands.
And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba and its pasture lands, and Alemeth and its pasture lands, and Anathoth and its pasture lands. All their cities were thirteen cities by their clans.
And to the sons of Kohath who remained, from the clan of the tribe, from the half of the tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
And to the sons of Gershom by their clans: from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
To the sons of Merari by their clans: from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun, by lot, twelve cities.
And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their pasture lands.
And they gave by lot, from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which they called by names.
And some of the clans of the sons of Kohath — and the cities of their territory were from the tribe of Ephraim.
And they gave them the cities of refuge: Shechem and its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer and its pasture lands,
and Jokmeam and its pasture lands, and Beth-horon and its pasture lands,
and Aijalon and its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon and its pasture lands.
And from the half of the tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its pasture lands, and Bileam and its pasture lands — for the clan of the sons of Kohath who remained.
To the sons of Gershom: from the clan of the half of the tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan and its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth and its pasture lands;
and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its pasture lands, Daberath and its pasture lands,
and Ramoth and its pasture lands, and Anem and its pasture lands;
and from the tribe of Asher: Mashal and its pasture lands, and Abdon and its pasture lands,
and Hukok and its pasture lands, and Rehob and its pasture lands;
and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its pasture lands, and Hammon and its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim and its pasture lands.
To the sons of Merari who remained: from the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono and its pasture lands, Tabor and its pasture lands;
and beyond the Jordan of Jericho, to the east of the Jordan: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness and its pasture lands, and Jahzah and its pasture lands,
and Kedemoth and its pasture lands, and Mephaath and its pasture lands;
and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its pasture lands, and Mahanaim and its pasture lands,
and Heshbon and its pasture lands, and Jazer and its pasture lands.

1 chronicles_7.t: And to the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron — four.

And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Jibsam and Samuel, chiefs of their ancestral house, of Tola, mighty men of valour in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel, Isshiah — five, chiefs all of them.
And with them, by their generations, by their ancestral house, were troops of the army of war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
And their brothers, of all the clans of Issachar, were mighty men of valour: eighty-seven thousand, their genealogical record, of them all.
Benjamin: Bela and Beker and Jediael — three.
And the sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri — five, chiefs of an ancestral house, mighty men of valour; and their genealogical record was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
And the sons of Beker: Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jeremoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.
And their genealogical record, by their generations, chiefs of their ancestral house, mighty men of valour: twenty thousand two hundred.
And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Kenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar.
All these were the sons of Jediael, by the chiefs of the fathers, mighty men of valour: seventeen thousand two hundred going out to the army for battle.
And Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir; Hushim, the sons of Aher.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum — the sons of Bilhah.
The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom she bore; his Aramean concubine bore Makir the father of Gilead.
And Makir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim; and the name of his sister was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
And Maacah the wife of Makir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir son of Manasseh.
And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah.
And the sons of Shemida were Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam.
And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. And the men of Gath who were born in the land killed them, because they went down to take their livestock.
And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, because it was in distress in his house.
And his daughter was Sheerah, and she built Lower Beth-horon and Upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
And Rephah his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Nun his son, Joshua his son.

And their possession and their dwelling places were Bethel and its daughter-villages, and to the east Naaran, and to the west Gezer and its daughter-villages, and Shechem and its daughter-villages, as far as Ayyah and its daughter-villages.

And on the sides of the sons of Manasseh: Beth-shan and its daughter-villages, Taanach and its daughter-villages, Megiddo and its daughter-villages, Dor and its daughter-villages. In these dwelt the sons of Joseph son of Israel.
The sons of Asher: Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah; and Serah was their sister.
And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel; he was the father of Birzaith.
And Heber fathered Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. These were the sons of Japhlet.
And the sons of Shemer: Ahi and Rohgah and Hubbah and Aram.
And the son of Helem his brother: Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal.
The sons of Zophah: Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah,
Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera.
And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh and Pispah and Ara.
And the sons of Ulla: Arah and Hanniel and Rizia.

All these were the sons of Asher, chiefs of the ancestral house, chosen mighty men of valour, chiefs of the leaders. And their genealogical record in the army, for battle: their number was twenty-six thousand men.

1 chronicles_8.t: And Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second and Ahrah the third,
Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth.
And Bela had sons: Addar and Gera and Abihud,
and Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah,
and Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.
And these were the sons of Ehud — these were the chiefs of ancestral houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they took them into exile to Manahath —
and Naaman and Ahijah and Gera — he took them into exile — and he fathered Uzzah and Ahihud.
And Shaharaim fathered in the region of Moab, after he had sent them away — Hushim and Baara his wives.
And he fathered from Hodesh his wife: Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malkam,
and Jeuz and Sakia and Mirmah. These were his sons, chiefs of ancestral houses.
And from Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.
And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed — he built Ono and Lod and its daughter-villages —
and Beriah and Shema — they were the chiefs of the ancestral houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon; they put to flight the inhabitants of Gath —
and Ahio, Shashak and Jeremoth,
and Zebadiah and Arad and Eder,
and Michael and Ishpah and Joha — the sons of Beriah.
And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber,
and Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab — the sons of Elpaal.
And Jakim and Zikri and Zabdi,
and Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel,
and Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath — the sons of Shimei.
And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel,
and Abdon and Zikri and Hanan,
and Hananiah and Elam and Anthothijah,
and Iphdeiah and Penuel — the sons of Shashak.
And Shamsherai and Shechariah and Athaliah,
and Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zikri — the sons of Jeroham.
These were chiefs of ancestral houses, by their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; and the name of his wife was Maacah.
And his firstborn son was Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Nadab,
and Gedor and Ahio and Zeker.
And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And they too dwelt opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, with their brothers.
And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan and Malki-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.
And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
And Moza fathered Binea; Raphah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second and Eliphelet the third.
And the sons of Ulam were men, mighty men of valour, bending the bow, and having many sons and sons of sons — a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

1 chronicles_9.t: And all Israel were enrolled by genealogy, and here they are, written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile to Babylon for their unfaithfulness.
And the first inhabitants who were in their possession, in their cities, were Israel, the priests, the Levites and the given ones.
And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the sons of Judah and some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Perez son of Judah;
and of the Shilonite: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons;
and of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel; and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;
and Ibneiah son of Jeroham; and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;
and their brothers, by their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were chiefs of ancestral houses, by their ancestral house.
And of the priests: Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jakin;
and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, leader of the house of God;
and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;
and their brothers, chiefs of their ancestral house — a thousand seven hundred and sixty, mighty in ability for the work of the service of the house of God.
And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
and Bakbakkar, Heresh and Galal; and Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zikri, son of Asaph;
and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathite.
And the gatekeepers: Shallum and Akkub and Talmon and Ahiman; and their brother Shallum was the chief.
And until now, at the king's gate on the east, they were the gatekeepers for the camps of the sons of Levi.

And Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his brothers of his ancestral house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent; and their fathers had been over the camp of YHWH, keepers of the entrance.
And Phinehas son of Eleazar had been leader over them formerly; YHWH was with him.
Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the entrance of the tent of meeting.
All those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. They were enrolled by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them in their trust.
And they and their sons were over the gates of the house of YHWH, of the house of the tent, for guard duties.
The gatekeepers were on four sides: east, west, north and south.
And their brothers in their villages were to come in for seven days, from time to time, with these.
For in trust were the four mighty ones of the gatekeepers; they were the Levites, and they were over the store-rooms and over the treasuries of the house of God.
And around the house of God they spent the night, for the duty was on them; and they were over the key, morning by morning.
And some of them were over the articles of the service, for they brought them in by number and took them out by number.
And some of them were appointed over the articles and over all the articles of the holy place, and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the frankincense and the spices.
And some of the sons of the priests mixed the mixture of the spices.
And Mattithiah, one of the Levites — he was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite — was in trust over the work of the flat cakes.
And some of the sons of the Kohathite, of their brothers, were over the bread of the row, to prepare it sabbath by sabbath.
And these were the singers, chiefs of ancestral houses of the Levites, in the rooms, free of duty; for by day and night the work was on them.
These were chiefs of the ancestral houses of the Levites, by their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel; and the name of his wife was Maacah;
and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab,
and Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.
And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they too dwelt opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, with their brothers.
And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan and Malki-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Meri-baal fathered Micah.
And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tahrea.
And Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
And Moza fathered Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

1 chronicles_10.t: And the Philistines fought against Israel, and the man of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and they fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
And the Philistines pursued closely after Saul and after his sons, and the Philistines struck down Jonathan and Abinadab and Malki-shua, the sons of Saul.
And the battle was heavy on Saul, and the archers with the bow found him, and he was in severe pain from the archers.

And Saul said to his weapon-bearer: Draw your sword and pierce me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and deal wantonly with me. But his weapon-bearer was not willing, for he was very afraid. And Saul took the sword and fell on it.
And his weapon-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he too fell on the sword, and he died.
And Saul died, and his three sons, and all his household died together.
And every man of Israel who was in the valley saw that they had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, and they abandoned their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
And it was on the next day that the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
And they stripped him and took his head and his weapons, and sent them through the land of the Philistines all around, to bear the news to their idols and to the people.
And they put his weapons in the house of their gods, and they fixed his skull in the house of Dagon.
And all Jabesh-gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul.
And every mighty man arose, and they took the corpse of Saul and the corpses of his sons and brought them to Jabesh; and they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
And Saul died in his unfaithfulness, by which he acted unfaithfully against YHWH, concerning the word of YHWH that he did not keep, and also for consulting a medium, to seek guidance;
and he did not seek guidance of YHWH; so he put him to death and turned the kingship over to David son of Jesse.

1 chronicles_11.t: And all Israel gathered to David at Hebron, saying: Here, we are your bone and your flesh.

Both yesterday and the day before, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led out and brought in Israel; and YHWH your God said to you: You shall shepherd my people Israel, and you shall be leader over my people Israel.

And all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before YHWH; and they anointed David as king over Israel, according to the word of YHWH by the hand of Samuel.
And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem — that is Jebus — and the Jebusite, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David: You shall not come in here. But David captured the stronghold of Zion — that is the city of David.
And David said: Whoever strikes down a Jebusite first shall become chief and commander. And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became chief.
And David dwelt in the fortress; therefore they called it the city of David.
And he built the city round about, from the Millo and as far as the surroundings; and Joab restored the rest of the city.
And David went on, growing continually greater, and YHWH of hosts was with him.
And these were the chiefs of the mighty men whom David had, who held strongly with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of YHWH concerning Israel.
And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam a Hacmonite, chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred slain at one time.
And after him was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite; he was among the three mighty men.
He was with David at Pas-dammim, and the Philistines were gathered there for battle; and the portion of the field was full of barley, and the people fled from before the Philistines.
And they took their stand in the middle of the portion and defended it, and struck down the Philistines; and YHWH delivered with a great deliverance.
And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock, to David, to the cave of Adullam; and the camp of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
And David craved and said: Who will give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is at the gate?

And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was at the gate, and carried it and brought it to David; and David was not willing to drink it, and he poured it out to YHWH.

And he said: Far be it from me, from my God, to do this. Shall I drink the blood of these men at the cost of their lives? For at the cost of their lives they brought it. And he was not willing to drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
And Abshai the brother of Joab — he was chief of the three; and he wielded his spear against three hundred slain, and he had a name among the three.
Of the three he was honoured more than the two, and he became their commander; but he did not come to the three.

Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the son of a man of valour, great in deeds, from Kabzeel — he struck down the two Ariel of Moab; and he went down and struck down the lion inside the pit on the day of the snow.

And he struck down the Egyptian man, a man of stature, five cubits; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a club, and tore the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with his own spear.
These things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
Of the thirty, he was honoured, but to the three he did not come. And David appointed him over his bodyguard.
And the mighty men of the forces: Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;
Shammoth the Harorite; Helez the Pelonite;
Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; Abiezer the Anathothite;
Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite;
Maharai the Netophathite; Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite;
Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin; Benaiah the Pirathonite;
Hurai from the wadis of Gaash; Abiel the Arbathite;
Azmaveth the Baharumite; Eliahba the Shaalbonite;
the sons of Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan son of Shageh the Hararite;
Ahiam son of Sakar the Hararite; Eliphal son of Ur;
Hepher the Mekerathite; Ahijah the Pelonite;
Hezro the Carmelite; Naarai son of Ezbai;
Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar son of Hagri;
Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai the Beerothite, the weapon-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah;
Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite;
Uriah the Hittite; Zabad son of Ahlai;
Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenite, and thirty with him;
Hanan son of Maacah; and Joshaphat the Mithnite;
Uzzia the Ashterathite; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite;
Jediael son of Shimri, and Joha his brother the Tizite;
Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite;
Eliel and Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

1 chronicles_12.t: And these were the ones who came to David at Ziklag while he was still kept back from before Saul son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
equipped with the bow, using the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows on the bow; some of the brothers of Saul, from Benjamin.
The chief was Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Hasshemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah and Jehu the Anathothite;
and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and over the thirty; and Jeremiah and Jahaziel and Johanan and Jozabad the Gederathite;
Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
Elkanah and Isshiah and Azarel and Joezer and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

And from the Gadite there separated themselves to David at the fortress in the wilderness mighty men of valour, men of the army for battle, preparing shield and spear; and their faces were the faces of a lion, and they were like gazelles on the mountains for swiftness.
Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
These were of the sons of Gad, chiefs of the army: the least was over a hundred and the greatest over a thousand.
These were the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing over all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the fortress, to David.

And David went out before them, and he answered and said to them: If you have come to me in peace, to help me, my heart will be joined to you; but if to betray me to my adversaries, when there is no violence in my hands, may the God of our fathers see and judge.

And a spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the officers: Yours, David, and with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to the one who helps you, for your God has helped you. And David received them and appointed them among the chiefs of the band.

And some of Manasseh fell in with David when he came with the Philistines against Saul for battle — but they did not help them, for the rulers of the Philistines sent him away by counsel, saying: At the cost of our heads he will fall to his lord Saul.
When he went to Ziklag, these of Manasseh fell in with him: Adnah and Jozabad and Jediael and Michael and Jozabad and Elihu and Zillethai, chiefs of the thousands who belonged to Manasseh.
And they helped David against the band, for they were all mighty men of valour; and they became commanders in the army.
For from day to day they came to David to help him, until it was a great camp, like the camp of God.
And these are the numbers of the chiefs of those equipped for the army, who came to David at Hebron to turn over the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the mouth of YHWH.
The sons of Judah, bearing shield and spear: six thousand eight hundred, equipped for the army.
Of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the army: seven thousand one hundred.
Of the sons of the Levite: four thousand six hundred.
And Jehoiada was the leader of Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
and Zadok, a young man mighty in valour, and his ancestral house — twenty-two commanders.
And of the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul: three thousand — and until now the greater part of them were keeping the duty of the house of Saul.
And of the sons of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valour, men of names in their ancestral house.
And of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who had been designated by names to come and make David king.
And of the sons of Issachar, those who knew understanding of the times, to know what Israel should do: their chiefs were two hundred, and all their brothers were at their mouth.
Of Zebulun, those going out to the army, preparing for battle with every weapon of war: fifty thousand, and to help with no double heart.
And of Naphtali: a thousand commanders, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.
And of the Danite, preparing for battle: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
And of Asher, those going out to the army, to deploy for battle: forty thousand.
And from beyond the Jordan, of the Reubenite and the Gadite and the half-tribe of Manasseh, with every weapon of the army of war: a hundred and twenty thousand.

All these were men of war, helpers of the battle line; with a complete heart they came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and also all the rest of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brothers had prepared for them.

And also those near to them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys and on camels and on mules and on oxen: provisions of flour, fig cakes and clusters of raisins, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

1 chronicles_13.t: And David consulted with the commanders of the thousands and of the hundreds, with every leader.

And David said to all the assembly of Israel: If it is good with you, and it is from YHWH our God, let us spread out and send to our brothers who remain in all the lands of Israel, and with them the priests and the Levites in the cities of their pasture lands, that they may gather to us.
And let us bring round the ark of our God to us; for we did not seek it in the days of Saul.
And all the assembly said to do so, for the matter was right in the eyes of all the people.
And David gathered all Israel, from the Shihor of Egypt as far as Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, YHWH who sits on the cherubim, where a name is called.
And they made the ark of God ride on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzzah and Ahio were leading the cart.
And David and all Israel were making merry before God with all their strength, and with songs and with lyres and with harps and with tambourines and with cymbals and with trumpets.
And they came as far as the threshing floor of Kidon, and Uzzah stretched out his hand to grasp the ark, for the oxen had stumbled.
And the anger of YHWH burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had stretched out his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
And it burned to David, because YHWH had broken out a breaking-out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez-uzzah, to this day.
And David feared God on that day, saying: How can I bring the ark of God to myself?
And David did not turn the ark aside to himself, to the city of David, but he turned it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom, in his house, three months; and YHWH blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that belonged to him.

1 chronicles_14.t: And Huram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar wood, and craftsmen of walls and craftsmen of wood, to build him a house.
And David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel, for his kingdom was exalted on high for the sake of his people Israel.
And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.
And these are the names of those born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab, Nathan and Solomon,
and Ibhar and Elishua and Elpelet,
and Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia,
and Elishama and Beeliada and Eliphelet.
And the Philistines heard that David had been anointed as king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard and went out before them.
And the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
And David enquired of God, saying: Shall I go up against the Philistines, and will you give them into my hand? And YHWH said to him: Go up, and I will give them into your hand.

And they went up at Baal-perazim, and David struck them down there. And David said: God has burst out against my enemies by my hand, like a bursting-out of water. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
And they abandoned their gods there; and David spoke, and they were burned with fire.
And the Philistines did it again, and made a raid in the valley.
And David enquired again of God, and God said to him: You shall not go up after them; go around away from them and come at them opposite the balsam trees.
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then you shall go out in battle; for God has gone out before you to strike down the camp of the Philistines.
And David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
And the name of David went out into all the lands, and YHWH put the dread of him on all the nations.

1 chronicles_15.t: And he made houses for himself in the city of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
Then David said: No one is to carry the ark of God except the Levites; for YHWH chose them to carry the ark of YHWH and to serve him for ever.
And David assembled all Israel to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of YHWH to its place, which he had prepared for it.
And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the leader and his brothers — a hundred and twenty;
of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the leader and his brothers — two hundred and twenty;
of the sons of Gershom, Joel the leader and his brothers — a hundred and thirty;
of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and his brothers — two hundred;
of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the leader and his brothers — eighty;
of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and his brothers — a hundred and twelve.
And David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites: Uriel, Asaiah and Joel, Shemaiah and Eliel and Amminadab.

And he said to them: You are the chiefs of the ancestral houses of the Levites. Consecrate yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up the ark of YHWH the God of Israel to the place I have prepared for it.
For because you were not there the first time, YHWH our God burst out against us; for we did not seek him according to the ordinance.
And the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of YHWH the God of Israel.
And the sons of the Levites carried the ark of God, as Moses had commanded according to the word of YHWH, on their shoulders with the poles upon them.
And David said to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brothers the singers, with instruments of song — harps and lyres and cymbals — sounding aloud, to raise the voice for joy.
And the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel, and of his brothers Asaph son of Berekiah; and of the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan son of Kushaiah.

And with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers.
And the singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound aloud with bronze cymbals;
and Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah, with harps on alamoth;
and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel and Azaziah, with lyres on the sheminith, to act as overseers.
And Kenaniah, leader of the Levites in the lifting up — he was an instructor in the lifting up, for he was skilled.
And Berekiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.

And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers for the ark.
And David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of the thousands were the ones who went to bring up the ark of the covenant of YHWH from the house of Obed-edom with joy.
And it was, because God helped the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of YHWH, that they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
And David was wrapped in a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who carried the ark, and the singers, and Kenaniah the leader of the lifting up of the singers; and on David was a linen ephod.
And all Israel were bringing up the ark of the covenant of YHWH with a shout and with the sound of a horn, and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.

And it was, as the ark of the covenant of YHWH was coming to the city of David, that Michal daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw King David dancing and making merry; and she despised him in her heart.

1 chronicles_16.t: And they brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they brought near burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
And David finished offering up the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in the name of YHWH.
And he distributed to every person of Israel, from man to woman, to each a round loaf of bread and a portion of meat and a raisin-cake.
And he appointed before the ark of YHWH some of the Levites as ministers, and to bring to remembrance and to give thanks and to praise YHWH the God of Israel:

Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah; Jeiel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel, with instruments — harps and lyres; and Asaph was sounding aloud with the cymbals;
and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests, with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
On that day, then David appointed for the first time to give thanks to YHWH by the hand of Asaph and his brothers:
Give thanks to YHWH, call on his name, make his deeds known among the peoples.
Sing to him, make music to him, tell of all his wonders.
Boast in his holy name; let the heart of those who seek YHWH rejoice.
Seek YHWH and his strength; seek his face continually.
Remember his wonders that he has done, his portents and the judgements of his mouth,
offspring of Israel his servant, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is YHWH our God; his judgements are in all the earth.
Remember his covenant for ever, the word he commanded for a thousand generations,
which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,
and he confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as a perpetual covenant,
saying: To you I will give the land of Canaan, the portion of your inheritance;
when you were men of number, very few, and sojourners in it.
And they went about from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.
He did not allow anyone to oppress them, and he rebuked kings on their account:
Do not touch my anointed ones, and do no harm to my prophets.
Sing to YHWH, all the earth; bear the news of his salvation from day to day.
Recount his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
For great is YHWH and greatly to be praised, and he is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but YHWH made the heavens.
Splendour and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his place.
Ascribe to YHWH, clans of the peoples, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.
Ascribe to YHWH the glory of his name; lift up an offering and come before him; bow down to YHWH in holy adornment.
Tremble before him, all the earth; indeed the world is established, it will not be shaken.
Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad, and let them say among the nations: YHWH reigns!
Let the sea thunder and all that fills it; let the field exult, and all that is in it.
Then the trees of the forest will shout for joy before YHWH, for he is coming to judge the earth.
Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good, for his steadfast love is for ever.
And say: Save us, God of our salvation, and gather us and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to boast in your praise.
Blessed be YHWH the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. And all the people said: Amen! And they praised YHWH.
And he left there, before the ark of the covenant of YHWH, Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as each day's matter required;
and Obed-edom and their brothers, sixty-eight; and Obed-edom son of Jedithun, and Hosah, as gatekeepers;
and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the tabernacle of YHWH at the high place that was in Gibeon,
to offer up burnt offerings to YHWH on the altar of the burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of YHWH, which he commanded Israel.
And with them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen, who were designated by names, to give thanks to YHWH, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and with them Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals for those who sound aloud, and the instruments of the song of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.
And all the people went, each to his house; and David turned to bless his household.

1 chronicles_17.t: And it was, when David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet: Here I am dwelling in a house of cedars, and the ark of the covenant of YHWH is under tent curtains.
And Nathan said to David: Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.
And it was in that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying:
Go and say to David my servant: Thus says YHWH: You shall not build me the house to dwell in.
For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been from tent to tent, and from tabernacle.
In all where I went about among all Israel, did I speak a word with one of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying: Why have you not built me a house of cedars?
And now, thus you shall say to my servant, to David: Thus says YHWH of hosts: I myself took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be leader over my people Israel.
And I was with you wherever you went, and I cut off all your enemies from before you; and I will make for you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

And I will establish a place for my people Israel, and I will plant them, and they will dwell in their place and be agitated no more; and the sons of injustice will not consume them again, as at the first,
and from the days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. And I tell you that YHWH will build you a house.
And it will be, when your days are completed to go with your fathers, that I will raise up your offspring after you, who will be one of your sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to me; and I will not remove my steadfast love from him, as I removed it from the one who was before you.
And I will appoint him in my house and in my kingdom for ever, and his throne will be established for ever.
According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
And King David came and sat before YHWH, and he said: Who am I, YHWH God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
And this was small in your eyes, God, and you have spoken concerning the house of your servant for a distant time; and you have looked on me according to the order of humankind going up, YHWH God.
What more can David add to you for the honour of your servant? And you yourself know your servant.
YHWH, for the sake of your servant and according to your heart you have done all this greatness, making known all the great things.
YHWH, there is none like you, and there is no God besides you, in all that we have heard with our ears.

And who is like your people Israel, one nation on the earth, whom God went to redeem for himself as a people, to make for yourself a name of great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed from Egypt?
And you made your people Israel your own people for ever, and you, YHWH, became God for them.
And now, YHWH, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as you have spoken.
And let it be established, and let your name be great for ever, saying: YHWH of hosts is the God of Israel, God to Israel; and let the house of David your servant be established before you.
For you, my God, have uncovered the ear of your servant to build him a house; therefore your servant has found it in himself to pray before you.
And now, YHWH, you are God, and you have spoken this good thing concerning your servant.
And now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, to be for ever before you; for you, YHWH, have blessed, and it is blessed for ever.

1 chronicles_18.t: And it was after this that David struck down the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its daughter-villages out of the hand of the Philistines.
And he struck down Moab, and the Moabites became subjects to David, bearers of tribute.
And David struck down Hadadezer king of Zobah, towards Hamath, when he went to establish his monument at the river Euphrates.
And David captured from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand foot soldiers; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left of them a hundred chariots.
And Aram of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, and David struck down among Aram twenty-two thousand men.
And David put garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subjects to David, bearers of tribute; and YHWH gave David victory wherever he went.
And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
And from Tibhath and from Kun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze; with it Solomon made the bronze sea and the pillars and the bronze articles.
And Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck down all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

and he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him of his welfare and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him — for Hadadezer had been a man of wars with Tou — and all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze.

These also King David consecrated to YHWH, with the silver and the gold that he had carried off from all the nations: from Edom and from Moab and from the people of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek.
And Abshai son of Zeruiah struck down Edom in the Valley of Salt — eighteen thousand.
And he put garrisons in Edom, and all Edom became subjects to David; and YHWH gave David victory wherever he went.
And David reigned over all Israel, and he was doing justice and righteousness for all his people.
And Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
and Zadok son of Ahitub and Abimelech son of Abiathar were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were the first at the king's side.

1 chronicles_19.t: And it was after this that Nahash king of the people of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

And David said: I will do loyalty with Hanun son of Nahash, for his father did loyalty with me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came into the land of the people of Ammon, to Hanun, to comfort him.

And the officials of the people of Ammon said to Hanun: Is David honouring your father in your eyes, that he has sent comforters to you? Is it not in order to explore and to overthrow and to spy out the land that his servants have come to you?
And Hanun took David's servants and shaved them, and cut off their robes in the middle, up to the buttocks, and sent them away.
And they went and told David about the men, and he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly humiliated. And the king said: Stay at Jericho until your beard grows back, and then return.

And the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious with David, and Hanun and the people of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariotry and horsemen from Aram-naharaim and from Aram-maacah and from Zobah.

And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; and they came and encamped before Medeba. And the people of Ammon gathered from their cities and came for battle.
And David heard, and he sent Joab and all the army, the mighty men.
And the people of Ammon went out and deployed for battle at the entrance of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.
And Joab saw that the face of the battle was against him, front and rear, and he chose from all the choice men in Israel and deployed to meet Aram.
And the rest of the people he put into the hand of Abshai his brother, and they deployed to meet the people of Ammon.
And he said: If Aram is too strong for me, then you shall be my deliverance; and if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will deliver you.
Be strong, and let us show ourselves strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and YHWH will do what is good in his eyes.
And Joab and the people who were with him drew near before Aram for battle, and they fled from before him.
And the people of Ammon saw that Aram had fled, and they too fled from before Abshai his brother, and went into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.

And Aram saw that they had been defeated before Israel, and they sent messengers and brought out the Arameans who were from beyond the River; and Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army was before them.
And it was told to David, and he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan and came to them and deployed against them; and David deployed to meet Aram in battle, and they fought with him.
And Aram fled from before Israel, and David killed of Aram seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers; and he put to death Shophach the commander of the army.
And the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated before Israel, and they made peace with David and served him; and Aram was not willing to deliver the people of Ammon again.

1 chronicles_20.t: And it was at the time of the turn of the year, at the time when kings go out, that Joab led out the army of the war and destroyed the land of the people of Ammon; and he came and besieged Rabbah, while David was staying in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and overthrew it.

And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone; and it was put on David's head. And he brought out the plunder of the city, very much.

And the people who were in it he brought out, and he sawed with the saw and with iron picks and with axes; and so David did to all the cities of the people of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
And it was after this that a battle arose at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, one of those born of the Rephaites, and they were subdued.
And there was again a battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair struck down Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
And there was again a battle at Gath; and there was a man of great stature, and his digits were six and six, twenty-four; and he too was born to the Rapha.
And he taunted Israel, and Jonathan son of Shimea, David's brother, struck him down.
These were born to the Rapha in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

1 chronicles_21.t: And Satan stood up against Israel, and he incited David to count Israel.
And David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people: Go, count Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring the number to me, that I may know it.

And Joab said: May YHWH add to his people a hundred times as many as they are! Are they not, my lord the king, all of them my lord's subjects? Why does my lord seek this? Why should it become guilt for Israel?
But the king's word prevailed over Joab, and Joab went out and went about through all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

And Joab gave the number of the muster of the people to David; and all Israel was a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Judah four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew the sword.
But Levi and Benjamin he did not enrol among them, for the king's word was abhorrent to Joab.
And it was displeasing in the eyes of God concerning this matter, and he struck Israel.
And David said to God: I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. And now, take away, please, the guilt of your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.
And YHWH spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying:
Go and speak to David, saying: Thus says YHWH: Three things I am holding out over you; choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.
And Gad came to David and said to him: Thus says YHWH: Take for yourself —

whether three years of famine; or three months of being swept away from before your foes, with the sword of your enemies overtaking you; or three days of the sword of YHWH and pestilence in the land, with the messenger of YHWH destroying throughout all the territory of Israel. And now consider what word I shall bring back to the one who sent me.
And David said to Gad: It is very distressing to me. Let me fall, please, into the hand of YHWH, for his compassion is very great; but into the hand of a human let me not fall.
And YHWH put a pestilence on Israel, and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

And God sent a messenger to Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was destroying, YHWH saw and relented concerning the calamity, and said to the destroying messenger: Enough! Now let your hand drop. And the messenger of YHWH was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

And David lifted up his eyes and saw the messenger of YHWH standing between the earth and the heavens, with his drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem; and David and the elders, covered in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

And David said to God: Was it not I who said to count the people? And I am the one who has sinned and done great evil; but these, the sheep — what have they done? YHWH my God, let your hand be against me and against my father's house, but not against your people, for a plague.
And the messenger of YHWH said to Gad to say to David that David should go up to set up an altar to YHWH on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
And David went up at the word of Gad, which he had spoken in the name of YHWH.
And Ornan turned and saw the messenger, and his four sons with him were hiding themselves; and Ornan was threshing wheat.
And David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David, and went out from the threshing floor and bowed down to David with his face to the ground.
And David said to Ornan: Give me the place of the threshing floor, that I may build on it an altar to YHWH — give it to me for full silver — that the plague may be restrained from upon the people.

And Ornan said to David: Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do what is good in his eyes. See, I give the oxen for the burnt offerings, and the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering — I give it all.
And King David said to Ornan: No — for I will certainly buy it for full silver; for I will not take what is yours for YHWH, or offer up a burnt offering for nothing.
And David gave Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

And David built there an altar to YHWH, and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings; and he called out to YHWH, and he answered him with fire from the heavens on the altar of the burnt offering.
And YHWH spoke to the messenger, and he returned his sword to its sheath.
At that time, when David saw that YHWH had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
And the tabernacle of YHWH, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering were at that time at the high place in Gibeon.
And David was not able to go before it to seek God, for he was terrified of the sword of the messenger of YHWH.

1 chronicles_22.t: And David said: This is the house of YHWH God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.
And David said to gather the sojourners who were in the land of Israel, and he appointed stonecutters to cut hewn stones to build the house of God.
And iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the clamps David prepared; and bronze in abundance, without weight;
and cedar wood without number — for the Sidonians and the Tyrians had brought cedar wood in abundance to David.

And David said: Solomon my son is a youth and tender, and the house to be built for YHWH is to be made exceedingly great, for a name and for splendour to all the lands. Let me now prepare for it. And David prepared in abundance before his death.
And he summoned Solomon his son and commanded him to build a house for YHWH the God of Israel.
And David said to Solomon: My son, as for me, it was with my heart to build a house for the name of YHWH my God.
But the word of YHWH came to me, saying: You have shed blood in abundance and made great wars. You shall not build a house for my name, for you have shed much blood on the ground before me.

Here, a son is about to be born to you; he will be a man of rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for Solomon will be his name, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
He will build a house for my name, and he will be a son to me and I a father to him; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
Now, my son, may YHWH be with you, and may you succeed and build the house of YHWH your God, as he spoke concerning you.
Only may YHWH give you insight and understanding, and give you charge over Israel, and to keep the law of YHWH your God.
Then you will succeed, if you take care to do the statutes and the judgements that YHWH commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and be courageous; do not be afraid and do not be dismayed.

And here, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of YHWH a hundred thousand talents of gold and a thousand thousand talents of silver, and for the bronze and the iron there is no weight, for it is in abundance; and wood and stones I have prepared, and you will add to them.
