And he will return to his own land with great property; and his heart will be against the covenant of holiness. And he will act, and return to his own land.
At the appointed time he will return and come into the south; but it will not be as the former time and as the latter.

And ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will be disheartened. And he will turn back and direct indignation against the covenant of holiness, and he will act; and he will turn back and pay attention to those who forsake the covenant of holiness.
And forces from him will arise, and they will profane the sanctuary, the stronghold; and they will abolish the perpetual, and they will set up the detestable thing that desolates.
And those who act wickedly against the covenant he will pollute with flattering words; but a people who know their God will display strength and act.
And those who have insight among the people will give understanding to the many; but they will stumble by sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, for days.
And when they stumble they will be helped with a little help; and many will join themselves to them with intrigues.
And some of those who have insight will stumble, to refine among them and to purge and to make white, until the time of the end; for it is still for the appointed time.

And the king will do according to his pleasure; and he will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and against the God of gods he will speak extraordinary things. And he will succeed until the indignation is completed, for what is decreed will be done.
And to the gods of his fathers he will pay no attention, nor to the desire of women, nor to any god will he pay attention; for above all he will magnify himself.

And to a god of strongholds, in its place, he will give honour; and to a god whom his fathers did not know he will give honour with gold and with silver and with costly stone and with precious things.

And he will act for the fortresses of strongholds with a foreign god; whoever acknowledges him he will increase in honour, and he will make them rule over the many, and he will divide land for a price.

And at the time of the end the king of the south will wage war with him; and the king of the north will storm against him with chariotry and with horsemen and with many ships; and he will come into lands and overflow and pass through.
And he will come into the land of beauty, and many will stumble; but these will escape from his hand: Edom and Moab and the first of the people of Ammon.
And he will stretch out his hand against lands, and the land of Egypt will not be for an escaped remnant.
And he will rule over the treasures of gold and silver and over all the precious things of Egypt; and Libyans and Cushites will be in his footsteps.
But reports from the east and from the north will dismay him; and he will go out in great rage to destroy and to devote many to destruction.
And he will pitch the tents of his palace between the seas and the mountain of the beauty of holiness; and he will come to his end, and there will be no helper for him.

daniel_12.t: And at that time Michael, the great prince who stands over the sons of your people, will arise. And there will be a time of distress such as has not happened since a nation came to be until that time; and at that time your people will escape — everyone who is found written in the scroll.
And many of the sleepers of the ground of dust will awake — these to life of perpetuity, and these to reproaches, to abhorrence of perpetuity.
And those who have insight will shine like the shining of the firmament, and those who turn the many to righteousness like the stars, for ever and ever.
And you, Daniel, keep the words secret and seal up the scroll until the time of the end. Many will rove about, and knowledge will increase.
And I, Daniel, saw, and behold, two others were standing, one here on the bank of the River and one here on the bank of the River.
And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the River: Until when is the end of the wonders?

And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the River; and he raised his right hand and his left to the heavens and swore by the one who lives for ever: that it is for a time, times and a half; and when the shattering of the hand of the people of holiness is finished, all these will be finished.
And I heard, but I did not understand; and I said: My lord, what will be the latter part of these things?
And he said: Go, Daniel, for the things are kept secret and sealed up until the time of the end.
Many will purge themselves and make themselves white and be refined; and the wicked will act wickedly, and none of the wicked will understand — but those who have insight will understand.
And from the time the perpetual is abolished, and to the setting up of the detestable thing that desolates, will be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
How blessed is the one who waits and reaches to a thousand three hundred and thirty-five days!
And you — go to the end; and you will rest, and you will arise to your allotted portion at the end of the days.

deuteronomy_1.t: These [are] the words which Moses spoke to all Israel across the Jordan, in the wilderness, in the desert plain opposite Suph, between Paran and between Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and Di Zahab.
[It is] eleven days from Horeb, the way of Mount Seir, as far as Kadesh Barnea.
And it was, in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that YHWH had commanded him for them.
after he had struck down Sihon king of the Amorites, who was dwelling in Heshbon, and Og king of the Bashan, who was dwelling in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
Across the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to make plain this law, saying:
YHWH our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying: Enough for you, remaining at this mountain!

Turn and set out for yourselves and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all its neighbours — in the desert plain, in the hill country and in the Shephelah and in the Negev and on the coast of the sea — the land of the Canaanites, and the Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
See, I have set the land before you. Go in and take possession of the land which YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob, to give to them and to their offspring after them.
And I said to you at that time, saying: I am not able by myself to bear you.
YHWH your God has multiplied you, and here you are today like the stars of the heavens for multitude.
May YHWH, the God of your fathers, add to you a thousand times as many as you are, and may he bless you as he has spoken to you.
How can I bear by myself your load and your burden and your disputes?
Provide for yourselves men, wise and understanding and known, for your tribes, and I will set them as your heads.
And you answered me and said: The thing which you have spoken is good to do.

And I took the heads of your tribes, men wise and known, and I set them as heads over you — leaders of thousands and leaders of hundreds and leaders of fifties and leaders of tens, and officials for your tribes.
And I commanded your judges at that time, saying: Hear between your brothers and judge righteousness between a man and his brother and between his sojourner.

You shall not regard faces in judgement. You shall hear the small as the great. You shall not be afraid before any man, for the judgement belongs to God. And the matter which is too hard for you, you shall bring near to me, and I will hear it.
And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

And we set out from Horeb and we went through all that great and awesome wilderness which you saw, the way of the hill country of the Amorites, just as YHWH our God had commanded us, and we came as far as Kadesh Barnea.
And I said to you: You have come as far as the hill country of the Amorites, which YHWH our God is giving to us.
See, YHWH your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, just as YHWH the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed.

And you drew near to me, all of you, and you said: Let us send men before us, and let them search out the land for us, and let them bring back to us word — the way by which we should go up and the cities we should come to.
And the thing was good in my eyes, and I took twelve men from you, one man for each tribe.
And they turned and went up to the hill country and came as far as the wadi of Eshcol, and they spied it out.
And they took in their hand some of the fruit of the land and brought it down to us, and they brought back to us word and said: The land which YHWH our God is giving to us is good.
But you were not willing to go up, and you rebelled against the mouth of YHWH your God.
And you murmured in your tents and said: In YHWH's hatred of us he brought us out from the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
Where are we going up? Our brothers have melted our heart, saying: A people greater and taller than we; cities great and fortified up to the heavens; and also we saw the sons of the Anakim there.
And I said to you: Do not be terrified and do not be afraid of them.
YHWH your God, the one going before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did with you in Egypt before your eyes,
and in the wilderness, where you saw that YHWH your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went until you came to this place.
Yet in this thing you were not trusting in YHWH your God,
the one going before you on the way to seek out for you a place for your camping — in the fire by night, to show you the way by which you should go, and in the cloud by day.
And YHWH heard the sound of your words, and he was angry and swore, saying:
If any man among these men, this evil generation, shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers — !
except Caleb son of Jephunneh — he shall see it, and to him I will give the land on which he has trodden, and to his sons, because he filled after YHWH.
Also with me YHWH was angry on your account, saying: You also shall not go in there.
Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall go in there. Strengthen him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

And your little ones, of whom you said they would become plunder, and your children, who today do not know good and evil — they shall go in there, and to them I will give it, and they shall take possession of it.
But as for you, turn and set out for yourselves to the wilderness, the way of the Sea of Reeds.

And you answered and said to me: We have sinned against YHWH. We ourselves will go up and fight, according to all that YHWH our God commanded us. And each man girded on his weapons of war, and you thought it easy to go up to the hill country.
And YHWH said to me: Say to them, You shall not go up and you shall not fight, for I am not in your midst, lest you be struck down before your enemies.
And I spoke to you, and you did not listen, and you rebelled against the mouth of YHWH, and you acted presumptuously and went up to the hill country.
And the Amorites who were dwelling in that hill country came out to meet you, and they pursued you as bees do, and they beat you down in Seir as far as Hormah.
And you returned and wept before YHWH, and YHWH did not listen to your voice and did not give ear to you.
And you stayed at Kadesh many days — like the days that you stayed.

deuteronomy_2.t: And we turned and set out toward the wilderness, the way of the Sea of Reeds, just as YHWH had spoken to me, and we went around the hill country of Seir many days.
And YHWH said to me, saying:
Enough for you, going around this hill country! Turn for yourselves northward.
And command the people, saying: You are passing through the territory of your brothers, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, and they will be afraid of you. And you shall take great heed.
Do not engage in strife with them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a treading-place for the sole of a foot, for I have given the hill country of Seir to Esau as a possession.
Food you shall buy from them with silver, and you shall eat; and also water you shall buy from them with silver, and you shall drink.

For YHWH your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years YHWH your God has been with you; you have not lacked a thing.

And we passed by, away from our brothers the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, away from the way of the desert plain, from Elath and from Ezion Geber. And we turned and passed along the way of the wilderness of Moab.

And YHWH said to me: Do not harass Moab and do not engage in strife with them in battle, for I will not give you any of his land as a possession, for I have given Ar to the sons of Lot as a possession.
The Emim formerly dwelt in it — a people great and numerous and tall, like the Anakim.
Rephaim they too were reckoned, like the Anakim, and the Moabites call them Emim.

And in Seir the Horites formerly dwelt, and the sons of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them and dwelt in their place — just as Israel did to the land of his possession, which YHWH gave to them.
Now arise and cross over for yourselves the Wadi Zered. And we crossed over the Wadi Zered.

And the days that we walked from Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Wadi Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation, the men of war, were finished from the midst of the camp, just as YHWH had sworn to them.
And also the hand of YHWH was against them, to rout them from the midst of the camp until they were finished.
And it was, when all the men of war had finished dying from the midst of the people,
YHWH spoke to me, saying:
You are passing today through the border of Moab, Ar.

And you will draw near opposite the sons of Ammon. Do not harass them and do not engage in strife with them, for I will not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as a possession, for I have given it to the sons of Lot as a possession.
A land of Rephaim it too was reckoned. Rephaim formerly dwelt in it, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim.
a people great and numerous and tall, like the Anakim. And YHWH destroyed them from before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place —
just as he did for the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them, and they dispossessed them and have dwelt in their place until this day.
And the Avvim, who dwell in villages as far as Gaza — the Caphtorim, who came out from Caphtor, destroyed them and dwelt in their place.
Arise, set out and cross over the Wadi Arnon. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin, take possession, and engage in strife with him in battle.
This day I begin to put your dread and your fear on the face of the peoples under all the heavens, who will hear the report of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you.
And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon, words of peace, saying:
Let me pass through your land. On the road, on the road I will go; I will not turn aside right or left.
Food for silver you shall sell me, and I will eat; and water for silver you shall give me, and I will drink. Only let me pass through on my feet —
just as the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir did for me, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar — until I cross the Jordan into the land which YHWH our God is giving to us.
But Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing to let us pass through him, for YHWH your God had hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, in order to give him into your hand, as at this day.
And YHWH said to me: See, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you. Begin, take possession, to take possession of his land.
And Sihon came out to meet us, he and all his people, to the battle at Jahaz.
And YHWH our God gave him before us, and we struck him down, and his sons, and all his people.
And we captured all his cities at that time, and we devoted to destruction every city of men, and the women and the little ones. We did not leave a survivor.
Only the livestock we plundered for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities that we had captured.
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the wadi, and as far as the Gilead — there was no town that was too high for us. YHWH our God gave everything before us.
Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not draw near — all the side of the Wadi Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and all that YHWH our God had commanded.

deuteronomy_3.t: And we turned and went up the way of the Bashan, and Og king of the Bashan came out to meet us, he and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
And YHWH said to me: Do not fear him, for into your hand I have given him and all his people and his land, and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon.
And YHWH our God gave into our hand also Og king of the Bashan and all his people, and we struck him down until there was no survivor left to him.
And we captured all his cities at that time. There was no town that we did not take from them — sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in the Bashan.
All these were fortified cities — a high wall, double gates and a bar — apart from the cities of the hamlet-dwellers, very many.
And we devoted them to destruction, just as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon — devoting to destruction every city of men, the women and the little ones.
And all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we plundered for ourselves.
And we took at that time the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan, from the Wadi Arnon as far as Mount Hermon —
the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir —
all the cities of the plain and all the Gilead and all the Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in the Bashan.

For only Og king of the Bashan was left from the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bed was a bed of iron — is it not in Rabbah of the sons of Ammon? Nine cubits its length and four cubits its breadth, by the cubit of a man.
And this land we took possession of at that time. From Aroer, which is at the Wadi Arnon, and half the hill country of the Gilead and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
And the remainder of the Gilead and all the Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh — all the region of the Argob, all that Bashan; that is called the land of Rephaim.
Jair son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and he called them by his own name — the Bashan — Havvoth Jair, until this day.
And to Makir I gave the Gilead.
And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from the Gilead as far as the Wadi Arnon — the middle of the wadi and a border — and as far as the Jabbok, the wadi, the border of the sons of Ammon;
and the Arabah, and the Jordan and a border, from Kinnereth as far as the Sea of the Arabah, the Sea of Salt, under the slopes of the Pisgah eastward.

And I commanded you at that time, saying: YHWH your God has given you this land to take possession of it. Equipped for battle you shall cross over before your brothers, the sons of Israel — all the sons of valour.
Only your wives and your little ones and your livestock — I know that you have much livestock — shall remain in your cities which I have given you,

until YHWH gives rest to your brothers as to you, and they also take possession of the land which YHWH your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then you shall return, each man to his possession which I have given you.
And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying: Your eyes are the ones that have seen all that YHWH your God did to these two kings. So YHWH will do to all the kingdoms into which you are crossing over.
You shall not fear them, for YHWH your God, he is the one fighting for you.
And I sought favour from YHWH at that time, saying:

Lord YHWH, you have begun to show your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in the heavens or on the earth who can do according to your works and according to your mighty deeds?
Let me cross over, please, and see the good land that is across the Jordan — this good hill country and the Lebanon.
But YHWH was furious with me on your account and did not listen to me. And YHWH said to me: Enough for you! Do not speak to me again about this matter.
Go up to the top of the Pisgah and lift up your eyes westward and northward and southward and eastward, and see with your own eyes, for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
And commission Joshua and encourage him and strengthen him, for he shall cross over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you will see.
And we stayed in the valley opposite Beth Peor.

deuteronomy_4.t: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I am teaching you to do, so that you may live and go in and take possession of the land which YHWH, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
You shall not add to the word which I am commanding you, and you shall not take away from it, so as to keep the commandments of YHWH your God which I am commanding you.
Your eyes are the ones that saw what YHWH did at Baal Peor, for every man who walked after Baal Peor — YHWH your God destroyed him from your midst.
But you, the ones clinging to YHWH your God, are alive, all of you, today.
See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, just as YHWH my God commanded me, to do so in the midst of the land which you are going into to take possession of it.

And you shall keep and do them, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples, who will hear all these statutes and will say: Surely a wise and understanding people is this great nation.
For what great nation is there that has a god near to it as YHWH our God is, whenever we call on him?
And what great nation is there that has righteous statutes and ordinances like all this law which I am setting before you today?

Only take heed to yourself and guard your self exceedingly, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; and you shall make them known to your children and to your children's children —

the day when you stood before YHWH your God at Horeb, when YHWH said to me: Assemble the people to me and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the ground, and they shall teach their children.
And you drew near and stood under the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire up to the heart of the heavens — darkness, cloud and thick darkness.
And YHWH spoke to you from the midst of the fire. A sound of words you were hearing, but a form you were not seeing — only a voice.
And he declared to you his covenant which he commanded you to do — the ten words — and he wrote them on two tablets of stone.
And me YHWH commanded at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, for you to do them in the land into which you are crossing over to take possession of it.
And you shall take great heed to yourselves — for you saw no form on the day YHWH spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire —
lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves an image, a form of any figure, a likeness of male or female,
a likeness of any animal that is on the earth, a likeness of any winged bird that flies in the heavens,
a likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, a likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth.

and lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens and see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of the heavens, and be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them — which YHWH your God has allotted to all the peoples under all the heavens.
But you YHWH took, and he brought you out from the furnace of iron, from Egypt, to become for him a people of inheritance, as at this day.
And YHWH was angry with me on account of your words, and he swore that I should not cross the Jordan and that I should not go into the good land which YHWH your God is giving you as an inheritance.
For I am dying in this land; I am not crossing the Jordan. But you are crossing over, and you shall take possession of this good land.
Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of YHWH your God which he cut with you, and make for yourselves an image, a form of anything, which YHWH your God has commanded you.
For YHWH your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

When you father children and children's children and have grown old in the land, and you act corruptly and make an image, a form of anything, and do what is evil in the eyes of YHWH your God, to provoke him to anger —

I call as witnesses against you today the heavens and the earth, that perishing you shall quickly perish from upon the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. You shall not prolong days upon it, for being destroyed you shall be destroyed.
And YHWH will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where YHWH will drive you.
And there you will serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and stone, which do not see and do not hear and do not eat and do not smell.
And from there you will seek YHWH your God, and you will find him, for you will search for him with all your heart and with all your soul.
In your distress, when all these things have come upon you, in the latter days, you will return to YHWH your God and listen to his voice.
For YHWH your God is a compassionate God. He will not abandon you and will not destroy you, and he will not forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

For ask now of the former days that were before you, from the day when God created humankind on the earth, and from one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens: has anything happened like this great thing, or has anything been heard like it?
Has a people heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and lived?

Or has a god attempted to come and take for himself a nation from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs and by wonders, and by battle and by a strong hand and by an outstretched arm and by great terrors, according to all that YHWH your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
You yourself were shown, to know that YHWH, he is the God; there is no other besides him.
From the heavens he made you hear his voice, to discipline you; and on the earth he showed you his great fire, and his words you heard from the midst of the fire.
And because he loved your fathers, he chose their offspring after them, and he brought you out by his presence, by his great power, from Egypt,
to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you from before you, to bring you in, to give you their land as an inheritance, as at this day.
And you shall know today and bring back to your heart that YHWH, he is the God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.

And you shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I am commanding you today, so that it may go well for you and for your children after you, and so that you may prolong days upon the ground which YHWH your God is giving you for all time.
Then Moses set apart three cities across the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
for a killer to flee there who kills his neighbour without knowledge, and he was not hating him from yesterday or the day before; and he shall flee to one of these cities and live —
Bezer in the wilderness, in the land of the plain, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in the Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in the Bashan for the Manassites.
And this is the law which Moses set before the sons of Israel.
These are the testimonies and the statutes and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
across the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel struck down when they came out of Egypt.
And they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of the Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun,
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, as far as Mount Siyon — that is Hermon —
and all the Arabah across the Jordan eastward, as far as the Sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of the Pisgah.

deuteronomy_5.t: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I am speaking in your ears today; and you shall learn them and keep them, to do them.
YHWH our God cut with us a covenant at Horeb.
Not with our fathers did YHWH cut this covenant, but with us — we, these here, today, all of us alive.
Face to face YHWH spoke with you at the mountain, from the midst of the fire.
I was standing between YHWH and you at that time, to declare to you the word of YHWH — for you were afraid because of the fire and did not go up the mountain — saying:
I am YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.
There shall not be for you other gods before my face.
You shall not make for yourself a carved image of any form that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth.

You shall not bow down to them and you shall not serve them; for I, YHWH your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of fathers upon sons, upon a third generation and upon a fourth generation, of those who hate me,
and doing steadfast love to thousands, to those who love me and to those who keep my commandments.
You shall not take up the name of YHWH your God for emptiness, for YHWH will not leave unpunished the one who takes up his name for emptiness.
Keep the day of the sabbath, to set it apart as holy, just as YHWH your God commanded you.
Six days you shall labour and do all your work,

and the seventh day is a sabbath to YHWH your God. You shall not do any work — you, and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and your ox and your donkey and all your livestock, and your sojourner who is within your gates — so that your male servant and your female servant may rest like you.

And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and YHWH your God brought you out from there by a strong hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore YHWH your God commanded you to do the day of the sabbath.
Honour your father and your mother, just as YHWH your God commanded you, so that your days may be long and so that it may go well for you upon the ground which YHWH your God is giving you.
You shall not murder.
And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal.
And you shall not testify against your neighbour as a witness of emptiness.

And you shall not covet the wife of your neighbour. And you shall not desire the house of your neighbour, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbour's.

These words YHWH spoke to all your assembly at the mountain, from the midst of the fire, the cloud and the thick darkness — a great voice — and he did not add. And he wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
And it was, when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, that you drew near to me — all the heads of your tribes and your elders —

and you said: Behold, YHWH our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and his voice we have heard from the midst of the fire. This day we have seen that God speaks with a human being and he lives.
And now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we go on hearing the voice of YHWH our God any more, then we shall die.
For who of all flesh is there that has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
You draw near and hear all that YHWH our God says, and you shall speak to us all that YHWH our God speaks to you, and we will listen and do it.

And YHWH heard the sound of your words when you spoke to me, and YHWH said to me: I have heard the sound of the words of this people which they spoke to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
Who will give that this heart of theirs should be theirs, to fear me and to keep all my commandments all the days, so that it may go well for them and for their children forever!
Go, say to them: Return to your tents.

But you, stand here with me, and I will speak to you all the commandment and the statutes and the ordinances which you shall teach them, and they shall do them in the land which I am giving to them to take possession of it.
And you shall keep to do just as YHWH your God has commanded you. You shall not turn aside right or left.
In all the way which YHWH your God has commanded you, you shall walk, so that you may live and it may be good for you, and you may prolong days in the land which you will take possession of.

deuteronomy_6.t: And this is the commandment, the statutes and the ordinances, which YHWH your God commanded to teach you, to do in the land into which you are crossing over to take possession of it,

so that you may fear YHWH your God, keeping all his statutes and his commandments which I am commanding you — you and your son and your son's son — all the days of your life, and so that your days may be long.

And you shall hear, Israel, and keep to do, so that it may go well for you and so that you may increase greatly, just as YHWH, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you — a land flowing with milk and honey.
Hear, Israel: YHWH our God, YHWH is one.
And you shall love YHWH your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your muchness.
And these words which I am commanding you today shall be upon your heart.
And you shall repeat them to your children, and you shall speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise up.
And you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as marks between your eyes.
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.
And it shall be, when YHWH your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob, to give to you — great and good cities which you did not build,
and houses full of every good thing which you did not fill, and hewn cisterns which you did not hew, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant — and you shall eat and be satisfied.
take heed to yourself lest you forget YHWH, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.
YHWH your God you shall fear, and him you shall serve, and by his name you shall swear.
You shall not walk after other gods, from among the gods of the peoples who are around you —
for a jealous God is YHWH your God in your midst — lest the anger of YHWH your God burn against you and he destroy you from upon the face of the ground.
You shall not put YHWH your God to the test, as you put him to the test at Massah.
Keeping you shall keep the commandments of YHWH your God, and his testimonies and his statutes which he has commanded you.
And you shall do what is right and good in the eyes of YHWH, so that it may go well for you, and you shall go in and take possession of the good land which YHWH swore to your fathers,
to drive out all your enemies from before you, just as YHWH has spoken.
When your son asks you tomorrow, saying: What are the testimonies and the statutes and the ordinances which YHWH our God commanded you? —
then you shall say to your son: We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and YHWH brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand.
And YHWH gave signs and wonders, great and grievous, against Egypt, against Pharaoh and against all his household, before our eyes.
And us he brought out from there, in order to bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
And YHWH commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear YHWH our God, for our good all the days, to keep us alive as at this day.
And it will be righteousness for us if we keep to do all this commandment before YHWH our God, just as he commanded us.

deuteronomy_7.t: When YHWH your God brings you into the land into which you are going to take possession of it, and clears away many nations from before you — the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you —
and YHWH your God gives them before you and you strike them down — devoting you shall devote them to destruction. You shall not cut a covenant with them and you shall not show them favour.
And you shall not intermarry with them. Your daughter you shall not give to his son, and his daughter you shall not take for your son,
for he will turn your son aside from after me, and they will serve other gods, and the anger of YHWH will burn against you, and he will destroy you quickly.
But this is what you shall do to them: their altars you shall break down, and their pillars you shall shatter, and their Asherim you shall cut down, and their images you shall burn with fire.
For you are a people set apart as holy to YHWH your God. You YHWH your God chose to be for him a people of treasured possession out of all the peoples who are on the face of the ground.
Not because you were more numerous than all the peoples did YHWH set his love on you and choose you — for you were the fewest of all the peoples —

but because of YHWH's love for you and because he kept the oath which he swore to your fathers, YHWH brought you out with a strong hand and redeemed you from a house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

And you shall know that YHWH your God, he is the God, the faithful God, keeping the covenant and the steadfast love to those who love him and to those who keep his commandments, to a thousand generations,
and repaying those who hate him to his face, to destroy him. He will not delay with the one who hates him; to his face he will repay him.
And you shall keep the commandment and the statutes and the ordinances which I am commanding you today, to do them.
And it shall be, as a consequence of your hearing these ordinances and keeping and doing them, that YHWH your God will keep for you the covenant and the steadfast love which he swore to your fathers.

And he will love you and bless you and multiply you, and he will bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground — your grain and your new wine and your fresh oil, the offspring of your cattle and the young of your flock — upon the ground which he swore to your fathers to give to you.
Blessed you shall be above all the peoples. There shall not be among you a sterile male or a barren female, or among your livestock.
And YHWH will remove from you every sickness, and all the grievous diseases of Egypt which you knew he will not put on you, and he will set them on all who hate you.
And you shall consume all the peoples whom YHWH your God is giving to you. Your eye shall not look with pity on them, and you shall not serve their gods, for that would be a snare to you.
If you say in your heart: These nations are greater than I — how can I dispossess them? —
you shall not be afraid of them. Remembering you shall remember what YHWH your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt —

the great trials which your eyes saw, and the signs and the wonders, and the strong hand and the outstretched arm, by which YHWH your God brought you out. So YHWH your God will do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
And also the hornet YHWH your God will send among them, until those who remain and those who hide themselves from before you perish.
You shall not be terrified of them, for YHWH your God is in your midst, a great and awesome God.
And YHWH your God will clear away these nations from before you little by little. You will not be able to make an end of them quickly, lest the animals of the field increase against you.
And YHWH your God will give them before you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
And he will give their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under the heavens. No man shall stand before you until you have destroyed them.
The images of their gods you shall burn with fire. You shall not covet the silver and gold on them and take it for yourself, lest you be ensnared by it, for it is an abomination to YHWH your God.
And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, and so become devoted to destruction like it. Detesting you shall detest it and abhorring you shall abhor it, for it is devoted to destruction.

deuteronomy_8.t: All the commandment which I am commanding you today you shall keep to do, so that you may live and increase and go in and take possession of the land which YHWH swore to your fathers.

And you shall remember all the way which YHWH your God led you these forty years in the wilderness, in order to humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart — whether you would keep his commandments or not.

And he humbled you and let you hunger, and he fed you the manna, which you did not know and your fathers did not know, in order to make you know that a human being does not live on bread alone, but a human being lives on every utterance of the mouth of YHWH.
Your clothing did not wear out from upon you, and your foot did not swell, these forty years.
And you shall know with your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, YHWH your God is disciplining you.
And you shall keep the commandments of YHWH your God, by walking in his ways and by fearing him.
For YHWH your God is bringing you into a good land — a land of streams of water, of springs and deeps flowing out in the valley and in the hill country,
a land of wheat and barley and vine and fig and pomegranate, a land of oil-olive and honey,
a land in which you will eat bread without scarcity, in which you will lack nothing; a land whose stones are iron, and from whose hills you will dig copper.
And you shall eat and be satisfied, and you shall bless YHWH your God for the good land which he has given you.
Take heed to yourself, lest you forget YHWH your God, so as not to keep his commandments and his ordinances and his statutes which I am commanding you today —
lest you eat and be satisfied, and build good houses and dwell in them,
and your herd and your flock increase, and silver and gold increase for you, and all that you have increases,
and your heart is lifted up, and you forget YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves,
who led you through the great and awesome wilderness — fiery serpent and scorpion and thirsty ground where there was no water — who brought out water for you from the flinty rock,
who fed you manna in the wilderness, which your fathers did not know, in order to humble you and in order to test you, to do you good in your latter end —
and you say in your heart: My strength and the might of my hand have made this wealth for me.
But you shall remember YHWH your God, that it is he who gives you strength to make wealth, in order to confirm his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as at this day.
And it shall be, if forgetting you forget YHWH your God and walk after other gods and serve them and bow down to them, I testify against you today that perishing you shall perish.
Like the nations which YHWH is destroying from before you, so you shall perish — as a consequence of your not listening to the voice of YHWH your God.

deuteronomy_9.t: Hear, Israel: you are crossing the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you, cities great and fortified up to the heavens,
a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know and of whom you have heard: Who can stand before the sons of Anak?

And you shall know today that YHWH your God, he is the one crossing over before you, a consuming fire. He will destroy them and he will subdue them before you, and you shall dispossess them and destroy them quickly, just as YHWH has spoken to you.

Do not say in your heart, when YHWH your God drives them out from before you: Because of my righteousness YHWH has brought me in to take possession of this land. But it is because of the wickedness of these nations that YHWH is dispossessing them from before you.

Not because of your righteousness and the uprightness of your heart are you going in to take possession of their land, but because of the wickedness of these nations YHWH your God is dispossessing them from before you, and in order to confirm the word which YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob.
And you shall know that not because of your righteousness is YHWH your God giving you this good land to take possession of it, for you are a stiff-necked people.

Remember, do not forget, how you provoked YHWH your God to anger in the wilderness. From the day you came out from the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebelling against YHWH.
And at Horeb you provoked YHWH to anger, and YHWH was angry with you enough to destroy you.

When I went up the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which YHWH cut with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. Bread I did not eat and water I did not drink.

And YHWH gave me the two tablets of stone, written by the finger of God, and on them was according to all the words which YHWH spoke with you on the mountain from the midst of the fire, on the day of the assembly.
And it was, at the end of forty days and forty nights, YHWH gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

And YHWH said to me: Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you brought out from Egypt have acted corruptly. They have turned aside quickly from the way which I commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten image.
And YHWH said to me, saying: I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.
Let me alone, and I will destroy them and wipe out their name from under the heavens, and I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they.
And I turned and went down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire, and the two tablets of the covenant were on my two hands.
And I saw, and behold, you had sinned against YHWH your God. You had made for yourselves a calf of cast metal. You had turned aside quickly from the way which YHWH had commanded you.
And I seized the two tablets and threw them from upon my two hands, and I broke them before your eyes.

And I fell down before YHWH as at the first, forty days and forty nights. Bread I did not eat and water I did not drink — because of all your sin which you had sinned, in doing what was evil in the eyes of YHWH, to provoke him to anger.
For I was afraid because of the anger and the rage with which YHWH was angry against you, enough to destroy you. And YHWH listened to me also at that time.
And with Aaron YHWH was very angry, enough to destroy him; and I prayed also for Aaron at that time.

And your sin, which you had made — the calf — I took and burned with fire, and I crushed it, grinding it well until it was fine as dust, and I threw its dust into the wadi that comes down from the mountain.
And at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah you were provoking YHWH to anger.

And when YHWH sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying: Go up and take possession of the land which I have given you — then you rebelled against the mouth of YHWH your God, and you did not trust him and did not listen to his voice.
Rebelling you have been against YHWH from the day I knew you.
And I fell down before YHWH the forty days and the forty nights that I fell down, for YHWH had said he would destroy you.
And I prayed to YHWH and said: Lord YHWH, do not destroy your people and your inheritance, whom you redeemed by your greatness, whom you brought out from Egypt with a strong hand.
Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Do not turn toward the stubbornness of this people, or toward its wickedness, or toward its sin,

lest the land from which you brought us out should say: Because YHWH was not able to bring them into the land which he spoke of to them, and because of his hatred of them, he brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.
And they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out by your great strength and by your outstretched arm.

deuteronomy_10.t: At that time YHWH said to me: Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to me on the mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood.
And I will write on the tablets the words which were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.
And I made an ark of acacia wood and cut two tablets of stone like the first, and I went up the mountain, and the two tablets were in my hand.
And he wrote on the tablets, like the first writing, the ten words which YHWH had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly, and YHWH gave them to me.
And I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark which I had made, and they have been there, just as YHWH commanded me.
And the sons of Israel set out from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son served as priest in his place.
From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.
At that time YHWH set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of YHWH, to stand before YHWH to serve him, and to bless in his name, until this day.
Therefore Levi has no portion or inheritance with his brothers. YHWH is his inheritance, just as YHWH your God spoke to him.
And I stood on the mountain like the former days, forty days and forty nights, and YHWH listened to me also that time; YHWH was not willing to destroy you.
And YHWH said to me: Arise, go on the journey before the people, so that they may go in and take possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.
And now, Israel, what is YHWH your God asking of you, except to fear YHWH your God, to walk in all his ways and to love him, and to serve YHWH your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
to keep the commandments of YHWH and his statutes which I am commanding you today, for your good?
Behold, to YHWH your God belong the heavens and the heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that is in it.
Only on your fathers did YHWH set his love, to love them, and he chose their offspring after them — you — out of all the peoples, as at this day.
And you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and your neck you shall not stiffen again.
For YHWH your God, he is the God of gods and the Lord of lords, the great, the mighty and the awesome God, who does not lift up faces and does not take a bribe,
doing justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loving the sojourner, giving him bread and clothing.
And you shall love the sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
YHWH your God you shall fear; him you shall serve, and to him you shall cling, and by his name you shall swear.
He is your praise and he is your God, who has done with you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
With seventy persons your fathers went down to Egypt, and now YHWH your God has made you like the stars of the heavens for multitude.

deuteronomy_11.t: And you shall love YHWH your God and keep his charge and his statutes and his ordinances and his commandments, all the days.
And you shall know today — for I am not speaking with your children, who have not known and have not seen the discipline of YHWH your God, his greatness, his strong hand and his outstretched arm,
and his signs and his deeds which he did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to all his land,

and what he did to the army of Egypt, to its horses and to its chariotry, when he made the waters of the Sea of Reeds flow over their faces as they pursued after you, and YHWH destroyed them, until this day;
and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

and what he did to Dathan and to Abiram, the sons of Eliab son of Reuben, when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households and their tents, and every living thing that was at their feet, in the midst of all Israel —
for your eyes are the ones that saw all the great work of YHWH which he did.
And you shall keep all the commandment which I am commanding you today, so that you may be strong and go in and take possession of the land into which you are crossing over to take possession of it,
and so that you may prolong days upon the ground which YHWH swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring — a land flowing with milk and honey.

For the land into which you are going to take possession of it is not like the land of Egypt, from which you came out, where you would sow your seed and water it with your foot, like a garden of vegetables.
But the land into which you are crossing over to take possession of it is a land of mountains and valleys; from the rain of the heavens it drinks water,
a land which YHWH your God cares for. Continually the eyes of YHWH your God are upon it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.
And it shall be, if listening you listen to my commandments which I am commanding you today, to love YHWH your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
then I will give the rain of your land in its season, the early rain and the later rain, and you shall gather your grain and your new wine and your fresh oil.
And I will give grass in your field for your livestock, and you shall eat and be satisfied.
Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be enticed and you turn aside and serve other gods and bow down to them,
and the anger of YHWH burn against you, and he shut up the heavens and there be no rain, and the ground not give its produce, and you perish quickly from upon the good land which YHWH is giving you.
And you shall put these my words upon your heart and upon your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as marks between your eyes.
And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise up.
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
so that your days and the days of your children may be many upon the ground which YHWH swore to your fathers to give to them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.
For if keeping you keep all this commandment which I am commanding you to do it — to love YHWH your God, to walk in all his ways and to cling to him —
then YHWH will dispossess all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than you.
Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours. From the wilderness and the Lebanon, from the River, the river Euphrates, to the western sea shall be your territory.
No man shall stand before you. YHWH your God will put the dread and fear of you on the face of all the land on which you tread, just as he has spoken to you.
See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of YHWH your God which I am commanding you today;
and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of YHWH your God, and you turn aside from the way which I am commanding you today, to walk after other gods which you have not known.
And it shall be, when YHWH your God brings you into the land into which you are going to take possession of it, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
Are they not across the Jordan, beyond the road of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
For you are crossing the Jordan to go in to take possession of the land which YHWH your God is giving you, and you shall take possession of it and dwell in it.
And you shall keep to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I am setting before you today.

deuteronomy_12.t: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall keep to do in the land which YHWH, the God of your fathers, has given you to take possession of it, all the days that you live upon the ground.
Destroying you shall destroy all the places where the nations whom you are dispossessing served their gods — on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.

And you shall break down their altars and shatter their pillars, and their Asherim you shall burn with fire, and the images of their gods you shall cut down, and you shall destroy their name from that place.
You shall not do so to YHWH your God.
But to the place which YHWH your God will choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there — to his dwelling you shall resort, and you shall come there.

And you shall bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, and your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and your vows and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock.
And you shall eat there before YHWH your God, and you shall rejoice in every undertaking of your hand, you and your households, in which YHWH your God has blessed you.
You shall not do according to all that we are doing here today, each man all that is right in his own eyes.
For you have not yet come to the resting place and to the inheritance which YHWH your God is giving you.
And you shall cross the Jordan and dwell in the land which YHWH your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies round about, and you shall dwell in security.

And the place which YHWH your God will choose to cause his name to dwell there — there you shall bring all that I am commanding you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and all the choice of your vows which you vow to YHWH.

And you shall rejoice before YHWH your God, you and your sons and your daughters, and your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates — for he has no portion or inheritance with you.
Take heed to yourself, lest you offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see.
But in the place which YHWH will choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer up your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I am commanding you.

Only, according to all the desire of your being you may slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of YHWH your God which he has given you, within all your gates. The unclean and the clean may eat it, as of the gazelle and as of the deer.
Only the blood you shall not eat; on the ground you shall pour it out like water.

You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain or your new wine or your fresh oil, or the firstborn of your herd or your flock, or any of your vows which you vow, or your freewill offerings, or the contribution of your hand.

But before YHWH your God you shall eat it, in the place which YHWH your God will choose — you and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates — and you shall rejoice before YHWH your God in every undertaking of your hand.
Take heed to yourself, lest you forsake the Levite all your days upon your ground.

When YHWH your God enlarges your territory, just as he spoke to you, and you say: Let me eat meat — because your being desires to eat meat — you may eat meat according to all the desire of your being.

If the place which YHWH your God will choose to put his name there is too far from you, then you shall slaughter from your herd and from your flock which YHWH has given you, just as I have commanded you, and you shall eat within your gates according to all the desire of your being.
Surely, just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it.
Only be strong not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the meat.
You shall not eat it; on the ground you shall pour it out like water.
You shall not eat it, so that it may go well for you and for your children after you, when you do what is right in the eyes of YHWH.
Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which YHWH will choose.

And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of YHWH your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of YHWH your God, and the flesh you shall eat.
Keep and hear all these words which I am commanding you, so that it may go well for you and for your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the eyes of YHWH your God.
When YHWH your God cuts off the nations, whom you are going in to dispossess, from before you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

take heed to yourself, lest you be ensnared after them, after they have been destroyed from before you, and lest you enquire after their gods, saying: How did these nations serve their gods? — and I will do so too.
You shall not do so to YHWH your God, for every abomination of YHWH, which he hates, they have done for their gods — for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire for their gods.
Every word which I am commanding you — it you shall keep to do. You shall not add to it and you shall not take away from it.

deuteronomy_13.t: If a prophet or a dreamer of a dream arises in your midst and gives you a sign or a wonder,
and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying: Let us walk after other gods, whom you have not known, and let us serve them —
you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or to that dreamer of the dream, for YHWH your God is testing you, to know whether you love YHWH your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
After YHWH your God you shall walk, and him you shall fear, and his commandments you shall keep, and to his voice you shall listen, and him you shall serve, and to him you shall cling.

And that prophet or that dreamer of the dream shall be put to death, for he has spoken rebellion against YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from a house of slaves, to thrust you aside from the way in which YHWH your God commanded you to walk. And you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own being, entices you in secret, saying: Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known, you nor your fathers —
from among the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you or far from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth —
you shall not yield to him and you shall not listen to him, and your eye shall not look with pity on him, and you shall not spare him and you shall not cover for him.
For killing you shall kill him. Your hand shall be against him first, to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward.
And you shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, for he sought to thrust you aside from YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.
And all Israel shall hear and fear, and they shall not do again such an evil thing as this in your midst.
If you hear it said in one of your cities which YHWH your God is giving you to dwell there,
Men have gone out from your midst, worthless men, and they have thrust aside the inhabitants of their city, saying: Let us go and serve other gods, whom you have not known —
then you shall investigate and search and enquire thoroughly. And behold, if it is true, the thing is established, this abomination has been done in your midst,
striking you shall strike the inhabitants of that city with the mouth of the sword — devoting it to destruction, and all that is in it, and its livestock, with the mouth of the sword.

And all its plunder you shall gather into the middle of its open place, and you shall burn with fire the city and all its plunder, whole, to YHWH your God. And it shall be a mound forever; it shall not be built again.

And nothing of what is devoted to destruction shall cling to your hand, so that YHWH may turn from the burning of his anger and give you compassion, and have compassion on you and multiply you, just as he swore to your fathers,
when you listen to the voice of YHWH your God, keeping all his commandments which I am commanding you today, doing what is right in the eyes of YHWH your God.

deuteronomy_14.t: You are sons to YHWH your God. You shall not cut yourselves, and you shall not put baldness between your eyes for a dead person.
For you are a people set apart as holy to YHWH your God, and YHWH has chosen you to be for him a people of treasured possession out of all the peoples who are on the face of the ground.
You shall not eat any abomination.
This is the livestock which you may eat: ox, sheep and goat,
deer and gazelle and roebuck, and wild goat and ibex and antelope and mountain sheep.
And every animal that divides the hoof and cleaves the cleft into two hooves, bringing up the cud among the animals — that you may eat.

Nevertheless, of those that bring up the cud and of those that divide the cloven hoof, you shall not eat these: the camel and the hare and the rock hyrax, for they bring up the cud but do not divide the hoof — they are unclean for you.
And the pig, for it divides the hoof but not the cud — it is unclean for you. Of their meat you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch.
These you may eat, of all that is in the water: everything that has fins and scales you may eat.
And everything that does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; it is unclean for you.
Every clean bird you may eat.
And these are the ones you shall not eat of them: the eagle and the bearded vulture and the black vulture,
and the red kite and the falcon and the kite of its kind,
and every raven of its kind,
and the daughter of the ostrich and the owl and the gull and the hawk of its kind,
the little owl and the great owl and the white owl,
and the desert owl and the carrion vulture and the cormorant,
and the stork and the heron of its kind, and the hoopoe and the bat.
And every winged swarming creature is unclean for you; they shall not be eaten.
Every clean winged creature you may eat.

You shall not eat any carcass. To the sojourner who is within your gates you may give it, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a people set apart as holy to YHWH your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
Tithing you shall tithe all the produce of your seed that comes out of the field, year by year.

And you shall eat before YHWH your God, in the place which he will choose to cause his name to dwell there, the tithe of your grain, your new wine and your fresh oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock, so that you may learn to fear YHWH your God all the days.

And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, because the place which YHWH your God will choose to put his name there is too far from you — for YHWH your God will bless you —
then you shall exchange it for silver, and bind up the silver in your hand, and go to the place which YHWH your God will choose.

And you shall give the silver for whatever your being desires — for cattle and for flock, and for wine and for strong drink, and for whatever your being asks of you — and you shall eat there before YHWH your God and rejoice, you and your household.
And the Levite who is within your gates — you shall not forsake him, for he has no portion or inheritance with you.
At the end of three years you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in that year, and you shall set it down within your gates.

And the Levite shall come — for he has no portion or inheritance with you — and the sojourner and the fatherless and the widow who are within your gates, and they shall eat and be satisfied, so that YHWH your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

deuteronomy_15.t: At the end of seven years you shall make a release.

And this is the manner of the release: every holder of a loan of his hand, which he has lent to his neighbour, shall let it drop. He shall not press his neighbour or his brother, for a release has been proclaimed for YHWH.
The foreigner you may press, but what is yours with your brother your hand shall release.
Nevertheless, there shall be no needy person among you, for YHWH will surely bless you in the land which YHWH your God is giving you as an inheritance to take possession of it —
only if listening you listen to the voice of YHWH your God, to keep and do all this commandment which I am commanding you today.
For YHWH your God has blessed you, just as he spoke to you, and you shall lend to many nations but you shall not borrow, and you shall rule over many nations but over you they shall not rule.

If there is among you a needy person, one of your brothers, in one of your gates in your land which YHWH your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart and you shall not shut your hand from your needy brother.
For opening you shall open your hand to him, and lending you shall lend him enough for his lack, whatever he lacks.

Take heed to yourself, lest there be a worthless word with your heart, saying: The seventh year, the year of release, has drawn near — and your eye be evil toward your needy brother and you give him nothing, and he cry out against you to YHWH, and it be sin on you.

Giving you shall give to him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, for on account of this thing YHWH your God will bless you in all your work and in every undertaking of your hand.
For the needy will not cease from the midst of the land. Therefore I am commanding you, saying: Opening you shall open your hand to your brother, to your poor and to your needy in your land.
If your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you, he shall serve you six years, and in the seventh year you shall send him out free from you.
And when you send him out free from you, you shall not send him out empty.
Furnishing you shall furnish him from your flock and from your threshing floor and from your winepress. As YHWH your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and YHWH your God redeemed you. Therefore I am commanding you this thing today.
And it shall be, if he says to you: I will not go out from you — because he loves you and your household, because it is good for him with you —
then you shall take the awl and put it through his ear and into the door, and he shall be your slave forever. And to your maidservant also you shall do so.
It shall not be hard in your eyes when you send him out free from you, for double the wage of a hired worker he has served you six years; and YHWH your God will bless you in all that you do.

Every firstborn male that is born in your herd and in your flock you shall set apart as holy to YHWH your God. You shall not work with the firstborn of your ox, and you shall not shear the firstborn of your flock.
Before YHWH your God you shall eat it, year by year, in the place which YHWH will choose, you and your household.
And if there is a blemish in it — lame or blind, any bad blemish — you shall not sacrifice it to YHWH your God.
Within your gates you shall eat it, the unclean and the clean alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.
Only its blood you shall not eat; on the ground you shall pour it out like water.

deuteronomy_16.t: Keep the month of Abib and make a passover to YHWH your God, for in the month of Abib YHWH your God brought you out from Egypt by night.
And you shall sacrifice a passover to YHWH your God, flock and herd, in the place which YHWH will choose to cause his name to dwell there.

You shall not eat leavened bread with it. Seven days you shall eat with it unleavened bread, bread of affliction — for in haste you came out from the land of Egypt — so that you may remember the day of your coming out from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
And no leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory for seven days, and none of the meat which you sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall remain overnight until morning.
You may not sacrifice the passover in one of your gates which YHWH your God is giving you,

but at the place which YHWH your God will choose to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall sacrifice the passover in the evening, as the sun goes down, at the appointed time of your coming out from Egypt.
And you shall boil it and eat it in the place which YHWH your God will choose, and in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.
Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly to YHWH your God. You shall not do work.
Seven weeks you shall count for yourself; from the beginning of the sickle in the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
And you shall make a festival of weeks to YHWH your God, the tribute of the freewill offering of your hand which you give, as YHWH your God blesses you.

And you shall rejoice before YHWH your God — you and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates, and the sojourner and the fatherless and the widow who are in your midst — in the place which YHWH your God will choose to cause his name to dwell there.
And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall keep and do these statutes.
You shall make the festival of booths for yourself seven days, when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.

And you shall rejoice in your festival — you and your son and your daughter, and your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite and the sojourner and the fatherless and the widow who are within your gates.

Seven days you shall keep the festival to YHWH your God in the place which YHWH will choose, for YHWH your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear before the face of YHWH your God in the place which he will choose: at the festival of unleavened bread and at the festival of weeks and at the festival of booths. And he shall not appear before the face of YHWH empty.
Each man according to the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of YHWH your God which he has given you.
Judges and officials you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates which YHWH your God is giving you, for your tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgement.
You shall not turn aside judgement. You shall not regard faces. And you shall not take a bribe, for the bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
Righteousness, righteousness you shall pursue, so that you may live and take possession of the land which YHWH your God is giving you.
You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah of any tree beside the altar of YHWH your God which you shall make for yourself.
And you shall not set up for yourself a pillar, which YHWH your God hates.

deuteronomy_17.t: You shall not sacrifice to YHWH your God an ox or a sheep in which there is a blemish, any bad thing, for that is an abomination to YHWH your God.
If there is found in your midst, in one of your gates which YHWH your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the eyes of YHWH your God, transgressing his covenant,
and has gone and served other gods and bowed down to them — either to the sun or to the moon or to all the host of the heavens, which I have not commanded —
and it is told to you and you hear it, then you shall investigate thoroughly. And behold, if it is true, the thing is established, this abomination has been done in Israel,
then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates — the man or the woman — and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
On the mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses the one who dies shall be put to death. He shall not be put to death on the mouth of one witness.
The hand of the witnesses shall be against him first, to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward. And you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

If a matter is too difficult for you in judgement — between blood and blood, between case and case, between wound and wound, matters of disputes within your gates — then you shall rise and go up to the place which YHWH your God will choose.
And you shall come to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge who will be in those days, and you shall enquire, and they shall tell you the word of the judgement.
And you shall do according to the mouth of the word which they tell you from that place which YHWH will choose, and you shall keep to do according to all that they instruct you.

According to the mouth of the law which they instruct you, and according to the judgement which they say to you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the word which they tell you, right or left.
And the man who acts presumptuously, not listening to the priest who stands to serve there before YHWH your God, or to the judge — that man shall die. And you shall burn out the evil from Israel.
And all the people shall hear and fear, and they shall not act presumptuously again.
When you come into the land which YHWH your God is giving you, and you take possession of it and dwell in it, and you say: Let me set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me —

setting you shall set over yourself a king whom YHWH your God will choose. From the midst of your brothers you shall set a king over yourself. You may not put over yourself a foreign man, who is not your brother.
Only he shall not multiply horses for himself, and he shall not make the people return to Egypt in order to multiply horses — for YHWH has said to you: You shall not return that way again.
And he shall not multiply wives for himself, so that his heart may not turn aside; and silver and gold he shall not multiply for himself exceedingly.
And it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write for himself a copy of this law on a scroll, from before the priests, the Levites.
And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear YHWH his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them,

so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and so that he may not turn aside from the commandment, right or left — so that he may prolong days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.
