And you shall slaughter the ram, and you shall take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's ear and on the lobe of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot; and you shall dash the blood against the altar all around.

And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the oil of anointing, and you shall spatter it on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him; and he shall be holy, he and his garments, and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.

And you shall take from the ram the fat and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the entrails, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and the right thigh — for it is a ram of installation.
And one round loaf of bread, and one cake of oil-bread, and one wafer, from the basket of unleavened bread that is before YHWH.
And you shall put it all on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and you shall wave them as a wave offering before YHWH.
And you shall take them from their hand and make them smoke on the altar, on the burnt offering, for an odour of soothing before YHWH. It is a food offering to YHWH.
And you shall take the breast from the ram of installation that is Aaron's, and you shall wave it as a wave offering before YHWH; and it shall be your portion.

And you shall set apart as holy the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution, which was waved and which was raised, from the ram of installation, from what is Aaron's and from what is his sons'.

And it shall be Aaron's and his sons', a prescribed portion of perpetuity from the sons of Israel, for it is a contribution; and it shall be a contribution from the sons of Israel, from their peace-offering sacrifices — their contribution to YHWH.
And the garments of holiness that are Aaron's shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed in them and to have their hand filled in them.
Seven days the priest in his place from among his sons shall wear them, he who comes into the tent of meeting to serve in the holy place.
And the ram of installation you shall take, and you shall boil its flesh in a holy place.
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
And they shall eat those things by which atonement was made, to fill their hand, to set them apart as holy; and a stranger shall not eat, for they are holy.
And if any of the flesh of the installation, or of the bread, is left over until the morning, then you shall burn what is left over with fire. It shall not be eaten, for it is holy.
And you shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. Seven days you shall fill their hand.
And a bull of sin offering you shall offer each day for the atonements, and you shall purify the altar by making atonement on it, and you shall anoint it to set it apart as holy.
Seven days you shall make atonement on the altar and set it apart as holy, and the altar shall be a holiness of holinesses; everything that touches the altar shall be holy.
And this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs, sons of a year, each day, continually.
The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer between the evenings.
And a tenth of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine, for the one lamb.
And the second lamb you shall offer between the evenings; like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you shall offer for it, for an odour of soothing, a food offering to YHWH.
A continual burnt offering for your generations, at the entrance of the tent of meeting before YHWH, where I will meet with you to speak to you there.
And I will meet there with the sons of Israel, and it shall be set apart as holy by my glory.
And I will set apart as holy the tent of meeting and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I will set apart as holy, to serve me as priests.
And I will dwell among the sons of Israel, and I will be God for them.
And they shall know that I am YHWH their God, who brought them out from the land of Egypt for my dwelling among them. I am YHWH their God.

exodus_30.t: And you shall make an altar, a place of smoking incense; of acacia wood you shall make it.
A cubit its length and a cubit its breadth — square it shall be — and two cubits its height; from it shall be its horns.
And you shall overlay it with pure gold — its top and its sides all around and its horns — and you shall make for it a moulding of gold all around.
And two rings of gold you shall make for it, below its moulding, on its two sides; you shall make them on its two flanks, and they shall be holders for poles, to carry it by them.
And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and you shall overlay them with gold.
And you shall put it before the veil that is over the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.
And Aaron shall make fragrant incense smoke on it; morning by morning, when he tends the lamps, he shall make it smoke.
And when Aaron sets up the lamps between the evenings, he shall make it smoke — a continual incense before YHWH throughout your generations.
You shall not offer up on it strange incense, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering; and a drink offering you shall not pour out on it.

And Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; from the blood of the sin offering of the atonements, once in the year he shall make atonement on it, throughout your generations. It is a holiness of holinesses to YHWH.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

When you take the sum of the sons of Israel by their enrolments, then each shall give a ransom for his life to YHWH when they are enrolled, and there shall be no plague among them when they are enrolled.
This they shall give, everyone who passes over to those enrolled: half a shekel by the shekel of the holy place — twenty gerahs is the shekel — half a shekel as a contribution to YHWH.
Everyone who passes over to those enrolled, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the contribution of YHWH.
The rich shall not give more and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, in giving the contribution of YHWH to make atonement for your lives.

And you shall take the atonement money from the sons of Israel and give it for the service of the tent of meeting, and it shall be for the sons of Israel a remembrance before YHWH, to make atonement for your lives.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
And you shall make a washbasin of bronze, and its stand of bronze, for washing; and you shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water there.
And Aaron and his sons shall wash from it their hands and their feet.
When they come into the tent of meeting they shall wash with water, and they shall not die; or when they draw near to the altar to serve, to make a food offering smoke to YHWH,
then they shall wash their hands and their feet, and they shall not die. And it shall be for them a decree of perpetuity, for him and for his offspring throughout their generations.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
And you, take for yourself the finest spices: flowing myrrh, five hundred; and fragrant cinnamon, half of it, two hundred and fifty; and fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
and cassia, five hundred, by the shekel of the holy place; and olive oil, a hin.
And you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a perfumed compound, the work of a perfumer; a holy anointing oil it shall be.
And you shall anoint with it the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony,
and the table and all its articles, and the lampstand and its articles, and the altar of incense,
and the altar of the burnt offering and all its articles, and the washbasin and its stand.
And you shall set them apart as holy, and they shall be a holiness of holinesses; everything that touches them shall be holy.
And Aaron and his sons you shall anoint, and you shall set them apart as holy, to serve me as priests.
And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying: This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
On a person's flesh it shall not be poured, and in its proportion you shall not make any like it. It is holy; it shall be holy to you.
Anyone who compounds any like it, or who puts any of it on a stranger, shall be cut off from his kin.
And YHWH said to Moses: Take for yourself spices — stacte and onycha and galbanum, spices — and pure frankincense; part shall be equal to part.
And you shall make it an incense, a compound, the work of a perfumer, salted, pure, holy.
And you shall beat some of it fine, and you shall put some of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with you. A holiness of holinesses it shall be to you.
And the incense that you make — in its proportion you shall not make any for yourselves. It shall be holy to you, for YHWH.
Anyone who makes any like it, to smell it, shall be cut off from his kin.

exodus_31.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
And I have filled him [with] the Spirit of God, in wisdom and in understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of work,
to devise designs, to work in gold and in silver and in bronze,
and in cutting of stone for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in every kind of work.
And I, here, I have appointed with him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of everyone wise of heart I have put wisdom, and they shall make all that I have commanded you:
the tent of meeting, and the ark for the testimony, and the mercy seat that is on it, and all the articles of the tent,
and the table and its articles, and the pure lampstand and all its articles, and the altar of incense,
and the altar of the burnt offering and all its articles, and the washbasin and its stand,
and the woven garments, and the garments of holiness for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for serving as priests,
and the oil of anointing, and the incense of spices for the holy place. According to all that I have commanded you they shall do.
And YHWH said to Moses, saying:
And you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying: Surely my sabbaths you shall keep, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, to know that I am YHWH who sets you apart as holy.
And you shall keep the sabbath, for it is holy to you. Whoever profanes it, dying he shall be put to death; for anyone who does work on it, that person shall be cut off from among his kin.
Six days work shall be done, and on the seventh day is a sabbath of sabbath-keeping, holy to YHWH. Anyone who does work on the sabbath day, dying he shall be put to death.
And the sons of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to make the sabbath throughout their generations a covenant of perpetuity.
Between me and the sons of Israel it is a sign forever, for in six days YHWH made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased and drew breath.
And he gave to Moses, when he had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony — tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.

exodus_32.t: And the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, and the people assembled against Aaron and said to him: Arise, make for us gods who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt — we do not know what has become of him.
And Aaron said to them: Tear off the rings of gold that are in the ears of your wives, your sons and your daughters, and bring them to me.
And all the people tore off from themselves the rings of gold that were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
And he took it from their hand and formed it with a graving tool and made it a calf of cast metal. And they said: These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
And Aaron saw, and he built an altar before it, and Aaron called out and said: A festival to YHWH tomorrow.
And they rose early on the next day and offered up burnt offerings and brought near peace offerings, and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and they rose up to play.
And YHWH spoke to Moses: Go, go down, for your people, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, has acted corruptly.

They have turned aside quickly from the way that I commanded them. They have made for themselves a calf of cast metal and have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and said: These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
And YHWH said to Moses: I have seen this people, and here, it is a stiff-necked people.
And now, leave me alone, and let my anger burn against them, and let me make an end of them; and I will make you into a great nation.
And Moses entreated the face of YHWH his God and said: Why, YHWH, does your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out from the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?

Why should Egypt say, saying: With evil intent he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to make an end of them from upon the face of the ground? Turn from the burning of your anger, and relent concerning the harm to your people.

Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by yourself and said to them: I will multiply your offspring like the stars of the heavens, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall possess it forever.
And YHWH relented concerning the harm that he had spoken of doing to his people.
And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand — tablets written on their two sides, on this side and on that they were written.
And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
And Joshua heard the sound of the people as it shouted, and he said to Moses: There is a sound of war in the camp.
And he said: It is not the sound of the singing of strength, and it is not the sound of the singing of weakness; a sound of singing I am hearing.
And it happened, as he drew near to the camp, that he saw the calf and dancing, and Moses' anger burned, and he threw the tablets from his hands and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.
And he took the calf that they had made and burned it with fire, and ground it until it was fine, and scattered it on the face of the water, and made the sons of Israel drink it.
And Moses said to Aaron: What did this people do to you, that you have brought upon it a great sin?
And Aaron said: Let not my lord's anger burn. You yourself know the people, that it is set on evil.
And they said to me: Make for us gods who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt — we do not know what has become of him.
And I said to them: Whoever has gold, tear it off. And they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.
And Moses saw the people, that it was running wild — for Aaron had let it run wild, for derision among those who rise against them —
and Moses stood at the gate of the camp and said: Who is for YHWH? To me! And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves to him.

And he said to them: Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Put every man his sword on his thigh; pass to and fro from gate to gate in the camp, and kill, every man his brother and every man his companion and every man his kin.
And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses, and there fell of the people on that day about three thousand men.
And Moses said: Fill your hand today for YHWH — for every man was against his son and against his brother — and so to bring upon yourselves a blessing today.
And it happened on the next day that Moses said to the people: You yourselves have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to YHWH; perhaps I may make atonement for your sin.
And Moses returned to YHWH and said: Ah, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made for themselves gods of gold.
And now, if you will bear their sin — ; and if not, wipe me out, please, from your book that you have written.
And YHWH said to Moses: Whoever has sinned against me, him I will wipe out from my book.
And now, go, lead the people to where I have spoken to you. Here, my messenger will go before you. And on the day of my visiting, I will visit their sin upon them.
And YHWH struck the people because they had made the calf that Aaron made.

exodus_33.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses: Go, go up from here, you and the people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, to the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob, saying: To your offspring I will give it.
And I will send before you a messenger, and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and the Jebusite,
to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I make an end of you on the way.
And the people heard this bad word and mourned, and no one put his ornaments on himself.

And YHWH had said to Moses: Say to the sons of Israel: You are a stiff-necked people. In one moment I might go up in your midst and make an end of you. And now, take down your ornaments from upon you, and I will know what I shall do to you.
And the sons of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments, from Mount Horeb onward.

And Moses would take the tent and pitch it for himself outside the camp, far off from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought YHWH would go out to the tent of meeting, which was outside the camp.
And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise and stand, each at the entrance of his tent, and look after Moses until he had gone into the tent.
And whenever Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stand at the entrance of the tent, and he would speak with Moses.
And all the people would see the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, and all the people would rise and bow down, each at the entrance of his tent.
And YHWH would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his companion. And he would return to the camp; but his servant Joshua son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from within the tent.

And Moses said to YHWH: See, you are saying to me, Bring up this people — and you yourself have not made known to me whom you will send with me. And you yourself have said, I know you by name, and also you have found favour in my eyes.
And now, if I have indeed found favour in your eyes, make known to me, please, your ways, that I may know you, so that I may find favour in your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.
And he said: My face will go, and I will give you rest.
And he said to him: If your face is not going, do not bring us up from here.

And how then shall it be known that I have found favour in your eyes, I and your people — is it not by your going with us? And so we shall be distinguished, I and your people, from every people that is on the face of the ground.
And YHWH said to Moses: Also this thing that you have spoken I will do, for you have found favour in my eyes, and I know you by name.
And he said: Show me, please, your glory.

And he said: I myself will cause all my goodness to pass before your face, and I will proclaim the name YHWH before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
And he said: You are not able to see my face, for the human being cannot see me and live.
And YHWH said: Here, there is a place with me, and you shall station yourself on the rock.
And it shall be, when my glory passes by, that I will put you in the cleft of the rock and cover you with my palm until I have passed by.
And I will remove my palm, and you shall see my back parts; but my face shall not be seen.

exodus_34.t: And YHWH said to Moses: Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
And be ready by the morning, and you shall go up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and you shall station yourself for me there on the top of the mountain.
And no one shall go up with you, and also let no one be seen on all the mountain; also the flocks and the herds shall not graze in front of that mountain.
And he cut two tablets of stone like the first ones, and Moses rose early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as YHWH had commanded him, and he took in his hand the two tablets of stone.
And YHWH came down in the cloud and stood with him there, and he proclaimed the name YHWH.
And YHWH passed by before his face and proclaimed: YHWH, YHWH, a God compassionate and gracious, long of nostrils and abundant in steadfast love and faithfulness,

keeping steadfast love for the thousands, bearing iniquity and transgression and sin; but clearing, he will not clear — visiting the iniquity of fathers upon sons and upon sons of sons, upon the third and upon the fourth.
And Moses hurried and bowed low to the ground and bowed down.

And he said: If I have found favour in your eyes, my Lord, let my Lord go, please, in our midst — for it is a stiff-necked people — and forgive our iniquity and our sin, and take us as your possession.

And he said: Here, I am cutting a covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders that have not been created in all the earth or among all the nations, and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of YHWH, for it is fearful, what I am about to do with you.
Keep for yourself what I am commanding you today. Here, I am about to drive out from before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
Take heed for yourself, lest you cut a covenant with the inhabitant of the land into which you are going, lest he become a snare in your midst.
For their altars you shall pull down, and their pillars you shall break, and its Asherahs you shall cut down.
For you shall not bow down to another god; for YHWH — Jealous is his name — he is a jealous God.
Lest you cut a covenant with the inhabitant of the land, and they prostitute themselves after their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and he invite you, and you eat of his sacrifice;
and you take some of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters prostitute themselves after their gods, and they make your sons prostitute themselves after their gods.
Gods of cast metal you shall not make for yourself.

The festival of unleavened bread you shall keep: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time of the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.
Every firstborn of a womb is mine, and all your livestock that bears a male, the firstborn of ox and sheep.

And the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a sheep; and if you do not redeem it, you shall break its neck. Every firstborn of your sons you shall redeem, and my face shall not be seen empty-handed.
Six days you shall labour, and on the seventh day you shall cease; in ploughing time and in harvest you shall cease.
And the festival of weeks you shall make for yourself, the firstfruits of the wheat harvest; and the festival of ingathering at the turn of the year.
Three times in the year all your males shall be seen before the face of the Lord YHWH, the God of Israel.
For I will dispossess nations from before you and will widen your border, and no one shall covet your land when you go up to be seen before the face of YHWH your God three times in the year.
You shall not slaughter the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, and the sacrifice of the festival of the passover shall not remain overnight until the morning.
The first of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring to the house of YHWH your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
And YHWH said to Moses: Write for yourself these words, for according to these words I have cut a covenant with you and with Israel.
And he was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread and he did not drink water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten words.

And it happened, when Moses came down from Mount Sinai — and the two tablets of the testimony were in Moses' hand when he came down from the mountain — that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been speaking with him.
And Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, and here, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to draw near to him.
And Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the leaders in the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.
And after that all the sons of Israel drew near, and he commanded them all that YHWH had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a face covering over his face.
And whenever Moses went in before YHWH to speak with him, he would remove the face covering until he came out; and he would come out and speak to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded.
And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone; and Moses would put the face covering back over his face until he went in to speak with him.

exodus_35.t: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and he said to them, These are the words which YHWH has commanded, to do them.
Six days work shall be done, and on the seventh day there shall be for you a holy thing, a sabbath of sabbath-keeping to YHWH. Everyone doing work on it shall be put to death.
You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the day of the sabbath.
And Moses said to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, This is the word which YHWH has commanded, saying,
Take from among you a contribution for YHWH. Everyone willing of heart, let him bring it, the contribution of YHWH: gold and silver and bronze,
and violet and purple and scarlet and fine linen and goat hair,
and ram skins dyed red and fine leather and acacia wood,
and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the incense of aromatics,
and onyx stones and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
And everyone wise of heart among you, let them come and make all that YHWH has commanded:
the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its clasps and its frames, its bars, its pillars and its bases;
the ark and its poles, the mercy seat, and the veil of the screen;
the table and its poles and all its articles, and the bread of the Presence;
the lampstand for the light and its articles and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil and the incense of aromatics, and the screen of the entrance for the entrance of the tabernacle;
the altar of the burnt offering and the grating of bronze that belongs to it, its poles and all its articles, the washbasin and its stand;
the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the screen of the gate of the courtyard;
the tent pegs of the tabernacle and the tent pegs of the courtyard and their cords;
the woven garments for serving in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for serving as priests.
And all the congregation of the sons of Israel went out from before Moses.

And they came, everyone whose heart lifted him, and everyone whose spirit made him willing; they brought the contribution of YHWH for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service and for the holy garments.
And the men came with the women; everyone willing of heart brought clasp and ring and signet-ring and armlet, every article of gold; and every man who waved a wave-offering of gold to YHWH.
And every man with whom was found violet and purple and scarlet and fine linen and goat hair and ram skins dyed red and fine leather, they brought them.
Everyone lifting a contribution of silver and bronze brought the contribution of YHWH; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
And every woman wise of heart spun with her hands, and they brought what was spun: the violet and the purple, the scarlet and the fine linen.
And all the women whose heart lifted them with skill spun the goat hair.
And the leaders brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece,
and the spice and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the incense of aromatics.
Every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work which YHWH had commanded to be done by the hand of Moses — the sons of Israel brought a freewill offering to YHWH.
And Moses said to the sons of Israel, See, YHWH has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
And he has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and in understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of work,
and to devise designs, to work in gold and in silver and in bronze,
and in cutting of stone for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in every kind of designed work.
And to teach he has put in his heart, he and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do all the work of a craftsman and a designer and an embroiderer in the violet and in the purple, in the scarlet and in the fine linen, and of a weaver — doers of every work and devisers of designs.

exodus_36.t: And Bezalel shall work, and Oholiab, and every man wise of heart in whom YHWH has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work of the service of the holy place, according to all that YHWH has commanded.
And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every man wise of heart in whose heart YHWH had put wisdom, everyone whose heart lifted him to draw near to the work, to do it.

And they received from before Moses all the contribution which the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the holy place, to do it. And they still brought to him a freewill offering morning by morning.
And all the skilled men who were doing all the work of the holy place came, each man from his work which they were doing,
and they said to Moses, saying, The people are bringing much more than enough for the service of the work which YHWH commanded to do.
And Moses commanded, and they sent a proclamation through the camp, saying, Let no man or woman do any more work for the contribution of the holy place. And the people were restrained from bringing.
And the work was their sufficiency for all the work, to do it, and there was left over.
And everyone wise of heart among those doing the work made the tabernacle: ten curtains of fine twisted linen and violet and purple and scarlet; cherubim, the work of a designer, he made them.
The length of the one curtain was twenty-eight by the cubit, and the breadth four by the cubit, the one curtain; one measure for all the curtains.
And he joined five of the curtains one to one, and five curtains he joined one to one.
And he made loops of violet on the edge of the one curtain, from the end in the set; thus he did on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
Fifty loops he made on the one curtain, and fifty loops he made on the end of the curtain which was in the second set, the loops opposite one to one.
And he made fifty clasps of gold, and he joined the curtains one to one with the clasps, and the tabernacle was one.
And he made curtains of goat hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he made them.
The length of the one curtain was thirty by the cubit, and four cubits the breadth of the one curtain; one measure for the eleven curtains.
And he joined five of the curtains by themselves and six of the curtains by themselves.
And he made loops, fifty, on the edge of the outermost curtain in the set, and fifty loops he made on the edge of the curtain of the second set.
And he made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent, to be one.
And he made a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red, and a covering of fine leather above.
And he made the frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
Ten cubits was the length of the frame, and a cubit and half a cubit the breadth of the one frame.
Two hands belonged to the one frame, joined one to one; thus he did for all the frames of the tabernacle.
And he made the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side, southward.
And forty bases of silver he made under the twenty frames: two bases under the one frame for its two hands, and two bases under the one frame for its two hands.
And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, he made twenty frames,
and their forty bases of silver: two bases under the one frame, and two bases under the one frame.
And for the innermost parts of the tabernacle, westward, he made six frames.
And two frames he made for the corners of the tabernacle, in the innermost parts.
And they were twins from below, and together they were complete to its top, into the one ring; thus he did for both of them, for the two corners.
And there were eight frames, and their bases of silver, sixteen bases: two bases, two bases under the one frame.
And he made bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
and five bars for the frames of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the tabernacle at the innermost parts, westward.
And he made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the frames from end to end.
And the frames he overlaid with gold, and their rings he made of gold as holders for the bars, and he overlaid the bars with gold.
And he made the veil of violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen; the work of a designer he made it, with cherubim.
And he made for it four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were gold; and he cast for them four bases of silver.
And he made a screen for the entrance of the tent of violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer,
and its five pillars and their hooks; and he overlaid their tops and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.

exodus_37.t: And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood: two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
And he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and he made for it a moulding of gold all around.
And he cast for it four rings of gold on its four feet: two rings on its one side and two rings on its second side.
And he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark.
And he made a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
And he made two cherubim of gold; hammered work he made them, from the two ends of the mercy seat.
One cherub was from the end on this side, and one cherub from the end on that side; from the mercy seat he made the cherubim, from its two ends.
And the cherubim were spreading out wings upward, covering with their wings over the mercy seat, and their faces each toward his brother; toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.
And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, and he made for it a moulding of gold all around.
And he made for it a rim of a handbreadth all around, and he made a moulding of gold for its rim all around.
And he cast for it four rings of gold, and he put the rings on the four corners which belonged to its four feet.
Close to the rim were the rings, holders for the poles, to carry the table.
And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
And he made the articles which were on the table: its dishes and its pans and its bowls and the jars with which it is poured out, of pure gold.
And he made the lampstand of pure gold; hammered work he made the lampstand, its base and its shaft; its cups, its bulbs and its blossoms were from it.
And six branches were going out from its sides: three branches of lampstand from its one side, and three branches of lampstand from its second side.

Three cups shaped like almond blossoms were on the one branch, a bulb and a blossom, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms on one branch, a bulb and a blossom; thus for the six branches going out from the lampstand.
And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms, its bulbs and its blossoms.
And a bulb was under two of the branches from it, and a bulb under two of the branches from it, and a bulb under two of the branches from it, for the six branches going out from it.
Their bulbs and their branches were from it; all of it was one hammered work of pure gold.
And he made its seven lamps, and its tongs and its firepans, of pure gold.
Of a talent of pure gold he made it, and all its articles.
And he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit its length and a cubit its breadth, square, and two cubits its height; its horns were from it.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, its top and its sides all around and its horns; and he made for it a moulding of gold all around.
And two rings of gold he made for it, below its moulding, on its two sides, on its two flanks, as holders for poles, to carry it by them.
And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
And he made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of aromatics, the work of a perfumer.

exodus_38.t: And he made the altar of the burnt offering of acacia wood: five cubits its length and five cubits its breadth, square, and three cubits its height.
And he made its horns on its four corners; its horns were from it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
And he made all the articles of the altar: the pots and the shovels and the basins, the forks and the firepans; all its articles he made of bronze.
And he made for the altar a grating, a work of a net of bronze, under its ledge below, to its middle.
And he cast four rings on the four ends for the grating of bronze, holders for the poles.
And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, to carry it by them. Hollow of boards he made it.
And he made the washbasin of bronze and its stand of bronze, with the mirrors of the serving women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
And he made the courtyard: for the south side, southward, the hangings of the courtyard were of fine twisted linen, a hundred by the cubit;
their pillars twenty and their bases twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
And for the north side, a hundred by the cubit; their pillars twenty and their bases twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
And for the west side, hangings fifty by the cubit; their pillars ten and their bases ten; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
And for the east side, eastward, fifty cubits.
Hangings of fifteen cubits to the one shoulder; their pillars three and their bases three.
And for the second shoulder, on this side and on that side of the gate of the courtyard, hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three and their bases three.
All the hangings of the courtyard all around were fine twisted linen.

And the bases for the pillars were bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver, and the overlay of their tops was silver; and they were furnished with bands of silver, all the pillars of the courtyard.

And the screen of the gate of the courtyard was the work of an embroiderer, of violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen; and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in breadth was five cubits, corresponding to the hangings of the courtyard.
And their pillars four and their bases four, of bronze; their hooks were silver, and the overlay of their tops and their bands were silver.
And all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard all around were bronze.
These are the musterings of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, which were mustered at the mouth of Moses: the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
And Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that YHWH had commanded Moses.
And with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, a craftsman and a designer and an embroiderer in the violet and in the purple and in the scarlet and in the fine linen.

All the gold that was used for the work, in all the work of the holy place — and the gold of the wave-offering was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels by the shekel of the holy place.
And the silver of those of the congregation who were enrolled was a hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels by the shekel of the holy place:

a beka for the head, half a shekel by the shekel of the holy place, for everyone who passed over to those enrolled, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the holy place and the bases of the veil: a hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent for a base.
And of the one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five he made hooks for the pillars, and he overlaid their tops and furnished them with bands.
And the bronze of the wave-offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
And with it he made the bases of the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the altar of bronze and the grating of bronze that belonged to it, and all the articles of the altar,
and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of the gate of the courtyard, and all the tent pegs of the tabernacle and all the tent pegs of the courtyard all around.

exodus_39.t: And from the violet and the purple and the scarlet they made woven garments for serving in the holy place; and they made the holy garments which were for Aaron, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he made the ephod of gold, violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen.
And they hammered out the thin plates of gold, and he cut threads, to work in among the violet and in among the purple and in among the scarlet and in among the fine linen, the work of a designer.
Shoulder-pieces they made for it, joined; on its two ends it was joined.
And the band of its ephod which was on it was from it, like its workmanship: gold, violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they prepared the onyx stones, surrounded with settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a seal, on the names of the sons of Israel.
And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he made the breastpiece, the work of a designer, like the work of the ephod: gold, violet and purple and scarlet and fine twisted linen.
It was square; doubled over they made the breastpiece: a span its length and a span its breadth, doubled over.
And they filled in it four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz and emerald, the first row;
and the second row: turquoise, sapphire and diamond;
and the third row: jacinth, agate and amethyst;
and the fourth row: beryl, onyx and jasper, surrounded with settings of gold in their settings.
And the stones were on the names of the sons of Israel; they were twelve, on their names, the engravings of a seal, each on his name, for the twelve tribes.
And they made on the breastpiece chains of twisted work, braided, of pure gold.
And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold, and they put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
And they put the two braids of gold on the two rings, on the ends of the breastpiece.
And the two ends of the two braids they put on the two settings, and they put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, at the front of its face.
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its edge which was toward the side of the ephod, inward.
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod, below, at the front of its face, close to its joining, above the band of the ephod.

And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of violet, so as to be on the band of the ephod, and the breastpiece did not come loose from the ephod, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he made the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver, entirely of violet.
And the opening of the robe was in the middle of it, like the opening of a corselet, with an edge for its opening all around, so that it would not be torn.
And they made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of violet and purple and scarlet, twisted.
And they made bells of pure gold, and they put the bells among the pomegranates on the skirts of the robe all around, among the pomegranates:
a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, on the skirts of the robe all around, for serving, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they made the tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,
and the turban of fine linen, and the head-wraps of the headdresses of fine linen, and the undergarments of linen of fine twisted linen,
and the sash of fine twisted linen and violet and purple and scarlet, the work of an embroiderer, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they inscribed on it an inscription, the engravings of a seal: Holiness to YHWH.
And they put on it a cord of violet, to put it on the turban from above, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And all the labour of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished; and the sons of Israel did according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses — so they did.
And they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its articles, its clasps, its frames, its bars, and its pillars and its bases;
and the covering of ram skins dyed red, and the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the screen;
the ark of the testimony and its poles, and the mercy seat;
the table, all its articles, and the bread of the Presence;
the pure lampstand, its lamps — the lamps of the row — and all its articles, and the oil for the light;
and the altar of gold, and the anointing oil, and the fragrant incense, and the screen of the entrance of the tent;
the altar of bronze and the grating of bronze that belonged to it, its poles and all its articles, the washbasin and its stand;

the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the courtyard, its cords and its tent pegs, and all the articles of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
the woven garments for serving in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for serving as priests.
According to all that YHWH had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did all the labour.
And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it — just as YHWH had commanded, so they had done — and Moses blessed them.

exodus_40.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
And you shall put there the ark of the testimony, and you shall cover over the ark with the veil.
And you shall bring in the table and arrange its arrangement; and you shall bring in the lampstand and lift up its lamps.
And you shall put the altar of gold for incense before the ark of the testimony, and you shall set the screen of the entrance of the tabernacle.
And you shall put the altar of the burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
And you shall put the washbasin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water there.
And you shall set up the courtyard all around, and you shall put the screen of the gate of the courtyard.
And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything that is in it, and you shall set it apart as holy, and all its articles, and it shall be holy.
And you shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all its articles, and you shall set the altar apart as holy, and the altar shall be a holiness of holinesses.
And you shall anoint the washbasin and its stand, and you shall set it apart as holy.
And you shall bring near Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you shall wash them with water.
And you shall clothe Aaron with the holy garments, and you shall anoint him and set him apart as holy, and he shall serve me as priest.
And you shall bring near his sons and clothe them with tunics.
And you shall anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they shall serve me as priests; and their anointing shall be for them a priesthood of perpetuity throughout their generations.
And Moses did according to all that YHWH commanded him; so he did.
And it was in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was set up.
And Moses set up the tabernacle, and he put its bases and set its frames and put in its bars and set up its pillars.
And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it above, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and he set the poles on the ark, and he put the mercy seat on the ark above.
And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and he set up the veil of the screen and covered over the ark of the testimony, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil.
And he arranged on it an arrangement of bread before YHWH, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
And he lifted up the lamps before YHWH, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he put the altar of gold in the tent of meeting before the veil,
and he made fragrant incense smoke on it, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he set up the screen of the entrance of the tabernacle.

And the altar of the burnt offering he set at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and he offered up on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he put the washbasin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and he put water there for washing.
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed from it their hands and their feet.
When they went into the tent of meeting and when they drew near to the altar they washed, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And he set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put the screen of the gate of the courtyard. And Moses finished the work.
And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of YHWH filled the tabernacle.
And Moses was not able to go into the tent of meeting, for the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of YHWH filled the tabernacle.
And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel would set out in all their journeys.
And if the cloud was not taken up, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
For the cloud of YHWH was over the tabernacle by day, and fire would be in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, in all their journeys.

ezekiel_1.t: And it was in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], on the fifth of the month, and I was among the exiles by the river Kebar — the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
On the fifth of the month — it was the fifth year of the exile of king Jehoiachin —
coming, the word of YHWH came to Ezekiel son of Buzi the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Kebar; and the hand of YHWH was upon him there.
And I looked, and there! a storm wind coming from the north, a great cloud and fire flashing, and brightness around it; and from its midst, like glowing metal, from the midst of the fire.
And from its midst, a likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: a likeness of a human belonged to them.
And four faces belonged to each one, and four wings belonged to each one of them.
And their legs were a straight leg, and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot, and they were gleaming like the gleam of burnished bronze.
And human hands were under their wings on their four sides; and the four of them had their faces and their wings.
Their wings were touching each to its sister. They did not turn when they moved; each moved toward the side of its face.

And the likeness of their faces: the face of a human; and the face of a lion on the right, for the four of them; and the face of an ox on the left, for the four of them; and the face of an eagle, for the four of them.
And their faces and their wings were spread apart above; for each, two were touching each other, and two were covering their bodies.
And each moved toward the side of its face. Wherever the spirit was to go, they went; they did not turn when they moved.

And the likeness of the living creatures: their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. It was moving about among the living creatures; and the fire had brightness, and out of the fire went lightning.
And the living creatures were running and returning, like the appearance of the lightning flash.
And I saw the living creatures, and there! one wheel on the ground beside the living creatures, for its four faces.

The appearance of the wheels and their construction was like the gleam of beryl, and the four of them had one likeness; and their appearance and their construction was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
On their four sides they moved when they moved; they did not turn when they moved.
And their rims — they had height, and they had fear; and their rims were full of eyes all around, for the four of them.
And when the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the ground, the wheels were lifted up.
Wherever the spirit was to go, they went — there the spirit was to go — and the wheels were lifted up alongside them, for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

When they moved, they moved; and when they stood still, they stood still; and when they were lifted up from the ground, the wheels were lifted up alongside them, for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
And over the heads of the living creature was a likeness of a firmament, like the gleam of the awesome ice, spread out over their heads above.
And under the firmament their wings were straight, each to its sister; each had two covering them, and each had two covering them, their bodies.

And I heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of many waters, like the sound of the Almighty, when they moved — a sound of tumult, like the sound of an army. When they stood still, they let their wings drop.
And there came a sound from above the firmament that was over their heads. When they stood still, they let their wings drop.

And above the firmament that was over their heads, like the appearance of a stone of sapphire, a likeness of a throne; and on the likeness of the throne, a likeness like the appearance of a human upon it, above.

And I saw like glowing metal, like the appearance of fire with an enclosure to it all around, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw like the appearance of fire, and brightness belonged to him all around.

Like the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud on the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. That was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of YHWH. And I saw, and I fell on my face, and I heard a voice speaking.

ezekiel_2.t: And he said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you."
And a spirit came into me as he spoke to me, and it stood me on my feet; and I heard the one speaking to me.
And he said to me, "Son of man, I am sending you to the people of Israel, to rebellious nations who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me to this very day.
And the children are stern of face and hard of heart. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says Lord YHWH.'
And they — whether they listen or whether they refrain, for they are a house of rebellion — they will know that a prophet has been among them.

And you, son of man — do not fear them, and do not fear their words, though nettles and thorns are with you and you are dwelling among scorpions. Do not fear their words, and do not be dismayed at their faces, for they are a house of rebellion.
And you shall speak my words to them, whether they listen or whether they refrain, for they are rebellion.
And you, son of man, hear what I am speaking to you. Do not be rebellion like the house of rebellion. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you."
And I saw, and there! a hand stretched out to me, and there! in it a scroll of a document.
And he spread it out before me, and it was written on the front and on the back; and written on it were lamentations and moaning and wailing.

ezekiel_3.t: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel."
And I opened my mouth, and he made me eat this scroll.
And he said to me, "Son of man, make your belly eat and fill your inward parts with this scroll that I am giving you." And I ate it, and it was in my mouth like honey for sweetness.
And he said to me, "Son of man, go, come to the house of Israel, and you shall speak with my words to them.
For you are not being sent to a people deep of lip and heavy of tongue, but to the house of Israel —
not to many peoples deep of lip and heavy of tongue, whose words you would not understand. Surely, if I had sent you to them, they would listen to you.
But the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, for they are not willing to listen to me; for all the house of Israel are hard of forehead and stern of heart.
Look, I have made your face hard corresponding to their faces, and your forehead hard corresponding to their forehead.
Like shamir, harder than flint, I have made your forehead. Do not fear them and do not be dismayed at their faces, for they are a house of rebellion."
And he said to me, "Son of man, all my words that I will speak to you — take them into your heart, and hear with your ears.
And go, come to the exiles, to the children of your people, and speak to them and say to them, 'Thus says Lord YHWH' — whether they listen or whether they refrain."
And a spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great rumbling: "Blessed be the glory of YHWH from his place!"
And the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching each to its sister, and the sound of the wheels alongside them, and the sound of a great rumbling.
And a spirit lifted me up and took me, and I went bitter, in the rage of my spirit; and the hand of YHWH was strong upon me.
And I came to the exiles at Tel Abib, who were dwelling by the river Kebar, and I sat where they were dwelling; and I sat there seven days, appalled among them.
And it was at the end of seven days, and the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. And you shall hear a word from my mouth and warn them from me.

When I say to the wicked, 'Dying you shall die,' and you have not warned him and have not spoken to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to keep him alive — that wicked one shall die in his iniquity, and his blood I will require from your hand.
But you, if you have warned the wicked and he has not turned from his wickedness and from his wicked way — he shall die in his iniquity, and you have delivered your own life.

And when a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice, and I put an obstacle before him — he shall die. Because you did not warn him, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous acts that he did shall not be remembered; and his blood I will require from your hand.
But you, if you have warned him, the righteous one, so that the righteous one does not sin, and he has not sinned — living he shall live, because he was warned; and you have delivered your own life."
And the hand of YHWH was upon me there, and he said to me, "Arise, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you."
And I arose and went out to the plain, and there! there the glory of YHWH was standing, like the glory that I had seen by the river Kebar; and I fell on my face.
And a spirit came into me and stood me on my feet, and he spoke with me and said to me, "Go, shut yourself up inside your house.
And you, son of man — look, they will put ropes on you and bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
And I will make your tongue stick to your palate, and you will be mute, and you will not be to them a man who reproves, for they are a house of rebellion.

And when I speak with you I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says Lord YHWH.' Let the one who hears, hear; and the one who refrains, let him refrain — for they are a house of rebellion."

ezekiel_4.t: "And you, son of man, take yourself a brick and set it before you, and inscribe on it a city — Jerusalem.
And set a siege against it, and build a siege-wall against it, and pour out a ramp against it, and set camps against it, and place battering-rams against it all around.

And you, take yourself an iron griddle and set it as an iron wall between you and the city; and set your face against it, and it shall be under siege, and you shall besiege it. It is a sign for the house of Israel.
And you, lie on your left side and put the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. The number of days that you lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
And I myself have assigned to you the years of their iniquity by a number of days: three hundred and ninety days. And you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
And you shall complete these, and lie a second time on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah: forty days. A day for a year, a day for a year, I have assigned it to you.
And you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
And look, I will put ropes on you, and you shall not turn from one side to your other side until you have completed the days of your siege.

And you, take yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make them into bread for yourself. The number of days that you are lying on your side — three hundred and ninety days — you shall eat it.
And your food that you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat it.
And water by measure you shall drink, a sixth of a hin; from time to time you shall drink.
And a barley cake you shall eat it, and it — over balls of human excrement you shall bake it, before their eyes."
And YHWH said, "Thus the people of Israel shall eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will banish them."

And I said, "Alas, Lord YHWH! Look, my self has never been made unclean; and from my youth until now I have not eaten an animal that died of itself or one torn by beasts, and no foul flesh has come into my mouth."
And he said to me, "See, I give you cattle dung in place of human dung, and you shall make your bread on it."
And he said to me, "Son of man, look, I am about to break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they shall eat bread by weight and in anxiety, and drink water by measure and in horror,
so that they may lack bread and water, and be appalled, each with his brother, and waste away in their iniquity."

ezekiel_5.t: "And you, son of man, take yourself a sharp sword — take it for yourself as a barber's razor — and pass it over your head and over your beard. And take yourself scales for weighing and divide them.

A third you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city when the days of the siege are completed. And you shall take a third and strike it with the sword all around it; and a third you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw a sword after them.
And you shall take from there a few in number and bind them in your skirts.
And of these again you shall take, and throw them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will go out to all the house of Israel."
Thus says Lord YHWH: "This is Jerusalem. In the middle of the nations I have set her, and lands are around her.

And she has rebelled against my judgements more wickedly than the nations, and against my statutes more than the lands that are around her; for they have rejected my judgements, and my statutes — they have not walked in them.

Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: "Because your tumult is more than the nations that are around you — you have not walked in my statutes and you have not done my judgements, and you have not even acted according to the judgements of the nations that are around you —
therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, I myself, and I will perform judgements in the middle of you before the eyes of the nations.
And I will do in you what I have not done, and the like of which I will not do again, because of all your abominations.
Therefore fathers shall eat sons in the middle of you, and sons shall eat their fathers; and I will perform judgements in you, and I will scatter all your remnant to every wind.

Therefore, as I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — surely, because you have made my sanctuary unclean with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, I too will shave you back, and my eye will not look with compassion, and I too will not show pity.

A third of you shall die by pestilence and come to an end by famine in the middle of you; and a third shall fall by the sword around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw a sword after them.
And my anger will be spent, and I will give my rage rest upon them, and I will be relieved; and they will know that I, YHWH, have spoken in my jealousy, when I complete my rage upon them.
And I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations that are around you, before the eyes of everyone who passes by.

And it shall be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations that are around you, when I perform judgements on you in anger and in rage and with rebukes of rage. I, YHWH, have spoken.
When I shoot the evil arrows of famine at them, which will be for destruction, which I will shoot to destroy you — and I will increase famine upon you and break your staff of bread —
and I will send famine and evil beasts upon you, and they will bereave you; and pestilence and blood will pass through you, and I will bring a sword upon you. I, YHWH, have spoken."

ezekiel_6.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

and say: Mountains of Israel, hear the word of Lord YHWH. Thus says Lord YHWH to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys: Look, I myself am bringing a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
And your altars shall be made desolate and your incense altars shattered; and I will make your slain fall before your idols.
And I will put the corpses of the people of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

In all your dwelling places the cities shall be laid waste and the high places made desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and held guilty, and your idols shattered and brought to an end, and your incense altars cut down, and your works wiped out.
And the slain shall fall in the middle of you, and you will know that I am YHWH.
But I will leave some over, in that some of you will be escapees of the sword among the nations, when you are scattered among the lands.

And your escapees will remember me among the nations where they have been taken captive — how I was broken by their whoring heart that turned aside from me, and by their eyes that whored after their idols — and they will loathe themselves to their own faces for the evils they did, for all their abominations.
And they will know that I am YHWH: not for nothing did I speak of doing this evil to them."
Thus says Lord YHWH: Strike with your hand and stamp with your foot and say, "Alas!" — over all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by the sword, by famine and by pestilence.
The distant one shall die by pestilence, and the near one shall fall by the sword, and the one left over and preserved shall die by famine; and I will complete my rage upon them.

And you will know that I am YHWH, when their slain are among their idols, around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree and under every leafy terebinth — the place where they gave a soothing odour to all their idols.
And I will stretch out my hand over them and make the land a desolation and a waste, from the wilderness to Diblah, in all their dwelling places; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_7.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"And you, son of man — thus says Lord YHWH to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
Now the end is upon you, and I will send my anger against you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will requite upon you all your abominations.

And my eye will not look with compassion upon you, and I will not show pity; for I will requite your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the middle of you. And you will know that I am YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH: An evil! A single evil! Look, it is coming.
An end has come! The end has come! It has woken up against you. Look, it is coming.
Doom has come upon you, inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near — confusion, and not a shout on the mountains.
Now, soon, I will pour out my rage upon you and complete my anger against you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will requite upon you all your abominations.

And my eye will not look with compassion, and I will not show pity. According to your ways I will requite upon you, and your abominations shall be in the middle of you. And you will know that I, YHWH, am the one striking.
Look, the day! Look, it is coming. Doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed; arrogance has budded.
Violence has risen into a rod of wickedness. Not from them, and not from their multitude, and not from their tumult, and there is no distinction among them.
The time has come, the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for burning anger is against all her multitude.

For the seller will not return to what was sold, though their life is still among the living; for the vision concerning all her multitude will not turn back, and no one will strengthen himself in his iniquity, in his life.
They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but there is no one going to the battle, for my burning anger is against all her multitude.
The sword is outside, and pestilence and famine inside. Whoever is in the open country will die by the sword, and whoever is in the city — famine and pestilence will consume him.
And their escapees will escape and be on the mountains, like the doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each in his iniquity.
All hands will drop, and all knees will run with water.
And they will gird on sackcloth, and shuddering will cover them; and on every face, shame; and on all their heads, baldness.

They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an impurity. Their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them on the day of the fury of YHWH; they will not satisfy their appetite or fill their inward parts, for it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
And the beauty of its ornament — he set it up for pride, and they made in it the images of their abominations, their detestable things. Therefore I have made it an impurity to them.
And I will give it into the hand of strangers as spoil, and to the wicked of the earth as plunder, and they will profane it.
And I will turn my face away from them, and they will profane my treasured place; and robbers will come into it and profane it.
Make the chain! For the land is full of the judgement of blood, and the city is full of violence.
And I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will take possession of their houses; and I will put an end to the pride of the strong, and their sanctuaries will be profaned.
Anguish has come. And they will seek peace, and there is none.
Disaster upon disaster will come, and report upon report will be. And they will seek a vision from a prophet, and law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

The king will mourn, and the prince will clothe himself in desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be terrified. I will deal with them according to their way, and by their own judgements I will judge them; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_8.t: And it was in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of Lord YHWH fell upon me.

And I saw, and there! a likeness like the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins and downward, fire; and from his loins and upward, like the appearance of brightness, like glowing metal.

And he stretched out the form of a hand and took me by a lock of my head; and a spirit lifted me between the earth and the heavens and brought me to Jerusalem in visions of God, to the entrance of the inner gate that faces north, where the seat of the idol of jealousy stood, the one that provokes to jealousy.
And there! there was the glory of the God of Israel, like the appearance that I had seen on the plain.

And he said to me, "Son of man, lift up your eyes now toward the north." And I lifted up my eyes toward the north, and there! north of the gate of the altar was this idol of jealousy, at the entrance.

And he said to me, "Son of man, are you seeing what they are doing — the great abominations that the house of Israel are doing here, to drive me far from my sanctuary? And you will yet again see great abominations."
And he brought me to the entrance of the court; and I looked, and there! a hole in the wall.
And he said to me, "Son of man, dig now through the wall." And I dug through the wall, and there! an opening.
And he said to me, "Go in and see the wicked abominations that they are doing here."
And I went in and looked, and there! every form of creeping thing and detestable animal, and all the idols of the house of Israel, carved on the wall all around, all around.

And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them, were standing before them, and each with his censer in his hand; and the fragrance of the cloud of incense was going up.

And he said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each in the rooms of his carved image? For they are saying, 'YHWH is not seeing us; YHWH has forsaken the land.'"
And he said to me, "You will yet again see great abominations that they are doing."
And he brought me to the entrance of the gate of the house of YHWH that faces north; and there! there the women were sitting, weeping for the Tammuz.
And he said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? You will yet again see abominations greater than these."

And he brought me to the inner court of the house of YHWH; and there! at the entrance of the temple of YHWH, between the porch and the altar, about twenty-five men, their backs to the temple of YHWH and their faces eastward; and they were bowing down eastward to the sun.

And he said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? Is it too slight a thing for the house of Judah to do the abominations that they have done here, that they have filled the land with violence and have returned to provoke me to anger? And look, they are putting the branch to their nose.
And I too will act in rage. My eye will not look with compassion, and I will not show pity; and though they call out in my ears with a great voice, I will not hear them."

ezekiel_9.t: And he called out in my ears with a great voice, saying, "The punishments of the city have drawn near, and each with his weapon of destruction in his hand!"

And there! six men coming from the direction of the upper gate that faces north, and each with his weapon of shattering in his hand; and one man among them clothed in linen, with a scribe's writing case at his loins. And they came and stood beside the bronze altar.

And the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from over the cherub on which it had been, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed in the linen, who had the scribe's writing case at his loins;

and YHWH said to him, "Pass through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and put a taw on the foreheads of the people who sigh and groan over all the abominations that are done in the middle of it."
And to these he said in my ears, "Pass through the city after him and strike. Let your eye not look with compassion, and do not show pity.

Old man, young man and virgin, and little ones and women — kill to destruction. But do not come near any man on whom the taw is. And begin from my sanctuary." And they began with the old men who were before the house.
And he said to them, "Make the house unclean, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!" And they went out and struck in the city.

And it was, while they were striking and I was left, that I fell on my face and cried out and said, "Alas, Lord YHWH! Are you destroying all the remnant of Israel in pouring out your rage on Jerusalem?"

And he said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is very, very great; and the land is filled with blood and the city is full of perversity. For they have said, 'YHWH has forsaken the land, and YHWH is not seeing.'
And I too — my eye will not look with compassion, and I will not show pity. I have requited their conduct on their own head."
And there! the man clothed in the linen, who had the writing case at his loins, was bringing back a word, saying, "I have done according to all that you commanded me."

ezekiel_10.t: And I looked, and there! toward the firmament that was over the head of the cherubim, like a stone of sapphire, like the appearance of the likeness of a throne, it appeared above them.

And he said to the man clothed in the linen, and said, "Go in between the whirling wheels, under the cherub, and fill your cupped hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he went in before my eyes.
And the cherubim were standing on the south side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
And the glory of YHWH rose from over the cherub, to the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the glory of YHWH.
