And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the sound of God Almighty when he speaks.
And it was, when he commanded the man clothed in the linen, saying, "Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim," that he went in and stood beside the wheel.

And the cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and lifted some and put it into the cupped hands of the one clothed in the linen; and he took it and went out.
And there appeared to the cherubim the form of a human hand under their wings.
And I looked, and there! four wheels beside the cherubim — one wheel beside one cherub, and one wheel beside one cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like the gleam of beryl.
And their appearance: the four of them had one likeness, as it were a wheel within a wheel.
When they moved, they moved toward their four sides; they did not turn when they moved. For the place toward which the head turned, they went after it; they did not turn when they moved.
And all their body and their backs and their hands and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around — the four of them, their wheels.
As for the wheels — to them it was called out in my ears, "The whirling wheel!"
And each one had four faces: the face of the first was the face of the cherub, and the face of the second the face of a human, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
And the cherubim rose. That was the living creature that I had seen by the river Kebar.
And when the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the cherubim lifted their wings to rise from the earth, the wheels also did not turn from beside them.
When they stood still, these stood still; and when they rose, these rose with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
And the glory of YHWH went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

And the cherubim lifted their wings and rose from the earth before my eyes as they went out, and the wheels alongside them. And it stood at the entrance of the eastern gate of the house of YHWH, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
That was the living creature that I had seen under the God of Israel by the river Kebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
Four, four faces belonged to each, and four wings to each; and the likeness of human hands was under their wings.
And the likeness of their faces: they were the faces that I had seen by the river Kebar — their appearance, and themselves. Each moved toward the side of its face.

ezekiel_11.t: And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to the eastern gate of the house of YHWH, which faces east; and there! at the entrance of the gate, twenty-five men; and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
And he said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who plan wickedness and who counsel evil counsel in this city,
who say, 'Not near — building houses! It is the pot and we are the meat.'
Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."
And the spirit of YHWH fell upon me and said to me, "Say: Thus says YHWH: So you have said, house of Israel; and the risings of your spirit — I myself know them.
You have multiplied your slain in this city and filled its streets with the slain."
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Your slain whom you have put in the middle of it — they are the meat, and it is the pot; but you he will bring out from the middle of it.
A sword you have feared, and a sword I will bring upon you — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And I will bring you out from the middle of it and give you into the hand of strangers, and I will perform judgements on you.
By the sword you shall fall. On the territory of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am YHWH.
It will not be a pot for you, and you will not be the meat in the middle of it. On the territory of Israel I will judge you,
and you will know that I am YHWH — you who have not walked in my statutes and have not done my judgements, but have acted according to the judgements of the nations that are around you."

And it was, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried out with a great voice and said, "Alas, Lord YHWH! Are you making a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, your brothers, your brothers — the men of your redemption — and all the house of Israel, all of it, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Keep far from YHWH; to us this land has been given as a possession' —

therefore say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Though I have removed them far off among the nations, and though I have scattered them among the lands, yet I have become for them a sanctuary for a little while in the lands where they have gone.
Therefore say: Thus says Lord YHWH: And I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the lands where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
And they will come there and remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
And I will give them one heart, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
so that they may walk in my statutes and keep my judgements and do them. And they will be my people, and I will be their God.
But as for those whose heart goes after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I have requited their conduct on their own head — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the cherubim lifted their wings, and the wheels alongside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
And the glory of YHWH went up from over the middle of the city and stood on the mountain that is east of the city.
And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to Chaldea, to the exiles, in the vision, by the spirit of God; and the vision that I had seen went up from me.
And I spoke to the exiles all the words of YHWH that he had shown me.

ezekiel_12.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, you are dwelling in the middle of the house of rebellion, who have eyes to see and do not see, ears to hear and do not hear; for they are a house of rebellion.

And you, son of man, prepare for yourself an exile's baggage, and go into exile by day before their eyes; and you shall go into exile from your place to another place before their eyes. Perhaps they will see — for they are a house of rebellion.
And you shall bring out your baggage like an exile's baggage, by day, before their eyes; and you yourself shall go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who go out into exile.
Before their eyes dig through the wall for yourself, and bring out through it.
Before their eyes lift it on your shoulder; in the dark bring it out. You shall cover your face and not see the land, for I have made you a sign for the house of Israel."

And I did so, as I was commanded. My baggage I brought out like an exile's baggage, by day; and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself with my hand; in the dark I brought it out, on my shoulder I lifted it, before their eyes.
And the word of YHWH came to me in the morning, saying:
"Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the house of rebellion, said to you, 'What are you doing?'
Say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: The prince — this oracle — in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel who are among them.
Say: I am your sign. As I have done, so it will be done to them: into exile, into captivity they will go.

And the prince who is among them shall lift onto his shoulder in the dark and go out; they will dig through the wall to bring out through it. He shall cover his face because he himself will not see the land with his eye.
And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net; and I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans — and he will not see it, and there he will die.
And all who are around him, his help and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw a sword after them.
And they will know that I am YHWH, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands.

But I will leave over from them men of number, from the sword, from famine and from pestilence, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they have gone; and they will know that I am YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with anxiety.

And say to the people of the land: Thus says Lord YHWH concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, concerning the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, so that her land may be desolate of its fullness, because of the violence of all who dwell in it.
And the inhabited cities shall be laid waste, and the land shall become a desolation; and you will know that I am YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, what is this proverb you have concerning the land of Israel, saying, 'The days grow long, and every vision perishes'?

Therefore say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: I will make this proverb cease, and they shall not use it as a proverb in Israel any more. But speak to them: The days have drawn near, and the matter of every vision.
For there will be no more any worthless vision or flattering divination in the middle of the house of Israel.
For I, YHWH, will speak. What I speak as a word will be done; it will not be postponed any more. For in your days, house of rebellion, I will speak a word and do it — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, look, the house of Israel are saying, 'The vision that he is seeing is for many days off, and he is prophesying of distant times.'
Therefore say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: None of my words will be postponed any more. What I speak as a word will be done — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_13.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are prophesying, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart: Hear the word of YHWH!
Thus says Lord YHWH: Woe to the foolish prophets, who walk after their own spirit and have not seen!
Like foxes among ruins your prophets have been, Israel.
You have not gone up into the breaches, nor walled up a wall around the house of Israel, to stand in the battle on the day of YHWH.
They have seen worthlessness and lying divination, those who say, 'The declaration of YHWH,' when YHWH has not sent them; and they have waited for a word to be fulfilled.
Have you not seen a worthless vision and spoken a lying divination, when you say, 'The declaration of YHWH,' and I have not spoken?
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you have spoken worthlessness and seen falsehood, therefore look, I am against you — the declaration of Lord YHWH.

And my hand will be against the prophets who see worthlessness and divine falsehood. They will not be in the council of my people, and in the register of the house of Israel they will not be written, and into the land of Israel they will not come; and you will know that I am Lord YHWH.
Because, yes because, they have led my people astray, saying 'Peace!' when there is no peace — and one builds a partition and, look, they are plastering it with whitewash —
say to those who plaster with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing rain; and you, hailstones, will fall; and a tempest wind will break through.
And look, the wall has fallen. Will it not be said to you, "Where is the plastering that you plastered?"
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I will make a tempest wind break out in my rage, and an overflowing rain will come in my anger, and hailstones in rage, for a complete end.

And I will tear down the wall that you plastered with whitewash and bring it down to the ground, and its foundation will be laid bare; and it will fall, and you will come to an end in the middle of it; and you will know that I am YHWH.
And I will complete my rage on the wall and on those who plastered it with whitewash; and I will say to you: The wall is no more, and those who plastered it are no more —
the prophets of Israel who prophesied concerning Jerusalem and saw for her a vision of peace, when there was no peace — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own heart, and prophesy against them.

And say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Woe to the women who sew bands on all the joints of my hands and make veils for the head of every stature, to hunt lives! Will you hunt the lives of my people and keep your own lives alive?

And you have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for fragments of bread, putting to death lives that should not die and keeping alive lives that should not live, by your lying to my people, who listen to falsehood.

Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against your bands with which you are hunting the lives there like birds, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will set free the lives, the lives that you are hunting like birds.
And I will tear off your veils and deliver my people from your hand, and they will no longer be prey in your hand; and you will know that I am YHWH.

Because you have disheartened the heart of the righteous with falsehood, when I myself had not caused him pain, and have strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he does not turn back from his evil way to be kept alive —
therefore you will not see worthlessness and will not divine divination any more; and I will deliver my people from your hand, and you will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_14.t: And men from the elders of Israel came to me, and they sat down before me.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, these men have brought up their idols onto their heart and have set the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces. Shall I really let myself be consulted by them?

Therefore speak with them and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Anyone at all of the house of Israel who brings up his idols onto his heart and sets the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and then comes to the prophet — I, YHWH, will let myself answer him, as he comes, by the multitude of his idols,
so as to seize the house of Israel by their heart, because all of them have become estranged from me through their idols.
Therefore say to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: Turn back, and turn away from your idols; and from all your abominations turn your faces away.

For anyone at all of the house of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns in Israel, who separates himself from following me and brings up his idols onto his heart and sets the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and then comes to the prophet to consult me through him — I, YHWH, will let myself answer him myself.
And I will set my face against that man and make him a sign and a byword, and I will cut him off from the middle of my people; and you will know that I am YHWH.
And the prophet, if he is deceived and speaks a word — I, YHWH, have deceived that prophet; and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from the middle of my people Israel.
And they will bear their iniquity: as the iniquity of the enquirer, so will be the iniquity of the prophet,

so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from following me and no longer make themselves unclean with all their transgressions. And they will be my people, and I will be their God — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, if a land sins against me by acting unfaithfully with unfaithfulness, and I stretch out my hand against it and break for it the staff of bread and send famine on it and cut off from it humankind and animals —
and these three men were in the middle of it — Noah, Danel and Job — they by their righteousness would deliver their own lives, the declaration of Lord YHWH.
If I make evil beasts pass through the land and they bereave it, and it becomes a desolation with no one passing through, because of the beasts —
these three men in the middle of it — as I live, the declaration of Lord YHWH, they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They alone would be delivered, and the land would be a desolation.
Or if I bring a sword upon that land and say, 'Sword, pass through the land,' and I cut off from it humankind and animals —
and these three men in the middle of it — as I live, the declaration of Lord YHWH, they would not deliver sons or daughters, for they alone would be delivered.
Or if I send pestilence against that land and pour out my rage on it in blood, to cut off from it humankind and animals —
and Noah, Danel and Job were in the middle of it — as I live, the declaration of Lord YHWH, they would deliver neither son nor daughter. They by their righteousness would deliver their own lives.
For thus says Lord YHWH: How much more when I send my four evil judgements — sword and famine and evil beasts and pestilence — against Jerusalem, to cut off from it humankind and animals!

And look, there will be left in it an escaped remnant, those being brought out, sons and daughters. Look, they are coming out to you, and you will see their conduct and their practices; and you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, all that I have brought upon it.
And they will comfort you when you see their conduct and their practices; and you will know that not without cause have I done all that I have done in it — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_15.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, what is the wood of the vine more than any wood — the vine branch that is among the trees of the forest?
Is wood taken from it to make into anything? Do people take from it a peg to hang any vessel on?
Look, it is given to the fire for fuel; the fire consumes its two ends and its middle is charred. Is it fit for anything?
Look, when it was whole it could not be made into anything. How much less, when fire has consumed it and it is charred, can it still be made into anything!
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I have given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And I will set my face against them. They have come out from the fire, and the fire will consume them; and you will know that I am YHWH, when I set my face against them.
And I will make the land a desolation, because they have acted unfaithfully with unfaithfulness — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_16.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, make Jerusalem know her abominations,
and say: Thus says Lord YHWH to Jerusalem: Your origins and your birth were from the land of the Canaanite; your father was the Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

And as for your birth, on the day you were born your umbilical cord was not cut, and you were not washed with water for cleansing; you were not rubbed with salt at all, and you were not wrapped at all.
No eye looked on you with compassion, to do any one of these for you, to have pity on you; and you were thrown out onto the face of the field, in the loathing of your life, on the day you were born.
And I passed by you and saw you kicking about in your blood, and I said to you in your blood, "Live!" — and I said to you in your blood, "Live!"
A myriad, like the growth of the field, I made you; and you grew and became great and came to the finest of ornaments. Your breasts were firm and your hair had grown, and you were naked and bare.

And I passed by you and saw you, and there! your time was the time of love. And I spread the skirt of my garment over you and covered your nakedness; and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you — the declaration of Lord YHWH — and you became mine.
And I washed you with water and rinsed your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
And I clothed you with embroidered cloth and shod you with fine leather, and I wrapped your head with fine linen and covered you with silk.
And I adorned you with ornaments and put bracelets on your hands and a chain on your neck.
And I put a ring on your nose and earrings on your ears, and a crown of beauty on your head.

And you adorned yourself with gold and silver, and your clothing was fine linen and silk and embroidered cloth. Fine flour and honey and oil you ate, and you became beautiful, very, very, and you prospered into kingship.
And a name went out for you among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through my splendour that I had put upon you — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
But you trusted in your beauty and whored on your name, and you poured out your whorings on every passer-by — let it be his!
And you took some of your clothes and made for yourself high places of many colours, and you whored on them — such as should not come and should not be.
And you took your articles of beauty, from my gold and from my silver that I had given you, and you made for yourself images of a male, and you whored with them.
And you took your embroidered clothes and covered them, and my oil and my incense you set before them.
And my bread that I gave you — fine flour and oil and honey I fed you — you set it before them for a soothing odour; and so it was, the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And you took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne to me, and you sacrificed them to them to be devoured. Was your whoring too little?
And you slaughtered my children and gave them up, in making them pass over to them.
And with all your abominations and your whorings you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
And it was, after all your evil — woe, woe to you! the declaration of Lord YHWH —
you built for yourself a mound and made for yourself a high place in every open square.
At every head of a road you built your high place, and you made your beauty an abomination, and you spread your legs open to every passer-by, and you multiplied your whorings.
And you whored with the Egyptians, your neighbours, big of flesh; and you multiplied your whoring to provoke me to anger.

And look, I stretched out my hand against you and cut back your allotted portion, and I gave you over to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your licentious conduct.
And you whored with the Assyrians, because you were not satisfied; and you whored with them, and even so you were not satisfied.
And you multiplied your whoring toward a land of merchants, toward Chaldea; and even by this you were not satisfied.
How sick is your heart — the declaration of Lord YHWH — that you do all these, the deeds of a woman, a whore, and a domineering one!
When you built your mound at the head of every road and made your high place in every open square — and you were not like the whore, in scorning the whore's fee.
The adulterous wife, who takes strangers in place of her husband!
To all whores men give a gift; but you gave your gifts to all your lovers and bribed them to come to you from all around for your whorings.
And in you it was the opposite of other women in your whorings: no one whored after you, and in your giving a fee, when no fee was given to you — you became the opposite.
Therefore, whore, hear the word of YHWH!

Thus says Lord YHWH: Because your lust was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your whorings with your lovers, and because of all the idols of your abominations, and because of the blood of your children that you gave to them —

therefore look, I am gathering all your lovers to whom you were pleasing, and all whom you loved along with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from all around, and I will uncover your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.
And I will judge you with the judgements of adulteresses and of women who shed blood, and I will bring on you the blood of rage and jealousy.

And I will give you into their hand, and they will tear down your mound and break down your high places; and they will strip your clothes off you and take your articles of beauty, and leave you naked and bare.
And they will bring up a company against you and stone you with stones and cut you to pieces with their swords.
And they will burn your houses with fire and perform judgements on you before the eyes of many women; and I will make you cease from being a whore, and you will also give a fee no more.
And I will give my rage rest upon you, and my jealousy will turn aside from you; and I will be quiet and will not be angry any more.

Because you did not remember the days of your youth and enraged me with all these, look, I too have requited your conduct on your head — the declaration of Lord YHWH — and have you not committed licentiousness on top of all your abominations?
Look, everyone who speaks a proverb will speak a proverb about you, saying: "Like the mother, her daughter."

You are your mother's daughter, who loathed her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
And your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwells to your north; and your sister who is younger than you, who dwells to your south, is Sodom and her daughters.
And you did not walk in their ways or do according to their abominations — as if that were a little thing — and you acted more corruptly than they in all your ways.
As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — Sodom your sister, she and her daughters, did not do as you have done, you and your daughters.
Look, this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister: pride, surfeit of food and ease of quiet belonged to her and her daughters; and she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and the needy.
And they were haughty and did abomination before me; and I removed them when I saw it.
And Samaria did not sin as much as half your sins; and you multiplied your abominations more than they, and you made your sisters appear righteous by all your abominations that you have done.

You too, bear your disgrace, you who have interceded for your sister: by your sins, in which you acted more abominably than they, they are more righteous than you. And you too, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, because you made your sisters appear righteous.
And I will turn back their captivity — the captivity of Sodom and her daughters and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters — and the captivity of your captives in the middle of them,
so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all that you have done, in comforting them.

And your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former state; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former state; and you and your daughters will return to your former state.
And was not Sodom your sister a mention in your mouth in the day of your pride,
before your own evil was uncovered — like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Aram and all those around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you from all around?
Your licentiousness and your abominations — you have borne them, the declaration of YHWH.
For thus says Lord YHWH: And I will deal with you as you have done, you who despised an oath by breaking a covenant.
But I myself will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish for you a perpetual covenant.
And you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your sisters, those older than you and those younger than you; and I will give them to you as daughters, though not by your covenant.
And I myself will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am YHWH,

so that you may remember and be ashamed, and may no longer have an opening of the mouth because of your disgrace, when I make atonement for you for all that you have done — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_17.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, put a riddle and speak a proverb to the house of Israel,
and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: The great eagle, great of wings, long of pinion, full of plumage, which had the variegated feathers, came to Lebanon and took the treetop of the cedar.
It plucked off the top of its shoots and brought it to a land of merchants; in a city of traders it set it.
And it took some of the seed of the land and put it in a field of seed; it took it by many waters, it set it as a willow.
And it sprouted and became a spreading vine, low of stature, its branches turning toward it and its roots under it; and it became a vine and produced shoots and sent out boughs.

And there was another great eagle, great of wings and abundant of plumage; and look, this vine bent its roots toward it and sent out its branches to it, for it to water it, away from the beds where it was planted.
To a good field, by many waters, it was planted, to produce branches and bear fruit, to become a splendid vine.

Say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Will it prosper? Will he not pull up its roots and strip off its fruit, so that it withers — all the fresh growth of it will wither — and not by a great arm or by many people, to lift it from its roots?
And look, it is planted — will it prosper? When the east wind touches it, will it not wither and wither? On the beds where it grew it will wither."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Say now to the house of rebellion: Do you not know what these things are? Say: Look, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its princes and brought them to himself, to Babylon.
And he took one of the royal offspring and cut a covenant with him and brought him into an oath; and he took away the leaders of the land,
so that the kingdom should be lowly and not exalt itself, keeping his covenant so that it might stand.
But he rebelled against him by sending his messengers to Egypt, to give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one who does these things escape? Will he break a covenant and escape?
As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, with him, in the middle of Babylon, he will die.
And not with a large army or a great company will Pharaoh act with him in the battle, when a ramp is poured out and a siege-wall built to cut off many lives.
He despised an oath by breaking a covenant; and look, he had given his hand, and all these things he did — he will not escape.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: As I live, surely my oath that he despised and my covenant that he broke — I will requite it on his own head.

And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net; and I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgement with him there for his unfaithfulness by which he has acted unfaithfully against me.
And all his fugitives, among all his troops, will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind; and you will know that I, YHWH, have spoken.

Thus says Lord YHWH: And I myself will take from the treetop of the high cedar and will set it; from the top of its shoots I will pluck off a tender one, and I myself will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

On the mountain of the height of Israel I will plant it, and it will bear branches and produce fruit and become a majestic cedar; and under it will dwell every bird of every wing — in the shade of its branches they will dwell.
And all the trees of the field will know that I, YHWH, bring low the tall tree and raise up the low tree, dry up the moist tree and make the dry tree sprout. I, YHWH, have spoken and will do it."

ezekiel_18.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"What do you mean, you who speak this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying: 'Fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?
As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — you will no longer have occasion to speak this proverb in Israel.
Look, all the lives are mine: as the life of the father, so the life of the son — they are mine. The person who sins, that one will die.
And if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness —

he has not eaten on the mountains and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not made his neighbour's wife unclean and has not drawn near to a woman in menstrual impurity;
and he has not oppressed anyone, has returned the debtor's pledge, has robbed no robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing;
he has not lent at interest and has not taken increase, has turned his hand back from injustice, has done true justice between one person and another;
he walks in my statutes and has kept my judgements, doing faithfully — he is righteous. Living he shall live, the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And he fathers a violent son, a shedder of blood, who does — alas — any one of these things,
though he himself did none of these things — for he has even eaten on the mountains and made his neighbour's wife unclean,
has oppressed the poor and the needy, has robbed robberies, has not returned a pledge; and he has lifted his eyes to the idols, has done abomination,
has lent at interest and taken increase — and shall he live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations; dying he shall die. His blood will be upon him.
And look, he fathers a son who has seen all the sins of his father that he did — and he saw, and did not do like them:
he has not eaten on the mountains and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not made his neighbour's wife unclean;
and he has not oppressed anyone, has not taken a pledge, has robbed no robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing;
he has turned his hand back from the poor, has not taken interest or increase, has done my judgements, has walked in my statutes — he will not die for his father's iniquity. Living he shall live.
His father, because he extorted extortion, robbed a brother's robbery, and did what was not good among his people — look, he will die for his iniquity.
And you say, "Why has the son not borne the iniquity of the father?" But the son has done justice and righteousness, has kept all my statutes and done them; living he shall live.

The person who sins, that one will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous will be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon him.
And if the wicked turns back from all his sins that he has done and keeps all my statutes and does justice and righteousness, living he shall live; he will not die.
All his transgressions that he has done will not be remembered against him. For his righteousness that he has done he will live.
Do I really take pleasure in the death of the wicked — the declaration of Lord YHWH — and not rather that he should turn back from his ways and live?

And when a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice, doing according to all the abominations that the wicked does — shall he live? None of his righteous acts that he has done will be remembered. For his unfaithfulness by which he has acted unfaithfully and for his sin by which he has sinned — for them he will die.
And you say, "The way of the Lord is not right." Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
When a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice and dies for them — for his injustice that he has done he dies.
And when a wicked one turns from his wickedness that he has done and does justice and righteousness, he will keep his own life alive.
And he saw and turned back from all his transgressions that he had done; living he shall live, he will not die.
And the house of Israel say, "The way of the Lord is not right." Are my ways not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not right?

Therefore I will judge you, each according to his ways, house of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH. Turn back and turn away from all your transgressions, and iniquity will not be a stumbling block to you.
Throw away from yourselves all your transgressions by which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. And why will you die, house of Israel?
For I take no pleasure in the death of the one who dies — the declaration of Lord YHWH. So turn back and live!"

ezekiel_19.t: "And you, take up a lamentation over the princes of Israel,
and say: What a lioness was your mother among lions! She lay down among young lions; she reared her cubs.
And she brought up one of her cubs; he became a young lion. And he learned to tear prey; he devoured humans.
And nations heard of him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
And she saw that she had waited, that her hope was lost; and she took one of her cubs, made him a young lion.
And he went about among lions; he became a young lion. And he learned to tear prey; he devoured humans.
And he knew their widows, and he laid waste their cities; and the land and all that fills it were desolate at the sound of his roaring.
And nations set on him from the provinces all around; and they spread their net over him — he was caught in their pit.
And they put him in a cage with hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by water; she was fruitful and full of branches from the abundant waters.
And she had branches of strength for the sceptres of rulers; and its stature towered above the thick boughs, and it was seen in its height, in the abundance of its branches.
But she was plucked up in rage, thrown down to the ground; and the east wind dried up her fruit. They were torn off and withered — her branch of strength; fire consumed it.
And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
And fire went out from the branch of her shoots; it consumed her fruit. And there was in her no branch of strength, no sceptre for ruling. This is a lamentation, and it has become a lamentation.

ezekiel_20.t: And it was in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], on the tenth of the month, that men from the elders of Israel came to consult YHWH, and they sat down before me.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, speak with the elders of Israel and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Is it to consult me that you are coming? As I live, I will not let myself be consulted by you — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
Will you judge them? Will you judge, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers,

and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: On the day I chose Israel, I lifted my hand to the offspring of the house of Jacob and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt; and I lifted my hand to them, saying, 'I am YHWH your God.'
On that day I lifted my hand to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt to a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey — it is the beauty of all the lands.
And I said to them: Each of you, throw away the detestable things of his eyes, and do not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.

But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me. None of them threw away the detestable things of his eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said I would pour out my rage on them, to complete my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations among whom they were — before whose eyes I had made myself known to them, in bringing them out from the land of Egypt.
And I brought them out from the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
And I gave them my statutes and made known to them my judgements, which the person who does them will live by.
And also my sabbaths I gave to them, to be a sign between me and them, so that they would know that I am YHWH who sets them apart as holy.

But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not walk in my statutes and they rejected my judgements, which the person who does them will live by; and my sabbaths they profaned exceedingly. And I said I would pour out my rage on them in the wilderness, to make an end of them.
But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations before whose eyes I had brought them out.
And I also lifted my hand to them in the wilderness, not to bring them into the land that I had given, flowing with milk and honey — it is the beauty of all the lands —
because they had rejected my judgements and had not walked in my statutes and had profaned my sabbaths; for their heart was walking after their idols.
But my eye looked on them with compassion, so as not to destroy them, and I did not make an end of them in the wilderness.
And I said to their children in the wilderness: Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their judgements, and do not make yourselves unclean with their idols.
I am YHWH your God. Walk in my statutes and keep my judgements and do them,
and set my sabbaths apart as holy; and they will be a sign between me and you, so that you will know that I am YHWH your God.

But the children rebelled against me. They did not walk in my statutes and did not keep my judgements, to do them — which the person who does them will live by; my sabbaths they profaned. And I said I would pour out my rage on them, to complete my anger against them in the wilderness.
But I turned back my hand and acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations before whose eyes I had brought them out.
Also I lifted my hand to them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands,
because they had not done my judgements and had rejected my statutes and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and judgements by which they could not live;
and I made them unclean by their own gifts, in making every firstborn of the womb pass over — so that I might make them appalled, so that they would know that I am YHWH.
Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: In this also your fathers blasphemed me, in acting unfaithfully against me with unfaithfulness.

And I brought them into the land that I had lifted my hand to give to them; and they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and there they sacrificed their sacrifices and there they presented the provocation of their offering, and there they set their soothing odours, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
And I said to them: What is the high place that you go to? And its name has been called Bamah to this day.
Therefore say to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: Are you making yourselves unclean in the way of your fathers, and whoring after their detestable things?

And in lifting up your gifts, in making your children pass through the fire, you are making yourselves unclean with all your idols to this day. And shall I let myself be consulted by you, house of Israel? As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — I will not let myself be consulted by you.
And what comes up on your spirit will certainly not happen — what you are saying: 'We will be like the nations, like the clans of the lands, serving wood and stone.'
As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — surely with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with rage poured out I will reign over you.
And I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with rage poured out.
And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgement with you, face to face.
Just as I entered into judgement with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgement with you — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

And I will purge out from you those who rebel and those who transgress against me. From the land of their sojournings I will bring them out, but into the land of Israel he will not come; and you will know that I am YHWH.

And you, house of Israel — thus says Lord YHWH: Go, serve each of you his idols; and afterwards, if you will not listen to me — but my holy name you shall no longer profane with your gifts and with your idols.

For on my holy mountain, on the mountain height of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH — there all the house of Israel, all of it, will serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will seek your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your holy things.

As a soothing odour I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered; and I will show myself holy among you before the eyes of the nations.
And you will know that I am YHWH, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land that I lifted my hand to give to your fathers.
And there you will remember your ways and all your practices by which you made yourselves unclean; and you will loathe yourselves to your own faces for all your evils that you have done.

And you will know that I am YHWH, when I deal with you for the sake of my name — not according to your evil ways or according to your corrupt practices, house of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward the south, and prophesy against the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field, the Negev.

And say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of YHWH. Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will consume in you every moist tree and every dry tree. The blazing flame will not be extinguished, and by it every face from the south to the north will be scorched.
And all flesh will see that I, YHWH, have kindled it; it will not be extinguished."
And I said, "Alas, Lord YHWH! They are saying of me, 'Is he not a maker of parables?'"

ezekiel_21.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem and prophesy against the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
And say to the land of Israel: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am against you, and I will bring my sword out of its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
Because I am cutting off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh, from south to north.
And all flesh will know that I, YHWH, have brought my sword out of its sheath; it will not go back again."
"And you, son of man, groan; with breaking of loins and with bitterness, groan before their eyes.

And when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say: Because of a report — for it is coming, and every heart will melt and all hands will hang limp, and every spirit will grow faint and all knees will run with water. Look, it is coming, and it will happen — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says the Lord: Say: A sword, a sword — sharpened, and also polished!
Sharpened for slaughtering a slaughter, polished so as to have lightning for it — or shall we rejoice? The rod of my son rejects every tree.
And he gave it to be polished, to be grasped in the palm. It has been sharpened, a sword, and it has been polished, to be put into the hand of the slayer.
Cry out and wail, son of man, for it has come upon my people; it is upon all the princes of Israel. Thrown to the sword they have been, along with my people. Therefore slap the thigh.
For it has been tested — and what if even the rejecting rod does not come? the declaration of Lord YHWH."
"And you, son of man, prophesy and strike palm against palm. And let the sword be doubled a third time — the sword of the slain; it is the sword of the great slain one that closes in on them,
so that the heart may melt and the stumblings be many. At all their gates I have set the slaughter of a sword. Alas! It is made for lightning, wrapped for slaughtering.
Be sharp! Go right! Set yourself! Go left! Wherever your face is appointed.
And I too will strike my palm against my palm and give my rage rest. I, YHWH, have spoken."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"And you, son of man, mark out for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come by. From one land the two of them shall go out; and make a signpost — at the head of the road to a city make it.
Mark out a road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the people of Ammon, and to Judah, in fortified Jerusalem.

For the king of Babylon has stopped at the mother of the road, at the head of the two roads, to divine a divination. He has shaken the arrows, he has enquired of the teraphim, he has looked at the liver.

Into his right hand came the divination — Jerusalem: to set up battering-rams, to open the mouth in shattering, to lift the voice with a war cry, to set up battering-rams against the gates, to pour out a ramp, to build a siege-wall.
And it will be to them like a false divination in their eyes — they who have sworn oaths! But he brings iniquity to remembrance, so that they may be seized.

Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you have brought your iniquity to remembrance, in that your transgressions are uncovered so that your sins are seen in all your practices — because you have been brought to remembrance, you will be seized by the hand.
And you, profaned wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come at the time of the iniquity of the end —
thus says Lord YHWH: Remove the turban and lift off the crown! This is not this. Exalt the lowly and bring low the exalted.
A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! Also this will not be, until he comes to whom the judgement belongs; and I will give it to him.

"And you, son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says Lord YHWH concerning the people of Ammon and concerning their reproach; and say: A sword, a sword — drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, for the sake of lightning!
while they see worthlessness for you, while they divine falsehood for you — to lay you on the necks of the profaned wicked, whose day has come at the time of the iniquity of the end.
Put it back into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origins, I will judge you.
And I will pour out my indignation on you; with the fire of my wrath I will blow on you, and I will give you into the hand of brutish men, craftsmen of destruction.
You will become fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the middle of the land; you will not be remembered. For I, YHWH, have spoken."

ezekiel_22.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"And you, son of man — will you judge? will you judge the city of blood? Then make known to her all her abominations,
and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: A city that sheds blood in her midst, so that her time comes; and that has made idols for herself, to become unclean!

By your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your idols that you have made you have become unclean; and you have brought your days near and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a derision to all the lands.
Those near and those far from you will deride you — unclean of name, great in turmoil!
Look, the princes of Israel — each according to his own strength — have been in you, so as to shed blood.
Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; to the sojourner they have acted with oppression in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have maltreated in you.
My holy things you have despised, and my sabbaths you have profaned.
Men of slander have been in you, so as to shed blood; and on the mountains they have eaten in you; licentiousness they have done in your midst.
A father's nakedness has been uncovered in you; the woman unclean in her menstrual impurity has been humiliated in you.
And one has done abomination with his neighbour's wife; and one has made his daughter-in-law unclean with licentiousness; and one has humiliated his sister, his father's daughter, in you.

A bribe they have taken in you, so as to shed blood. Interest and increase you have taken, and you have made unjust gain from your neighbours by oppression; and me you have forgotten — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And look, I have struck my palm at your unjust gain that you have made, and at your blood that has been in your midst.
Will your heart endure, or will your hands be strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, YHWH, have spoken and will do it.
And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will make an end of your uncleanness from you.
And you will be profaned by yourself before the eyes of the nations; and you will know that I am YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are copper and tin and iron and lead in the middle of a furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because all of you have become dross, therefore look, I am gathering you into the middle of Jerusalem.

As silver and copper and iron and lead and tin are gathered into the middle of a furnace, to blow fire on it to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my rage, and I will set you down and melt you.
And I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
As silver is melted in the middle of a furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, YHWH, have poured out my rage on you."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, say to her: You are a land that has not been cleansed, not rained on in a day of indignation.
A conspiracy of her prophets is in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing prey. They have devoured persons; they take treasure and precious things; her widows they have multiplied in her midst.

Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. Between the holy and the common they have not separated, and between the unclean and the clean they have not made known; and from my sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I have been profaned among them.
Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing prey, to shed blood, to destroy lives, so as to make unjust gain.
And her prophets have plastered whitewash for them, seeing worthlessness and divining falsehood for them, saying, 'Thus says Lord YHWH,' when YHWH had not spoken.
The people of the land have oppressed with oppression and robbed robbery; they have maltreated the poor and the needy, and have oppressed the sojourner without justice.
And I sought from among them someone to build up a wall and stand in the breach before me for the land, so that I should not destroy it; but I found no one.
And I have poured out my indignation on them; with the fire of my wrath I have made an end of them. Their conduct I have requited on their own head — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_23.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
And they whored in Egypt; in their youth they whored. There their breasts were handled, and there their virgin nipples were squeezed.
And their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister; and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
And Oholah whored while she was mine, and lusted after her lovers, after Assyria — warriors,
clothed in violet, governors and officials, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.
And she gave her whorings to them — all of them the choicest of the Assyrians — and by all whom she lusted after, by all their idols, she made herself unclean.
And she did not forsake her whorings from Egypt, for they had lain with her in her youth and they had squeezed her virgin nipples and poured out their whoring on her.
Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, after whom she lusted.
They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, and her they killed with the sword. And she became a byword among women, and they carried out judgements on her.
And her sister Oholibah saw, and she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and her whorings were more than her sister's whorings.
She lusted after the Assyrians — governors and officials, warriors clothed in perfection, horsemen riding horses, all of them desirable young men.
And I saw that she had made herself unclean; both of them had one way.
And she added to her whorings. And she saw men carved on the wall, images of Chaldeans inscribed in vermilion,
girded with a waistband at their hips, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them with the appearance of officers, the likeness of the sons of Babylon — Chaldea was the land of their birth.
And she lusted after them at the sight of her eyes, and sent messengers to them, to Chaldea.
And the sons of Babylon came to her, to the bed of love, and they made her unclean with their whoring; and she became unclean by them, and her self was alienated from them.
And she uncovered her whorings and uncovered her nakedness; and my self was alienated from her, as my self had been alienated from her sister.
And she multiplied her whorings, remembering the days of her youth, when she whored in the land of Egypt.
And she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys and whose emission is the emission of horses.
And you sought out the licentiousness of your youth, when your nipples were squeezed by the Egyptians, on account of the breasts of your youth.
Therefore, Oholibah, thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your self was alienated, and I will bring them against you from all around —

the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the Assyrians with them — desirable young men, governors and officials, all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding horses.

And they will come against you with weapons, chariots and wheels, and with a company of peoples. Body shield and shield and helmet they will set against you all around; and I will set judgement before them, and they will judge you by their judgements.

And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in rage. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and what is left of you will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and what is left of you will be consumed by fire.
And they will strip you of your clothes and take away your articles of beauty.
And I will make your licentiousness cease from you, and your whoring from the land of Egypt; and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will not remember any more.
For thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am giving you into the hand of those you hate, into the hand of those from whom your self was alienated.
And they will deal with you in hatred and take all your property and leave you naked and bare; and the nakedness of your whorings will be uncovered, and your licentiousness and your whorings.
These things have been done to you because you whored after the nations, because you made yourself unclean with their idols.
In the way of your sister you have walked; and I will put her cup into your hand.
Thus says Lord YHWH: You will drink your sister's cup, the deep and the wide one; you will become laughter and mockery — it holds much.
With drunkenness and sorrow you will be filled — the cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
And you will drink it and drain it, and you will gnaw its shards and tear out your own breasts. For I have spoken — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you have forgotten me and thrown me behind your back, you also bear your licentiousness and your whorings.
And YHWH said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations,
for they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. With their idols they have committed adultery, and even their children whom they bore to me they have made pass over to them, for food.
Again, this they have done to me: they made my sanctuary unclean on that same day, and my sabbaths they profaned.
And when they had slaughtered their children for their idols, they came into my sanctuary on that same day to profane it. And look, this is what they did inside my house.
And more than that: they sent for men coming from far off, to whom a messenger was sent — and look, they came. For them you bathed, painted your eyes and put on ornaments.
And you sat on a glorious couch, with a table laid out before it; and my incense and my oil you set on it.

And the sound of a carefree multitude was in her; and to the men, out of the multitude of humankind, Sabeans were brought from the wilderness. And they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of beauty on their heads.
And I said of the worn-out one, "Adulteries! Now they will whore her whorings, and she too."
And they went in to her as one goes in to a whore. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the licentious women.
And righteous men — they will judge them with the judgement of adulteresses and the judgement of women who shed blood; for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
For thus says Lord YHWH: Bring up a company against them and give them over to terror and to spoil.
And the company will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
And I will make licentiousness cease from the land, and all the women will be warned, and they will not act according to your licentiousness.
And they will requite your licentiousness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols; and you will know that I am Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_24.t: And the word of YHWH came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying:
"Son of man, write for yourself the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has leaned against Jerusalem on this very day.
And speak a parable to the house of rebellion, and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Set on the pot, set it on, and also pour water into it.
Gather its pieces into it, every good piece — thigh and shoulder; fill it with the choicest of the bones.
Take the choicest of the flock, and also pile the bones under it; make its boilings boil; its bones have also been cooked inside it.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Woe, city of blood — a pot whose rust is in it, and whose rust has not gone out of it! Piece by piece take it out; no lot has fallen on it.
For her blood is in her midst; she set it on the bare rock. She did not pour it out on the ground, to cover it with dust.
To stir up rage, to take vengeance with vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, so that it should not be covered.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Woe, city of blood! I too will make the pile great.
Increase the wood, kindle the fire, finish off the meat, mix in the seasoning; and let the bones be charred.
And set it empty on its coals, so that it may grow hot and its bronze burn, and its uncleanness be melted inside it, its rust consumed.
It has wearied itself with toil, and its great rust has not gone out of it — its rust, into the fire!
In your uncleanness is licentiousness. Because I cleansed you and you were not clean, you will not be clean from your uncleanness again, until I have given my rage rest upon you.

I, YHWH, have spoken. It is coming, and I will do it. I will not refrain and I will not have compassion and I will not relent. According to your ways and according to your practices they have judged you — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, look, I am about to take from you the desire of your eyes with a blow; and you shall not lament and shall not weep, and your tears shall not come.
Groan — be silent. Do not perform mourning for the dead. Bind your turban on yourself and put your sandals on your feet; and do not cover the moustache, and do not eat the bread of mourners.
And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening; and in the morning I did as I had been commanded.
And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing?"
And I said to them: The word of YHWH came to me, saying:

Say to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am about to profane my sanctuary — the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes and the compassion of your being. And your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
And you will do as I have done: you will not cover the moustache and will not eat the bread of mourners;
and your turbans will be on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not lament and will not weep, but you will waste away in your iniquities and groan, each to his brother.
And Ezekiel will be a sign for you: according to all that he has done you will do. When it comes, you will know that I am Lord YHWH."

"And you, son of man — will it not be on the day I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendour, the desire of their eyes and the uplifting of their being, their sons and their daughters —
on that day an escapee will come to you, to make it heard by your ears?
On that day your mouth will be opened with the escapee, and you will speak and will no longer be mute. And you will be a sign for them; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_25.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward the people of Ammon and prophesy against them,

and say to the people of Ammon: Hear the word of Lord YHWH. Thus says Lord YHWH: Because you said 'Aha!' over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile —

therefore look, I am giving you to the people of the east as a possession. They will set up their encampments among you and put their dwellings among you; they will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
And I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and the people of Ammon a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am YHWH.
For thus says Lord YHWH: Because you clapped your hand and stamped with your foot and rejoiced with all the scorn of your being against the land of Israel —

therefore look, I have stretched out my hand against you and will give you as spoil to the nations, and I will cut you off from the peoples and destroy you from the lands. I will annihilate you, and you will know that I am YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Because Moab and Seir said, 'Look, the house of Judah is like all the nations' —
therefore look, I am about to open the shoulder of Moab, from the cities — from his cities, from his frontier — the beauty of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim,
to the people of the east, along with the people of Ammon; and I will give it as a possession, so that the people of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
And on Moab I will perform judgements; and they will know that I am YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Because Edom acted by taking vengeance with vengeance on the house of Judah, and they became utterly guilty and avenged themselves on them —

therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it humankind and animals, and I will make it a ruin. From Teman, and as far as Dedan, they will fall by the sword.

And I will put my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to my anger and according to my rage; and they will know my vengeance — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and avenged themselves with vengeance, with scorn in the self, to destroy in perpetual enmity —
therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am stretching out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast.
And I will perform great vengeance on them, with rebukes of rage; and they will know that I am YHWH, when I put my vengeance on them."

ezekiel_26.t: And it was in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, because Tyre said over Jerusalem, 'Aha! The doors of the peoples are broken; it has turned to me; I shall be filled, she is laid waste' —
therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
And they will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will scrape her dust from her and make her a bare rock.
She will be a spreading place for nets in the middle of the sea, for I have spoken — the declaration of Lord YHWH. And she will become spoil for the nations.
And her daughters who are in the field will be killed by the sword; and they will know that I am YHWH.
For thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am bringing against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north, king of kings, with horses and chariotry and horsemen, and a company and a numerous people.
Your daughters in the field he will kill with the sword; and he will set a siege-wall against you and pour out a ramp against you and raise a body shield against you.
And the blow of his battering-ram he will set against your walls, and your towers he will break down with his swords.
From the abundance of his horses their dust will cover you; from the sound of horseman and wheel and chariot your walls will shake, when he enters your gates as one enters a city broken into.
With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; your people he will kill with the sword, and the pillars of your strength will come down to the ground.

And they will plunder your wealth and take your merchandise as spoil, and tear down your walls and pull down your houses of desire; and your stones and your timber and your dust they will put in the middle of the water.
And I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will not be heard again.
And I will make you a bare rock; you will be a spreading place for nets. You will not be built again, for I, YHWH, have spoken — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH to Tyre: Will the islands not quake at the sound of your downfall, when the fatally wounded groan, when slaughter is slaughtered in your midst?

And all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones and remove their robes and strip off their embroidered clothes. They will clothe themselves in tremblings; they will sit on the ground and tremble every moment and be appalled at you.

And they will take up a lamentation over you and say to you: How you have perished, you who were peopled from the seas, the praised city that was mighty on the sea — she and her inhabitants, who put their terror on all who dwell there!
Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall, and the islands that are in the sea are terrified at your passing.
For thus says Lord YHWH: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the many waters cover you,

then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago, and make you dwell in the earth below, among ruins from of old, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will set splendour in the land of the living.
I will make you terrors, and you will be no more; and you will be sought and not found again, for ever — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_27.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"And you, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre,
and say to Tyre, who sits at the entrances of the sea, the trader of the peoples to many islands: Thus says Lord YHWH: Tyre, you have said, "I am perfect in beauty."
In the heart of the seas were your borders; your builders perfected your beauty.
Of fir trees from Senir they built for you all your planking; a cedar from Lebanon they took, to make a mast on you.
Oaks from Bashan they made into your oars; your deck they made of ivory inlaid in pine from the islands of Kittim.
Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt was your sail, to be a banner for you; violet and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your skilled men, Tyre, were in you — they were your sailors.
The elders of Gebal and her skilled men were in you, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their mariners were in you, to trade your merchandise.
Persia and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war. Shield and helmet they hung in you; they gave you your splendour.
The people of Arvad and Helech were on your walls all around, and the Gammadites were in your towers. Their shields they hung on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
Tarshish was your trader from the abundance of every kind of wealth; for silver, iron, tin and lead they exchanged your wares.
Javan, Tubal and Meshech — they were your traders. For the lives of humans and vessels of bronze they exchanged your merchandise.
From Beth-togarmah they exchanged your wares for horses and warhorses and mules.
The people of Dedan were your traders; many islands were the market of your hand. Horns of ivory and ebony they brought back to you as tribute.
Aram was your trader from the abundance of your products. For emeralds, purple and embroidered cloth, and fine linen and corals and ruby, they exchanged for your wares.
Judah and the land of Israel — they were your traders. For wheat of Minnith and pannag and honey and oil and balm they exchanged your merchandise.
Damascus was your trader in the abundance of your products, from the abundance of every kind of wealth — with the wine of Helbon and white wool.
And Vedan and Javan from Uzal exchanged for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus were in your merchandise.
Dedan was your trader in cloths of covering for riding.
Arabia and all the princes of Kedar — they were the traders of your hand, in lambs and rams and goats; in these they were your traders.
The traders of Sheba and Raamah — they were your traders. For the best of every spice and for every precious stone and gold they exchanged your wares.
Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad were your traders.
They were your traders in fine garments, in wrappings of violet and embroidered cloth, and in treasuries of variegated cloth, bound with cords and made firm — in your market.
The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise; and you were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas.
Into many waters your rowers brought you; the east wind broke you in the heart of the seas.

Your wealth and your wares, your merchandise, your mariners and your sailors, those who repaired your leaks and those who traded your merchandise, and all your men of war who were in you, and all your company that was in your midst — they will fall into the heart of the seas on the day of your downfall.
At the sound of the outcry of your sailors the pasturelands will quake.
And all who wield an oar will come down from their ships; the mariners, all the sailors of the sea, will stand on the land.
And they will make their voice heard over you and cry out bitterly; they will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
And they will make themselves bald for you and gird on sackcloth, and weep for you in bitterness of being, with bitter wailing.
And in their wailing they will take up a lamentation over you and lament over you: Who was like Tyre, like one silenced in the middle of the sea?
When your wares went out from the seas you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you made rich the kings of the earth.
Now you are broken from the seas, in the depths of the water; your merchandise and all your company have fallen in your midst.
All the inhabitants of the islands are appalled at you, and their kings shudder with shuddering; their faces are disturbed.
The traders among the peoples hiss at you; you have become terrors, and you will be no more, for ever."

ezekiel_28.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because your heart has been haughty and you have said, 'I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods, in the heart of the seas' — yet you are a human and not a god, and you have made your heart like the heart of a god —
look, you are wiser than Danel; no secret is dark to you!
By your wisdom and by your understanding you have acquired wealth for yourself, and have acquired gold and silver in your treasuries.
By the greatness of your wisdom, by your trading, you have increased your wealth, and your heart has been haughty in your wealth.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you have made your heart like the heart of a god,
therefore look, I am bringing against you strangers, the most ruthless of nations; and they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and profane your splendour.
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the deaths of the slain in the heart of the seas.
Will you really say, 'I am a god,' before the one who kills you? You are a human and not a god, in the hand of those who pierce you.
You will die the deaths of the uncircumcised, by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him: Thus says Lord YHWH: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering: ruby, topaz and diamond, beryl, onyx and jasper, sapphire, turquoise and emerald — and gold. The workmanship of your settings and your mountings was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
You were an anointed cherub who covers, and I appointed you; you were on the holy mountain of God, you walked about among stones of fire.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.

In the abundance of your trading they filled your midst with violence, and you sinned; and I profaned you from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, covering cherub, from among the stones of fire.
Your heart was haughty in your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your splendour. I threw you to the ground; before kings I set you, for them to look at you.
