From the greatness of your iniquities, by the unrighteousness of your trading, you profaned your sanctuaries. And I brought out fire from your midst; it consumed you, and I made you ashes on the ground before the eyes of all who saw you.
All who knew you among the peoples are appalled at you. You have become terrors, and you will be no more, for ever."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will gain glory in your midst; and they will know that I am YHWH when I perform judgements on her and show myself holy in her.
And I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the slain will fall in her midst, by the sword against her from all around; and they will know that I am YHWH.
And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a pricking brier or a painful thorn from any around them who despise them; and they will know that I am Lord YHWH.

Thus says Lord YHWH: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, and show myself holy among them before the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land, which I gave to my servant, to Jacob.

And they will dwell on it in safety, and build houses and plant vineyards, and dwell in safety, when I perform judgements on all who despise them from around them; and they will know that I am YHWH their God."

ezekiel_29.t: In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], on the twelfth of the month, the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
Speak and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great sea monster that lies among his canals, who has said, 'My Nile is my own, and I made it for myself.'
And I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your canals cling to your scales; and I will bring you up from among your canals, with all the fish of your canals clinging to your scales.

And I will abandon you to the wilderness, you and all the fish of your canals. On the face of the field you will fall; you will not be gathered up and will not be collected. To the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens I have given you for food.
And all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am YHWH, because they were a staff of reed for the house of Israel.
When they grasped you by the hand you were crushed, and you split open every shoulder of theirs; and when they leaned on you you broke, and you made all their hips stand.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will cut off from you humankind and animals.
And the land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin; and they will know that I am YHWH — because he said, 'The Nile is mine, and I made it.'
Therefore look, I am against you and against your canals, and I will make the land of Egypt into ruins of desolation, a waste, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
No foot of a human will pass through it, and no foot of an animal will pass through it; and it will not be inhabited for forty years.

And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be a desolation among laid-waste cities for forty years; and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
For thus says Lord YHWH: At the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples where they were scattered.
And I will turn back the captivity of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin; and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
It will be lowlier than the kingdoms and will not exalt itself over the nations again; and I will make them few, so as not to rule over the nations.
And it will no longer be a confidence for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turned after them; and they will know that I am Lord YHWH."
And it was in the twenty-seventh year, in the first [month], on the first of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labour a great labour against Tyre: every head was made bald and every shoulder was rubbed bare. But he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the labour that he laboured against it.

Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will carry off her wealth and plunder her plunder and take her spoil as spoil; and it will be wages for his army.
As his recompense, for which he laboured, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they acted for me — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and to you I will give an opening of the mouth in their midst; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_30.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Wail — Alas for the day!
For a day is near, and a day for YHWH is near, a day of cloud; it will be the time of the nations.
And a sword will come upon Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt; and they will take away her wealth, and her foundations will be torn down.
Cush and Put and Lud, and all the mixed people, and Kub, and the sons of the land of the covenant — with them they will fall by the sword.
Thus says YHWH: And the supporters of Egypt will fall, and the pride of her strength will come down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall in her by the sword — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And they will be desolate in the midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be among laid-waste cities.
And they will know that I am YHWH, when I put fire in Egypt and all her helpers are broken.
On that day messengers will go out from before me in ships, to make Cush tremble in her security; and there will be anguish among them on the day of Egypt — for look, it is coming.
Thus says Lord YHWH: And I will put an end to the multitude of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought to destroy the land; and they will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
And I will make the canals dry land and sell the land into the hand of the wicked, and I will devastate the land and all that fills it by the hand of strangers. I, YHWH, have spoken.
Thus says Lord YHWH: And I will destroy idols and put an end to worthless idols from Memphis; and there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
And I will devastate Pathros and put fire in Zoan, and I will perform judgements on Thebes.
And I will pour out my rage on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the multitude of Thebes.
And I will put fire in Egypt. Sin will writhe and writhe; Thebes is about to be broken into; and Memphis — the distresses of daytime.
The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and these will go into captivity.

And in Tahpanhes the day will hold back its light, when I break there the yoke-bars of Egypt, and the pride of her strength will cease in her. She — a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
And I will perform judgements on Egypt; and they will know that I am YHWH."
And it was in the eleventh year, in the first [month], on the seventh of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and look, it has not been bound up, to give healing, to put on a bandage to bind it, to make it strong to wield the sword.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms — the strong one and the broken one — and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
And I will make strong the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan the groans of a fatally wounded man before him.

And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall; and they will know that I am YHWH, when I put my sword in the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_31.t: And it was in the eleventh year, in the third [month], on the first of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: Whom are you like in your greatness?
Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful of branch and a shading thicket, and tall of height; and its treetop was among the thick boughs.
Waters made it grow; the deep raised it up, sending its rivers around the place where it was planted, and sending out its channels to all the trees of the field.
Therefore its height was taller than all the trees of the field, and its boughs became many and its branches became long, from the abundant waters when it sent them out.
In its boughs all the birds of the heavens made their nests, and under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth; and in its shade all the great nations dwelt.
And it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its root was by abundant waters.
Cedars did not eclipse it in the garden of God; fir trees were not like its boughs, and plane trees were not like its branches. No tree in the garden of God was like it in its beauty.
Beautiful I made it, in the abundance of its branches; and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you were tall in height, and it set its treetop among the thick boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
I gave it into the hand of a leader of nations; he will surely deal with it. According to its wickedness I drove it out.

And strangers cut it down, the most ruthless of nations, and abandoned it. On the mountains and in all the valleys its branches fell, and its branches were broken in all the ravines of the land; and all the peoples of the earth went down out of its shade and abandoned it.
On its fallen trunk all the birds of the heavens dwelt, and to its branches came all the beasts of the field —

so that no trees by water may be lifted up in their height or set their treetops among the thick boughs, and that no drinkers of water may stand up to them in their height. For all of them have been given over to death, to the earth below, among the children of humankind, with those who go down to the pit.

Thus says Lord YHWH: On the day it went down to Sheol I caused mourning; I covered the deep over it and restrained its rivers, and the abundant waters were held back. And I made Lebanon mourn over it, and all the trees of the field wilted over it.

At the sound of its downfall I made nations tremble, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the drinkers of water, were comforted in the earth below.
They too went down with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword — and its arm, those who dwelt in its shade among the nations.

Whom are you like in this, in splendour and in greatness, among the trees of Eden? And you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; among the uncircumcised you will lie, with those slain by the sword. That is Pharaoh and all his multitude — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_32.t: And it was in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: You likened yourself to a young lion of the nations, but you were like the sea monster in the seas; you burst out in your rivers and made the waters turbid with your feet and fouled their rivers.
Thus says Lord YHWH: And I will spread my net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet.
And I will abandon you on the land; on the face of the field I will fling you, and I will settle on you every bird of the heavens and satisfy from you the beasts of all the earth.
And I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your height.
And I will make the land drink your outflow, from your blood, as far as the mountains; and the ravines will be filled from you.
And when I extinguish you I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will put darkness over your land — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And I will disturb the heart of many peoples when I bring your breaking among the nations, to lands you have not known.

And I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with shuddering over you when I brandish my sword before their faces; and they will tremble every moment, each for his own life, on the day of your downfall.
For thus says Lord YHWH: The sword of the king of Babylon will come upon you.
By the swords of warriors I will make your multitude fall — all of them the most ruthless of nations. And they will devastate the pride of Egypt, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
And I will destroy all her livestock from beside the abundant waters; and no human foot will make them turbid again, nor will the hooves of livestock make them turbid.
Then I will make their waters settle and make their rivers run like oil — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is emptied of its fullness, when I strike down all who dwell in it — then they will know that I am YHWH.
It is a lamentation, and they will chant it; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and over all her multitude they will chant it — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And it was in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, that the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and bring her down — her and the daughters of majestic nations — to the earth below, with those who go down to the pit.
Whom do you surpass in loveliness? Go down and be laid with the uncircumcised!
Among those slain by the sword they will fall. The sword has been appointed; they have dragged her down, and all her multitudes.
The leaders of the mighty will speak to him from the midst of Sheol, with his helpers: They have gone down, they lie still — the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
Assyria is there, and all her company; his graves are around him. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword —
whose graves are set in the remotest parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword — those who put terror in the land of the living.

Elam is there, and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the earth below — those who put their terror in the land of the living. And they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.

Among the slain they have made a bed for her, with all her multitude; her graves are around him. All of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because their terror was put in the land of the living; and they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit. Among the slain he was put.
Meshech, Tubal and all her multitude are there; her graves are around him. All of them uncircumcised, pierced by the sword, because they put their terror in the land of the living.

And they do not lie with the fallen warriors of the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and whose swords were put under their heads; and their iniquities were on their bones — for the terror of the warriors was in the land of the living.
And you will be broken among the uncircumcised and will lie with those slain by the sword.
Edom is there, her kings and all her princes, who for all their strength were placed with those slain by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit.

The princes of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who went down with the slain — ashamed, for all the terror of their strength; and they lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, and they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude — Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
For I put my terror in the land of the living; and he will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword — Pharaoh and all his multitude — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_33.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, speak to the children of your people and say to them: A land, when I bring a sword upon it — and the people of the land take one man from among them and make him their watchman,
and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the trumpet and warns the people —
then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, and the sword comes and takes him — his blood will be on his own head.
He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning; his blood will be upon him. But he who took warning delivered his life.

But the watchman, if he sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes any one of them — that one is taken in his own iniquity, but his blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.
And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel; and you shall hear a word from my mouth and warn them from me.

When I say to the wicked, 'Wicked one, dying you shall die,' and you have not spoken to warn the wicked from his way — that wicked one will die in his iniquity, and his blood I will require from your hand.
But you, if you have warned the wicked from his way, to turn back from it, and he has not turned back from his way — he will die in his iniquity, and you have delivered your life.
"And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel: Thus you have said: 'Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are wasting away — how then shall we live?'

Say to them: As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn back from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?

"And you, son of man, say to the children of your people: The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him on the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not stumble by it on the day he turns back from his wickedness; and a righteous one will not be able to live by it on the day he sins.

When I say to the righteous, 'Living you shall live,' and he relies on his righteousness and does unrighteousness — none of his righteous acts will be remembered, and in the unrighteousness that he has done, in that he will die.
And when I say to the wicked, 'Dying you shall die,' and he turns back from his sin and does justice and righteousness —
if the wicked returns a pledge, repays what he has robbed, and walks in the statutes of life, doing no unrighteousness — living he shall live; he will not die.
None of his sins that he has sinned will be remembered against him. He has done justice and righteousness; living he shall live.
And the children of your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not right' — but it is their way that is not right.
When a righteous one turns back from his righteousness and does unrighteousness, he will die by them.
And when a wicked one turns back from his wickedness and does justice and righteousness, by them he will live.
And you say, 'The way of the Lord is not right.' I will judge each of you according to his ways, house of Israel."
And it was in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth [month], on the fifth of the month, that the escapee came to me from Jerusalem, saying, "The city has been struck."
And the hand of YHWH had been upon me in the evening, before the escapee came, and he had opened my mouth before he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, the inhabitants of these waste places on the land of Israel are saying: 'Abraham was one, and he took possession of the land; and we are many — the land has been given to us as a possession.'
Therefore say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: You eat with the blood, and you lift your eyes to your idols, and you shed blood — and shall you possess the land?
You have stood on your sword; you have done abomination; and each of you has made his neighbour's wife unclean — and shall you possess the land?

Thus you shall say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword; and the one who is on the open field I will give to the beasts to be devoured; and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of pestilence.
And I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her strength will cease; and the mountains of Israel will be desolate, with no one passing through.
And they will know that I am YHWH, when I make the land a desolation and a waste, because of all their abominations that they have done.

"And you, son of man — the children of your people who talk about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses, one speaking with another, each with his brother, saying, 'Come now and hear what the word is that comes out from YHWH!' —

and they come to you as a people comes, and my people sit before you and hear your words, but they do not do them. For with their mouths they make lustful shows, but their heart goes after their unjust gain.
And look, you are to them like a song of lust, beautiful of voice and playing well; and they hear your words but do not do them.
And when it comes — look, it is coming — then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

ezekiel_34.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and say to them, to the shepherds: Thus says Lord YHWH: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who have been shepherding themselves! Should not the shepherds shepherd the flock?
You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool; you slaughter the fat sheep; you do not shepherd the flock.

The weak you have not strengthened, and the sick you have not healed, and the broken you have not bound up, and the strayed you have not brought back, and the lost you have not sought; and with force you have ruled them, and with harshness.
And they were scattered without a shepherd, and became food for every beast of the field; and they were scattered.
My flock wander on all the mountains and on every high hill; and over all the face of the earth my flock have been scattered, with no one searching and no one seeking.
Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of YHWH:

As I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — surely, because my flock has become prey and my flock has become food for every beast of the field, for lack of a shepherd, and my shepherds did not search for my flock, and the shepherds shepherded themselves and did not shepherd my flock —
therefore, shepherds, hear the word of YHWH:

Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against the shepherds, and I will require my flock from their hand and make them cease from shepherding a flock; and the shepherds will no longer shepherd themselves. And I will deliver my flock from their mouth, and they will not be food for them.
For thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I myself will search for my flock and seek them out.

As a shepherd seeks out his flock on the day he is among his sheep that are scattered, so I will seek out my flock; and I will deliver them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of cloud and thick darkness.

And I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the lands and bring them to their own land; and I will shepherd them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the habitable places of the land.

In good pasture I will shepherd them, and on the mountain heights of Israel will be their pastureland. There they will lie down in good pastureland, and on rich pasture they will graze, on the mountains of Israel.
I myself will shepherd my flock, and I myself will make them lie down — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
The lost I will seek, and the strayed I will bring back, and the broken I will bind up, and the sick I will make strong; and the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.
And as for you, my flock — thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am judging between one sheep and another, between the rams and the male goats.

Is it too little for you that you graze the good pasture, that you must trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? And that you drink the clear water, that you must foul the rest with your feet?
And my flock — must they graze what your feet have trampled and drink what your feet have fouled?
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH to them: Look, I myself will judge between a fat sheep and a lean sheep.
Because you push with side and with shoulder and thrust at all the weak with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad —
I will save my flock, and they will no longer be prey; and I will judge between one sheep and another.
And I will raise up over them one shepherd, and he will shepherd them — my servant David. He will shepherd them, and he will be their shepherd.
And I, YHWH, will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them. I, YHWH, have spoken.
And I will make with them a covenant of peace and put an end to evil beasts from the land; and they will dwell in the wilderness in safety and sleep in the forests.
And I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing, and I will send down the rain in its season; they will be rains of blessing.

And the tree of the field will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce; and they will be on their own land in safety. And they will know that I am YHWH, when I break the bars of their yoke and deliver them from the hand of those who made them labour.
And they will no longer be spoil for the nations, and the beasts of the land will not devour them; and they will dwell in safety, with no one making them afraid.
And I will establish for them a planting of renown; and they will no longer be gathered away by famine in the land, and they will no longer bear the insult of the nations.
And they will know that I, YHWH their God, am with them, and that they are my people, the house of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And you are my flock, the flock of my pasture. You are humankind; I am your God — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_35.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face against the mountain of Seir and prophesy against it,
and say to it: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, mountain of Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolation and a waste.
Your cities I will make a ruin, and you will be a desolation; and you will know that I am YHWH.
Because you had a perpetual enmity and poured out the people of Israel onto the hands of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of the iniquity of the end —
therefore, as I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — I will appoint you to blood, and blood will pursue you. Surely you have hated blood, and blood will pursue you.
And I will make the mountain of Seir a desolation and a desolation, and I will cut off from it anyone who passes through and returns.
And I will fill its mountains with its slain; your hills and your valleys and all your ravines — those slain by the sword will fall in them.
I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities will not return; and you will know that I am YHWH.
Because you said, 'The two nations and the two lands will be mine, and we will take possession of them' — and YHWH was there —

therefore, as I live — the declaration of Lord YHWH — I will act according to your anger and according to your jealousy, which you showed out of your hatred of them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
And you will know that I, YHWH, have heard all your insults that you spoke against the mountains of Israel, saying, 'They are desolate; they have been given to us to devour.'
And you magnified yourselves against me with your mouth and multiplied your words against me. I have heard.
Thus says Lord YHWH: When all the earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.

As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be a desolation, mountain of Seir, and all Edom, all of it; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_36.t: "And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: Mountains of Israel, hear the word of YHWH.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Because the enemy has said over you, 'Aha! The ancient high places have become our possession' —

therefore prophesy and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Because, yes because, they have made you desolate and crushed you from every side, so that you became a possession for the rest of the nations, and you were taken up on the lip of the tongue and in the whispering of the people —

therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of Lord YHWH. Thus says Lord YHWH to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, and to the desolate waste places and to the forsaken cities that have become spoil and mockery to the rest of the nations that are all around —

therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Edom, who made my land their own possession with the joy of a whole heart, with scorn of self, so that its pastureland might be spoil.

Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, in my jealousy and in my rage I have spoken, because you have borne the insult of the nations.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: I lift up my hand: surely the nations that are around you — they will bear their own insult.
And you, mountains of Israel, will put out your branches and bear your fruit for my people Israel, for they are near to coming.
For look, I am for you, and I will turn to you; and you will be tilled and sown.
And I will multiply humankind upon you — all the house of Israel, all of it; and the cities will be inhabited and the waste places rebuilt.

And I will multiply upon you humankind and animals, and they will increase and be fruitful; and I will make you inhabited as in your former state, and do better for you than at your beginnings. And you will know that I am YHWH.
And I will cause humankind to walk upon you — my people Israel; and they will take possession of you, and you will be their inheritance; and you will no longer bereave them.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Because they say to you, 'You are a devourer of humankind, and you have bereaved your nations' —
therefore you will no longer devour humankind and will no longer bereave your nations — the declaration of Lord YHWH.

And I will no longer make you hear the insult of the nations, and you will no longer bear the reproach of the peoples; and you will no longer cause your nations to stumble — the declaration of Lord YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"Son of man, the house of Israel were dwelling on their own land, and they made it unclean by their conduct and by their practices. Like the uncleanness of menstrual impurity was their conduct before me.
And I poured out my rage upon them for the blood that they had poured out on the land, and because they had made it unclean with their idols.
And I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed among the lands; according to their conduct and according to their practices I judged them.
And they came to the nations where they went, and they profaned my holy name, when it was said of them, 'These are the people of YHWH, and they have come out of his land.'
But I had pity on my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they had gone.

Therefore say to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: It is not for your sake that I am acting, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.

And I will set apart as holy my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst; and the nations will know that I am YHWH — the declaration of Lord YHWH — when I show myself holy among you before their eyes.
And I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the lands and bring you to your own land.
And I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
And my spirit I will put within you, and I will bring it about that you walk in my statutes and keep my judgements and do them.
And you will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you will be my people, and I myself will be your God.
And I will save you from all your uncleannesses; and I will summon the grain and multiply it, and I will not put famine upon you.
And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will no longer receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
And you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves to your own faces because of your iniquities and because of your abominations.
It is not for your sake that I am acting — the declaration of Lord YHWH — let it be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel!"
Thus says Lord YHWH: On the day I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places will be rebuilt.
And the desolated land will be tilled, instead of being a desolation before the eyes of everyone who passes by.
And they will say, 'This land that was desolated has become like the garden of Eden; and the cities that were wasted and desolated and broken down are fortified and inhabited.'
And the nations that are left around you will know that I, YHWH, have rebuilt what was broken down and planted what was desolated. I, YHWH, have spoken, and I will do it.
Thus says Lord YHWH: This also I will let myself be sought for by the house of Israel, to do for them: I will multiply them like a flock, with humankind.
Like a flock of holy things, like the flock of Jerusalem at her appointed times, so the wasted cities will be full of a flock of humankind; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_37.t: The hand of YHWH was upon me, and he brought me out by the spirit of YHWH and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
And he made me pass by them, all around, all around; and there! they were very many on the surface of the valley, and there! they were very dry.
And he said to me, "Son of man, will these bones live?" And I said, "Lord YHWH, you know."
And he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them: Dry bones, hear the word of YHWH!
Thus says Lord YHWH to these bones: Look, I am bringing breath into you, and you will live.
And I will put sinews on you and bring up flesh over you and cover you with skin, and I will put breath in you, and you will live; and you will know that I am YHWH."
And I prophesied as I was commanded; and there was a sound as I prophesied, and there! a rattling; and the bones drew near, bone to its bone.
And I saw, and there! sinews were on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them over from above; but there was no breath in them.
And he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath: Thus says Lord YHWH: From the four winds come, breath, and blow on these killed ones, so that they may live."
And I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet — a very, very great army.
And he said to me, "Son of man, these bones are all the house of Israel. Look, they are saying, 'Our bones have dried up and our hope has perished; we are cut off, for ourselves.'
Therefore prophesy and say to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am about to open your graves and bring you up from your graves, my people; and I will bring you to the land of Israel.
And you will know that I am YHWH, when I open your graves and bring you up from your graves, my people.
And I will put my spirit in you, and you will live; and I will set you down on your own land. And you will know that I, YHWH, have spoken and have done it — the declaration of YHWH."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

"And you, son of man, take yourself one piece of wood and write on it, 'For Judah and for the people of Israel, his associates'; and take one piece of wood and write on it, 'For Joseph — the piece of wood of Ephraim — and all the house of Israel, his associates.'
And bring them near, one to one, for yourself, into one piece of wood; and they will become one in your hand.
And when the children of your people say to you, 'Will you not tell us what these are to you?' —

speak to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am about to take the piece of wood of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his associates, and I will put them with it — with the piece of wood of Judah — and make them one piece of wood; and they will be one in my hand.
And the pieces of wood on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.

And speak to them: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am about to take the people of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them to their own land.

And I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king will be king over all of them. And they will no longer be two nations, and will no longer be divided into two kingdoms.

And they will no longer make themselves unclean with their idols and their detestable things and all their transgressions; and I will save them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and I will cleanse them. And they will be my people, and I myself will be their God.
And my servant David will be king over them, and one shepherd will belong to all of them; and they will walk in my judgements and keep my statutes and do them.

And they will dwell on the land that I gave to my servant, to Jacob, in which your fathers dwelt. And they will dwell on it — they and their children and their children's children — for ever; and David my servant will be their prince for ever.
And I will make with them a covenant of peace; it will be a perpetual covenant with them. And I will establish them and multiply them, and I will put my sanctuary in their midst for ever.
And my dwelling place will be over them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.
And the nations will know that I, YHWH, am the one setting Israel apart as holy, when my sanctuary is in their midst for ever."

ezekiel_38.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
"Son of man, set your face toward Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

And I will turn you around and put hooks in your jaws, and bring you out — you and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them magnificently clothed, a great company with body shield and shield, all of them wielding swords —
Persia, Cush and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
Gomer and all its troops, Beth-togarmah, the remotest parts of the north, and all its troops — many peoples with you.
Be prepared and prepare yourself, you and all your company that have assembled to you; and you will be a guard for them.

After many days you will be mustered; at the end of the years you will come into a land restored from the sword, gathered from many peoples, upon the mountains of Israel, which had been a continual desolation. And it has been brought out from the peoples, and they are all dwelling in safety.
And you will go up; like a storm you will come; like a cloud covering the land you will be — you and all your troops, and many peoples with you.
Thus says Lord YHWH: And it will be on that day that words will come up on your heart, and you will plan an evil plan.
And you will say: I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will come against those at peace, dwelling in safety — all of them dwelling with no wall, and they have no bars and no gates —

to plunder plunder and take spoil as spoil; to turn your hand against inhabited waste places and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions, who dwell at the navel of the earth.

Sheba and Dedan and the traders of Tarshish and all its young lions will say to you: Have you come to plunder plunder? Have you assembled your company to take spoil as spoil — to carry away silver and gold, to take livestock and possessions, to plunder great plunder?
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog: Thus says Lord YHWH: On that day, when my people Israel are dwelling in safety, will you not know it?
And you will come from your place, from the remotest parts of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses — a great company and a mighty army.

And you will go up against my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. At the end of the days it will happen, and I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me, when I show myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days by the hand of my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days, for years, that I would bring you against them?
And it will be on that day, on the day Gog comes against the land of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH — that my rage will rise in my anger.
And in my jealousy, in the fire of my wrath, I have spoken: surely on that day there will be a great earthquake on the land of Israel.

And the fish of the sea and the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the field and every creeping thing that creeps on the ground, and every human that is on the face of the ground, will shake before me. And the mountains will be thrown down and the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
And I will summon a sword against him on all my mountains — the declaration of Lord YHWH; each man's sword will be against his brother.

And I will enter into judgement with him by pestilence and by blood; and an overflowing rain and hailstones, fire and sulphur, I will rain down on him and on his troops and on the many peoples that are with him.
And I will show myself great and show myself holy and make myself known before the eyes of many nations; and they will know that I am YHWH."

ezekiel_39.t: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: Thus says Lord YHWH: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
And I will turn you around and lead you on, and bring you up from the remotest parts of the north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
And I will strike your bow out of your left hand and make your arrows fall from your right hand.
On the mountains of Israel you will fall — you and all your troops and the peoples that are with you. To birds of prey of every wing and to the beasts of the field I will give you for food.
On the face of the field you will fall, for I have spoken — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell in safety in the coastlands; and they will know that I am YHWH.
And my holy name I will make known in the midst of my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned any more; and the nations will know that I am YHWH, holy in Israel.
Look, it is coming, and it will happen — the declaration of Lord YHWH. That is the day of which I have spoken.
And the inhabitants of the cities of Israel will go out and kindle and burn weapons — shield and body shield, bow and arrows, hand-staff and spear; and they will make fire with them for seven years.

And they will not carry wood from the field or cut it from the forests, for they will make fire with the weapons; and they will plunder those who plundered them and take spoil from those who took spoil from them — the declaration of Lord YHWH.

And it will be on that day that I will give Gog a place there, a burial site in Israel: the Valley of the Travellers, east of the sea. And it will block the way of those who travel; and they will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.
And the house of Israel will bury them for seven months, so as to cleanse the land.
And all the people of the land will bury them, and it will be a name for them, the day I show myself glorious — the declaration of Lord YHWH.

And they will set apart men of continual duty, passing through the land, burying those who travel — those left on the face of the land — to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make a search.
And those who pass through will pass through the land; and when one sees a human bone, he will build a marker beside it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
And the name of a city there is also Hamonah. And they will cleanse the land.

"And you, son of man — thus says Lord YHWH: Say to the birds of every wing and to every beast of the field: Assemble and come; gather from all around to my sacrifice, which I am sacrificing for you — a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel — and you will eat flesh and drink blood.
The flesh of warriors you will eat, and the blood of the princes of the earth you will drink — rams, lambs and goats, bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
And you will eat fat to satiety and drink blood to drunkenness, from my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.
And you will be satisfied at my table with horse and charioteer, warrior and every man of war — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And I will set my glory among the nations; and all the nations will see my judgement that I have executed and my hand that I have laid on them.
And the house of Israel will know that I am YHWH their God, from that day and onwards.

And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity, because they acted unfaithfully against me; and I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions I dealt with them, and I hid my face from them.
Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Now I will turn back the captivity of Jacob and have compassion on all the house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.
And they will bear their disgrace and all their unfaithfulness by which they acted unfaithfully against me, when they dwell on their own land in safety with no one disturbing them.
when I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, and show myself holy through them before the eyes of many nations.
And they will know that I am YHWH their God, in that I sent them into exile among the nations and then gathered them to their own land; and I will not leave any of them there any more.
And I will not hide my face from them any more, because I have poured out my spirit on the house of Israel — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_40.t: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck — on that very day the hand of YHWH was upon me, and he brought me there.
In visions of God he brought me to the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain; and on it, to the south, was something like the structure of a city.
And he brought me there, and there! a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a cord of linen in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he was standing in the gate.

And the man spoke to me: "Son of man, see with your eyes and hear with your ears and set your heart on all that I am about to show you, for you have been brought here in order to be shown it. Tell all that you see to the house of Israel."

And there! a wall on the outside of the house, all around, all around. And in the man's hand was the measuring reed, six cubits — by the cubit and a handbreadth. And he measured the breadth of the structure: one reed; and the height: one reed.
And he went to the gate that faces east and went up its steps, and he measured the threshold of the gate: one reed in breadth; and the other threshold: one reed in breadth.
And the guard chamber: one reed in length and one reed in breadth; and between the guard chambers, five cubits. And the threshold of the gate, beside the porch of the gate on the inside: one reed.
And he measured the porch of the gate on the inside: one reed.
And he measured the porch of the gate: eight cubits; and its jambs: two cubits. And the porch of the gate was on the inside.
And the guard chambers of the east gate: three on this side and three on that side — one measurement for the three of them; and one measurement for the jambs on this side and on that.
And he measured the breadth of the gate's entrance: ten cubits; the length of the gate: thirteen cubits.
And a barrier before the guard chambers: one cubit; and one cubit a barrier on that side. And the guard chamber: six cubits on this side and six cubits on that.
And he measured the gate from the roof of one guard chamber to the roof of the other: a breadth of twenty-five cubits, entrance opposite entrance.
And he made the jambs sixty cubits; and to the jamb was the court, the gate all around, all around.
And from the front of the entrance gate to the front of the porch of the inner gate: fifty cubits.

And closed windows opened to the guard chambers and to their jambs, inward to the gate, all around, all around; and so also to the porches. And there were windows all around, all around, inward; and on the jambs, palm trees.
And he brought me into the outer court; and there! rooms, and a pavement made for the court all around, all around — thirty rooms on the pavement.
And the pavement was at the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates — the lower pavement.
And he measured the breadth from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court, on the outside: a hundred cubits — the east and the north.
And the gate of the outer court that faces north — he measured its length and its breadth.

And its guard chambers: three on this side and three on that; and its jambs and its porches were according to the measurement of the first gate — fifty cubits its length, and the breadth twenty-five by the cubit.
And its windows and its porches and its palm trees were according to the measurement of the gate that faces east; and by seven steps people go up to it, and its porches were before them.
And a gate to the inner court was opposite the gate to the north and to the east; and he measured from gate to gate: a hundred cubits.
And he led me toward the south, and there! a gate toward the south; and he measured its jambs and its porches according to these measurements.
And it had windows, and its porches had windows all around, all around, like these windows: fifty cubits in length, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
And seven steps were its stairway, and its porches were before them; and it had palm trees, one on this side and one on that, on its jambs.
And the inner court had a gate toward the south; and he measured from gate to the gate toward the south: a hundred cubits.
And he brought me into the inner court by the south gate; and he measured the south gate according to these measurements.

And its guard chambers and its jambs and its porches were according to these measurements; and it had windows, and its porches had windows all around, all around — fifty cubits in length, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
And porches all around, all around: the length twenty-five cubits, and the breadth five cubits.
And its porches were toward the outer court, and palm trees were on its jambs; and its ascent was eight steps.
And he brought me into the inner court toward the east; and he measured the gate according to these measurements.

And its guard chambers and its jambs and its porches were according to these measurements; and it had windows, and its porches had windows all around, all around — the length fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
And its porches were toward the outer court, and palm trees on its jambs on this side and on that; and its ascent was eight steps.
And he brought me to the north gate, and he measured according to these measurements —
its guard chambers, its jambs and its porches; and it had windows all around, all around — the length fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
And its jambs were toward the outer court, and palm trees on its jambs on this side and on that; and its ascent was eight steps.
And there was a room, with its entrance at the jambs of the gates; there they rinse the burnt offering.
And in the porch of the gate: two tables on this side and two tables on that, on which to slaughter the burnt offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering.
And at the side outside, as one goes up to the entrance of the north gate: two tables; and at the other side, which belongs to the porch of the gate: two tables.
Four tables on this side and four tables on that, at the side of the gate — eight tables, on which they slaughter.

And four tables for the burnt offering, of hewn stone: a cubit and a half in length, a cubit and a half in breadth, and one cubit in height; on them they set down the equipment with which they slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
And the hooks, one handbreadth, were fixed inside, all around, all around; and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.

And outside the inner gate were rooms for the singers, in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate, and their front was toward the south; one was at the side of the east gate, its front toward the north.
And he spoke to me: "This room whose front is toward the south is for the priests who keep the charge of the house;
and the room whose front is toward the north is for the priests who keep the charge of the altar. They are the sons of Zadok, who among the sons of Levi draw near to YHWH to serve him."
And he measured the court: a hundred cubits in length and a hundred cubits in breadth, a square; and the altar was before the house.

And he brought me to the porch of the house, and he measured the jamb of the porch: five cubits on this side and five cubits on that; and the breadth of the gate: three cubits on this side and three cubits on that.
The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the breadth eleven cubits; and by the steps that people go up to it. And there were columns at the jambs, one on this side and one on that.

ezekiel_41.t: And he brought me to the great hall, and he measured the jambs: six cubits in breadth on this side and six cubits in breadth on that — the breadth of the tent.
And the breadth of the entrance: ten cubits; and the sides of the entrance: five cubits on this side and five cubits on that. And he measured its length: forty cubits; and the breadth: twenty cubits.
And he went inside and measured the jamb of the entrance: two cubits; and the entrance: six cubits; and the breadth of the entrance: seven cubits.
And he measured its length: twenty cubits; and the breadth: twenty cubits, at the front of the great hall. And he said to me, "This is the holy of holies."
And he measured the wall of the house: six cubits; and the breadth of the side chamber: four cubits, all around, all around the house, all around.

And the side chambers, side chamber upon side chamber: three and thirty times. And they entered the wall that belonged to the house, for the side chambers, all around, all around, to be held fast — and they were not held fast in the wall of the house.

And it broadened and wound upward, upward, to the side chambers, for the surrounding of the house was upward, upward, all around, all around the house; therefore the house had breadth upward. And so one goes up from the lowest to the highest by the middle.
And I saw that the house had a raised base all around, all around; the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed, six long cubits.
The breadth of the wall that belonged to the side chamber, to the outside: five cubits. And what was left free was the space of the side chambers that belonged to the house.
And between the rooms: a breadth of twenty cubits around the house, all around, all around.
And the entrance of the side chamber was to the open space: one entrance by way of the north and one entrance to the south. And the breadth of the place left open: five cubits all around, all around.

And the structure that was at the front of the separate place, on the side toward the sea: a breadth of seventy cubits; and the wall of the structure: five cubits in breadth all around, all around; and its length: ninety cubits.
And he measured the house: a length of a hundred cubits; and the separate place and the building and its walls: a length of a hundred cubits.
And the breadth of the front of the house and of the separate place, to the east: a hundred cubits.

And he measured the length of the structure at the front of the separate place that was behind it, and its galleries on this side and on that: a hundred cubits. And the inner great hall, and the porches of the court,

the thresholds and the closed windows and the galleries all around, for the three of them — opposite the threshold, panelling of wood all around, all around; and the ground up to the windows; and the windows were covered.
over the entrance and as far as the inner house, and outside, and on all the wall all around, all around, inside and outside: measurements.
And it was made with cherubim and palm trees, and a palm tree between cherub and cherub; and the cherub had two faces:
and a human face toward the palm tree on this side, and a young lion's face toward the palm tree on that side. It was made for all the house all around, all around.
From the ground up to above the entrance the cherubim and the palm trees were made; and the wall of the great hall.
The great hall: a squared doorpost; and the front of the holy place — the appearance [of one] was like the appearance [of the other].
The altar was wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits; and it had its corners; and its length and its walls were wood. And he spoke to me: "This is the table that is before YHWH."
And the great hall and the holy place each had two doors.
And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves — two for one door and two leaves for the other.
And on them, on the doors of the great hall, were made cherubim and palm trees, just as they were made for the walls; and there was a canopy of wood at the front of the porch, on the outside.
And closed windows and palm trees on this side and on that, on the sides of the porch; and the side chambers of the house, and the canopies.

ezekiel_42.t: And he brought me out to the outer court, the way toward the north; and he brought me to the room that was opposite the separate place and opposite the structure, toward the north.
At the front of the length of a hundred cubits was the north entrance; and the breadth was fifty cubits.
Opposite the twenty that belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement that belonged to the outer court, was gallery at the front of gallery, in three storeys.
And before the rooms was a walk ten cubits in breadth toward the inner part, a way of one cubit; and their entrances were to the north.
And the upper rooms were shortened, for the galleries took away from them, more than from the lower and than from the middle ones of the structure.
For they were in three storeys, and they had no columns like the columns of the courts; therefore it was shortened, more than the lower and than the middle ones, from the ground.
And the wall that was outside, close to the rooms, by way of the outer court at the front of the rooms — its length was fifty cubits.
For the length of the rooms that belonged to the outer court was fifty cubits; and there! at the front of the great hall, a hundred cubits.
And below these rooms was the entry from the east, as one comes to them from the outer court.
In the breadth of the wall of the court, by way of the east, at the front of the separate place and at the front of the structure: rooms.

And a way was before them, like the appearance of the rooms that were by way of the north — as their length, so their breadth; and all their exits, and according to their plans, and according to their entrances.
And like the entrances of the rooms that were by way of the south: an entrance at the head of a way, a way in front of the corresponding wall, by way of the east as one comes to them.

And he said to me, "The rooms of the north and the rooms of the south that are at the front of the separate place — they are the holy rooms, where the priests who draw near to YHWH shall eat the holiest of the holy things. There they shall set down the holiest of the holy things: the grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering — for the place is holy.

When the priests go in, they shall not go out from the holy place to the outer court; and there they shall set down their garments in which they serve, for they are holy. And they shall put on other garments, and they shall draw near to what belongs to the people."
And he finished the measurements of the inner house, and he brought me out by way of the gate whose face is toward the east, and he measured it all around, all around.
He measured the east side with the measuring reed: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed, all around.
He measured the north side: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed, all around.
The south side he measured: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
He turned to the side toward the sea; he measured five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
To the four sides he measured it. It had a wall all around, all around: a length of five hundred and a breadth of five hundred, to separate between the holy and the common.

ezekiel_43.t: And he led me to the gate, the gate that faces by way of the east.
And there! the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east; and his voice was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone from his glory.

And it was like the appearance of the vision that I saw, like the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Kebar. And I fell on my face.
And the glory of YHWH came into the house by way of the gate whose face is toward the east.
And a spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court; and there! the glory of YHWH filled the house.
And I heard one speaking to me from the house; and a man was standing beside me.

And he said to me: "Son of man, the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the sons of Israel for ever. And the house of Israel will not make my holy name unclean again — they and their kings — by their whoring and by the corpses of their kings at their high places,

when they put their threshold with my threshold and their doorpost beside my doorpost, and the wall between me and them; and they made my holy name unclean by their abominations that they did. And I made an end of them in my anger.
Now let them put far away their whoring and the corpses of their kings from me, and I will dwell among them for ever.
You, son of man, declare the house to the house of Israel, and let them be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the house and its arrangement, and its exits and its entrances, and all its designs, and all its statutes, and all its designs, and all its laws; and write it before their eyes, so that they may keep all its design and all its statutes and do them.
This is the law of the house: on the top of the mountain, all its territory all around, all around, is a holy of holies. There! this is the law of the house.

And these are the measurements of the altar in cubits — the cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: the gutter, a cubit; and a cubit the breadth; and its border on its edge all around, one span. And this is the mound of the altar.
And from the gutter of the ground to the lower ledge: two cubits; and the breadth, one cubit. And from the small ledge to the great ledge: four cubits; and the breadth, the cubit.
And the harel: four cubits; and from the ariel and upward, the four horns.
And the ariel: twelve in length by twelve in breadth, square, to its four sides.
And the ledge: fourteen in length by fourteen in breadth, to its four sides; and the border around it, half a cubit; and its gutter, a cubit all around. And its steps face east.
And he said to me: "Son of man, thus says Lord YHWH: These are the statutes of the altar on the day it is made, to offer up a burnt offering on it and to dash blood on it.

And you shall give to the priests, the Levites who are of the offspring of Zadok, who draw near to me — the declaration of Lord YHWH — to serve me, a bull, a young one of the herd, for a sin offering.
And you shall take some of its blood and put it on its four horns and on the four corners of the ledge and on the border all around; and you shall purify it from sin and make atonement for it.
And you shall take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burnt in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.
And on the second day you shall bring near a male goat of the goats, unblemished, for a sin offering; and they shall purify the altar from sin as they purified it from sin with the bull.
When you finish purifying it from sin, you shall bring near a bull, a young one of the herd, unblemished, and a ram from the flock, unblemished.
And you shall bring them near before YHWH; and the priests shall throw salt on them and offer them up as a burnt offering to YHWH.
Seven days you shall offer a male goat of a sin offering for the day; and a bull, a young one of the herd, and a ram from the flock, unblemished, they shall offer.
Seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; and they shall fill its hands.

And they shall complete the days. And it will be, on the eighth day and onwards, the priests shall offer on the altar your burnt offerings and your peace sacrifices; and I will accept you — the declaration of Lord YHWH."

ezekiel_44.t: And he brought me back by way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east; and it was shut.
And YHWH said to me: "This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, and no one shall go in by it, for YHWH the God of Israel has gone in by it; and it shall be shut.
As for the prince — a prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before YHWH. By way of the porch of the gate he shall come in, and by its way he shall go out."
And he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the house; and I looked, and there! the glory of YHWH had filled the house of YHWH. And I fell on my face.

And YHWH said to me: "Son of man, set your heart and see with your eyes and hear with your ears all that I am speaking to you concerning all the statutes of the house of YHWH and all its laws. And set your heart to the entrance of the house, with all the exits of the sanctuary.
And you shall say to rebellion, to the house of Israel: Thus says Lord YHWH: Enough of all your abominations, house of Israel!

when you brought in sons of foreignness, uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it — my house — when you brought near my food, fat and blood; and they broke my covenant, on top of all your abominations.
And you did not keep the charge of my holy things; and you appointed keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
Thus says Lord YHWH: No son of foreignness, uncircumcised of heart and uncircumcised of flesh, shall come into my sanctuary — any son of foreignness who is among the sons of Israel.
But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols — they shall bear their iniquity.

And they shall be servants in my sanctuary, overseers at the gates of the house and serving the house. They shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to serve them.

Because they served them before their idols and became for the house of Israel a stumbling block of iniquity — therefore I have lifted my hand against them, the declaration of Lord YHWH, and they shall bear their iniquity.

And they shall not draw near to me to serve me as priests, nor draw near to any of my holy things, to the holiest of the holy things; and they shall bear their disgrace and their abominations that they have done.
And I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all its service and for all that is done in it.

But the priests, the Levites, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge of my sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from me — they shall draw near to me to serve me, and they shall stand before me to bring near to me fat and blood, the declaration of Lord YHWH.
They shall come into my sanctuary, and they shall draw near to my table to serve me; and they shall keep my charge.
And it shall be, when they come into the gates of the inner court, they shall wear garments of linen; and wool shall not come upon them when they serve at the gates of the inner court and inside.
Head-dresses of linen shall be on their head, and undergarments of linen shall be on their loins. They shall not gird themselves with sweat.

And when they go out to the outer court — to the outer court, to the people — they shall take off their garments in which they serve and set them down in the holy rooms; and they shall put on other garments, and they shall not set the people apart as holy with their garments.
And they shall not shave their head, and they shall not let the hair go loose; trimming, they shall trim their heads.
And wine no priest shall drink when they come into the inner court.
And a widow or a divorced woman they shall not take for themselves as wives, but virgins from the offspring of the house of Israel; and the widow who is a widow of a priest they may take.
And they shall instruct my people between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean they shall make known to them.

And over a dispute they shall stand for judgement; by my judgements they shall judge it. And my laws and my statutes they shall keep at all my appointed times, and my sabbaths they shall set apart as holy.

And to a dead person he shall not go, to become unclean; only for a father or for a mother or for a son or for a daughter, for a brother or for a sister who has not belonged to a husband, may they make themselves unclean.
And after his cleansing they shall count seven days for him.
And on the day he goes into the holy place, into the inner court, to serve in the holy place, he shall bring near his sin offering — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
And it shall be theirs for an inheritance: I am their inheritance. And a holding you shall not give them in Israel: I am their holding.
The grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering — they shall eat them; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

And the best of all the first fruits of everything, and every contribution of everything, from all your contributions, shall be the priests'. And the best of your dough you shall give to the priest, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
Any carcass or torn animal, from the birds or from the animals, the priests shall not eat.

ezekiel_45.t: And when you make the land fall as an inheritance, you shall offer up a contribution to YHWH, a holy portion from the land: the length, five and twenty thousand in length; and the breadth, ten thousand. It is holy in all its territory all around.
Of this there shall be for the holy place five hundred by five hundred, square all around; and fifty cubits of pasture land for it all around.
And from this measured area you shall measure a length of five and twenty thousand and a breadth of ten thousand; and in it shall be the sanctuary, a holy of holies.
It is a holy portion from the land; it shall be for the priests who serve the sanctuary, who draw near to serve YHWH; and it shall be for them a place for houses, and a holy place for the sanctuary.
And five and twenty thousand in length and ten thousand in breadth shall belong to the Levites who serve the house, as their holding: twenty rooms.
And as the holding of the city you shall give five thousand in breadth and five and twenty thousand in length, alongside the contribution of the holy portion. It shall be for all the house of Israel.

And to the prince: on this side and on that of the contribution of the holy portion and of the holding of the city, at the front of the contribution of the holy portion and at the front of the holding of the city, from the west side westward and from the east side eastward; and the length corresponding to one of the portions, from the western border to the eastern border.
As for the land, it shall be his as a holding in Israel; and my princes shall no longer oppress my people, and they shall give the land to the house of Israel by their tribes.
Thus says Lord YHWH: Enough for you, princes of Israel! Remove violence and destruction, and do judgement and righteousness. Lift your evictions off my people — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
Balances of righteousness, and an ephah of righteousness, and a bath of righteousness shall you have.
The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, so that the bath carries a tenth of a homer, and the ephah a tenth of a homer; by the homer shall its measurement be.
And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, ten and five shekels shall be your mina.
This is the contribution that you shall offer up: a sixth of the ephah from a homer of wheat; and you shall give a sixth of the ephah from a homer of barley.
And the prescribed portion of oil, the bath of oil: a tenth of the bath from the cor — ten baths are a homer, for ten baths are a homer.

And one sheep from the flock, from the two hundred, from the well-watered land of Israel — for a grain offering and for a burnt offering and for peace sacrifices, to make atonement for them, the declaration of Lord YHWH.
All the people of the land shall be for this contribution to the prince in Israel.

And on the prince shall be the burnt offerings and the grain offering and the drink offering at the festivals and at the new moons and on the sabbaths, at all the appointed times of the house of Israel. He shall provide the sin offering and the grain offering and the burnt offering and the peace sacrifices, to make atonement for the house of Israel.
Thus says Lord YHWH: In the first month, on the first of the month, you shall take a bull, a young one of the herd, unblemished, and purify the sanctuary from sin.

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorpost of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the doorpost of the gate of the inner court.
And so you shall do on the seventh of the month, for anyone who errs and for the simple; and you shall make atonement for the house.
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a festival of weeks of days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
And the prince shall provide on that day, for himself and for all the people of the land, a bull as a sin offering.

And for the seven days of the festival he shall provide a burnt offering to YHWH: seven bulls and seven rams, unblemished, for the day, for the seven days; and a sin offering, a male goat of the goats, for the day.
And a grain offering: an ephah for the bull and an ephah for the ram he shall provide; and oil, a hin to the ephah.

In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the festival, he shall provide the like for the seven days: as the sin offering, as the burnt offering, and as the grain offering, and as the oil.

ezekiel_46.t: Thus says Lord YHWH: The gate of the inner court that faces east shall be shut the six days of work; and on the day of the sabbath it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

And the prince shall come by way of the porch of the gate from outside and stand at the doorpost of the gate; and the priests shall offer his burnt offering and his peace sacrifices. And he shall bow down at the threshold of the gate and go out; and the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
And the people of the land shall bow down at the entrance of that gate on the sabbaths and on the new moons, before YHWH.
And the burnt offering that the prince shall bring near to YHWH on the day of the sabbath: six lambs, unblemished, and a ram, unblemished.
And a grain offering: an ephah for the ram; and for the lambs, a grain offering, the gift of his hand; and oil, a hin to the ephah.
And on the day of the new moon: a bull, a young one of the herd, unblemished; and six lambs and a ram — they shall be unblemished.
And an ephah for the bull and an ephah for the ram he shall provide as a grain offering; and for the lambs, as much as his hand reaches; and oil, a hin to the ephah.
And when the prince comes in, he shall come by way of the porch of the gate, and by its way he shall go out.

And when the people of the land come before YHWH at the appointed times: the one who comes by way of the north gate to bow down shall go out by way of the south gate; and the one who comes by way of the south gate shall go out by way of the north gate. He shall not return by way of the gate he came in by, for he shall go out opposite it.
And the prince shall be among them: when they come in, he shall come in; and when they go out, they shall go out.
And at the festivals and at the appointed times the grain offering shall be an ephah for the bull and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs the gift of his hand; and oil, a hin to the ephah.

And when the prince provides a freewill offering — a burnt offering or peace sacrifices, a freewill offering to YHWH — the gate that faces east shall be opened for him, and he shall offer his burnt offering and his peace sacrifices as he does on the day of the sabbath; and he shall go out, and the gate shall be shut after he has gone out.
And a lamb, a son of its year, unblemished, you shall provide as a burnt offering for the day to YHWH; morning by morning you shall provide it.
