And Joseph took the two of them, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right, and he brought them near to him.
And Israel stretched out his right hand and set it on Ephraim's head — and he was the younger — and his left hand on Manasseh's head. He crossed his hands, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
And he blessed Joseph and said, The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has shepherded me from my beginning until this day,

the messenger who redeems me from all harm — may he bless the lads, and let my name be called on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and let them teem into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

And Joseph saw that his father was setting his right hand on Ephraim's head, and it was bad in his eyes; and he took hold of his father's hand to remove it from on Ephraim's head onto Manasseh's head.
And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his head.

And his father refused and said, I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will be great; but his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will be the fullness of the nations.
And he blessed them on that day, saying, By you Israel will bless, saying, May God make you like Ephraim and like Manasseh. And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
And Israel said to Joseph, Look, I am dying, and God will be with you and will bring you back to the land of your fathers.
And I give you one ridge of land above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

genesis_49.t: And Jacob called to his sons and said, Gather yourselves, and let me tell you what will befall you in the latter part of the days.
Assemble and hear, sons of Jacob; and hear Israel your father.
Reuben, my firstborn are you, my strength and the beginning of my vigour, surpassing in dignity and surpassing in power.
Reckless as water, you shall not excel, for you went up your father's beds; then you profaned it — my couch he went up.
Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their swords.
Into their council let my self not come; with their assembly let my honour not be united — for in their anger they killed a man, and at their pleasure they hamstrung an ox.
Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce, and their wrath, for it is hard. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
Judah — you, your brothers will praise you; your hand on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons will bow down to you.
A lion's cub is Judah; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. He crouched, he lay down like a lion, and like a lioness — who will rouse him?
The staff will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's rod from between his feet, until tribute comes to him; and to him the obedience of peoples.
Binding his donkey to the vine and his she-donkey's colt to the choice vine, he washed his clothing in wine and his robe in the blood of grapes.
Dark of eyes from wine, and white of teeth from milk.
Zebulun will dwell at the shore of seas, and he at a shore of ships, and his flank toward Sidon.
Issachar is a bony donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
And he saw a resting place, that it was good, and the land, that it was pleasant; and he bent his shoulder to bear a load and became a labouring serf.
Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
Let Dan be a serpent on the road, a viper on the path, biting the horse's heels so that its rider falls backward.
For your deliverance I wait, YHWH.
Gad — a raiding band will raid him, and he will raid at their heel.
From Asher — his bread is rich, and he will give the delicacies of a king.
Naphtali is a doe let loose, the one giving sayings of beauty.
A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough by a spring; daughters — she strode over a wall.
And they embittered him and shot, and the masters of arrows harassed him.
But his bow stayed in firmness, and the arms of his hands were made agile by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob — from there, the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel —
from the God of your father, and may he help you, and with the Almighty, and may he bless you: blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep lying beneath, blessings of breasts and womb.

The blessings of your father have prevailed over the blessings of my progenitors, to the desire of the ancient hills. May they be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of the nazir of his brothers.
Benjamin is a wolf that tears; in the morning he devours the prey, and at evening he divides the spoil.
All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve; and this is what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them — each according to his blessing he blessed them.
And he commanded them and said to them, I am being gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers, in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which faces Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial holding.
There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
The purchase of the field and the cave that is in it was from the sons of Heth.
And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed, and he expired and was gathered to his peoples.

genesis_50.t: And Joseph fell on his father's face and wept over him and kissed him.
And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
And forty days were completed for him, for so are completed the days of embalming; and Egypt wept for him seventy days.
And the days of weeping for him passed, and Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, If I have found favour in your eyes, speak, please, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

My father made me swear, saying, Look, I am dying. In my grave which I dug for myself in the land of Canaan, there you will bury me. And now, let me go up, please, and bury my father, and I will return.
And Pharaoh said, Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear.
And Joseph went up to bury his father, and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
and all the house of Joseph and his brothers and his father's house. Only their little ones and their flocks and their herds they left in the land of Goshen.
And there went up with him both chariotry and horsemen, and the company was very heavy.
And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is across the Jordan, and there they lamented a great and very heavy lament; and he made a mourning for his father, seven days.

And the inhabitant of the land, the Canaanite, saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, and they said, This is a heavy mourning for Egypt. Therefore its name was called Abel-mizraim, which is across the Jordan.
And his sons did for him thus, just as he had commanded them.
And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham had bought with the field as a burial holding from Ephron the Hittite, facing Mamre.
And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers and all who had gone up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
And Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, and they said, What if Joseph bears a grudge against us and repays us in full for all the harm that we dealt him?
And they sent word to Joseph, saying, Your father commanded before his death, saying,

Thus you shall say to Joseph: Please, lift, we beg, the transgression of your brothers and their sin, for they dealt you evil. And now, lift, please, the transgression of the servants of the God of your father. And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
And his brothers also went and fell before him, and they said, Here we are, yours as slaves.
And Joseph said to them, Do not be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
And you — you devised evil against me; God devised it for good, in order to do as it is this day, to keep alive a numerous people.
And now, do not be afraid. I myself will provide for you and your little ones. And he comforted them and spoke to their heart.
And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his father's house; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
And Joseph saw of Ephraim sons of the third generation; also the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh were born on Joseph's knees.
And Joseph said to his brothers, I am dying, and God will surely attend to you and bring you up from this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob.
And Joseph made the sons of Israel swear, saying, God will surely attend to you, and you will bring up my bones from here.
And Joseph died, a son of a hundred and ten years. And they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

habakkuk_1.t: The oracle which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
How long, YHWH, have I cried for help and you do not hear? I cry out to you, "Violence!" and you do not save.
Why do you make me see wickedness, and look on mischief? And devastation and violence are before me, and there is strife, and contention arises.
Therefore law grows numb, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked surrounds the righteous; therefore justice goes forth perverted.
See among the nations and look, and be astounded, be astonished! For one is working a work in your days that you would not believe if it were recounted.
For look, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation, who march to the breadths of the earth to take possession of dwellings not their own.
Terrifying and dreadful is it; from itself its justice and its dignity go forth.
And its horses are swifter than leopards, and keener than the wolves of the evening; and its warhorses paw the ground. And its horsemen come from afar; they fly like an eagle hastening to devour.
All of it comes for violence; the set of their faces is eastward; and it gathers captives like the sand.
And it derides kings, and rulers are a laughing matter to it. It laughs at every fortress; it heaps up earth and captures it.
Then it sweeps on like a wind and passes over — and he is guilty, this one whose strength is his god.
Are you not from of old, YHWH my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. YHWH, for judgement you have appointed it; and Rock, for reproof you have established it.
You are too pure of eyes to see evil, and you are not able to look on mischief. Why do you look on the treacherous, and keep silent when the wicked swallows one more righteous than he?
And you make humankind like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no one ruling over them.
All of it he brings up with a hook; he drags it away in his net and gathers it in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
Therefore he sacrifices to his net and makes smoke to his dragnet, for by them his portion is fat and his food rich.
Shall he therefore empty his net, and continually kill nations without pity?

habakkuk_2.t: At my post I will stand, and I will station myself on the rampart, and I will watch to see what he will speak in me, and what I shall bring back concerning my complaint.
And YHWH answered me and said: Write the vision, and make it plain on the tablets, so that the one who reads it may run.
For the vision is still for the appointed time; it pants toward the end and does not lie. If it delays, wait for it, for coming it will come; it will not be late.
Look — it is swollen; his being is not upright within him. But the righteous — by his faithfulness he will live.

And moreover, wine is treacherous; an arrogant man — and he does not rest; who has made his throat wide as Sheol, and he is like death and is not satisfied. And he gathers to himself all the nations and assembles to himself all the peoples.
Shall not all of these lift up a saying against him, and a mocking song of riddles about him, and say: "Woe to him who multiplies what is not his — how long? — and loads himself with pledges!"
Will not your creditors suddenly rise, and those who make you tremble awake? And you will become plunder for them.
Because you have plundered many nations, all the rest of the peoples will plunder you — because of human blood and violence to the land, to the town and all who dwell in it.
Woe to him who gains an evil gain for his house, to set his nest on high, to be delivered from the hand of harm!
You have planned shame for your house, cutting off many peoples, and sinning against your own being.
For a stone will cry out from the wall, and a rafter from the woodwork will answer it.
Woe to him who builds a city with blood, and founds a town with injustice!
Is it not — look! — from YHWH of hosts that peoples labour for fire, and nations weary themselves for nothing?
For the earth will be filled with the knowing of the glory of YHWH, as the waters cover the sea.
Woe to him who makes his neighbour drink, pouring out your rage, and even making them drunk, so as to look on their nakedness!
You are sated with shame rather than glory. Drink, you also, and be uncircumcised! The cup of YHWH's right hand will come round to you, and disgrace upon your glory.
For the violence to Lebanon will cover you, and the devastation of the animals will terrify them — because of human blood and violence to the land, to the town and all who dwell in it.
What does a carved image profit, that its maker has carved it — a molten image, and a teacher of falsehood — that the one who formed it trusts in his own formation, to make dumb worthless idols?
Woe to him who says to the wood, "Wake up!" — "Awake!" to a silent stone. Can it teach? Look, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.
But YHWH is in his holy temple. Hush before him, all the earth!

habakkuk_3.t: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, on shigionoth.
YHWH, I have heard the report of you; I feared. YHWH, your work — in the midst of the years revive it; in the midst of the years make it known. In wrath remember to have compassion.
God comes from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His splendour has covered the heavens, and his praise has filled the earth.
And brightness is like the light; two horns from his hand are his; and there is the hiding of his strength.
Before him goes pestilence, and a flame goes out at his feet.
He stood and shook the earth; he looked and made the nations start. And the ancient mountains were shattered; the everlasting hills bowed down. The everlasting ways are his.
Under trouble I saw the tents of Cushan; the curtains of the land of Midian tremble.
Was YHWH angry with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your fury against the sea, that you ride on your horses, your chariots of salvation?
Bared, your bow is bared; oaths of arrows — a word. Selah. With rivers you split the earth.
The mountains saw you; they writhed. A downpour of water passed over. The deep gave its voice; it lifted its hands on high.
Sun, moon — it stood still in its lofty abode at the light of your arrows as they went, at the brightness of the flash of your spear.
In indignation you marched through the earth; in anger you trampled down nations.
You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You shattered the head from the house of the wicked, laying bare foundation to neck. Selah.
You pierced with his own arrows the head of his warriors, who storm out to scatter me. Their exultation was as if to devour the afflicted in secret.
You trod on the sea with your horses, a heap of many waters.

I heard, and my belly trembled; at the sound my lips quivered. Rottenness entered my bones, and beneath me I trembled — that I should wait quietly for the day of distress, for the coming up against the people who attack us.

For the fig tree does not blossom, and there is no produce on the vines; the yield of the olive fails, and the fields produce no food; the flock is cut off from the fold, and there is no cattle in the stalls.
But as for me, in YHWH I will exult; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.
YHWH the Lord is my strength. And he makes my feet like the does', and he makes me tread on my high places. To the choirmaster, with my stringed instruments.

haggai_1.t: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of YHWH came by the hand of Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the great priest, saying:
Thus said YHWH of hosts, saying: This people have said, 'It is not a time to come, the time of the house of YHWH, for it to be built.'
And the word of YHWH came by the hand of Haggai the prophet, saying:
Is it a time for you, you yourselves, to dwell in your panelled houses, while this house is desolate?
And now, thus said YHWH of hosts: Set your heart upon your ways.

You have sown much and bringing in little; eating, and there is no being satisfied; drinking, and there is no becoming drunk; clothing yourselves, and there is no warmth for anyone; and the one earning wages is earning wages into a pierced bag.
Thus said YHWH of hosts: Set your heart upon your ways.
Go up the hill country and bring wood and build the house, and I will take pleasure in it and I will be honoured, said YHWH.

Turning to much, and behold, to little! And you brought it home, and I blew upon it. Because of what? — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — because of my house, which is desolate, while you are running, each to his own house.
Therefore over you the heavens have withheld from dew, and the land has withheld its produce.

And I summoned a drought upon the land and upon the mountains, and upon the grain and upon the new wine and upon the fresh oil, and upon what the ground brings forth, and upon humankind and upon the livestock, and upon all the toil of hands.

And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the great priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of YHWH their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, as YHWH their God had sent him; and the people feared before YHWH.
And Haggai, the messenger of YHWH, said in the message of YHWH to the people, saying: I am with you — the declaration of YHWH.

And YHWH stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the great priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work on the house of YHWH of hosts their God,
on the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth; in the second year of Darius the king.

haggai_2.t: In the seventh, on the twenty-first of the month, the word of YHWH came by the hand of Haggai the prophet, saying:
Say now to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the great priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying:
Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? And what are you seeing it now? Is it not as nothing in your eyes?

And now, be strong, Zerubbabel — the declaration of YHWH — and be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the great priest, and be strong, all people of the land — the declaration of YHWH — and work; for I am with you, the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
The word that I cut with you when you came out from Egypt — and my spirit is standing in your midst. Do not be afraid.
For thus said YHWH of hosts: Yet once — it is a little — and I am about to shake the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry land.
And I will shake all the nations, and the desirable things of all the nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, said YHWH of hosts.
The silver is mine and the gold is mine — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
Great will be the glory of this house — the latter — more than the former, said YHWH of hosts; and in this place I will give peace, the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
On the twenty-fourth of the ninth, in the second year of Darius, the word of YHWH came to Haggai the prophet, saying:
Thus said YHWH of hosts: Ask now the priests for law, saying:

See — a man carries holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and touches with his skirt the bread, or the cooked food, or the wine, or the oil, or any food: does it become holy? And the priests answered and said: No.
And Haggai said: If one unclean by a corpse touches any of these, does it become unclean? And the priests answered and said: It becomes unclean.
And Haggai answered and said: So is this people, and so is this nation before me — the declaration of YHWH — and so is every work of their hands; and what they bring near there, it is unclean.
And now, set your heart, please, from this day and upwards: before a stone was placed on a stone in the temple of YHWH —
from when they were: one came to a heap of twenty, and it was ten; one came to the wine vat to draw off fifty measures from the press, and it was twenty.
I struck you with blight and with mildew and with hail — all the work of your hands — and you were not towards me, the declaration of YHWH.
Set your heart, please, from this day and upwards: from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth, from the day the temple of YHWH was founded — set your heart.
Is the seed still in the granary? And even the vine and the fig tree and the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne. From this day I will bless.
And the word of YHWH came a second time to Haggai on the twenty-fourth of the month, saying:
Say to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying: I am about to shake the heavens and the earth,

and I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; and I will overthrow chariotry and its riders, and horses and their riders will go down, each by the sword of his brother.

On that day — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — I will take you, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant — the declaration of YHWH — and I will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you, the declaration of YHWH of hosts.

hosea_1.t: The word of YHWH which came to Hosea son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.

The beginning of YHWH's speaking through Hosea. And YHWH said to Hosea, "Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitutions and children of prostitutions, for the land surely prostitutes itself away from YHWH."
And he went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
And YHWH said to him, "Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little and I will visit the bloods of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.
And it will be on that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel."
And she conceived again and bore a daughter. And he said to him, "Call her name Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer again have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should surely forgive them.
But on the house of Judah I will have compassion, and I will save them by YHWH their God; and I will not save them by bow or by sword or by battle, by horses or by horsemen."
And she weaned Lo-ruhamah, and she conceived and bore a son.
And he said, "Call his name Lo-ammi, for you are not my people, and I — I will not be yours."

And the number of the sons of Israel will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured and cannot be counted. And it will be that in the place where it was said to them, "You are not my people," it will be said to them, "Sons of the living God."
And the sons of Judah and the sons of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one head, and they will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

hosea_2.t: Say to your brothers, "Ammi," and to your sisters, "Ruhamah."
Bring a case against your mother, bring a case, for she is not my wife and I am not her husband — and let her put away her prostitutions from her face and her adulteries from between her breasts,
lest I strip her naked and set her out as on the day she was born, and make her like the wilderness and set her like a dry land and kill her with thirst.
And on her children I will not have compassion, for they are children of prostitutions.

For their mother has prostituted herself; she who conceived them has acted shamefully. For she said, "Let me go after my lovers, the givers of my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drinks."
Therefore, here I am, hedging up your way with thorns, and I will wall up her wall, and she will not find her paths.
And she will pursue her lovers and not overtake them, and she will seek them and not find them. And she will say, "Let me go and return to my first husband, for it was better for me then than now."
And she did not know that I myself gave her the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, and silver I multiplied for her, and gold — which they made into the Baal.
Therefore I will return and take back my grain in its time and my new wine in its appointed time, and I will snatch away my wool and my flax, which were to cover her nakedness.
And now I will uncover her lewdness to the eyes of her lovers, and no one will deliver her from my hand.
And I will put an end to all her rejoicing: her festival, her new moon and her sabbath, and all her appointed feasts.
And I will lay waste her vine and her fig tree, of which she said, "They are my fee, which my lovers gave me." And I will make them a thicket, and the wild animal of the field will devour them.

And I will visit on her the days of the Baals, when she made offerings smoke to them and adorned herself with her ring and her jewellery and went after her lovers — and me she forgot. Declaration of YHWH.
Therefore, here I am, persuading her, and I will lead her into the wilderness and speak to her heart.
And I will give her her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor as a door of hope. And she will answer there as in the days of her youth, as on the day she came up from the land of Egypt.
And it will be on that day — declaration of YHWH — that you will call me "My husband," and you will no longer call me "My baal."
And I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, and they will no longer be remembered by their name.

And I will cut for them a covenant on that day with the wild animal of the field and with the bird of the heavens and the creeping thing of the ground; and bow and sword and battle I will break from the land, and I will make them lie down in security.
And I will betroth you to myself for ever; and I will betroth you to myself in righteousness and in judgement, and in steadfast love and in compassion.
And I will betroth you to myself in faithfulness, and you will know YHWH.
And it will be on that day that I will answer — declaration of YHWH — I will answer the heavens, and they will answer the earth,
and the earth will answer the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil, and they will answer Jezreel.
And I will sow her for myself in the land, and I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah, and I will say to Lo-ammi, "You are my people," and he will say, "My God."

hosea_3.t: And YHWH said to me, "Go again, love a woman loved by a companion and committing adultery — as YHWH loves the sons of Israel, and they are turning to other gods and loving cakes of raisins."
And I bought her for myself for fifteen of silver and a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.
And I said to her, "Many days you shall dwell for me; you shall not prostitute yourself and you shall not belong to a man — and I also toward you."
For many days the sons of Israel will dwell with no king and no prince, and no sacrifice and no pillar, and no ephod and teraphim.
Afterwards the sons of Israel will return and seek YHWH their God and David their king, and they will come in dread to YHWH and to his goodness at the end of the days.

hosea_4.t: Hear the word of YHWH, sons of Israel, for YHWH has a case against the inhabitants of the land: there is no faithfulness and no steadfast love and no knowledge of God in the land.
Cursing and deceiving and murdering and stealing and committing adultery — they have broken out, and bloodshed touches bloodshed.
Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it wither, with the wild animal of the field and with the bird of the heavens; and even the fish of the sea are swept away.
Yet let no one bring a case, and let no one reprove; and your people are like those who contend with a priest.
And you will stumble by day, and a prophet will also stumble with you by night; and I will destroy your mother.

My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from serving me as a priest; and you have forgotten the law of your God — I also will forget your children.
The more they increased, the more they sinned against me; I will exchange their glory for shame.
They feed on the sin of my people, and to their iniquity they lift up their appetite.
And it will be: as the people, so the priest. And I will visit his ways on him, and his deeds I will repay to him.
And they will eat and not be satisfied; they will prostitute themselves and not increase, for they have abandoned YHWH, to keep —
Prostitution and wine and new wine take away the heart.
My people enquire of their wood, and their stick tells them; for a spirit of prostitutions has led them astray, and they have prostituted themselves out from under their God.

On the tops of the mountains they sacrifice, and on the hills they make offerings smoke, under oak and poplar and terebinth, for their shade is good. Therefore your daughters prostitute themselves and your brides commit adultery.

I will not visit judgement on your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor on your brides when they commit adultery; for the men themselves go apart with the prostitutes and sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes. And a people that does not understand comes to ruin.
Though you prostitute yourself, Israel, let Judah not become guilty. And do not go to Gilgal, and do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear, "As YHWH lives."
For like a stubborn heifer Israel is stubborn. Now will YHWH pasture them like a lamb in a broad place?
Ephraim is joined to idols. Let him alone.
Their drink has turned; they have surely prostituted themselves. Her shields have loved — "Give!" — shame.
A wind has wrapped her in its wings, and they will be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

hosea_5.t: Hear this, priests, and pay attention, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king, for the judgement is yours: for you have been a trap at Mizpah and a net spread over Tabor.
And in slaughtering, rebels have gone deep; and I am discipline to all of them.
I myself know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now you have prostituted yourself, Ephraim, Israel has made itself unclean.
Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitutions is within them, and YHWH they do not know.
And the pride of Israel testifies to his face, and Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity; Judah also has stumbled with them.
With their flock and with their herd they will go to seek YHWH, and they will not find him; he has withdrawn from them.
Against YHWH they have dealt treacherously, for they have borne strange children. Now a new moon will devour them with their portions.
Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah! Raise the alarm at Beth-aven — after you, Benjamin!
Ephraim will become a waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is sure.
The leaders of Judah have become like those who move a boundary. On them I will pour out my fury like water.
Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgement, for he was determined to walk after a command.
And I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like rot to the house of Judah.
And Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound; and Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to king Jareb. But he is not able to heal you, and he will not remove the wound from you.
For I am like a lion to Ephraim, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, I myself will tear and go; I will carry off, and there is no deliverer.
I will go, I will return to my place, until they are held guilty and seek my face. In their distress they will seek me earnestly.

hosea_6.t: Come, let us return to YHWH, for he has torn and he will heal us; he has struck and he will bind us up.
He will revive us after two days; on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live before him.
And let us know, let us pursue the knowing of YHWH. Like the dawn his going forth is sure, and he will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? And your steadfast love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that goes early away.
Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets, I have killed them by the sayings of my mouth; and your judgements — light goes forth.
For steadfast love I desire, and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they dealt treacherously with me.
Gilead is a town of doers of iniquity, tracked with blood.
And like marauders lying in wait for a man, so is a company of priests: they murder on the way to Shechem, for they have committed depravity.
In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: there is Ephraim's prostitution; Israel has made itself unclean.
Also, Judah — he has set a harvest for you, when I turn back the fortunes of my people.

hosea_7.t: When I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered and the evils of Samaria; for they practise falsehood, and a thief comes in, a marauding band strips outside.
And they do not say to their heart that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds have surrounded them; they are before my face.
With their evil they make the king glad, and with their lies, the princes.
All of them are adulterers, like an oven burning from the baker, who ceases from stirring from the kneading of dough until it is leavened.
The day of our king — the princes have made themselves sick with the fever of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
For they have brought their heart near like an oven in their ambush. All the night their baker sleeps; in the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
All of them grow hot like the oven and devour their rulers. All their kings have fallen; there is none among them who calls to me.
Ephraim — he mixes himself among the peoples. Ephraim has become a flat cake not turned over.
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he does not know; grey hair too is sprinkled on him, and he does not know.
And the pride of Israel testifies to his face, and they have not returned to YHWH their God, and they have not sought him, for all this.
And Ephraim has become like a silly dove, without heart: they have called to Egypt, they have gone to Assyria.
As they go, I will spread my net over them; like a bird of the heavens I will bring them down. I will chastise them according to the report to their assembly.
Woe to them, for they have strayed from me! Devastation to them, for they have rebelled against me! And I would redeem them, but they have spoken lies against me.
And they have not cried out to me with their heart, but they wail on their beds; over grain and new wine they assemble themselves; they turn aside against me.
And I — I disciplined, I strengthened their arms, and against me they plot evil.
They turn — not upward. They have become like a slack bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

hosea_8.t: To your palate — a horn! Like an eagle over the house of YHWH, because they have transgressed my covenant and rebelled against my law.
To me they cry out: "My God, we know you — Israel!"
Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
They themselves have made kings, but not from me; they have made princes, and I did not know it. Their silver and their gold they have made into idols for themselves, so that it may be cut off.
He has rejected your calf, Samaria! My anger has burned against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
For it is from Israel, and it — a craftsman made it, and it is not God; for the calf of Samaria will become splinters.
For they sow wind, and they will reap the storm-wind. Standing grain it has none; the growth will make no flour; if perhaps it makes any, strangers will swallow it.
Israel is swallowed. Now they are among the nations like a vessel in which there is no pleasure.
For they have gone up to Assyria — a wild donkey off by itself. Ephraim has hired lovers.
Even though they hire among the nations, now I will gather them; and they have begun to be diminished by the burden of a king of princes.
For Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning; they have become to him altars for sinning.
I wrote for him the multitude of my law; they were regarded as a strange thing.
The sacrifices of my gifts — they sacrifice flesh and eat it; YHWH is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their iniquity and visit their sins: they will return to Egypt.
And Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces, and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; and I will send fire on his cities, and it will consume her fortresses.

hosea_9.t: Do not rejoice, Israel, to exultation like the peoples, for you have prostituted yourself away from your God. You have loved a prostitute's fee on every threshing floor of grain.
Threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
They will not remain in the land of YHWH; and Ephraim will return to Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat what is unclean.

They will not pour out wine to YHWH, and their sacrifices will not be pleasing to him. Like the bread of mourners it will be to them — all who eat it will make themselves unclean — for their bread is for their own hunger; it will not come into the house of YHWH.
What will you do for the day of the appointed feast, and for the day of the festival of YHWH?
For behold, they have gone from devastation; Egypt will gather them, Memphis will bury them. As for the treasure of their silver, nettles will possess it; thorns will be in their tents.

The days of punishment have come, the days of recompense have come. Let Israel know it! The prophet is a fool, the man of the spirit is mad — because of the greatness of your iniquity, and great is the animosity.
Ephraim was a watchman with my God; a prophet — the trap of a fowler is on all his ways; animosity is in the house of his God.
They have gone deep — they have acted corruptly — as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity; he will visit their sins.

Like grapes in the wilderness I found Israel; like an early fig on a fig tree in its first season I saw your fathers. They — they came to Baal-peor and devoted themselves to the shameful thing, and they became detestable like the thing they loved.
Ephraim — like a bird their glory will fly away: from birth and from the womb and from conception.
For even if they bring up their children, I will bereave them of every one. For woe to them also when I turn away from them!
Ephraim, as I have seen, is planted in a meadow like Tyre; and Ephraim is to bring out his children to the slayer.
Give them, YHWH — what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
All their evil is at Gilgal, for there I hated them. Because of the evil of their deeds I will drive them out of my house. I will not love them again; all their princes are rebels.
Ephraim is struck down; their root is dried up; they will produce no fruit. Even if they give birth, I will put to death the precious things of their womb.
My God will reject them, for they have not listened to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

hosea_10.t: Israel is a luxuriant vine; he makes fruit for himself. According to the abundance of his fruit he multiplied altars; according to the goodness of his land they made good pillars.
Their heart is slippery; now they will be held guilty. He will break the neck of their altars; he will destroy their pillars.
For now they will say, "We have no king, for we did not fear YHWH — and the king, what could he do for us?"
They have spoken words, swearing falsely, cutting a covenant; and judgement sprouts like a poison-weed on the furrows of a field.

For the calves of Beth-aven the inhabitants of Samaria will be in dread. For its people will mourn over it, and its idol-priests will writhe over it, over its glory, because it has gone into exile from it.
It too will be carried to Assyria as tribute to king Jareb. Ephraim will take shame, and Israel will be ashamed of its own counsel.
Samaria is destroyed; her king is like a twig on the face of the waters.
And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. Thorn and thistle will come up on their altars. And they will say to the mountains, "Cover us," and to the hills, "Fall on us."
Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, Israel; there they have stood. Will not war overtake them in Gibeah, against the sons of injustice?
At my desire I will discipline them; and peoples will be gathered against them when they are harnessed to their two iniquities.
And Ephraim was a trained heifer that loved to thresh, and I myself passed over the goodness of her neck. I will make Ephraim draw; Judah will plough; Jacob will harrow for himself.
Sow for yourselves for righteousness; reap according to steadfast love. Break up for yourselves untilled ground; and it is time to seek YHWH until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
You have ploughed wickedness; you have reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lying. For you have trusted in your own way, in the multitude of your warriors.
And an uproar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be devastated as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel on the day of battle — mother dashed to pieces upon children.
Thus he will do to you, Bethel, because of the evil of your evil. At the dawn the king of Israel will be utterly destroyed.

hosea_11.t: When Israel was a youth I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
They called to them; so they went from before them. They sacrificed to the Baals and made offerings smoke to the carved images.
And I myself taught Ephraim to walk; he took them on his arms; and they did not know that I had healed them.
With cords of a human I drew them, with ropes of love; and I was to them like those who lift a yoke from off their jaws, and I bent down to him, I fed him.
He will not return to the land of Egypt, but Assyria — he will be his king, for they have refused to return.
And a sword will whirl in his cities and put an end to his bars and devour, because of their counsels.
And my people are hung on turning away from me; and to the height they call him — together he does not exalt.

How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I set you like Zeboiim? My heart is overturned within me; my compassions have grown warm together.
I will not carry out the burning of my anger; I will not turn to destroy Ephraim. For I am God and not a human, the Holy One in your midst; and I will not come in rage.
After YHWH they will walk; like a lion he will roar. When he roars, children will come trembling from the sea.
They will come trembling like a bird from Egypt, and like a dove from the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses. Declaration of YHWH.
Ephraim has surrounded me with lying, and the house of Israel with deceit; and Judah still roams with God, and with the Holy One he is faithful.

hosea_12.t: Ephraim feeds on wind and pursues the east wind all the day; he multiplies lying and violence. And they cut a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried to Egypt.
And YHWH has a case against Judah, and to visit judgement on Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
In the womb he seized his brother's heel, and in his vigour he struggled with God.
And he struggled against a messenger and prevailed; he wept and sought his favour. At Bethel he would find him, and there he would speak with us —
and YHWH, the God of hosts, YHWH is his memorial name.
And you — return by your God! Keep steadfast love and judgement, and wait for your God continually.
A Canaanite! In his hand are scales of deceit; he loves to defraud.
And Ephraim said, "Surely I have grown rich; I have found wealth for myself. All my toil — they will find in me no iniquity that is sin."
And I am YHWH your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
And I spoke to the prophets, and I myself multiplied vision, and by the hand of the prophets I gave likenesses.
If Gilead is iniquity, surely they have become worthlessness. In Gilgal they have sacrificed bulls; yes, their altars are like heaps of stones on the furrows of a field.
And Jacob fled to the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept flocks.
And by a prophet YHWH brought Israel up from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.
Ephraim has provoked bitterly; and his blood he will leave upon him, and his lord will return his reproach to him.

hosea_13.t: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty through the Baal, and he died.

And now they go on sinning and have made for themselves a molten image from their silver, idols according to their own skill, all of it the work of craftsmen. Of them they say, "Let the sacrificers of men kiss calves."
Therefore they will be like a morning cloud and like the dew that goes early away, like chaff storm-driven from a threshing floor and like smoke from a lattice.
And I am YHWH your God from the land of Egypt, and you shall know no god but me; and there is no saviour besides me.
I knew you in the wilderness, in a land of droughts.
According to their pasture, so they were satisfied; they were satisfied and their heart was exalted. Therefore they forgot me.
So I became to them like a lion; like a leopard I will watch beside the way.
I will meet them like a bear robbed of her cubs and tear open the enclosure of their heart. And I will devour them there like a lion; the wild animal of the field will rip them open.
It has destroyed you, Israel, for in me — in your help.
Where now is your king, that he may save you in all your cities, and your rulers, of whom you said, "Give me a king and princes"?
I gave you a king in my anger, and I take him away in my fury.
The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored away.
The pains of one giving birth will come upon him. He is a son who is not wise, for at the time he does not present himself at the breaking open of children.
From the hand of Sheol I will ransom them; from Death I will redeem them. Where are your plagues, Death? Where is your destruction, Sheol? Compassion is hidden from my eyes.

Though he flourishes among brothers, an east wind will come, the wind of YHWH, coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will be dried up and his fountain will be parched. It will plunder the treasury of every precious article.
Samaria will be held guilty, for she has rebelled against her God. By the sword they will fall; their infants will be dashed to pieces, and her pregnant women will be ripped open.

hosea_14.t: Return, Israel, to YHWH your God, for you have stumbled in your iniquity.
Take words with you and return to YHWH. Say to him, "Forgive all iniquity and take what is good, and let us pay the bulls of our lips."
Assyria will not save us; we will not ride on horses, and we will no longer say "Our God" to the work of our hands — for in you the fatherless finds compassion.
I will heal their turning away; I will love them freely, for my anger has turned from him.
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and strike his roots like Lebanon.
His young shoots will spread, and his splendour will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Those who dwell in his shade will return; they will make grain live and blossom like the vine. His memorial will be like the wine of Lebanon.
Ephraim — what have I to do any more with idols? I have answered and I will watch over him. I am like a luxuriant cypress; from me your fruit is found.
Who is wise? Let him understand these things. Discerning? Let him know them. For the ways of YHWH are upright, and the righteous walk in them, but transgressors stumble in them.

isaiah_1.t: The vision of Isaiah son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for YHWH has spoken: Children I have brought up and raised high, and they — they have transgressed against me.
An ox knows its owner, and a donkey its master's feeding trough; Israel does not know, my people does not understand.
Woe, sinning nation, people heavy with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who act corruptly! They have forsaken YHWH, they have spurned the Holy One of Israel, they have turned away backward.
Upon what will you be struck again? You add more turning away. Every head is sick, and every heart is faint.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it — bruise and welt and fresh wound; they have not been pressed out, nor bound up, nor softened with oil.
Your land is a desolation, your cities are burned with fire; your ground — before you strangers are devouring it, and it is a desolation, like the overthrow of strangers.
And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard, like a shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
If YHWH of hosts had not left us survivors, a few, we would have been like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.
Hear the word of YHWH, O rulers of Sodom! Give ear to the law of our God, O people of Gomorrah!

'What is the multitude of your sacrifices to me?' says YHWH. 'I have had my fill of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fatlings; and in the blood of bulls and lambs and he-goats I take no pleasure.
When you come to appear before my face, who required this from your hand — the trampling of my courts?
Do not go on bringing a worthless offering; incense — it is an abomination to me. New moon and sabbath, the calling of a convocation — I cannot endure wrongdoing and solemn assembly.
Your new moons and your appointed times my being hates. They have become a burden upon me; I am weary of bearing them.
And when you spread out your palms, I will hide my eyes from you; even though you multiply prayer, I am not listening. Your hands are full of blood.
Wash, make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your deeds from before my eyes; cease to do evil,
learn to do good; seek justice, set the oppressor right; vindicate the fatherless, conduct the widow's case.
'Come now, and let us argue the case together,' says YHWH. 'Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall become white as snow; though they are red like the worm, they shall be like wool.
If you are willing and you obey, you shall eat the good of the land;
but if you refuse and rebel, by the sword you shall be eaten — for the mouth of YHWH has spoken.
How she has become a prostitute, the faithful town! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her — and now, murderers.
Your silver has become dross; your drink is diluted with water.
Your officials are stubborn and companions of thieves; every one of them loves a bribe and runs after payments. The fatherless they do not vindicate, and the widow's case does not come before them.
Therefore — the declaration of the Lord, YHWH of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel: 'Ah, I will get relief from my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.
And I will turn my hand against you and refine away your dross as with lye, and remove all your alloy.
And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counsellors as at the beginning. After that you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful Town.
Zion will be ransomed by justice, and those in her who turn back, by righteousness.
But a crushing of transgressors and sinners together, and those who forsake YHWH will come to an end.
For they will be ashamed of the great trees that you desired, and you will be abashed at the gardens that you chose.
For you will be like a terebinth whose leafage is withering, and like a garden that has no water.
And the strong one will become tow, and his work a spark; and the two of them will burn together, with none to put them out.

isaiah_2.t: The word that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
And it will be at the end of the days that the mountain of the house of YHWH will be established at the head of the mountains, and lifted above the hills; and all the nations will stream to it.

And many peoples will come and say: 'Come, let us go up to the mountain of YHWH, to the house of the God of Jacob, that he may teach us of his ways and we may walk in his paths.' For from Zion law goes out, and the word of YHWH from Jerusalem.

And he will judge between the nations and decide for many peoples; and they will beat their swords into ploughshares and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, and they will not learn war any more.
O house of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of YHWH.
For you have abandoned your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full from the east, and soothsayers like the Philistines, and with the children of foreigners they strike hands.
And his land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to his treasures; and his land is filled with horses, and there is no end to his chariots.
And his land is filled with idols; to the work of his hands they bow down, to what his fingers have made.
And humankind is brought low, and a man is made low; and do not forgive them.
Go into the rock and hide yourself in the dust, from before the dread of YHWH and from the magnificence of his majesty.
The haughty eyes of humankind will be made low, and the pride of men will be humbled; and YHWH alone will be exalted in that day.
For YHWH of hosts has a day against all that is proud and lofty, and against all that is lifted up — and it will be brought low;
and against all the cedars of Lebanon that are lofty and lifted up, and against all the oaks of Bashan;
and against all the mountains that are lofty, and against all the hills that are lifted up;
and against every high tower, and against every fortified wall;
and against all the ships of Tarshish, and against all the desirable craft.
And the haughtiness of humankind will be humbled, and the pride of men will be made low; and YHWH alone will be exalted in that day.
And the idols — completely will they pass away.
And people will go into the caves of the rocks and into the holes of the dust, from before the dread of YHWH and from the magnificence of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
In that day humankind will throw away its idols of silver and its idols of gold, which they made for themselves to bow down to, to the digging moles and to the bats;
to go into the crevices of the rocks and into the clefts of the rocks, from before the dread of YHWH and from the magnificence of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
Cease for yourselves from humankind, whose breath is in his nostrils — for at what is he to be accounted?

isaiah_3.t: For behold, the Lord, YHWH of hosts, is removing from Jerusalem and from Judah support and support, every support of bread and every support of water;
warrior and man of war, judge and prophet, diviner and elder,
commander of fifty and one whose face is lifted, and counsellor and skilled in magic arts and expert in charms.
And I will make youths their officials, and wantonness will rule over them.
And the people will oppress one another, each man against a man and each against his neighbour; the youth will act insolently against the elder, and the lightly esteemed against the honoured.
For a man will seize his brother in his father's house: 'You have a cloak — you shall be a ruler for us, and this heap of ruins shall be under your hand.'
In that day he will lift up his voice, saying: 'I will not be a binder of wounds; and in my house there is no bread and no cloak. You shall not appoint me a ruler of the people.'
For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen, because their tongue and their deeds are against YHWH, to rebel against the eyes of his glory.
The look of their faces has testified against them, and their sin they have declared like Sodom — they have not hidden it. Alas for their being, for they have dealt out evil to themselves.
Say of the righteous that it is good, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
Alas for the wicked — it will go badly, for the requital of his hands will be done to him.
My people — its oppressors act like children, and women rule over it. O my people, your guides mislead, and the way of your paths they have confused.
YHWH is taking his stand to conduct a case, and standing to judge peoples.
YHWH will come into judgement with the elders of his people and its officials: 'And you — you have consumed the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
What do you mean, that you crush my people and grind the faces of the poor?' The declaration of the Lord YHWH of hosts.
And YHWH said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with necks stretched out, making seductive glances with their eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and tinkling with their feet —
therefore the Lord will make the scalp of the daughters of Zion scabby, and YHWH will lay bare their forehead.
In that day the Lord will remove the splendour of the anklets and the headbands and the crescents,
the pendants and the bracelets and the veils,
the headdresses and the ankle chains and the sashes and the perfume boxes and the amulets,
the signet rings and the nose rings,
the festal robes and the over-tunics and the cloaks and the purses,
and the mirrors and the linen garments and the turbans and the shawls.
And it will be: instead of perfume, rottenness; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a girding of sackcloth; a brand instead of beauty.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your might in battle.
And her gates will lament and mourn, and emptied out, she will sit on the ground.

isaiah_4.t: And seven women will take hold of one man in that day, saying: 'We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothing; only let your name be called over us — take away our reproach.'
In that day the Branch of YHWH will be for beauty and for glory, and the fruit of the land for majesty and for splendour, for the escaped of Israel.
And it will be: the one who remains in Zion and the one left in Jerusalem will be called holy — everyone recorded for life in Jerusalem;
when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and rinsed away the blood of Jerusalem from its midst by a spirit of judgement and by a spirit of burning.
And YHWH will create over all the place of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud by day and smoke, and the brightness of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory there will be a canopy.
And there will be a booth for shade by day from the heat, and for a refuge and a shelter from the storm and from the rain.

isaiah_5.t: Let me sing now for my beloved my love's song about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a horn, a son of oil.

And he dug it and cleared it of stones and planted it with choice vines, and built a tower in its middle, and also hewed out a winepress in it; and he waited for it to produce grapes, and it produced rotten grapes.
And now, inhabitant of Jerusalem and man of Judah, judge, please, between me and my vineyard.
What more was there to do for my vineyard that I did not do in it? Why did I wait for it to produce grapes, and it produced rotten grapes?
And now let me make known to you what I am about to do to my vineyard: removing its hedge, and it will become grazing; breaking down its wall, and it will become a trampling ground.
And I will make it a waste: it will not be pruned and it will not be hoed, and thorn and briar will come up; and I will command the clouds not to rain rain on it.

For the vineyard of YHWH of hosts is the house of Israel, and the man of Judah is the planting of his delight. And he waited for justice — and there, bloodshed; for righteousness — and there, an outcry.
Woe to those who join house to house, who bring field near to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the midst of the land.
In my ears YHWH of hosts: Surely many houses will become a waste, great and good ones, with no inhabitant.
For ten acres of vineyard will produce one bath, and a homer of seed will produce an ephah.
Woe to those who rise early in the morning to pursue strong drink, who linger into the twilight while wine inflames them.
And lyre and harp, tambourine and flute and wine are their feasts; but the deed of YHWH they do not regard, and the work of his hands they have not seen.
Therefore my people has gone into exile for lack of knowledge, and its glory are men of hunger, and its multitude parched with thirst.
Therefore Sheol has enlarged its being and opened its mouth beyond measure; and her magnificence and her multitude and her uproar go down, and the one exulting in her.
And humankind is brought low, and a man is made low, and the eyes of the proud are brought low.
And YHWH of hosts is exalted in judgement, and the holy God shows himself holy in righteousness.
And lambs will graze as in their own pasture, and sojourners will eat among the waste places of the fat ones.
Woe to those who drag iniquity along with cords of falsehood, and sin as with a cart rope;
who say: 'Let him hurry, let him hasten his work, so that we may see; and let the plan of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, so that we may know.'
Woe to those who say of evil, good, and of good, evil; who put darkness for light and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.
Woe to those wise in their own eyes, and discerning before their own faces.
Woe to those who are mighty at drinking wine, and men of ability at mixing strong drink,
who justify the wicked for the sake of a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him.

Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes stubble and dry grass sinks down in the flame, their root will be like rottenness and their blossom will go up like dust; because they have rejected the law of YHWH of hosts, and spurned the speech of the Holy One of Israel.

Therefore the anger of YHWH has burned against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against it and struck it, and the mountains quaked, and their corpses were like refuse in the midst of the streets. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
And he will lift up a standard for the nations from afar, and whistle for it from the end of the earth; and there — swiftly, quickly, it comes.
There is none weary and none stumbling among it; it does not slumber and does not sleep; and the waistcloth of its loins is not loosed, and the thong of its sandals is not torn.
whose arrows are sharpened and all whose bows are bent; the hooves of its horses are reckoned like flint, and its wheels like the storm wind.
Its roaring is like a lion; it roars like young lions, and growls and seizes prey and carries it off, and there is none to rescue.
And it will growl over it in that day like the growling of the sea; and one looks to the land, and there — darkness, distress; and the light has grown dark in its clouds.

isaiah_6.t: In the year of the death of King Uzziah I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and his hems were filling the temple.
Seraphim were standing above him. Six wings, six wings to each: with two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.
And one called to another and said: Holy, holy, holy is YHWH of hosts; the fullness of all the earth is his glory.
And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of the one calling, and the house was filled with smoke.
And I said: Alas for me, for I am destroyed! For I am a man unclean of lips, and I dwell among a people unclean of lips — for my eyes have seen the King, YHWH of hosts.
And one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand a live coal that he had taken with tongs from upon the altar.
And he touched it to my mouth and said: Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.
And I heard the voice of the Lord saying: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? And I said: Here I am — send me.
And he said: Go, and say to this people: Hearing, hear — and do not understand; and seeing, see — and do not perceive.
Make the heart of this people fat, and make its ears heavy, and seal over its eyes — lest it see with its eyes and hear with its ears and its heart understand, and it turn back and be healed.
And I said: Until when, Lord? And he said: Until cities lie waste with no inhabitant, and houses with no one in them, and the ground is devastated, a desolation;
and YHWH has sent humankind far away, and the abandoned places are many in the midst of the land.
and though a tenth is still in it, it will again be for burning — like a terebinth or an oak, which in the felling has a stump in them. A holy seed is its stump.

isaiah_7.t: And it was in the days of Ahaz son of Jotham son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel went up to Jerusalem for battle against it, and he was not able to fight against it.
And it was told to the house of David: Aram has settled upon Ephraim. And his heart shook, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest shake before a wind.
And YHWH said to Isaiah: Go out, please, to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your son, to the end of the conduit of the upper pool, to the highway of the Launderer's Field,

and say to him: Take care and be quiet. Do not be afraid, and let your heart not be weak, because of these two smoking stubs of firebrands — because of the burning anger of Rezin and Aram and the son of Remaliah.
Because Aram has planned evil against you — Ephraim and the son of Remaliah — saying,
Let us go up against Judah and tear it apart and break it open for ourselves, and let us make a king in its midst — the son of Tabeel.
Thus says the Lord YHWH: It will not stand, and it will not happen.
For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. And within sixty-five years Ephraim will be shattered from being a people.
And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you will not be firm, surely you will not be confirmed.
And YHWH spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
Ask for yourself a sign from YHWH your God — make it deep as Sheol, or make it high, upward.
And Ahaz said: I will not ask, and I will not put YHWH to the test.
And he said: Hear, please, house of David! Is it too little for you to weary men, that you weary my God also?
Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will conceive and bear a son, and she will call his name Immanuel.
Curds and honey he will eat, until he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
For before the boy knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you dread will be forsaken.
YHWH will bring upon you and upon your people and upon your father's house days such as have not come since the day Ephraim turned aside from Judah — the king of Assyria.
And it will be in that day that YHWH will whistle for the fly that is at the end of the canals of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
And they will all come and settle in the wadis of the cliffs and in the clefts of the rocks, and on all the thornbushes and in all the watering places.
In that day the Lord will shave, with a razor hired from beyond the River — with the king of Assyria — the head and the hair of the feet; and it will also sweep away the beard.
And it will be in that day that a man will keep alive a heifer of the herd and two sheep,
And it will be that from the abundance of milk they produce he will eat curds; for curds and honey will everyone who remains in the midst of the land eat.
And it will be in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver pieces will become thorns and briars.
With arrows and with a bow one will go there, for all the land will be thorns and briars.
And all the hills that were hoed with the hoe — you will not go there for fear of thorns and briars; and it will become a place for letting out oxen and for the trampling of sheep.

isaiah_8.t: And YHWH said to me: Take yourself a large tablet and write on it with a common stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
And I called as witnesses for myself reliable witnesses: Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.
And I drew near to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. And YHWH said to me: Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
For before the boy knows to call out 'my father' and 'my mother', the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off before the king of Assyria.
And YHWH spoke to me again, saying,
Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that go gently, and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

therefore, behold, the Lord is bringing up over them the waters of the River, mighty and many — the king of Assyria and all his glory — and it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks.
And it will sweep on into Judah, overflowing and passing over; it will reach up to the neck. And the spreading of its wings will fill the breadth of your land, Immanuel.
Be broken, O peoples, and be shattered! Give ear, all you distant places of the earth! Gird yourselves and be shattered! Gird yourselves and be shattered!
Plan a plan — and it will be frustrated; speak a word — and it will not stand; for God is with us.
For thus YHWH said to me, with the strength of the hand upon me, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
Do not say 'Conspiracy!' of everything this people calls a conspiracy; and do not fear what it fears, and do not hold it in awe.
YHWH of hosts — him you shall regard as holy; and he is your fear, and he is the one you hold in awe.
And he will become a sanctuary — and a stone of striking and a rock of stumbling to the two houses of Israel, a trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And many among them will stumble and fall and be broken, and be ensnared and captured.
Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
And I will wait for YHWH, who is hiding his face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope for him.
Behold, I and the children whom YHWH has given me are for signs and portents in Israel, from YHWH of hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
And when they say to you, 'Consult the ghosts and the knowing spirits, who chirp and mutter' — should not a people consult its God? On behalf of the living, the dead?
To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, it is because there is no dawn for them.
And he will pass through it, hard pressed and hungry; and it will be that when he is hungry he will be enraged and will curse his king and his God, and turn his face upward.
And he will look to the earth, and behold — distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and he is thrust into thick darkness.

isaiah_9.t: For there is no gloom for her that was in distress. In the former time he treated with contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the latter he will make it honoured — the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
The people who walk in darkness have seen a great light; those who dwell in a land of deep darkness — light has shone upon them.
You have multiplied the nation; you have made its joy great. They rejoice before you as with the joy at harvest, as people are glad when they divide plunder.
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff on his shoulder, the rod of the one who oppresses him — you have shattered as on the day of Midian.
For every boot that marches with shaking, and cloak rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for fire.
For a child has been born to us, a son has been given to us, and the dominion is upon his shoulder; and his name is called Wonder-Counsellor, Mighty God, Father of Perpetuity, Prince of Peace.

Of the increase of the dominion and of peace there will be no end, upon the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and to sustain it in justice and in righteousness, from now and for ever. The zeal of YHWH of hosts will do this.
The Lord has sent a word against Jacob, and it has fallen on Israel.
And all the people will know it — Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria — who say in pride and greatness of heart:
Bricks have fallen, but with hewn stone we will build; sycamores have been cut down, but cedars we will put in their place.
And YHWH has set the adversaries of Rezin on high against him, and has stirred up his enemies —
Aram from the east and the Philistines from behind, and they have devoured Israel with the whole mouth. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
And the people has not turned back to the one who struck it, and YHWH of hosts they have not sought.
And YHWH has cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
The elder and the man of rank, he is the head; and the prophet who teaches falsehood, he is the tail.
And the guides of this people have been misleading, and those they guided have been swallowed up.

Therefore the Lord does not rejoice over its young men, and on its fatherless and its widows he has no compassion; for all of it is godless and doing evil, and every mouth speaks disgraceful folly. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
For wickedness burns like fire; it consumes thorns and briars, and kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they swirl upward in a rising of smoke.
By the wrath of YHWH of hosts the land is scorched, and the people has become like fuel for fire; no one spares his brother.
And he devours on the right and is hungry, and eats on the left and they are not satisfied; each devours the flesh of his own arm.
Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they are against Judah. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.

isaiah_10.t: Woe to those who decree decrees of wrongdoing, and to the writers who have written out trouble,
to turn the weak aside from judgement, and to rob the poor of my people of justice, so that widows become their prey and they may plunder the fatherless.
And what will you do on the day of reckoning, and at the devastation that comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your glory?
There is nothing but to crouch among the prisoners, and among the slain they will fall. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
Woe, Assyria, the rod of my anger! And the staff in their hand is my indignation.
Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to plunder plunder and to spoil spoil, and to make it a trampling ground like the mud of the streets.
But he does not intend it so, and his heart does not plan it so; for it is in his heart to destroy and to cut off nations, not a few.
For he says: Are not my commanders all of them kings?
Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
Just as my hand has reached the kingdoms of the idol — and their images were more than Jerusalem's and Samaria's —
shall I not do to Jerusalem and its figures as I have done to Samaria and its idols?

And it will be, when the Lord has finished all his work on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, that I will attend to the fruit of the greatness of the heart of the king of Assyria, and to the splendour of his haughty eyes.

For he has said: By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of peoples and plundered their stores, and like a mighty one I brought down those who sat enthroned.

And my hand has found, like a nest, the wealth of the peoples; and as one gathers abandoned eggs, I myself gathered all the earth; and there was none that fluttered a wing or opened a mouth or chirped.

Does the axe glorify itself over the one who hews with it? Does the saw magnify itself over the one who wields it? As if a rod should wield those who lift it, as if a staff should lift what is not wood.
Therefore the Lord, YHWH of hosts, will send leanness among his fat ones; and under his glory a burning will burn like the burning of fire.
And the Light of Israel will become a fire, and his Holy One a flame; and it will burn and consume his thorns and his briars in one day.
And the glory of his forest and of his orchard he will bring to an end, from being to flesh; and it will be as when a sick man wastes away.
And the remnant of the trees of his forest will be a number, and a boy could write them down.

And it will be in that day that the remnant of Israel and the escaped of the house of Jacob will no longer lean on the one who struck them, but will lean on YHWH, the Holy One of Israel, in faithfulness.
A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the Mighty God.
For though your people Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant will return in it. Annihilation is decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
For a complete destruction, and one decreed, the Lord YHWH of hosts is about to make in the midst of all the land.
Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH of hosts: Do not be afraid, my people who dwell in Zion, of Assyria, who strikes you with the rod and lifts up his staff against you in the manner of Egypt.
For yet a very little while, and indignation will be finished, and my anger will be on their destruction.
And YHWH of hosts will wield a whip against him, like the striking of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it up in the manner of Egypt.
And it will be in that day that his burden will be removed from your shoulder and his yoke from your neck; and the yoke will be broken because of fatness.
He has come to Aiath, he has passed through Migron; at Michmash he deposits his baggage.
They have crossed the pass; Geba is our lodging place. Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul has fled.
Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!
Madmenah has fled; the inhabitants of Gebim have taken refuge.
This very day he will halt at Nob; he shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Behold, the Lord, YHWH of hosts, is lopping off the boughs with a crash; and the lofty in height are cut down, and the tall are brought low.
And he will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by a mighty one.

isaiah_11.t: And a shoot will go out from the stock of Jesse, and a branch from his roots will bear fruit.
And the spirit of YHWH will rest upon him: a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of counsel and might, a spirit of knowledge and the fear of YHWH.
