And his delight will be in the fear of YHWH. And he will not judge by what his eyes see, nor decide by what his ears hear;

but he will judge the weak with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth; and he will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he will put the wicked to death.
And righteousness will be the waistcloth of his hips, and trustworthiness the waistcloth of his loins.
And a wolf will sojourn with a lamb, and a leopard will lie down with a kid; and a calf and a young lion and a fatling together, and a small boy leading them.
And a cow and a bear will graze; their young will lie down together; and a lion will eat straw like the ox.
And a nursing child will play over the hole of a cobra, and over the viper's den a weaned child will put out his hand.
They will not do harm and they will not destroy in all my holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of YHWH as the waters cover the sea.
And it will be in that day that the root of Jesse, who stands as a standard for the peoples — to him the nations will seek; and his resting place will be glory.

And it will be in that day that the Lord will put out his hand a second time to acquire the remnant of his people that remains from Assyria and from Egypt, from Pathros and from Cush, from Elam and from Shinar and from Hamath and from the coastlands of the sea.
And he will lift up a standard for the nations, and gather the banished of Israel; and the scattered of Judah he will assemble from the four corners of the earth.
And the jealousy of Ephraim will come to an end, and the opponents of Judah will be cut off; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will not oppose Ephraim.
And they will swoop on the shoulder of the Philistines westward; together they will plunder the people of the east. Edom and Moab will be the reach of their hand, and the Ammonites their subjects.

And YHWH will utterly destroy the tongue of the sea of Egypt, and will wave his hand over the River with the scorching of his wind; and he will strike it into seven wadis and make people walk over in sandals.
And there will be a highway for the remnant of his people that remains from Assyria, as there was for Israel on the day it came up from the land of Egypt.

isaiah_12.t: And you will say in that day: I will give you thanks, YHWH, for you were angry with me; let your anger turn back, and comfort me.
Behold, God is my deliverance; I will trust and I will not dread; for Yah YHWH is my power and my might, and he has become for me deliverance.
And you will draw water with rejoicing from the springs of deliverance.
And you will say in that day: Give thanks to YHWH, call on his name; make known his deeds among the peoples, bring to remembrance that his name is exalted.
Make music to YHWH, for he has done majestically; let this be made known in all the earth.
Cry aloud and shout, inhabitant of Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel.

isaiah_13.t: The oracle of Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw.
On a bare mountain lift up a standard; raise the voice to them, wave a hand, and let them enter the gates of the nobles.
I myself have commanded my consecrated ones; I have also summoned my warriors for my anger, my proudly exulting ones.
The sound of a tumult on the mountains, the likeness of a numerous people! The sound of an uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathering! YHWH of hosts is mustering an army for battle.
They come from a distant land, from the end of the heavens — YHWH and the weapons of his indignation — to destroy all the earth.
Wail, for the day of YHWH is near; it comes like devastation from the Almighty.
Therefore all hands will drop, and every human heart will melt.
And they will be terrified; pangs and pains will seize them; like a woman giving birth they will writhe. Each will look in astonishment at his neighbour; their faces will be faces of flame.
Behold, the day of YHWH comes, cruel, with wrath and burning anger, to make the land a waste; and its sinners he will destroy from it.
For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not flash their light; the sun will be dark at its rising, and the moon will not shine its light.
And I will visit evil upon the world, and their iniquity upon the wicked; and I will put an end to the pride of the arrogant, and the haughtiness of the ruthless I will bring low.
I will make a human more precious than pure gold, and humankind than the gold of Ophir.
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will shake from its place, in the wrath of YHWH of hosts and in the day of his burning anger.
And it will be like a hunted gazelle, and like sheep with none to gather them: each will turn to his own people, and each will flee to his own land.
Everyone found will be pierced through, and everyone swept up will fall by the sword.
And their children will be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses will be plundered and their wives lain with.
Behold, I am rousing the Medes against them, who do not value silver and take no delight in gold.
And bows will dash young men in pieces; and on the fruit of the womb they will have no compassion; their eye will not look with pity on children.
And Babylon, the beauty of kingdoms, the splendour of the pride of the Chaldeans, will be like God's overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah.
She will never be inhabited, nor settled from generation to generation; no Arab will pitch a tent there, and shepherds will not make their flocks lie down there.
But desert creatures will lie down there, and their houses will be full of howling things; and daughters of the ostrich will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about there.
And hyenas will answer in its citadels, and jackals in the palaces of delight. And her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

isaiah_14.t: For YHWH will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel, and will give them rest on their own ground; and the sojourner will join himself to them, and they will attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

And peoples will take them and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel will take them as an inheritance on the land of YHWH, as male and female servants. And they will take captive their captors, and rule over their oppressors.
And it will be on the day YHWH gives you rest from your pain and from your turmoil and from the hard labour that was laboured through you,
you will lift up this saying against the king of Babylon and say: How the oppressor has ceased! How the raging has ceased!
YHWH has broken the staff of the wicked, the rod of rulers,
which struck peoples in wrath with a blow that did not cease, which ruled nations in anger with a persecution that none restrained.
All the earth is at rest, at peace; people have broken out into a shout of joy.
Even the fir trees rejoice over you, the cedars of Lebanon: 'Since you lay down, no woodcutter has come up against us.'
Sheol beneath is stirred for you, to meet you at your coming; it rouses for you the shades, all the he-goats of the earth; it has raised from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
All of them will answer and say to you: 'Even you have been made weak like us; you have become like us.'
Your pride has been brought down to Sheol, the sound of your harps; beneath you maggots are spread as a bed, and worms are your covering.
How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of dawn! You have been cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
And you said in your heart: 'I will ascend to the heavens; above the stars of God I will raise my throne; and I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the remotest parts of the north.
I will ascend above the heights of the cloud; I will make myself like the Most High.'
Nevertheless, to Sheol you are brought down, to the remotest parts of the pit.
Those who see you will stare at you; they will consider you carefully: 'Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who made kingdoms shake,
who made the world like the wilderness and tore down its cities, who did not open the way home for his prisoners?'
All the kings of the nations, all of them, lie down in glory, each one in his own house.
But you have been thrown out from your tomb like an abhorred branch, clothed with the slain, those pierced by the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit — like a trampled corpse.
You will not be joined with them in burial, for you have ruined your land, you have slain your people. May the offspring of evildoers never be named.
Prepare a slaughtering place for his sons because of the iniquity of their fathers, lest they rise and take possession of the earth and fill the face of the world with cities.
And I will rise up against them — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — and I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, offspring and posterity — the declaration of YHWH.
And I will make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water; and I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
YHWH of hosts has sworn: Surely as I have intended, so it has come to be; and as I have planned, it will stand.
to break Assyria in my land, and on my mountains I will trample him; and his yoke will be removed from them, and his burden removed from their shoulder.
This is the plan planned against all the earth, and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations.
For YHWH of hosts has planned, and who will frustrate it? And his hand is stretched out — and who will turn it back?
In the year of the death of King Ahaz this oracle came.
Do not rejoice, all Philistia, that the rod of the one who struck you is broken; for from the root of a serpent a viper will come out, and its fruit will be a flying serpent.
And the firstborn of the weak will graze, and the needy will lie down in safety; but I will put your root to death with famine, and it will kill your remnant.
Wail, gate! Cry out, city! Melt away, all Philistia! For from the north smoke is coming, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
And what will one answer the messengers of a nation? That YHWH has founded Zion, and in her the poor of his people will take refuge.

isaiah_15.t: The oracle of Moab. Because in a night Ar of Moab was devastated, destroyed; because in a night Kir of Moab was devastated, destroyed —
The house and Dibon have gone up to the high places to weep. Over Nebo and over Medeba Moab wails. On all its heads is baldness; every beard is cut off.
In its streets they have girded on sackcloth; on its roofs and in its open places all of it wails, going down in weeping.
And Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; as far as Jahaz their voice is heard. Therefore the armed men of Moab shout; its being trembles within it.
My heart cries out for Moab; its fugitives are as far as Zoar, Eglath-shelishiyah. For the ascent of Luhith — with weeping they go up it; for on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of shattering.
For the waters of Nimrim are wastes; for the grass has dried up, the vegetation has wasted away, there is no greenery.
Therefore the surplus they have made, and their store, they carry over the Wadi of the Poplars.
For the cry has gone round the territory of Moab; as far as Eglaim its wailing, and to Beer-elim its wailing.
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will put yet more on Dimon — a lion for the escaped of Moab, and for the remainder of the ground.

isaiah_16.t: Send a lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela toward the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
And it will be: like a fluttering bird, a nest sent away, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
'Bring counsel, make a decision; make your shade like night in the middle of noon; hide the outcasts, do not expose the fugitive.

Let my outcasts sojourn among you, Moab; be a shelter for them from before the destroyer.' For the oppressor will come to an end, devastation will cease, those who trample will be finished from the land.
And a throne will be established in steadfast love, and one will sit on it in faithfulness, in the tent of David, judging and seeking justice and prompt in righteousness.
We have heard of the pride of Moab — very proud — its haughtiness and its pride and its fury; its empty boasts are not right.
Therefore Moab will wail for Moab; all of it will wail. For the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth you will groan, utterly stricken.

For the fields of Heshbon have withered, the vine of Sibmah; the rulers of nations have struck down its choice branches, which reached as far as Jazer, wandered into the wilderness; its shoots spread out, they crossed the sea.
Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I drench you with my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh; for over your summer fruit and over your harvest the shout has fallen.
And joy and gladness are taken away from the orchard; and in the vineyards there is no singing, no shouting; no treader treads wine in the winepresses. I have made the shout to cease.
Therefore my inward parts sound like a lyre for Moab, and my inner being for Kir-heres.
And it will be, when Moab presents itself, when it wearies itself on the high place, and comes to its sanctuary to pray, that it will not prevail.
This is the word that YHWH spoke concerning Moab in time past.

And now YHWH has spoken, saying: Within three years, like the years of a hired labourer, the glory of Moab will be brought into contempt, with all its great multitude; and the remnant will be very few, not mighty.

isaiah_17.t: The oracle of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is being removed from being a city, and it will be a heap of ruins.
The cities of Aroer are abandoned; they will be for flocks, and they will lie down with none to terrify them.
And the fortress will cease from Ephraim, and kingship from Damascus and the remnant of Aram; they will be like the glory of the sons of Israel — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
And it will be in that day that the glory of Jacob will be brought low, and the fatness of his flesh will be made lean.
And it will be like the gathering of a harvest of standing grain, and his arm reaping the ears; and it will be like one gleaning ears in the Valley of Rephaim.

And gleanings will be left in it, as at the beating of an olive tree: two, three olives at the top of the topmost bough; four, five on its fruiting branches — the declaration of YHWH, the God of Israel.
In that day a person will look to his Maker, and his eyes will see the Holy One of Israel;
and he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, and what his fingers have made he will not see — the asherahs and the incense altars.
In that day his fortified cities will be like the forsaken places of the wood and the topmost bough, which they abandoned because of the sons of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
For you have forgotten the God of your deliverance, and the Rock of your refuge you have not remembered. Therefore you plant pleasant plantings and sow it with the vine-shoot of a stranger.
On the day of your planting you make it grow, and in the morning you make your seed sprout; but the harvest is a heap in a day of sickness and incurable pain.
Woe — the tumult of many peoples! Like the roaring of seas they roar. And the uproar of nations! Like the uproar of mighty waters they are in uproar.
Nations roar like the uproar of many waters — but he rebukes it, and it flees far away, and is chased like chaff of the mountains before a wind, and like whirling dust before a storm.
At evening time — and behold, sudden terror! Before morning, it is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who despoil us.

isaiah_18.t: Woe — land of whirring wings, which is beyond the rivers of Cush,

which sends envoys by the sea, in vessels of papyrus on the face of the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared from it and beyond, a nation of strength upon strength and of trampling, whose land the rivers divide.
All you inhabitants of the world and dwellers of the earth: when a standard is lifted on the mountains, you will see; and when a ram's horn is sounded, you will hear.
For thus YHWH said to me: I will be quiet and will look on from my place, like dazzling heat over light, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
For before the harvest, when the bud is finished and the ripening grape becomes a blossom, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives and remove the tendrils, cutting them away.
They will be abandoned together to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the animals of the earth; and the birds of prey will summer on them, and every animal of the earth will winter on them.

At that time a gift will be brought to YHWH of hosts from a people tall and smooth-skinned, and from a people feared from it and beyond, a nation of strength upon strength and of trampling, whose land the rivers divide — to the place of the name of YHWH of hosts, Mount Zion.

isaiah_19.t: The oracle of Egypt. Behold, YHWH is riding on a swift cloud and coming to Egypt; and the idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the heart of Egypt melts within it.
And I will provoke Egypt against Egypt, and they will fight, each against his brother and each against his neighbour, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
And the spirit of Egypt will be emptied out within it, and its plan I will confuse; and they will consult the idols and the mutterers and the ghosts and the knowing spirits.
And I will hand Egypt over into the hand of a cruel master, and a strong king will rule over them — the declaration of the Lord, YHWH of hosts.
And the waters will be dried up from the sea, and the river will become dry and be dry.
And the rivers will stink; the canals of Egypt will run low and dry up; reed and rush will wither.
The bare places by the Nile, by the mouth of the Nile, and all that is sown by the Nile, will dry up, be driven away, and be no more.
And the fishermen will lament, and all who cast a hook in the Nile will mourn; and those who spread a net on the face of the waters will languish.
And the workers of combed flax will be ashamed, and the weavers of white cloth.
And her foundations will be crushed; all who work for wages will be grieved of being.
The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counsellors of Pharaoh — their counsel is stupid. How can you say to Pharaoh, 'I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings'?
Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now, and let them know what YHWH of hosts has planned against Egypt.
The officials of Zoan have become fools; the officials of Memphis are deceived; they have misled Egypt, the cornerstone of its tribes.
YHWH has mixed within her a spirit of confusion, and they have made Egypt stagger in all its work, as a drunkard staggers in his vomit.
And there will be no work for Egypt that head or tail, palm branch or reed can do.
In that day Egypt will be like women, and will tremble and be in dread before the brandishing of the hand of YHWH of hosts, which he is brandishing over it.
And the land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt; everyone to whom it is mentioned will be in dread, because of the plan of YHWH of hosts, which he is planning against it.
In that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt speaking the language of Canaan and swearing to YHWH of hosts. One will be called the City of Destruction.
In that day there will be an altar to YHWH in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to YHWH beside its border.

And it will be for a sign and for a witness to YHWH of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to YHWH because of oppressors, and he will send them a deliverer and a defender, and he will rescue them.
And YHWH will make himself known to Egypt, and Egypt will know YHWH in that day; and they will serve with sacrifice and offering, and they will vow a vow to YHWH and pay it.
And YHWH will strike Egypt, striking and healing; and they will turn back to YHWH, and he will be entreated by them and will heal them.
In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria; and Assyria will come into Egypt and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt will serve with Assyria.
In that day Israel will be a third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
which YHWH of hosts will bless, saying: Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.

isaiah_20.t: In the year the commander-in-chief came to Ashdod, when Sargon king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and captured it —
at that time YHWH spoke by the hand of Isaiah son of Amoz, saying: Go and loosen the sackcloth from your hips, and take your sandals off your feet. And he did so, going naked and barefoot.
And YHWH said: Just as my servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot three years, a sign and a portent against Egypt and against Cush,
so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot, with buttocks uncovered — the nakedness of Egypt.
And they will be dismayed and ashamed of Cush their hope and of Egypt their splendour.
And the inhabitant of this coastland will say in that day: Look — this is our hope, where we fled for help, to be rescued from before the king of Assyria! And how shall we ourselves escape?

isaiah_21.t: The oracle of the wilderness of the sea. Like storms sweeping through the Negeb, it comes from the wilderness, from a land to be feared.
A severe vision has been told to me: the traitor betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam! Lay siege, Media! I have put an end to all her groaning.
Therefore my loins are filled with anguish; pangs have seized me like the pangs of a woman giving birth. I am bent over from hearing; I am terrified from seeing.
My heart wanders; shuddering has overwhelmed me. The twilight I desired he has turned into trembling for me.
They arrange the table, they spread the rug, eating, drinking. Arise, officials! Oil the shield!
For thus the Lord said to me: Go, station the watchman; what he sees, let him tell.
And he will see riders, a pair of horsemen, riders on a donkey, riders on a camel; and he will listen closely, with great attentiveness.
And the seer called out: On a watchtower, Lord, I stand continually by day, and at my post I am stationed all the nights.
And behold, this is coming: riders, a man, a pair of horsemen! And he answered and said: Fallen, fallen is Babylon, and all the images of her gods he has shattered to the ground.
My threshed one, my threshing-floor's son: what I have heard from YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel, I have told you.
The oracle of Dumah. Someone is calling to me from Seir: Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
The watchman says: Morning comes, and also night. If you would enquire, enquire; come back again.
The oracle on Arabia. In the thickets in Arabia you will lodge, caravans of Dedanites.
Bring water to meet the thirsty! Inhabitants of the land of Tema, meet the fugitive with his bread.
For they have fled from before swords, from before a drawn sword, and from before a bent bow, and from before the weight of battle.
For thus the Lord said to me: Within a year, like the years of a hired labourer, all the glory of Kedar will be finished.
And the remnant of the number of the bowmen, the warriors of the sons of Kedar, will be few; for YHWH, the God of Israel, has spoken.

isaiah_22.t: The oracle of the Valley of Vision. What is the matter with you, then, that all of you have gone up to the roofs?
Full of noises, turbulent city, jubilant town! Your slain are not slain by the sword and are not dead in battle.
All your rulers have fled together; without a bow they were captured. All of you who were found were captured together; from far off they had fled.
Therefore I said: Look away from me; let me be bitter in weeping. Do not insist on comforting me over the devastation of the daughter of my people.
For the Lord YHWH of hosts has a day of consternation and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision — a breaking down of walls, and a crying out to the mountain.
And Elam took up the quiver, with chariotry of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
And it was that the choicest of your valleys were full of chariotry, and the horsemen took a firm stand at the gate.
And he uncovered the covering of Judah. And you looked in that day to the weaponry of the House of the Forest,
and you saw that the breaches of the City of David were many; and you gathered the waters of the lower pool.
And you counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you pulled down the houses to fortify the city wall.
And you made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool; but you did not look to the one who made it, and the one who formed it long ago you did not see.
And the Lord YHWH of hosts called in that day for weeping and for wailing, for baldness and for girding on sackcloth;
and behold — rejoicing and joy, killing cattle and slaughtering sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: 'Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!'
And YHWH of hosts revealed himself in my ears: Surely this iniquity will not be atoned for you until you die, says the Lord YHWH of hosts.
Thus says the Lord YHWH of hosts: Go, come to this steward, to Shebna who is over the house,
What is yours here, and who is yours here, that you have dug out a tomb for yourself here — digging his tomb on a height, cutting a dwelling for himself in the rock?
Behold, YHWH is about to hurl you away with a hurling, O man, and to grasp you firmly.
Winding, he will wind you into a ball, into a land broad on both hands. There you will die, and there the chariots of your splendour will be the disgrace of your master's house.
And I will push you from your office, and from your post he will tear you down.
And it will be in that day that I will summon my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah,

and I will clothe him with your tunic and make your sash firm on him, and I will put your authority into his hand; and he will become a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
And I will put the key of the house of David on his shoulder; and he will open, and none will shut; and he will shut, and none will open.
And I will drive him as a tent peg in a firm place; and he will become a seat of honour for his father's house.
And they will hang on him all the honour of his father's house — the descendants and the offshoots, all the small vessels, from the vessels of bowls to all the vessels of jars.

In that day — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — the tent peg driven in a firm place will be removed; and it will be cut down and fall, and the burden that was on it will be cut off; for YHWH has spoken.

isaiah_23.t: The oracle of Tyre. Wail, ships of Tarshish, for it is devastated — no house, no entering! From the land of Cyprus it was revealed to them.
Be silent, inhabitants of the coastland! The trader of Sidon, crossing the sea, has filled you.
And on many waters the grain of Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she became the traffic of nations.
Be ashamed, Sidon, for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying: I have not been in labour and I have not given birth; I have not brought up young men, nor raised virgins.
When the report reaches Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
Cross over to Tarshish! Wail, inhabitants of the coastland!
Is this your jubilant city, whose beginning is from days of antiquity, whose feet carried her far off to sojourn?
Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders were princes, whose merchants were the honoured of the earth?
YHWH of hosts has planned it, to profane the pride of all beauty, to bring into contempt all the honoured of the earth.
Cross over your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.
He has stretched out his hand over the sea; he has made kingdoms tremble. YHWH has commanded concerning Canaan to destroy her strongholds.
And he said: You will not exult again, oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will have no rest.
Behold, the land of the Chaldeans — this is the people that was not; Assyria allotted it to desert creatures. They raised up their siege towers, they stripped bare her palaces, they made her a ruin.
Wail, ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is devastated.
And it will be in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
Take a lyre, go about the city, forgotten prostitute! Play well, multiply song, so that you may be remembered.
And it will be at the end of seventy years that YHWH will visit Tyre, and she will return to her hire and will prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the earth on the face of the ground.

And her profit and her hire will be holy to YHWH. It will not be stored up and it will not be hoarded; for her profit will belong to those who dwell before YHWH, to eat to satiety and for magnificent covering.

isaiah_24.t: Behold, YHWH is laying the earth waste and devastating it; and he will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.

And it will be: as the people, so the priest; as the servant, so his master; as the maidservant, so her mistress; as the buyer, so the seller; as the lender, so the borrower; as the creditor, so the one who owes him.
Laying waste, the earth will be laid waste; plundering, it will be plundered. For YHWH has spoken this word.
The earth dries up and withers; the world languishes and withers; the heights of the people of the earth languish.
And the earth has been polluted under its inhabitants, for they have transgressed laws, overstepped the statute, broken the everlasting covenant.
Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and those who dwell in it are held guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth have dwindled, and few humans are left.
The new wine dries up, the vine languishes; all the joyful of heart groan.
The gaiety of tambourines has ceased; the uproar of the jubilant has stopped; the gaiety of the lyre has ceased.
They will not drink wine with song; strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
The town of emptiness is broken; every house is shut up from entering.
There is an outcry over wine in the streets; all joy has gone to evening; the gaiety of the earth has departed.
Desolation is left in the city, and the gate is crushed to ruin.
For so it will be in the midst of the earth, among the peoples: like the beating of an olive tree, like gleanings when the grape harvest is finished.
They lift up their voice, they shout for joy; over the majesty of YHWH they cry aloud from the sea.
Therefore in the east give glory to YHWH, in the coastlands of the sea the name of YHWH, the God of Israel.

From the edge of the earth we have heard songs: 'Glory to the righteous one!' And I said: Leanness to me, leanness to me! Alas for me! The treacherous act treacherously; with treachery the treacherous act treacherously.
Dread and pit and snare are upon you, inhabitant of the earth!

And it will be that the one fleeing from the sound of the dread will fall into the pit, and the one coming up from the midst of the pit will be caught in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth shake.
Breaking, the earth is broken; splitting, the earth is split; shaking, the earth is shaken.
Staggering, the earth staggers like a drunkard; it sways like a shelter; and its transgression is heavy upon it, and it falls and will not rise again.
And it will be in that day that YHWH will visit the host of the height on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
And they will be gathered together, a gathering of prisoners to a pit, and shut up in a prison; and after many days they will be punished.
And the moon will be abashed and the sun ashamed; for YHWH of hosts reigns on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before his elders — glory.

isaiah_25.t: YHWH, you are my God; I will exalt you, I will give thanks to your name, for you have done a wonder — plans from long ago, trustworthiness and sureness.
For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified town into a ruin; the fortress of strangers is no longer a city; it will never be rebuilt.
Therefore a strong people will honour you; the town of ruthless nations will fear you.

For you have been a refuge for the weak, a refuge for the needy in his distress, a shelter from the rainstorm, a shade from the heat; for the breath of the ruthless is like a rainstorm against a wall.
Like heat in a dry land you subdue the uproar of strangers; heat by the shade of a cloud — the song of the ruthless is quietened.
And YHWH of hosts will make for all the peoples on this mountain a feast of fat things, a feast of old wines, fat things full of marrow, old wines distilled.
And he will swallow up on this mountain the face of the covering that covers over all the peoples, and the woven veil woven over all the nations.
He will swallow up death for ever; and the Lord YHWH will wipe the tears from every face, and the reproach of his people he will remove from all the earth — for YHWH has spoken.
And one will say in that day: Behold, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he delivered us. This is YHWH; we have waited for him. Let us be glad and rejoice in his deliverance.
For the hand of YHWH will rest on this mountain; and Moab will be trampled down in its place, as straw is trampled down in a dung pit.
And he will spread out his hands in the midst of it as a swimmer spreads them out to swim; and he will bring low his haughtiness with the tricks of his hands.
And the fortification, the refuge of your walls, he will lay low; he will bring it low, he will bring it down to the ground, to the dust.

isaiah_26.t: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; he sets deliverance as walls and rampart.
Open the gates, that a righteous nation may enter, one that keeps faithfulness.
A firm inclination you keep in peace, peace, because it trusts in you.
Trust in YHWH for ever, for in Yah YHWH is an everlasting Rock.
For he has laid low those who dwell on high, the town set on high; he brings it low, he brings it low to the ground, he brings it down to the dust.
A foot will trample it — the feet of the poor, the footsteps of the weak.
The path of the righteous is level; upright one, you make level the track of the righteous.
Also in the path of your judgements, YHWH, we have waited for you; your name and your remembrance are the desire of the being.
My being has desired you in the night; yes, my spirit within me seeks you at dawn. For when your judgements are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
If the wicked is shown favour, he does not learn righteousness; in a land of straightforwardness he acts unjustly, and does not see the majesty of YHWH.
YHWH, your hand is raised, and they do not behold it. Let them behold and be ashamed of the zeal for your people; let the fire of your adversaries consume them.
YHWH, you will establish peace for us; for all our works also you have done for us.
YHWH our God, lords other than you have ruled over us; by you alone do we bring your name to remembrance.
The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and made all remembrance of them perish.
You have added to the nation, YHWH; you have added to the nation, you have gained glory; you have extended all the boundaries of the land.
YHWH, in distress they sought you; they poured out a whisper when your chastening was on them.
As a pregnant woman drawing near to give birth writhes and cries out in her labour pains, so were we before you, YHWH.
We were pregnant, we writhed — it was as if we gave birth to wind. We have accomplished no deliverance in the earth, and the inhabitants of the world have not fallen.
Your dead will live; my corpses will rise. Awake and shout for joy, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is a dew of lights, and the earth will make the departed spirits fall.
Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your door behind you; hide for a little moment until the indignation passes by.
For behold, YHWH is going out from his place to visit the iniquity of the inhabitant of the earth upon him; and the earth will disclose her blood and will no longer cover over her slain.

isaiah_27.t: In that day YHWH will visit, with his fierce and great and mighty sword, Leviathan the fleeing serpent, and Leviathan the twisting serpent; and he will slay the sea monster that is in the sea.
In that day: A vineyard of delight — sing of it!
I, YHWH, am its keeper; every moment I water it. Lest anyone injure it, night and day I guard it.
I have no rage. Who will give me thorns and briars in battle? I would march against it, I would burn it altogether.
Or let him take hold of my protection; let him make peace with me; peace let him make with me.
In the days to come Jacob will take root; Israel will blossom and bud, and they will fill the face of the world with fruit.
Has he struck him as he struck the one who struck him? Or has he been slain as his slain were slain?
By banishing, by sending her away, you conducted the case with her; he drove her out with his fierce wind in the day of the east wind.

Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be atoned for, and this is all the fruit of the removing of his sin: when he makes all the stones of the altar like pulverised chalkstones, no asherahs or incense altars will stand.
For the fortified city stands alone, a habitation deserted and forsaken like the wilderness. There a calf will graze, and there it will lie down and finish off its branches.

When its branches dry up they are broken off; women come and set light to them. For it is not a people of understanding; therefore the one who made it will not have compassion on it, and the one who formed it will not show it favour.
And it will be in that day that YHWH will beat out the grain from the flowing stream of the River to the Wadi of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, sons of Israel.

And it will be in that day that a great ram's horn will be blown; and those lost in the land of Assyria will come, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt; and they will bow down to YHWH on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

isaiah_28.t: Woe — the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and the withering flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of the valley of fat things, of those struck down with wine!
Behold, the Lord has one mighty and strong; like a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, like a storm of mighty overflowing waters, he will thrust it down to the ground with his hand.
With feet it will be trampled — the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim.

And the withering flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of the valley of fat things, will be like an early fig before summer: when the one who sees it sees it, while it is still in his hand he swallows it.
In that day YHWH of hosts will become a crown of beauty and a diadem of splendour for the remnant of his people,
and a spirit of justice for the one who sits in judgement, and might for those who turn back the battle at the gate.

And these too reel with wine and stagger with strong drink: priest and prophet reel with strong drink, they are confused by wine, they stagger from strong drink; they reel in vision, they totter in giving a decision.
For all the tables are full of vomit and filth, with no room left.
Whom will he teach knowledge? And whom will he make understand the message? Those weaned from milk, those taken from the breasts?
For it is tsav latsav tsav latsav, qav laqav qav laqav, ze'er sham ze'er sham.
For with stammering lips and another tongue he will speak to this people —
he who said to them: This is the resting place — give rest to the weary; and this is the place of repose. But they were not willing to listen.
And the word of YHWH will be to them tsav latsav tsav latsav, qav laqav qav laqav, ze'er sham ze'er sham — so that they may go and stumble backward and be broken, and be ensnared and captured.
Therefore hear the word of YHWH, men of mockery, rulers of this people who are in Jerusalem.

Because you have said: We have cut a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have made an agreement. The overflowing scourge, when it passes through, will not come to us, for we have made falsehood our refuge and hidden ourselves in deception.
Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone — a stone of testing, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation. The one who trusts will not hurry.
And I will make justice the measuring-line and righteousness the plummet; and hail will sweep away the refuge of falsehood, and waters will overflow the hiding place.
And your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. The overflowing scourge, when it passes through — you will become a trampling ground for it.
As often as it passes through it will take you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night. And it will be sheer terror to understand the message.
For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too narrow to wrap oneself in.
For YHWH will rise as at Mount Perazim; he will rage as in the valley at Gibeon, to do his deed — strange is his deed — and to work his work — alien is his work.
And now, do not mock, lest your fetters be made strong; for a complete destruction, and one decreed, I have heard from the Lord YHWH of hosts against all the land.
Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my speech.
Does the ploughman plough all day to sow? Does he keep loosening and harrowing his ground?
Does he not, when he has levelled its surface, scatter black cumin and sprinkle cumin, and set wheat in rows and barley in its place and spelt at its border?
And he instructs him in the right way; his God teaches him.
For black cumin is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over cumin; but black cumin is beaten out with a staff, and cumin with a rod.
Grain for bread is crushed; for he does not thresh it for ever. He drives the wheel of his cart and his horses over it, but he does not crush it.
This too comes from YHWH of hosts: he has made counsel wonderful, he has made sound wisdom great.

isaiah_29.t: Woe — Ariel, Ariel, the town where David encamped! Add year to year; let the festivals go round.
And I will bring distress to Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; and she will be to me like an Ariel.
And I will encamp in a circle against you, and I will lay siege against you with siege-works, and I will raise fortifications against you.

And you will be brought low; from the ground you will speak, and from the dust your speech will be humbled. And your voice will be like a ghost from the ground, and from the dust your speech will whisper.
And the multitude of your strangers will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff; and it will happen in an instant, suddenly.
From YHWH of hosts she will be visited, with thunder and earthquake and a great noise, storm and tempest and the flame of a devouring fire.
And the multitude of all the nations who wage war against Ariel will be like a dream, a vision of the night — all who wage war against her and her stronghold, and those who bring distress to her.

And it will be as when a hungry man dreams — and there, he is eating! — and he awakes and his being is empty; and as when a thirsty man dreams — and there, he is drinking! — and he awakes and there, he is faint, and his being is longing: so will be the multitude of all the nations who wage war against Mount Zion.
Delay and be astounded! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
For YHWH has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep; he has shut your eyes — the prophets — and covered your heads — the seers.
And the vision of the whole has become for you like the words of a sealed scroll, which people give to one who knows writing, saying: Read this, please. And he says: I cannot, for it is sealed.
And the scroll is given to one who does not know writing, saying: Read this, please. And he says: I do not know writing.

And the Lord said: Because this people has drawn near with its mouth and honoured me with its lips, while its heart is far from me, and their fear of me has become a commandment of men, learned by rote —
therefore, behold, I will again deal wonderfully with this people, wonderfully and a wonder; and the wisdom of its wise men will perish, and the understanding of its discerning men will hide itself.
Woe to those who go deep to hide a plan from YHWH, whose deeds are in a dark place, and who say: Who sees us? And who knows us?
Your perversity! Shall the potter be reckoned as the clay, that a thing made should say of its maker: He did not make me, and a thing formed say of the one who formed it: He has no understanding?
Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon turns into an orchard, and the orchard is reckoned as a forest?
And in that day the deaf will hear the words of a scroll, and out of gloom and out of darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
And the humble will add joy in YHWH, and the needy of humankind will be glad in the Holy One of Israel.
For the ruthless one will come to an end and the mocker will be finished, and all who lie in wait to do wrong will be cut off —
those who make a person out to be a sinner by a word, and lay a trap for the one who adjudicates in the gate, and turn the righteous aside with emptiness.
Therefore thus says YHWH to the house of Jacob, he who ransomed Abraham: Not now will Jacob be ashamed, and not now will his face grow pale.
For when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in his midst, they will regard my name as holy; and they will regard as holy the Holy One of Jacob, and will hold the God of Israel in awe.
And those who go astray in spirit will know understanding, and murmurers will learn instruction.

isaiah_30.t: Woe to stubborn children — the declaration of YHWH — who carry out a plan, but not from me, and pour out a libation, but not of my spirit, so as to add sin to sin;
who set out to go down to Egypt but have not consulted my mouth, to take refuge in the refuge of Pharaoh and to seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt.
And the refuge of Pharaoh will become shame for you, and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt, ignominy.
For his officials have been in Zoan, and his messengers have reached Hanes.
All are put to shame over a people who bring them no profit, no help and no profit, but shame and also reproach.

The oracle of the animals of the Negeb. Through a land of trouble and distress, of lioness and lion, viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the shoulders of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people who bring no profit.
And Egypt — futility and emptiness is their help. Therefore I have called this one: Rahab They-Sit-Still.
Now go, write it on a tablet with them, and inscribe it on a scroll, that it may be for a later day, for ever, to eternity.
For it is a people of rebellion, lying children, children who have not been willing to hear the law of YHWH;
who say to the seers: Do not see; and to the visionaries: Do not envision for us what is straight. Speak to us smooth things; envision deceptions.
Turn aside from the way; turn away from the path; make the Holy One of Israel cease from before us!
Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: Because you have rejected this word and have trusted in oppression and crookedness and leaned on it,
therefore this iniquity will be to you like a breach about to fall, a bulge in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly, in an instant.
And its breaking will be like the breaking of a potter's jar, smashed without pity, and among its fragments not a sherd will be found to snatch fire from a hearth or to scoop water from a cistern.
For thus says the Lord YHWH, the Holy One of Israel: In returning and rest you will be delivered; in quietness and in trust will be your might. But you were not willing.
And you said: No — on horses we will flee! Therefore you will flee. And: On swift ones we will ride! Therefore your pursuers will be swift.
A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will flee, until you are left like a flagstaff on the top of a mountain and like a standard on a hill.
And therefore YHWH waits to show you favour, and therefore he rises up to have compassion on you; for YHWH is a God of justice. How blessed are all who wait for him!
For a people will dwell in Zion, in Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely show you favour at the sound of your crying out; when he hears it, he will answer you.
And the Lord will give you the bread of distress and the water of oppression; but your Teacher will no longer hide himself, and your eyes will see your Teacher.
And your ears will hear a word behind you, saying: This is the way; walk in it — when you turn to the right and when you turn to the left.
And you will make unclean the plating of your silver images and the sheathing of your molten image of gold. You will throw them away like a menstrual rag; you will say to it: Filth!
And he will give rain for your seed with which you sow the ground, and bread, the produce of the ground, will be rich and fat; in that day your livestock will graze in a broad pasture.
And the cattle and the donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder, which has been winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
And on every high mountain and on every lifted hill there will be streams, watercourses of water, on the day of great slaughter, when towers fall.

And the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, like the light of seven days, on the day YHWH binds up the fracture of his people and heals the wound of his blow.
Behold, the name of YHWH comes from afar, his anger burning and heavy with rising smoke; his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is like a devouring fire.
And his breath is like an overflowing torrent that reaches up to the neck, to sift the nations in a sieve of worthlessness, and a misleading bridle is on the jaws of the peoples.
The song will be yours as on a night when a festival is consecrated, and gladness of heart as when one walks with the flute to go to the mountain of YHWH, to the Rock of Israel.
And YHWH will make the grandeur of his voice heard, and will show the descent of his arm in raging anger and the flame of a devouring fire, in driving storm and rainstorm and hailstones.
For at the voice of YHWH Assyria will be shattered; he will strike with the rod.
And every stroke of the appointed staff that YHWH lays on it will be with tambourines and lyres; and with battles of brandishing he will fight against them.

For a place of burning has long been arranged; it too has been prepared for the king. He has made it deep and wide; its pyre is fire and much wood. The breath of YHWH, like a torrent of sulphur, sets it ablaze.

isaiah_31.t: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and lean on horses, and trust in chariotry because it is many and in horsemen because they are exceedingly numerous; but they do not look to the Holy One of Israel and do not seek YHWH.
But he too is wise, and he has brought evil; and his words he has not turned aside. And he will rise against the house of evildoers and against the help of those who do wrong.

And Egypt is humankind and not God, and their horses are flesh and not spirit. And YHWH will stretch out his hand, and the helper will stumble and the helped will fall, and together all of them will come to an end.

For thus YHWH said to me: As a lion growls, a young lion over its prey, when a whole band of shepherds is summoned against it — at their voice it is not dismayed, and at their tumult it does not cringe — so YHWH of hosts will come down to wage war on Mount Zion and on its hill.
Like birds flying, so YHWH of hosts will shield Jerusalem; shielding and rescuing, passing over and bringing to safety.
Return to him from whom you have deeply turned away, sons of Israel!
For in that day everyone will reject his idols of silver and his idols of gold, which your hands have made for you as sin.
And Assyria will fall by a sword not of a man, and a sword not of humankind will devour it; and it will flee from before a sword, and its young men will become forced labour.
And its rock will pass away from terror, and its commanders will be dismayed at a standard — the declaration of YHWH, whose fire is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

isaiah_32.t: Behold, a king will reign for righteousness, and officials will rule for justice.
And each will be like a hiding place from the wind and a shelter from the rainstorm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a heavy rock in a weary land.
And the eyes of those who see will not be closed, and the ears of those who hear will pay attention.
And the heart of the hasty will understand knowledge, and the tongue of stammerers will hasten to speak clearly.
A fool will no longer be called noble, and a scoundrel will not be said to be eminent.
For a fool speaks folly, and his heart does wrong: doing godlessness, and speaking error concerning YHWH, leaving the being of the hungry empty, and depriving the thirsty of drink.
And a scoundrel — his weapons are evil; he plans wicked schemes, to ruin the poor with sayings of falsehood even when the needy speaks what is just.
But a noble plans noble things, and on noble things he stands.
Carefree women, rise up, hear my voice! Confident daughters, give ear to my speech!
In a year and some days you will be agitated, you confident ones; for the grape harvest will fail, the gathering will not come.
Tremble, you carefree ones! Be agitated, you confident ones! Strip off and make yourselves bare, and gird sackcloth on your loins!
Beating the breasts, for the fields of delight, for the fruitful vine —
on the ground of my people, where thorn and thornbush come up; yes, on all the houses of gaiety in the jubilant town.
For the palace will be forsaken, the tumult of the city abandoned; the hill and the watchtower will become bare places for ever, a gaiety of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks —
until a spirit is poured out on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes an orchard, and the orchard is reckoned a forest.
And justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness will remain in the orchard.
And the work of righteousness will be peace, and the labour of righteousness, quietness and security for ever.
And my people will dwell in a habitation of peace, in dwelling places of security, and in undisturbed resting places.
And it will hail when the forest comes down, and the city will be brought utterly low.
How blessed are you who sow beside every water, who let the foot of the ox and the donkey range free!

isaiah_33.t: Woe, destroyer, and you yourself not destroyed; traitor, and none has dealt treacherously with you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; when you have done with dealing treacherously, they will deal treacherously with you.
YHWH, show us favour; for you we have waited. Be their arm every morning, and our deliverance in a time of distress.
At the sound of tumult peoples flee; at your rising, nations scatter.
And your plunder will be gathered as the locust gathers; as locusts rush, so they will rush upon it.
YHWH is exalted, for he dwells on high; he fills Zion with justice and righteousness.
And he will be the trustworthiness of your times, a wealth of deliverance, wisdom and knowledge; the fear of YHWH — that is his treasure.
Behold, their valiant ones cry out in the streets; the messengers of peace weep bitterly.
The highways are desolate; the traveller on the path has ceased. He has broken a covenant, rejected cities; he has valued no human being.
The land dries up and languishes; Lebanon is shamed and withers; Sharon has become like the desert plain, and Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.
Now I will arise, says YHWH; now I will exalt myself; now I will lift myself up.
You conceive dry grass; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
And peoples will be burnings of lime, thorns cut down that are kindled in the fire.
Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and know, you who are near, my might.
Sinners in Zion are in dread; trembling has seized the godless: Who among us can sojourn with a devouring fire? Who among us can sojourn with everlasting hearths?

The one who walks in righteousness and speaks uprightly, who rejects the gain of extortions, who shakes his hands free from taking hold of a bribe, who stops his ear from hearing of bloodshed and shuts his eyes from looking on evil —
he will dwell on the heights; the strongholds of the rocks will be his refuge; his bread will be given, his water reliable.
Your eyes will behold a king in his beauty; they will see a land of far distances.
Your heart will meditate on the terror: Where is the one who counted? Where is the one who weighed? Where is the one who counted the towers?
You will not see the barbarous people, a people too unintelligible of speech to hear, stammering of tongue, without understanding.

Look on Zion, the town of our appointed times! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, an undisturbed habitation, a tent that will not be packed up, whose tent pegs will never be pulled out, and none of whose ropes will be torn apart.
But there the majestic YHWH will be for us a place of rivers, of broad canals, where no rowing ship will go and no majestic vessel will pass.
For YHWH is our judge; YHWH is our lawgiver; YHWH is our king — he will deliver us.
Your ropes hang loose; they do not hold firm the base of their mast; they have not spread out the sail. Then abundant booty of plunder will be divided; the lame will take spoil.
And no inhabitant will say: I am sick. The people who dwell in her will be forgiven of iniquity.

isaiah_34.t: Draw near, nations, to hear; and peoples, pay attention! Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that comes from it.
For YHWH has wrath against all the nations and rage against all their host; he has devoted them to destruction, given them over to slaughter.
And their slain will be thrown out, and the stench of their corpses will go up, and the mountains will melt with their blood.
And all the host of the heavens will rot away, and the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll; and all their host will wither as leafage withers from a vine, and like withered fruit from a fig tree.
For my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people I have devoted to destruction, for judgement.

A sword belongs to YHWH; it is full of blood, it is gorged with fat — with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For YHWH has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
And wild oxen will go down with them, and young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will drink its fill of blood, and their dust will be gorged with fat.
For YHWH has a day of vengeance, a year of retribution for the cause of Zion.
And her torrents will be turned into pitch, and her dust into sulphur; and her land will become burning pitch.
Night and day it will not be extinguished; its smoke will go up for ever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; for ever and ever none will pass through it.
And the desert owl and the hedgehog will possess it, and the great owl and the raven will dwell in it. And he will stretch over it a measuring-line of emptiness and the plumb-stones of emptiness.
Her nobles — there is no kingship there to proclaim — and all her princes will be nothing.
And thorns will grow up in her fortresses, nettles and thornbushes in her fortifications; and she will become a habitation of jackals, grass for the daughters of the ostrich.
And desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and the goat-demon will call to its companion. Surely there Lilith will rest and find for herself a resting place.
There the owl will nest and lay, and hatch and gather her brood in her shadow. Surely there the kites will be gathered, each with her companion.
Seek from the scroll of YHWH and read: not one of these will be missing; none will miss her companion. For his mouth — it has commanded, and his spirit — it has gathered them.
And he himself has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it out to them by the measuring-line. For ever they will possess it; from generation to generation they will dwell in it.

isaiah_35.t: The wilderness and the dry region will rejoice over them, and the desert plain will be glad and bud like a crocus.

It will bud abundantly and be glad — yes, with gladness and shouting for joy! The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the magnificence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of YHWH, the splendour of our God.
Strengthen the slack hands, and make firm the stumbling knees.
Say to those hasty of heart: Be strong, do not be afraid! Behold, your God — vengeance will come, the requital of God; he himself will come and deliver you.
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
Then the lame will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will shout for joy; for waters will burst forth in the wilderness, and torrents in the desert plain.
And the parched ground will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water; in the habitation of jackals, their resting place, there will be grass for reeds and papyrus.
And there will be a highway there, and a way, and it will be called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not pass along it; it is for them — one who walks the way, even fools, will not go astray.
No lion will be there, and no ravening beast will go up on it; it will not be found there. And the redeemed will walk there.
And the ransomed of YHWH will return and come to Zion with a shout of joy, and everlasting joy will be on their head. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

isaiah_36.t: And it was in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and seized them.

And the king of Assyria sent the chief commander from Lachish to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a massive army; and he stood at the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the Launderer's Field.
And there went out to him Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder.
And the chief commander said to them: Say now to Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: What is this trust in which you trust?
I say — only a word of the lips! — that there is plan and might for the war. Now, in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
Behold, you trust in the staff of this crushed reed, in Egypt, which, if a man leans on it, will go into his palm and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
And if you say to me: We trust in YHWH our God — is he not the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem: Before this altar you shall bow down?
And now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria, and let me give you two thousand horses — if you are able to put riders on them!
And how will you turn back the face of one governor of the least of my master's servants, when you have been relying on Egypt for chariotry and for horsemen?
And now, is it apart from YHWH that I have come up against this land to destroy it? YHWH said to me: Go up against this land and destroy it.

And Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the chief commander: Speak, please, to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Judean in the ears of the people who are on the city wall.

And the chief commander said: Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you, and not to the men sitting on the city wall, who are to eat their own excrement and drink the water of their own feet with you?
And the chief commander stood and called out with a great voice in Judean and said: Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
Thus says the king: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to rescue you.
And do not let Hezekiah make you trust in YHWH, saying: YHWH will surely rescue us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

Do not listen to Hezekiah. For thus says the king of Assyria: Make a blessing with me and come out to me, and each of you will eat of his own vine and his own fig tree, and each will drink the water of his own cistern,
until I come and take you to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
Do not let Hezekiah mislead you, saying: YHWH will rescue us. Have the gods of the nations rescued, any of them, his own land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? And have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
Who among all the gods of these lands are those who have rescued their land from my hand, that YHWH should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?
And they kept silent and did not answer him a word, for the king's commandment was: Do not answer him.

And Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their garments torn, and told him the words of the chief commander.

isaiah_37.t: And it was, when King Hezekiah heard, that he tore his garments and covered himself with sackcloth and went into the house of YHWH.
And he sent Eliakim, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet.
And they said to him: Thus says Hezekiah: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and insult; for children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to bring them out.

Perhaps YHWH your God will hear the words of the chief commander, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to taunt the living God, and will rebuke the words that YHWH your God has heard. So lift up a prayer for the remnant that is found.
And the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
And Isaiah said to them: Thus you shall say to your master: Thus says YHWH: Do not be afraid because of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Behold, I am putting a spirit in him, and he will hear a report and return to his own land; and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.
And the chief commander returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.
And he heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush: He has come out to do battle with you. And he heard, and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying:
Thus you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let your God, in whom you are trusting, deceive you, saying: Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Behold, you yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, devoting them to destruction. And will you be rescued?
Did the gods of the nations rescue them — the nations my fathers destroyed: Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?
Where is the king of Hamath and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena and Ivvah?
And Hezekiah took the letters from the hand of the messengers and read them; and he went up to the house of YHWH, and Hezekiah spread them out before YHWH.
And Hezekiah prayed to YHWH, saying:
YHWH of hosts, God of Israel, who sits upon the cherubim: you alone are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made the heavens and the earth.
Incline your ear, YHWH, and hear! Open your eyes, YHWH, and see! And hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to taunt the living God.
Truly, YHWH, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the lands and their land,
and have put their gods into the fire — for they were not gods, but the work of human hands, wood and stone — and they destroyed them.
And now, YHWH our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone are YHWH.
And Isaiah son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying: Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria —
this is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: She despises you, she mocks you — the virgin daughter of Zion; behind you she shakes her head — the daughter of Jerusalem.
Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

By the hand of your servants you have taunted the Lord, and have said: With the abundance of my chariotry I have gone up to the heights of the mountains, to the remotest parts of Lebanon; and I will cut down its tallest cedars, its choicest pines, and come to its farthest height, its densest forest.
I myself have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the canals of Egypt.
Have you not heard? Long ago I did it; from days of antiquity I formed it; now I have brought it to pass, that you should make fortified cities crash into ruined heaps.

And their inhabitants were short of hand; they were dismayed and ashamed. They were the vegetation of the field, the green of growing things, grass of the roofs, and a field before the standing grain.
And your sitting down and your going out and your coming in I know, and your raging against me.
Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle on your lips, and I will turn you back by the way you came.

And this will be the sign for you: this year you will eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
And the escaped of the house of Judah that remains will again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
For from Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and the escaped from Mount Zion. The zeal of YHWH of hosts will do this.

Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the king of Assyria: He will not come into this city, and will not shoot an arrow there; and he will not confront it with a shield, and will not pour out a siege mound against it.
By the way he came he will return, and into this city he will not come — the declaration of YHWH.
And I will shield this city, to deliver it, for my own sake and for the sake of David my servant.
And the messenger of YHWH went out and struck down in the camp of Assyria a hundred and eighty-five thousand; and they rose early in the morning, and there they all were — dead corpses.
And Sennacherib king of Assyria set out and went and returned, and remained in Nineveh.

And it was, while he was bowing down in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him down with the sword; and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.

isaiah_38.t: In those days Hezekiah became sick to the point of death. And Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet came to him and said to him: Thus says YHWH: Give orders to your household, for you are about to die and will not live.
And Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH.
And he said: Please, YHWH, remember how I have walked before you in faithfulness and with a whole heart, and have done what is good in your eyes. And Hezekiah wept a great weeping.
And the word of YHWH came to Isaiah, saying:
Go and say to Hezekiah: Thus says YHWH, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I am adding fifteen years to your days.
And I will rescue you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will shield this city.
And this will be the sign for you from YHWH, that YHWH will do this thing that he has spoken:
Behold, I am turning back the shadow of the steps, which has gone down on the steps of Ahaz with the sun, backward ten steps. And the sun went back ten steps on the steps by which it had gone down.
A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he was sick and recovered from his sickness.
I said: In the quiet of my days I must go into the gates of Sheol; I am deprived of the remainder of my years.
I said: I shall not see Yah, Yah in the land of the living; I shall not look on humankind any more with the inhabitants of the world that ceases.
My dwelling is pulled up and removed from me like a shepherd's tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver; he cuts me off from the loom. From day to night you make an end of me.
I have composed myself until morning; like a lion, so he breaks all my bones. From day to night you make an end of me.
Like a swift or a crane, so I chirp; I moan like a dove. My eyes are worn out looking to the heights. Lord, I am oppressed — be my surety!
What can I say? He has spoken to me, and he himself has acted. I shall walk slowly all my years because of the bitterness of my being.
Lord, by these things people live, and in all of them is the life of my spirit. So restore me to health and keep me alive.
Behold, it was for my welfare that I was bitterly embittered; but you have loved my being back from the pit of destruction, for you have thrown all my sins behind your back.
For Sheol does not give you thanks; death does not praise you; those who go down to the pit do not hope for your faithfulness.
The living, the living — he gives you thanks, as I do this day. A father makes known to children your faithfulness.
YHWH is at hand to deliver me; and we will play my songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives, at the house of YHWH.
And Isaiah had said: Let them take a cake of figs and rub it on the boil, and he will live.
And Hezekiah had said: What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of YHWH?

isaiah_39.t: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard that he had been sick and had grown strong.

And Hezekiah was pleased over them, and showed them his treasure house — the silver and the gold and the spices and the good oil and his whole armoury, and everything that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him: What did these men say, and where do they come to you from? And Hezekiah said: They have come to me from a distant land, from Babylon.
And he said: What did they see in your house? And Hezekiah said: They saw everything that is in my house. There was nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them.
And Isaiah said to Hezekiah: Hear the word of YHWH of hosts!
Behold, days are coming when everything in your house, and what your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will remain, says YHWH.
And some of your own sons who come from you, whom you will father, will be taken; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah: The word of YHWH that you have spoken is good. And he said: For there will be peace and faithfulness in my days.

isaiah_40.t: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
Speak to the heart of Jerusalem and proclaim to her that her service is completed, that her iniquity is accepted, that she has received from the hand of YHWH double for all her sins.
A voice calling: In the wilderness clear the way of YHWH; make straight in the desert plain a highway for our God.
Every valley will be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; and the steep place will become level ground, and the rough places a plain.
And the glory of YHWH will be revealed, and all flesh together will see it; for the mouth of YHWH has spoken.
A voice saying: Proclaim! And he said: What shall I proclaim? All flesh is grass, and all its beauty is like the flower of the field.
The grass dries up, the flower withers, for the wind of YHWH blows on it. Truly the people is grass.
The grass dries up, the flower withers, but the word of our God will stand for ever.
Go up on a high mountain, bearer of news to Zion; lift up your voice with strength, bearer of news to Jerusalem! Lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the cities of Judah: Behold, your God!
Behold, the Lord YHWH comes with strength, and his arm rules for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
Like a shepherd he will shepherd his flock; in his arm he will gather the lambs and carry them in his bosom; he will lead the nursing ewes.

Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the heavens with a span, and held the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in a balance and the hills in scales?
Who has directed the spirit of YHWH, or as the man of his counsel has informed him?
With whom did he take counsel, and who gave him understanding and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge and made known to him the way of understanding?
Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and are reckoned like the dust on the scales. Behold, he lifts the coastlands like fine dust.
And Lebanon is not enough for burning, and its animals not enough for a burnt offering.
All the nations are as nothing before him; they are reckoned by him as less than nothingness and emptiness.
To whom then will you liken God? And what likeness will you set beside him?
The image — a craftsman casts it, and a refiner overlays it with gold and refines chains of silver.
The one too poor for such an offering chooses wood that will not rot; he seeks out for himself a skilled craftsman to set up an image that will not totter.
Do you not know? Do you not hear? Has it not been told to you from the beginning? Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?
It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain and spreads them like a tent to dwell in;
who brings rulers to nothing and makes the judges of the earth like emptiness.
Scarcely are they planted, scarcely are they sown, scarcely has their stock taken root in the ground, when he blows on them and they dry up, and a tempest carries them off like stubble.
To whom then will you liken me, that I should be equal? says the Holy One.

Lift up your eyes on high and see: who created these? He who brings out their host by number, calling them all by name; by the greatness of his might and the strength of his power, not one is missing.
Why do you say, Jacob, and declare, Israel: My way is hidden from YHWH, and my justice passes away from my God?
Do you not know? Have you not heard? YHWH is the everlasting God, the creator of the ends of the earth. He does not grow faint and does not grow weary; there is no searching out his understanding.
He gives strength to the faint, and to those with no vigour he increases might.
Youths grow faint and weary, and young men utterly stumble;
but those who wait for YHWH will renew their strength; they will go up on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary; they will walk and not grow faint.
