isaiah_41.t: Be silent to me, coastlands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them draw near, then let them speak; together let us come near for judgement.
Who stirred up from the east — in righteousness he calls him to his foot? He gives up nations before him and subdues kings; he makes them like dust by his sword, like driven stubble by his bow.
He pursues them; he passes on in peace, by a path his feet have not travelled.
Who has done it and accomplished it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, YHWH, am first, and with the last ones — I am he.
The coastlands have seen and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble; they have drawn near and come.
Each helps his neighbour, and to his brother he says: Be strong!
And the craftsman encouraged the refiner, the one who smooths with the hammer him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering: It is good. And he strengthened it with nails; it will not be shaken.
But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend —
you whom I took hold of from the ends of the earth and called from its remotest parts, and I said to you: You are my servant, I have chosen you and have not rejected you.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you; do not look about, for I am your God. I have strengthened you, I have also helped you, I have also supported you with the right hand of my righteousness.
See, all who are angry with you will be ashamed and put to shame; those who contend with you will be as nothing and will perish.
You will seek them and not find them, those who strive with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as nothingness.
For I am YHWH your God, who takes hold of your right hand, who says to you: Do not be afraid, I myself will help you.
Do not be afraid, worm Jacob, men of Israel! I myself will help you, the declaration of YHWH, and your redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
See, I have made you a threshing-sledge, sharp, new, an owner of teeth. You will thresh mountains and crush them, and make hills like chaff.
You will winnow them, and a wind will carry them away, and a tempest will scatter them. And you will be glad in YHWH; in the Holy One of Israel you will boast.
The poor and the needy are seeking water, and there is none; their tongue is dry with thirst. I, YHWH, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry region springs of water.
I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle and the tree of oil. I will set in the desert plain the juniper, the plane and the cypress together.
so that they may see and know, and set it to heart and have insight together, that the hand of YHWH has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
Bring near your case, says YHWH; bring forward your arguments, says the King of Jacob.
Let them bring them near and tell us what will happen. The former things — what were they? Tell us, and let us set our heart and know their outcome; or make us hear the things that are coming.
Tell us the things coming afterwards, and we will know that you are gods. Yes — do good or do harm, and let us look about and see together.
See, you are from nothing, and your work is from nothingness. An abomination is the one who chooses you.
I have stirred up one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun he will call on my name. And he will come on officials as on mud, and as a potter tramples clay.

Who told it from the beginning, that we might know, and beforehand, that we might say: He is right? No — there was none who told; no — there was none who proclaimed; no — there was none who heard your sayings.
First to Zion — See, see them! and to Jerusalem I gave a bearer of news.
And I look, and there is no one; and among these there is no counsellor, that I might ask them and they return a word.
See, all of them — deception; their deeds are nothingness; wind and emptiness are their cast images.

isaiah_42.t: See, my servant, whom I support, my chosen one, in whom my being is pleased. I have put my spirit on him; he will bring forth judgement to the nations.
He will not cry out and will not lift up, and will not make his voice heard in the street.
A crushed reed he will not break, and a dim wick he will not extinguish; in faithfulness he will bring forth judgement.
He will not grow dim and will not be crushed until he establishes judgement on the earth; and for his law the coastlands hope.
Thus says the God, YHWH, who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and what it brings forth, who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk on it:
I, YHWH, have called you in righteousness, and I will take hold of your hand; and I will watch over you and make you a covenant of the people, a light of the nations,
to open blind eyes, to bring the prisoner out from the prison, from the house of imprisonment those who dwell in darkness.
I am YHWH — that is my name; and my glory I will not give to another, nor my praise to images.
The former things — see, they have come; and new things I am telling. Before they spring up I make you hear them.
Sing to YHWH a new song, his praise from the end of the earth — you who go down to the sea and what fills it, the coastlands and those who dwell in them.
Let the wilderness and its cities lift up, the villages where Kedar dwells. Let the inhabitants of Sela shout for joy; from the top of the mountains let them cry aloud.
Let them give glory to YHWH, and declare his praise in the coastlands.
YHWH will go forth like a warrior; like a man of wars he will stir up zeal. He will raise a war-cry, yes, he will shout; against his enemies he will prevail.
I have been silent from of old; I have kept still, I have restrained myself. Like a woman giving birth I groan; I gasp and pant together.
I will lay waste mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn rivers into coastlands and dry up the pools.

And I will lead the blind by a way they have not known; in paths they have not known I will guide them. I will turn the dark place before them into light, and the rough places into level ground. These are the things I will do, and I will not abandon them.
They are turned back, utterly put to shame, those who trust in the image, those who say to a molten image: You are our gods.
You deaf, listen! And you blind, look, to see!
Who is blind but my servant, and deaf like my messenger whom I send? Who is blind like my dedicated one, and blind like the servant of YHWH?
You have seen many things, but do not keep them; ears are open, but he does not listen.
YHWH was pleased, for the sake of his righteousness, to make law great and glorious.

But this is a people despoiled and plundered; all of them are trapped in holes and hidden in houses of imprisonment. They have become spoil, and there is no rescuer; plunder, and there is no one who says: Bring it back.
Who among you will give ear to this, will pay attention and listen for the time to come?
Who gave Jacob to plunder, and Israel to despoilers? Was it not YHWH, against whom we have sinned? And they were not willing to walk in his ways, and they did not listen to his law.
So he poured out on him the rage of his anger and the fierceness of battle. It set him ablaze all round, and he did not know; it burned in him, and he did not set it to heart.

isaiah_43.t: And now, thus says YHWH, who created you, Jacob, and who formed you, Israel: Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name — you are mine.
When you pass through the waters, I am with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through fire you will not be scorched, and flame will not burn in you.
For I am YHWH your God, the Holy One of Israel, your deliverer. I have given Egypt as your ransom price, Cush and Seba in place of you.
Because you are precious in my eyes, you are honoured, and I myself love you; and I give humankind in place of you, and peoples in place of your being.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you. From the east I will bring your offspring, and from the west I will gather you.
I will say to the north: Give up! and to the south: Do not withhold! Bring my sons from far off, and my daughters from the end of the earth —
everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed, whom I also made.
Bring out a people that is blind, though it has eyes, and deaf, though they have ears.

All the nations have assembled together, and the peoples have gathered. Who among them declares this, and makes us hear the former things? Let them bring their witnesses and be justified; and let them hear and say: It is faithfulness.

You are my witnesses, the declaration of YHWH, and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and perceive that I am he. Before me no god was formed, and after me there will be none.
I, I am YHWH, and apart from me there is no deliverer.
I declared and delivered and made heard, and there was no strange god among you; and you are my witnesses, the declaration of YHWH, and I am God.
Also, from the day on, I am he, and there is no one who rescues from my hand. I act, and who will turn it back?
Thus says YHWH, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon and brought down all of them as fugitives, and the Chaldeans in the ships of their shout of joy.
I am YHWH, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
Thus says YHWH, who makes a way in the sea and a path in mighty waters;
who brings out chariot and horse, army and mighty one together. They lie down, they do not rise; they are extinguished, quenched like a wick.
Do not remember the former things, and do not consider the ancient things.
See, I am doing a new thing; now it springs up — do you not know it? I will indeed make a way in the wilderness, rivers in the wasteland.
The animal of the field will honour me, jackals and daughters of the ostrich, because I have put water in the wilderness, rivers in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen one.
The people I formed for myself will recount my praise.
But you have not called on me, Jacob, for you have grown weary of me, Israel.
You have not brought me the sheep of your burnt offerings, and with your sacrifices you have not honoured me. I have not burdened you with offering, and I have not made you weary with frankincense.
You have not bought me sweet cane with money, and with the fat of your sacrifices you have not satisfied me. Rather, you have burdened me with your sins; you have made me weary with your iniquities.
I, I am he who wipes out your transgressions for my own sake, and your sins I will not remember.
Make me remember; let us enter into judgement together. Recount, you yourself, so that you may be justified.
Your first ancestor sinned, and your spokesmen transgressed against me.
So I profaned the officials of holiness, and gave Jacob over to be devoted to destruction, and Israel to reviling.

isaiah_44.t: And now listen, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
Thus says YHWH, who made you and formed you from the belly, who helps you: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, and Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
For I will pour water on the thirsty ground and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my spirit on your offspring and my blessing on your descendants.
And they will spring up in among the grass, like poplars by watercourses of water.
This one will say: I belong to YHWH; and this one will call by the name of Jacob; and this one will write on his hand: Belonging to YHWH, and will name himself by the name of Israel.
Thus says YHWH, the King of Israel, and its redeemer, YHWH of hosts: I am first and I am last, and apart from me there is no god.

And who is like me? Let him proclaim, and let him declare it and set it in order before me, since I established an ancient people; and the things coming, and the things that will come — let them declare to them.
Do not dread and do not be afraid. Did I not make you hear it from long ago and declare it? And you are my witnesses. Is there a god apart from me? And there is no Rock — I know none.
Those who form an image are all of them emptiness, and their desired things confer no profit; and their own witnesses see nothing and know nothing, so that they may be ashamed.
Who has formed a god or cast an image that confers no profit?
See, all his companions will be ashamed, and the craftsmen — they are from humankind. Let them all gather together, let them stand; let them dread, let them be ashamed together.

The craftsman in iron — a tool; and he works it on the coals and forms it with hammers, and works it with the arm of his strength. He is even hungry, and there is no strength; he has drunk no water, and he grows weary.

The craftsman in wood stretches out a measuring-line; he outlines it with a marker; he works it with scraping tools and outlines it with a compass. And he makes it like the form of a man, like the splendour of humankind, to dwell in a house.
cutting down cedars for himself, and he took a cypress and an oak and let it grow strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a cedar, and the rain makes it grow.

And it becomes something for a person to burn: he takes some of it and warms himself; he also kindles a fire and bakes bread; he also makes a god and bows down; he makes it an image and prostrates himself to it.
Half of it he burns in a fire; over half of it he eats meat; he roasts a roast and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says: Aha! I am warm; I have seen a fire.
And the remainder of it he makes into a god, into his image; he prostrates himself to it and bows down and prays to it and says: Rescue me, for you are my god.
They do not know and do not understand, for their eyes are besmeared from seeing, their hearts from having insight.

And no one brings it back to his heart, and there is no knowledge and no understanding, to say: Half of it I burned in a fire, and I also baked bread on its coals; I roast meat and eat. And shall I make the remainder of it into an abomination? Shall I prostrate myself to a block of wood?
He feeds on ashes; a deceived heart has turned him aside, and he will not rescue his being and will not say: Is there not a lie in my right hand?
Remember these things, Jacob, and Israel, for you are my servant. I formed you; you are a servant of mine. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
I have wiped out your transgressions like a dark cloud, and your sins like a cloud. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

Shout for joy, heavens, for YHWH has acted! Shout in triumph, depths of the earth! Break forth in a shout of joy, mountains, forest and every tree in it! For YHWH has redeemed Jacob, and in Israel he will get glory for himself.
Thus says YHWH, your redeemer, and the one who formed you from the belly: I am YHWH, who makes everything, who stretches out the heavens alone, who spreads out the earth — from with myself.
who frustrates the signs of empty talkers and makes diviners look foolish, who turns wise ones backwards and makes their knowledge foolish;

who establishes the word of his servant and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem: It will be inhabited, and of the cities of Judah: They will be rebuilt, and its waste places I will raise up;
who says to the deep: Be dried up, and your rivers I will make dry;
who says of Cyrus: My shepherd, and all my desire he will perform; and who says of Jerusalem: Let it be rebuilt, and of the temple: Let it be refounded.

isaiah_45.t: Thus says YHWH to his anointed one, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have taken hold of, to subdue nations before him and to loosen the loins of kings, to open doors before him and gates that will not be shut:
I myself will go before you and make the mountainous places smooth. I will break doors of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
And I will give you treasures of darkness and hidden hoards of secret places, so that you may know that I am YHWH, who calls you by your name — the God of Israel.
For the sake of my servant Jacob and Israel my chosen one, I called you by your name; I gave you a title, though you do not know me.
I am YHWH, and there is no other; besides me there is no god. I gird you, though you do not know me,
so that they may know, from the rising of the sun and from its setting, that there is nothing apart from me. I am YHWH, and there is no other;
who forms light and creates darkness, who makes peace and creates evil. I am YHWH, who does all these things.

Drip down, heavens, from above, and let the clouds flow with righteousness. Let the earth open, and let them bear the fruit of deliverance, and let it make righteousness sprout together. I, YHWH, have created it.
Woe to the one who contends with the one who formed him — a potsherd among the potsherds of the ground! Does the clay say to the one who forms it: What are you making? And: Your work has no hands?
Woe to the one who says to a father: What are you fathering? and to a woman: What are you in labour with?
Thus says YHWH, the Holy One of Israel and the one who formed it: Ask me the things that are coming! Concerning my children and concerning the work of my hands, would you command me?
I myself made the earth and created humankind on it. I — my hands stretched out the heavens, and all their host I commanded.
I myself have stirred him up in righteousness, and all his ways I will make smooth. He will build my city and send out my exiles, not for a price and not for a bribe, says YHWH of hosts.

Thus says YHWH: The produce of Egypt and the traffic of Cush and the Sabeans, men of stature — they will pass over to you and will be yours; they will walk behind you; in fetters they will pass over; and to you they will bow down, to you they will pray: Only among you is God, and there is no other; there are no gods.
Truly you are a God who hides himself, God of Israel, deliverer.
They are ashamed and also put to shame, all of them; they walk in ignominy together — the craftsmen of effigies.
Israel has been delivered by YHWH with an everlasting deliverance. You will not be ashamed and will not be put to shame for ever and ever.

For thus says YHWH, the creator of the heavens — he is God — the one who formed the earth and made it; he established it; he did not create it an emptiness; he formed it to be dwelt in: I am YHWH, and there is no other.
I did not speak in secret, in a place of a land of darkness. I did not say to the offspring of Jacob: Seek me in emptiness. I, YHWH, speak righteousness, declaring uprightness.
Gather together and come; draw near together, fugitives of the nations! They do not know — those who carry the wood of their image and pray to a god that cannot deliver.

Declare and bring near; yes, let them take counsel together. Who made this heard from of old, declared it from long ago? Was it not I, YHWH? And there is no god apart from me — a righteous God and a deliverer; there is none besides me.
Turn to me and be delivered, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
By myself I have sworn; righteousness has gone out from my mouth, a word that will not return: that to me every knee will bend, every tongue will swear.
Only in YHWH, one will say of me, are righteousness and power. To him will come and be ashamed all who are angry with him.
In YHWH all the offspring of Israel will be justified and will boast.

isaiah_46.t: Bel has bent down; Nebo is stooping low. Their figures are for the animal and for the cattle. The things you carried are loaded up, a load for a weary beast.
They have stooped low, they have bent down together; they could not bring the load to safety, and their own being has gone into captivity.
Listen to me, house of Jacob and all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been carried from the belly, borne from the womb.
And until old age I am he, and until grey hair I will carry. I myself made, and I myself will bear; and I will carry and bring to safety.
To whom will you liken me and make me equal, and compare me, that we should be alike?
Those who pour out gold from a bag and weigh silver on the scale — they hire a refiner, and he makes it a god; they prostrate themselves; they also bow down.

They lift it on a shoulder; they carry it and set it down in its place, and it stands; from its place it does not move. Even if one cries out to it, it does not answer; from his distress it does not deliver him.
Remember this and pluck up courage; bring it back to heart, transgressors.
Remember the former things from of old: that I am God and there is no other, God, and there is nothing like me;
declaring the end from the beginning, and from of old the things that have not been done; saying: My plan will stand, and all my desire I will do —
calling a bird of prey from the east, from a distant land the man of my plan. I have also spoken; I will also bring it about. I have formed it; I will also do it.
Listen to me, you mighty of heart, far from righteousness:
I have brought near my righteousness; it is not far off, and my deliverance will not delay. And I will give deliverance in Zion, to Israel my splendour.

isaiah_47.t: Go down and sit on the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground — there is no throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will not go on being called tender and delicate.
Take a hand-mill and grind flour. Uncover your veil; strip off the skirt; uncover the leg; pass through rivers.
Let your nakedness be uncovered; let your reproach also be seen. I will take vengeance, and I will meet no one.
Our redeemer — YHWH of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
Sit silently and go into the darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans; for you will not go on being called queen of kingdoms.
I was angry with my people; I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You set them no compassion; on the old you made your yoke very heavy.
And you said: For ever I will be a queen — until you did not set these things on your heart; you did not remember its outcome.
And now hear this, voluptuous one, who sits in security, who says in her heart: I, and besides me there is no other. I will not sit as a widow and will not know childlessness.

And both of these will come to you in a moment, in one day: childlessness and widowhood. In their full measure they will come upon you, in the abundance of your sorceries, in the great might of your spells.
And you trusted in your evil. You said: No one sees me. Your wisdom and your knowledge — it has led you away; and you said in your heart: I, and besides me there is no other.

And evil will come upon you that you will not know how to charm away, and disaster will fall on you that you will not be able to cover over; and ruin will come upon you suddenly, which you will not know.
Stand now with your spells and with the abundance of your sorceries, in which you have laboured from your youth. Perhaps you will be able to profit; perhaps you will inspire awe.

You have become weary with the abundance of your counsels. Let them stand and deliver you — those who divide the heavens, who gaze at the stars, who at the new moons make known what will come upon you.
See, they have become like stubble; fire has burned them. They will not rescue their own being from the hand of the flame. There will be no coal to warm them, no fire to sit before.
So they have become for you — those for whom you have laboured, your traders from your youth. Each has wandered off to his own side; there is no one to deliver you.

isaiah_48.t: Hear this, house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and who came out from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of YHWH and bring the God of Israel to remembrance — but not in faithfulness and not in righteousness.
For they have called themselves from the city of holiness and have supported themselves on the God of Israel — YHWH of hosts is his name.
The former things I declared long ago; they went out from my mouth, and I made them heard. Suddenly I acted, and they came about.
Because I knew that you are stubborn, and your neck a sinew of iron, and your forehead bronze,
so I declared it to you long ago; before it came about I made you hear it, lest you should say: My figure did them, and my image and my cast image commanded them.
You have heard; look at all of it! And you — will you not declare it? I make you hear new things from now on, and hidden things you have not known.
They are created now and not long ago, and before this day you had not heard of them, lest you should say: See, I knew them.
You had neither heard nor known, nor from long ago was your ear opened; for I knew you would deal utterly treacherously, and you were called a transgressor from the belly.
For the sake of my name I will make my anger long, and for my praise I will restrain myself towards you, so as not to cut you off.
See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
For my own sake, for my own sake I will act — for how should it be profaned? And my glory I will not give to another.
Listen to me, Jacob, and Israel, my called one: I am he; I am first, yes, I am last.
My own hand founded the earth, and my right hand spanned the heavens. I call to them; they stand together.
Gather together, all of you, and listen! Who among them declared these things? YHWH loves him; he will do his desire on Babylon, and his arm will be on the Chaldeans.
I, I have spoken; yes, I have summoned him. I have brought him, and he will make his way succeed.
Draw near to me; hear this! From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it came about, I was there. And now the Lord YHWH has sent me — and his spirit.
Thus says YHWH, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am YHWH your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go.
If only you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like the river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
And your offspring would have been like the sand, and the descendants of your inward parts like its grains. His name would not be cut off and would not be destroyed from before me.
Go out from Babylon; flee from the Chaldeans! With a sound of a shout of joy declare this; make it heard; send it out to the end of the earth. Say: YHWH has redeemed his servant Jacob.
And they were not thirsty when he led them through the waste places; he made water flow for them from a rock; and he split a rock, and waters flowed out.
There is no peace, says YHWH, for the wicked.

isaiah_49.t: Listen to me, coastlands, and pay attention, peoples, from far off! YHWH called me from the belly; from the inward parts of my mother he brought my name to remembrance.
And he made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand he hid me. And he made me a polished arrow; in his quiver he concealed me.
And he said to me: You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will get glory for myself.
And I myself said: For nothing I have laboured; for emptiness and futility I have spent my strength. Yet my judgement is with YHWH, and my recompense with my God.

And now YHWH says — who formed me from the belly to be a servant to him, to bring Jacob back to him, and that Israel might be gathered to him; and I am honoured in the eyes of YHWH, and my God has been my power —

and he said: It is too slight a thing for you to be my servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the preserved of Israel. And I will make you a light of the nations, to be my deliverance to the end of the earth.

Thus says YHWH, the redeemer of Israel, its Holy One, to the one despised of being, to the one abhorred by a nation, to a servant of rulers: Kings will see and stand up, princes — and they will bow down, because of YHWH, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and he has chosen you.

Thus says YHWH: In a time of favour I answered you, and in a day of deliverance I helped you. And I will watch over you and make you a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to give as inheritance the desolate inheritances,
saying to the prisoners: Come out! to those in darkness: Show yourselves! On the roads they will graze, and on all the bare heights will be their pasture.
They will not hunger and will not thirst, and burning heat and sun will not strike them; for the one who has compassion on them will guide them, and by springs of water he will lead them.
And I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways will be lifted up.
See, these come from far off, and see, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.
Shout for joy, heavens, and be glad, earth! Break forth in a shout of joy, mountains! For YHWH has comforted his people and has compassion on his poor.
And Zion said: YHWH has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.
Does a woman forget her nursing child, from having compassion on the child of her womb? Even these may forget, but I myself will not forget you.
See, on the palms of my hands I have inscribed you; your walls are before me continually.
Your children have hastened; those who tear you down and make you desolate go out from you.

Lift up your eyes all around and see: all of them have gathered together; they have come to you. As I live, the declaration of YHWH, you will put them all on like an ornament and tie them on like a bride.
For your waste places and your desolate places and the land of your destruction — for now you will be too cramped for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far off.
The children of your bereavement will yet say in your ears: The place is too cramped for me; make room for me, that I may dwell.

And you will say in your heart: Who fathered these for me? And I was bereaved and barren, gone into exile and thrust away — and these, who brought them up? See, I was left alone; these — where were they?
Thus says the Lord YHWH: See, I will lift up my hand to the nations and raise my standard to the peoples; and they will bring your sons in a bosom, and your daughters will be carried on a shoulder.

And kings will be your foster-fathers, and their princesses your nursing-mothers. With faces to the ground they will bow down to you and lick up the dust of your feet. And you will know that I am YHWH, and those who wait for me will not be ashamed.
Can booty be taken from a warrior, or the captives of a righteous one escape?

For thus says YHWH: Even the captives of a warrior will be taken, and the booty of a ruthless one will escape; and I myself will contend with the one who contends with you, and I myself will deliver your children.

And I will make those who maltreat you eat their own flesh, and they will be drunk on their own blood as on sweet wine. And all flesh will know that I, YHWH, am your deliverer and your redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

isaiah_50.t: Thus says YHWH: Where is this document of your mother's divorce, by which I sent her away? Or which of my creditors is it to whom I sold you? See, for your iniquities you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.

Why did I come and there was no one? I called, and there was no one who answered. Is my hand really too short for ransom? Or is there no strength in me to rescue? See, by my rebuke I dry up the sea; I make rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink for lack of water and die of thirst.
I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth their covering.
The Lord YHWH has given me a tongue of disciples, to know how to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens morning by morning; he awakens my ear to hear like disciples.
The Lord YHWH has opened my ear, and I myself was not rebellious; I did not turn back.
I gave my back to those who struck it, and my cheeks to those who made them bare. I did not hide my face from insults and spittle.
And the Lord YHWH helps me; therefore I have not been humiliated. Therefore I have set my face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
The one who justifies me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand together. Who is the master of my case? Let him draw near to me.
See, the Lord YHWH helps me. Who is he who will condemn me? See, all of them will wear out like a garment; a moth will eat them.
Who among you fears YHWH, listening to the voice of his servant, who has walked in darkness and has no brightness? Let him trust in the name of YHWH and lean on his God.
See, all of you who kindle a fire, who gird on firebrands: walk by the light of your fire and by the firebrands you have kindled. This has come to you from my hand: you will lie down in pain.

isaiah_51.t: Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek YHWH: look to the rock from which you were hewn, and to the quarry of the pit from which you were dug out.
Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave birth to you; for he was one when I called him, and I blessed him and multiplied him.

For YHWH has comforted Zion; he has comforted all her waste places and made her wilderness like Eden and her desert plain like the garden of YHWH. Rejoicing and joy will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of music.
Pay attention to me, my people, and give ear to me, my nation; for law will go out from me, and my judgement I will set as a light of peoples in a moment.
My righteousness is near; my deliverance has gone out, and my arms will judge peoples. For me the coastlands will wait, and for my arm they will hope.

Lift up your eyes to the heavens and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will be dispersed like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment, and its inhabitants will die like gnats. But my deliverance will be for ever, and my righteousness will not be broken.
Listen to me, you who know righteousness, a people with my law in their heart: do not fear the reproach of humankind, and do not be dismayed by their reviling.
For a moth will eat them like a garment, and a clothes-moth will eat them like wool. But my righteousness will be for ever, and my deliverance to a generation of generations.
Awake, awake, put on power, arm of YHWH! Awake as in the days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the sea monster?
Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?
And the ransomed of YHWH will return and come to Zion with a shout of joy, and everlasting joy will be on their head. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.
I, I am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of a person who dies, and of a child of humankind who is made grass?

And you have forgotten YHWH your maker, who stretched out the heavens and founded the earth, and you dread continually, all the day, before the rage of the oppressor, when he has made ready to destroy. And where is the rage of the oppressor?
The one who stoops hastens to be let loose; he will not die in the pit, and his bread will not be lacking.
And I am YHWH your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar — YHWH of hosts is his name.
And I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand, to plant the heavens and to found the earth, and to say to Zion: You are my people.
Rouse yourself, rouse yourself, arise, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of YHWH the cup of his rage; the bowl, the cup of staggering, you have drunk, you have drained.
There is no one to lead her of all the children she has borne, and no one to take hold of her hand of all the children she has brought up.
These two things have happened to you — who will show sympathy to you? — the devastation and the destruction, and the famine and the sword. How shall I comfort you?
Your children have become faint; they have lain down at the head of every street like an antelope in a net, full of the rage of YHWH, the rebuke of your God.
Therefore hear this, poor one, and drunken, but not with wine:
Thus says your Lord YHWH, your God, who contends for his people: See, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the bowl, the cup of my rage — you will not go on drinking it again.

And I will put it into the hand of those who torment you, who said to your being: Lie down, that we may pass over you. And you made your back like the ground and like the street for those who pass over.

isaiah_52.t: Awake, awake, put on your power, Zion! Put on the garments of your splendour, Jerusalem, city of holiness; for the uncircumcised and the unclean will not go on coming into you again.
Shake yourself free from the dust! Arise, sit down, Jerusalem! Loosen for yourself the fetters of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!
For thus says YHWH: You were sold for nothing, and not with money will you be redeemed.
For thus says the Lord YHWH: To Egypt my people went down at the first, to sojourn there; and Assyria oppressed it for nothing.
And now, what is there for me here — the declaration of YHWH — for my people has been taken for nothing? Its rulers wail — the declaration of YHWH — and continually, all the day, my name is reviled.
Therefore my people will know my name; therefore, in that day — that I am he who speaks: here I am.
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of the one who bears news, who proclaims peace, who bears good news, who proclaims deliverance, who says to Zion: Your God reigns!
The voice of your watchmen — they have lifted up the voice; together they shout for joy; for eye in eye they will see when YHWH returns to Zion.
Break forth, shout for joy together, waste places of Jerusalem! For YHWH has comforted his people; he has redeemed Jerusalem.
YHWH has bared the arm of his holiness before the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth will see the deliverance of our God.
Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch nothing unclean! Go out from her midst; purify yourselves, you who carry the articles of YHWH!
For you will not go out in haste, and you will not go in flight; for YHWH is going before you, and the God of Israel is your rearguard.
See, my servant will prosper; he will be high and lifted up and exalted exceedingly.
Just as many were appalled at you — so disfigured was his appearance, beyond a man, and his form beyond the children of humankind —
so he will sprinkle many nations; kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what had not been recounted to them they will see, and what they had not heard they will understand.

isaiah_53.t: Who has believed our report, and the arm of YHWH — to whom has it been revealed?
And he grew up before him like a shoot, and like a root from a dry region. He had no form and no magnificence, that we should look at him; and no appearance, that we should desire him.
He was despised and rejected of men, a man of pains and acquainted with sickness; and like one hiding the face from him he was despised, and we did not value him.
Truly he bore our sicknesses and carried our pains; and we ourselves considered him stricken, struck by God and afflicted.
And he was pierced because of our transgressions, crushed because of our iniquities. The chastening of our peace was on him, and by his wound there was healing for us.
All of us like sheep have gone astray; each has turned to his own way. And YHWH made the iniquity of us all fall upon him.
He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, and he did not open his mouth. Like a sheep that is brought to the slaughter, and like a ewe that is dumb before her shearers, he did not open his mouth.
By oppression and by judgement he was taken away; and his generation — who considers it? For he was cut off from the land of the living; because of the transgression of my people he was stricken.
And he assigned his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his deaths, though he had done no violence and there was no deceit in his mouth.
And YHWH desired to crush him; he made him sick. If his being makes a guilt offering, he will see offspring, he will prolong days; and the desire of YHWH will prosper in his hand.
From the labour of his being he will see; he will be satisfied. By his knowledge the righteous one, my servant, will justify the many, and he himself will carry their iniquities.

Therefore I will allot him a portion among the many, and with the mighty he will apportion plunder, because he poured out his being to death and was numbered with transgressors; and he himself bore the sin of many and makes intercession for the transgressors.

isaiah_54.t: Shout for joy, barren one who has not given birth! Break forth in a shout of joy and cry aloud, you who have not been in labour! For the children of the desolate one are more than the children of the married one, says YHWH.
Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings; do not hold back. Make your tent cords long and make your tent pegs strong.
For you will spread out to the right and to the left, and your offspring will take possession of nations and will settle desolated cities.

Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; and do not be ashamed, for you will not display shame. For you will forget the shame of your youth, and the reproach of your widowhood you will not remember again.
For your husband is your maker — YHWH of hosts is his name — and your redeemer is the Holy One of Israel; the God of all the earth he is called.
For like a wife abandoned and grieved in spirit YHWH has called you, and like a wife of youth when she is rejected, says your God.
For a small moment I abandoned you, and with great compassion I will gather you.
In a flood of wrath I hid my face for a moment from you; but with everlasting steadfast love I will have compassion on you, says your redeemer, YHWH.
For this is like the waters of Noah to me: as I swore that the waters of Noah would not pass over the earth again, so I have sworn not to be angry with you and not to rebuke you.
For the mountains may be removed and the hills may shake, but my steadfast love will not be removed from you, and my covenant of peace will not shake, says the one who has compassion on you, YHWH.
Poor one, storm-tossed, not comforted: see, I am setting your stones in antimony and will refound you with sapphires.
And I will make your battlements of ruby, and your gates of stones of beryl, and all your border of stones of delight.
And all your children will be taught of YHWH, and great will be the peace of your children.
In righteousness you will be established. Be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and from terror, for it will not draw near to you.
See, anyone who quarrels quarrels not from me; whoever quarrels with you will fall because of you.
See, I myself created the craftsman who blows on a fire of charcoal and brings out a weapon for its work; and I myself created the destroyer to ruin.

Every weapon formed against you will not succeed, and every tongue that rises with you for judgement you will condemn. This is the inheritance of the servants of YHWH, and their righteousness from me, the declaration of YHWH.

isaiah_55.t: Ah, every thirsty one, come to the waters! And the one who has no money — come, buy grain and eat! Come, buy grain without money and without price — wine and milk!
Why do you weigh out money for what is not bread, and your toil for what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me and eat what is good, and let your being take delight in fatness.
Incline your ear and come to me; listen, and let your being live. And I will cut with you an everlasting covenant, the faithful steadfast loves of David.
See, I made him a witness of peoples, a leader and a commander of peoples.
See, a nation you do not know you will call, and a nation that has not known you will run to you, because of YHWH your God and for the Holy One of Israel, for he has glorified you.
Seek YHWH while he lets himself be found; call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the man of wrongdoing his thoughts; and let him return to YHWH, and he will have compassion on him, and to our God, for he will abundantly forgive.
For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways, the declaration of YHWH.
For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
For as the rain and the snow come down from the heavens and do not return there until they have watered the earth and made it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater —
so will my word be that goes out from my mouth: it will not return to me empty, but will do what I have desired and prosper in what I sent it for.
For in joy you will go out, and in peace you will be led. The mountains and the hills will break forth before you in a shout of joy, and all the trees of the field will clap the palm.
In place of the thornbush a cypress will grow up, and in place of the nettle a myrtle will grow up. And it will be for YHWH a name, an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.

isaiah_56.t: Thus says YHWH: Keep justice and do righteousness; for my deliverance is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
How blessed is the person who does this, and the child of humankind who takes hold of it: keeping the sabbath from profaning it, and keeping his hand from doing any evil.
And let not the son of foreignness who has joined himself to YHWH say: YHWH will surely separate me from his people. And let not the eunuch say: See, I am a dry tree.
For thus says YHWH to the eunuchs who keep my sabbaths and choose what I desire and take hold of my covenant:
I will give them in my house and within my walls a monument and a name, better than sons and than daughters. An everlasting name I will give him that will not be cut off.

And the sons of foreignness who join themselves to YHWH to serve him and to love the name of YHWH, to become servants to him — every one who keeps the sabbath from profaning it and who takes hold of my covenant —

I will bring them to the mountain of my holiness and make them rejoice in the house of my prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be for acceptance on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples.
The declaration of the Lord YHWH, who gathers the banished of Israel: I will gather still more to him, to those of his already gathered.
All animals of the field, come to devour — all animals in the forest!
Its watchmen are blind, all of them; they do not know. All of them are dumb dogs; they cannot bark — dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

And the dogs are strong of being; they do not know satiety. And they are shepherds who do not know how to understand. All of them have turned to their own way, each to his own unjust gain, from his own end.
Come, let me take wine, and let us drink our fill of strong drink! And tomorrow will be like this day — great, exceedingly abundant.

isaiah_57.t: The righteous one has perished, and there is no one who sets it on the heart; and men of loyalty are taken away, with no one understanding that the righteous one is taken away from before the evil.
Peace will come; they will rest on their beds — the one who walks in his uprightness.
And you, draw near here, children of a soothsayer, offspring of an adulterer and of her who has played the prostitute!
At whom are you making fun? At whom do you make the mouth wide and make the tongue long? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deception?
you who inflame yourselves among the great trees, under every luxuriant tree, who slaughter the children in the wadis, under the clefts of the rocks.

Among the smooth stones of the wadi is your portion; they, they are your allotted portion. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering, you have offered up a grain offering. Shall I relent over these?
On a high and lifted-up mountain you have set your bed; there too you went up to sacrifice a sacrifice.

And behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your memorial. For away from me you have uncovered and gone up; you have made your bed wide and cut a covenant for yourself with them. You have loved their bed; you have seen a hand.
And you journeyed to the king with oil and increased your perfumes. And you sent your envoys far off and brought yourself low as far as Sheol.
With the greatness of your journey you became weary; you did not say: It is hopeless. You found the life of your hand; therefore you did not become weak.
And of whom were you in dread and afraid, that you should lie and not remember me, not set it on your heart? Is it not that I have been silent, even from long ago, and you do not fear me?
I myself will declare your righteousness — and your deeds; and they will not benefit you.

When you cry out, let your collection of idols rescue you! And a wind will carry them all away; a vapour will take them. But the one who takes refuge in me will inherit the land and will possess the mountain of my holiness.
And one will say: Build up, build up! Clear the way! Lift the obstacle from the way of my people!

For thus says the high and lifted-up one, who dwells for ever, and whose name is holy: I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the contrite and lowly of spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and to restore the heart of the contrite.
For I will not contend for ever and will not be angry for all time; for the spirit would grow faint before me, and the breaths that I myself have made.
For the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry, and I struck him — hiding myself — and was angry; and he went on, turning away, in the way of his own heart.
I have seen his ways, and I will heal him; and I will lead him and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
creating the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to the far off and to the near, says YHWH, and I will heal him.
But the wicked are like the tossed sea, for it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mire and mud.
There is no peace, says my God, for the wicked.

isaiah_58.t: Call out with the throat; do not hold back! Like the trumpet raise your voice, and declare to my people their transgression, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

And me they seek day by day, and they desire the knowledge of my ways, like a nation that has done righteousness and has not forsaken the judgement of its God. They ask me for judgements of righteousness; they desire the approach of God.
Why have we fasted, and you have not seen? We have humbled our being, and you do not know. See, on the day of your fasting you find your own desire, and you drive hard all your labourers.
See, you fast for strife and contention and to strike with a fist of wickedness. You do not fast as on this day to make your voice heard in the height.

Is a fast like this the one I choose, a day for a person to humble his being? Is it to bend his head like a bulrush and to spread sackcloth and ashes as a bed? Is this what you call a fast and a day of acceptance to YHWH?
Is not this the fast I choose: to loosen the bonds of wickedness, to unfasten the bindings of the yoke-bar, and to let the crushed go free, and that you tear apart every yoke-bar?
Is it not to break your bread for the hungry, and that you bring the homeless poor into a house; when you see the naked, that you cover him, and that you do not hide yourself from your own flesh?
Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will spring up quickly; and your righteousness will go before you; the glory of YHWH will be your rearguard.
Then you will call and YHWH will answer; you will cry for help and he will say: Here I am. If you remove from among you the yoke-bar, the stretching out of the finger and the speaking of wrongdoing,
and you offer your being to the hungry and satisfy the being of the afflicted, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your gloom will be like noon.
And YHWH will lead you continually and satisfy your being in arid regions and strengthen your bones. And you will be like a watered garden and like a spring of waters whose waters do not fail.

And some of you will rebuild the ancient waste places; you will raise up the foundations of generation and generation. And you will be called the waller-up of the breach, the restorer of paths to dwell in.

If you turn back your foot from the sabbath, from doing your desires on the day of my holiness, and call the sabbath a delight, the holy day of YHWH honourable, and honour it by not doing your own ways, not finding your desire and speaking a word —
then you will take delight in YHWH, and I will make you ride on the high places of the land and feed you the inheritance of Jacob your father; for the mouth of YHWH has spoken.

isaiah_59.t: See, the hand of YHWH is not too short to deliver, and his ear is not too heavy to hear.
But your iniquities have been separating between you and your God, and your sins have hidden the face from you, from hearing.
For your hands are defiled with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken deception; your tongue mutters injustice.

There is no one who calls in righteousness, and no one who enters into judgement in trustworthiness. They trust in emptiness and speak worthlessness; they conceive mischief and bring forth wrongdoing.
They have hatched the eggs of a viper and weave the webs of a spider. The one who eats any of their eggs will die, and the pressed egg hatches a snake.
Their webs will not become clothing, and people will not cover themselves with their products. Their products are products of wrongdoing, and a deed of violence is in their hands.
Their feet run to evil, and they hasten to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of wrongdoing; devastation and destruction are on their highways.
A way of peace they do not know, and there is no justice on their tracks. Their paths they have made crooked for themselves; no one who treads on it knows peace.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We wait for the light, and see — darkness; for gleams of light, and we walk in gloom.
We grope for a wall like the blind, and like those with no eyes we grope. We have stumbled at noon as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
We all growl like bears, and like doves we utterly moan. We wait for justice, and there is none; for deliverance — it is far from us.
For our transgressions are many before you, and our sins have testified against us; for our transgressions are with us, and our iniquities — we know them.
Transgressing and denying YHWH, and turning back from after our God; speaking oppression and rebellion, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of deception.
And justice has been driven back, and righteousness stands far off; for faithfulness has stumbled in the open place, and uprightness cannot enter.
And faithfulness has become lacking, and the one who turns aside from evil is plundered. And YHWH saw, and it was evil in his eyes that there was no justice.
And he saw that there was no one, and he was appalled that there was no one who interposes. And his own arm brought him deliverance, and his own righteousness — it sustained him.
And he put on righteousness like body armour, and a helmet of deliverance on his head. And he put on garments of vengeance as clothing and wrapped himself in zeal like a robe.
According to their deeds, so he will repay: rage to his adversaries, requital to his enemies; to the coastlands he will repay requital.
And they will fear the name of YHWH from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come like a rushing stream that the wind of YHWH drives.
And a redeemer will come to Zion, and to those in Jacob who turn from transgression, the declaration of YHWH.

And I — this is my covenant with them, says YHWH: my spirit that is on you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, will not depart from your mouth and from the mouth of your offspring and from the mouth of the offspring of your offspring, says YHWH, from now and for ever.

isaiah_60.t: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of YHWH has dawned upon you.
For see, the darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but upon you YHWH will dawn, and his glory will appear over you.
And nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
Lift up your eyes all around and see: all of them have gathered together; they have come to you. Your sons will come from far off, and your daughters will be carried on the hip.
Then you will see and be radiant, and your heart will be in awe and be enlarged; for the abundance of the sea will be turned over to you, the wealth of nations will come to you.
A multitude of camels will cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all of them will come from Sheba. They will carry gold and frankincense and will bear news of the praises of YHWH.
Every flock of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will go up on my altar for acceptance, and I will beautify the house of my splendour.
Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their openings?

For the coastlands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish at the first, to bring your children from far off, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of YHWH your God and for the Holy One of Israel, for he has glorified you.
And the sons of foreignness will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, and in my favour I have had compassion on you.
And your gates will be open continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you the wealth of nations, and their kings led.
For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolate.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you — the juniper, the plane and the cypress together — to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place of my feet.

And the children of those who afflicted you will come to you bowing down, and all who despised you will bow down to the soles of your feet. And they will call you the City of YHWH, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
In place of your being forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting majesty, a joy of generation and generation.
And you will suck the milk of nations and suck the breast of kings; and you will know that I, YHWH, am your deliverer, and your redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

In place of the bronze I will bring gold, and in place of the iron I will bring silver, and in place of the wood, bronze, and in place of the stones, iron. And I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters righteousness.
Violence will no longer be heard in your land, devastation and destruction within your territories; and you will call your walls Deliverance and your gates Praise.
The sun will no longer be your light by day, and for brightness the moon will not shine for you; but YHWH will be for you an everlasting light, and your God your splendour.
Your sun will no longer go down, and your moon will not be taken away; for YHWH will be for you an everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will be complete.
And your people — all of them righteous — will possess the land for ever: the shoot of my plantings, the work of my hands, that I may glorify myself.
The small one will become a thousand, and the little one a mighty nation. I am YHWH; in its time I will hasten it.

isaiah_61.t: The spirit of the Lord YHWH is on me, because YHWH has anointed me to bear news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken of heart, to proclaim liberty to captives and release to prisoners,
to proclaim a year of favour of YHWH and a day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all mourners,

to appoint for the mourners of Zion, to give them a turban in place of ashes, oil of rejoicing in place of mourning, a mantle of praise in place of a faint spirit; and they will be called the great trees of righteousness, the planting of YHWH, that he may glorify himself.
And they will rebuild the ancient waste places; they will raise up the former desolate places and renew the cities of devastation, the desolate places of generation and generation.
And strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks, and the sons of foreignness will be your farmers and your vinedressers.
And you will be called the priests of YHWH; ministers of our God will be said of you. You will consume the wealth of nations, and in their glory you will boast.
In place of your shame — double; and ignominy — they will shout for joy over their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double; everlasting joy will be theirs.
For I, YHWH, love justice; I hate robbery with injustice. And I will give their recompense in faithfulness and cut an everlasting covenant for them.
And their offspring will be known among the nations, and their descendants in the midst of the peoples. All who see them will recognise them, that they are the offspring YHWH has blessed.

I will greatly rejoice in YHWH; my being will be glad in my God; for he has clothed me with garments of deliverance, has covered me with a robe of righteousness, like a bridegroom who acts as priest with a turban, and like a bride who adorns herself with her ornaments.
For as the ground brings forth its growth, and as a garden makes what is sown in it grow, so the Lord YHWH will make righteousness and praise grow before all the nations.

isaiah_62.t: For Zion's sake I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not remain quiet, until her righteousness goes forth like brightness and her deliverance burns like a torch.
And nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory; and you will be called by a new name that the mouth of YHWH will designate.
And you will be a crown of splendour in the hand of YHWH, and a headdress of royalty in the palm of your God.

It will no longer be said of you: Forsaken, and of your land it will no longer be said: Desolation. For you will be called My-Delight-Is-In-Her, and your land Married; for YHWH delights in you, and your land will be married.
For as a young man marries a virgin, your sons will marry you; and with the joy of a bridegroom over a bride, your God will rejoice over you.
On your walls, Jerusalem, I have appointed guards; all the day and all the night, continually, they will not be silent. You who bring YHWH to remembrance, let there be no rest for you!
And give him no rest until he establishes and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

YHWH has sworn by his right hand and by the arm of his power: I will never again give your grain as food to your enemies, and the sons of foreignness will not drink your new wine for which you have laboured.
For those who gather it will eat it and praise YHWH, and those who collect it will drink it in the courts of my holiness.
Pass through, pass through the gates! Clear the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway; clear it of stones! Raise a standard over the peoples!
See, YHWH has made it heard to the end of the earth: Say to the daughter of Zion: See, your deliverance is coming! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
And they will be called the people of holiness, the redeemed of YHWH; and you will be called Sought-Out, a city not forsaken.

isaiah_63.t: Who is this coming from Edom, in garments reddened, from Bozrah? This one magnificent in his clothing, stooping in the greatness of his strength? It is I, speaking in righteousness, great to deliver.
Why is there redness on your clothing, and your garments like one who treads in a winepress?

I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples there was no one with me. And I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my rage, and their lifeblood spattered on my garments, and all my clothes I have defiled.
For a day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redemption had come.
And I looked, and there was no helper, and I was appalled that there was no sustainer. And my own arm brought me deliverance, and my rage — it sustained me.
And I trod down peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my rage, and I brought down their lifeblood to the ground.

I will bring to remembrance the steadfast loves of YHWH, the praises of YHWH, according to all that YHWH has dealt out to us, and the great goodness to the house of Israel that he has dealt out to them according to his compassion and according to the greatness of his steadfast loves.
And he said: Surely they are my people, children who will not deal falsely. And he became a deliverer for them.

In all their distress there was distress to him, and the messenger of his presence delivered them. In his love and in his mercy he redeemed them, and he lifted them and carried them all the days of old.
But they rebelled and grieved the spirit of his holiness; and he turned himself into an enemy for them; he himself fought against them.

And he remembered the days of old, Moses his people: Where is the one who brought them up from the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is the one who put the spirit of his holiness in his midst,
who made the arm of his splendour go at the right hand of Moses, who split the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name,
who made them walk through the deeps — like a horse in the wilderness, they did not stumble.
Like livestock that goes down into the valley, the spirit of YHWH gave it rest. So you led your people, to make yourself a name of splendour.

Look down from the heavens and see, from the lofty abode of your holiness and your splendour! Where are your zeal and your mighty deeds, the tumult of your inward parts and your compassion? They have restrained themselves towards me.
For you are our father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, YHWH, are our father; our redeemer from of old is your name.
Why, YHWH, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our heart from the fear of you? Return, for the sake of your servants, the tribes of your inheritance!
For a little while your people of holiness possessed; our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
We have become like those you have never ruled over, like those on whom your name has not been called.

isaiah_64.t: If only you had torn the heavens and come down — from before you the mountains would shake!
As fire kindles brushwood, as fire makes water boil, to make your name known to your adversaries, so that nations would quake before you!
When you did awesome deeds we were not looking for, you came down; from before you the mountains shook.
And from of old they have not heard, they have not given ear; no eye has seen a God besides you who acts for the one who waits for him.
You meet the one who rejoices and does righteousness; in your ways they remember you. See, you were angry, and we sinned — in them for a long time — and shall we be delivered?
And we have all become like the unclean, and all our righteousnesses like a garment of menstruation. And we have all withered like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us off like the wind.
And there is no one who calls on your name, who rouses himself to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and melted us in the hand of our iniquity.
And now, YHWH, you are our father. We are the clay, and you are the one who formed us, and all of us are the work of your hand.
Do not be angry, YHWH, to the utmost, and do not remember iniquity for ever. See, look now — all of us are your people!
The cities of your holiness have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
The house of our holiness and our splendour, where our fathers praised you, has become a burning of fire; and all our pleasant things have become a ruin.
Over these will you restrain yourself, YHWH? Will you be silent and afflict us to the utmost?

isaiah_65.t: I let myself be sought by those who did not ask; I let myself be found by those who did not seek me. I said: Here I am, here I am! to a nation not called by my name.
I spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people who walk the way that is not good, after their own thoughts —
the people who provoke me to anger to my face continually, sacrificing in the gardens and making smoke on the bricks,
who sit among the graves and spend the night in secret places, who eat the flesh of the pig, and broth of unclean meat is in their vessels —
who say: Keep to yourself; do not draw near to me, for I am holier than you! These are smoke in my nose, a fire burning all the day.
See, it is written before me: I will not be silent, but I will repay; and I will repay into their bosom —
your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together, says YHWH, who made smoke on the mountains and taunted me on the hills. And I will measure their former work into their bosom.
Thus says YHWH: As the new wine is found in the cluster and one says: Do not destroy it, for a blessing is in it — so I will act for the sake of my servants, so as not to destroy everyone.
And I will bring out offspring from Jacob, and from Judah a possessor of my mountains; and my chosen ones will take possession of it, and my servants will dwell there.
And Sharon will become a pasture of sheep, and the valley of Achor a resting place of cattle, for my people who have sought me.
But you who forsake YHWH, who forget the mountain of my holiness, who arrange a table for Fortune and fill mixed wine for Destiny —

I will appoint you for the sword, and all of you will bow down to the slaughter; because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen, and you did what was evil in my eyes and chose what I did not desire.
Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: See, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; see, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty; see, my servants will rejoice, but you will be ashamed;
see, my servants will shout for joy from goodness of heart, but you will cry out from pain of heart and wail from brokenness of spirit.
and you will leave your name as a curse for my chosen ones. And the Lord YHWH will put you to death, and he will call his servants by another name,

so that the one who blesses himself in the land will bless himself by the God of Amen, and the one who swears in the land will swear by the God of Amen; for the former troubles will be forgotten and will be hidden from my eyes.
For see, I am creating new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered and will not come up on the heart.
But rejoice and be glad for ever in what I am creating; for see, I am creating Jerusalem a joy and her people a gladness.
And I will be glad in Jerusalem and rejoice in my people; and the sound of weeping will no longer be heard in her, nor the sound of a cry of distress.

There will no longer be from there an infant of days, or an old one who does not complete his days; for the young man will die a hundred years old, and the one who misses the mark, a hundred years old, will be cursed.
And they will build houses and dwell in them, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

They will not build and another dwell; they will not plant and another eat. For like the days of the tree will be the days of my people, and my chosen ones will use to the full the work of their hands.
They will not labour for emptiness and will not bring forth children for sudden terror; for they are the offspring of those blessed by YHWH, and their descendants with them.
And it will be that before they call, I myself will answer; while they are still speaking, I myself will hear.

Wolf and lamb will graze as one, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, and the snake — dust will be its food. They will do no harm and will not destroy in all the mountain of my holiness, says YHWH.

isaiah_66.t: Thus says YHWH: The heavens are my throne, and the earth the footstool of my feet. Where is this house that you would build for me, and where is this place of my rest?
And all these my hand made, and all these came to be, the declaration of YHWH. And to this one I will look: to the poor and stricken of spirit and the one who trembles at my word.

The one who slaughters the ox strikes down a person; the one who sacrifices the lamb breaks a dog's neck; the one who offers up a grain offering — the blood of a pig; the one who offers frankincense as a memorial blesses wrongdoing. They too have chosen their own ways, and their being has delighted in their detestable things.

I too will choose their punishments and bring their fears upon them; because I called and there was no one who answered, I spoke and they did not listen, and they did what was evil in my eyes and chose what I did not desire.

Hear the word of YHWH, you who tremble at his word: Your brothers who hate you, who exclude you for my name's sake, have said: Let YHWH be honoured, that we may look on your joy! But they will be ashamed.
A sound of uproar from the city! A sound from the temple! The sound of YHWH repaying requital to his enemies!
Before she was in labour she gave birth; before pain came to her she delivered a male.

Who has heard the like of this? Who has seen the like of these? Can a land be brought forth in one day? Or can a nation be born at one time? For Zion was in labour and also gave birth to her children.
Shall I bring to the birth and not cause to bring forth? says YHWH. Or am I the one who causes to bring forth, and shall I restrain? says your God.
Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad in her, all who love her! Rejoice with her a rejoicing, all who mourn over her!
so that you may suck and be satisfied from the breast of her consolations, so that you may drain and take delight from the nipple of her glory.
For thus says YHWH: See, I am extending peace to her like a river, and the glory of nations like an overflowing torrent; and you will suck, be carried on the hip and be fondled on the knees.
Like a person whose mother comforts him, so I myself will comfort you; and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.
And you will see, and your heart will rejoice, and your bones will sprout like grass; and the hand of YHWH will be made known to his servants, and he will be indignant against his enemies.
For see, YHWH will come in fire, and his chariots like the storm-wind, to bring back his anger in rage and his rebuke in flames of fire.
For by fire YHWH will enter into judgement, and by his sword, with all flesh; and those slain by YHWH will be many.

Those who consecrate themselves and cleanse themselves towards the gardens, after one in the middle, eating the flesh of the pig and the detestable thing and the mouse — they will come to an end together, the declaration of YHWH.
And I — their deeds and their thoughts! — it is coming, to gather all the nations and the tongues; and they will come and see my glory.

And I will perform a sign among them and send survivors from them to the nations — Tarshish, Pul and Lud, who draw the bow, Tubal and Javan, the distant coastlands that have not heard my report and have not seen my glory — and they will declare my glory among the nations.

And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as an offering to YHWH — on horses and in chariots and in wagons and on mules and on camels — to the mountain of my holiness, Jerusalem, says YHWH, just as the sons of Israel bring the grain offering in a clean vessel to the house of YHWH.
And I will also take some of them for the priests, for the Levites, says YHWH.
For just as the new heavens and the new earth that I am making stand before me, the declaration of YHWH, so your offspring and your name will stand.
And it will be that from new moon to new moon and from sabbath to sabbath, all flesh will come to bow down before me, says YHWH.

And they will go out and look on the corpses of the people who transgressed against me; for their worm will not die and their fire will not be extinguished, and they will be an abhorrence to all flesh.

judges_1.t: And it was after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel enquired of YHWH, saying, "Who shall go up for us against the Canaanite first, to fight against him?"
And YHWH said, "Judah shall go up. Behold, I have given the land into his hand."
And Judah said to Simeon his brother, "Come up with me into my lot, and let us fight against the Canaanite; and I too will go with you into your lot." And Simeon went with him.
And Judah went up, and YHWH gave the Canaanite and the Perizzite into their hand, and they struck them at Bezek — ten thousand men.
And they found Adoni-bezek at Bezek, and they fought against him, and they struck the Canaanite and the Perizzite.
And Adoni-bezek fled, and they pursued after him and seized him, and they cut off the thumbs of his hands and his feet.

And Adoni-bezek said, "Seventy kings with the thumbs of their hands and their feet cut off used to gather up under my table. As I have done, so God has repaid me." And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
And the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it, and they struck it with the mouth of the sword, and the city they sent into fire.
And afterwards the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanite dwelling in the hill country and the Negev and the Shephelah.
And Judah went against the Canaanite dwelling in Hebron — and the name of Hebron before was Kiriath-arba — and they struck Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.
And he went from there against the inhabitants of Debir — and the name of Debir before was Kiriath-sepher.
And Caleb said, "Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it — I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
And Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, the younger than he, captured it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
And it was, when she came, that she incited him to ask from her father the field; and she went down from upon the donkey. And Caleb said to her, "What is to you?"
And she said to him, "Give me a blessing, for you have given me the land of the Negev; and you shall give me springs of water." And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

And the sons of the Kenite, the father-in-law of Moses, went up from the city of palms with the sons of Judah to the wilderness of Judah, which is in the Negev of Arad; and he went and dwelt with the people.
And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanite dwelling in Zephath, and they devoted it to destruction; and he called the name of the city Hormah.
And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, and Ashkelon and its territory, and Ekron and its territory.
And YHWH was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country; but not to dispossess the inhabitants of the valley, for they had chariots of iron.
And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had spoken; and he dispossessed from there the three sons of Anak.
And the Jebusite dwelling in Jerusalem the sons of Benjamin did not dispossess; and the Jebusite has dwelt with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
And the house of Joseph, they too went up, to Beth-el; and YHWH was with them.
And the house of Joseph caused Beth-el to be spied out — and the name of the city before was Luz.
And the watchers saw a man coming out from the city, and they said to him, "Show us, please, the entrance of the city, and we will do loyalty with you."
And he showed them the entrance of the city, and they struck the city with the mouth of the sword; but the man and all his family they let go.
