And there — an old man coming from his work, from the field, in the evening; and the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he was sojourning in Gibeah; and the men of the place were Benjaminites.
And he lifted up his eyes and saw the man, the traveller, in the open square of the city; and the old man said, "Where are you going, and where do you come from?"

And he said to him, "We are passing from Bethlehem of Judah to the remotest parts of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem of Judah; and I am going to the house of YHWH. And there is no one taking me into a house.
"And there is both straw and fodder for our donkeys, and there is also bread and wine for me and for your maidservant and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything."
And the old man said, "Peace to you. Only, all your lack is on me. Only, do not spend the night in the open square."
And he brought him into his house and gave fodder to the donkeys; and they washed their feet and ate and drank.

They were making their hearts glad, and there — the men of the city, worthless men, surrounded the house, beating violently on the door; and they said to the man, the master of the house, the old man, "Bring out the man who came to your house, that we may know him."
And the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, "No, my brothers, do not do evil, please. After this man has come into my house, do not do this outrage."
"Behold, my daughter, the virgin, and his concubine — let me bring them out, please, and afflict them and do to them what is good in your eyes; but to this man do not do this outrageous thing."

But the men were not willing to listen to him. So the man took hold of his concubine and brought her out to them, outside; and they knew her and abused her all the night until the morning, and they let her go as the dawn came up.
And the woman came at the turning of the morning and fell at the entrance of the man's house where her master was, until the light.

And her master rose in the morning and opened the doors of the house and went out to go on his way; and there — the woman, his concubine, fallen at the entrance of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
And he said to her, "Get up, and let us go." And there was no one answering. And he took her on the donkey, and the man rose and went to his place.
And he came to his house and took the knife and took hold of his concubine and cut her in pieces, by her bones, into twelve pieces; and he sent her throughout all the territory of Israel.

And it was that everyone who saw said, "Such a thing has not happened and has not been seen from the day the sons of Israel came up from the land of Egypt to this day. Set your minds on it, take counsel, and speak."

judges_20.t: And all the sons of Israel went out, and the congregation assembled as one man, from Dan and as far as Beer-sheba, and the land of Gilead, to YHWH at Mizpah.
And the corners of all the people, all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God: four hundred thousand men on foot, drawing the sword.
And the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to Mizpah. And the sons of Israel said, "Speak: how did this evil happen?"
And the man, the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, answered and said, "I came to Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.
"And the lords of Gibeah rose up against me and surrounded the house against me by night. They intended to kill me, and my concubine they abused, and she died.
"And I took hold of my concubine and cut her in pieces, and I sent her throughout all the land of the inheritance of Israel, because they had done depravity and outrage in Israel.
"Behold, all of you are the sons of Israel. Give yourselves a word and counsel here."
And all the people rose as one man, saying, "None of us will go to his tent, and none of us will turn aside to his house."
"And now, this is the thing that we will do to Gibeah: against it by lot!

"And we will take ten men out of a hundred for all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred out of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to take provisions for the people, so that when they come to Geba of Benjamin they may deal with it according to all the outrage that it has done in Israel."
And every man of Israel gathered to the city as one man, united.
And the tribes of Israel sent men throughout all the tribes of Benjamin, saying, "What is this evil that has happened among you?

"And now, give up the men, the worthless men who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and burn out evil from Israel." But the sons of Benjamin were not willing to listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.
And the sons of Benjamin gathered from the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle with the sons of Israel.
And the sons of Benjamin were mustered on that day from the cities: twenty-six thousand men drawing the sword, apart from the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were mustered: seven hundred chosen men.
Out of all this people were seven hundred chosen men impeded in the right hand; every one of these could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
And the man of Israel was mustered, apart from Benjamin: four hundred thousand men drawing the sword; every one of these was a man of war.
And they rose and went up to Beth-el and enquired of God; and the sons of Israel said, "Who shall go up for us first to the battle with the sons of Benjamin?" And YHWH said, "Judah first."
And the sons of Israel rose in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
And the man of Israel went out to battle with Benjamin, and the man of Israel deployed for battle against them at Gibeah.
And the sons of Benjamin went out from Gibeah, and they destroyed in Israel on that day twenty-two thousand men, to the ground.
And the people, the man of Israel, showed themselves strong, and they again deployed for battle in the place where they had deployed on the first day.

And the sons of Israel went up and wept before YHWH until the evening, and they enquired of YHWH, saying, "Shall I again draw near to battle with the sons of Benjamin my brother?" And YHWH said, "Go up against him."
And the sons of Israel drew near to the sons of Benjamin on the second day.
And Benjamin went out to meet them from Gibeah on the second day, and they destroyed among the sons of Israel again eighteen thousand men, to the ground; all these were drawers of the sword.

And all the sons of Israel and all the people went up and came to Beth-el, and they wept and sat there before YHWH, and they fasted on that day until the evening; and they offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings before YHWH.
And the sons of Israel enquired of YHWH — and the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron was standing before it in those days — saying, "Shall I again go out to battle with the sons of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?" And YHWH said, "Go up, for tomorrow I will give him into your hand."
And Israel set ambushers around Gibeah.
And the sons of Israel went up against the sons of Benjamin on the third day, and they deployed against Gibeah as time after time.

And the sons of Benjamin went out to meet the people; they were drawn away from the city, and they began to strike down some of the people, fatally wounded, as time after time, on the highways — one of which goes up to Beth-el and one to Gibeah — in the field: about thirty men in Israel.
And the sons of Benjamin said, "They are defeated before us as at the first." But the sons of Israel said, "Let us flee, and we will draw him away from the city to the highways."
And every man of Israel rose from his place and deployed at Baal-tamar; and the ambusher of Israel was bursting forth from his place, from the open ground of Geba.
And ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came opposite Gibeah, and the battle was heavy; and they did not know that the calamity was touching them.
And YHWH defeated Benjamin before Israel, and the sons of Israel destroyed in Benjamin on that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men; all these were drawing the sword.
And the sons of Benjamin saw that they were defeated; and the man of Israel had given place to Benjamin, because they trusted in the ambush that they had set against Gibeah.
And the ambushers hurried and made a raid against Gibeah; and the ambusher marched and struck all the city with the mouth of the sword.
And the appointed signal between the man of Israel and the ambushers was to make great the rising of the smoke go up from the city.

And the man of Israel turned in the battle; and Benjamin had begun to strike down fatally wounded among the man of Israel, about thirty men, for they said, "Surely he is utterly defeated before us, as in the first battle."
And the rising began to go up from the city, a pillar of smoke; and Benjamin turned behind him, and there — the whole of the city was going up toward the heavens.
And the man of Israel turned, and the man of Benjamin was terrified, for he saw that the calamity had touched him.
And they turned before the man of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle overtook him; and those who were from the cities were destroying him in his midst.
They surrounded Benjamin, they pursued him, they trod him down at his resting place, as far as opposite Gibeah, toward the rising of the sun.
And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men — all these were men of valour.

And they turned and fled toward the wilderness, to the rock of Rimmon; and they gleaned of them on the highways five thousand men, and they pursued closely after him as far as Gidom, and struck down two thousand men of him.
And all who fell of Benjamin that day were twenty-five thousand men drawing the sword; all these were men of valour.
And six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness, to the rock of Rimmon; and they stayed at the rock of Rimmon four months.

And the man of Israel turned back against the sons of Benjamin and struck them with the mouth of the sword — from the city of soundness to animal, to all that was found; also all the cities that were found they sent into fire.

judges_21.t: And the man of Israel had sworn at Mizpah, saying, "None of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife."
And the people came to Beth-el and sat there until the evening before God, and they lifted up their voice and wept a great weeping.
And they said, "Why, YHWH, God of Israel, has this happened in Israel, that today one tribe should be missing from Israel?"
And it was on the next day that the people rose early and built there an altar and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings.

And the sons of Israel said, "Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that did not go up in the assembly to YHWH?" — for the great oath had been made concerning whoever did not go up to YHWH at Mizpah, saying, "Dying he shall be put to death."
And the sons of Israel were moved to compassion toward Benjamin their brother, and they said, "Today one tribe has been cut off from Israel.
"What shall we do for them, for those who remain, for wives? For we have sworn by YHWH not to give them any of our daughters as wives."
And they said, "Which one from the tribes of Israel did not go up to YHWH at Mizpah?" And behold, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh-gilead, to the assembly.
And the people were mustered, and behold, no one was there from the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead.

And the congregation sent there twelve thousand men from the sons of valour, and they commanded them, saying, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the mouth of the sword — and the women and the little ones.
"And this is the thing you shall do: every male, and every woman who has known lying with a male, you shall devote to destruction."

And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young women, virgins, who had not known a man by lying with a male; and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
And the whole congregation sent and spoke to the sons of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon, and they proclaimed peace to them.
And Benjamin returned at that time, and they gave them the women whom they had kept alive from the women of Jabesh-gilead; but they did not find enough for them so.
And the people were moved to compassion for Benjamin, because YHWH had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
And the elders of the congregation said, "What shall we do for those who remain, for wives? For woman has been destroyed from Benjamin."
And they said, "A possession for the escaped remnant belongs to Benjamin, and a tribe shall not be wiped out from Israel."
"But we ourselves are not able to give them wives from our daughters, for the sons of Israel have sworn, saying, "Cursed be the one who gives a wife to Benjamin."

And they said, "Behold, there is a festival of YHWH at Shiloh from days to days, which is north of Beth-el, toward the rising of the sun from the highway that goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
And they commanded the sons of Benjamin, saying, "Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

"and you shall watch; and behold, when the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then you shall come out from the vineyards and seize for yourselves, each man his wife, from the daughters of Shiloh; and you shall go to the land of Benjamin.

"And it shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to make a complaint to us, that we will say to them, 'Show us favour concerning them, for we did not take each man his wife in the battle; for you did not give them to them — at this time you would be guilty.'"

And the sons of Benjamin did so, and they carried off wives according to their number from the dancers whom they had seized; and they went and returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the cities and dwelt in them.
And the sons of Israel dispersed from there at that time, each man to his tribe and to his clan; and they went out from there, each man to his inheritance.
In those days there was no king in Israel; each man did what was right in his own eyes.

jeremiah_1.t: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were at Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
to whom the word of YHWH came in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reigning;

and it came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the completing of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the exiling of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Before I formed you in the belly I knew you, and before you came out from the womb I set you apart as holy; a prophet to the nations I appointed you.
And I said, "Alas, Lord YHWH! Look, I do not know how to speak, for I am a youth."
And YHWH said to me: "Do not say, 'I am a youth'; for to everyone to whom I send you, you shall go, and everything that I command you, you shall speak."
"Do not be afraid before them, for I am with you to deliver you" — the declaration of YHWH.
And YHWH stretched out his hand and touched upon my mouth, and YHWH said to me: "Look, I have put my words in your mouth."
"See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to pull down, and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant."
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying: "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "A branch of an almond tree I see."
And YHWH said to me: "You have done well to see, for I am watching [shoqed] over my word to do it."
And the word of YHWH came to me a second time, saying: "What do you see?" And I said, "A pot blown upon I see, and its face is from the face of the north."
And YHWH said to me: "From the north the disaster shall be opened upon all the inhabitants of the land."

"For here I am, summoning all the clans of the kingdoms of the north" — the declaration of YHWH — "and they shall come, and each shall set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls round about, and against all the cities of Judah."
"And I will speak my judgements with them concerning all their evil, in that they have forsaken me and have made smoke to other gods and have bowed down to the works of their own hands."
"And you, you shall gird your loins and arise and speak to them all that I myself command you. Do not be dismayed before them, lest I dismay you before them."

"And I, look, I have made you this day into a city of fortification and into a pillar of iron and into walls of bronze against all the land — against the kings of Judah, against its officials, against its priests, and against the people of the land."
"And they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail over you, for I am with you" — the declaration of YHWH — "to deliver you."

jeremiah_2.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:

Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying: Thus says YHWH: I have remembered for you the loyalty of your youth, the love of your betrothal, your walking after me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
Israel was a holy thing to YHWH, the beginning of his produce. All who devour it are held guilty; disaster comes upon them — the declaration of YHWH.
Hear the word of YHWH, O house of Jacob, and all the clans of the house of Israel.
Thus says YHWH: What injustice did your fathers find in me, that they went far from me, and walked after the vapour and became vapour?

And they did not say, "Where is YHWH, who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us in the wilderness, in a land of desert plain and pit, in a land of drought and deep darkness, in a land no one has passed through and no human has dwelt in?"
And I brought you into a land of orchard land, to eat its fruit and its good things; but you came and made my land unclean, and my inheritance you set as an abomination.

The priests did not say, "Where is YHWH?" and those who handle the law did not know me; and the shepherds rebelled against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and walked after things that do not profit.
Therefore I will yet contend with you — the declaration of YHWH — and with the children of your children I will contend.
For cross over to the coasts of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and consider carefully, and see whether there has been anything like this.
Has a nation exchanged gods, and they are not gods? But my people have exchanged their glory for what does not profit.
Be appalled, O heavens, at this, and shudder, be utterly desolate — the declaration of YHWH.
For two evils my people have done: me they have forsaken, the spring of living water, to hew out for themselves cisterns — broken cisterns that cannot hold the water.
Is Israel a slave? Or is he one born of the household? Why has he become plunder?
Over him young lions have roared, they have given their voice; and they have made his land a waste, his cities are burned, with no inhabitant.
Also the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes have grazed your scalp.
Have you not done this to yourself, by your forsaking YHWH your God at the time he was leading you in the way?
And now, what is it to you, the way to Egypt, to drink the water of the Shihor? And what is it to you, the way to Assyria, to drink the water of the River?

Your evil will discipline you, and your turnings away will rebuke you. Know, then, and see that it is evil and bitter, your forsaking YHWH your God, and that the dread of me is not upon you — the declaration of Lord YHWH of hosts.
For long ago I broke your yoke, I tore off your bonds, and you said, "I will not transgress." For on every high hill and under every luxuriant tree you are sprawling, a prostitute.
And I myself planted you a choice vine, wholly a seed of faithfulness. And how have you turned yourself against me into the degenerate shoots of an alien vine?
For though you wash with natron and use much soap for yourself, your iniquity is stained before me — the declaration of Lord YHWH.
How can you say, "I have not made myself unclean; after the Baals I have not walked"? Look at your way in the valley, know what you have done — a swift young camel criss-crossing her ways,

a wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness, in the craving of her appetite she sniffs the wind — her heat, who can turn it back? All who seek her need not weary themselves; in her month they will find her.
Restrain your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, "It is hopeless. No! For I have loved strangers, and after them I will go."
As the shame of a thief when he is found, so the house of Israel has been put to shame — they, their kings, their officials, and their priests and their prophets,
who say to a tree, "You are my father," and to a stone, "You gave birth to us." For they have turned to me the back and not the face; but at the time of their calamity they say, "Arise and save us!"
And where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them arise, if they can save you at the time of your calamity. For as the number of your cities are your gods, O Judah.
Why do you contend against me? All of you have rebelled against me — the declaration of YHWH.
In vain I struck your sons; they accepted no correction. Your sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion.
O generation, you — see the word of YHWH! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of thick darkness? Why have my people said, "We roam free; we will not come to you again"?
Does a virgin forget her ornaments, a bride her sashes? Yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
How well you make your way good to seek love! Therefore even to the wicked women you have taught your ways.
Also on your skirts is found the blood of the lives of the innocent needy. Not at a break-in did you find them — but on account of all these things.
And you said, "Surely I am innocent; his anger has turned back from me." Here I am, entering into judgement with you because of your saying, "I have not sinned."
Why do you go about so lightly, changing your way? By Egypt too you will be put to shame, just as you were put to shame by Assyria.
From this one also you will go out, your hands upon your head; for YHWH has rejected those you trust in, and you will not prosper by them.

jeremiah_3.t: Saying: If a man sends away his wife and she goes from him and becomes another man's, will he return to her again? Would not that land be utterly polluted? And you have played the whore with many companions — and would you return to me? — the declaration of YHWH.

Lift up your eyes to the bare heights and see: where have you not been lain with? By the roads you sat for them like an Arab in the wilderness. And you polluted the land with your whoring and with your evil.
And the showers were withheld, and the spring rain did not come; and you had the forehead of a whoring woman — you refused to be ashamed.
Have you not from now called to me, "My father, you are the companion of my youth"?
"Will he keep his anger for ever? Will he maintain it to perpetuity?" Look — you have spoken, and you have done evil things, and you have prevailed.
And YHWH said to me in the days of Josiah the king: Have you seen what Turning-away Israel did? She went on every high hill and under every luxuriant tree, and played the whore there.
And I said, after she had done all these things, "She will return to me" — but she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

And I saw that for all the causes for which Turning-away Israel had committed adultery I had sent her away and given her document of divorce to her; yet her treacherous sister Judah was not afraid, but went and played the whore herself as well.
And it came about that from the lightness of her whoring the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stone and with wood.
And even for all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but in falsehood — the declaration of YHWH.
And YHWH said to me: Turning-away Israel has shown herself more in the right than treacherous Judah.

Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say: Turn back, Turning-away Israel — the declaration of YHWH — I will not make my face fall upon you, for I am loyal — the declaration of YHWH — I will not keep anger for ever.

Only acknowledge your iniquity, that against YHWH your God you have rebelled, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every luxuriant tree, and to my voice you have not listened — the declaration of YHWH.
Turn back, turning-away sons — the declaration of YHWH — for I am master over you; and I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and I will bring you to Zion.
And I will give you shepherds according to my own heart, and they will shepherd you with knowledge and insight.

And it will be, when you multiply and are fruitful in the land in those days — the declaration of YHWH — they will no longer say, "The ark of the covenant of YHWH." It will not come up on the heart; they will not remember it, they will not miss it, and it will not be made again.

At that time they will call Jerusalem "The Throne of YHWH," and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the name of YHWH, to Jerusalem; and they will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from a land of the north to the land that I gave as an inheritance to your fathers.

And I myself said: How I would set you among the sons and give you a land of desire, an inheritance, the most beautiful of the nations! And I said: You will call me "My father," and from following me you will not turn away.
Nevertheless, as a woman deals treacherously with her companion, so you have dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel — the declaration of YHWH.
A sound is heard on the bare heights, the weeping of the pleadings of the sons of Israel, because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten YHWH their God.
Turn back, turning-away sons; I will heal your turnings away. "Here we are, we have come to you, for you are YHWH our God."
Truly, for falsehood are the hills, the tumult of the mountains. Truly, in YHWH our God is the salvation of Israel.
And the Shame has consumed the toil of our fathers from our youth — their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us; for against YHWH our God we have sinned, we and our fathers, from our youth and until this day; and we have not listened to the voice of YHWH our God.

jeremiah_4.t: If you will turn back, Israel — the declaration of YHWH — to me you will turn back; and if you will remove your detestable things from before me, then you will not waver.
and you will swear, "As YHWH lives," in faithfulness, in justice and in righteousness; and the nations will bless themselves by him, and in him they will boast.
For thus says YHWH to the man of Judah and to Jerusalem: Break up for yourselves unbroken ground, and do not sow among thorns.

Circumcise yourselves to YHWH, and remove the foreskins of your heart, O man of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest my wrath go out like fire and burn with none to quench it, because of the evil of your deeds.
Declare in Judah, and in Jerusalem make it heard, and say: Blow the ram's horn in the land! Call out, fill the cry, and say: Gather yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities!
Lift up a standard toward Zion! Take refuge, do not stand still! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and a great shattering.
A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out; he has gone out from his place to make your land a waste. Your cities will fall in ruins, with no inhabitant.
For this, gird on sackcloth, mourn and wail, for the burning of YHWH's anger has not turned back from us.
And it will be on that day — the declaration of YHWH — the heart of the king will perish, and the heart of the officials; and the priests will be appalled, and the prophets will be astounded.
And I said: Alas, Lord YHWH! Truly you have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, "Peace shall be yours" — and a sword reaches to the throat.
At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem: A scorching wind of the bare heights in the wilderness is the way of the daughter of my people — not to winnow and not to cleanse.
A wind too full for these things will come for me. Now I myself will also speak judgements with them.
Look — like clouds he goes up, and like the storm-wind his chariots; swifter than eagles are his horses. Woe to us, for we are devastated!
Wash your heart from evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will your wicked thoughts lodge within you?
For a voice declares from Dan, and proclaims trouble from the hill country of Ephraim.
Make it known to the nations! Look — proclaim concerning Jerusalem: Besiegers are coming from a distant land, and they give forth their voice against the cities of Judah.
Like those who guard a field they are against her, round about, for she has been rebellious against me — the declaration of YHWH.
Your way and your deeds have brought these things upon you. This is your evil — for it is bitter, for it has reached to your heart.

My inward parts, my inward parts! Let me wait! The walls of my heart! My heart is in turmoil within me; I cannot keep silent, for the sound of the ram's horn you have heard, O my self, the shout of battle.
Shattering upon shattering is proclaimed, for all the land is devastated. Suddenly my tents are devastated, in a moment my curtains.
How long must I see the standard, must I hear the sound of the ram's horn?
For my people is a fool; me they do not know. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are wise to do evil, and to do good they do not know.
I looked at the earth, and behold — formlessness and emptiness; and to the heavens, and their light was gone.
I looked at the mountains, and behold — they were quaking, and all the hills shook to and fro.
I looked, and behold — there was no human, and every bird of the heavens had fled.
I looked, and behold — the garden-land was the wilderness, and all its cities were pulled down before YHWH, before the burning of his anger.
For thus says YHWH: All the land will be a desolation, yet a full end I will not make.
For this the land will mourn, and the heavens above will be dark; because I have spoken, I have purposed, and I have not relented, and I will not turn back from it.
From the sound of horseman and bowman every city is in flight. They have gone into the thickets, and they have gone up on the rocks. Every city is abandoned, and no one dwells in them.

And you, devastated one, what are you doing, that you dress in scarlet, that you ornament yourself with ornaments of gold, that you tear your eyes open with eye-paint? In vain you make yourself beautiful. Your lovers have rejected you; they seek your life.

For I have heard a sound like a woman in labour, distress like a woman bearing her first, the sound of the daughter of Zion gasping for breath, spreading out her hands: "Woe to me now, for my self faints before murderers!"

jeremiah_5.t: Rove about in the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and search in her open places: if you can find a man, if there is one doing justice, seeking faithfulness — then I will forgive her.
And though they say, "As YHWH lives," yet they swear to falsehood.

YHWH, are your eyes not toward faithfulness? You struck them, but they did not writhe; you brought them to an end, but they refused to accept correction. They made their faces harder than rock; they refused to turn back.
And I myself said: They are only the poor; they have acted foolishly, for they do not know the way of YHWH, the ordinance of their God.
Let me go to the great and speak with them, for they know the way of YHWH, the ordinance of their God. But they alike had broken the yoke, they had torn off the bonds.

Therefore a lion from the forest will strike them, a wolf of the desert plains will devastate them, a leopard is watching over their cities. Everyone who goes out from them will be torn in pieces, for their rebellions are many, their turnings away are numerous.
Why should I forgive you for this? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by what are not gods. I satisfied them, and they committed adultery, and they troop to a whore's house.
They were well-fed, lusting horses; each neighs for his neighbour's wife.
Shall I not call these things to account — the declaration of YHWH — and on a nation such as this shall my self not avenge itself?
Go up among her vine rows and destroy, but do not make a full end. Strip away her tendrils, for they are not YHWH's.
For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly dealt treacherously with me — the declaration of YHWH.
They have denied YHWH and said, "Not he! And disaster will not come upon us, and sword and famine we will not see."
And the prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus let it be done to them.
Therefore thus says YHWH, the God of hosts: Because you have spoken this word, here I am, making my words in your mouth a fire and this people wood, and it will consume them.

Here I am, bringing upon you a nation from far off, O house of Israel — the declaration of YHWH — an enduring nation it is, a nation from long ago it is, a nation whose language you do not know, and you will not hear what it says.
His quiver is like an open grave; all of them are warriors.

And it will devour your harvest and your food; they will devour your sons and your daughters; it will devour your flocks and your herds; it will devour your vines and your fig trees. It will shatter with the sword your fortified cities in which you are trusting.
And even in those days — the declaration of YHWH — I will not make a full end with you.

And it will be, when you say, "In return for what has YHWH our God done all these things to us?", then you shall say to them: Just as you forsook me and served gods of foreignness in your own land, so you shall serve strangers in a land not your own.
Declare this in the house of Jacob, and proclaim it in Judah, saying:
Hear this now, O foolish people and without heart: they have eyes and do not see, they have ears and do not hear.

Do you not fear me — the declaration of YHWH — or tremble before me, who set the sand as a boundary for the sea, a perpetual statute that it cannot pass over? They toss themselves, but they cannot prevail; its waves roar, but they cannot pass over it.
But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and gone.
And they have not said in their heart, "Let us now fear YHWH our God, who gives the rain, the autumn rain and the spring rain, in its time, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of the harvest."
Your iniquities have turned these things aside, and your sins have withheld the good from you.
For wicked men are found among my people; he watches, as fowlers crouch; they have set a destroying thing — it is men they catch.
Like a cage full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great and grown rich.

They have grown fat, they have grown sleek; they have also overflowed in deeds of evil. They do not plead a cause — the cause of the fatherless — that they might prosper; and the justice of the needy they have not judged.
Shall I not call these things to account — the declaration of YHWH — and on a nation such as this shall my self not avenge itself?
An appalling thing and a horror has happened in the land:
The prophets prophesy with falsehood, and the priests rule on their own authority; and my people have loved it so. And what will you do at the end of it?

jeremiah_6.t: Take refuge, sons of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! And in Tekoa blow the ram's horn, and over Beth-hakkerem raise a signal! For disaster looks down from the north, and a great shattering.
The comely and the delicate one — I destroy the daughter of Zion.
To her shepherds will come with their flocks; they will pitch tents against her all around; each will graze his own portion.
Set apart war against her! Arise, and let us go up at noon! Woe to us, for the day has turned, for the shadows of evening are stretching out.
Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her fortresses!
For thus says YHWH of hosts: Cut down timber and pour out a siege mound against Jerusalem. She is the city that must be called to account; all of her is oppression within her.
As a well keeps its waters cool, so she keeps her evil cool. Violence and havoc are heard in her; before my face continually are sickness and wounds.
Let yourself be corrected, Jerusalem, lest my self be torn away from you, lest I make you a desolation, a land not inhabited.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: They will thoroughly glean, as a vine, the remnant of Israel. Pass your hand back again like a grape gatherer over the branches.

To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? Look, their ear is uncircumcised, and they are not able to pay attention. Look, the word of YHWH has become a reproach to them; they take no delight in it.

And I am full of the wrath of YHWH; I am weary of holding it in. Pour it out on the child in the street and on the gathering of young men together; for even husband with wife will be caught, the old with the one full of days.
And their houses will be turned over to others, fields and wives together; for I will stretch out my hand against the inhabitants of the land — the declaration of YHWH.
For from their least to their greatest, all of them are gaining unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, all of them are doing falsehood.
And they have healed the shattering of my people lightly, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they did an abomination? They were not at all ashamed; they did not even know how to feel disgrace. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; at the time I call them to account they will stumble, says YHWH.
Thus says YHWH: Stand at the roads and look, and ask for the ancient paths — where the good way is — and walk in it, and find rest for your selves. But they said, "We will not walk in it."
And I raised up watchmen over you: "Pay attention to the sound of the ram's horn!" But they said, "We will not pay attention."
Therefore hear, O nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
Hear, O earth! Look, I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes; for to my words they have not paid attention, and my law — they have rejected it.
Why is this to me — frankincense that comes from Sheba, and the good cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not for acceptance, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.
Therefore thus says YHWH: Here I am, putting stumbling blocks before this people, and they will stumble over them — fathers and sons together, neighbour and his friend — and they will perish.
Thus says YHWH: Look, a people is coming from a land of the north, and a great nation will be roused from the remotest parts of the earth.
Bow and javelin they take hold of; cruel it is, and they show no mercy. Their sound roars like the sea, and on horses they ride, drawn up as a man for battle against you, daughter of Zion.
We have heard the report of it; our hands hang limp. Distress has taken hold of us, anguish like a woman giving birth.
Do not go out into the field, and do not walk on the road; for the enemy has a sword — terror all around.
Daughter of my people, gird on sackcloth and roll in ashes. Make for yourself the mourning of an only child, a wailing of bitterness; for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
An assayer I have made you among my people, a fortification, that you may know and test their way.
All of them are stubborn rebels, walking about in slander. They are bronze and iron; all of them are destroyers.
The bellows puff; from the fire the lead is finished. In vain the refiner has refined, and the evil ones have not been separated out.
"Rejected silver" they have called them, for YHWH has rejected them.

jeremiah_7.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Stand in the gate of the house of YHWH and proclaim there this word, and say: Hear the word of YHWH, all Judah, you who come in at these gates to bow down to YHWH.
Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Make your ways and your deeds good, and I will let you dwell in this place.
Do not trust for yourselves in the words of falsehood, saying: "The temple of YHWH, the temple of YHWH, the temple of YHWH are these!"
For if you thoroughly make your ways and your deeds good, if you thoroughly do justice between a man and his neighbour,
if you do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after other gods to your own harm,
then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old and for ever.
Look, you are trusting for yourselves in the words of falsehood, which are of no profit.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear to falsehood, make smoke to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you have not known,
and then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, "We are delivered!" — so as to go on doing all these abominations?
Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? I too — look, I have seen it — the declaration of YHWH.
For go now to my place that was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel.
And now, because you have done all these deeds — the declaration of YHWH — and I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not listen, and I called you, but you did not answer:
therefore I will do to the house that is called by my name, in which you are trusting, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
And I will cast you out from before my face, just as I cast out all your brothers, all the offspring of Ephraim.
And you — do not pray for this people, and do not lift up for them a cry of entreaty or a prayer, and do not press me, for I will not be hearing you.
Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes for the queen of the heavens; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods, so as to provoke me to anger.
Is it me they are provoking? — the declaration of YHWH. Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own faces?

Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, my anger and my wrath are being poured out on this place — on humankind and on the animals, and on the tree of the field and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and not be quenched.
Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
For I did not speak with your fathers, and I did not command them, on the day I brought them out from the land of Egypt, concerning matters of burnt offering and sacrifice.

But this is the word that I commanded them, saying: Listen to my voice, and I will be God to you and you will be a people to me; and walk in all the way that I command you, so that it may go well for you.
But they did not listen, and they did not incline their ear, but walked in counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart; and they went backward and not forward.
From the day your fathers came out from the land of Egypt until this day, I sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising early and sending;
but they did not listen to me and did not incline their ear, and they stiffened their neck. They did more evil than their fathers.
And you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; and you shall call to them, but they will not answer you.
And you shall say to them: This is the nation that did not listen to the voice of YHWH its God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished and has been cut off from their mouth.
Cut off your consecrated hair and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for YHWH has rejected and abandoned the generation of his fury.
For the sons of Judah have done what is evil in my eyes — the declaration of YHWH. They have set their detestable things in the house that is called by my name, to make it unclean.

And they have built the high places of the Topheth that is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire — which I did not command, and which did not come up on my heart.

Therefore, look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when it will no longer be said "the Topheth" and "the Valley of Ben-hinnom," but "the Valley of Slaughter"; and they will bury in Topheth for lack of room.
And the corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the heavens and for the animals of the earth, with none to frighten them away.

And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride; for the land will become a desolation.

jeremiah_8.t: At that time — the declaration of YHWH — they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah and the bones of its officials and the bones of the priests and the bones of the prophets and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their graves.

And they will spread them out to the sun and to the moon and to all the host of the heavens, which they loved and which they served and after which they walked and which they consulted and to which they bowed down. They will not be gathered and they will not be buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground.
And death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant that remains of this evil clan, in all the places that remain, where I have banished them — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH: Do people fall and not get up? Does one turn away and not turn back?
Why has this people, Jerusalem, turned away with a lasting turning away? They have kept hold of deceit; they have refused to turn back.

I have paid attention and listened: they do not speak rightly. There is no one who relents over his evil, saying, "What have I done?" Every one of them turns to his own course, like a horse rushing into the battle.
Even the stork in the heavens knows her appointed times, and the turtle-dove and the swift and the crane keep the time of their coming; but my people do not know the ordinance of YHWH.
How can you say, "We are wise, and the law of YHWH is with us"? Truly, look — into falsehood it has been turned by the false stylus of the scribes.
The wise will be put to shame, they will be dismayed and captured. Look, they have rejected the word of YHWH — and what wisdom is theirs?

Therefore I will give their wives to others, their fields to those who dispossess them; for from the small to the great, all of them are gaining unjust gain; from prophet to priest, all of them are doing falsehood.
And they have healed the shattering of the daughter of my people lightly, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they did an abomination? They were not at all ashamed; they did not know how to be shamed. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; at the time of their punishment they will stumble, says YHWH.
I will utterly make an end of them — the declaration of YHWH. There are no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf has withered; and what I gave them passes away from them.

Why are we sitting still? Gather yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities and perish there; for YHWH our God has silenced us and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against YHWH.
We waited for peace, and there was no good; for a time of healing, and look — terror.

From Dan is heard the snorting of his horses; at the sound of the neighing of his stallions all the land quakes. And they come and devour the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it.
For look, I am sending among you serpents, vipers, for which there is no charm, and they will bite you — the declaration of YHWH.
My cheer — over sorrow! Upon me my heart is faint.

Look — the sound of the cry for help of the daughter of my people from a distant land: "Is YHWH not in Zion? Is her king not in her?" Why have they provoked me to anger with their carved images, with foreign vapours?
The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, and we — we have not been saved.
For the shattering of the daughter of my people I am shattered; I am in mourning; desolation has taken hold of me.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the healing of the daughter of my people not come up?

jeremiah_9.t: Oh that my head were water and my eye a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of travellers, that I might leave my people and go from them! For all of them are adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
And they bend their tongue, their bow of falsehood; and not for faithfulness are they strong in the land. For from evil to evil they go out, and me they do not know — the declaration of YHWH.
Each of you, be on guard against his neighbour, and do not rely on any brother; for every brother utterly supplants, and every neighbour goes about slandering.
And each deceives his neighbour, and faithfulness they do not speak. They have taught their tongue to speak falsehood; they are weary with acting perversely.
Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; in deceit they have refused to know me — the declaration of YHWH.
Therefore thus says YHWH of hosts: Here I am, refining them and testing them; for how else shall I act, because of the daughter of my people?
Their tongue is a beaten arrow; it speaks deceit. With his mouth one speaks peace with his neighbour, but within him he sets his ambush.
Shall I not call them to account for these things — the declaration of YHWH — and on a nation such as this shall my self not avenge itself?

Over the mountains I will take up weeping and wailing, and over the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation; for they are burned up, with no one passing through, and no one hears the sound of livestock. From the birds of the heavens to the animals, they have fled, they are gone.
And I will make Jerusalem heaps of stones, a lair of jackals; and the cities of Judah I will make a waste, with no inhabitant.

Who is the wise man that may understand this, and to whom the mouth of YHWH has spoken, that he may declare it — why the land has perished, is burned up like the wilderness, with no one passing through?
And YHWH said: Because they have forsaken my law that I set before them, and have not listened to my voice and have not walked in it,
but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them —
therefore thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Here I am, feeding this people wormwood and giving them poisoned water to drink.
And I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send the sword after them until I have made an end of them.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Consider, and summon the wailing women, that they may come; and send to the skilled women, that they may come.
And let them hasten and take up a wailing over us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids flow with water.
For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion: "How we are devastated! We are utterly put to shame, for we have left the land, for they have cast down our dwellings."
For hear, O women, the word of YHWH, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters a wailing, and each woman her neighbour a lamentation.
For death has come up into our windows; it has entered our fortresses, to cut off the child from the street, the young men from the open places.
Speak: Thus is the declaration of YHWH — And the corpses of humankind will fall like dung on the face of the field, and like cut grain behind the reaper, with none to gather.
Thus says YHWH: Let not the wise boast in his wisdom, and let not the mighty boast in his might; let not the rich boast in his riches.

But in this let the one who boasts boast: that he has insight and knows me, that I am YHWH, who does steadfast love, justice and righteousness in the earth; for in these I delight — the declaration of YHWH.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will call to account everyone circumcised in the foreskin:

against Egypt and against Judah and against Edom and against the sons of Ammon and against Moab, and against all who have their temples clipped, who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised of heart.

jeremiah_10.t: Hear the word that YHWH has spoken to you, O house of Israel.
Thus says YHWH: Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be dismayed at the signs of the heavens, though the nations are dismayed at them.
For the statutes of the peoples are vapour: for it is a tree from the forest that someone cut down, the work of a craftsman's hands with the tool.
With silver and with gold he beautifies it; with nails and with hammers they fasten them, so that it will not totter.
They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, and they do not speak; they must be carried, for they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them, for they do no harm, and doing good is not in them either.
There is none like you, YHWH. You are great, and your name is great in strength.
Who would not fear you, King of the nations? For it befits you; for among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like you.
But all together they are stupid and foolish: the instruction of vapours — it is wood.
Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of a craftsman and of the hands of a metalsmith. Violet and purple are their clothing; they are all the work of skilled men.
But YHWH is a God of faithfulness; he is the living God and the everlasting King. At his rage the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure his indignation.
Thus you shall say to them: The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.
He made the earth by his power, established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.

At the sound of his giving forth, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens; and he makes clouds rise from the end of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
Every human is stupid, without knowledge; every metalsmith is put to shame by the idol, for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
They are vapour, a work of mockery; at the time of their punishment they will perish.
Not like these is the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed everything; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. YHWH of hosts is his name.
Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who dwell under siege.
For thus says YHWH: Look, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and I will bring distress on them, so that they may find it out.
Woe to me for my shattering! My wound is severe. But I said: Surely this is a sickness, and I will bear it.
My tent is devastated, and all my tent cords are snapped. My children have gone out from me, and they are no more. There is no one to pitch my tent again or to raise up my curtains.
For the shepherds have behaved stupidly, and they have not sought YHWH. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
The sound of a report! Look, it is coming — a great din from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
I know, YHWH, that a person's way is not his own, that it is not for one who walks to direct his step.
Correct me, YHWH, but only in justice — not in your anger, lest you make me few.

Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you, and on the clans that have not called on your name; for they have devoured Jacob — they have devoured him and made an end of him, and they have devastated his habitation.

jeremiah_11.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Hear the words of this covenant, and speak them to the man of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Cursed is the man who does not hear the words of this covenant,

which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them out from the land of Egypt, from the furnace of iron, saying: Listen to my voice and do them, according to all that I command you; and you shall be a people to me, and I will be God to you —
so as to carry out the oath that I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day. And I answered and said: Amen, YHWH.
And YHWH said to me: Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
For I solemnly warned your fathers on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt, and until this day, rising early and warning, saying: Listen to my voice.

But they did not listen and did not incline their ear, and each walked in the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do and they did not do.
And YHWH said to me: A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

They have turned back to the iniquities of their former fathers, who refused to hear my words; and they themselves have walked after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I cut with their fathers.
Therefore thus says YHWH: Look, I am bringing on them a disaster that they cannot go out from; and they will cry out to me, and I will not listen to them.
And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they make smoke, but they will certainly not deliver them at the time of their calamity.
For as the number of your cities are your gods, O Judah; and as the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the Shame, altars to make smoke to Baal.
And you — do not pray for this people, and do not lift up for them a cry of entreaty or a prayer; for I will not be listening at the time they call to me about their calamity.
What has my beloved to do in my house, her doing the scheme, the many? And holy flesh — will they pass away from you? For your evil — then you exult.
"A luxuriant olive tree, beautiful in shapely fruit" — YHWH called your name. At the sound of a great roar he has kindled fire against it, and its branches are broken.

And YHWH of hosts, who planted you, has spoken disaster against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves, provoking me to anger by making smoke to Baal.
And YHWH made it known to me, and I knew. Then you showed me their deeds.

And I was like a docile lamb led to the slaughter, and I did not know that against me they had planned plans: "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, and his name will be remembered no more."
But YHWH of hosts, who judges righteousness, who tests kidneys and heart — let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have made known my case.
Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the men of Anathoth, who are seeking your life, saying: "You shall not prophesy in the name of YHWH, or you will die by our hand" —
therefore thus says YHWH of hosts: Look, I am calling them to account. The young men will die by the sword; their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
And there will be no remnant for them, for I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth — the year of their punishment.

jeremiah_12.t: You are righteous, YHWH, when I bring a case to you; yet judgements I will speak with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are all who deal treachery at ease?
You planted them; they have also taken root. They go on; they have also produced fruit. You are near in their mouth and far from their kidneys.
But you, YHWH, know me; you see me, and you have tested my heart with you. Drag them away like sheep for slaughter, and set them apart for a day of killing.
How long will the land mourn and the vegetation of every field wither, because of the evil of those who dwell in it? Beasts and birds have been swept away, for they said, "He will not see our end."
If you have run with foot soldiers and they have wearied you, how then will you compete with horses? And in a land of peace you feel secure — but how will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?

For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; even they have called out after you at full voice. Do not trust them, though they speak good things to you.
I have forsaken my house, I have abandoned my inheritance; I have given the beloved of my self into the hand of her enemies.
My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest; she has given her voice against me; therefore I hate her.
Is my inheritance a hyena, a bird of prey, to me, with birds of prey all around against her? Go, gather all the animals of the field; bring them to eat.
Many shepherds have ruined my vineyard; they have trodden down my portion; they have made the portion of my delight a wilderness of desolation.
He has made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns to me. All the land is made desolate, for there is no one who takes it to heart.
Over all the bare heights in the wilderness destroyers have come; for a sword of YHWH is devouring from one end of the land to the other end of the land. There is no peace for any flesh.
They have sown wheat and reaped thorns; they have worn themselves out and have not profited. Be ashamed of your harvests, because of the burning of YHWH's anger.

Thus says YHWH concerning all my evil neighbours who touch the inheritance that I gave my people Israel to inherit: Look, I am plucking them up from upon their own ground, and the house of Judah I will pluck up from among them.
And it will be, after I have plucked them up, I will turn back and have compassion on them, and I will bring them back, each to his own inheritance and each to his own land.

And it will be, if they will indeed learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, "As YHWH lives," just as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of my people.
But if they will not listen, then I will utterly pluck up that nation and destroy it — the declaration of YHWH.

jeremiah_13.t: Thus said YHWH to me: Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it on your loins, but do not bring it into water.
And I bought the loincloth according to the word of YHWH, and I put it on my loins.
And the word of YHWH came to me a second time, saying:
Take the loincloth that you bought, which is on your loins, and arise, go to Perath and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.
And I went and hid it at Perath, just as YHWH had commanded me.
And it was, at the end of many days, YHWH said to me: Arise, go to Perath and take from there the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.
And I went to Perath and dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it; and look — the loincloth was ruined; it was profitable for nothing.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Thus says YHWH: In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart and have walked after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them — let it be like this loincloth, which is profitable for nothing.

For just as the loincloth clings to a man's loins, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me — the declaration of YHWH — to be to me a people, and a name, and a praise, and a splendour; but they did not listen.

And you shall speak this word to them: Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And they will say to you: Do we not know very well that every wineskin will be filled with wine?

And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am filling all the inhabitants of this land — and the kings who sit for David on his throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem — with drunkenness.

And I will smash them one against another, both the fathers and the sons together — the declaration of YHWH. I will not show pity, and I will not spare, and I will not have compassion, from destroying them.
Hear and give ear; do not be haughty, for YHWH has spoken.

Give glory to YHWH your God before he brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on the mountains of twilight; and you wait for light, and he makes it deep darkness, and turns it to thick darkness.
But if you will not listen to it, my self will weep in secret places because of pride; and my eye will weep bitterly and run down with tears, for the flock of YHWH has been taken captive.
Say to the king and to the queen mother: Make yourselves low, sit down, for it has come down from your heads, your crown of splendour.
The cities of the Negev are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is taken into exile, all of it; taken into exile completely.
Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, the sheep of your splendour?
What will you say when he appoints over you — and you yourself taught them to be over you — close companions as your head? Will not pangs seize you like a woman in labour?
And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things happened to me?" — for the greatness of your iniquity your skirts have been uncovered, your heels have suffered violence.
Can a Cushite change his skin, or a leopard his spots? Then you too could do good, you who are trained to do evil.
And I will scatter them like chaff passing away to the wind of the wilderness.
This is your lot, the portion of your measure from me — the declaration of YHWH — because you have forgotten me and trusted in falsehood.
And I myself have stripped your skirts up over your face, and your shame is seen.
Your adulteries and your neighings, the wickedness of your whoring — on the hills, in the field, I have seen your detestable things. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be clean. After how long yet?

jeremiah_14.t: What came as the word of YHWH to Jeremiah concerning the matters of the droughts:
Judah mourns, and her gates languish; they are in mourning down to the ground, and the outcry of Jerusalem has gone up.

And their nobles have sent their servants for water. They came to the cisterns and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty. They were ashamed and humiliated, and they covered their heads.
Because the ground is cracked, for there has been no rain in the land, the farmers are ashamed; they have covered their heads.
For even the doe in the field has given birth and abandoned it, for there is no grass.
And wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; they pant for breath like jackals. Their eyes fail, for there is no vegetation.
Though our iniquities testify against us, YHWH, act for the sake of your name; for our turnings away are many; against you we have sinned.
Hope of Israel, its deliverer in a time of distress, why are you like a sojourner in the land, like a traveller who has turned aside to spend the night?
Why are you like a man astounded, like a warrior who cannot save? Yet you are in our midst, YHWH, and your name is called over us. Do not leave us!

Thus says YHWH concerning this people: So they have loved to wander; they have not restrained their feet. And YHWH has not accepted them; now he will remember their iniquity and call their sins to account.
And YHWH said to me: Do not pray for this people, for their good.

When they fast, I will not be listening to their cry of entreaty; and when they offer up a burnt offering and a grain offering, I will not be accepting them. For by the sword and by famine and by pestilence I am bringing them to an end.
And I said: Alas, Lord YHWH! Look, the prophets are saying to them: You will not see the sword, and famine will not come to you; for I will give you a peace of faithfulness in this place.

And YHWH said to me: The prophets are prophesying falsehood in my name. I did not send them, and I did not command them, and I did not speak to them. A vision of falsehood, and divination, and a worthless thing, and the deceit of their own heart — that is what they are prophesying to you.

Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name — and I did not send them — and who say, "Sword and famine will not be in this land": By sword and by famine those prophets will meet their end.

And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, with no one to bury them — them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. And I will pour out their evil upon them.

And you shall speak to them this word: Let my eyes run down with tears, night and day, and let them not cease; for with a great shattering the virgin daughter of my people is shattered, with a wound made very grievous.
If I go out into the field — look, those slain by the sword; and if I enter the city — look, the diseases of famine. For both prophet and priest have gone about in a land they do not know.
Have you utterly rejected Judah? Does your self abhor Zion? Why have you struck us with no healing for us? We waited for peace, and there was no good; for a time of healing, and look — terror.
We know, YHWH, our wickedness, the iniquity of our fathers; for against you we have sinned.
Do not spurn, for the sake of your name; do not treat with contempt the throne of your glory. Remember — do not break your covenant with us.
Are there among the vapours of the nations any that send rain? Or do the heavens themselves give showers? Is it not you, YHWH our God? So we wait for you, for you have made all these things.

jeremiah_15.t: And YHWH said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me, my self would not be toward this people. Send them away from before my face, and let them go out.

And it will be, when they say to you, "Where shall we go out?", you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH: Those who are for death, to death; and those who are for the sword, to the sword; and those who are for famine, to famine; and those who are for captivity, to captivity.
And I will appoint over them four kinds — the declaration of YHWH — the sword to kill, and the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the heavens and the animals of the earth to devour and to destroy.
And I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, on account of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.
For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? And who will show sympathy for you? And who will turn aside to ask after your welfare?
You yourself abandoned me — the declaration of YHWH — you keep going backward. So I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you; I am weary of relenting.
And I have winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land. I have bereaved, I have destroyed my people; from their ways they did not turn back.

Their widows have become more numerous to me than the sand of the seas. I have brought against them, against the mother of a young man, a destroyer at noon. I have made anguish and sudden terrors fall upon her suddenly.

She who bore seven has grown feeble; she has breathed out her life. Her sun has set while it was still day; she is ashamed and abashed. And the rest of them I will give to the sword before their enemies — the declaration of YHWH.
Woe to me, my mother, that you bore me, a man of strife and a man of contention to all the land! I have not lent, and they have not lent to me, yet all of them curse me.
YHWH said: Surely I have set you free for good; surely I have made the enemy plead with you in a time of evil and in a time of distress.
Can one break iron — iron from the north — and bronze?
Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without price, and that for all your sins throughout all your territories.
And I will make your enemies pass over into a land you do not know; for a fire is kindled in my anger — it will burn against you.
You know, YHWH. Remember me and attend to me, and avenge me on those who harass me. In your long anger do not take me away; know that for your sake I bear reproach.
Your words were found, and I ate them, and your word became to me a joy and the delight of my heart; for your name is called over me, YHWH, God of hosts.
I have not sat in the company of merrymakers and rejoiced; because of your hand I sat alone, for you filled me with indignation.
Why has my pain become perpetual, and my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will you really be to me like a deceitful stream, waters that are not reliable?

Therefore thus says YHWH: If you turn back, I will bring you back; you will stand before me. And if you bring out what is precious from what is worthless, you will be as my mouth. They will turn back to you, but you shall not turn back to them.

And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; and they will fight against you but will not prevail over you, for I am with you to save you and to deliver you — the declaration of YHWH.
And I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and ransom you from the palm of the ruthless.

jeremiah_16.t: And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
You shall not take a wife for yourself, and you shall not have sons or daughters in this place.
For thus says YHWH concerning the sons and concerning the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and concerning their fathers who fathered them in this land:

They will die deaths of diseases; they will not be mourned and they will not be buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground. And by the sword and by famine they will come to an end, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the heavens and for the animals of the earth.

For thus says YHWH: Do not enter a house of mourning, and do not go to lament, and do not show sympathy for them; for I have withdrawn my peace from this people — the declaration of YHWH — the steadfast love and the compassion.
And great and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, and no one will lament for them, and no one will cut himself or make himself bald for them.
And no one will break bread for them in mourning, to comfort him for the dead; and no one will give them the cup of consolations to drink, for his father or for his mother.
And you shall not enter a house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

For thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am causing to cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride.

And it will be, when you tell this people all these words, and they say to you, "For what has YHWH spoken against us all this great disaster? And what is our iniquity, and what is our sin that we have sinned against YHWH our God?" —
then you shall say to them: Because your fathers forsook me — the declaration of YHWH — and walked after other gods and served them and bowed down to them, and forsook me and did not keep my law;
and you yourselves have done more evil than your fathers; and look, you are walking, each after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so as not to listen to me.
So I will hurl you from upon this land to the land that you have not known, you and your fathers; and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will grant you no favour.
Therefore, look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when it will no longer be said, "As YHWH lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,"

but, "As YHWH lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where he had banished them." And I will bring them back to their own ground, which I gave to their fathers.

Look, I am sending for many fishermen — the declaration of YHWH — and they will fish them out; and after that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and from every hill and from the clefts of the rocks.
For my eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from before me, and their iniquity is not concealed from before my eyes.
And first I will repay double their iniquity and their sin, because they profaned my land with the corpses of their detestable things, and filled my inheritance with their abominations.

YHWH, my strength and my stronghold, my refuge in a day of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say: Our fathers inherited only falsehood, vapour, and there was nothing in them that profits.
Can a human make gods for himself? And they are not gods!
Therefore, look, I am making them know — this time I will make them know my hand and my might; and they will know that my name is YHWH.

jeremiah_17.t: The sin of Judah is written with a stylus of iron, with a point of flint engraved on the tablet of their heart and on the horns of your altars.
as their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by every luxuriant tree, on the high hills.
My mountain in the field — your wealth, all your treasures I will give as plunder, your high places, for sin throughout all your territories.

And you will let go, and through yourself, of your inheritance that I gave you; and I will make you serve your enemies in the land that you do not know; for a fire you have kindled in my anger — for ever it will burn.
Thus says YHWH: Cursed is the man who trusts in humankind and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart turns aside from YHWH.
And he will be like a bush in the desert plain, and he will not see when good comes; and he will dwell in parched places in the wilderness, a land of salt that is not inhabited.
Blessed is the man who trusts in YHWH, and YHWH is his trust.

And he will be like a tree planted by water, which sends out its roots by a stream; and it will not see when heat comes, and its leaf will be luxuriant; and in a year of drought it will not be anxious, and it will not cease from producing fruit.
The heart is more crooked than all, and it is incurable. Who can know it?
I, YHWH, search the heart, test the kidneys, and give to each according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds.
A partridge that gathers a brood it did not lay — so is one who makes wealth and not with justice. In the middle of his days it will leave him, and at his end he will be a fool.
A throne of glory, a high place from the first, is the place of our sanctuary.
Hope of Israel, YHWH! All who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn from me will be written in the earth, for they have forsaken the spring of living water, YHWH.
