Heal me, YHWH, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
Look, they are saying to me: "Where is the word of YHWH? Let it come, then!"
But I have not hurried away from being a shepherd after you, and the incurable day I have not desired. You know: what came out of my lips was before your face.
Do not become to me an object of terror; you are my refuge in a day of disaster.
Let my pursuers be put to shame, and let me not be put to shame; let them be dismayed, and let me not be dismayed. Bring on them a day of disaster, and with double shattering shatter them.
Thus said YHWH to me: Go and stand in the gate of the sons of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them: Hear the word of YHWH, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem who come in at these gates.
Thus says YHWH: Take heed for your lives, and do not carry a burden on the sabbath day, and do not bring it in at the gates of Jerusalem.
And you shall not bring out a burden from your houses on the sabbath day, and you shall do no work; and you shall set apart the sabbath day as holy, just as I commanded your fathers.
But they did not listen and did not incline their ear; and they stiffened their neck so as not to listen and not to accept correction.

And it will be, if you will indeed listen to me — the declaration of YHWH — not to bring a burden in at the gates of this city on the sabbath day, and to set apart the sabbath day as holy, so as to do no work on it,

then there will come in at the gates of this city kings and officials sitting on the throne of David, riding in the chariot and on horses — they and their officials, the man of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem — and this city will remain for ever.

And they will come from the cities of Judah and from around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin and from the Shephelah and from the hill country and from the Negev, bringing burnt offering and sacrifice and grain offering and frankincense, and bringing a thank offering to the house of YHWH.

But if you will not listen to me, to set apart the sabbath day as holy, and not to carry a burden and come in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in her gates, and it will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem, and it will not be extinguished.

jeremiah_18.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Arise and go down to the house of the potter, and there I will make you hear my words.
And I went down to the house of the potter, and there he was, doing work on the stones.
And the vessel that he was making with the clay was spoiled in the potter's hand; and he would turn back and make it into another vessel, just as it was right in the potter's eyes to make.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Can I not do to you as this potter does, house of Israel? — the declaration of YHWH. Look, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
At one moment I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to pull down and to destroy;
and if that nation turns back from its evil, concerning which I spoke, then I will relent concerning the disaster that I planned to do to it.
And at one moment I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant;
and if it does the evil in my eyes, so as not to listen to my voice, then I will relent concerning the good that I said I would do to it.

And now, say to the man of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am shaping disaster against you and planning a plan against you. Turn back now, each from his evil way, and make your ways and your deeds good.
But they say: It is hopeless. For we will walk after our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.
Therefore thus says YHWH: Ask now among the nations: Who has heard the like of these? A most horrible thing the virgin of Israel has done.
Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rock of the field? Are the strange, cool, flowing waters plucked up?
But my people have forgotten me; they make smoke to a delusion. And they have made them stumble in their ways, the paths of old, to walk in bypaths, on a way not built up,
to make their land a waste, a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will wag his head.
Like an east wind I will scatter them before the enemy. I will show them the back and not the face on the day of their doom.

And they said: Come, let us plan plans against Jeremiah; for law will not be lost from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.
Be attentive to me, YHWH, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
Is evil repaid in place of good? For they have dug a pit for my life. Remember my standing before you to speak good on their behalf, to turn back your wrath from them.

Therefore give their children to famine and pour them out onto the hands of the sword; and let their wives become bereaved of children and widows, and let their men be slain by death, their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a marauding band upon them suddenly; for they have dug a pit to capture me, and they have hidden snares for my feet.

And you, YHWH, know all their plan against me, for death. Do not make atonement for their iniquity, and do not wipe out their sin from before you. Let them be overthrown before you; in the time of your anger deal with them.

jeremiah_19.t: Thus said YHWH: Go and buy a potter's earthenware flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests;
and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is at the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I speak to you.

And you shall say: Hear the word of YHWH, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am bringing disaster on this place, such that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

Because they have forsaken me and treated this place as foreign, and made smoke in it to other gods whom neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have known, and have filled this place with the blood of the innocent;
and they have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal — which I did not command and did not speak, and which did not come up on my heart.
Therefore, look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when this place will no longer be called the Topheth and the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

And I will make void the plan of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their life; and I will give their corpses as food to the birds of the heavens and to the animals of the earth.
And I will make this city a waste and a hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will hiss over all its wounds.

And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each will eat the flesh of his neighbour, in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies and those who seek their life will press them.
And you shall break the flask before the eyes of the men who go with you,

and say to them: Thus says YHWH of hosts: So will I shatter this people and this city, as one shatters a potter's vessel that can no longer be repaired; and in Topheth they will bury, for lack of room to bury.
So I will do to this place — the declaration of YHWH — and to its inhabitants, making this city like Topheth.

And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be like the place of the Topheth — the unclean ones — all the houses on whose roofs they made smoke to all the host of the heavens and poured out drink offerings to other gods.
And Jeremiah came from the Topheth, where YHWH had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of YHWH and said to all the people:

Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am bringing on this city and on all its towns all the disaster that I have spoken against it, because they have stiffened their neck so as not to hear my words.

jeremiah_20.t: And Pashhur son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of YHWH, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
And Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of YHWH.
And it was on the next day, and Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks; and Jeremiah said to him: Not Pashhur has YHWH called your name, but Terror All Around.

For thus says YHWH: Look, I am making you a terror to yourself and to all who love you; and they will fall by the sword of their enemies while your eyes look on. And all Judah I will give into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take them into exile to Babylon and strike them down with the sword.

And I will give all the wealth of this city and all its produce and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies; and they will plunder them and take them and bring them to Babylon.

And you, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity; and you will come to Babylon, and there you will die and there you will be buried — you and all who love you, to whom you have prophesied with falsehood.
You deceived me, YHWH, and I was deceived; you overpowered me and prevailed. I have become a laughing-stock all day long; every one of them mocks me.
For as often as I speak I cry out; "Violence and havoc!" I proclaim. For the word of YHWH has become for me a reproach and derision all day long.
And if I say, "I will not remember him, and I will not speak any more in his name," then it becomes in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones; and I am weary of holding it in, and I cannot.

For I have heard the whispering of many — Terror All Around! — "Denounce him! Let us denounce him!" Every man of my peace watches for my stumbling: "Perhaps he will be deceived, and we will prevail over him and take our vengeance on him."

But YHWH is with me like a ruthless warrior; therefore my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will be utterly put to shame, for they will not succeed — a perpetual ignominy that will not be forgotten.
And YHWH of hosts, who tests the righteous, who sees kidneys and heart — let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have made known my case.
Sing to YHWH! Praise YHWH! For he has delivered the life of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
Cursed be the day on which I was born! The day my mother bore me — let it not be blessed!
Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, saying, "A son has been born to you, a male!" — making him very glad.
And let that man be like the cities that YHWH overturned and did not relent; and let him hear a cry in the morning and an alarm at the time of noon,
because he did not kill me from the womb, so that my mother would have been my grave and her womb pregnant for ever.
Why is it that I came out from the womb to see trouble and sorrow, and my days are ended in shame?

jeremiah_21.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:
Seek YHWH on our behalf, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps YHWH will deal with us according to all his wonders, and he will go up from against us.
And Jeremiah said to them: Thus you shall say to Zedekiah:

Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Look, I am turning back the weapons of war that are in your hand, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are besieging you outside the wall; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, and in anger and in wrath and in great rage.
And I will strike down the inhabitants of this city, both humankind and the animals; by a great pestilence they will die.

And after that — the declaration of YHWH — I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people and those who remain in this city from the pestilence, from the sword and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life; and he will strike them down by the mouth of the sword. He will not spare them, and he will not show pity, and he will not have compassion.
And to this people you shall say: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

The one who remains in this city will die by the sword and by famine and by pestilence; and the one who goes out and falls to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and his life will be his as plunder.
For I have set my face against this city for harm and not for good — the declaration of YHWH. It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.
And to the house of the king of Judah: Hear the word of YHWH.

House of David, thus says YHWH: Judge justice in the morning, and deliver the robbed from the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire and burn with none to quench it, because of the evil of your deeds.
Look, I am against you, enthroned above the valley, rock of the plain — the declaration of YHWH — you who say, "Who will come down against us? And who will enter our lairs?"
And I will call you to account according to the fruit of your deeds — the declaration of YHWH — and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will consume everything around her.

jeremiah_22.t: Thus said YHWH: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
and say: Hear the word of YHWH, king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David — you and your servants and your people who come in at these gates.

Thus says YHWH: Do justice and righteousness, and deliver the robbed from the hand of the oppressor; and do not maltreat the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow, and do not treat them violently, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

For if you will indeed do this thing, then there will come in at the gates of this house kings sitting for David on his throne, riding in the chariot and on horses — he and his servants and his people.
But if you will not listen to these words, by myself I swear — the declaration of YHWH — that this house will become a ruin.
For thus says YHWH concerning the house of the king of Judah: Gilead you are to me, the top of Lebanon; yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that are not inhabited.
And I will set apart destroyers against you, each with his weapons; and they will cut down the choicest of your cedars and cast them on the fire.
And many nations will pass by this city, and each will say to his neighbour: For what did YHWH do thus to this great city?
And they will say: Because they forsook the covenant of YHWH their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.
Do not weep for the dead, and do not show sympathy for him. Weep bitterly for the one who goes away, for he will not return again and see the land of his birth.
For thus says YHWH concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, and who has gone out from this place: He will not return there again;
for in the place where they have taken him into exile, there he will die, and this land he will not see again.
Woe to the one who builds his house with no righteousness and his upper rooms with no justice, who makes his neighbour work for nothing and does not give him his wages;
who says, "I will build myself a house of great size and spacious upper rooms," and cuts out windows for himself, panelled with cedar and smeared with vermilion.
Do you reign because you compete in cedar? Your father — did he not eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
He defended the cause of the poor and the needy; then it was well. Is not that the knowing of me? — the declaration of YHWH.
For your eyes and your heart are on nothing but your unjust gain, and on shedding the blood of the innocent, and on oppression and on extortion, to do it.

Therefore thus says YHWH concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: They will not lament for him: "Alas, my brother!" and "Alas, sister!" They will not lament for him: "Alas, lord!" and "Alas, his splendour!"
With the burial of a donkey he will be buried — dragged and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan give forth your voice; and cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are shattered.
I spoke to you in your prosperity; you said, "I will not listen." This has been your way from your youth, for you have not listened to my voice.
The wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then indeed you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your evil.
You who dwell in Lebanon, nested among the cedars, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, anguish like a woman in labour!
As I live — the declaration of YHWH — even if Coniah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, from there I would pull you off.

And I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of those before whom you are afraid, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
And I will hurl you and your mother who bore you into another land, where you were not born; and there you will die.
And to the land to which they lift up their desire to return, there they will not return.
Is this man Coniah a despised, smashed pot, or a vessel no one delights in? Why have they been hurled out, he and his offspring, and thrown into a land they do not know?
Land, land, land, hear the word of YHWH!
Thus says YHWH: Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for none of his offspring will prosper, sitting on the throne of David and ruling over Judah again.

jeremiah_23.t: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the flock of my pasture — the declaration of YHWH.

Therefore thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, concerning the shepherds who shepherd my people: You have scattered my flock and driven them away, and you have not attended to them. Look, I am calling you to account for the evil of your deeds — the declaration of YHWH.
And I myself will gather the remnant of my flock from all the lands where I have banished them, and I will bring them back to their pasture; and they will be fruitful and increase.
And I will raise up over them shepherds who will shepherd them; and they will no longer be afraid or be dismayed, and none will be missing — the declaration of YHWH.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch; and a king will reign and act prudently, and will do justice and righteousness in the land.
In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell in security. And this is his name by which he will be called: YHWH Our Righteousness.
Therefore, look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when they will no longer say, "As YHWH lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,"
but, "As YHWH lives, who brought up and who brought the offspring of the house of Israel from a land northward and from all the lands where I banished them." And they will dwell on their own ground.
Concerning the prophets: My heart is shattered within me; all my bones tremble. I have become like a drunken man, like a man whom wine has overcome, because of YHWH and because of his holy words.
For the land is full of adulterers; for because of a curse the land mourns, the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. And their course has become evil, and their strength is not right.
For both prophet and priest are polluted; even in my house I have found their evil — the declaration of YHWH.

Therefore their way will become for them like slippery places in the darkness; they will be driven on and fall in it. For I will bring disaster on them, the year of their punishment — the declaration of YHWH.
And among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: they prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: committing adultery and walking in falsehood; and they strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns back from his evil. All of them have become to me like Sodom, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.

Therefore thus says YHWH of hosts concerning the prophets: Look, I am feeding them wormwood and giving them poisoned water to drink; for from the prophets of Jerusalem pollution has gone out to all the land.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They are filling you with vapour; they speak the vision of their own heart, not from the mouth of YHWH.
They keep saying to those who despise me: "YHWH has spoken: Peace shall be yours." And to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his heart they say: "Disaster will not come upon you."
For who has stood in the council of YHWH to see and to hear his word? Who has paid attention to his word and listened?
Look — the storm of YHWH! Wrath has gone out, a whirling storm; on the head of the wicked it will whirl.
The anger of YHWH will not turn back until he has done and until he has carried out the purposes of his heart. At the end of the days you will understand it with understanding.
I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
But if they had stood in my council, they would have made my people hear my words, and they would have turned them back from their evil way and from the evil of their deeds.
Am I a God from near — the declaration of YHWH — and not a God from far off?
Can a man hide himself in hiding places and I not see him? — the declaration of YHWH. Do I not fill the heavens and the earth? — the declaration of YHWH.
I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy falsehood in my name, saying: I have dreamed! I have dreamed!
How long? Is there anything in the heart of the prophets who prophesy falsehood, prophets of the deceit of their own heart —
who plan to make my people forget my name by their dreams, which they recount to one another, just as their fathers forgot my name for Baal?
The prophet who has a dream, let him recount the dream; and the one who has my word, let him speak my word in faithfulness. What has the straw to do with the grain? — the declaration of YHWH.
Is not my word like fire? — the declaration of YHWH — and like a hammer that smashes rock?
Therefore, look, I am against the prophets — the declaration of YHWH — who steal my words, each from his neighbour.
Look, I am against the prophets — the declaration of YHWH — who take their tongue and utter a declaration.

Look, I am against those who prophesy dreams of falsehood — the declaration of YHWH — and recount them and lead my people astray by their falsehoods and by their recklessness; and I did not send them and did not command them, and they certainly do not benefit this people — the declaration of YHWH.
And when this people, or the prophet or a priest, asks you, saying, "What is the burden of YHWH?", you shall say to them: "What burden?" And I will abandon you — the declaration of YHWH.
And the prophet and the priest and the people who say, "The burden of YHWH" — I will call that man and his house to account.
Thus you shall say, each to his neighbour and each to his brother: What has YHWH answered? and What has YHWH spoken?
And the burden of YHWH you shall not mention again, for the burden is each man's own word; and you have overturned the words of the living God, YHWH of hosts, our God.
Thus you shall say to the prophet: What has YHWH answered you? and What has YHWH spoken?
But if you say, "The burden of YHWH" — therefore thus says YHWH: Because you have spoken this word, "The burden of YHWH," when I sent to you, saying, You shall not say, "The burden of YHWH" —
therefore, look, I will surely forget you and lift you up, and I will abandon you and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, from before my face.
And I will put on you a perpetual reproach and a perpetual shame that will not be forgotten.

jeremiah_24.t: YHWH showed me, and there were two baskets of figs set before the temple of YHWH — after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken into exile Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the officials of Judah and the craftsman and the smith, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
One basket was very good figs, like first-ripe figs; and one basket was very bad figs, which could not be eaten for their badness.
And YHWH said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said: Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, which cannot be eaten for their badness.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so I will regard for good the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
And I will set my eye on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; and I will build them and not pull them down, and I will plant them and not pluck them up.
And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am YHWH; and they will be a people to me, and I will be God to them, for they will return to me with all their heart.

And like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten for their badness — for thus says YHWH — so I will make Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials and the remnant of Jerusalem, those who remain in this land and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
And I will make them a horror, an evil, to all the kingdoms of the earth — a reproach and a byword, a taunt and a curse in all the places where I will banish them.
And I will send against them the sword, the famine and the pestilence, until they are finished from upon the ground that I gave to them and to their fathers.

jeremiah_25.t: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah — that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon —
which Jeremiah the prophet spoke concerning all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, and until this day — these twenty-three years — the word of YHWH has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you have not listened.
And YHWH sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending, but you did not listen and did not incline your ear to listen.
saying: Turn back now, each from his evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and dwell on the ground that YHWH gave to you and to your fathers, from of old and for ever.
And do not walk after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them; and do not provoke me to anger with the work of your hands, and I will not do harm to you.
But you did not listen to me — the declaration of YHWH — so as to provoke me to anger with the work of your hands, to your own harm.
Therefore thus says YHWH of hosts: Because you have not listened to my words,

look, I am sending and I will fetch all the clans of the north — the declaration of YHWH — and Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, my servant; and I will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all these nations round about. And I will devote them to destruction and make them a waste and a hissing and perpetual ruins.
And I will destroy from them the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride, the sound of the hand-mill and the light of the lamp.
And all this land will become a desolation, a waste; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

And it will be, when seventy years are completed, I will call to account the king of Babylon and that nation — the declaration of YHWH — for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it perpetual desolations.
And I will bring on that land all my words that I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
For many nations and great kings will make them serve, they also; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.
For thus said YHWH, the God of Israel, to me: Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
And they will drink and stagger and act like madmen, because of the sword that I am sending among them.
And I took the cup from the hand of YHWH and made all the nations to whom YHWH sent me drink:
Jerusalem and the cities of Judah and its kings, its officials — to make them a ruin, a waste, a hissing and a curse, as at this day;
Pharaoh king of Egypt and his servants and his officials and all his people;
and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines — Ashkelon and Gaza and Ekron and the remnant of Ashdod;
Edom and Moab and the sons of Ammon;
and all the kings of Tyre and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland that is beyond the sea;
Dedan and Tema and Buz, and all who have their temples clipped;
and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
and all the kings of Zimri and all the kings of Elam and all the kings of Media;
and all the kings of the north, near and far, each to his brother, and all the kingdoms of the earth that are on the face of the ground. And the king of Sheshach will drink after them.
And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink and be drunk and vomit, and fall and do not rise, because of the sword that I am sending among you.
And it will be, if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH of hosts: You shall surely drink!

For look, in the city that is called by my name I am beginning to do harm, and shall you be utterly exempt from punishment? You shall not be exempt, for I am calling a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.

And you, prophesy to them all these words, and say to them: YHWH roars from on high and from his holy dwelling gives forth his voice. He roars mightily over his habitation; he raises a shout like those who tread, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
An uproar has come to the end of the earth, for YHWH has a case against the nations; he is entering into judgement with all flesh. The wicked he has given to the sword — the declaration of YHWH.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Look, disaster is going out from nation to nation, and a great storm is being roused from the remotest parts of the earth.

And the slain of YHWH on that day will be from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. They will not be mourned and not gathered and not buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground.
Wail, shepherds, and cry out; roll in ashes, nobles of the flock! For your days for slaughter are completed, and your dispersions; and you will fall like a vessel of desire.
And a place of escape will be lost from the shepherds, and escape from the nobles of the flock.
The sound of the cry of the shepherds and the wailing of the nobles of the flock! For YHWH is destroying their pasture,
and the peaceful pastures are devastated because of the burning of YHWH's anger.
He has left his lair like a young lion, for their land has become a waste because of the anger of the oppressor and because of the burning of his anger.

jeremiah_26.t: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from YHWH, saying:

Thus said YHWH: Stand in the court of the house of YHWH, and speak to all the cities of Judah who come to bow down at the house of YHWH all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them. Do not hold back a word.
Perhaps they will listen and turn back, each from his evil way; and I will relent concerning the disaster that I am planning to do to them because of the evil of their deeds.
And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH: If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law that I have set before you,
to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I am sending to you — rising early and sending, though you have not listened —
then I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will make a curse for all the nations of the earth.
And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of YHWH.
And it was, when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that YHWH had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying: You shall surely die!

Why have you prophesied in the name of YHWH, saying: This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, with no inhabitant? And all the people assembled against Jeremiah in the house of YHWH.
And the officials of Judah heard these things, and they came up from the house of the king to the house of YHWH, and they sat at the entrance of the New Gate of YHWH.
And the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people: A sentence of death for this man! For he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears.
And Jeremiah said to all the officials and to all the people: YHWH sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
And now, make your ways and your deeds good, and listen to the voice of YHWH your God; and YHWH will relent concerning the disaster that he has spoken against you.
And as for me, here I am in your hand; do to me according to what is good and right in your eyes.

Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you are bringing innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon its inhabitants; for in truth YHWH has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.
And the officials and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: There is no sentence of death for this man, for he has spoken to us in the name of YHWH our God.
And men from the elders of the land arose and said to all the assembly of the people:

Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah: Thus says YHWH of hosts: Zion will be ploughed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house, high places of a forest.

Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah actually put him to death? Did he not fear YHWH and entreat the face of YHWH, so that YHWH relented concerning the disaster he had spoken against them? And we are about to do a great evil against our own lives.
And there was also a man prophesying in the name of YHWH, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
And King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and all the officials heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. And Uriah heard, and he was afraid and fled and went to Egypt.
And King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt — Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him — to Egypt.
And they brought Uriah out from Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, and he struck him with the sword and threw his corpse into the graves of the sons of the people.
Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he was not given into the hand of the people to be put to death.

jeremiah_27.t: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Thus said YHWH to me: Make for yourself bonds and yoke-bars, and put them on your neck.

And send them to the king of Edom and to the king of Moab and to the king of the sons of Ammon and to the king of Tyre and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
And command them to say to their masters: Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Thus you shall say to your masters:
I myself made the earth, humankind and the animals that are on the face of the earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I give it to whomever is right in my eyes.
And now I myself have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, my servant; and I have also given him the animals of the field to serve him.
And all the nations will serve him, and his son and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes, and many nations and great kings make him serve.

And it will be, the nation and the kingdom that will not serve him — Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon — and that will not put its neck into the yoke of the king of Babylon: with the sword and with famine and with pestilence I will call that nation to account — the declaration of YHWH — until I have finished them by his hand.
And as for you, do not listen to your prophets and to your diviners and to your dreams and to your soothsayers and to your sorcerers, who say to you: You shall not serve the king of Babylon.
For falsehood they are prophesying to you, so as to remove you far from your ground, and I will drive you out and you will perish.
But the nation that brings its neck into the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will let it remain on its own ground — the declaration of YHWH — and it will work it and dwell in it.
And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying: Bring your necks into the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
Why should you die, you and your people, by the sword, by famine and by pestilence, as YHWH has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
And do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you: You shall not serve the king of Babylon — for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
For I did not send them — the declaration of YHWH — and they are prophesying in my name to falsehood, so that I drive you out and you perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you.

And to the priests and to all this people I spoke, saying: Thus says YHWH: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying: Look, the articles of the house of YHWH are about to be brought back from Babylon now, quickly — for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a ruin?

And if they are prophets, and if the word of YHWH is with them, let them now entreat YHWH of hosts, that the articles remaining in the house of YHWH and the house of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem may not go to Babylon.
For thus says YHWH of hosts concerning the pillars and concerning the sea and concerning the stands and concerning the rest of the articles that remain in this city,
which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he took into exile Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
For thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the articles that remain in the house of YHWH and the house of the king of Judah and Jerusalem:
They will be taken to Babylon, and there they will remain until the day I attend to them — the declaration of YHWH — and I bring them up and bring them back to this place.

jeremiah_28.t: And it was in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah son of Azzur the prophet, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of YHWH, before the eyes of the priests and all the people:
Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Within two years' time I am bringing back to this place all the articles of the house of YHWH that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took from this place and brought to Babylon.

And Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles of Judah who went to Babylon I am bringing back to this place — the declaration of YHWH — for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
And Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet, before the eyes of the priests and before the eyes of all the people who were standing in the house of YHWH —

and Jeremiah the prophet said: Amen! May YHWH do so; may YHWH carry out your words that you have prophesied, to bring back the articles of the house of YHWH and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
Nevertheless, hear now this word that I am about to speak in your ears and in the ears of all the people:
The prophets who were before me and before you, from of old, prophesied against many lands and against great kingdoms, of war and of disaster and of pestilence.
The prophet who prophesies of peace — when the word of that prophet comes to pass, the prophet will be known, the one whom YHWH has truly sent.
And Hananiah the prophet took the yoke-bar from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.

And Hananiah said before the eyes of all the people: Thus says YHWH: So will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon within two years' time from off the neck of all the nations. And Jeremiah the prophet went his way.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke-bar from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying:
Go and say to Hananiah: Thus says YHWH: Yoke-bars of wood you have broken, but you will make in their place yoke-bars of iron.

For thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: A yoke of iron I have put on the neck of all these nations, to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. And I have also given him the animals of the field.
And Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet: Listen now, Hananiah: YHWH did not send you, and you have made this people rely on falsehood.
Therefore thus says YHWH: Look, I am casting you out from off the face of the ground. This year you are to die, for you have spoken rebellion against YHWH.
And Hananiah the prophet died in that year, in the seventh month.

jeremiah_29.t: And these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders of the exile, and to the priests and to the prophets and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon,
after Jeconiah the king and the queen mother and the court officials, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsman and the smith had gone out from Jerusalem —
by the hand of Eleasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying:
Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel, to all the exiles whom I have sent into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:
Build houses and dwell in them, and plant gardens and eat their produce.
Take wives and father sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; and multiply there and do not diminish.
And seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray for it to YHWH; for in its welfare you will have welfare.
For thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Do not let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you; and do not listen to your dreams that you are dreaming.
For with falsehood they are prophesying to you in my name. I did not send them — the declaration of YHWH.
For thus says YHWH: When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will attend to you and carry out for you my good word, to bring you back to this place.
For I myself know the plans that I am planning for you — the declaration of YHWH — plans of well-being and not of harm, to give you a future and a hope.
And you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
And you will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your heart.

And I will let myself be found by you — the declaration of YHWH — and I will turn back your captivity and gather you from all the nations and from all the places where I have banished you — the declaration of YHWH — and I will bring you back to the place from which I sent you into exile.
But you have said: YHWH has raised up prophets for us in Babylon.
For thus says YHWH concerning the king who sits on the throne of David and concerning all the people who dwell in this city — your brothers who did not go out with you into exile —
thus says YHWH of hosts: Look, I am sending against them the sword, the famine and the pestilence; and I will make them like rotten figs that cannot be eaten for their badness.

And I will pursue them with the sword, with famine and with pestilence; and I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth — a curse and a waste and a hissing and a reproach among all the nations where I have banished them,
because they did not listen to my words — the declaration of YHWH — which I sent to them by my servants the prophets, rising early and sending; and you did not listen — the declaration of YHWH.
And you, hear the word of YHWH, all you exiles whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon.

Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying falsehood to you in my name: Look, I am giving them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes.
And from them a curse will be taken up by all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon, saying: May YHWH make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire —

because they did folly in Israel and committed adultery with the wives of their neighbours, and spoke a word in my name, falsehood, which I did not command them. And I am the one who knows, and a witness — the declaration of YHWH.
And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall say:

Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest and to all the priests, saying:
YHWH has made you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, to be officers in the house of YHWH for every man who is mad and prophesies, and you shall put him in the stocks and in the iron collar.
And now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah the Anathothite, who is prophesying to you?
For on that account he has sent to us in Babylon, saying: It will be long. Build houses and dwell in them, and plant gardens and eat their produce.
And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, saying:
Send to all the exiles, saying: Thus says YHWH concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he has made you rely on falsehood —

therefore thus says YHWH: Look, I am calling Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring to account. He will not have anyone dwelling among this people, and he will not look on the good that I am doing for my people — the declaration of YHWH — for he has spoken rebellion against YHWH.

jeremiah_30.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Write for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

For look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will turn back the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, says YHWH; and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will take possession of it.
And these are the words that YHWH spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
For thus says YHWH: A sound of trembling we have heard — dread, and there is no peace.
Ask now and see: does a male give birth? Why then have I seen every man with his hands on his loins like a woman in labour, and every face turned to paleness?
Woe! For that day is great; there is none like it. And it is a time of distress for Jacob, but out of it he will be saved.
And it will be on that day — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — I will break his yoke from off your neck, and your bonds I will tear apart; and strangers will no longer make him serve.
And they will serve YHWH their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

And you, do not fear, my servant Jacob — the declaration of YHWH — and do not be dismayed, Israel; for look, I am saving you from far off, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. And Jacob will return and be undisturbed and at ease, with none to frighten him.

For I am with you — the declaration of YHWH — to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations among whom I scattered you, but of you I will not make a full end. And I will discipline you for justice, and I will certainly not leave you unpunished.
For thus says YHWH: Incurable is your shattering; your wound is severe.
There is no one to plead your cause, for a sore; for you there are no medicines of healing.

All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not care for you. For with the blow of an enemy I have struck you, the correction of a cruel one, because of the greatness of your iniquity; your sins are numerous.
Why do you cry out over your shattering? Your pain is incurable. Because of the greatness of your iniquity, your sins being numerous, I have done these things to you.
Therefore all who devour you will be devoured, and all your foes, all of them, will go into captivity; and those who plunder you will become plunder, and all who despoil you I will make spoil.
For I will bring up new flesh for you, and from your wounds I will heal you — the declaration of YHWH — because they have called you an outcast: "It is Zion; no one cares for her."

Thus says YHWH: Look, I am turning back the captivity of the tents of Jacob, and on his dwellings I will have compassion; and a city will be rebuilt on its mound, and a fortress will stand in its proper place.
And from them will go out thanksgiving and the sound of merrymakers; and I will multiply them and they will not diminish, and I will make them honoured and they will not be insignificant.
And his children will be as long ago, and his congregation will be established before me; and I will call to account all who oppress him.

And his noble one will be from among him, and his ruler will come out from his midst; and I will bring him near, and he will draw near to me. For who is this who has pledged his heart to draw near to me? — the declaration of YHWH.
And you will be a people to me, and I will be God to you.
Look — the storm of YHWH! Wrath has gone out, a storm sweeping on; on the head of the wicked it will whirl.
The burning of YHWH's anger will not turn back until he has done and until he has carried out the purposes of his heart. At the end of the days you will understand it.

jeremiah_31.t: At that time — the declaration of YHWH — I will be God to all the clans of Israel, and they will be a people to me.
Thus says YHWH: A people, the survivors of the sword, found favour in the wilderness — Israel, going to find its rest.
From far off YHWH appeared to me: With a love of perpetuity I have loved you; therefore I have prolonged steadfast love toward you.
Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O virgin of Israel. Again you will adorn yourself with your tambourines and go out in the dance of the merrymakers.
Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; planters will plant and put them to common use.
For there will be a day when watchmen will call out in the hill country of Ephraim: Arise, and let us go up to Zion, to YHWH our God!
For thus says YHWH: Cry out with gladness for Jacob, and shout for joy at the head of the nations! Proclaim, praise, and say: Save, YHWH, your people, the remnant of Israel!

Look, I am bringing them from a land of the north, and I will gather them from the remotest parts of the earth — among them the blind and the lame, the pregnant and the one giving birth together; a great company will return here.

With weeping they will come, and with pleas for mercy I will bring them; I will lead them to torrents of water, on a straight way, where they will not stumble. For I have become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
Hear the word of YHWH, O nations, and declare it in the coastlands far off; and say: The one who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him as a shepherd keeps his flock.
For YHWH has ransomed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand of one stronger than he.

And they will come and cry out for joy on the height of Zion, and be radiant over the goodness of YHWH — over grain and over new wine and over fresh oil, and over the young of the flock and the herd. And their life will be like a watered garden, and they will not languish again.
Then a virgin will rejoice in the dance, and young men and old together; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and comfort them and make them glad after their sorrow.
And I will satisfy the appetite of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness — the declaration of YHWH.
Thus says YHWH: A voice is heard in Ramah, a wailing, bitter weeping — Rachel weeping for her children, refusing to be comforted for her children, because he is no more.
Thus says YHWH: Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears; for there is a reward for your work — the declaration of YHWH — and they will return from the land of the enemy.
And there is hope for your future — the declaration of YHWH — and children will return to their own territory.
I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself: You disciplined me, and I was disciplined, like an untrained calf. Turn me back and I will turn back, for you are YHWH my God.
For after I turned away I repented, and after I was made to know I slapped my thigh. I was ashamed, and I was also humiliated, because I bore the reproach of my youth.

Is Ephraim a dear son to me, or a child of delight? For as often as I speak against him, I still surely remember him. Therefore my inward parts are in tumult for him; I will surely have compassion on him — the declaration of YHWH.
Set up signposts for yourself, place guideposts for yourself; set your heart to the highway, the way you went. Return, virgin of Israel, return to these cities of yours!
How long will you waver, O turning-away daughter? For YHWH has created a new thing in the land: a female will encompass a man.

Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Again they will say this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I turn back their captivity: May YHWH bless you, abode of righteousness, mountain of holiness!
And Judah and all its cities together will dwell in it — farmers and those who journey with the flock.
For I will give water to the weary throat, and every faint being I will fill.
At this I awoke and looked, and my sleep had been pleasant to me.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of humankind and the seed of animals.
And it will be, just as I watched over them to pluck up and to pull down and to overthrow and to destroy and to do harm, so I will watch over them to build and to plant — the declaration of YHWH.
In those days they will no longer say: The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are blunted.
But each will die for his own iniquity; every human who eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will be blunted.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will cut with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant,

not like the covenant that I cut with their fathers on the day I took hold of their hand to bring them out from the land of Egypt — my covenant that they themselves broke, though I was a husband to them — the declaration of YHWH.

For this is the covenant that I will cut with the house of Israel after those days — the declaration of YHWH: I will put my law within them, and on their heart I will write it; and I will be God to them, and they will be a people to me.

And they will no longer teach, each his neighbour and each his brother, saying: Know YHWH! For all of them will know me, from their least to their greatest — the declaration of YHWH — for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will remember no more.
Thus says YHWH, who gives the sun for light by day, the fixed orders of the moon and the stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar — YHWH of hosts is his name:
If these fixed orders depart from before me — the declaration of YHWH — then the offspring of Israel too will cease from being a nation before me all the days.

Thus says YHWH: If the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below explored, then I too will reject all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done — the declaration of YHWH.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when the city will be rebuilt for YHWH, from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
And the measuring line will go out farther, straight ahead, to the hill of Gareb, and it will turn toward Goah.

And all the valley of the corpses and of the fatty ash, and all the terraced fields as far as the Wadi Kidron, as far as the corner of the Horse Gate eastward, will be holy to YHWH. It will not be plucked up and not overthrown again, for ever.

jeremiah_32.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah — that was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
And at that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the house of the king of Judah,
where Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying: Why are you prophesying, saying: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it;

and Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, for he will surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak with his mouth and his eyes will see his eyes;
and he will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and there he will remain until I attend to him — the declaration of YHWH. Though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.
And Jeremiah said: The word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Look, Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is coming to you, saying: Buy for yourself my field that is at Anathoth, for the right of redemption is yours, to buy it.

And Hanamel son of my uncle came to me, according to the word of YHWH, to the courtyard of the guard, and said to me: Buy now my field that is at Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin, for the right of possession is yours and the redemption is yours; buy it for yourself. And I knew that this was the word of YHWH.
And I bought the field from Hanamel son of my uncle, which was at Anathoth, and I weighed out for him the silver — seven shekels and ten of silver.
And I wrote in the document and sealed it and had witnesses witness it, and I weighed the silver on scales.
And I took the document of purchase — the sealed one, the terms and the conditions, and the open one —

and I gave the document of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah son of Mahseiah, before the eyes of Hanamel my uncle's son and before the eyes of the witnesses who had signed the document of purchase, before the eyes of all the Judeans who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
And I commanded Baruch before their eyes, saying:

Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these documents — this document of purchase, both the sealed one and this open document — and put them in an earthenware vessel, so that they may last many days.
For thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.
And I prayed to YHWH, after I had given the document of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, saying:
Alas, Lord YHWH! Look, you made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm; nothing is too difficult for you —
who does steadfast love to thousands and repays the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them, the great and mighty God — YHWH of hosts is his name,
great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are open on all the ways of the children of humankind, to give to each according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds;
who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, until this day, and in Israel and among humankind, and made for yourself a name, as at this day;
and you brought out your people Israel from the land of Egypt with signs and with wonders and with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with great terror;
and you gave them this land, which you had sworn to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

and they came and took possession of it, but they did not listen to your voice and did not walk in your law; all that you commanded them to do they did not do, and you have made all this disaster happen to them.

Look, the siege mounds have come to the city to capture it, and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it, because of the sword and the famine and the pestilence; and what you spoke has happened, and here you are, seeing it.
And you yourself said to me, Lord YHWH: Buy for yourself the field with silver and have witnesses witness it — and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, saying:
Look, I am YHWH, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for me?
Therefore thus says YHWH: Look, I am giving this city into the hand of the Chaldeans and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come and set this city on fire and burn it, with the houses on whose roofs they made smoke to Baal and poured out drink offerings to other gods, so as to provoke me to anger.

For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been doing only what is evil in my eyes from their youth; for the sons of Israel have been only provoking me to anger with the work of their hands — the declaration of YHWH.
For this city has been to me a cause of my anger and of my wrath from the day they built it until this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

because of all the evil of the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah that they did to provoke me to anger — they, their kings, their officials, their priests and their prophets, and the man of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And they turned to me the back and not the face; and though I taught them, rising early and teaching, they were not listening, to accept correction.
And they put their detestable things in the house that is called by my name, to make it unclean.

And they built the high places of Baal that are in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to make their sons and their daughters pass over to Molech — which I did not command them, and it did not come up on my heart to do this abomination, so as to cause Judah to sin.

And now, therefore, thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you are saying: It has been given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword and by famine and by pestilence:
Look, I am gathering them from all the lands where I have banished them in my anger and in my wrath and in great rage; and I will bring them back to this place and cause them to dwell in security.
And they will be a people to me, and I will be God to them.
And I will give them one heart and one way, to fear me all the days, for good to them and to their children after them.
And I will cut for them a perpetual covenant, that I will not turn back from after them, to do good to them; and my fear I will put in their heart, so that they will not turn aside from me.
And I will rejoice over them, to do good to them; and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all my heart and with all my being.
For thus says YHWH: Just as I have brought upon this people all this great disaster, so I am bringing upon them all the good that I am speaking concerning them.
And the field will be bought in this land, of which you are saying: It is a desolation, without human being or animal; it has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

Fields will be bought with silver, and documents written and sealed and witnessed, in the land of Benjamin and in the surroundings of Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah and in the cities of the hill country and in the cities of the Shephelah and in the cities of the Negev; for I will turn back their captivity — the declaration of YHWH.

jeremiah_33.t: And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still shut up in the courtyard of the guard, saying:
Thus says YHWH who made it, YHWH who formed it to establish it — YHWH is his name:
Call to me and I will answer you, and I will tell you great and inaccessible things that you do not know.
For thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which have been pulled down against the siege mounds and against the sword:

they are coming to fight with the Chaldeans and to fill them with the corpses of humankind, whom I struck down in my anger and in my wrath, and from whom I have hidden my face from this city because of all their evil:
Look, I am bringing up for it new flesh and healing, and I will heal them; and I will uncover for them an abundance of well-being and faithfulness.
And I will turn back the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel, and I will rebuild them as at the first.
And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they sinned against me, and I will forgive all their iniquities by which they sinned against me and by which they rebelled against me.

And it will be to me a name of joy, a praise and a splendour, to all the nations of the earth who will hear of all the good that I am doing for them; and they will be in awe and tremble because of all the good and because of all the well-being that I am doing for it.

Thus says YHWH: Again there will be heard in this place, of which you are saying: It is desolate, without human being and without animal — in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are made desolate, without human being and without inhabitant and without animal —

the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride, the sound of those who say: Give thanks to YHWH of hosts, for YHWH is good, for his steadfast love is for ever! — bringing a thank offering to the house of YHWH. For I will turn back the captivity of the land as at the first, says YHWH.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Again there will be in this place, which is desolate, without human being and even without animal, and in all its cities, a pasture of shepherds making flocks lie down.

In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the Shephelah and in the cities of the Negev, and in the land of Benjamin and in the surroundings of Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of one who counts them, says YHWH.
Look, days are coming — the declaration of YHWH — when I will carry out the good word that I have spoken to the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.
In those days and at that time I will cause a Branch of righteousness to sprout for David, and he will do justice and righteousness in the land.
In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will dwell in security. And this is what she will be called: YHWH Our Righteousness.
For thus says YHWH: There will not be cut off for David a man sitting on the throne of the house of Israel;
and for the priests, the Levites, there will not be cut off a man from before me, offering up a burnt offering and burning a grain offering as smoke and making a sacrifice, all the days.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, saying:
Thus says YHWH: If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night do not come at their appointed time,
then also my covenant with David my servant may be broken, so that he has no son reigning on his throne, and with the Levites, the priests, my ministers.
As the host of the heavens cannot be counted and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will increase the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, saying:
Have you not seen what this people have spoken, saying: The two clans that YHWH chose — he has rejected them? And they spurn my people, so that they are no longer a nation before them.
Thus says YHWH: If I have not established my covenant with day and night, the fixed orders of heaven and earth,

then also I will reject the offspring of Jacob and David my servant, so as not to take from his offspring rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will turn back their captivity and have compassion on them.

jeremiah_34.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH — while Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms of the earth under the rule of his hand and all the peoples were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities — saying:

Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Go and say to Zedekiah king of Judah, and say to him: Thus says YHWH: Look, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.

And you will not escape from his hand, for you will surely be captured and given into his hand; and your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak with your mouth, and you will go to Babylon.
Only hear the word of YHWH, Zedekiah king of Judah: Thus says YHWH concerning you: You will not die by the sword.

In peace you will die; and as with the burnings for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will burn for you, and they will lament for you: Alas, lord! For I myself have spoken the word — the declaration of YHWH.
And Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left — against Lachish and against Azekah; for these remained among the cities of Judah as fortified cities.
The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH after King Zedekiah had cut a covenant with all the people who were in Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them:
that each should let go his male slave and each his female slave, the Hebrew man and the Hebrew woman, free — so that no one should make a slave of them, of a Judean, his brother.

And all the officials and all the people who had entered into the covenant obeyed, that each should let go his male slave and each his female slave, free, so as not to make slaves of them again; and they obeyed and let them go.
But afterwards they turned back and took back the male slaves and the female slaves whom they had let go free, and subdued them as male slaves and female slaves.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: I myself cut a covenant with your fathers on the day I brought them out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves, saying:

At the end of seven years each of you shall let go his brother, the Hebrew who sells himself to you and serves you six years; you shall let him go free from you. But your fathers did not listen to me and did not incline their ear.
And you yourselves turned back today and did what is right in my eyes, by proclaiming liberty each to his neighbour; and you cut a covenant before me in the house that is called by my name.

But you turned back and profaned my name, and each took back his male slave and each his female slave, whom you had let go free at their own desire, and you subdued them to be male slaves and female slaves for you.

Therefore thus says YHWH: You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty each to his brother and each to his neighbour. Look, I am proclaiming liberty for you — the declaration of YHWH — to the sword, to the pestilence and to the famine; and I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
And I will make the men who transgressed my covenant, who did not carry out the words of the covenant that they cut before me — the calf that they cut in two and passed between its pieces —
the officials of Judah and the officials of Jerusalem, the court officials and the priests and all the people of the land, who passed between the pieces of the calf —
I will give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life; and their corpses will become food for the birds of the heavens and for the animals of the earth.

And Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials I will give into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon that has gone up from you.

Look, I am giving command — the declaration of YHWH — and I will bring them back to this city; and they will fight against it and capture it and burn it with fire. And the cities of Judah I will make a waste, with no inhabitant.

jeremiah_35.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying:
Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak with them, and bring them to the house of YHWH, to one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.
And I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites,

and I brought them to the house of YHWH, to the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was beside the room of the officials, which was above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.
And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them: Drink wine.
And they said: We do not drink wine, for Jonadab son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying: You shall not drink wine, you or your children, for ever.

And you shall not build a house, and you shall not sow seed, and you shall not plant a vineyard, and you shall not have one; for you shall dwell in tents all your days, so that you may live many days on the face of the ground where you are sojourning.
And we have listened to the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab our father, in all that he commanded us — not to drink wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons and our daughters,
and not to build houses for our dwelling; and we have no vineyard or field or seed.
And we have dwelt in tents, and we have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

And it was, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, that we said: Come, let us go to Jerusalem, because of the army of the Chaldeans and because of the army of Aram. And we have dwelt in Jerusalem.
And the word of YHWH came to Jeremiah, saying:
Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and say to the man of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Will you not accept correction, to listen to my words? — the declaration of YHWH.

The words of Jonadab son of Rechab, who commanded his sons not to drink wine, have been carried out; and they have not drunk to this day, for they have obeyed the commandment of their father. But I myself have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

And I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying: Turn back now, each from his evil way, and make your deeds good, and do not walk after other gods to serve them; and dwell on the ground that I gave to you and to your fathers. But you did not incline your ear and did not listen to me.
For the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have carried out the commandment of their father that he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.

Therefore thus says YHWH, the God of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am bringing on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I have spoken against them; because I spoke to them and they did not listen, and I called to them and they did not answer.

And to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said: Thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have listened to the commandment of Jonadab your father and kept all his commandments and done according to all that he commanded you,
therefore thus says YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel: There will not be cut off for Jonadab son of Rechab a man standing before me, all the days.

jeremiah_36.t: And it was in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:

Take for yourself a scroll of a document and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you concerning Israel and concerning Judah and concerning all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, until this day.
Perhaps the house of Judah will hear all the harm that I am planning to do to them, so that they may turn back, each from his evil way, and I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.
And Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of YHWH that he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a document.
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying: I am shut up; I am not able to go to the house of YHWH.

So you go, and read from the scroll that you have written from my mouth — the words of YHWH — in the ears of the people, in the house of YHWH on a day of fasting; and also in the ears of all Judah who are coming from their cities you shall read them.
Perhaps their supplication will fall before YHWH, and they will turn back, each from his evil way; for great is the anger and the wrath that YHWH has spoken against this people.
And Baruch son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, to read from the scroll the words of YHWH in the house of YHWH.

And it was, in the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, they proclaimed a fast before YHWH — all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

And Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah, in the house of YHWH, in the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entrance of the New Gate of the house of YHWH, in the ears of all the people.
And Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan heard all the words of YHWH from the scroll.

And he went down to the house of the king, to the room of the scribe; and there all the officials were sitting: Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan son of Achbor, and Gemariah son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the officials.
And Micaiah told them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read from the scroll in the ears of the people.
