And the western border is the Great Sea and its territory. This is the border of the sons of Judah round about, by their clans.
And to Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the sons of Judah, according to the mouth of YHWH to Joshua: Kiriath-arba — Arba was the father of Anak — that is Hebron.
And Caleb dispossessed from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, those born of Anak.
And he went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir; and the name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher.
And Caleb said, "Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
And Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
And it was, when she came, that she incited him to ask a field from her father. And she alighted from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What is it with you?"
And she said, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me the land of the Negev, give me also springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their clans.
And the cities at the far end of the tribe of the sons of Judah, toward the border of Edom in the south, were Kabzeel and Eder and Jagur,
and Kinah and Dimonah and Adadah,
and Kedesh and Hazor and Ithnan,
Ziph and Telem and Bealoth,
and Hazor-hadattah and Kerioth-hezron — that is Hazor —
Amam and Shema and Moladah,
and Hazar-gaddah and Heshmon and Beth-pelet,
and Hazar-shual and Beersheba and Biziothiah,
Baalah and Iim and Ezem,
and Eltolad and Kesil and Hormah,
and Ziklag and Madmannah and Sansannah,
and Lebaoth and Shilhim and Ain and Rimmon: all the cities, twenty-nine, with their villages.
In the Shephelah: Eshtaol and Zorah and Ashnah,
and Zanoah and En-gannim, Tappuah and Enam,
Jarmuth and Adullam, Socoh and Azekah,
and Shaaraim and Adithaim and Gederah and Gederothaim: fourteen cities, with their villages.
Zenan and Hadashah and Migdal-gad,
and Dilean and Mizpeh and Joktheel,
Lachish and Bozkath and Eglon,
and Cabbon and Lahmas and Kitlish,
and Gederoth, Beth-dagon and Naamah and Makkedah: sixteen cities, with their villages.
Libnah and Ether and Ashan,
and Iphtah and Ashnah and Nezib,
and Keilah and Aczib and Mareshah: nine cities, with their villages.
Ekron, with its daughter-towns and its villages;
from Ekron westward, all that is beside Ashdod, with their villages;
Ashdod, its daughter-towns and its villages; Gaza, its daughter-towns and its villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt, and the Great Sea and its territory.
And in the hill country: Shamir and Jattir and Socoh,
and Dannah and Kiriath-sannah — that is Debir —
and Anab and Eshtemoh and Anim,
and Goshen and Holon and Giloh: eleven cities, with their villages.
Arab and Rumah and Eshan,
and Janum and Beth-tappuah and Aphekah,
and Humtah and Kiriath-arba — that is Hebron — and Zior: nine cities, with their villages.
Maon, Carmel and Ziph and Juttah,
and Jezreel and Jokdeam and Zanoah,
Kain, Gibeah and Timnah: ten cities, with their villages.
Halhul, Beth-zur and Gedor,
and Maarath and Beth-anoth and Eltekon: six cities, with their villages.
Kiriath-baal — that is Kiriath-jearim — and Rabbah: two cities, with their villages.
In the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin and Secacah,
and Nibshan and the City of Salt and En-gedi: six cities, with their villages.
And the Jebusite, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah were not able to dispossess; and the Jebusite has dwelt with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.

joshua_16.t: And the lot for the sons of Joseph went out from the Jordan of Jericho, to the waters of Jericho on the east, the wilderness going up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
And it goes out from Bethel to Luz and passes on to the border of the Archite, to Ataroth,
and goes down westward to the border of the Japhletite, as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and as far as Gezer; and its extremities are at the sea.
And the sons of Joseph — Manasseh and Ephraim — received their inheritance.
And the territory of the sons of Ephraim by their clans was this: the border of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon;
and the border goes out westward — Micmethath is on the north — and the border turns eastward to Taanath-shiloh and passes by it on the east to Janoah,
and goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, and touches Jericho and goes out at the Jordan.
From Tappuah the border goes westward to the Wadi Kanah, and its extremities are at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim by their clans;
and the cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim within the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
And they did not dispossess the Canaanite who dwelt in Gezer; and the Canaanite has dwelt in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and has become a slave gang doing forced labour.

joshua_17.t: And the lot belonged to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was Joseph's firstborn — to Machir, Manasseh's firstborn, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war; and Gilead and Bashan belonged to him.

And it belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh by their clans: to the sons of Abiezer and the sons of Helek and the sons of Asriel and the sons of Shechem and the sons of Hepher and the sons of Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, by their clans.
And Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

And they came near before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua son of Nun and before the leaders, saying, "YHWH commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." And he gave them, according to the mouth of YHWH, an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
And ten portions fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
for the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons; and the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Micmethath, which is before Shechem; and the border goes to the south, to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to the sons of Ephraim.

And the border goes down to the Wadi Kanah, south of the wadi. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh; and the border of Manasseh was on the north of the wadi, and its extremities were at the sea.
Southward it belonged to Ephraim and northward to Manasseh, and the sea was its border; and on the north they touch Asher, and on the east Issachar.

And in Issachar and in Asher there belonged to Manasseh: Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, and Ibleam and its daughter-towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its daughter-towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its daughter-towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its daughter-towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its daughter-towns — the three of Napheth.
And the sons of Manasseh were not able to take possession of these cities, and the Canaanite was determined to dwell in this land.
And it was, when the sons of Israel became strong, that they put the Canaanite to forced labour; but they did not utterly dispossess him.
And the sons of Joseph spoke with Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me one lot and one portion as an inheritance, when I am a numerous people, since until now YHWH has blessed me?"

And Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up for yourself to the forest and clear ground for yourself there, in the land of the Perizzite and the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you."

And the sons of Joseph said, "The hill country will not be enough for us, and there is iron chariotry among all the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley — among those in Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, and among those in the Valley of Jezreel."
And Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, "You are a numerous people and you have great strength; you shall not have one lot only,

"for the hill country shall be yours. Though it is forest, you shall clear it, and its extremities shall be yours; for you shall dispossess the Canaanite, though he has iron chariotry, though he is strong."

joshua_18.t: And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and they caused the tent of meeting to dwell there; and the land was subdued before them.
And there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes that had not divided their inheritance.
And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "How long will you show yourselves slack about going in to take possession of the land that YHWH the God of your fathers has given you?
"Provide for yourselves three men for each tribe, and I will send them, and they shall arise and walk through the land and describe it in writing according to their inheritance, and come to me.
"And they shall divide it among themselves into seven portions. Judah shall remain on its territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain on their territory in the north.
"And you shall describe the land in writing in seven portions and bring it to me here, and I will cast the lot for you here before YHWH our God.

"For the Levites have no portion among you, because the priesthood of YHWH is their inheritance; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of YHWH gave them."

And the men arose and went; and Joshua commanded those who went to describe the land in writing, saying, "Go and walk through the land and describe it in writing and return to me, and here I will cast the lot for you before YHWH in Shiloh."
And the men went and passed through the land and described it in writing by cities, in seven portions, on a scroll; and they came to Joshua, to the camp at Shiloh.
And Joshua cast the lot for them in Shiloh before YHWH; and there Joshua apportioned the land to the sons of Israel according to their divisions.
And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up by their clans, and the territory of their lot went out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

And their border on the northern side was from the Jordan; and the border goes up to the northern slope of Jericho and goes up in the hill country westward, and its extremities are at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
And from there the border passes on to Luz, to the southern slope of Luz — that is Bethel; and the border goes down to Ataroth-addar, on the mountain that is south of Lower Beth-horon.

And the border bends and turns on the western side southward, from the mountain that faces Beth-horon on the south; and its extremities are at Kiriath-baal — that is Kiriath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah. This is the western side.
And the southern side is from the end of Kiriath-jearim; and the border goes out westward and goes out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

And the border goes down to the end of the mountain that faces the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is in the Valley of Rephaim to the north; and it goes down the Valley of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Jebusite, and goes down to En-rogel.
And it bends from the north and goes out to En-shemesh and goes out to Geliloth, which is opposite the Ascent of Adummim; and it goes down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben,
and passes on to the slope opposite the Arabah northward, and goes down to the Arabah;

and the border passes on to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah; and the extremities of the border are at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the southern end of the Jordan. This is the southern border.
And the Jordan borders it on the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, by its borders round about, by their clans.
And the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin by their clans were Jericho and Beth-hoglah and Emek-keziz,
and Beth-arabah and Zemaraim and Bethel,
and Avvim and Parah and Ophrah,
and Kephar-ammoni and Ophni and Geba: twelve cities, with their villages.
Gibeon and Ramah and Beeroth,
and Mizpeh and Kephirah and Mozah,
and Rekem and Irpeel and Taralah,
and Zela, Haeleph and the Jebusite — that is Jerusalem — Gibeah, Kiriath: fourteen cities, with their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin by their clans.

joshua_19.t: And the second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon by their clans; and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the sons of Judah.
And they had as their inheritance: Beersheba and Sheba and Moladah,
and Hazar-shual and Balah and Ezem,
and Eltolad and Bethul and Hormah,
and Ziklag and Beth-marcaboth and Hazar-susah,
and Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen: thirteen cities, with their villages.
Ain, Rimmon and Ether and Ashan: four cities, with their villages;
and all the villages that were around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negev. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon by their clans.

The inheritance of the sons of Simeon was out of the portion of the sons of Judah, because the portion of the sons of Judah was too great for them; and the sons of Simeon received their inheritance within their inheritance.
And the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun by their clans; and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.
And their border goes up westward, and Maralah, and touches Dabbesheth, and touches the wadi that faces Jokneam;
and it turns back from Sarid eastward, toward the rising of the sun, to the border of Kisloth-tabor, and goes out to Daberath and goes up to Japhia;
and from there it passes on eastward, toward the sunrise, to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon, which bends to Neah;
and the border turns about it on the north to Hannathon; and its extremities are at the Valley of Iphtah-el;
and Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Bethlehem: twelve cities, with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun by their clans: these cities, with their villages.
For Issachar the fourth lot came out, for the sons of Issachar by their clans;
and their border was to Jezreel and Kesulloth and Shunem,
and Hapharaim and Shion and Anaharath,
and Rabbith and Kishion and Ebez,
and Remeth and En-gannim and En-haddah and Beth-pazzez.
And the border touches Tabor and Shahazumah and Beth-shemesh, and the extremities of their border are at the Jordan: sixteen cities, with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar by their clans: the cities, with their villages.
And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher by their clans;
and their border was Helkath and Hali and Beten and Acshaph,
and Allammelech and Amad and Mishal; and it touches Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath,
and it turns back toward the rising of the sun to Beth-dagon and touches Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el northward, Beth-emek and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left,
and Ebron and Rehob and Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
And the border turns back to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turns back to Hosah, and its extremities are at the sea, from the region of Aczib;
and Ummah and Aphek and Rehob: twenty-two cities, with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher by their clans: these cities, with their villages.
For the sons of Naphtali the sixth lot came out, for the sons of Naphtali by their clans;
and their border was from Heleph, from the great tree at Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum; and its extremities were at the Jordan.

And the border turns back westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from there to Hukkok; and it touches Zebulun on the south, and Asher it touches on the west, and Judah at the Jordan toward the rising of the sun.
And the fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer and Hammath, Rakkath and Kinnereth,
and Adamah and Ramah and Hazor,
and Kedesh and Edrei and En-hazor,
and Yiron and Migdal-el, Horem and Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh: nineteen cities, with their villages.
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali by their clans: the cities, with their villages.
For the tribe of the sons of Dan by their clans the seventh lot came out.
And the territory of their inheritance was Zorah and Eshtaol and Ir-shemesh,
and Shaalabbin and Aijalon and Ithlah,
and Elon and Timnah and Ekron,
and Eltekeh and Gibbethon and Baalath,
and Jehud and Bene-berak and Gath-rimmon,
and the waters of the Jarkon and the Rakkon, with the territory opposite Joppa.

And the territory of the sons of Dan went out from them; and the sons of Dan went up and fought with Leshem and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword, and took possession of it and dwelt in it; and they called Leshem Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan by their clans: these cities, with their villages.
And they finished dividing the land for possession by its borders; and the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua son of Nun in their midst.
According to the mouth of YHWH they gave him the city that he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt in it.

These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned by lot at Shiloh, before YHWH, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. And they finished dividing the land.

joshua_20.t: And YHWH spoke to Joshua, saying,
"Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Assign for yourselves the cities of refuge of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moses,
'that a killer who strikes a person down by inadvertence, without knowledge, may flee there; and they shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood.

'And he shall flee to one of these cities and stand at the entrance of the gate of the city and speak his words in the ears of the elders of that city; and they shall gather him into the city to themselves and give him a place, and he shall dwell with them.
'And if the avenger of blood pursues after him, they shall not deliver the killer into his hand, because he struck his neighbour without knowledge and did not hate him previously.

'And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgement, until the death of the high priest who is in those days. Then the killer shall return and come to his own city and to his own house, to the city from which he fled.'"
And they set apart as holy Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba — that is Hebron — in the hill country of Judah.

And beyond the Jordan of Jericho, eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain, from the tribe of Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.

These were the cities of appointment for all the sons of Israel and for the sojourner sojourning among them, that anyone who strikes a person down by inadvertence might flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stood before the congregation.

joshua_21.t: And the heads of the fathers of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel;
and they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, "YHWH commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock."
And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the mouth of YHWH, these cities with their pasture lands.

And the lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites; and the descendants of Aaron the priest, from among the Levites, received by lot from the tribe of Judah and from the tribe of the Simeonites and from the tribe of Benjamin thirteen cities.
And the rest of the descendants of Kohath received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half-tribe of Manasseh ten cities.

And the descendants of Gershon received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan thirteen cities.
The descendants of Merari, by their clans, received from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun twelve cities.
And the sons of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands to the Levites by lot, just as YHWH had commanded by the hand of Moses.
And they gave from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon these cities, which are called by name.
And it belonged to the descendants of Aaron, of the clans of the Kohathites, of the descendants of Levi, for the first lot was theirs.
And they gave them Kiriath-arba — Arba was the father of Anak — that is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.
But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his holding.
And to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave the city of refuge for the killer, Hebron, with its pasture lands; and Libnah with its pasture lands,
and Jattir with its pasture lands, and Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
and Holon with its pasture lands, and Debir with its pasture lands,
and Ain with its pasture lands, and Juttah with its pasture lands, Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities from these two tribes.
And from the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.
All the cities of the descendants of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
And to the clans of the descendants of Kohath, the Levites who remained of the descendants of Kohath — the cities of their lot were from the tribe of Ephraim.
And they gave them the city of refuge for the killer, Shechem, with its pasture lands, in the hill country of Ephraim; and Gezer with its pasture lands,
and Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth-horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the tribe of Dan: Eltekeh with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
All the cities were ten, with their pasture lands, for the clans of the descendants of Kohath who remained.

And to the descendants of Gershon, of the clans of the Levites: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, the city of refuge for the killer, Golan in Bashan, with its pasture lands; and Beeshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
And from the tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En-gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the tribe of Asher: Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the tribe of Naphtali: the city of refuge for the killer, Kedesh in Galilee, with its pasture lands; and Hammoth-dor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.
All the cities of the Gershonites, by their clans, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
And to the clans of the descendants of Merari, the Levites who remained: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
Dimnah with its pasture lands, Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer with its pasture lands, and Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
And from the tribe of Gad: the city of refuge for the killer, Ramoth in Gilead, with its pasture lands; and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.
All the cities of the descendants of Merari, by their clans, who remained of the clans of the Levites — their lot was twelve cities.
All the cities of the Levites within the holding of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
These cities were each a city with its pasture lands around it; so it was for all these cities.
And YHWH gave to Israel all the land that he had sworn to give to their fathers; and they took possession of it and dwelt in it.
And YHWH gave them rest round about, according to all that he had sworn to their fathers; and not a man of all their enemies stood before them. All their enemies YHWH gave into their hand.
Not a word failed of all the good word that YHWH had spoken to the house of Israel; the whole of it came.

joshua_22.t: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
and said to them, "You have kept all that Moses the servant of YHWH commanded you, and you have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
"You have not forsaken your brothers these many days, to this day, and you have kept the charge of the commandment of YHWH your God.

"And now YHWH your God has given rest to your brothers, just as he spoke to them. And now turn and go to your tents, to the land of your holding, which Moses the servant of YHWH gave you beyond the Jordan.

"Only take great care to do the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of YHWH commanded you: to love YHWH your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cling to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul."
And Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.

And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given a portion in Bashan, and to its other half Joshua gave a portion with their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. And moreover, when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them

and said to them, "Return to your tents with great riches and with very much livestock, with silver and with gold and with bronze and with iron and with very many garments. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers."

And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned and went from the sons of Israel, from Shiloh which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their holding, in which they had taken possession according to the mouth of YHWH by the hand of Moses.

And they came to Geliloth of the Jordan, which is in the land of Canaan, and the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there at the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

And the sons of Israel heard it said, "Behold, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built the altar opposite the land of Canaan, at Geliloth of the Jordan, on the side of the sons of Israel."
And the sons of Israel heard, and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go up against them for war.
And the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest,
and ten leaders with him, one leader, one leader for each ancestral house, for all the tribes of Israel; and each of them was head of his ancestral house among the thousands of Israel.
And they came to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and spoke with them, saying,

"Thus says the whole congregation of YHWH: What is this unfaithfulness that you have committed against the God of Israel, turning back today from following YHWH, by building for yourselves an altar, rebelling today against YHWH?
"Was the iniquity of Peor too little for us — from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, and the plague came upon the congregation of YHWH —
"that you should turn away today from following YHWH? And it will be: you rebel today against YHWH, and tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

"And surely, if the land of your holding is unclean, cross over to the land of the holding of YHWH, where the tabernacle of YHWH dwells, and take a holding among us. But do not rebel against YHWH, and do not rebel against us, by building for yourselves an altar besides the altar of YHWH our God.

"Did not Achan son of Zerah commit unfaithfulness in the matter of what was devoted to destruction, and wrath came upon the whole congregation of Israel? And he was one man — did he not perish for his iniquity?"
And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke with the heads of the thousands of Israel:
"God, God, YHWH! God, God, YHWH! He knows, and let Israel itself know: if it was in rebellion or in unfaithfulness against YHWH — do not save us this day!

"— to build for ourselves an altar to turn back from following YHWH; or if to offer up on it a burnt offering and a grain offering, or if to make on it sacrifices of peace offerings — may YHWH himself require it!
"But truly, we did this out of anxiety over a matter, saying, 'Tomorrow your children will say to our children, What have you to do with YHWH, the God of Israel?
"'For YHWH has set a border between us and you, sons of Reuben and sons of Gad — the Jordan. You have no portion in YHWH.' And so your children would make our children cease from fearing YHWH.
"And we said, 'Let us act for ourselves by building the altar — not for burnt offering and not for sacrifice,

"'but that it may be a witness between us and you and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of YHWH before him with our burnt offerings and with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings; so that your children will not say to our children in time to come, You have no portion in YHWH.'

"And we said, 'And it shall be, when they say this to us and to our generations in time to come, that we shall say, See the copy of the altar of YHWH that our fathers made — not for burnt offering and not for sacrifice, but it is a witness between us and you.'

"Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH and to turn back today from following YHWH by building an altar for burnt offering, for grain offering or for sacrifice, besides the altar of YHWH our God that is before his tabernacle."

And Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the congregation and the heads of the thousands of Israel who were with him heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Manasseh spoke, and it was good in their eyes.

And Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Manasseh, "Today we know that YHWH is in our midst, because you have not committed this unfaithfulness against YHWH. Now you have delivered the sons of Israel from the hand of YHWH."

And Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest and the leaders returned from the sons of Reuben and from the sons of Gad, from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel, and brought them back word.

And the word was good in the eyes of the sons of Israel, and the sons of Israel blessed God; and they did not speak of going up against them for war, to destroy the land in which the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad were dwelling.
And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad called the altar — for it is a witness between us that YHWH is God.

joshua_23.t: And it was, after many days, after YHWH had given rest to Israel from all their enemies round about, and Joshua was old, come into days,
that Joshua summoned all Israel — its elders and its heads and its judges and its officers — and said to them, "I am old, come into days.
"And you, you have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all these nations before you; for YHWH your God, he is the one fighting for you.
"See, I have made these remaining nations fall to you as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan; and all the nations that I cut off, and the Great Sea, toward the setting of the sun.
"And YHWH your God, he will thrust them out from before you and dispossess them from before you, and you shall take possession of their land, just as YHWH your God spoke to you.
"And you shall be very strong, to take care to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so as not to turn aside from it to the right or to the left,

"so as not to go in among these nations, these that remain with you. And the name of their gods you shall not bring to remembrance, and you shall not cause anyone to swear by them, and you shall not serve them, and you shall not bow down to them.
"But to YHWH your God you shall cling, as you have done to this day.
"And YHWH has dispossessed from before you nations great and mighty; and as for you, no one has stood before you to this day.
"One man of you puts a thousand to flight, for YHWH your God, he is the one fighting for you, just as he spoke to you.
"And you shall take great heed to yourselves, to love YHWH your God.
"For if turning back you turn back and cling to the remnant of these nations, these that remain with you, and intermarry with them and go in among them and they among you,

"know certainly that YHWH your God will not continue to dispossess these nations from before you; and they shall become for you a trap and a snare and a scourge in your sides and pricks in your eyes, until you perish from upon this good ground that YHWH your God has given you.

"And behold, I am going today in the way of all the earth. And you know with all your heart and with all your soul that not one word has fallen of all the good words that YHWH your God spoke concerning you. All of them have come to you; not one word of them has fallen.

"And it shall be, just as every good word has come upon you that YHWH your God spoke to you, so YHWH will bring upon you every bad word, until he has destroyed you from upon this good ground that YHWH your God has given you,

"when you transgress the covenant of YHWH your God that he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them. Then the anger of YHWH will burn against you, and you will perish quickly from upon the good land that he has given you."

joshua_24.t: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and summoned the elders of Israel and its heads and its judges and its officers; and they presented themselves before God.

And Joshua said to all the people, "Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: 'Beyond the River your fathers dwelt from of old — Terah the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor — and they served other gods.
'And I took your father Abraham from beyond the River and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his offspring and gave him Isaac.
'And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau; and I gave to Esau Mount Seir to take possession of it; and Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
'And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I struck Egypt as I did in its midst; and afterwards I brought you out.
'And I brought your fathers out from Egypt, and you came to the sea; and Egypt pursued after your fathers with chariotry and with horsemen to the Sea of Reeds.

'And they cried out to YHWH, and he put gloom between you and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea over him and covered him. And your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. And you dwelt in the wilderness many days.

'And I brought you to the land of the Amorite who dwelt beyond the Jordan, and they fought with you; and I gave them into your hand, and you took possession of their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
'And Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel; and he sent and summoned Balaam son of Beor to curse you.
'And I was not willing to listen to Balaam, and blessing he blessed you; and I delivered you from his hand.

'And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho; and the lords of Jericho fought against you — the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Girgashite, the Hivite and the Jebusite — and I gave them into your hand.
'And I sent the hornet before you, and it drove them out from before you — the two kings of the Amorite — not by your sword and not by your bow.
'And I gave you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you did not build, and you dwelt in them; vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, you are eating.'"
"And now, fear YHWH and serve him in blamelessness and in faithfulness; and remove the gods that your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve YHWH.

"And if it is bad in your eyes to serve YHWH, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve — whether the gods that your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorite in whose land you are dwelling. But as for me and my house, we will serve YHWH."
And the people answered and said, "Far be it from us to forsake YHWH to serve other gods!

"For YHWH our God, he is the one who brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves, and who did these great signs before our eyes and kept us on all the way that we went and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.
"And YHWH drove out all the peoples, and the Amorite who dwelt in the land, from before us. We also will serve YHWH, for he is our God."
And Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve YHWH, for he is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not bear your transgression and your sins.
"If you forsake YHWH and serve gods of foreignness, then he will turn and do you harm and make an end of you, after he has done you good."
And the people said to Joshua, "No, for YHWH we will serve."
And Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you yourselves have chosen YHWH, to serve him." And they said, "Witnesses."
"And now, remove the gods of foreignness that are in your midst, and turn your heart to YHWH, the God of Israel."
And the people said to Joshua, "YHWH our God we will serve, and to his voice we will listen."
And Joshua cut a covenant for the people on that day, and set for it a statute and an ordinance at Shechem.
And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone and set it up there under the oak that was at the sanctuary of YHWH.

And Joshua said to all the people, "Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the sayings of YHWH that he spoke with us; and it shall be a witness against you, lest you deny your God."
And Joshua sent the people away, each to his inheritance.
And it was after these things that Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died, a son of a hundred and ten years.
And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
And Israel served YHWH all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who prolonged days after Joshua and who knew all the work of YHWH that he had done for Israel.

And the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel had brought up from Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in the portion of the field that Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money; and they became an inheritance for the sons of Joseph.
And Eleazar son of Aaron died, and they buried him at Gibeah of Phinehas his son, which had been given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.

lamentations_1.t: How she sits alone, the city great with people! She has become like a widow — great among the nations, a princess among the provinces, become forced labour.
Bitterly she weeps in the night, and her tears are on her cheek. She has no comforter among all her lovers; all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they have become her enemies.
Judah has gone into exile out of affliction and out of much servitude. She dwells among the nations; she has found no resting place. All her pursuers have overtaken her between the narrow places.
The roads of Zion are mourning, for none come to the appointed feast. All her gates are desolate; her priests groan; her virgins grieve, and she — it is bitter to her.
Her adversaries have become the head; her enemies are at ease, for YHWH has caused her grief for the multitude of her transgressions. Her children have gone into captivity before the adversary.
And all her splendour has gone out from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that have found no pasture, and they have gone without strength before a pursuer.

Jerusalem has remembered, in the days of her affliction and her homelessness, all her precious things that were from the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of an adversary and she had no helper. The adversaries saw her; they laughed at her annihilation.
Jerusalem has sinned grievously; therefore she has become an impurity. All who honoured her despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away backward.
Her uncleanness is on her skirts; she did not remember her outcome. And she has come down astonishingly; she has no comforter. "See, YHWH, my affliction, for the enemy has magnified himself."
The adversary has spread out his hand over all her precious things, for she has seen nations enter her sanctuary, of whom you commanded that they should not come into your assembly.
All her people are groaning, seeking bread. They have given their precious things for food, to bring back life. "See, YHWH, and look, for I have become despised."
Is it nothing to you, all you who pass along the road? Look and see if there is any pain like my pain, which was dealt out to me, with which YHWH caused me grief on the day of his burning anger.
From on high he sent fire into my bones, and it mastered them. He spread a net for my feet; he turned me back; he made me desolate, faint all the day.

The yoke of my transgressions has been bound on by his hand; they are woven together, they have come up on my neck; he has made my strength feeble. The Lord has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
The Lord has thrown away all my mighty ones in my midst. He has proclaimed an appointed meeting against me, to break my young men. The Lord has trodden a winepress for the virgin daughter of Judah.
For these things I am weeping; my eye, my eye runs down with water, for a comforter is far from me, one who would bring back my life. My children are desolate, for the enemy has prevailed.
Zion has spread out her hands; she has no comforter. YHWH has commanded concerning Jacob that those around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem has become an impure thing among them.
YHWH is righteous, for I have rebelled against his mouth. Listen, please, all you peoples, and see my pain: my virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
I called to my lovers; they deceived me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they sought food for themselves, to bring back their life.
See, YHWH, for I am in distress; my inward parts are in turmoil. My heart is overturned within me, for I have been utterly rebellious. Outside, the sword has bereaved; in the house, it is like death.
They have heard that I am groaning; I have no comforter. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they have rejoiced, for you have done it. Bring the day you proclaimed, and let them become like me.
Let all their wickedness come before you, and deal severely with them as you have dealt severely with me for all my transgressions; for my groanings are many and my heart is faint.

lamentations_2.t: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has thrown down from heaven to earth the splendour of Israel, and he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

The Lord has swallowed up and has not spared all the settlements of Jacob. He has torn down in his wrath the fortifications of the daughter of Judah; he has brought them to the ground; he has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
He has cut off in burning anger every horn of Israel; he has turned back his right hand from before the enemy, and he has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes all around.

He has bent his bow like an enemy; his right hand has taken a stand like an adversary, and he has killed all the delights of the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion he has poured out his rage like fire.

The Lord has become like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces; he has ruined his fortifications, and he has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

And he has treated his booth violently, like a garden; he has ruined his appointed place. YHWH has caused appointed feast and sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, and he has spurned, in the indignation of his anger, king and priest.

The Lord has rejected his altar; he has repudiated his sanctuary. He has delivered into the hand of an enemy the walls of her palaces. They have given voice in the house of YHWH as on the day of an appointed feast.

YHWH has planned to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a measuring-line; he has not turned back his hand from swallowing up, and he has made rampart and wall mourn; together they have languished.
Her gates have sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations; there is no law; also her prophets have found no vision from YHWH.

The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground; they are silent. They have brought up dust on their head; they have girded on sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem have brought down their head to the ground.

My eyes have failed with tears; my inward parts are in turmoil. My liver is poured out to the ground for the brokenness of the daughter of my people, because child and suckling faint in the open places of the town.
To their mothers they say, "Where are grain and wine?" as they faint away like the fatally wounded in the open places of the city, as their life pours itself out into the bosom of their mothers.

What can I testify for you? What can I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What can I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your brokenness is great as the sea; who can heal you?
Your prophets have seen for you worthlessness and sham, and they have not laid bare your iniquity, to turn back your captivity; but they have seen for you oracles of worthlessness and enticements.

All who pass along the road have clapped hands at you; they have hissed and shaken their head at the daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city of which they said, 'Perfect in beauty, a joy to all the earth'?"

All your enemies have opened their mouth at you; they have hissed and gnashed the teeth; they have said, "We have swallowed her up! Surely this is the day we waited for; we have found it, we have seen it."

YHWH has done what he purposed; he has fulfilled his speech, which he commanded from the days of old. He has torn down and has not spared, and he has made the enemy rejoice over you; he has lifted up the horn of your adversaries.
Their heart has cried out to the Lord. Wall of the daughter of Zion, send down tears like a river, by day and night! Give yourself no rest; let the daughter of your eye not be still.

Arise, cry out in the night, at the head of the night-watches! Pour out your heart like water before the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the life of your children, who faint from hunger at the head of all the streets.
See, YHWH, and look! To whom have you dealt so severely? Shall women eat their own fruit, the children they have reared? Shall priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
Young and old have lain down on the ground in the streets; my virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered; you have not spared.

You have summoned, as on the day of an appointed feast, my terrors from all around, and there was no escapee or survivor in the day of YHWH's anger. Those whom I had borne and reared, my enemy has made an end of them.

lamentations_3.t: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his fury.
He has driven me and made me walk in darkness and not in light.
Surely against me he turns his hand again and again, all the day.
He has made my flesh and my skin waste away; he has broken my bones.
He has built against me and surrounded me with poison and hardship.
In dark places he has made me dwell, like the dead of old.
He has walled me in and I cannot go out; he has made my bronze fetters heavy.
Even when I cry out and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
He has walled up my ways with hewn stone; he has made my paths crooked.
He is to me a bear lying in wait, a lion in hiding places.
He has turned my ways aside and torn me in pieces; he has made me desolate.
He has bent his bow and set me up like a target for the arrow.
He has brought into my kidneys the sons of his quiver.
I have become a laughingstock to all my people, their taunt song all the day.
He has surfeited me with bitter things; he has made me drink wormwood.
And he has broken my teeth with gravel; he has made me cower in ashes.
And my being is excluded from peace; I have forgotten good.
And I said, "My endurance has perished, and my expectation from YHWH."
Remember my affliction and my homelessness, the wormwood and the poison.
My being surely remembers, and it bows down within me.
This I bring back to my heart; therefore I will wait.
The steadfast love of YHWH — surely we are not consumed, for his compassion does not come to an end.
They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
"YHWH is my portion," my being has said; "therefore I will wait for him."
YHWH is good to those who wait for him, to the being that seeks him.
It is good that one should wait, and in silence, for the deliverance of YHWH.
It is good for a man that he should bear a yoke in his youth.
Let him sit alone and be silent, for he has laid it upon him.
Let him put his mouth in the dust; perhaps there is hope.
Let him give his cheek to the one who strikes him; let him be sated with reproach.
For the Lord will not reject for ever.
For though he has caused grief, he will have compassion according to the greatness of his steadfast love.
For he does not afflict from his heart, or grieve the children of a man.
To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the land,
to turn aside the justice of a man before the presence of the Most High,
to subvert a person in his case at law — the Lord has not seen it?
Who is this who has spoken and it came to be, when the Lord has not commanded it?
Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that troubles and good go forth?
Why should a living person complain, a man, about his sins?
Let us examine our ways and search them out, and let us return to YHWH.
Let us lift up our heart to the palms, to God in the heavens.
We ourselves have transgressed and rebelled; you have not forgiven.
You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have killed; you have not spared.
You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
Scouring and refuse you have made us in the midst of the peoples.
All our enemies have opened their mouth at us.
Terror and a pit have come upon us, devastation and brokenness.
My eye runs down with streams of water for the brokenness of the daughter of my people.
My eye pours itself out and does not cease, from lack of any stopping,
until YHWH looks down and sees from heaven.
My eye has dealt severely with my being because of all the daughters of my city.
They have surely hunted me like a bird, my enemies, without cause.
They have destroyed my life in the pit and thrown a stone down on me.
Waters flowed over my head; I said, "I am cut off."
I called on your name, YHWH, from the lowest pit.
You heard my voice: "Do not hide your ear from my relief, from my cry for help."
You drew near on the day I called on you; you said, "Do not fear."
You have conducted the cases of my being, Lord; you have redeemed my life.
You have seen my oppression, YHWH; judge my judgement.
You have seen all their vengeance, all their plans against me.
You have heard their reproach, YHWH, all their plans against me,
the lips of those who rise against me, and their muttering against me all the day.
Look at their sitting and their rising: I am their mocking song.
You will repay them a recompense, YHWH, according to the work of their hands.
You will give them shamelessness of heart; your curse be upon them.
You will pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of YHWH.

lamentations_4.t: How the gold is dimmed, the fine gold changed! The holy stones lie scattered at the head of all the streets.
The precious children of Zion, weighed against pure gold — how they are reckoned as jars of earthenware, the work of a potter's hands!
Even jackals draw out the breast; they suckle their young. The daughter of my people has become cruel, like ostriches in the wilderness.
The tongue of the suckling has cleaved to its palate for thirst; children have asked for bread; there is no one who breaks it for them.
Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets; those brought up in crimson have embraced ash heaps.
And the punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment, and no hands were wrung over her.
Her nobles were brighter than snow, more dazzling than milk; their bodies were redder than corals; their polish was sapphire.
Their appearance is darker than soot; they are not recognised in the streets. Their skin has shrivelled on their bones; it has become dry as wood.
Better were those slain by the sword than those slain by hunger, who flowed away, pierced through, for lack of the produce of the field.
The hands of compassionate women have boiled their own children; they became food for them in the brokenness of the daughter of my people.
YHWH has completed his rage; he has poured out his burning anger, and he has kindled a fire in Zion that has consumed her foundations.
The kings of the earth did not believe, nor all the inhabitants of the world, that adversary and enemy would enter the gates of Jerusalem.
It was from the sins of her prophets, the iniquities of her priests, who shed in her midst the blood of the righteous.
They wandered blind in the streets; they were defiled with blood, so that none could touch their garments.
"Depart! Unclean!" they called to them; "Depart, depart, do not touch!" For they fled and also wandered; they said among the nations, "They shall not go on sojourning."
The presence of YHWH has scattered them; he will look on them no more. They did not lift up the faces of the priests; they showed no favour to the elders.
Still our eyes failed, looking for our help — a vapour. In our watchtower we watched for a nation that could not save.
They hunted our steps, so that we could not walk in our open places. Our end drew near; our days were completed; for our end had come.
Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of heaven; they hotly pursued us on the mountains; in the wilderness they lay in wait for us.
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of YHWH, was captured in their pits — he of whom we said, "In his shadow we shall live among the nations."
Exult and rejoice, daughter of Edom, dwelling in the land of Uz! To you also the cup will pass; you will become drunk and strip yourself naked.
Your iniquity is finished, daughter of Zion; he will not take you into exile again. He will punish your iniquity, daughter of Edom; he will lay bare your sins.

lamentations_5.t: Remember, YHWH, what has happened to us; look, and see our reproach.
Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
We have become fatherless ones, and there is no father; our mothers are like widows.
Our water we have drunk for money; our wood comes at a price.
At our neck we have been pursued; we have grown weary, and no rest has been given us.
To Egypt we have given a hand, to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.
Our fathers sinned, and they are no more; and we — we have borne their iniquities.
Slaves have ruled over us; there is none who tears us out of their hand.
With our life we bring in our bread, because of the sword of the wilderness.
Our skin has grown hot like an oven, because of the burning heat of hunger.
Women in Zion they have humiliated, virgins in the cities of Judah.
Princes were hanged by their hands; the faces of elders were not honoured.
Young men have lifted the millstone; and boys have staggered under the wood.
Elders have ceased from the gate, young men from their music.
The joy of our heart has ceased; our dancing has been turned into mourning.
The crown has fallen from our head! Woe now to us, for we have sinned.
For this our heart has become faint; for these things our eyes have grown dim.
For Mount Zion, which lies desolate — foxes have prowled over it.
You, YHWH, sit enthroned for ever; your throne is to generation and generation.
Why do you forget us for perpetuity, abandon us for length of days?
Turn us back, YHWH, to yourself, and we shall turn back; renew our days as of old.
For if rejecting you have rejected us, you have been angry with us utterly.

leviticus_1.t: And he called to Moses, and YHWH spoke to him from [the] tent of meeting, saying:

Speak to [the] sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: A human being, when he brings near from among you an offering to YHWH — from the livestock, from the herd and from the flock you shall bring near your offering.
If a burnt offering [is] his offering, from the herd — a male, unblemished, he shall bring it near; to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting he shall bring it near, for his acceptance before YHWH.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him, to make atonement on him.

And he shall slaughter the young of the herd before YHWH, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring near the blood and dash the blood on the altar all around, which [is at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.
And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the pieces, the head and the suet, on the wood that [is] on the fire that [is] on the altar.
And its entrails and its legs he shall wash with water, and the priest shall turn all of it to smoke towards the altar: a burnt offering, a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And if from the flock [is] his offering, from the young rams or from the goats, for a burnt offering — a male, unblemished, he shall bring it near.
And he shall slaughter it at [the] side of the altar northward before YHWH, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash its blood on the altar all around.
And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its suet, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that [is] on the fire that [is] on the altar.

And the entrails and the legs he shall wash with water, and the priest shall bring near all of it and turn [it] to smoke towards the altar. It [is] a burnt offering, a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And if from the birds [is] a burnt offering, his offering to YHWH, then he shall bring near from the turtle-doves or from the young of the dove his offering.
And the priest shall bring it near to the altar and pinch off its head and turn [it] to smoke towards the altar, and its blood shall be drained out on [the] wall of the altar.
And he shall remove its craw with its feathers and throw it beside the altar eastward, to [the] place of the fatty ashes.

And he shall tear it apart by its wings — he shall not separate [it] — and the priest shall turn it to smoke towards the altar, on the wood that [is] on the fire. It [is] a burnt offering, a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.

leviticus_2.t: And a person, when she brings near an offering of a grain offering to YHWH — fine flour shall be his offering, and he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and he shall scoop from there the fullness of his handful, from its fine flour and from its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall turn its memorial portion to smoke towards the altar: a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And the remainder from the grain offering [is] for Aaron and for his sons — a holy thing of holy things from the food offerings of YHWH.
And when you bring near an offering of a grain offering, a baked thing of an oven — fine flour, loaves of unleavened bread mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread smeared with oil.
And if a grain offering on the griddle [is] your offering — fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened it shall be.
Crumble it into crumbs, and you shall pour oil on it. It [is] a grain offering.
And if a grain offering of a pan [is] your offering — of fine flour with oil it shall be made.
And you shall bring the grain offering that is made from these to YHWH, and he shall present it to the priest, and he shall bring it near to the altar.
And the priest shall lift up from the grain offering its memorial portion and turn [it] to smoke towards the altar: a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And the remainder from the grain offering [is] for Aaron and for his sons — a holy thing of holy things from the food offerings of YHWH.
Every grain offering that you bring near to YHWH shall not be made leavened, for you shall not turn any leaven or any honey to smoke as a food offering to YHWH.
As an offering of first produce you shall bring them near to YHWH, but to the altar they shall not go up as an odour of soothing.

And every offering of your grain offering you shall salt with salt, and you shall not let the salt of the covenant of your God cease from upon your grain offering. With all your offerings you shall bring near salt.
And if you bring near a grain offering of first fruits to YHWH — fresh ears roasted in fire, groats of fresh grain — you shall bring near the grain offering of your first fruits.
And you shall put oil on it and place frankincense on it. It [is] a grain offering.
And the priest shall turn its memorial portion to smoke — from its groats and from its oil, with all its frankincense: a food offering to YHWH.

leviticus_3.t: And if a sacrifice of peace offering [is] his offering — if from the herd he [is] bringing [it] near, whether male or female, unblemished he shall bring it near before YHWH.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of his offering and slaughter it [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash the blood on the altar all around.
And he shall bring near from the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] a food offering to YHWH: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,
and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, that [is] on the loins, and the lobe on the liver — with the kidneys he shall remove it.
And the sons of Aaron shall turn it to smoke towards the altar, on the burnt offering that [is] on the wood that [is] on the fire: a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And if from the flock [is] his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering to YHWH — male or female, unblemished he shall bring it near.
If a sheep he [is] bringing near [as] his offering, then he shall bring it near before YHWH.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of his offering and slaughter it before the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood on the altar all around.

And he shall bring near from the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] a food offering to YHWH: its fat — the fat tail entire, close to the backbone he shall remove it — and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,
and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, that [is] on the loins, and the lobe on the liver — with the kidneys he shall remove it.
And the priest shall turn it to smoke towards the altar: food of a food offering to YHWH.
And if a goat [is] his offering, then he shall bring it near before YHWH.
And he shall lean his hand on its head and slaughter it before the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood on the altar all around.
And he shall bring near from it his offering, a food offering to YHWH: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,
and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, that [is] on the loins, and the lobe on the liver — with the kidneys he shall remove it.
And the priest shall turn them to smoke towards the altar: food of a food offering, for an odour of soothing. All fat [belongs] to YHWH.
A statute of perpetuity for your generations, in all your dwelling places: any fat and any blood you shall not eat.

leviticus_4.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying: A person, when she sins inadvertently against any of the commandments of YHWH that are not to be done, and does any one of them —
if the anointed priest sins, [bringing] guilt on the people, then he shall bring near for his sin that he sinned a bull, a young of the herd, unblemished, to YHWH as a sin offering.
And he shall bring the bull to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting before YHWH, and lean his hand on [the] head of the bull, and slaughter the bull before YHWH.
And the anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent of meeting.
And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before YHWH, towards the face of the veil of the holy place.

And the priest shall put some of the blood on [the] horns of the altar of fragrant incense before YHWH, which [is] in the tent of meeting, and all the blood of the bull he shall pour out at [the] base of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And all the fat of the bull of the sin offering he shall lift up from it: the fat that covers over the entrails and all the fat that [is] on the entrails,
and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, that [is] on the loins, and the lobe on the liver — with the kidneys he shall remove it,
just as it is lifted up from the ox of the sacrifice of the peace [offerings]; and the priest shall turn them to smoke on the altar of the burnt offering.
And the hide of the bull and all its flesh, with its head and with its legs, and its entrails and its dung —

and he shall bring out all the bull to outside the camp, to a clean place, to [the] pouring-place of the fatty ashes, and burn it on wood in fire; at the pouring-place of the fatty ashes it shall be burned.

And if all the congregation of Israel goes astray, and the matter is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they do one of all the commandments of YHWH that are not to be done, and they become guilty —
and the sin that they sinned concerning it becomes known, then the assembly shall bring near a bull, a young of the herd, as a sin offering, and bring it before the tent of meeting.
And the elders of the congregation shall lean their hands on [the] head of the bull before YHWH, and he shall slaughter the bull before YHWH.
And the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull into the tent of meeting.
And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood and sprinkle [it] seven times before YHWH, towards the face of the veil.

And some of the blood he shall put on [the] horns of the altar that [is] before YHWH, which [is] in the tent of meeting, and all the blood he shall pour out at [the] base of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And all its fat he shall lift up from it and turn to smoke towards the altar.
And he shall do to the bull just as he did to the bull of the sin offering — so he shall do to it — and the priest shall make atonement on them, and it shall be forgiven to them.
And he shall bring the bull out to outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull. It [is] the sin offering of the assembly.
When a leader sins and does inadvertently one of all the commandments of YHWH his God that are not to be done, and becomes guilty —
or his sin that he sinned by it is made known to him, then he shall bring his offering: a male goat of the goats, a male, unblemished.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of the male goat and slaughter it in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before YHWH. It [is] a sin offering.

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put [it] on [the] horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and its blood he shall pour out at [the] base of the altar of the burnt offering.

And all its fat he shall turn to smoke towards the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of the peace [offerings]; and the priest shall make atonement on him from his sin, and it shall be forgiven to him.
And if one person from the people of the land sins inadvertently, in doing one of the commandments of YHWH that are not to be done, and becomes guilty —
or his sin that he sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring his offering: a female goat of the goats, unblemished, a female, for his sin that he sinned.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put [it] on [the] horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and all its blood he shall pour out at [the] base of the altar.

And all its fat he shall remove, just as the fat was removed from upon the sacrifice of the peace [offerings]; and the priest shall turn [it] to smoke towards the altar for an odour of soothing to YHWH. And the priest shall make atonement on him, and it shall be forgiven to him.
And if he brings a lamb [as] his offering for a sin offering, a female, unblemished, he shall bring it.
And he shall lean his hand on [the] head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put [it] on [the] horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and all its blood he shall pour out at [the] base of the altar.

And all its fat he shall remove, just as the fat of the sheep is removed from the sacrifice of the peace [offerings]; and the priest shall turn them to smoke towards the altar, on the food offerings of YHWH. And the priest shall make atonement on him for his sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven to him.

leviticus_5.t: And a person, when she sins: she has heard a voice of adjuration and he was a witness — either he saw or he knew — if he does not tell, then he shall bear his iniquity.

Or a person who touches any unclean thing — whether the carcass of an unclean wild animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of an unclean swarming creature — and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall become guilty.
Or if he touches a human uncleanness — any of his uncleanness by which he becomes unclean — and it is hidden from him, and he comes to know, then he shall become guilty.

Or a person who swears, speaking rashly with the lips to do harm or to do good — anything that people speak rashly in an oath — and it is hidden from him, and he comes to know, then he shall become guilty in one of these.
And it shall be, when he becomes guilty in one of these, that he shall confess that in which he sinned.

And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH for his sin that he sinned — a female from the flock, a ewe lamb or a female goat of the goats — as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement on him from his sin.

And if his hand does not reach enough for a sheep, then he shall bring as his guilt offering for what he sinned two turtle-doves or two young of the dove to YHWH, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering.
And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring near the one that is for the sin offering first, and pinch off its head from in front of its neck, but he shall not separate [it].
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on [the] wall of the altar, and the remainder of the blood shall be drained out at [the] base of the altar. It [is] a sin offering.
And the second he shall make a burnt offering according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement on him from his sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven to him.

And if his hand does not reach two turtle-doves or two young of the dove, then he shall bring his offering for what he sinned: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He shall not place oil on it and shall not put frankincense on it, for it [is] a sin offering.

And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall scoop from it the fullness of his handful as its memorial portion, and turn [it] to smoke towards the altar, on the food offerings of YHWH. It [is] a sin offering.
And the priest shall make atonement on him for his sin that he sinned in any one of these, and it shall be forgiven to him. And it shall belong to the priest, like the grain offering.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

A person, when she acts unfaithfully an act of unfaithfulness and sins inadvertently against the holy things of YHWH, then he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH: an unblemished ram from the flock, at your valuation in silver shekels, by the sanctuary shekel, as a guilt offering.

And what he sinned from the holy thing he shall repay, and its fifth he shall add to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement on him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven to him.
And if a person sins and does one of all the commandments of YHWH that are not to be done, and he did not know, then he shall become guilty and shall bear his iniquity.

And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock, at your valuation, as a guilt offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement on him for his inadvertence in which he went astray, though he did not know, and it shall be forgiven to him.
It [is] a guilt offering. Being guilty, he was guilty towards YHWH.

leviticus_6.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

A person, when she sins and acts unfaithfully an act of unfaithfulness against YHWH, and deceives his fellow in a deposit, or in a pledge placed in hand, or in a robbery, or he has extorted from his fellow,
or he has found a lost thing and deceived about it and sworn to a falsehood — in any one of all these that people do, sinning by them —

then it shall be, when he sins and becomes guilty, that he shall return what he took by robbery, which he robbed, or the extortion which he extorted, or the deposit which was deposited with him, or the lost thing which he found,
or anything about which he swore falsely — he shall repay it in its principal amount and add its fifth to it; to the one to whom it belongs he shall give it, on the day of his guilt.
And his guilt offering he shall bring to YHWH: an unblemished ram from the flock, at your valuation, as a guilt offering, to the priest.
And the priest shall make atonement on him before YHWH, and it shall be forgiven to him for any one of all that one may do to become guilty by it.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This [is] the law for the burnt offering. It [is] the burnt offering on the hearth on the altar all the night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and linen undergarments he shall put on over his flesh, and he shall lift up the fatty ashes to which the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and put them beside the altar.
And he shall strip off his garments and put on other garments, and take the fatty ashes out to outside the camp, to a clean place.

And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not be extinguished. And the priest shall kindle wood on it morning by morning, and arrange the burnt offering on it, and turn to smoke on it the fats of the peace offerings.
A fire shall be kept burning continually on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.
And this [is] the law for the grain offering. The sons of Aaron shall bring it near before YHWH, to the face of the altar.

And he shall lift up from it in his handful, from the fine flour of the grain offering and from its oil, and all the frankincense that [is] on the grain offering, and turn [it] to smoke on the altar: an odour of soothing, its memorial portion, to YHWH.
And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. Unleavened it shall be eaten, in a holy place; in [the] courtyard of [the] tent of meeting they shall eat it.
It shall not be baked leavened. [As] their share I have given it from my food offerings. It [is] a holy thing of holy things, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.
Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it — a perpetual due for your generations from the food offerings of YHWH. Everything that touches them shall become holy.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

This [is] the offering of Aaron and his sons that they shall bring near to YHWH on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
On a griddle with oil it shall be made; well mixed you shall bring it; baked pieces of a grain offering of crumbs you shall bring near, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons shall make it. [It is] a perpetual due to YHWH; it shall be turned entirely to smoke as a whole offering.
And every grain offering of a priest shall be a whole offering; it shall not be eaten.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This [is] the law for the sin offering. In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered the sin offering shall be slaughtered, before YHWH. It [is] a holy thing of holy things.
The priest who offers it as a sin offering shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten, in [the] courtyard of [the] tent of meeting.
Everything that touches its flesh shall become holy; and when some of its blood is sprinkled on a garment, what it was sprinkled on you shall wash in a holy place.
And an earthenware vessel in which it was boiled shall be broken; and if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured and rinsed with water.
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It [is] a holy thing of holy things.
And any sin offering some of whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place shall not be eaten; it shall be burned in the fire.

leviticus_7.t: And this [is] the law for the guilt offering. It [is] a holy thing of holy things.
In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering they shall slaughter the guilt offering, and its blood he shall dash on the altar all around.
And all its fat he shall bring near from it: the fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,
