and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, that [is] on the loins, and the lobe on the liver — with the kidneys he shall remove it.
And the priest shall turn them to smoke towards the altar, a food offering to YHWH. It [is] a guilt offering.
Every male among the priests shall eat it. In a holy place it shall be eaten. It [is] a holy thing of holy things.
As the sin offering, so the guilt offering: one law [belongs] to them. The priest who makes atonement by it — to him it shall belong.
And the priest who presents anyone's burnt offering — the hide of the burnt offering that he presented shall belong to the priest, to him.
And every grain offering that is baked in the oven, and everything made in the pan or on the griddle, shall belong to the priest who presents it; to him it shall belong.
And every grain offering mixed with oil, or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.
And this [is] the law for the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] that one brings near to YHWH.

If for thanksgiving he brings it near, then he shall bring near with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened loaves mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers smeared with oil, and fine flour well mixed [in] loaves mixed with oil.
With loaves of leavened bread he shall bring near his offering, with the sacrifice of the thanksgiving of his peace [offerings].
And he shall bring near from it one from each offering as a contribution to YHWH; it shall belong to the priest who dashes the blood of the peace offerings, to him.
And the flesh of the sacrifice of the thanksgiving of his peace [offerings] shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until morning.
And if a vow or a freewill offering [is] the sacrifice of his offering, it shall be eaten on the day he brings his sacrifice near, and on the next day the remainder of it shall be eaten.
And the remainder from the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned in the fire.

And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace [offerings] is ever eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted; the one who presents it — it shall not be reckoned to him; it shall be foul, and the person who eats of it shall bear her iniquity.
And the flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned in the fire. And the flesh — every clean person may eat flesh.
And the person who eats flesh from the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] that [belongs] to YHWH while his uncleanness [is] on him — that person shall be cut off from her kin.

And a person who touches anything unclean — a human uncleanness, or unclean livestock, or any unclean detestable creature — and eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] that [belongs] to YHWH, that person shall be cut off from her kin.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying: Any fat of ox or sheep or goat you shall not eat.
And the fat of a carcass and the fat of a torn animal may be used for any work, but eating it you shall not eat it.
For anyone who eats fat from the animal from which he brings near a food offering to YHWH — the person who eats shall be cut off from her kin.
And any blood you shall not eat in all your dwelling places, whether of bird or of livestock.
Every person who eats any blood — that person shall be cut off from her kin.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying: The one who brings near the sacrifice of his peace [offerings] to YHWH shall bring his offering to YHWH from the sacrifice of his peace [offerings].
His own hands shall bring the food offerings of YHWH: the fat with the breast he shall bring it, the breast, to wave it as a wave offering before YHWH.
And the priest shall turn the fat to smoke towards the altar, and the breast shall belong to Aaron and to his sons.
And the right thigh you shall give as a contribution to the priest from the sacrifices of your peace [offerings].
The one among the sons of Aaron who brings near the blood of the peace offerings and the fat — to him shall the right thigh belong as a portion.

For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution I have taken from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace [offerings], and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a perpetual due from the sons of Israel.
This [is] the anointing portion of Aaron and the anointing portion of his sons from the food offerings of YHWH, on the day he presented them to serve as priests to YHWH,
which YHWH commanded to be given to them on the day he anointed them, from the sons of Israel — a perpetual statute for their generations.

This [is] the law for the burnt offering, for the grain offering, and for the sin offering, and for the guilt offering, and for the ordination offering, and for the sacrifice of the peace [offerings],
which YHWH commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day he commanded the sons of Israel to bring near their offerings to YHWH, in the wilderness of Sinai.

leviticus_8.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,
and assemble all the congregation at [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And Moses did just as YHWH commanded him, and the congregation assembled at [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And Moses said to the congregation: This [is] the word that YHWH commanded to be done.
And Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.
And he put the tunic on him and girded him with the sash and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him, and girded him with the waistband of the ephod and bound it on him with it.
And he placed the breastpiece on him, and put the Urim and the Thummim into the breastpiece.
And he placed the turban on his head, and placed on the turban, at the front of his face, the plate of gold, the crown of holiness, just as YHWH commanded Moses.
And Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] in it, and set them apart as holy.
And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its articles and the washbasin and its stand, to set them apart as holy.
And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to set him apart as holy.
And Moses brought the sons of Aaron near and clothed them with tunics and girded them with a sash and bound headdresses on them, just as YHWH commanded Moses.
And he brought near the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on [the] head of the bull of the sin offering.

And he slaughtered [it], and Moses took the blood and put [it] on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar from sin; and the blood he poured at [the] base of the altar, and set it apart as holy, to make atonement on it.
And he took all the fat that [was] on the entrails and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned [them] to smoke towards the altar.
And the bull, and its hide and its flesh and its dung, he burned in the fire outside the camp, just as YHWH commanded Moses.
And he brought near the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on [the] head of the ram.
And he slaughtered [it], and Moses dashed the blood on the altar all around.
And the ram he cut into its pieces, and Moses turned the head and the pieces and the suet to smoke.

And the entrails and the legs he washed with water, and Moses turned all the ram to smoke towards the altar. It [was] a burnt offering for an odour of soothing; it [was] a food offering to YHWH, just as YHWH commanded Moses.
And he brought near the second ram, the ram of the ordination offering, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on [the] head of the ram.
And he slaughtered [it], and Moses took some of its blood and put [it] on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

And he brought the sons of Aaron near, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobe of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and Moses dashed the blood on the altar all around.
And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that [was] on the entrails, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh.
And from the basket of unleavened bread that [was] before YHWH he took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fats and on the right thigh.
And he put all of it on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and waved them as a wave offering before YHWH.

And Moses took them from on their palms and turned [them] to smoke towards the altar, on the burnt offering. They [were] an ordination offering for an odour of soothing; it [was] a food offering to YHWH.
And Moses took the breast and waved it as a wave offering before YHWH. From the ram of the ordination offering it belonged to Moses as a portion, just as YHWH commanded Moses.

And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that [was] on the altar, and sprinkled [it] on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons' garments with him; and he set Aaron apart as holy, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons: Boil the flesh [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, and there you shall eat it, and the bread that [is] in the basket of the ordination offering, just as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
And what remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn in the fire.
And from [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting you shall not go out for seven days, until the day your days of ordination are completed; for seven days he shall fill your hand.
As has been done on this day, YHWH has commanded to do, to make atonement on you.
And [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting you shall stay day and night for seven days, and keep the charge of YHWH, and you shall not die; for so I have been commanded.
And Aaron and his sons did all the things that YHWH commanded by the hand of Moses.

leviticus_9.t: And it was on the eighth day that Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
And he said to Aaron: Take for yourself a calf, a young of the herd, for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, unblemished, and bring [them] near before YHWH.
And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying: Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, sons of a year, unblemished, for a burnt offering,
and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before YHWH, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today YHWH is appearing to you.
And they took what Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and all the congregation drew near and stood before YHWH.
And Moses said: This [is] the thing that YHWH commanded you to do, that the glory of YHWH may appear to you.

And Moses said to Aaron: Draw near to the altar and make your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people; and make the offering of the people and make atonement for them, just as YHWH commanded.
And Aaron drew near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering that [was] for himself.
And the sons of Aaron brought the blood near to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put [it] on the horns of the altar; and the blood he poured at [the] base of the altar.
And the fat and the kidneys and the lobe from the liver from the sin offering he turned to smoke towards the altar, just as YHWH commanded Moses.
And the flesh and the hide he burned in the fire outside the camp.
And he slaughtered the burnt offering, and the sons of Aaron handed him the blood, and he dashed it on the altar all around.
And the burnt offering they handed him in its pieces, and the head, and he turned [them] to smoke on the altar.
And he washed the entrails and the legs and turned [them] to smoke on the burnt offering, towards the altar.
And he brought near the offering of the people, and took the goat of the sin offering that [was] for the people, and slaughtered it and purified with it from sin, like the first.
And he brought near the burnt offering and made it according to the ordinance.
And he brought near the grain offering and filled his palm from it, and turned [it] to smoke on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
And he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of the peace [offerings] that [was] for the people, and the sons of Aaron handed him the blood, and he dashed it on the altar all around.
And the fats from the ox, and from the ram: the fat tail, and the covering, and the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver —
and they placed the fats on the breasts, and he turned the fats to smoke towards the altar.
And the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved as a wave offering before YHWH, just as Moses commanded.
And Aaron lifted his hands towards the people and blessed them, and he came down from making the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and they came out and blessed the people, and the glory of YHWH appeared to all the people.
And fire went out from before YHWH and consumed the burnt offering and the fats on the altar; and all the people saw and shouted and fell on their faces.

leviticus_10.t: And the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, took each his censer and put fire in them and placed incense on it, and brought near before YHWH strange fire, which he had not commanded them.
And fire went out from before YHWH and consumed them, and they died before YHWH.
And Moses said to Aaron: This [is] what YHWH spoke, saying, 'Among those near me I will show myself holy, and before the face of all the people I will be honoured.' And Aaron was silent.
And Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them: Draw near, carry your kinsmen from before the holy place, to outside the camp.
And they drew near and carried them in their tunics to outside the camp, just as Moses had spoken.

And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar his sons: Do not let your heads go loose, and do not tear your garments, and you shall not die, and he will not be angry towards all the congregation. But your kinsmen, all the house of Israel, shall weep for the burning that YHWH has burned.
And from [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting you shall not go out, lest you die, for the oil of the anointing of YHWH [is] on you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
And YHWH spoke to Aaron, saying:
Wine and strong drink you shall not drink, you and your sons with you, when you come into the tent of meeting, and you shall not die — a perpetual statute for your generations —
and to separate between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean,
and to teach the sons of Israel all the statutes that YHWH has spoken to them by the hand of Moses.

And Moses spoke to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his remaining sons: Take the grain offering that remains from the food offerings of YHWH and eat it unleavened beside the altar, for it [is] a holy thing of holy things.
And you shall eat it in a holy place, for it [is] your prescribed portion and your sons' prescribed portion from the food offerings of YHWH; for so I have been commanded.

And the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution you shall eat in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you; for they are given as your due and your sons' due from the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the sons of Israel.

The thigh of the contribution and the breast of the wave offering they shall bring with the food offerings of the fats, to wave as a wave offering before YHWH; and it shall belong to you and to your sons with you as a perpetual due, just as YHWH commanded.
And the goat of the sin offering Moses sought and sought, and there — it had been burned! And he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the remaining sons of Aaron, saying:

Why did you not eat the sin offering in the place of the holy, for it [is] a holy thing of holy things, and he gave it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement on them before YHWH?
Look — its blood was not brought into the holy place within! You should certainly have eaten it in the holy place, just as I commanded.

And Aaron spoke to Moses: Look — today they brought near their sin offering and their burnt offering before YHWH, and such things as these have befallen me. Had I eaten a sin offering today, would it have been good in the eyes of YHWH?
And Moses heard, and it was good in his eyes.

leviticus_11.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them:
Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying: This [is] the creature that you may eat from among all the livestock that [are] on the land.
Anything among the livestock that divides a hoof and cleaves a cleft of hooves and brings up cud — that you may eat.
Nevertheless this you shall not eat, from those that bring up the cud and from those that divide the hoof: the camel, for it brings up cud but does not divide a hoof — it [is] unclean for you;
and the rock hyrax, for it brings up cud but does not divide a hoof — it [is] unclean for you;
and the hare, for it brings up cud but does not divide a hoof — it [is] unclean for you;
and the pig, for it divides a hoof and cleaves a cleft of hoof, but it does not chew cud — it [is] unclean for you.
From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch. They [are] unclean for you.
This you may eat from all that [is] in the waters: everything that has fin and scale in the waters, in the seas and in the wadis — those you may eat.

And everything that has no fin and scale in the seas and in the wadis, from every swarming creature of the waters and from every living creature that [is] in the waters — they [are] detestable for you.
And they shall be detestable for you: from their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall treat as detestable.
Everything that has no fin and scale in the waters — it [is] detestable for you.
And these you shall treat as detestable from among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they [are] detestable: the eagle, and the bearded vulture, and the black vulture,
and the kite, and the falcon after its kind,
every raven after its kind,
and the daughter of the ostrich, and the screech owl, and the gull, and the hawk after its kind,
and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
and the white owl, and the desert owl, and the carrion vulture,
and the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
Every winged swarming creature that goes on four [legs] — it [is] detestable for you.
Nevertheless these you may eat from among all the winged swarming creatures that go on four [legs]: those that have jointed legs above their feet, for hopping with them on the ground.
These of them you may eat: the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.
But every winged swarming creature that has four feet — it [is] detestable for you.
And by these you shall become unclean: everyone who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until the evening,
and everyone who carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening.
As for every animal that divides a hoof but does not cleave a cleft, or does not bring up cud — they [are] unclean for you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
And everything that goes on its paws among all the creatures that go on four [feet] — they [are] unclean for you. Everyone who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until the evening,
and the one who carries their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening. They [are] unclean for you.
And this [is] what is unclean for you among the swarming creatures that swarm on the ground: the choled, and the mouse, and the tsav after its kind,
and the gecko, and the monitor lizard, and the lizard, and the skink, and the chameleon.
These [are] what is unclean for you among all the swarming creatures. Everyone who touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

And anything on which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean — any vessel of wood, or a garment, or a hide, or sacking, any vessel with which work is done. It shall be put into water and be unclean until the evening, and then be clean.
And every earthenware vessel into whose inside any of them falls — everything in it shall be unclean, and it you shall break.
Any food that may be eaten on which water has come shall be unclean, and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel shall be unclean.
And anything on which any of their carcasses falls shall be unclean. An oven or a stove shall be broken down; they [are] unclean, and unclean they shall be for you.
Nevertheless a spring or a cistern, a gathering of water, shall be clean; but the one who touches their carcass shall be unclean.
And if any of their carcass falls on any seed for sowing that is to be sown, it [is] clean.
But if water has been put on seed and any of their carcass falls on it, it [is] unclean for you.
And if any of the livestock that [is] yours for food dies, the one who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
And the one who eats of its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening; and the one who carries its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening.
And every swarming creature that swarms on the ground — it [is] detestable; it shall not be eaten.

Anything that goes on the belly, and anything that goes on four [feet], up to anything with many feet, among all the swarming creatures that swarm on the ground — you shall not eat them, for they [are] detestable.
Do not make yourselves detestable by any swarming creature that swarms, and do not make yourselves unclean by them, so that you become unclean by them.
For I [am] YHWH your God. And you shall set yourselves apart as holy and be holy, for I [am] holy. And you shall not make yourselves unclean by any swarming creature that creeps on the ground.
For I [am] YHWH who brought you up from the land of Egypt, to be God for you. And you shall be holy, for I [am] holy.
This [is] the law for the livestock and the bird and every living creature that moves in the waters and every creature that swarms on the ground,
to separate between the unclean and the clean, and between the creature that may be eaten and the creature that may not be eaten.

leviticus_12.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to [the] sons of Israel, saying: A woman, when she produces seed and bears a male, shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the menstrual impurity of her ailing she shall be unclean.
And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

And thirty days and three days she shall remain in the blood of her cleansing. She shall not touch any holy thing, and she shall not come into the sanctuary, until the days of her cleansing are completed.
And if she bears a female, she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her menstrual impurity; and sixty days and six days she shall remain upon the blood of cleansing.

And when the days of her cleansing are completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb, a son of its year, for a burnt offering, and a young of the dove or a turtle-dove for a sin offering, to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, to the priest.
And he shall bring it near before YHWH and make atonement on her, and she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This [is] the law for the one who gives birth, for the male or for the female.

And if her hand does not find enough for a sheep, then she shall take two turtle-doves or two young of the dove, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement on her, and she shall be clean.

leviticus_13.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:

A human being, when there is on the skin of his flesh a swelling or a rash or a bright spot, and it becomes on the skin of his flesh an affliction of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

And the priest shall look at the affliction on the skin of the flesh, and if the hair in the affliction has turned white and the appearance of the affliction is deeper than the skin of his flesh, it [is] an affliction of leprosy; and the priest shall look at him and pronounce him unclean.

And if it [is] a white bright spot on the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, then the priest shall shut the afflicted one away seven days.

And the priest shall look at him on the seventh day, and if the affliction has stayed in his sight and the affliction has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him away seven days a second time.

And the priest shall look at him on the seventh day a second time, and if the affliction has become dull and the affliction has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It [is] a rash; and he shall wash his garments and be clean.
And if the rash spreads and spreads in the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, then he shall show himself a second time to the priest.
And the priest shall look, and if the rash has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] leprosy.
An affliction of leprosy, when it is on a human being, then he shall be brought to the priest.
And the priest shall look, and if there is a white swelling in the skin and it has turned the hair white, and [there is] a raw spot of living flesh in the swelling,
it [is] an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not shut him away, for he [is] unclean.
And if the leprosy breaks out and breaks out in the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the afflicted one, from his head to his feet, as far as the priest's eyes can see,
then the priest shall look, and if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce the afflicted one clean. All of it has turned white; he [is] clean.
But on the day living flesh appears on him he shall be unclean.
And the priest shall look at the living flesh and pronounce him unclean. The living flesh [is] unclean; it [is] leprosy.
Or if the living flesh turns back and is turned to white, then he shall come to the priest.
And the priest shall look at him, and if the affliction has been turned to white, then the priest shall pronounce the afflicted one clean. He [is] clean.
And flesh, when there is on it, on its skin, a boil, and it heals,
and there is in the place of the boil a white swelling or a reddish-white bright spot, then he shall show himself to the priest.

And the priest shall look, and if its appearance is lower than the skin and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] an affliction of leprosy; it has broken out in the boil.
And if the priest looks at it, and there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is dull, then the priest shall shut him away seven days.
And if it spreads and spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] an affliction.
But if the bright spot stays in its place and has not spread, it [is] the scar of the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Or flesh, when there is on its skin a burn of fire, and the raw spot of the burn is a reddish-white or white bright spot,

then the priest shall look at it, and if the hair has been turned white in the bright spot and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it [is] leprosy; it has broken out in the burn. And the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] an affliction of leprosy.
And if the priest looks at it, and there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is dull, then the priest shall shut him away seven days.
And the priest shall look at him on the seventh day. If it spreads and spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] an affliction of leprosy.
And if the bright spot stays in its place and has not spread in the skin, and it is dull, it [is] the swelling of the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it [is] the scar of the burn.
And a man or a woman, when there is on him an affliction on the head or in the beard,

then the priest shall look at the affliction, and if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and in it is thin yellow hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It [is] a scall; it [is] leprosy of the head or the beard.

And when the priest looks at the affliction of the scall, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut the afflicted one of the scall away seven days.
And the priest shall look at the affliction on the seventh day, and if the scall has not spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the scall is not deeper than the skin,
then he shall shave himself, but the scall he shall not shave; and the priest shall shut the scall away seven days a second time.

And the priest shall look at the scall on the seventh day, and if the scall has not spread in the skin and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his garments and be clean.
But if the scall spreads and spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
then the priest shall look at him, and if the scall has spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair. He [is] unclean.
But if in his sight the scall has stayed and black hair has sprouted in it, the scall has healed. He [is] clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
And a man or a woman, when there are on the skin of their flesh bright spots, white bright spots,
then the priest shall look, and if on the skin of their flesh the bright spots are dull white, it [is] a harmless rash; it has broken out on the skin. He [is] clean.
And a man, when his head becomes bare — he [is] bald; he [is] clean.
And if his head becomes bare on the side of his face, he [is] bald at the forehead; he [is] clean.
And when there is on the bald patch or on the bald forehead a reddish-white affliction, it [is] leprosy breaking out on his bald patch or on his bald forehead.
And the priest shall look at him, and if the swelling of the affliction is reddish-white on his bald patch or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy of the skin of the flesh,
he [is] a man with leprosy; he [is] unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his affliction [is] on his head.
And the one with leprosy, on whom the affliction is — his garments shall be torn and his head shall go loose, and he shall cover over his moustache and call out, Unclean! Unclean!
All the days that the affliction is on him he shall be unclean. He [is] unclean. He shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
And a garment, when there is on it an affliction of leprosy, in a garment of wool or in a garment of linen,
or in warp or in weft, of the linen or of the wool, or in a hide or in anything made of hide,
and the affliction is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the hide or in the warp or in the weft or in anything of hide, it [is] an affliction of leprosy, and it shall be shown to the priest.
And the priest shall look at the affliction and shut the affliction away seven days.

And he shall look at the affliction on the seventh day: if the affliction has spread in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in the hide, in anything the hide is made into for use, the affliction [is] a persistent leprosy. It [is] unclean.

And he shall burn the garment, or the warp, or the weft, in the wool or in the linen, or any article of hide in which the affliction is; for it [is] a persistent leprosy. It shall be burned in the fire.
And if the priest looks, and the affliction has not spread in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in anything of hide,
then the priest shall command, and they shall wash what the affliction is in, and he shall shut it away seven days a second time.

And the priest shall look after the affliction has been washed out, and if the affliction has not changed its eye and the affliction has not spread, it [is] unclean. You shall burn it in the fire. It [is] a pitting, on its bald patch or on its bald forehead.
And if the priest has looked, and the affliction has become dull after it was washed out, then he shall tear it out of the garment or out of the hide or out of the warp or out of the weft.
And if it appears again in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in anything of hide, it [is] breaking out. You shall burn in the fire what the affliction is in.
And the garment, or the warp, or the weft, or any article of hide that you wash, and the affliction departs from them — it shall be washed a second time and be clean.
This [is] the law for an affliction of leprosy in a garment of wool or of linen, or in the warp or in the weft, or in any article of hide, to pronounce it clean or to pronounce it unclean.

leviticus_14.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
This shall be the law for the one with leprosy on the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought to the priest,
and the priest shall go out to outside the camp, and the priest shall look, and if the affliction of leprosy has been healed in the one who had leprosy,
then the priest shall command, and there shall be taken for the one cleansing himself two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet of the worm, and hyssop.
And the priest shall command, and one of the birds shall be slaughtered into an earthenware vessel over living water.

The living bird — he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet of the worm, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered, over the living water.
And he shall sprinkle on the one cleansing himself from the leprosy seven times, and pronounce him clean, and let the living bird go over the face of the field.

And the one cleansing himself shall wash his garments and shave off all his hair and wash with water, and he shall be clean. And afterwards he shall come into the camp, but he shall stay outside his tent seven days.

And it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave off all his hair — his head and his beard and his eyebrows; all his hair he shall shave off — and he shall wash his garments and wash his flesh with water, and he shall be clean.

And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished lambs, and one ewe lamb, a daughter of its year, unblemished, and three tenths of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
And the priest who pronounces clean shall station the person who is cleansing himself, and them, before YHWH at [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.
And the priest shall take the one lamb and bring it near as a guilt offering, with the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before YHWH.

And he shall slaughter the lamb in the place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered, in the holy place; for like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest. It [is] a holy thing of holy things.

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put [it] on the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour [it] on the priest's left palm.
And the priest shall dip his right finger in some of the oil that [is] on his left palm and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before YHWH.

And from the remainder of the oil that [is] on his palm the priest shall put on the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the blood of the guilt offering.
And what remains of the oil that [is] on the priest's palm he shall put on the head of the one cleansing himself; and the priest shall make atonement on him before YHWH.
And the priest shall make the sin offering and make atonement on the one cleansing himself from his uncleanness; and afterwards he shall slaughter the burnt offering.
And the priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering towards the altar, and the priest shall make atonement on him, and he shall be clean.

And if he is poor and his hand does not reach, then he shall take one lamb as a guilt offering for a wave offering, to make atonement on him, and one tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and a log of oil,
and two turtle-doves or two young of the dove, whatever his hand can reach; and one shall be a sin offering and the one a burnt offering.
And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, before YHWH.
And the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before YHWH.

And he shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put [it] on the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
And the priest shall pour some of the oil on the priest's left palm.
And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that [is] on his left palm, seven times before YHWH.

And the priest shall put some of the oil that [is] on his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one cleansing himself, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the guilt offering.
And what remains of the oil that [is] on the priest's palm he shall put on the head of the one cleansing himself, to make atonement on him before YHWH.
And he shall make one of the turtle-doves or of the young of the dove, from what his hand can reach,
whatever his hand can reach: the one a sin offering and the one a burnt offering, with the grain offering. And the priest shall make atonement on the one cleansing himself before YHWH.
This [is] the law for one who has an affliction of leprosy, whose hand cannot reach at his cleansing.
And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
When you come into the land of Canaan, which I am giving to you as a possession, and I put an affliction of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession,
then the one to whom the house belongs shall come and tell the priest, saying: Something like an affliction has appeared to me in the house.

And the priest shall command, and they shall clear the house before the priest comes to look at the affliction, so that everything in the house does not become unclean; and after that the priest shall come to look at the house.
And he shall look at the affliction, and if the affliction is in the walls of the house — greenish or reddish hollows, and their appearance lower than the wall —
then the priest shall go out from the house to [the] entrance of the house and shut the house away seven days.
And the priest shall return on the seventh day and look, and if the affliction has spread in the walls of the house,
then the priest shall command, and they shall tear out the stones in which the affliction is, and throw them outside the city, to an unclean place.
And the house he shall have scraped inside all around, and they shall pour out the dust they have scraped off outside the city, to an unclean place.
And they shall take other stones and bring them in place of the stones, and he shall take other dust and plaster the house.
And if the affliction returns and breaks out in the house after the stones have been torn out, and after the house has been scraped, and after it has been plastered,
then the priest shall come and look, and if the affliction has spread in the house, it [is] a persistent leprosy in the house. It [is] unclean.
And he shall pull down the house — its stones and its timbers and all the dust of the house — and take them outside the city, to an unclean place.
And the one who goes into the house all the days it is shut away shall be unclean until the evening.
And the one who lies down in the house shall wash his garments, and the one who eats in the house shall wash his garments.

But if the priest indeed comes and looks, and the affliction has not spread in the house after the house has been plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, for the affliction has been healed.
And to purify the house from sin he shall take two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet of the worm, and hyssop.
And he shall slaughter one of the birds into an earthenware vessel over living water.

And he shall take the cedar wood and the hyssop and the scarlet of the worm and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered and in the living water, and sprinkle towards the house seven times.
And he shall purify the house from sin with the blood of the bird, and with the living water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet of the worm.
And he shall let the living bird go outside the city, over the face of the field, and make atonement on the house, and it shall be clean.
This [is] the law for every affliction of leprosy, and for the scall,
and for the leprosy of the garment and for the house,
and for the swelling and for the rash and for the bright spot,
to teach on the day of the unclean and on the day of the clean. This [is] the law for leprosy.

leviticus_15.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man, any man, when he has a discharge from his flesh — his discharge is unclean.
And this shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his flesh runs with his discharge, or his flesh is stopped from his discharge — it is his uncleanness.
Every bed on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and every article on which he sits shall be unclean.
And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And whoever sits on the article on which the one with the discharge sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And whoever touches the flesh of the one with the discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And if the one with the discharge spits on the clean person, then he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And every saddle on which the one with the discharge rides shall be unclean.

And everyone who touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening; and the one who carries them shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And everyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And an earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.

And when the one with the discharge becomes clean from his discharge, then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, and he shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in living water, and he shall be clean.
And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, and he shall come before YHWH to the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.
And the priest shall offer them, the one a sin offering and the one a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him before YHWH from his discharge.
And a man, when an emission of seed goes out from him, he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And every garment and every hide on which there is an emission of seed shall be washed in water, and it shall be unclean until the evening.
And a woman with whom a man lies, an emission of seed — they shall bathe in water, and they shall be unclean until the evening.
And a woman, when she has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be seven days in her menstrual impurity, and everyone who touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
And everything on which she lies in her menstrual impurity shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
And everyone who touches her bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And everyone who touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And if it is on the bed, or on the article on which she was sitting, when he touches it he shall be unclean until the evening.
And if a man indeed lies with her, and her menstrual impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

And a woman, when the discharge of her blood flows many days not at the time of her menstrual impurity, or when she discharges beyond her menstrual impurity — all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her menstrual impurity; she is unclean.

Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her menstrual impurity, and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, like the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.
And everyone who touches them shall be unclean, and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until the evening.
And if she becomes clean from her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtle-doves or two young pigeons, and she shall bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
And the priest shall offer the one a sin offering and the one a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before YHWH from the discharge of her uncleanness.
And you shall keep the sons of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by their making unclean my tabernacle that is in their midst.
This is the law for the one with a discharge, and for him from whom an emission of seed goes out, to be unclean by it;
and for her who is ailing in her menstrual impurity, and for the one who has a discharge, whether male or female, and for a man who lies with an unclean woman.

leviticus_16.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before YHWH and died.

And YHWH said to Moses: Speak to Aaron your brother, that he not come at any time into the holy place inside the veil, before the mercy seat that is on the ark, and not die; for in the cloud I will appear over the mercy seat.
With this Aaron shall come into the holy place: with a bull, a son of the herd, for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

A tunic of linen, of holiness, he shall wear, and undergarments of linen shall be on his flesh, and with a sash of linen he shall gird himself, and with a turban of linen he shall wind himself. They are garments of holiness; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two he-goats of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
And Aaron shall bring near the bull of the sin offering that is his own, and make atonement for himself and for his household.
And he shall take the two he-goats and station them before YHWH at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
And Aaron shall put lots on the two he-goats: one lot for YHWH and one lot for Azazel.
And Aaron shall bring near the goat on which the lot for YHWH came up, and offer it as a sin offering.
And the goat on which the lot for Azazel came up shall be stationed alive before YHWH, to make atonement on it, to send it away to Azazel, to the wilderness.
And Aaron shall bring near the bull of the sin offering that is his own, and make atonement for himself and for his household; and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering that is his own.
And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar, from before YHWH, and his two hands full of fine fragrant incense, and bring it inside the veil.
And he shall put the incense on the fire before YHWH, and the cloud of the incense shall cover the mercy seat that is over the testimony, and he shall not die.

And he shall take some of the blood of the bull and spatter it with his finger on the face of the mercy seat, eastward; and before the mercy seat he shall spatter seven times some of the blood with his finger.

And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and spatter it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

And he shall make atonement on the holy place from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel and from their transgressions, for all their sins; and so he shall do for the tent of meeting, which dwells with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

And no person shall be in the tent of meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place, until he comes out; and he shall make atonement for himself and for his household and for all the assembly of Israel.

And he shall go out to the altar that is before YHWH and make atonement on it; and he shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat and put it on the horns of the altar all around.
And he shall spatter on it some of the blood with his finger seven times, and cleanse it and set it apart as holy from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.
And when he has finished making atonement for the holy place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall bring near the living goat.

And Aaron shall lean his two hands on the head of the living goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the sons of Israel and all their transgressions, for all their sins, and put them on the head of the goat; and he shall send it away by the hand of a man in readiness, to the wilderness.
And the goat shall bear on itself all their iniquities to a land cut off; and he shall send the goat away in the wilderness.
And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and strip off the garments of linen that he wore when he went into the holy place, and leave them there.

And he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, and put on his garments; and he shall come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
And the fat of the sin offering he shall turn to smoke towards the altar.
And the one who sends the goat away to Azazel shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and after that he shall come into the camp.

And the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be brought outside the camp, and their hides and their flesh and their offal shall be burned with fire.
And the one who burns them shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and after that he shall come into the camp.

And it shall be for you a statute of perpetuity: in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, you shall afflict your selves, and you shall do no work at all — the native-born and the sojourner who sojourns among you.
For on this day he shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins before YHWH you shall be clean.
It is a sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall afflict your selves — a statute of perpetuity.
And the priest who is anointed and whose hand is filled to serve as priest in place of his father shall make atonement; and he shall wear the garments of linen, the garments of holiness.

And he shall make atonement for the sanctuary of holiness, and for the tent of meeting and for the altar he shall make atonement, and for the priests and for all the people of the assembly he shall make atonement.
And this shall be for you a statute of perpetuity, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins once in the year. And he did just as YHWH had commanded Moses.

leviticus_17.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: This is the word that YHWH has commanded, saying,
Any man of the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a sheep or a goat in the camp, or who slaughters it outside the camp,

and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to bring near an offering to YHWH before the tabernacle of YHWH — blood shall be reckoned to that man; he has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.

so that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices that they are sacrificing on the face of the field, and bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace offerings to YHWH.
And the priest shall dash the blood on the altar of YHWH at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and turn the fat to smoke as an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And they shall no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat-demons after which they are prostituting themselves. This shall be a statute of perpetuity for them throughout their generations.
And to them you shall say: Any man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns among them, who offers up a burnt offering or a sacrifice,
and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it to YHWH — that man shall be cut off from his kin.

And any man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns among them, who eats any blood — I will set my face against the person who eats the blood, and I will cut it off from among its people.
For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I myself have given it to you on the altar to make atonement on your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by the life.
Therefore I have said to the sons of Israel: No person among you shall eat blood, and the sojourner who sojourns among you shall not eat blood.
And any man of the sons of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns among them, who hunts a catch of animal or bird that may be eaten, shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust.

For the life of all flesh — its blood is its life. And I have said to the sons of Israel: You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; everyone who eats it shall be cut off.
And every person who eats a carcass or a torn animal, whether native-born or sojourner, shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening; and then he shall be clean.
And if he does not wash them and does not bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

leviticus_18.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: I am YHWH your God.

According to the doings of the land of Egypt, in which you dwelt, you shall not do; and according to the doings of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you, you shall not do; and in their statutes you shall not walk.
My judgements you shall do, and my statutes you shall keep, to walk in them. I am YHWH your God.
And you shall keep my statutes and my judgements, which the human being shall do and live by them. I am YHWH.
Any man shall not draw near to any near kin of his flesh, to uncover nakedness. I am YHWH.
The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
The nakedness of your father's wife you shall not uncover; it is your father's nakedness.
The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother, born at home or born outside — you shall not uncover their nakedness.
The nakedness of your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter — you shall not uncover their nakedness, for they are your own nakedness.
The nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife, born of your father — she is your sister; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
The nakedness of your father's sister you shall not uncover; she is your father's near kin.
The nakedness of your mother's sister you shall not uncover, for she is your mother's near kin.
The nakedness of your father's brother you shall not uncover; you shall not draw near to his wife. She is your aunt.
The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you shall not uncover; she is your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
The nakedness of your brother's wife you shall not uncover; it is your brother's nakedness.
The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you shall not uncover. Her son's daughter and her daughter's daughter you shall not take, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kin. It is depravity.
And a woman together with her sister you shall not take, to make her a rival, to uncover her nakedness beside her, in her lifetime.
And to a woman in the menstrual impurity of her uncleanness you shall not draw near, to uncover her nakedness.
And to your neighbour's wife you shall not give your emission for seed, to be made unclean by her.
And you shall not give any of your offspring to make pass over to Molech, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am YHWH.
And with a male you shall not lie the lyings of a woman; it is an abomination.
And with any animal you shall not give your emission, to be made unclean by it. And a woman shall not stand before an animal to couple with it; it is perversion.
Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these, for by all of these the nations that I am sending away from before you have made themselves unclean.
And the land became unclean, and I visited its iniquity upon it, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
But you shall keep my statutes and my judgements, and you shall not do any of these abominations — the native-born or the sojourner who sojourns among you.
For all these abominations the people of the land who were before you did, and the land became unclean.
So that the land will not vomit you out when you make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
For everyone who does any of these abominations — the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.
And you shall keep my charge, not to do any of the customs of the abominations that were done before you, and you shall not make yourselves unclean by them. I am YHWH your God.

leviticus_19.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I, YHWH your God, am holy.
You shall each fear his mother and his father, and you shall keep my sabbaths. I am YHWH your God.
Do not turn to the worthless things, and gods of cast metal you shall not make for yourselves. I am YHWH your God.
And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of peace offering to YHWH, you shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.
On the day of your sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day; and what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.
And if it is indeed eaten on the third day, it is a foul thing; it will not be accepted.
And whoever eats it shall bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to YHWH; and that person shall be cut off from his kin.
And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish reaping the edge of your field, and the gleaning of your harvest you shall not gather.
And your vineyard you shall not strip bare, and the fallen fruit of your vineyard you shall not gather. For the poor and for the sojourner you shall leave them. I am YHWH your God.
You shall not steal, and you shall not deceive, and you shall not deal falsely, each with his neighbour.
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, and so profane the name of your God. I am YHWH.
You shall not oppress your neighbour, and you shall not rob. The wages of a hired worker shall not stay with you overnight until morning.
You shall not curse a deaf person, and before a blind person you shall not put a stumbling block; and you shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
You shall not do injustice in judgement. You shall not lift up the face of the poor, and you shall not honour the face of the great. In righteousness you shall judge your neighbour.
You shall not go about as a slanderer among your kin. You shall not stand on the blood of your neighbour. I am YHWH.
You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely reprove your neighbour, and you shall not bear sin on account of him.
You shall not take vengeance, and you shall not keep [a grudge against] the sons of your people; and you shall love your neighbour as yourself. I am YHWH.
My statutes you shall keep. Your livestock you shall not breed with two kinds. Your field you shall not sow with two kinds. And a garment of two kinds, shaatnez, shall not go up on you.

And a man, when he lies with a woman with an emission of seed, and she is a slave-woman designated for a man, and she has not been redeemed at all, nor has freedom been given her — there shall be punishment. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, to the entrance of the tent of meeting — a ram of guilt offering.
And the priest shall make atonement on him with the ram of the guilt offering before YHWH, for his sin that he has sinned; and he shall be forgiven for his sin that he has sinned.
And when you come into the land and plant any tree for food, you shall treat its fruit as its foreskin: three years it shall be uncircumcised for you; it shall not be eaten.
And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, praise-offerings to YHWH.
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, so as to increase its yield for you. I am YHWH your God.
You shall not eat over the blood. You shall not practise divination, and you shall not practise soothsaying.
You shall not round off the edge of your head, and you shall not ruin the edge of your beard.
And you shall not make a gash in your flesh for the dead, and incised writing you shall not put on yourselves. I am YHWH.
Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, so that the land does not prostitute itself and the land be filled with depravity.
My sabbaths you shall keep, and my sanctuary you shall fear. I am YHWH.
Do not turn to the mediums, and do not seek out the spiritists, to be made unclean by them. I am YHWH your God.
Before grey hair you shall rise, and you shall honour the face of an old person; and you shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
And when a sojourner sojourns with you in your land, you shall not wrong him.
As a native-born among you shall be to you the sojourner who sojourns with you; and you shall love him as yourself, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.
You shall not do injustice in judgement, in measure, in weight, or in volume.
Balances of righteousness, weights of righteousness, an ephah of righteousness and a hin of righteousness you shall have. I am YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt.
And you shall keep all my statutes and all my judgements, and do them. I am YHWH.

leviticus_20.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

And to the sons of Israel you shall say: Any man of the sons of Israel, or of the sojourner who sojourns in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
And I myself will set my face against that man and cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, so as to make my sanctuary unclean and to profane my holy name.
And if the people of the land indeed hide their eyes from that man when he gives of his offspring to Molech, so as not to put him to death,

then I myself will set my face against that man and against his clan, and I will cut him off, and all who prostitute themselves after him by prostituting themselves after Molech, from among their people.
And the person who turns to the mediums and to the spiritists, prostituting himself after them — I will set my face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
And you shall set yourselves apart as holy, and you shall be holy, for I am YHWH your God.
And you shall keep my statutes and do them. I am YHWH who sets you apart as holy.
For any man who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father and his mother; his blood is on him.
And a man who commits adultery with the wife of a man — who commits adultery with the wife of his neighbour — the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
And a man who lies with his father's wife has uncovered his father's nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood is on them.
And a man who lies with his daughter-in-law — both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion; their blood is on them.
And a man who lies with a male the lyings of a woman — both of them have done an abomination. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is on them.
And a man who takes a woman and her mother — it is depravity. They shall burn him and them with fire, so that there be no depravity among you.
And a man who gives his emission with an animal shall surely be put to death, and the animal you shall kill.
And a woman who draws near to any animal to couple with it — you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is on them.

And a man who takes his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness — it is a disgrace. They shall be cut off before the eyes of the sons of their people. He has uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

And a man who lies with a woman who is ailing and uncovers her nakedness — he has laid bare her spring, and she has uncovered the spring of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
And the nakedness of your mother's sister or your father's sister you shall not uncover, for he has laid bare his own near kin; they shall bear their iniquity.
And a man who lies with his aunt has uncovered his uncle's nakedness. They shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
And a man who takes his brother's wife — it is impurity. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
And you shall keep all my statutes and all my judgements and do them, so that the land to which I am bringing you to dwell in it does not vomit you out.
And you shall not walk in the statutes of the nation that I am sending away from before you, for they did all these things, and I loathed them.

And I said to you: You shall take possession of their ground, and I myself will give it to you to possess it — a land flowing with milk and honey. I am YHWH your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

And you shall separate between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean, and you shall not make yourselves detestable by animal or by bird or by anything with which the ground crawls, which I have separated for you as unclean.
And you shall be holy to me, for I, YHWH, am holy; and I have separated you from the peoples to be mine.
And a man or a woman in whom there is a ghost or a knowing spirit shall surely be put to death. They shall stone them with stones; their blood is on them.

leviticus_21.t: And YHWH said to Moses: Say to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and you shall say to them: For a dead person he shall not make himself unclean among his kin,
except for his near kin, those close to him: for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
and for his sister, the virgin who is close to him, who has not belonged to a husband — for her he may make himself unclean.
He shall not make himself unclean as a husband among his kin, profaning himself.
They shall not make a baldness on their head, and they shall not shave off the edge of their beard, and in their flesh they shall not cut a cut.
They shall be holy to their God and shall not profane the name of their God, for they are the ones who bring near the food offerings of YHWH, the food of their God; and they shall be holy.
A woman who is a prostitute or profaned they shall not take, and a woman divorced from her husband they shall not take, for he is holy to his God.
And you shall set him apart as holy, for he brings near the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I, YHWH who sets you apart as holy, am holy.
And the daughter of a man who is a priest, if she profanes herself by prostituting herself, she is profaning her father; she shall be burned with fire.

And the priest who is greatest among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil was poured and whose hand was filled to wear the garments, shall not let his head go loose and shall not tear his garments.
And he shall not go in to any dead bodies; for his father or for his mother he shall not make himself unclean.
And he shall not go out from the sanctuary, and he shall not profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am YHWH.
And he shall take a woman in her virginity.
A widow, or a divorced woman, or one profaned, a prostitute — these he shall not take; but a virgin from his kin he shall take as a wife.
And he shall not profane his offspring among his kin, for I am YHWH who sets him apart as holy.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to Aaron, saying: A man of your offspring, throughout their generations, in whom there is a blemish shall not draw near to bring near the food of his God.
For any man in whom there is a blemish shall not draw near: a man blind, or lame, or with a disfigured face, or with a limb too long;
or a man in whom there is a broken foot or a broken hand;
or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or with a defect in his eye, or with an itching disease, or with scabs, or with a crushed testicle.

Any man in whom there is a blemish, of the offspring of Aaron the priest, shall not come near to bring near the food offerings of YHWH. There is a blemish in him; he shall not come near to bring near the food of his God.
He may eat the food of his God, from the holiest of the holy things and from the holy things.
Only he shall not come to the veil, and he shall not come near to the altar, for there is a blemish in him; and he shall not profane my sanctuaries, for I am YHWH who sets them apart as holy.
And Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel.

leviticus_22.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to Aaron and to his sons, that they keep themselves separate from the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they set apart as holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am YHWH.

Say to them: Throughout your generations, any man of all your offspring who draws near to the holy things that the sons of Israel set apart as holy to YHWH, while his uncleanness is upon him — that person shall be cut off from before me. I am YHWH.

Any man of the offspring of Aaron who has leprosy, or has a discharge, shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. And whoever touches anything made unclean by a corpse, or a man from whom an emission of seed goes out,
or a man who touches any swarming creature by which he becomes unclean, or a person by whom he becomes unclean — whatever his uncleanness may be:
the person who touches it shall be unclean until the evening, and he shall not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water.
And when the sun goes down he shall be clean, and afterwards he may eat of the holy things, for it is his food.
A carcass or a torn animal he shall not eat, to become unclean by it. I am YHWH.
And they shall keep my charge and not bear sin on account of it and die by it, because they have profaned it. I am YHWH who sets them apart as holy.
And no outsider shall eat a holy thing. A priest's resident or a hired worker shall not eat a holy thing.
But if a priest acquires a person, an acquisition of his money, that person may eat of it; and those born in his household — they may eat of his food.
And a priest's daughter, if she belongs to a man who is an outsider — she shall not eat of the contribution of the holy things.

And a priest's daughter, if she becomes a widow or is divorced and has no offspring, and returns to her father's house as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food; but no outsider shall eat of it.
And if a man eats a holy thing inadvertently, he shall add a fifth of it to it and give the holy thing to the priest.
And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they lift up to YHWH,
and so cause them to bear iniquity of guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am YHWH who sets them apart as holy.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:

Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourner in Israel, who brings near his offering for any of their vows or for any of their freewill offerings, which they bring near to YHWH as a burnt offering —
for your acceptance: an unblemished male from the cattle, from the sheep, or from the goats.
Anything in which there is a blemish you shall not bring near, for it will not be for acceptance for you.

And when a man brings near a sacrifice of peace offering to YHWH, to fulfil a vow or as a freewill offering, from the herd or from the flock, it shall be unblemished for acceptance; there shall be no blemish at all in it.
Blind, or broken, or mutilated, or with a running sore, or with an itch, or with scabs — you shall not bring these near to YHWH, and you shall not give a food offering from them on the altar to YHWH.
And an ox or a sheep with a limb too long or a limb stunted — you may offer it as a freewill offering, but for a vow it will not be accepted.
And one bruised, or crushed, or torn, or cut — you shall not bring near to YHWH; and in your land you shall not do it.
And from the hand of a foreigner you shall not bring near the food of your God from any of these; for their corruption is in them, a blemish is in them; they will not be accepted for you.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
An ox or a sheep or a goat, when it is born, shall be seven days under its mother; and from the eighth day and onwards it shall be accepted as an offering, a food offering to YHWH.
And an ox or a sheep — it and its young you shall not slaughter on one day.
And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to YHWH, you shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.
On that day it shall be eaten; you shall not leave any of it until morning. I am YHWH.
And you shall keep my commandments and do them. I am YHWH.
And you shall not profane my holy name, and I shall be set apart as holy among the sons of Israel. I am YHWH who sets you apart as holy,
who brought you out from the land of Egypt to be God for you. I am YHWH.

leviticus_23.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: The appointed times of YHWH, which you shall proclaim as convocations of holiness — these are my appointed times.
Six days work shall be done, and on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a convocation of holiness. You shall do no work at all; it is a sabbath to YHWH in all your dwelling places.
These are the appointed times of YHWH, convocations of holiness, which you shall proclaim at their appointed time.
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, between the evenings, is a passover to YHWH.
And on the fifteenth day of this month is the festival of unleavened bread to YHWH; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
On the first day there shall be for you a convocation of holiness; you shall do no work of servitude.
And you shall bring near a food offering to YHWH seven days. On the seventh day there is a convocation of holiness; you shall do no work of servitude.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When you come into the land that I am giving you and reap its harvest, you shall bring the sheaf of the first of your harvest to the priest.
And he shall wave the sheaf before YHWH for your acceptance; on the day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
And on the day you wave the sheaf you shall offer a lamb, unblemished, a son of its year, as a burnt offering to YHWH;
and its grain offering, two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil, a food offering to YHWH, an odour of soothing; and its drink offering, wine, a fourth of a hin.

And bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain you shall not eat until this very day, until you have brought the offering of your God. It is a statute of perpetuity throughout your generations, in all your dwelling places.
And you shall count for yourselves from the day after the sabbath, from the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven complete sabbaths they shall be.
Until the day after the seventh sabbath you shall count fifty days, and you shall bring near a new grain offering to YHWH.
From your dwelling places you shall bring bread of a wave offering: two loaves of two tenths of fine flour; they shall be, baked leavened — first-fruits to YHWH.

And you shall bring near with the bread seven lambs, unblemished, sons of a year, and one bull, a son of the herd, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with their grain offering and their drink offerings — a food offering, an odour of soothing to YHWH.
And you shall offer one he-goat of the goats as a sin offering, and two lambs, sons of a year, as a sacrifice of peace offering.
And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits as a wave offering before YHWH, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to YHWH, for the priest.

And you shall proclaim on this very day: there shall be for you a convocation of holiness; you shall do no work of servitude. It is a statute of perpetuity in all your dwelling places, throughout your generations.

And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish the edge of your field as you reap, and the gleaning of your harvest you shall not gather. For the poor and for the sojourner you shall leave them. I am YHWH your God.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: In the seventh month, on the first of the month, there shall be for you a solemn rest, a remembrance of a loud blast, a convocation of holiness.
You shall do no work of servitude, and you shall bring near a food offering to YHWH.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Surely on the tenth of this seventh month is the day of atonements. It shall be for you a convocation of holiness, and you shall afflict your selves and bring near a food offering to YHWH.
And you shall do no work at all on this very day, for it is a day of atonements, to make atonement for you before YHWH your God.
