For any person who is not afflicted on this very day shall be cut off from his kin.
And any person who does any work at all on this very day — I will destroy that person from among his people.
You shall do no work at all. It is a statute of perpetuity throughout your generations, in all your dwelling places.
It is a sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall afflict your selves. On the ninth of the month in the evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your sabbath.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the festival of booths, seven days to YHWH.
On the first day is a convocation of holiness; you shall do no work of servitude.

Seven days you shall bring near a food offering to YHWH. On the eighth day there shall be for you a convocation of holiness, and you shall bring near a food offering to YHWH. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no work of servitude.

These are the appointed times of YHWH, which you shall proclaim as convocations of holiness, to bring near a food offering to YHWH — a burnt offering and a grain offering, a sacrifice and drink offerings, the matter of a day on its day —
besides the sabbaths of YHWH, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings that you give to YHWH.

Surely on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather in the produce of the land, you shall celebrate the festival of YHWH seven days. On the first day is a solemn rest, and on the eighth day a solemn rest.

And on the first day you shall take for yourselves the fruit of a splendid tree, fronds of palms, and a branch of a leafy tree, and willows of the wadi; and you shall rejoice before YHWH your God seven days.
And you shall celebrate it as a festival to YHWH seven days in the year. It is a statute of perpetuity throughout your generations; in the seventh month you shall celebrate it.
In booths you shall dwell seven days; every native-born in Israel shall dwell in booths,
so that your generations may know that I caused the sons of Israel to dwell in booths when I brought them out from the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.
And Moses spoke the appointed times of YHWH to the sons of Israel.

leviticus_24.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Command the sons of Israel that they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to set up a lamp continually.
Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening until morning before YHWH continually. It is a statute of perpetuity throughout your generations.
On the pure lampstand he shall arrange the lamps before YHWH continually.
And you shall take fine flour and bake it into twelve loaves; two tenths shall be in each loaf.
And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the pure table before YHWH.
And you shall put pure frankincense on the row, and it shall be for the bread as a memorial portion, a food offering to YHWH.
On the sabbath day, on the sabbath day, he shall arrange it before YHWH continually — from the sons of Israel, a covenant of perpetuity.

And it shall belong to Aaron and to his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, for it is a holy thing of holy things for him, from the food offerings of YHWH — a prescribed portion of perpetuity.

And the son of an Israelite woman went out — and he was the son of an Egyptian man — among the sons of Israel; and they struggled together in the camp, the son of the Israelite woman and the Israelite man.
And the son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name and cursed. And they brought him to Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
And they put him in custody, for it to be made clear to them by the mouth of YHWH.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Bring out the one who cursed to outside the camp, and all who heard shall lean their hands on his head, and the whole congregation shall stone him.
And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying: Any man who curses his God shall bear his sin.

And one who blasphemes the name of YHWH shall surely be put to death; the whole congregation shall surely stone him. As the sojourner, so the native-born: when he blasphemes the Name, he shall be put to death.
And anyone who strikes down any human life shall surely be put to death.
And one who strikes down the life of an animal shall repay it, life for life.
And anyone who inflicts a blemish on his neighbour — as he has done, so it shall be done to him:
fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he inflicts a blemish on a person, so it shall be inflicted on him.
And one who strikes down an animal shall repay it, and one who strikes down a person shall be put to death.
You shall have one judgement: as the sojourner, so the native-born shall it be; for I am YHWH your God.
And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought out the one who had cursed to outside the camp and stoned him with stones. And the sons of Israel did just as YHWH had commanded Moses.

leviticus_25.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When you come into the land that I am giving you, the land shall keep a sabbath to YHWH.
Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its produce.
And in the seventh year there shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath to YHWH. Your field you shall not sow, and your vineyard you shall not prune.
The self-sown grain of your harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your untrimmed vines you shall not gather. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
And the sabbath of the land shall be food for you — for you, and for your male slave, and for your female slave, and for your hired worker, and for your resident who sojourns with you,
and for your livestock and for the wild animals that are in your land — all its produce shall be for eating.
And you shall count for yourself seven sabbaths of years, seven years seven times; and the days of the seven sabbaths of years shall be for you forty-nine years.
And you shall cause a ram's horn of loud blast to pass through in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the day of atonements you shall cause a ram's horn to pass through all your land.

And you shall set apart as holy the fiftieth year and proclaim a release in the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you, and you shall return each to his holding, and each to his clan you shall return.
A jubilee it is; the fiftieth year shall be for you. You shall not sow, and you shall not reap its self-sown grain, and you shall not gather from its untrimmed vines.
For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy for you. From the field you shall eat its produce.
In this year of the jubilee you shall return, each to his holding.
And when you sell something to your neighbour, or buy from your neighbour's hand, you shall not wrong one another.
By the number of years after the jubilee you shall buy from your neighbour; by the number of harvest years he shall sell to you.

According to the abundance of the years you shall increase its purchase price, and according to the fewness of the years you shall decrease its purchase price, for he is selling you a number of harvests.
And you shall not wrong one another, and you shall fear your God, for I am YHWH your God.
And you shall do my statutes, and my judgements you shall keep and do them; and you shall dwell on the land in security.
And the land shall give its fruit, and you shall eat to satiety and dwell on it in security.
And if you say, What shall we eat in the seventh year? — look, we may not sow and we may not gather in our produce —
then I will command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and it will make the produce for three years.
And you shall sow the eighth year and eat from the old produce; until the ninth year, until its produce comes in, you shall eat what is old.
And the land shall not be sold beyond reclaim, for the land is mine; for you are sojourners and residents with me.
And in all the land of your holding you shall grant a right of redemption for the land.
If your brother becomes poor and sells some of his holding, then his redeemer who is nearest to him shall come and redeem what his brother sold.
And if a man has no redeemer, but his hand reaches and he finds enough for its redemption,
then he shall reckon the years of its sale and repay the surplus to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return to his holding.

And if his hand does not find enough to repay him, then what he sold shall remain in the hand of the one who bought it until the year of the jubilee; and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return to his holding.
And if a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then his right of redemption shall be until the end of the year of its sale; his right of redemption shall be a year of days.

And if it is not redeemed before a full year is completed for it, then the house that is in the city that has a wall shall stand in perpetuity to the one who bought it, throughout his generations; it shall not go out in the jubilee.
But the houses of villages that have no wall around them shall be reckoned with the field of the land: there shall be a right of redemption for it, and in the jubilee it shall go out.
And as for the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their holding — a right of redemption of perpetuity shall belong to the Levites.

And whoever redeems from the Levites — the sale of a house and the city of his holding shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their holding among the sons of Israel.
But the field of the pasture land of their cities shall not be sold, for it is a holding of perpetuity for them.
And if your brother becomes poor and his hand slips with you, then you shall hold him up — a sojourner and a resident — and he shall live with you.
You shall not take from him interest or increase; and you shall fear your God, and your brother shall live with you.
Your silver you shall not give him at interest, and for increase you shall not give your food.
I am YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be God for you.
And if your brother becomes poor with you and sells himself to you, you shall not make him serve the labour of a slave.
As a hired worker, as a resident, he shall be with you; until the year of the jubilee he shall serve with you.
And he shall go out from you, he and his sons with him, and he shall return to his clan, and to the holding of his fathers he shall return.
For they are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as a slave is sold.
You shall not rule over him with harshness, and you shall fear your God.
And your male slave and your female slave who are yours — from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy a male slave and a female slave.

And also from the children of the residents who sojourn with you, from them you may buy, and from their clans that are with you, whom they have fathered in your land; and they shall be a holding for you.

And you shall give them as an inheritance to your sons after you, to take possession of as a holding; for ever you may make them serve. But over your brothers, the sons of Israel, no one shall rule over his brother with harshness.
And if the hand of a sojourner or resident with you reaches, and your brother becomes poor with him and sells himself to the sojourner, the resident with you, or to a member of a sojourner's clan,
after he has sold himself there shall be a right of redemption for him; one of his brothers shall redeem him.
Or his uncle, or his uncle's son, shall redeem him; or one of his near kin from his clan shall redeem him; or if his hand reaches, he shall redeem himself.

And he shall reckon with the one who bought him, from the year he sold himself to him until the year of the jubilee; and the silver of his sale shall be by the number of years — as the days of a hired worker he shall be with him.
If there are still many years, in proportion to them he shall repay his redemption price from the silver of his purchase.
And if few years remain until the year of the jubilee, then he shall reckon for himself; in proportion to his years he shall repay his redemption price.
As a worker hired year by year he shall be with him; he shall not rule over him with harshness before your eyes.
And if he is not redeemed by these means, then he shall go out in the year of the jubilee, he and his sons with him.
For the sons of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.

leviticus_26.t: You shall not make for yourselves worthless things, and a carved image or a standing pillar you shall not raise up for yourselves, and a figured stone you shall not set in your land to bow down upon it; for I am YHWH your God.
My sabbaths you shall keep, and my sanctuary you shall fear. I am YHWH.
If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments and do them,
then I will give your rains in their time, and the land will give its yield, and the tree of the field will give its fruit.
And your threshing will reach the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will reach the sowing; and you will eat your bread to satiety and dwell in security in your land.
And I will give peace in the land, and you will lie down with none making you afraid; and I will make the wild beasts cease from the land, and a sword will not pass through your land.
And you will pursue your enemies, and they will fall before you to the sword.
And five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand; and your enemies will fall before you to the sword.
And I will turn towards you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish my covenant with you.
And you will eat old grain long stored, and you will clear out the old before the new.
And I will set my tabernacle among you, and my self will not abhor you.
And I will walk about among you, and I will be God for you, and you will be a people for me.
I am YHWH your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt from being slaves to them; and I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk upright.
But if you do not listen to me and do not do all these commandments,
and if you reject my statutes, and if your self abhors my judgements, so as not to do all my commandments, breaking my covenant —

then I also will do this to you: I will appoint over you sudden terror — the wasting disease and the fever, which consume the eyes and drain away the life; and you will sow your seed for nothing, for your enemies will eat it.
And I will set my face against you, and you will be struck down before your enemies; and those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee with none pursuing you.
And if even after these things you do not listen to me, then I will go on to discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
And I will break the pride of your strength, and I will make your heavens like iron and your land like bronze.
And your strength will be spent for nothing, and your land will not give its yield, and the tree of the land will not give its fruit.
And if you walk contrary to me and are not willing to listen to me, then I will add to you a blow sevenfold, according to your sins.
And I will send among you the wild beasts of the field, and they will bereave you and cut off your livestock and make you few; and your roads will be desolate.
And if by these things you are not disciplined by me, and you walk contrary to me,
then I also will walk contrary to you, and I also will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
And I will bring upon you a sword avenging the vengeance of the covenant; and you will gather into your cities, and I will send pestilence among you, and you will be given into the hand of an enemy.
When I break for you the staff of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven and bring back your bread by weight; and you will eat and not be satisfied.
And if in spite of this you do not listen to me, and you walk contrary to me,
then I will walk contrary to you in fury, and I also will discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
And you will eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters you will eat.
And I will destroy your high places and cut down your incense altars, and I will put your corpses on the corpses of your idols; and my self will abhor you.
And I will make your cities a waste and desolate your sanctuaries, and I will not smell your odours of soothing.
And I myself will desolate the land, and your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled at it.
And you I will scatter among the nations, and I will draw a sword after you; and your land will be a desolation, and your cities will be a waste.
Then the land will make up for its sabbaths, all the days of its desolation, while you are in the land of your enemies; then the land will rest and make up for its sabbaths.
All the days of its desolation it will rest, because it did not rest during your sabbaths when you dwelt on it.

And as for those of you who are left, I will bring faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a driven leaf will pursue them, and they will flee as one flees from a sword, and they will fall with none pursuing.
And they will stumble over one another as before a sword, with none pursuing; and you will have no power to stand before your enemies.
And you will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.
And those of you who are left will rot away in their iniquity in the lands of their enemies; and also in the iniquities of their fathers, with them, they will rot away.
And they will confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their unfaithfulness by which they were unfaithful to me, and also that they walked contrary to me —
I also walked contrary to them and brought them into the land of their enemies — or then their uncircumcised heart will be humbled, and then they will make up for their iniquity.
then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham I will remember; and I will remember the land.

And the land will be forsaken by them and will make up for its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will make up for their iniquity, because and again because they rejected my judgements, and their self abhorred my statutes.
And yet even so, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them and will not abhor them so as to make an end of them, breaking my covenant with them; for I am YHWH their God.
And I will remember for them the covenant of the ancestors, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, to be God for them. I am YHWH.
These are the statutes and the judgements and the laws that YHWH gave between himself and the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.

leviticus_27.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When a man makes a special vow, the valuation of persons to YHWH shall be as follows.
And your valuation shall be, for a male from twenty years old to sixty years old — your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, by the shekel of the holy place.
And if it is a female, your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
And if from five years old to twenty years old, your valuation shall be, for the male, twenty shekels, and for the female, ten shekels.
And if from a month old to five years old, your valuation shall be, for the male, five shekels of silver, and for the female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
And if from sixty years old and upwards — if a male, your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female, ten shekels.

And if he is too poor for your valuation, then he shall be stationed before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to what the hand of the one who vowed can reach, the priest shall value him.
And if it is an animal of the kind that people bring near as an offering to YHWH, everything of it that one gives to YHWH shall be holy.
He shall not replace it or exchange it, good for bad or bad for good; and if he does exchange one animal for another, then it and its substitute shall be holy.
And if it is any unclean animal, of the kind that people do not bring near as an offering to YHWH, then he shall station the animal before the priest,
and the priest shall value it, whether good or bad; as the priest's valuation is, so shall it be.
And if he does redeem it, he shall add a fifth of it to your valuation.
And when a man sets apart his house as holy to YHWH, the priest shall value it, whether good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
And if the one who set it apart as holy redeems his house, he shall add a fifth of the silver of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
And if a man sets apart as holy to YHWH part of the field of his holding, then your valuation shall be according to its seed: seed of a homer of barley at fifty shekels of silver.
If he sets apart his field as holy from the year of the jubilee, it shall stand at your valuation.

And if he sets apart his field as holy after the jubilee, the priest shall reckon the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of the jubilee, and it shall be deducted from your valuation.
And if the one who set the field apart as holy does redeem it, he shall add a fifth of the silver of your valuation to it, and it shall stand as his.
And if he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed again.
And when the field goes out in the jubilee, it shall be holy to YHWH, like a field devoted; the priest shall have it as his holding.
And if he sets apart as holy to YHWH a field he has bought, which is not part of the field of his holding,
then the priest shall reckon for him the amount of your valuation up to the year of the jubilee, and he shall give the valuation on that day as a holy thing to YHWH.
In the year of the jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to the one whose holding of the land it is.
And every valuation of yours shall be by the shekel of the holy place: twenty gerahs shall the shekel be.
Only a firstborn among livestock, which is born as a firstling to YHWH, no one shall set apart as holy; whether ox or sheep, it belongs to YHWH.
And if it is among the unclean livestock, then he shall ransom it at your valuation and add a fifth of it to it; and if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold at your valuation.

Only, every devoted thing that a man devotes to YHWH from all that is his — of humankind or livestock or the field of his holding — shall not be sold and shall not be redeemed. Every devoted thing is a holy thing of holy things to YHWH.
Every devoted person who is devoted from among humankind shall not be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
And every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land or from the fruit of the tree, belongs to YHWH; it is holy to YHWH.
And if a man does redeem any of his tithe, he shall add a fifth of it to it.
And every tithe of the herd and the flock — everything that passes under the rod — the tenth shall be holy to YHWH.
He shall not scrutinise whether it is good or bad, and he shall not exchange it; and if he does exchange it, then it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
These are the commandments that YHWH commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.

malachi_1.t: A burden: the word of YHWH to Israel by the hand of Malachi.
I have loved you, says YHWH. And you have said: In what have you loved us? Was not Esau a brother to Jacob — the declaration of YHWH — and I loved Jacob,
and Esau I hated, and I made his mountains a desolation and his inheritance for the jackals of the wilderness.

For Edom says: We have been shattered, but we will return and rebuild the ruins. Thus says YHWH of hosts: They may build, and I myself will tear down; and they will call them the territory of wickedness, and the people with whom YHWH is indignant for ever.
And your eyes will see, and you yourselves will say: YHWH is great beyond the border of Israel.

A son honours a father, and a servant his master. And if I am a father, where is my honour? And if I am a master, where is my fear? — says YHWH of hosts to you, O priests, who despise my name. And you have said: In what have we despised your name?
bringing near upon my altar defiled food. And you have said: In what have we defiled you? By your saying: The table of YHWH — it is despicable.

And when you bring near a blind [animal] for sacrifice — is that not evil? And when you bring near a lame one and a sick one — is that not evil? Bring it near, please, to your governor: will he be pleased with you, or will he lift up your face? — says YHWH of hosts.
And now, entreat the face of God, please, that he may show us favour. From your hand this has come — will he lift up a face from any of you? — says YHWH of hosts.
Who even among you would shut the doors, so that you would not kindle my altar in vain? I have no delight in you, says YHWH of hosts, and an offering I will not accept from your hand.

For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name will be great among the nations, and in every place incense will be brought near to my name, and a pure offering; for my name will be great among the nations, says YHWH of hosts.
And you are profaning it by your saying: The table of the Lord — it is defiled; and its fruit, its food, is despicable.

And you have said: Look, what a weariness! And you have sniffed at it, says YHWH of hosts. And you have brought what was stolen, and the lame and the sick; and you have brought the offering. Shall I accept it from your hand? — says YHWH.
And cursed be the deceiver, who has in his flock a male and vows, and sacrifices a corrupted thing to the Lord. For I am a great king, says YHWH of hosts, and my name is feared among the nations.

malachi_2.t: And now, to you is this commandment, O priests.

If you will not listen, and if you will not lay it upon the heart to give honour to my name, says YHWH of hosts, then I will send among you the curse, and I will curse your blessings — and indeed I have already cursed it, because you are not laying it upon the heart.
Here I am, rebuking the seed on your account, and I will scatter dung upon your faces — the dung of your festivals — and one will carry you away to it.
And you will know that I have sent to you this commandment, so that my covenant may be with Levi, says YHWH of hosts.
My covenant was with him — the life and the peace — and I gave them to him as fear, and he feared me, and before my name he was in awe.
Law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found on his lips. In peace and in uprightness he walked with me, and many he turned back from iniquity.
For the lips of a priest keep knowledge, and law they seek from his mouth; for he is the messenger of YHWH of hosts.
But you — you have turned aside from the way, you have made many stumble by the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says YHWH of hosts.
And I also — I have made you despised and low before all the people, according as you are not keeping my ways and are lifting up faces in the law.
Is there not one Father for us all? Did not one God create us? Why do we deal treacherously, each with his brother, profaning the covenant of our ancestors?

Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination has been done in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holy place of YHWH, which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.
May YHWH cut off, from the tents of Jacob, the man who does it — one who is awake and one who answers — and one who brings near an offering to YHWH of hosts.
And this, a second thing, you do: covering the altar of YHWH with tears, with weeping and with groaning, because there is no longer any turning to the offering or taking pleasure from your hand.

And you have said: On account of what? Because YHWH has testified between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously — and she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

And not one did he make — and a remnant of spirit was his. And what was the one seeking? Offspring of God. So take heed in your spirit, and against the wife of your youth let no one deal treacherously.
For he hated sending away, says YHWH the God of Israel, and he covered violence over his garment, says YHWH of hosts. So take heed in your spirit, and you must not deal treacherously.

You have wearied YHWH with your words. And you have said: In what have we wearied him? By your saying: Everyone who does evil is good in the eyes of YHWH, and in them he delights — or: Where is the God of judgement?

malachi_3.t: Here I am, sending my messenger, and he will clear a way before me. And suddenly he will come to his temple — the Lord whom you are seeking — and the messenger of the covenant in whom you delight: here he is, coming, says YHWH of hosts.
And who can endure the day of his coming? And who is the one standing when he appears? For he is like the fire of a refiner and like the soap of washers.
And he will sit refining and purifying silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi and purge them like gold and like silver; and they will belong to YHWH, bringing near an offering in righteousness.
And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to YHWH, as in the days of antiquity and as in former years.

And I will draw near to you for judgement, and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against those who swear falsely, and against those who defraud the hired labourer of his wages, the widow and the fatherless, and those who thrust aside the sojourner — and who do not fear me, says YHWH of hosts.
For I, YHWH, have not changed; and you, sons of Jacob, have not come to an end.
From the days of your ancestors you have turned aside from my statutes and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you, says YHWH of hosts. And you have said: In what shall we return?
Will a human rob God? For you are robbing me. And you have said: In what have we robbed you? The tithe and the contribution.
With the curse you are cursed, and me you are robbing — the nation, all of it.

Bring the whole tithe into the house of the store, that there may be food in my house; and test me now by this, says YHWH of hosts, whether I will not open for you the floodgates of the heavens and pour out for you blessing until there is no sufficiency.
And I will rebuke the devourer for you, and it will not destroy for you the fruit of the ground; and the vine in the field will not fail to bear for you, says YHWH of hosts.
And all the nations will call you blessed, for you yourselves will be a land of delight, says YHWH of hosts.
Your words have been strong against me, says YHWH. And you have said: What have we spoken together against you?
You have said: It is emptiness to serve God, and what is the profit that we have kept his charge and that we have walked mournfully before YHWH of hosts?
And now we are calling the arrogant blessed. Indeed, those who do wickedness have been built up; indeed, they have tested God and have escaped.

Then those who fear YHWH spoke together, each with his neighbour; and YHWH paid attention and heard, and a document of remembrance was written before him, for those who fear YHWH and for those who esteem his name.
And they will be mine, says YHWH of hosts, for the day on which I am making a treasured possession; and I will have compassion on them as a man has compassion on his son who serves him.
And you will return and see the difference between a righteous person and a wicked person, between one who serves God and one who does not serve him.

malachi_4.t: For here, the day is coming, burning like the furnace; and all the arrogant and everyone who does wickedness will be stubble, and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says YHWH of hosts, so that it will not leave them root or branch.
And for you who fear my name a sun of righteousness will rise, and healing will be in its wings; and you will go out and skip about like calves of the stall.
And you will tread down the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day that I am acting, says YHWH of hosts.
Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded him at Horeb concerning all Israel — statutes and judgements.
Here I am, sending to you Elijah the prophet, before the coming of the day of YHWH, the great and the fearsome.
And he will turn back the heart of fathers to sons, and the heart of sons to their fathers, lest I come and strike the land, devoting it to destruction.

micah_1.t: The word of YHWH that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Hear, O peoples, all of them; pay attention, O earth and what fills it — and let Lord YHWH be a witness against you, my Lord from his holy temple.
For behold, YHWH is going out from his place, and he will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
And the mountains will melt beneath him and the valleys will be split open, like wax before the fire, like water poured out down a slope.
All this is for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
And I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the field, a planting place for a vineyard; and I will pour her stones down into the valley and uncover her foundations.

And all her carved images will be shattered, and all her hire will be burned in the fire, and all her idols I will make a waste; for from the hire of a prostitute she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute they shall return.
For this I will lament and wail; I will go barefoot and naked. I will make a lament like the jackals and a mourning like the daughters of the ostrich.
For her wounds are incurable; for it has come as far as Judah, it has reached to the gate of my people, to Jerusalem.
In Gath do not tell; weeping, do not weep. In Beth Leaphrah roll yourself in dust.
Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan has not come out. The lament of Beth Ezel will take from you its standing place.
For the inhabitant of Maroth is in anguish for good, for calamity has come down from YHWH to the gate of Jerusalem.
Harness the chariot to the steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin for the daughter of Zion, for in you were found the transgressions of Israel.
Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceit to the kings of Israel.
Again I will bring the dispossessor to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. As far as Adullam the glory of Israel will come.
Make yourself bald and shear yourself for the children of your delight; make your baldness wide as the eagle's, for they have gone from you into exile.

micah_2.t: Woe to those who plan wickedness and work out evil on their beds! In the light of the morning they do it, for it is in the power of their hand.
And they desire fields and seize them, and houses, and take them away; and they oppress a man and his household, a person and his inheritance.
Therefore thus said YHWH: Behold, I am planning against this clan a calamity from which you will not remove your necks, and you will not walk haughtily, for it will be an evil time.

On that day one will lift up a saying against you and wail a wailing of wailings. He will say: We are utterly devastated! He exchanges the portion of my people. How he removes it from me! To an apostate he apportions our fields.
Therefore you will have no one casting a measuring line by lot in the assembly of YHWH.
Do not preach! — so they preach — they shall not preach of these things; reproaches will not be turned back.
Is it said, O house of Jacob: Is the spirit of YHWH short? Are these his deeds? Do my words not do good with the one who walks upright?
And yesterday my people rose up as an enemy. From in front of a garment you strip off the mantle from those who pass by in security, turned back from war.
The women of my people you drive out from the house of her delights; from her children you take away my glory for ever.
Arise and go, for this is not the resting place — because of uncleanness it will destroy, and the destruction will be grievous.
If a man walking after wind and falsehood lied: I will preach to you of wine and strong drink — he would be the preacher of this people.

Gathering I will gather all of you, Jacob; assembling I will assemble the remnant of Israel. Together I will set them like sheep in a fold, like a flock in the midst of its pasture; they will be in tumult with people.
The one who breaks through has gone up before them; they have broken through and passed the gate and gone out by it. And their king has passed on before them, and YHWH at their head.

micah_3.t: And I said: Hear, please, heads of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know justice? —
you who hate good and love evil, tearing their skin from off them and their flesh from off their bones;
and who have eaten the flesh of my people, and stripped their skin from off them, and broken their bones in pieces, and chopped them up as into a pot, and like meat in the midst of a cauldron.
Then they will cry out to YHWH and he will not answer them. He will hide his face from them at that time, as they have made their deeds evil.

Thus said YHWH concerning the prophets who lead my people astray, who bite with their teeth and proclaim peace; and whoever does not put something into their mouth — against him they set apart a war as holy.
Therefore it will be night for you, without vision, and darkness for you, without divining. The sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will go dark over them.
And the seers will be ashamed and those who divine will be abashed; and all of them will cover the moustache, for there is no answer of God.
But I — I am filled with power, with the spirit of YHWH, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
Hear this, please, heads of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who loathe justice and make crooked everything that is straight;
building Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustice.
Her heads judge for a bribe, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets divine for money; and they lean on YHWH, saying: Is not YHWH in our midst? Calamity will not come upon us.
Therefore, on account of you, Zion will be ploughed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house, high places of a forest.

micah_4.t: And it will be, at the end of the days, that the mountain of the house of YHWH will be established at the head of the mountains, and it will be lifted up, it, above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

And many nations will come and say: Come, let us go up to the mountain of YHWH and to the house of the God of Jacob, and let him teach us from his ways and let us walk in his paths. For from Zion law will go out, and the word of YHWH from Jerusalem.

And he will judge between many peoples and decide for mighty nations far away. And they will beat their swords into ploughshares and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, and they will not learn war any more.
And they will dwell, each under his vine and under his fig tree, and there will be no one making them afraid; for the mouth of YHWH of hosts has spoken.
For all the peoples walk, each in the name of his god; and we — we will walk in the name of YHWH our God for ever and ever.
On that day — the declaration of YHWH — I will gather the lame and assemble the outcast, and those to whom I have done harm.
And I will make the lame into a remnant and the one driven far off into a mighty nation; and YHWH will reign over them in Mount Zion from now and for ever.
And you, O tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion — to you it will come; and the former dominion will come, the kingship, to the daughter of Jerusalem.
Now, why do you shout a shout? Is there no king in you? Or has your counsellor perished, that anguish has seized you like a woman giving birth?

Writhe and burst forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman giving birth; for now you will go out from the town and dwell in the open country, and you will come as far as Babylon. There you will be delivered; there YHWH will redeem you from the palm of your enemies.
And now many nations have gathered against you, those who say: Let her be defiled, and let our eyes look on Zion.
But they do not know the thoughts of YHWH and they do not understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like cut grain to the threshing floor.

Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron and I will make your hooves bronze, and you will crush many peoples; and I will devote their unjust gain to YHWH, and their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

micah_5.t: Now you will gash yourself, daughter of a troop. A siege he has set against us. With the rod they strike on the cheek the judge of Israel.
And you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, too little to be among the clans of Judah — from you one will come out for me to be ruler over Israel, and his goings forth are from of old, from the days of long ago.
Therefore he will give them up until the time when she who is in labour has given birth; and the rest of his brothers will return to the sons of Israel.
And he will stand and shepherd by the strength of YHWH, by the majesty of the name of YHWH his God; and they will remain, for now he will be great to the ends of the earth.
And this one will be peace. Assyria — when it comes into our land and when it treads on our fortresses, then we will raise up against it seven shepherds and eight princes of men.
And they will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword and the land of Nimrod at its entrances; and he will deliver from Assyria when it comes into our land and when it treads on our territory.
And the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from YHWH, like showers on vegetation, which does not wait for anyone and does not hope for the children of humankind.

And the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which, when it passes through, tramples and tears, and there is no deliverer.
May your hand be lifted up over your adversaries, and may all your enemies be cut off.
And it will be on that day — the declaration of YHWH — that I will cut off your horses from your midst and destroy your chariots;
and I will cut off the cities of your land and tear down all your fortresses;
and I will cut off sorceries from your hand, and you will have no soothsayers;
and I will cut off your carved images and your pillars from your midst, and you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands;
and I will pluck up your Asherah poles from your midst, and I will destroy your cities.
And I will take vengeance in anger and in rage on the nations that have not listened.

micah_6.t: Hear, please, what YHWH is saying: Arise, conduct a case with the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
Hear, O mountains, the case of YHWH, and you enduring ones, foundations of the earth; for YHWH has a case with his people, and with Israel he will argue it out.
My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? Testify against me.
For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and from a house of slaves I ransomed you; and I sent before you Moses, Aaron and Miriam.
My people, remember, please, what Balak king of Moab planned and what Balaam son of Beor answered him; from Shittim to Gilgal, so as to know the righteous acts of YHWH.
With what shall I come to meet YHWH, bow myself down to the God on high? Shall I come to meet him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
Will YHWH be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of torrents of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my belly for the sin of my being?
He has told you, O human, what is good, and what YHWH is requiring from you: nothing but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God.
The voice of YHWH calls out to the city — and it is sound wisdom to fear your name — Hear, O rod, and whoever appointed it.
Are there still, in the house of the wicked, treasures of wickedness and a scant ephah that is accursed?
Shall I be clear with wicked balances and with a bag of deceitful weights?
Her rich are full of violence and her inhabitants speak falsehood, and their tongue is deceit in their mouth.
And I also — I have made myself sick striking you, making you desolate for your sins.
You will eat and not be satisfied, and your emptiness will be in your midst; and you will carry away and not bring to safety, and what you do bring to safety I will give to the sword.
You will sow and not reap; you will tread the olive and not anoint yourself with oil, and new wine and not drink wine.

And the statutes of Omri are kept, and every deed of the house of Ahab, and you have walked in their schemes — so that I make you a horror and her inhabitants a hissing; and you will bear the reproach of my people.

micah_7.t: Woe is me! For I have become like the gatherings of summer fruit, like the gleanings of the grape harvest: there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that my being craves.
The loyal has perished from the land, and there is no upright one among humankind. All of them lie in wait for blood; each hunts his brother with a net.
Both hands are on the evil, to do it well. The official asks, and the judge is for a bribe, and the great man speaks the craving of his being — he himself — and they weave it together.
The best of them is like a briar, the most upright, worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, your punishment, has come; now their confusion will come.
Do not believe in a neighbour; do not trust in a close friend. From her who lies in your bosom guard the openings of your mouth.
For a son treats a father with contempt, a daughter rises against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man's enemies are the people of his own household.
But I — for YHWH I will watch; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Do not rejoice over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, YHWH is light for me.
The indignation of YHWH I will bear, for I have sinned against him, until he conducts my case and executes my judgement. He will bring me out to the light; I will look on his righteousness.
And my enemy will see, and shame will cover her — she who says to me: Where is YHWH your God? My eyes will look on her; now she will be a trampling place like the mud of the streets.
A day for building your walls! That day — the boundary will be far extended.
That day — and to you one will come from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt to the River, and sea from sea, and mountain from mountain.
And the earth will become a desolation because of its inhabitants, from the fruit of their deeds.
Shepherd your people with your rod, the flock of your inheritance, dwelling alone, a forest in the midst of a garden land. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of long ago.
As in the days of your coming out from the land of Egypt I will show him wonders.
Nations will see and be ashamed of all their might; they will put a hand on the mouth, their ears will go deaf.
They will lick dust like the serpent, like things that crawl on the earth. They will come trembling out of their strongholds; to YHWH our God they will be in dread, and they will be afraid of you.
Who is a God like you, lifting away iniquity and passing over transgression for the remnant of his inheritance? He does not hold on to his anger for ever, for he delights in steadfast love.
He will return, he will have compassion on us; he will subdue our iniquities. And you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
You will give faithfulness to Jacob, steadfast love to Abraham, which you swore to our fathers from the days of long ago.

nahum_1.t: The oracle of Nineveh. The document of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
A jealous and avenging God is YHWH; avenging is YHWH, and a lord of rage; avenging is YHWH toward his adversaries, and he keeps [it] toward his enemies.
YHWH is long of nostrils and great of power, but clearing, he will not clear. YHWH — in the whirlwind and in the storm is his way, and cloud is the dust of his feet.
He is rebuking the sea and he dried it up, and all the rivers he made dry. Bashan withers, and Carmel, and the blossom of Lebanon withers.
Mountains quaked because of him, and the hills melted away. And the earth lifted up from before him, the world and all who dwell in it.
Before his indignation who will stand? And who will endure at the burning of his anger? His rage is poured out like fire, and the rocks are pulled down by him.
Good is YHWH, for a stronghold in a day of trouble, and he knows those who take refuge in him.
And with a passing flood he will make a complete end of her place, and his enemies he will pursue into darkness.
What are you plotting against YHWH? He is making a complete end. Trouble will not rise a second time.
For while they are entangled as thorns, and as their drink drunken, they are consumed like stubble fully dry.
From you came out one plotting evil against YHWH, a counsellor of worthlessness.
Thus says YHWH: Though they are complete and thus many, even so they will be cut down, and he will pass away. And I afflicted you; I will not afflict you again.
And now I will break his yoke-bar from upon you, and your fetters I will tear apart.

And YHWH has commanded concerning you: From your name it will not be sown again. From the house of your gods I will cut off carved image and cast-metal image. I will make your grave, for you are of no weight.

There! On the mountains the feet of one bearing news, proclaiming peace. Celebrate your festivals, O Judah, pay your vows, for never again will one of worthlessness pass through you; all of him is cut off.

nahum_2.t: One who scatters has come up against your face. Guard the fortification, watch the road, strengthen the loins, make strength very firm.
For YHWH is restoring the majesty of Jacob like the majesty of Israel, for those who lay waste have laid them waste, and their branches they have destroyed.
The shield of his warriors is dyed red, men of valour are clothed in scarlet. In fire of metal is the chariotry on the day he prepares it, and the cypress spears have been made to quiver.
In the streets the chariotry drives madly; they rush about in the open places. Their appearance is like torches; like lightning flashes they run.
He remembers his nobles; they stumble in their going. They hurry to her wall, and the cover is prepared.
The gates of the rivers have been opened, and the palace has melted away.
And it is fixed: she was uncovered, she was taken away, and her maidservants are moaning like the sound of doves, beating on their hearts.
And Nineveh is like a pool of water from her days, and they are fleeing. Stop! Stop! And there is no one turning back.
Plunder silver! Plunder gold! And there is no end to the supply, abundance from every article of preciousness.
Emptiness and emptiness and devastation! And the heart is melting, and knees are tottering, and anguish is in all loins, and the faces of all of them have gathered a glow.
Where is the dwelling of lions, and the pasture — it — for the young lions, where the lion walked, the lioness, the cub of the lion, and there was none disturbing?
The lion was tearing enough for his cubs and strangling for his lionesses, and he filled his holes with prey and his dens with torn flesh.

Here I am against you — the declaration of YHWH of hosts. And I will burn her chariotry in smoke, and your young lions the sword will consume. And I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.

nahum_3.t: Woe, city of bloods! All of her is lying, full of plunder; prey does not depart.
The sound of a whip, and the sound of the rattling of a wheel, and a galloping horse, and a jolting chariot!
A horseman bringing up, and the blade of a sword, and the flash of a spear, and a multitude of slain, and a heaviness of corpses, and there is no end to the bodies — they stumble over their bodies.
Because of the many whorings of the prostitute, good of grace, a mistress of sorceries, who sells nations by her whorings and clans by her sorceries —
Here I am against you — the declaration of YHWH of hosts. And I will uncover your hem over your face, and I will show nations your nakedness and kingdoms your shame.
And I will throw detestable things on you, and I will treat you with contempt, and I will make you like a spectacle.
And it will be, all who see you will flee from you and will say: Nineveh is devastated! Who will show sympathy for her? From where shall I seek comforters for you?
Are you better than No Amon, which sat among the canals, waters all around her, whose rampart was the sea, from sea her wall?
Cush was her strength, and Egypt, and there was no end. Put and the Libyans were among your helpers.

Also she went into exile, into captivity. Also her children were dashed in pieces at the head of every street, and over her honoured ones they cast a lot, and all her great ones were bound with fetters.
You also will become drunk; you will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold from the enemy.
All your fortresses are fig trees with first-fruits: if they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of an eater.
Look, your people in your midst are women. To your enemies the gates of your land are certainly opened. Fire has consumed your bars.
Draw for yourself water of siege! Strengthen your fortresses! Go into the clay and trample in the mortar! Take hold of the brick mould!
There fire will consume you, the sword will cut you off, it will consume you like the young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust! Make yourself many like the swarming locust!
You have multiplied your traders beyond the stars of the heavens. The young locust strips off and flies away.

Your courtiers are like the swarming locust, and your officials like a locust of locusts, which camp in the walls on a day of cold. The sun rises and it flees, and its place is not known — where are they?
Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; your nobles settle down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is none gathering.
There is no relief for your fracture; your wound is severe. All who hear the report of you clap the palm over you, for over whom has your evil not passed continually?

nehemiah_1.t: The words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah. And it happened in the month of Kislev, the twentieth year, and I was in Susa the citadel;
and Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and men from Judah; and I asked them about the Jews, the escaped remnant who had survived from the captivity, and about Jerusalem.

And they said to me: The survivors who have survived from the captivity, there in the province, are in great trouble and in disgrace; and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and its gates have been burned with fire.
And it happened, when I heard these words, I sat down and wept and mourned for days; and I was fasting and praying before the God of the heavens.
And I said: I beg you, YHWH, God of the heavens, the great and awesome God, keeping the covenant and steadfast love for those who love him and for those who keep his commandments —

let your ear be attentive and your eyes open, to listen to the prayer of your servant which I am praying before you today, day and night, for the sons of Israel your servants, and confessing the sins of the sons of Israel which we have sinned against you; and I and the house of my father have sinned.
Acting corruptly, we have acted corruptly against you, and we have not kept the commandments and the statutes and the ordinances which you commanded Moses your servant.
Remember, please, the word which you commanded Moses your servant, saying: You will act unfaithfully — I will scatter you among the peoples.

And you will return to me and keep my commandments and do them — if your banished ones are at the end of the heavens, from there I will gather them and bring them to the place which I have chosen to make my name dwell there.
And they are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and by your strong hand.

I beg you, Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and give success, please, to your servant today, and give him compassion before this man. And I was cupbearer to the king.

nehemiah_2.t: And it happened in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him; and I lifted the wine and gave it to the king. And I had never been sad before him.
And the king said to me: Why is your face sad, when you are not sick? This is nothing but sadness of heart. And I was very greatly afraid.
And I said to the king: Let the king live for ever! Why should my face not be sad, when the city, the house of the tombs of my fathers, is desolate and its gates have been consumed by fire?
And the king said to me: For what is it that you are asking? And I prayed to the God of the heavens,
and I said to the king: If it is good to the king, and if your servant is good before you, that you would send me to Judah, to the city of the tombs of my fathers, and I will build it.

And the king said to me — and the queen consort was sitting beside him — How long will your journey be, and when will you return? And it was good before the king, and he sent me; and I gave him a time.
And I said to the king: If it is good to the king, let letters be given to me for the governors of Beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

and a letter to Asaph, keeper of the forest that belongs to the king, that he may give me wood to make beams for the gates of the citadel that belongs to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will go into. And the king gave them to me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
And I came to the governors of Beyond the River and gave them the letters of the king. And the king had sent with me commanders of the army and horsemen.
And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard, and it was displeasing to them, a great displeasure, that a man had come to seek good for the sons of Israel.
And I came to Jerusalem, and I was there three days.
And I arose by night, I and a few men with me; and I had told no one what my God was putting into my heart to do for Jerusalem. And there was no animal with me except the animal that I was riding.

And I went out by night by the Valley Gate, and towards the face of the Spring of the Dragon, and to the Dung Gate; and I was examining the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates consumed by fire.
And I passed on to the Spring Gate and to the King's Pool; and there was no room for the animal to pass through under me.
And I was going up in the wadi by night, and I was examining the wall; and I turned back and came in by the Valley Gate, and returned.

And the officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing; and to the Jews and to the priests and to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest who were doing the work I had not told anything until then.

And I said to them: You see the trouble that we are in, that Jerusalem is desolate and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, and let us build the wall of Jerusalem, and let us be a reproach no longer.

And I told them of the hand of my God, that it had been good upon me, and also the words of the king that he had spoken to me. And they said: Let us arise and build. And they strengthened their hands for the good.

And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arab heard, and they mocked us and despised us and said: What is this thing that you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?

And I returned them a word and said to them: The God of the heavens, he will grant us success; and we his servants will arise and build. But you have no share and no right and no memorial in Jerusalem.

nehemiah_3.t: And Eliashib the great priest arose, and his brothers the priests, and they built the Sheep Gate. They set it apart as holy and set up its doors; and as far as the Tower of the Hundred they set it apart as holy, as far as the Tower of Hananel.
And at his hand the men of Jericho built; and at his hand Zaccur son of Imri built.
And the Fish Gate the sons of Hassenaah built; they made beams for it and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.
And at their hand Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired; and at their hand Meshullam son of Berekiah son of Meshezabel repaired; and at their hand Zadok son of Baana repaired.
And at their hand the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles did not bring their neck into the work of their lords.
And the Jeshanah Gate Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired; they made beams for it and set up its doors and its bolts and its bars.
And at their hand Melatiah the Gibeonite repaired, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, up to the seat of the governor of Beyond the River.
At his hand Uzziel son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, repaired; and at his hand Hananiah, son of the perfumers, repaired. And they restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
And at their hand Rephaiah son of Hur, official of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired.
And at their hand Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired, and opposite his own house; and at his hand Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired.
A second measured portion Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired, and the Tower of the Ovens.
And at his hand Shallum son of Hallohesh, official of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired — he and his daughters.
The Valley Gate Hanun repaired, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars, and a thousand cubits in the wall as far as the Dung Gate.
And the Dung Gate Malkijah son of Rechab, official of the district of Beth-hakkerem, repaired; he built it and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.

And the Spring Gate Shallun son of Col-hozeh, official of the district of Mizpah, repaired; he built it and roofed it and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars; and the wall of the Pool of Shelah by the King's Garden, and as far as the steps that go down from the City of David.

After him Nehemiah son of Azbuk, official of half the district of Beth-zur, repaired, as far as opposite the tombs of David, and as far as the pool that was made, and as far as the house of the mighty men.
After him the Levites repaired: Rehum son of Bani. At his hand Hashabiah, official of half the district of Keilah, repaired for his district.
After him their brothers repaired: Bavvai son of Henadad, official of half the district of Keilah.
And Ezer son of Jeshua, official of Mizpah, repaired at his hand a second measured portion, opposite the ascent to the armoury, at the buttress.
After him Baruch son of Zaccai zealously repaired a second measured portion, from the buttress to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the great priest.
After him Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired a second measured portion, from the entrance of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house of Eliashib.
And after him the priests repaired, the men of the surrounding region.
After him Benjamin and Hasshub repaired, opposite their own house. After him Azariah son of Maaseiah son of Ananiah repaired, beside his own house.
After him Binnui son of Henadad repaired a second measured portion, from the house of Azariah to the buttress and to the corner.
Palal son of Uzai, opposite the buttress and the tower that projects from the upper house of the king, which belongs to the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah son of Parosh.
And the temple servants were dwelling on the Ophel, as far as opposite the Water Gate to the east, and the projecting tower.
After him the Tekoites repaired a second measured portion, from opposite the great projecting tower and as far as the wall of the Ophel.
Above the Horse Gate the priests repaired, each opposite his own house.
After him Zadok son of Immer repaired, opposite his own house. And after him Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, keeper of the East Gate, repaired.
After him Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired a second measured portion. After him Meshullam son of Berekiah repaired, opposite his own chamber.
After him Malkijah, of the goldsmiths, repaired as far as the house of the temple servants and the traders, opposite the Muster Gate, and as far as the upper chamber of the corner.
And between the upper chamber of the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the traders repaired.

nehemiah_4.t: And it happened, when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, that it burned within him and he was very angry, and he mocked the Jews.

And he said before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and he said: What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they restore it for themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of debris, when they are burned?
And Tobiah the Ammonite was beside him, and he said: Even what they are building — if a fox goes up, it will break down their wall of stones.
Hear, our God, for we have become contempt; and turn back their reproach on their own head, and give them for plunder in a land of captivity.
And do not cover over their iniquity, and let their sin not be wiped out from before you; for they have provoked to anger before the builders.
And we built the wall, and all the wall was joined together to half its height; and the people had a heart to work.

And it happened, when Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabs and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites heard that the repair of the walls of Jerusalem had gone up, that the broken places had begun to be closed, that it burned within them exceedingly.
And they all conspired together to come and wage war against Jerusalem, and to make confusion for it.
And we prayed to our God and stationed a guard against them day and night because of them.
And Judah said: The strength of the burden-bearer has failed, and the debris is much; and we ourselves are not able to build on the wall.
And our adversaries said: They will not know and they will not see, until we come into their midst and kill them and put an end to the work.
And it happened, when the Jews who were dwelling beside them came, that they said to us ten times: From all the places where you turn, they will come upon us.
And I stationed the people from the lowest parts of the place, behind the wall, in the exposed places; and I stationed the people by clans with their swords, their spears and their bows.

And I saw, and I arose and said to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest of the people: Do not be afraid before them. Remember the Lord, the great and awesome one, and fight for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your houses.
And it happened, when our enemies heard that it had been made known to us, and God had frustrated their purpose, that we all returned to the wall, each to his work.

And it happened from that day that half of my young men were doing the work, and half of them were holding the spears, the shields, the bows and the body armour; and the commanders were behind all the house of Judah,
those who were building on the wall. And those who carried burdens were loaded: with one of his hands doing the work, and one holding the weapon.
And the builders — each had his sword girded on his hips, and they were building; and the one who sounded the ram's horn was beside me.
And I said to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest of the people: The work is much and extensive, and we are separated on the wall, far each from his brother.
In the place where you hear the sound of the ram's horn, there you shall assemble to us. Our God will fight for us.
And we were doing the work, and half of them were keeping hold on the spears, from the coming up of the dawn until the coming out of the stars.
Also at that time I said to the people: Let each man and his young man spend the night inside Jerusalem, and they will be for us a guard by night and work by day.
And neither I nor my brothers nor my young men nor the men of the guard who were behind me — we were not stripping off our clothes; each his weapon, the water.

nehemiah_5.t: And there was a great outcry of the people and their wives against their brothers the Jews.
And there were those who were saying: Our sons and our daughters — we are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.
And there were those who were saying: Our fields and our vineyards and our houses — we are mortgaging them, that we may get grain in the famine.
And there were those who were saying: We have borrowed money for the king's tribute on our fields and our vineyards.

And now, our flesh is like the flesh of our brothers, our children are like their children; and behold, we are subduing our sons and our daughters as slaves, and some of our daughters are already subdued; and there is no power in our hand, and our fields and our vineyards belong to others.
And it burned within me exceedingly when I heard their outcry and these words.

And my heart took counsel within me, and I contended with the nobles and with the officials, and I said to them: A loan, each man against his brother, you are exacting. And I set a great assembly against them.

And I said to them: We ourselves have bought back our brothers the Jews who were sold to the nations, as far as we were able; and will you yourselves even sell your brothers, and shall they be sold to us? And they were silent and found no word.
And I said: The thing you are doing is not good. Should you not walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
And I too, my brothers and my young men, are lending them money and grain. Let us abandon this loan, please.

Return to them, please, this very day, their fields, their vineyards, their olive trees and their houses; and the hundredth of the money and the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil, which you are lending them.
And they said: We will return it, and from them we will require nothing. So we will do, just as you say. And I summoned the priests and made them swear to act according to this word.

Also I shook out my bosom and said: So may God shake out every man who does not carry out this word, from his house and from his property; and so may he be shaken out and empty. And all the assembly said, Amen, and they praised YHWH. And the people acted according to this word.

Also from the day that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year until the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king — twelve years — I and my brothers did not eat the food of the governor.

And the former governors who were before me made it heavy upon the people, and took from them in food and wine, after that forty shekels of silver; also their young men domineered over the people. But I did not do so, because of the fear of God.
And also on the work of this wall I kept hold, and we acquired no field; and all my young men were assembled there for the work.
And the Jews and the officials, a hundred and fifty men, and those who came to us from the nations that were around us, were at my table.

And what was prepared for one day was one ox, six choice sheep, and birds were prepared for me; and every ten days, all kinds of wine in abundance. And with all this I did not seek the food of the governor, because the service was heavy upon this people.
Remember for me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.

nehemiah_6.t: And it happened, when it was heard by Sanballat and Tobiah and by Geshem the Arab and by the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall and no breach was left in it — though up to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates —
Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying: Come, and let us meet together in Hakkephirim, in the plain of Ono. And they were planning to do me harm.
And I sent messengers to them, saying: I am doing a great work and I am not able to come down. Why should the work cease while I let it drop and come down to you?
And they sent to me according to this word four times, and I sent them back according to this word.
And Sanballat sent his young man to me according to this word a fifth time, and an open letter was in his hand.

Written in it: It is heard among the nations, and Gashmu is saying, that you and the Jews are planning to rebel; therefore you are building the wall. And you are to become their king, according to these words.

And also you have appointed prophets to proclaim about you in Jerusalem, saying: There is a king in Judah! And now it will be heard by the king according to these words. And now, come, and let us take counsel together.
And I sent to him, saying: Nothing has happened according to these words that you are saying; for you are inventing them from your own heart.
For all of them were making us afraid, saying: Their hands will drop from the work, and it will not be done. And now, strengthen my hands.

And I came to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah son of Mehetabel, and he was shut in; and he said: Let us meet at the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you — and by night they are coming to kill you.
And I said: Should a man like me flee? And who is there like me who would go into the temple and live? I will not go.
And I recognised, and behold, God had not sent him; for he had spoken the prophecy against me, and Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
For this purpose he was hired: that I might be afraid and act so and sin, and it would become for them a bad name, so that they might reproach me.
Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these works of his; and also Noadiah the prophetess, and the rest of the prophets who were making me afraid.
And the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.
And it happened, when all our enemies heard, and all the nations that were around us were afraid, that they fell greatly in their own eyes; and they knew that this work had been done from our God.
Also in those days the nobles of Judah were multiplying their letters going to Tobiah, and those of Tobiah were coming to them.
For many in Judah were lords of an oath to him, because he was a son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah, and Jehohanan his son had taken the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.
Also they were telling his good deeds before me, and my words they were bringing out to him. Tobiah sent letters to make me afraid.

nehemiah_7.t: And it happened, when the wall had been built and I had set up the doors, that the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed.
And I appointed Hanani my brother, and Hananiah the commander of the citadel, over Jerusalem; for he was like a man of faithfulness, and feared God more than many.

And I said to them: The gates of Jerusalem shall not be opened until the sun is hot; and while they are standing by, let them shut the doors and bolt them. And appoint guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each at his guard post and each opposite his own house.
And the city was broad of both hands and large, and the people in it were few, and there were no houses built.

And my God put it into my heart, and I gathered the nobles and the officials and the people to be enrolled by genealogy. And I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found written in it:

These are the children of the province who came up from the captivity of the exile, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken into exile; and they returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, each to his own city,
those who came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
the sons of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two;
the sons of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two;
the sons of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two;
the sons of Pahath-moab, of the sons of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and eighteen;
the sons of Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty-four;
the sons of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five;
the sons of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty;
the sons of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight;
the sons of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight;
the sons of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty-two;
the sons of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven;
the sons of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven;
the sons of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five;
the sons of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight;
the sons of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight;
the sons of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four;
the sons of Hariph, one hundred and twelve;
the sons of Gibeon, ninety-five;
the men of Bethlehem and Netophah, one hundred and eighty-eight;
the men of Anathoth, one hundred and twenty-eight;
the men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two;
the men of Kiriath-jearim, Kephirah and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three;
the men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one;
the men of Michmas, one hundred and twenty-two;
the men of Bethel and Ai, one hundred and twenty-three;
the men of the other Nebo, fifty-two;
the sons of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty-four;
the sons of Harim, three hundred and twenty;
the sons of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five;
the sons of Lod, Hadid and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one;
the sons of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
The priests: the sons of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three;
the sons of Immer, one thousand and fifty-two;
the sons of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred and forty-seven;
the sons of Harim, one thousand and seventeen.
The Levites: the sons of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the sons of Hodevah, seventy-four.
The singers: the sons of Asaph, one hundred and forty-eight.
The gatekeepers: the sons of Shallum, the sons of Ater, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akkub, the sons of Hatita, the sons of Shobai, one hundred and thirty-eight.
The temple servants: the sons of Ziha, the sons of Hasupha, the sons of Tabbaoth,
the sons of Keros, the sons of Sia, the sons of Padon,
the sons of Lebanah, the sons of Hagabah, the sons of Shalmai,
the sons of Hanan, the sons of Giddel, the sons of Gahar,
the sons of Reaiah, the sons of Rezin, the sons of Nekoda,
the sons of Gazzam, the sons of Uzza, the sons of Paseah,
the sons of Besai, the sons of Meunim, the sons of Nephushesim,
the sons of Bakbuk, the sons of Hakupha, the sons of Harhur,
the sons of Bazlith, the sons of Mehida, the sons of Harsha,
