the sons of Barkos, the sons of Sisera, the sons of Temah,
the sons of Neziah, the sons of Hatipha.
The sons of the servants of Solomon: the sons of Sotai, the sons of Sophereth, the sons of Perida,
the sons of Jaala, the sons of Darkon, the sons of Giddel,
the sons of Shephatiah, the sons of Hattil, the sons of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the sons of Amon.
All the temple servants and the sons of the servants of Solomon: three hundred and ninety-two.
And these are those who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon and Immer; and they were not able to declare their ancestral house and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, the sons of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.
And of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai, who had taken a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
These sought their document, those who had been enrolled by genealogy, and it was not found; and they were excluded from the priesthood as defiled.
And the Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest should stand for Urim and Thummim.
The whole assembly together: forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,
besides their male servants and their female servants, these being seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred male singers and female singers.
Their horses, seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules, two hundred and forty-five;
camels, four hundred and thirty-five; donkeys, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
And some of the heads of the ancestral houses gave to the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury: gold, a thousand darics; fifty basins; five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
And some of the heads of the ancestral houses gave to the treasury of the work: gold, twenty thousand darics; and silver, two thousand two hundred minas.
And what the rest of the people gave was: gold, twenty thousand darics; and silver, two thousand minas; and sixty-seven priests' garments.

And the priests and the Levites and the gatekeepers and the singers, and some of the people, and the temple servants, and all Israel, dwelt in their own cities. And the seventh month arrived, and the sons of Israel were in their cities.

nehemiah_8.t: And all the people gathered as one man to the open space that was before the Water Gate; and they said to Ezra the scribe to bring the scroll of the law of Moses, which YHWH had commanded Israel.
And Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, from man to woman, and all who could understand what they heard, on the first day of the seventh month.

And he read aloud in it, before the open space that was before the Water Gate, from the light until the middle of the day, in front of the men and the women and those who could understand; and the ears of all the people were toward the scroll of the law.

And Ezra the scribe stood on a high platform of wood which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah and Shema and Anaiah and Uriah and Hilkiah and Maaseiah on his right hand, and on his left Pedaiah and Mishael and Malkijah and Hashum and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, Meshullam.
And Ezra opened the scroll before the eyes of all the people, for he was above all the people; and as he opened it, all the people stood up.
And Ezra blessed YHWH, the great God; and all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with the raising of their hands, and they bowed low and bowed down to YHWH with faces to the ground.

And Jeshua and Bani and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah — and the Levites — were making the people understand the law, and the people were at their place.
And they read aloud in the scroll, in the law of God, making it clear; and they gave the sense, and they understood the reading.

And Nehemiah — he was the Tirshatha — and Ezra the priest, the scribe, and the Levites who were making the people understand, said to all the people: This day is holy to YHWH your God. Do not mourn and do not weep. For all the people were weeping when they heard the words of the law.

And he said to them: Go, eat rich things and drink sweet things, and send portions to those for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy to our Lord. And do not be grieved, for the joy of YHWH — it is your stronghold.
And the Levites were quieting all the people, saying: Hush, for this day is holy. And do not be grieved.
And all the people went to eat and to drink and to send portions and to make great joy, for they had understood the words that had been made known to them.
And on the second day the heads of the ancestral houses of all the people, the priests and the Levites, gathered to Ezra the scribe, to gain insight into the words of the law.
And they found written in the law that YHWH had commanded by the hand of Moses, that the sons of Israel should dwell in booths during the festival in the seventh month,

and that they should make proclamation and send a proclamation through all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying: Go out to the hill country and bring leaves of olive and leaves of oil tree and leaves of myrtle and leaves of palm and leaves of leafy tree, to make booths, as it is written.

And the people went out and brought them, and made themselves booths, each on his own roof, and in their courtyards, and in the courtyards of the house of God, and in the open space of the Water Gate, and in the open space of the Gate of Ephraim.

And all the assembly that had returned from the captivity made booths and dwelt in the booths; for the sons of Israel had not done so since the days of Jeshua son of Nun until that day. And there was very great joy.

And he read aloud in the scroll of the law of God day by day, from the first day until the last day; and they kept the festival seven days, and on the eighth day a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

nehemiah_9.t: And on the twenty-fourth day of this month the sons of Israel gathered with fasting and in sackcloth, and earth was on them.
And the offspring of Israel separated themselves from all the sons of foreignness; and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
And they stood up at their place and read aloud in the scroll of the law of YHWH their God a fourth of the day; and a fourth they were confessing and bowing down to YHWH their God.
And Jeshua and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Kenani stood up on the platform of the Levites and cried out with a loud voice to YHWH their God.

And the Levites — Jeshua and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, Pethahiah — said: Arise, bless YHWH your God from everlasting to everlasting. And let them bless your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

You are he, YHWH, you alone. You made the heavens, the heavens of the heavens and all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them; and you preserve them all alive, and the host of the heavens are bowing down to you.
You are he, YHWH the God, who chose Abram and brought him out from Ur of the Chaldeans and made his name Abraham;

and you found his heart faithful before you, and made with him the covenant to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Jebusite and the Girgashite — to give it to his offspring. And you fulfilled your words, for you are righteous.
And you saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and you heard their outcry at the Sea of Reeds.

And you gave signs and wonders against Pharaoh and against all his servants and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they had acted presumptuously against them; and you made a name for yourself, as it is this day.
And the sea you split before them, and they passed through the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and their pursuers you threw into the depths like a stone into mighty waters.
And in a pillar of cloud you led them by day, and in a pillar of fire by night, to light up for them the way in which they should walk.
And on Mount Sinai you came down and spoke with them from heaven, and you gave them upright ordinances and laws of faithfulness, good statutes and commandments.
And your holy sabbath you made known to them, and commandments and statutes and law you commanded them by the hand of Moses your servant.

And bread from heaven you gave them for their hunger, and water from a rock you brought out for them for their thirst; and you said to them to go in and take possession of the land which you had lifted your hand to give them.
But they and our fathers acted presumptuously, and stiffened their neck, and did not listen to your commandments.

And they refused to listen, and did not remember your wonders that you had done with them; and they stiffened their neck and appointed a head to return to their servitude in their rebellion. But you are a God of forgivenesses, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, and you did not abandon them.
Even when they had made themselves a calf of cast metal and had said, This is your god who brought you up from Egypt, and had committed great blasphemies —

you in your great compassion did not abandon them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud did not depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; nor the pillar of fire by night, to light up for them, and the way in which they should walk.
And your good spirit you gave to instruct them, and your manna you did not withhold from their mouth, and water you gave them for their thirst.
And forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.
And you gave them kingdoms and peoples, and apportioned them to a corner; and they took possession of the land of Sihon king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
And their children you multiplied like the stars of the heavens, and you brought them into the land which you had told their fathers to go in and take possession of.

And the children went in and took possession of the land, and you brought low before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hand — them and their kings and the peoples of the land — to do with them as they pleased.

And they captured fortified cities and fertile ground, and took possession of houses full of every good thing, hewn cisterns, vineyards and olive trees and fruit trees in abundance. And they ate and were satisfied and grew fat, and luxuriated in your great goodness.
And they were disobedient and rebelled against you, and threw your law behind their back, and killed your prophets who had warned them to bring them back to you; and they committed great blasphemies.

And you gave them into the hand of their adversaries, who caused them distress; and in the time of their distress they cried out to you, and you from heaven heard, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, and they delivered them from the hand of their adversaries.

And as soon as they had rest they returned to do evil before you, and you abandoned them into the hand of their enemies, and they ruled over them; and they returned and cried out to you, and you from heaven heard and rescued them according to your compassion, many times.

And you warned them, to bring them back to your law; but they acted presumptuously and did not listen to your commandments, and against your ordinances they sinned — which if a person does them, he shall live by them — and they gave a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their neck and did not listen.
And you prolonged over them many years, and warned them by your spirit by the hand of your prophets; and they did not give ear, and you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
But in your great compassion you did not make an end of them and did not abandon them, for you are a gracious and compassionate God.

And now, our God, the great, the mighty and the awesome God, who keeps the covenant and the steadfast love: let not all the hardship seem small before you that has come upon us — upon our kings, upon our leaders, upon our priests, upon our prophets, upon our fathers and upon all your people — from the days of the kings of Assyria until this day.
And you are righteous in all that has come upon us, for you have acted in faithfulness and we have acted wickedly.
And our kings, our leaders, our priests and our fathers did not do your law, and did not pay attention to your commandments and to your testimonies with which you admonished them.

And they, in their own kingdom and in your great goodness which you gave them, and in the broad and fertile land which you set before them, did not serve you and did not turn back from their evil deeds.
Behold, we are slaves today; and the land which you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good things — behold, we are slaves upon it.
And its produce increases for the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins; and over our bodies they rule over us, and over our cattle as they please. And we are in great distress.
And in all this we are making a firm agreement and writing it; and on the sealed document are our leaders, our Levites, our priests.

nehemiah_10.t: And on the sealed documents were: Nehemiah the Tirshatha son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah. These were the priests.
And the Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
and their brothers: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
The heads of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

And the rest of the people — the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and everyone who had separated himself from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons and their daughters, everyone who knew and understood —

they were holding fast to their brothers, their nobles, and entering into a curse and into an oath to walk in the law of God, which was given by the hand of Moses the servant of God, and to keep and to do all the commandments of YHWH our Lord and his ordinances and his statutes;
and that we will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, and their daughters we will not take for our sons;

and that the peoples of the land who bring wares and any grain on the sabbath day to sell, we will not take from them on the sabbath or on a holy day; and that we will let go the seventh year and the loan of every hand;
and we established commandments upon ourselves, to put upon ourselves a third of a shekel a year for the service of the house of our God:

for the bread of the row, and the regular grain offering, and for the regular burnt offering, the sabbaths, the new moons, for the appointed times and for the holy things and for the sin offerings, to make atonement for Israel; and all the work of the house of our God.

And we cast the lots concerning the offering of the wood — the priests, the Levites and the people — to bring it to the house of our God, by our ancestral houses, at appointed times, year by year, to burn on the altar of YHWH our God, as it is written in the law.
And to bring the firstfruits of our ground and the firstfruits of all fruit of every tree, year by year, to the house of YHWH;

and the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as it is written in the law; and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who serve in the house of our God;

and the first of our dough, and our contributions, and the fruit of every tree, new wine and fresh oil, we will bring to the priests, to the storerooms of the house of our God; and the tithe of our ground to the Levites — and they, the Levites, are the ones who collect the tithes in all the cities of our labour.

And the priest, the son of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites collect the tithes; and the Levites shall bring up a tithe of the tithe to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury house.

For to the storerooms the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the contribution of the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil; and there are the articles of the sanctuary, and the priests who serve, and the gatekeepers and the singers. And we will not neglect the house of our God.

nehemiah_11.t: And the leaders of the people dwelt in Jerusalem; and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the cities.
And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to dwell in Jerusalem.

And these are the heads of the province who dwelt in Jerusalem; and in the cities of Judah each dwelt on his own property, in their cities — Israel, the priests and the Levites and the temple servants and the sons of the servants of Solomon.

And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the sons of Judah and some of the sons of Benjamin. Of the sons of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah son of Zechariah son of Amariah son of Shephatiah son of Mahalalel, of the sons of Perez;
and Maaseiah son of Baruch son of Col-hozeh son of Hazaiah son of Adaiah son of Joiarib son of Zechariah, son of the Shilonite.
All the sons of Perez who dwelt in Jerusalem: four hundred and sixty-eight men of strength.
And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam son of Joed son of Pedaiah son of Kolaiah son of Maaseiah son of Ithiel son of Jeshaiah;
and after him Gabbai, Sallai: nine hundred and twenty-eight.
And Joel son of Zikri was officer over them, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
Of the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jakin;
Seraiah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, supervisor of the house of God;
and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pelaliah son of Amzi son of Zechariah son of Pashhur son of Malkijah,
and his brothers, heads of ancestral houses, two hundred and forty-two; and Amashsai son of Azarel son of Ahzai son of Meshillemoth son of Immer,
and their brothers, mighty men of strength, one hundred and twenty-eight; and officer over them was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah son of Bunni;
and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the heads of the Levites, over the outside work of the house of God;

and Mattaniah son of Micah son of Zabdi son of Asaph, the head, the beginning, who gave thanks at the prayer; and Bakbukiah, second among his brothers; and Abda son of Shammua son of Galal son of Jeduthun.
All the Levites in the holy city: two hundred and eighty-four.
And the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates: one hundred and seventy-two.
And the rest of Israel, the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
And the temple servants were dwelling on the Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
And the officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani son of Hashabiah son of Mattaniah son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, for the work of the house of God.
For the commandment of the king was upon them, and a firm ordinance was upon the singers, the matter of a day in its day.
And Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah son of Judah, was at the king's side for every matter concerning the people.
And as for the villages with their fields: some of the sons of Judah dwelt in Kiriath-arba and its daughter-towns, and in Dibon and its daughter-towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
and in Jeshua and in Moladah and in Beth-pelet,
and in Hazar-shual, and in Beersheba and its daughter-towns,
and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in its daughter-towns,
and in En-rimmon and in Zorah and in Jarmuth,
Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its daughter-towns. And they encamped from Beersheba as far as the Valley of Hinnom.
And the sons of Benjamin were from Geba: Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel and its daughter-towns,
Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Lod and Ono, the Valley of the Craftsmen.
And of the Levites, divisions of Judah belonged to Benjamin.

nehemiah_12.t: And these are the priests and the Levites who came up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the heads of the priests and their brothers in the days of Jeshua.
And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah — he and his brothers were over the songs of thanksgiving.
And Bakbukiah and Unni, their brothers, were opposite them in the duties.
And Jeshua fathered Joiakim, and Joiakim fathered Eliashib, and Eliashib, Joiada,
and Joiada fathered Jonathan, and Jonathan fathered Jaddua.
And in the days of Joiakim there were priests, heads of the ancestral houses: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
of Abijah, Zikri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada and Johanan and Jaddua were recorded as heads of ancestral houses; and the priests, until the reign of Darius the Persian.
The sons of Levi, the heads of the ancestral houses, were recorded on the scroll of the matters of the days, and until the days of Johanan son of Eliashib.

And the heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah and Jeshua son of Kadmiel; and their brothers were opposite them, to praise and to give thanks, by the commandment of David the man of God, division corresponding to division.
Mattaniah and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were keeping guard as gatekeepers at the storerooms of the gates.
These were in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest, the scribe.

And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to hold a dedication with joy, and with thanksgivings and with song, cymbals, harps and lyres.
And the sons of the singers gathered, from the district around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites,
and from Beth-gilgal and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth; for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.
And the priests and the Levites cleansed themselves, and they cleansed the people and the gates and the wall.
And I brought up the leaders of Judah onto the wall, and I appointed two great thanksgiving choirs and processions; and one went to the right on the wall, toward the Dung Gate.
And after them went Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah,
and Azariah, Ezra and Meshullam,
Judah and Benjamin and Shemaiah and Jeremiah,
and some of the sons of the priests with trumpets: Zechariah son of Jonathan son of Shemaiah son of Mattaniah son of Micaiah son of Zaccur son of Asaph,
and his brothers Shemaiah and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with the instruments of song of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.
And at the Spring Gate, and straight ahead of them, they went up on the steps of the City of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, and as far as the Water Gate to the east.
And the second thanksgiving choir was the one going to the front, and I was behind it, and half the people, on the wall, above the Tower of the Ovens and as far as the Broad Wall,

and above the Gate of Ephraim, and over the Jeshanah Gate and over the Fish Gate, and the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, and as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
And the two thanksgiving choirs took their stand in the house of God, and I, and half the officials with me,
and the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, Hananiah, with trumpets;
and Maaseiah and Shemaiah and Eleazar and Uzzi and Jehohanan and Malkijah and Elam and Ezer. And the singers made themselves heard, and Izrahiah was the officer.

And they sacrificed great sacrifices on that day and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced. And the rejoicing of Jerusalem was heard from far off.

And on that day men were appointed over the chambers for the stores, for the contributions, for the first fruits and for the tithes, to gather into them from the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and for the Levites; for the joy of Judah was over the priests and over the Levites who stood there.
And they kept the service of their God and the service of the cleansing — and the singers and the gatekeepers — according to the commandment of David, of Solomon his son.
For in the days of David and Asaph, from of old, there were heads of the singers, and song of praise and thanksgivings to God.

And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah were giving the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, the matter of a day in its day; and they were setting apart for the Levites, and the Levites were setting apart for the sons of Aaron.

nehemiah_13.t: On that day there was read aloud in the scroll of Moses in the ears of the people; and it was found written in it that no Ammonite or Moabite should enter the assembly of God, for ever,
because they did not meet the sons of Israel with food and with water, and he hired Balaam against them to curse them; and our God turned the curse into a blessing.
And it happened, when they heard the law, that they separated all those of mixed descent from Israel.
And before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the storeroom of the house of our God, being close to Tobiah,

had made him a large room where formerly they used to put the grain offering, the frankincense and the articles, and the tithe of the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil — the commandment for the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers — and the contribution of the priests.
And in all this I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had gone to the king; and at the end of some days I asked leave of the king,
and I came to Jerusalem, and I perceived the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in making him a room in the courtyards of the house of God.
And it was very displeasing to me, and I threw all the goods of Tobiah's household outside, out of the room.
And I gave the order, and they cleansed the storerooms; and I brought back there the articles of the house of God, with the grain offering and the frankincense.
And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given, and that the Levites and the singers who did the work had fled, each to his own field.
And I contended with the officials and said: Why has the house of God been neglected? And I gathered them and set them at their place.
And all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil to the storerooms.

And I appointed as treasurers over the storerooms Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites; and at their hand was Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, for they were reckoned reliable; and it was on them to distribute to their brothers.
Remember for me, my God, concerning this; and do not wipe out my acts of loyalty which I have done for the house of my God and for its services.

In those days I saw in Judah men treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in the heaps of grain and loading them on donkeys, and also wine, grapes and figs and every kind of load, and bringing them into Jerusalem on the sabbath day; and I protested on the day they sold provisions.
And the Tyrians who dwelt in it were bringing in fish and every kind of merchandise, and selling on the sabbath to the sons of Judah and in Jerusalem.
And I contended with the nobles of Judah and said to them: What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the sabbath day?
Did not your fathers do thus, and our God brought upon us all this trouble, and upon this city? And you are adding wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

And it happened, when the gates of Jerusalem grew dark before the sabbath, that I gave the order and the doors were shut; and I said that they should not open them until after the sabbath. And some of my young men I stationed at the gates: no load should come in on the sabbath day.
And the traders and the sellers of every kind of merchandise spent the night outside Jerusalem, once and twice.
And I warned them and said to them: Why are you spending the night in front of the wall? If you do it again, I will stretch out a hand against you. From that time they did not come on the sabbath.

And I said to the Levites that they should be cleansing themselves and coming to guard the gates, to keep the sabbath day holy. This also remember for me, my God, and have pity on me according to the greatness of your steadfast love.
Also in those days I saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, of Moab.
And half their children were speaking Ashdodite and did not know how to speak Judean, but according to the language of one people and another.

And I contended with them and cursed them and struck some of the men among them and pulled out their hair; and I made them swear by God: You shall not give your daughters to their sons, and you shall not take any of their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

Did not Solomon king of Israel sin over these? And among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel; even him the foreign women caused to sin.
And is it to be heard of you, to do all this great evil, to act unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?
And one of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the great priest was a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite; and I drove him away from me.
Remember them, my God, concerning the defilements of the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
And I cleansed them from everything foreign, and I assigned duties to the priests and to the Levites, each in his own work;
and for the offering of the wood at appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember for me, my God, for good.

numbers_1.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year of their going out from the land of Egypt, saying:
Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, every male, by their skulls,
from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host in Israel — you shall enrol them by their hosts, you and Aaron.
And with you shall be a man, a man for the tribe; each is the head of the house of his fathers, he.
And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: for Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
for Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
for Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
for Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
for Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
for the sons of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
for Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
for Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
for Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
for Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
for Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan;
These were the called ones of the congregation, the leaders of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the clans of Israel.
And Moses and Aaron took these men, who had been designated by names,

and all the congregation they assembled on the first of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees upon their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, by their skulls.
just as YHWH had commanded Moses, so he enrolled them in the wilderness of Sinai.

And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, by their skulls, every male from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Reuben: six and forty thousand and five hundred.

Of the sons of Simeon: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, its enrolled, in the number of names, by their skulls, every male from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Simeon: nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
Of the sons of Gad: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Gad: five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
Of the sons of Judah: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Judah: four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
Of the sons of Issachar: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Issachar: four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
Of the sons of Zebulun: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Zebulun: seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.

Of the sons of Joseph, of the sons of Ephraim: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Ephraim: forty thousand and five hundred.
Of the sons of Manasseh: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Manasseh: two and thirty thousand and two hundred.
Of the sons of Benjamin: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Benjamin: five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
Of the sons of Dan: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Dan: two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
Of the sons of Asher: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Asher: one and forty thousand and five hundred.
The sons of Naphtali: their generations, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host —
Their enrolled, of the tribe of Naphtali: three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
These are the enrolled whom Moses enrolled, and Aaron, and the leaders of Israel, twelve men; a man, one for the house of his fathers they were.
And all the enrolled of the sons of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from a son of twenty years and upward, everyone going out to the host in Israel —
and all the enrolled were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
But the Levites, by the tribe of their fathers, were not enrolled among them.
And YHWH had spoken to Moses, saying:
'Only the tribe of Levi you shall not enrol, and their head you shall not lift up among the sons of Israel.

And you, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony and over all its articles and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, and they shall serve it, and around the tabernacle they shall encamp.
And when the tabernacle sets out, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle encamps, the Levites shall raise it up. And the stranger who draws near shall be put to death.
And the sons of Israel shall encamp, each at his camp and each at his standard, by their hosts.

And the Levites shall encamp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that there shall be no wrath upon the congregation of the sons of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the keeping of the tabernacle of the testimony.
And the sons of Israel did according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses; so they did.

numbers_2.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
Each at his standard, with the signs of the house of their fathers, the sons of Israel shall encamp; opposite, around the tent of meeting, they shall encamp.
And those encamping eastward, toward the sunrise: the standard of the camp of Judah, by their hosts; and the leader of the sons of Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
and his host and their enrolled: four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Issachar; and the leader of the sons of Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
and his host and his enrolled: four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
The tribe of Zebulun; and the leader of the sons of Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
and his host and his enrolled: seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.
All the enrolled of the camp of Judah: a hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred, by their hosts. They shall set out first.
The standard of the camp of Reuben southward, by their hosts; and the leader of the sons of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
and his host and their enrolled: six and forty thousand and five hundred.
And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Simeon; and the leader of the sons of Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
and his host and their enrolled: nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
And the tribe of Gad; and the leader of the sons of Gad, Eliasaph son of Reuel;
and his host and their enrolled: five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
All the enrolled of the camp of Reuben: a hundred thousand and one and fifty thousand and four hundred and fifty, by their hosts. And they shall set out second.
And the tent of meeting shall set out, the camp of the Levites, in the midst of the camps. Just as they encamp, so they shall set out, each in his place, by their standards.
The standard of the camp of Ephraim, by their hosts, westward; and the leader of the sons of Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud;
and his host and their enrolled: forty thousand and five hundred.
And beside him, the tribe of Manasseh; and the leader of the sons of Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
and his host and their enrolled: two and thirty thousand and two hundred.
And the tribe of Benjamin; and the leader of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
and his host and their enrolled: five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
All the enrolled of the camp of Ephraim: a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, by their hosts. And they shall set out third.
The standard of the camp of Dan northward, by their hosts; and the leader of the sons of Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
and his host and their enrolled: two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Asher; and the leader of the sons of Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
and his host and their enrolled: one and forty thousand and five hundred.
And the tribe of Naphtali; and the leader of the sons of Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan;
and his host and their enrolled: three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
All the enrolled of the camp of Dan: a hundred thousand and seven and fifty thousand and six hundred. They shall set out last, by their standards.
These are the enrolled of the sons of Israel by the house of their fathers. All the enrolled of the camps, by their hosts: six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
And the Levites were not enrolled among the sons of Israel, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And the sons of Israel did according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses; so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, each by his clans, upon the house of his fathers.

numbers_3.t: And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, on the day YHWH spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn, Nadab; and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hand he filled to serve as priests.

And Nadab and Abihu died before YHWH when they brought near strange fire before YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai, and sons they had none; and Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Bring near the tribe of Levi and make it stand before Aaron the priest, and they shall serve him.
And they shall keep his keeping and the keeping of all the congregation before the tent of meeting, by serving the service of the tabernacle.
And they shall keep all the articles of the tent of meeting and the keeping of the sons of Israel, by serving the service of the tabernacle.
And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; given, given they are to him from the sons of Israel.
And Aaron and his sons you shall appoint, and they shall keep their priesthood; and the stranger who draws near shall be put to death.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
And I, here, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn, the opener of the womb, from the sons of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine.
For every firstborn is mine. On the day I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt I set apart as holy for myself every firstborn in Israel, from human to beast; they shall be mine. I am YHWH.
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
Enrol the sons of Levi by the house of their fathers, by their clans; every male from a son of a month and upward you shall enrol them.
And Moses enrolled them at the mouth of YHWH, just as he had been commanded.
And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.
And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
And the sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are they, the clans of the Levite by the house of their fathers.
To Gershon: the clan of the Libnite and the clan of the Shimeite. These are they, the clans of the Gershonite.
Their enrolled, in the number of every male from a son of a month and upward — their enrolled: seven thousand and five hundred.
The clans of the Gershonite shall encamp behind the tabernacle, westward.
And the leader of the father's house of the Gershonite: Eliasaph son of Lael.
And the keeping of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting: the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,
and the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen of the entrance of the courtyard that is by the tabernacle and by the altar all around, and its ropes, for all its service.
And to Kohath: the clan of the Amramite and the clan of the Izharite and the clan of the Hebronite and the clan of the Uzzielite. These are they, the clans of the Kohathite.
In the number of every male from a son of a month and upward: eight thousand and six hundred, keepers of the keeping of the holy place.
The clans of the sons of Kohath shall encamp at the side of the tabernacle, southward.
And the leader of the father's house of the clans of the Kohathite: Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
And their keeping: the ark and the table and the lampstand and the altars and the articles of the holy place with which they serve, and the screen, and all its service.
And the leader of the leaders of the Levite: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, the oversight of the keepers of the keeping of the holy place.
To Merari: the clan of the Mahlite and the clan of the Mushite. These are they, the clans of Merari.
And their enrolled, in the number of every male from a son of a month and upward: six thousand and two hundred.
And the leader of the father's house of the clans of Merari: Zuriel son of Abihail. They shall encamp at the side of the tabernacle, northward.
And the oversight of the keeping of the sons of Merari: the frames of the tabernacle and its bars and its pillars and its bases, and all its articles, and all its service,
and the pillars of the courtyard all around, and their bases and their tent pegs and their ropes.

And those encamping before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise: Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the keeping of the sanctuary for the keeping of the sons of Israel; and the stranger who draws near shall be put to death.
All the enrolled of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the mouth of YHWH by their clans, every male from a son of a month and upward: two and twenty thousand.
And YHWH said to Moses: Enrol every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from a son of a month and upward, and take the number of their names.

And you shall take the Levites for me — I am YHWH — in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites in place of every firstborn among the livestock of the sons of Israel.
And Moses enrolled, just as YHWH had commanded him, every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
And every firstborn male, in the number of names from a son of a month and upward, by their enrolled, was: two and twenty thousand, three and seventy and two hundred.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Take the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am YHWH.
And as the redemption of the three and the seventy and the two hundred who are in excess over the Levites, from the firstborn of the sons of Israel —
you shall take five, five shekels per skull; by the shekel of the holy place you shall take it — twenty gerahs is the shekel.
And you shall give the money to Aaron and to his sons, the redemption of those in excess among them.
And Moses took the money of the redemption from those in excess over those redeemed by the Levites.
From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the money: five and sixty and three hundred and a thousand, by the shekel of the holy place.
And Moses gave the money of those redeemed to Aaron and to his sons at the mouth of YHWH, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.

numbers_4.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans, by the house of their fathers,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years, everyone coming to the host, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: the most holy things.
And Aaron and his sons shall come, when the camp sets out, and take down the veil of the screen and cover with it the ark of the testimony.
And they shall put on it a covering of fine leather and spread over it a cloth wholly of violet, and set in its poles.

And over the table of the Presence they shall spread a cloth of violet, and put on it the dishes and the pans and the bowls and the jars of the drink offering; and the bread of continuity shall be on it.
And they shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and set in its poles.
And they shall take a cloth of violet and cover the lampstand of the light and its lamps and its tongs and its firepans and all the articles of its oil, with which they serve it.
And they shall put it and all its articles into a covering of fine leather, and put it on the carrying frame.
And over the altar of gold they shall spread a cloth of violet and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and set in its poles.

And they shall take all the articles of the service with which they serve in the holy place and put them into a cloth of violet and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
And they shall take away the fatty ash from the altar and spread over it a cloth of purple,

and put on it all its articles with which they serve at it: the firepans, the forks and the shovels and the basins, all the articles of the altar; and they shall spread over it a covering of fine leather, and set in its poles.

And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy place and all the articles of the holy place, when the camp sets out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them; and they shall not touch the holy thing, or they will die. These are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.

And the oversight of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest: the oil of the light and the incense of spices and the grain offering of continuity and the oil of anointing — the oversight of all the tabernacle and all that is in it, of the holy place and of its articles.
And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
Do not cut off the tribe of the clans of the Kohathite from among the Levites.
And do this for them, so that they may live and not die when they draw near to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall come and set them, a man, a man, to his service and to his burden.
And they shall not come to see the holy thing as it is swallowed, or they will die.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Take the sum of the sons of Gershon, them also, by the house of their fathers, by their clans.
From a son of thirty years and upward to a son of fifty years you shall enrol them, everyone who comes to serve service, to serve the service in the tent of meeting.
This is the service of the clans of the Gershonite, to serve and to carry:

And they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting, its covering and the covering of fine leather that is over it above, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,

and the hangings of the courtyard and the screen of the entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is by the tabernacle and by the altar all around, and their ropes and all the articles of their service; and all that is done for them they shall serve.
At the mouth of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonite, for all their burden and for all their service; and you shall assign to them in charge all their burden.
This is the service of the clans of the sons of the Gershonite in the tent of meeting; and their charge is in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
The sons of Merari: by their clans, by the house of their fathers, you shall enrol them,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years you shall enrol them, everyone coming to the host, to serve the service of the tent of meeting.
And this is the charge of their burden, for all their service in the tent of meeting: the frames of the tabernacle and its bars and its pillars and its bases,

and the pillars of the courtyard all around and their bases and their tent pegs and their ropes, with all their articles and all their service; and by names you shall assign the articles of the charge of their burden.
This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, for all their service in the tent of meeting, in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
And Moses and Aaron and the leaders of the congregation enrolled the sons of the Kohathite by their clans and by the house of their fathers,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years, everyone coming to the host, for service in the tent of meeting.
And their enrolled by their clans were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
These are the enrolled of the clans of the Kohathite, everyone serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the mouth of YHWH, by the hand of Moses.
And the enrolled of the sons of Gershon, by their clans and by the house of their fathers,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years, everyone coming to the host, for service in the tent of meeting.
and their enrolled, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
These are the enrolled of the clans of the sons of Gershon, everyone serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the mouth of YHWH.
And the enrolled of the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans, by the house of their fathers,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years, everyone coming to the host, for service in the tent of meeting.
and their enrolled, by their clans, were three thousand and two hundred.
These are the enrolled of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the mouth of YHWH, by the hand of Moses.
All the enrolled whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel enrolled — the Levites, by their clans and by the house of their fathers,
from a son of thirty years and upward and to a son of fifty years, everyone coming to serve a service of service and a service of carrying in the tent of meeting —
and their enrolled were eight thousand and five hundred and eighty.
At the mouth of YHWH he enrolled them by the hand of Moses, a man, a man, to his service and to his burden; and his enrolled were those whom YHWH commanded Moses.

numbers_5.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Command the sons of Israel that they send out from the camp everyone with leprosy and everyone with a discharge and everyone unclean by a corpse.
From male to female you shall send them out; outside the camp you shall send them, and they shall not make unclean their camps, in the midst of which I am dwelling.
And the sons of Israel did so, and they sent them outside the camp; just as YHWH had spoken to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel: A man or a woman, when they do any of the sins of humankind, acting unfaithfully an act of unfaithfulness against YHWH, and that person becomes guilty —
then they shall confess their sin that they have done, and he shall repay his guilt in its principal amount, and add its fifth to it, and give it to the one to whom he is guilty.
And if the man has no redeemer to repay the guilt to him, the guilt that is repaid belongs to YHWH, for the priest — besides the ram of atonement with which he makes atonement for him.
And every contribution of all the holy things of the sons of Israel that they bring near to the priest shall be his.
And each man's holy things shall be his; whatever a man gives to the priest shall be his.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: A man, a man, when his wife turns aside and acts unfaithfully against him an act of unfaithfulness,

and a man lies with her, a lying of seed, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and she is undetected, and she has been made unclean, and there is no witness against her, and she was not caught —

and a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, and she has been made unclean; or a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, and she has not been made unclean —

then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her: a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He shall not pour oil on it and shall not put frankincense on it, for it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
And the priest shall bring her near and make her stand before YHWH.
And the priest shall take holy water in an earthenware vessel, and from the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

And the priest shall make the woman stand before YHWH, and shall let loose the head of the woman, and put on her palms the grain offering of remembrance — it is a grain offering of jealousy — and in the hand of the priest shall be the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

And the priest shall make her swear, and shall say to the woman: If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness under your husband, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
But you, if you have turned aside under your husband, and if you have been made unclean, and a man other than your husband has given his emission in you —

then the priest shall make the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman: May YHWH make you a curse and an oath among your people, when YHWH makes your thigh fall away and your belly swell;
and this water that brings a curse shall enter your inward parts, to make the belly swell and the thigh fall away. And the woman shall say: Amen, amen.
And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll, and shall wipe them off into the water of bitterness.
And he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings a curse; and the water that brings a curse shall enter her for bitterness.
And the priest shall take from the woman's hand the grain offering of jealousy, and shall wave the grain offering before YHWH, and bring it near to the altar.
And the priest shall scoop from the grain offering its memorial portion and turn it to smoke on the altar; and afterwards he shall make the woman drink the water.

And he shall make her drink the water; and it shall be, if she has been made unclean and has acted unfaithfully an act of unfaithfulness against her husband, that the water that brings a curse shall enter her for bitterness, and her belly shall swell and her thigh shall fall away; and the woman shall become a curse in the midst of her people.
And if the woman has not been made unclean, and she is clean, then she shall be free, and she shall be sown with seed.
This is the law for jealousy, when a wife turns aside under her husband and is made unclean,
or a man over whom a spirit of jealousy passes and he is jealous of his wife: he shall make the woman stand before YHWH, and the priest shall do to her all this law.
And the man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.

numbers_6.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: A man or a woman, when he makes a special vow, the vow of a nazirite, to live as a nazirite to YHWH,

he shall keep himself separate from wine and strong drink; vinegar of wine and vinegar of strong drink he shall not drink, and any infusion of grapes he shall not drink, and grapes fresh or dried he shall not eat.
All the days of his consecration he shall not eat anything made from the grapevine, from the seeds and to the skin.

All the days of the vow of his consecration a razor shall not pass over his head. Until the days are completed for which he lives as a nazirite to YHWH he shall be holy, letting the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
All the days of his living as a nazirite to YHWH he shall not come near a dead person.
For his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, he shall not make himself unclean for them at their death, because the consecration of his God is on his head.
All the days of his consecration he is holy to YHWH.

And if someone dies beside him in an instant, suddenly, and he makes unclean the head of his consecration, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

And the priest shall offer one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering, and shall make atonement for him because he sinned regarding the dead person; and he shall set apart as holy his head on that day.

And he shall live as a nazirite to YHWH the days of his consecration, and shall bring a lamb, the son of its year, for a guilt offering; and the former days shall fall, because his consecration became unclean.
And this is the law for the nazirite: on the day the days of his consecration are completed, he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting;

And he shall bring near his offering to YHWH: one lamb, the son of its year, unblemished, for a burnt offering; and one ewe lamb, the daughter of its year, unblemished, for a sin offering; and one ram, unblemished, for peace offerings;
and a basket of unleavened bread — fine flour, loaves mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread smeared with oil — and their grain offering and their drink offerings.
And the priest shall bring them near before YHWH, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
And the ram he shall offer as a sacrifice of peace offering to YHWH, together with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall offer its grain offering and its drink offering.

And the nazirite shall shave the head of his consecration at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his consecration and put it on the fire that is under the sacrifice of peace offering.

And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, and one loaf of unleavened bread from the basket, and one wafer of unleavened bread, and shall put them on the palms of the nazirite after he has shaved his consecration.

And the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before YHWH. It is holy for the priest, along with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution. And afterwards the nazirite may drink wine.

This is the law for the nazirite who vows: his offering to YHWH for his consecration, apart from what his hand reaches. According to the mouth of his vow that he vows, so he shall do, according to the law for his consecration.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: Thus you shall bless the sons of Israel. Say to them:
May YHWH bless you and keep you.
May YHWH make his face shine towards you and show you favour.
May YHWH lift up his face towards you and set peace for you.
And they shall put my name on the sons of Israel, and I will bless them.

numbers_7.t: And it was, on the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, that he anointed it and set it apart as holy, and all its articles, and the altar and all its articles; and he anointed them and set them apart as holy.
And the leaders of Israel brought near, the heads of the house of their fathers — they are the leaders of the tribes, they are the ones who stood over those enrolled —
And they brought their offering before YHWH: six covered carts and twelve oxen — a cart for two of the leaders, and an ox for each — and they brought them near before the tabernacle.
And YHWH said to Moses:
Take them from them, and they shall be for serving the service of the tent of meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, each according to the mouth of his service.
And Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
Two of the carts and four of the oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to the mouth of their service.
And four of the carts and eight of the oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to the mouth of their service, in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
And to the sons of Kohath he did not give, because the service of the holy things was on them; on the shoulder they carried.
And the leaders brought near the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed; and the leaders brought their offering near before the altar.
And YHWH said to Moses: One leader for the day, one leader for the day, they shall bring near their offering for the dedication of the altar.
And the one bringing near his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.

And his offering was one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, brought near.

He brought near his offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Nethanel son of Zuar.
On the third day: the leader of the sons of Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Eliab son of Helon.
On the fourth day: the leader of the sons of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Elizur son of Shedeur.
On the fifth day: the leader of the sons of Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
On the sixth day: the leader of the sons of Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Eliasaph son of Deuel.
On the seventh day: the leader of the sons of Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Elishama son of Ammihud.
On the eighth day: the leader of the sons of Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
On the ninth day: the leader of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
On the tenth day: the leader of the sons of Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
On the eleventh day: the leader of the sons of Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Pagiel son of Ocran.
On the twelfth day: the leader of the sons of Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.

His offering: one dish of silver, thirty and a hundred its weight; one basin, silver, seventy shekels by the shekel of the holy place, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
one pan, ten, gold, full of incense;
one bull, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, the son of its year, for a burnt offering;
one male goat of the goats for a sin offering;
and for the sacrifice of peace offering: two of the herd, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
This was the dedication of the altar, on the day it was anointed, from the leaders of Israel: twelve dishes of silver, twelve basins of silver, twelve pans of gold.
A hundred and thirty the one dish, silver, and seventy the one basin; all the silver of the articles was two thousand and four hundred by the shekel of the holy place.
Twelve pans of gold, full of incense, ten, ten the pan, by the shekel of the holy place; all the gold of the pans was twenty and a hundred.
All the cattle for the burnt offering: twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve lambs, sons of a year, with their grain offering; and twelve male goats of the goats for a sin offering.
And all the cattle of the sacrifice of peace offering: twenty and four bulls, sixty rams, sixty he-goats, sixty lambs, sons of a year. This was the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

numbers_8.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you set up the lamps, towards the front of the lampstand the seven lamps shall give light.
And Aaron did so; towards the front of the lampstand he set up its lamps, just as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And this was the work of the lampstand: hammered work of gold, from its base to its blossom it was hammered work — according to the appearance that YHWH had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.
And thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle on them water of purification from sin, and they shall pass a razor over all their flesh and wash their clothes and cleanse themselves.
And they shall take a bull, a son of the herd, and its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and a second bull, a son of the herd, you shall take for a sin offering.
And you shall bring the Levites near before the tent of meeting, and assemble all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
And you shall bring the Levites near before YHWH, and the sons of Israel shall lean their hands on the Levites.
And Aaron shall wave the Levites as a wave offering before YHWH, from the sons of Israel; and they shall be for serving the service of YHWH.
And the Levites shall lean their hands on the head of the bulls; and offer the one as a sin offering and the one as a burnt offering to YHWH, to make atonement for the Levites.
And you shall make the Levites stand before Aaron and before his sons, and wave them as a wave offering to YHWH.
And you shall separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
And after that the Levites shall come to serve the tent of meeting; and you shall cleanse them and wave them as a wave offering.
For given, given they are to me from among the sons of Israel; in place of the opening of every womb, the firstborn of all from the sons of Israel, I have taken them for myself.
For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is mine, among humankind and among the livestock. On the day I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt I set them apart as holy for myself.
And I have taken the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.

And I have given the Levites as given ones to Aaron and to his sons from among the sons of Israel, to serve the service of the sons of Israel in the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the sons of Israel, so that there shall be no plague among the sons of Israel when the sons of Israel draw near to the holy place.
And Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses concerning the Levites; so the sons of Israel did to them.
And the Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes; and Aaron waved them as a wave offering before YHWH, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
And after that the Levites came to serve their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and before his sons; just as YHWH had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
This is what belongs to the Levites: from a son of five and twenty years and upward he shall come to serve service in the service of the tent of meeting;
and from a son of fifty years he shall turn back from the host of the service and shall serve no more.
And he shall minister with his brothers in the tent of meeting, keeping the charge, but service he shall not serve. Thus you shall do to the Levites in their charges.

numbers_9.t: And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year of their going out from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying:
And let the sons of Israel keep the Passover at its appointed time.
On the fourteenth day in this month, between the two evenings, you shall keep it at its appointed time; according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances you shall keep it.
And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to keep the Passover.

And they kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the two evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai; according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
And there were men who were unclean by the corpse of a person and could not keep the Passover on that day; and they drew near before Moses and before Aaron on that day.
And those men said to him: We are unclean by the corpse of a person. Why should we be held back from bringing near the offering of YHWH at its appointed time among the sons of Israel?
And Moses said to them: Stand, and let me hear what YHWH will command concerning you.
And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: A man, a man, when he is unclean by a corpse or on a distant journey — for you or for your generations — he shall still keep a Passover to YHWH.
In the second month, on the fourteenth day, between the two evenings, they shall keep it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
They shall not leave any of it until morning, and a bone they shall not break in it; according to every statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

And the man who is clean and was not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover — that person shall be cut off from his kin, because he did not bring near the offering of YHWH at its appointed time. That man shall bear his sin.

And when a sojourner sojourns with you and would keep a Passover to YHWH, according to the statute of the Passover and according to its ordinance, so he shall do. One statute shall be for you, and for the sojourner and for the native of the land.
And on the day the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony; and in the evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.
So it was continually: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
And according to the taking up of the cloud from over the tent, after that the sons of Israel would set out; and in the place where the cloud settled, there the sons of Israel would encamp.
At the mouth of YHWH the sons of Israel would set out, and at the mouth of YHWH they would encamp; all the days that the cloud settled over the tabernacle they would encamp.
And when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle many days, the sons of Israel kept the charge of YHWH and would not set out.
And there were times when the cloud was a number of days over the tabernacle: at the mouth of YHWH they would encamp, and at the mouth of YHWH they would set out.
And there were times when the cloud was from evening until morning, and the cloud was taken up in the morning and they set out; or by day and by night, and the cloud was taken up and they set out.
