To acquire wisdom — how much better than fine gold! And to acquire understanding is to be chosen above silver.
The highway of the upright is to turn aside from evil; one who guards his way keeps his life.
Before breaking, pride; and before stumbling, haughtiness of spirit.
Better to be lowly of spirit with the humble than to divide plunder with the proud.
One who gives attention to a word will find good, and how blessed is one who trusts in YHWH!
One wise of heart will be called discerning, and sweetness of lips increases learning.
Insight is a fountain of life to those who have it, but the discipline of fools is folly.
The heart of the wise gives insight to his mouth and on his lips increases learning.
Sayings of kindness are a honeycomb — sweet to the being and healing to the bones.
There is a way that is right before a person, but its end is the ways of death.
The appetite of a labourer labours for him, for his mouth presses him on.
A worthless person digs up evil, and on his lip is a scorching fire.
A person of perversity sends out strife, and a slanderer separates a close companion.
A man of violence entices his neighbour and leads him in a way that is not good.
One who shuts his eyes to devise perversity, one who purses his lips — he has accomplished evil.
Grey hair is a crown of splendour; it is found in the way of righteousness.
Better one long of nostrils than a warrior, and one who rules his spirit than one who captures a city.
The lot is cast into the lap, but every decision of it is from YHWH.

proverbs_17.t: Better a dry morsel with quietness in it than a house full of sacrifices with strife.
A servant who acts with insight will rule over a son who acts shamefully, and among brothers he will share the inheritance.
A crucible is for silver and a furnace for gold, but YHWH tests hearts.
An evildoer pays attention to a lip of wickedness; falsehood gives ear to a tongue of destruction.
One who mocks the poor reproaches his Maker; one glad at calamity will not go unpunished.
The crown of the old is children's children, and the splendour of children is their parents.
A lip of excess is not fitting for a boor — how much less a lip of falsehood for a noble!
A bribe is a stone of favour in the eyes of its owner; wherever he turns, he prospers.
One who conceals a transgression seeks love, but one who repeats a matter separates a close companion.
A rebuke goes deeper into one who understands than a hundred blows into a dullard.
An evil person seeks only rebellion, and a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
Let a person meet a bear robbed of her cubs rather than a dullard in his folly.
One who returns evil for good — evil will not depart from his house.
Letting out water is the beginning of strife; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.
One who justifies the wicked and one who condemns the righteous — both of them alike are an abomination to YHWH.
Why is there a price in a dullard's hand to acquire wisdom, and there is no heart?
A friend loves at every time, and a brother is born for adversity.
A person lacking heart strikes hands, pledging a pledge before his neighbour.
One who loves transgression loves contention; one who makes his entrance high seeks a breaking.
One twisted of heart does not find good, and one perverted in his tongue falls into trouble.
One who begets a dullard — it is to his grief; and the father of a boor does not rejoice.
A joyful heart makes healing good, but a stricken spirit dries up the bones.
A wicked person takes a bribe from the bosom to turn aside the paths of judgement.
Wisdom is before the face of one who understands, but the eyes of a dullard are at the end of the earth.
A dull son is a vexation to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
Also, to fine the righteous is not good, nor to strike nobles for uprightness.
One who restrains his sayings knows knowledge, and one precious of spirit is a person of discernment.
Even a fool who keeps silent is reckoned wise; one who shuts his lips, discerning.

proverbs_18.t: One who separates himself seeks his own desire; against all sound sense he bursts out.
A dullard does not delight in discernment, but only in the revealing of his own heart.
When a wicked person comes, contempt comes too, and with disgrace, reproach.
The words of a person's mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a flowing wadi.
To lift the face of a wicked person is not good, nor to turn aside a righteous one in judgement.
A dullard's lips enter into strife, and his mouth calls for blows.
A dullard's mouth is his ruin, and his lips are the snare of his life.
The words of a slanderer are like delicacies, and they go down into the chambers of the belly.
Also, one who is slack in his work is a brother to a master of destruction.
The name of YHWH is a tower of strength; the righteous runs into it and is set on high.
The wealth of a rich person is his strong town, and like a high wall in his own imagination.
Before a breaking a person's heart is haughty, but before honour is humility.
One who returns a word before he has listened — it is folly to him, and ignominy.
A person's spirit will sustain his sickness, but a stricken spirit — who can bear it?
A discerning heart acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
A person's gift makes room for him and leads him before the great.
The first in his case is righteous, but his neighbour comes and examines him.
The lot puts an end to contentions and separates between the mighty.
A brother transgressed against is harder than a strong town, and contentions are like the bar of a fortress.
From the fruit of a person's mouth his belly is satisfied; with the produce of his lips he is satisfied.
Death and life are in the hand of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
One who finds a wife finds good and obtains favour from YHWH.
A poor person speaks supplications, but a rich one answers with strong words.
A person of companions is one to be broken, but there is a friend who clings closer than a brother.

proverbs_19.t: Better a poor person who walks in his integrity than one perverse of lips, and he is a dullard.
Also, a person without knowledge is not good, and one who hurries with his feet misses the way.
A person's folly subverts his way, and his heart rages against YHWH.
Wealth adds many friends, but a poor person is separated from his friend.
A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who breathes out lies will not escape.
Many entreat the face of a noble, and everyone is friend to a person of gifts.
All a poor person's brothers hate him — how much more do his friends keep far from him! One who pursues sayings — to him they [are].
One who acquires heart loves his own being; one who keeps discernment will find good.
A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who breathes out lies will perish.
Luxury is not fitting for a dullard — how much less for a servant to rule over princes!
A person's insight makes his anger long, and his splendour is to pass over a transgression.
A king's rage is a roaring like a young lion, but his favour is like dew on grass.
A dull son is destruction to his father, and a wife's contentions are a continual dripping.
House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from YHWH.
Laziness makes deep sleep fall, and a slack person will go hungry.
One who keeps a commandment keeps his life; one who despises his ways will die.
One who shows favour to the poor lends to YHWH, and he will repay him his recompense.
Discipline your son, for there is hope, and do not lift up your desire to putting him to death.
One great of rage bears a penalty; for if you rescue him, you will do it again.
Listen to counsel and accept discipline, so that you may become wise in your end.
Many are the plans in a person's heart, but the counsel of YHWH — it will stand.
A person's desire is his steadfast love, and better a poor person than a man of falsehood.
The fear of YHWH is to life; and one rests satisfied, not visited by harm.
A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
Strike a mocker and the naive will become shrewd; reprove one who is discerning and he will understand knowledge.
One who assaults a father, who drives out a mother, is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
Cease, my son, to listen to discipline, to stray from the sayings of knowledge.
A worthless witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked swallows wickedness.
Judgements are prepared for mockers, and blows for the back of dullards.

proverbs_20.t: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is boisterous, and no one who staggers in it is wise.
A king's terror is a roaring like a young lion; one who infuriates him misses his own life.
It is honour for a person to cease from strife, but every fool bursts out.
From winter the sluggard does not plough; he asks at harvest and there is nothing.
Counsel in a person's heart is deep waters, but a person of discernment draws it out.
Many a person proclaims his own loyalty, but a faithful person — who can find?
A righteous person goes about in his integrity — how blessed are his children after him!
A king sitting on the throne of judgement winnows all evil with his eyes.
Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am pure from my sin"?
A weight and a weight, a measure and a measure — both of them alike are an abomination to YHWH.
Even a youth makes himself known by his deeds, whether his activity is pure and whether it is upright.
An ear that hears and an eye that sees — YHWH has made both of them alike.
Do not love sleep, lest you become poor; open your eyes and be satisfied with food.
"Bad, bad," says the buyer; and going away, then he boasts.
There is gold and an abundance of corals, but lips of knowledge are a precious article.
Take his garment, for he has stood surety for a stranger, and for a foreign woman hold him in pledge.
Bread of falsehood is sweet to a person, but afterwards his mouth will be filled with gravel.
Plans are established by counsel; and make war by guidance.
One who goes about as a talebearer uncovers a confidence; so do not get involved with one who opens his lips.
One who curses his father and his mother — his lamp will be put out in the deep of darkness.
An inheritance gained hastily at first — its end will not be blessed.
Do not say, "I will repay evil"; wait for YHWH, and he will deliver you.
A weight and a weight are an abomination to YHWH, and scales of deceit are not good.
A man's steps are from YHWH; and a person — how can he understand his own way?
It is a snare for a person to say rashly, "Holy!" and after vows to reconsider.
A wise king winnows the wicked and brings the wheel back over them.
The breath of a human is the lamp of YHWH, searching all the chambers of the belly.
Loyalty and faithfulness preserve a king, and he sustains his throne by loyalty.
The splendour of young men is their strength, and the honour of the old is grey hair.
Wounds that bruise are a scouring for evil, and blows the chambers of the belly.

proverbs_21.t: A king's heart is streams of water in YHWH's hand; he turns it wherever he desires.
Every way of a person is upright in his own eyes, but YHWH weighs hearts.
To do righteousness and justice is chosen by YHWH above sacrifice.
Haughtiness of eyes and arrogance of heart — the lamp of the wicked is sin.
The plans of the diligent are only to advantage, but everyone hasty is only to want.
The getting of treasures by a tongue of falsehood is a driven vapour, seekers of death.
The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do justice.
The way of a guilty person is crooked, but the pure — his work is upright.
Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with a contentious wife in a shared house.
The appetite of a wicked person craves evil; his neighbour finds no favour in his eyes.
When a mocker is fined, the naive becomes wise; and when a wise person is given insight, he receives knowledge.
The Righteous One gives attention to the house of the wicked, subverting the wicked to calamity.
One who shuts his ear to the cry of the poor — he also will call out and not be answered.
A gift in secret subdues anger, and a bribe in the bosom, strong rage.
Doing justice is a joy to the righteous, but ruin to those who do wickedness.
A person who wanders from the way of insight will rest in the assembly of the shades.
One who loves pleasure will be a person of want; one who loves wine and oil will not grow rich.
The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and the treacherous in place of the upright.
Better to dwell in a wilderness land than with a contentious and vexing wife.
Desirable treasure and oil are in the dwelling of the wise, but a dull person swallows it up.
One who pursues righteousness and loyalty finds life, righteousness and honour.
A wise person goes up against a city of warriors and brings down the strength it trusted in.
One who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his being from troubles.
Proud, arrogant — "Mocker" is his name, one who acts in the overflow of pride.
The desire of a sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to work.
All the day he craves a craving, but the righteous gives and does not keep back.
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination — how much more when he brings it with depravity!
A witness of lies will perish, but a person who listens will speak for ever.
A wicked person makes his face bold, but an upright one — he considers his way.
There is no wisdom, no discernment and no counsel over against YHWH.
A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but the deliverance is YHWH's.

proverbs_22.t: A name is to be chosen above great wealth, and good favour above silver and gold.
The rich and the poor meet together; YHWH is the maker of them all.
A shrewd person sees trouble and hides himself, but the naive pass on and are punished.
The consequence of humility is the fear of YHWH, wealth and honour and life.
Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; one who guards his being keeps far from them.
Train a youth according to his way; even when he grows old he will not turn aside from it.
A rich person rules over the poor, and a borrower is servant to a lender.
One who sows unrighteousness will reap trouble, and the rod of his fury will come to an end.
One good of eye — he will be blessed, for he gives of his bread to the poor.
Drive out a mocker and strife will go out; dispute and disgrace will cease.
One who loves purity of heart — the grace of his lips, a king is his friend.
The eyes of YHWH preserve knowledge, but he subverts the words of the treacherous.
The sluggard says, "A lion is in the street! I shall be murdered in the midst of the open squares!"
The mouth of strange women is a deep pit; one cursed by YHWH will fall there.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a youth; a rod of discipline will drive it far from him.
One who oppresses the poor to increase for himself, one who gives to the rich — only to want.
The Words of the Wise Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise, and set your heart to my knowledge;
for it is pleasant that you keep them within you; let them be ready together on your lips.
so that your trust may be in YHWH, I have made it known to you today — even to you.
Have I not written for you thirty [things], with counsels and knowledge,
to make known to you the truth of sayings of faithfulness, to bring back sayings of faithfulness to those who send you?
Do not rob the poor because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
for YHWH will conduct their case and will rob of life those who rob them.
Do not associate with a master of anger, and do not go with a person of rages,
lest you learn his ways and take a snare for your being.
Do not be among those who strike hands, among those who stand surety for debts.
If you have nothing to pay, why should he take your bed from under you?
Do not displace an ancient boundary which your ancestors made.
Do you see a person skilled in his work? He will take his stand before kings; he will not take his stand before insignificant people.

proverbs_23.t: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, consider carefully what is before you,
and put a knife to your throat if you are a master of appetite.
Do not crave his dainties, for it is food of lies.
Do not labour to grow rich; cease from your own understanding.
Will you let your eyes fly upon it, and it is gone? For it surely makes itself wings, like an eagle it flies away to the heavens.
Do not eat the food of one evil of eye, and do not crave his dainties,
for as he calculates within himself, so is he. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
The morsel you have eaten you will vomit up, and you will have spoiled your pleasant words.
Do not speak in the ears of a dullard, for he will despise the insight of your words.
Do not displace an ancient boundary, and do not enter the fields of the fatherless,
for their Redeemer is strong; he will conduct their case against you.
Bring your heart to discipline and your ears to sayings of knowledge.
Do not withhold discipline from a youth; if you strike him with the rod he will not die.
You will strike him with the rod and deliver his life from Sheol.
My son, if your heart is wise, my heart will rejoice — mine also;
and my kidneys will exult when your lips speak what is upright.
Do not let your heart be jealous of sinners, but only in the fear of YHWH all the day;
for surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
Listen, you, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart in the way.
Do not be among those who drink wine deep, among gluttons of meat for themselves;
for a deep drinker and a glutton will become poor, and drowsiness will clothe one in rags.
Listen to your father who begot you, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
Buy truth and do not sell it — wisdom and discipline and understanding.
The father of a righteous son will greatly rejoice, and one who begets a wise son will rejoice in him.
Let your father and your mother rejoice, and let her who bore you be glad.
Give me your heart, my son, and let your eyes observe my ways.
For a prostitute is a deep pit, and a foreign woman a narrow well.
She also lies in wait like a robber and increases the treacherous among humankind.
Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaint? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?
Those who linger over wine, those who go to search out mixed wine.
Do not look at wine when it is red, when it gives its eye in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
In its end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
Your eyes will see strange things, and your heart will speak perversity.
And you will be like one lying down in the heart of the sea, like one lying down at the top of a mast.
"They struck me — I was not sick; they beat me — I did not know. When shall I awake? I will seek it again."

proverbs_24.t: Do not be jealous of evil people, and do not desire to be with them,
for their heart plots violence, and their lips speak trouble.
By wisdom a house is built, and by discernment it is established;
and by knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant wealth.
A wise man is in strength, and a person of knowledge makes strength firm.
For by guidance you will make war for yourself, and deliverance is in a multitude of counsellors.
Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the gate he does not open his mouth.
One who plans to do evil — people will call him a master of schemes.
The scheming of folly is sin, and a mocker is an abomination to humankind.
If you show yourself slack in the day of trouble, your strength is narrow.
Deliver those taken to death, and those staggering to the slaughter — if you hold back!
If you say, "Here, we did not know this" — does not the one who weighs hearts perceive? And the one who guards your being, does he not know? And he will repay a person according to his work.
Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet on your palate.
So know wisdom for your being: if you find it, then there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
Do not lie in wait, wicked one, against the dwelling of the righteous; do not devastate his resting place,
for a righteous person falls seven times and rises, but the wicked stumble in calamity.
When your enemy falls, do not rejoice, and when he stumbles, do not let your heart be glad,
lest YHWH see and it be evil in his eyes, and he turn back his anger from him.
Do not fret yourself over evildoers; do not be jealous of the wicked,
for there will be no future for the evil person; the lamp of the wicked will be put out.
Fear YHWH, my son, and the king; do not get involved with those who change,
for their calamity will arise suddenly, and the disaster of them both — who knows?
These also are of the wise. To pay regard to faces in judgement is not good.
One who says to the wicked, "You are righteous" — peoples will curse him, nations will denounce him.
But for those who reprove, it will be pleasant, and a blessing of good will come upon them.
He kisses the lips who brings back right words.
Establish your work outside and make it ready in the field for yourself; afterwards you shall build your house.
Do not be a witness without cause against your neighbour, and would you deceive with your lips?
Do not say, "As he has done to me, so I will do to him; I will repay a person according to his work."
I passed by the field of a lazy person and by the vineyard of a person lacking heart,
and here, it had all grown up with thorns; its surface was covered with nettles, and its wall of stones was broken down.
And I looked, I myself; I set my heart; I saw, I received instruction.
A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down —
and your poverty will come going about, and your wants like a man with a shield.

proverbs_25.t: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
The glory of God is to conceal a matter, and the glory of kings to search out a matter.
The heavens for height and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings — there is no searching out.
Remove the dross from silver, and a vessel comes out for the metalworker.
Remove the wicked from before a king, and his throne is established in righteousness.
Do not claim honour before a king, and do not stand in the place of the great;
for it is better that he say to you, "Come up here," than that you be put lower before a noble whom your eyes have seen.
Do not go out to contend quickly, lest — what will you do at its end, when your neighbour puts you to shame?
Conduct your case with your neighbour, and do not reveal the confidence of another;
lest one who hears bring shame on you, and your ill report not turn back.
Apples of gold in settings of silver — a word spoken in its right time.
A ring of gold and an ornament of fine gold — a wise reprover on a listening ear.
Like the cold of snow in the day of harvest is a faithful envoy to those who send him: he restores the life of his masters.
Clouds and wind, and there is no rain — a person who boasts of a gift of falsehood.
By length of nostrils a ruler is persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks a bone.
Have you found honey? Eat your sufficiency, lest you be surfeited with it and vomit it up.
Make your foot rare in your neighbour's house, lest he be surfeited with you and hate you.
A war-club and a sword and a sharpened arrow — a person who testifies against his neighbour as a false witness.
A broken tooth and a slipping foot — the trust of one who acts treacherously in the day of trouble.
One who removes a garment on a cold day, vinegar on soda — and one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
for you will be snatching up burning coals on his head, and YHWH will repay you.
A north wind brings forth rain, and a tongue of secrecy, indignant faces.
Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with a contentious wife in a shared house.
Cool water on a weary being — and a good report from a distant land.
A fouled spring and a ruined fountain — a righteous person who sways before a wicked one.
To eat much honey is not good, and the searching out of their own glory is glory.
A city broken into, without a wall — a person who has no control over his spirit.

proverbs_26.t: Like snow in summer and like rain at harvest, so honour is not fitting for a dullard.
Like a bird for fluttering, like a swallow for flying, so a curse without cause does not come.
A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of dullards.
Do not answer a dullard according to his folly, lest you also become like him.
Answer a dullard according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
One who cuts off feet, one who drinks violence — the sender of words by the hand of a dullard.
The legs of a lame person hang limp — and a proverb in the mouth of dullards.
Like binding a stone in a sling, so is one who gives honour to a dullard.
A thorn goes up in the hand of a drunkard — and a proverb in the mouth of dullards.
An archer who wounds everyone — and one who hires a dullard, and one who hires those passing by.
Like a dog returning to its own vomit, a dullard repeating his folly.
Do you see a person wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a dullard than for him.
The sluggard says, "A lion is in the road! A lion is among the open squares!"
A door turns on its hinge, and a sluggard on his bed.
A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too weary to bring it back to his mouth.
A sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven who answer with discernment.
One who takes hold of a dog's ears — a passer-by who enrages himself over a dispute not his own.
Like a madman who shoots firebrands, arrows and death,
so is a person who deceives his neighbour and says, "Was I not jesting?"
Without wood a fire goes out, and without a slanderer strife falls quiet.
Charcoal to burning coals and wood to fire, and a contentious person to kindle strife.
The words of a slanderer are like delicacies, and they go down into the chambers of the belly.
Silver of dross overlaid on earthenware — burning lips and an evil heart.
With his lips one who hates disguises himself, and within himself he sets deceit.
When he makes his voice gracious, do not trust him, for seven abominations are in his heart.
Hatred covers itself with deception; his wickedness will be revealed in the assembly.
One who digs a pit will fall into it, and one who rolls a stone — it will return upon him.
A lying tongue hates those it crushes, and a smooth mouth works ruin.

proverbs_27.t: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day will bring forth.
Let a stranger praise you, and not your own mouth; a foreigner, and not your own lips.
The heaviness of a stone and the weight of sand — but a fool's provocation is heavier than both.
The cruelty of rage and the flood of anger — but who can stand before jealousy?
Better an uncovered reproof than a hidden love.
The wounds of one who loves are faithful, but the kisses of one who hates are profuse.
A satisfied appetite tramples on honeycomb, but to a hungry appetite every bitter thing is sweet.
Like a bird wandering from its nest, so is a person wandering from his place.
Oil and perfume make the heart glad, and the sweetness of one's friend more than the counsel of a person.
Do not forsake your own friend and your father's friend, and do not go to your brother's house in the day of your calamity. Better a near neighbour than a far-off brother.
Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, so that I may bring back a word to one who taunts me.
A shrewd person sees trouble and hides himself; the naive pass on, they are punished.
Take his garment, for he has stood surety for a stranger, and for a foreign woman hold him in pledge.
One who blesses his neighbour with a loud voice, rising early in the morning — it is reckoned to him as a curse.
A continual dripping on a day of steady rain and a contentious wife are alike.
Those who would hide her hide the wind, and his right hand meets oil.
Iron sharpens iron, and a person sharpens the face of his friend.
One who keeps a fig tree will eat its fruit, and one who guards his master will be honoured.
As water is face to face, so is the heart of a person to a person.
Sheol and Abaddon are not satisfied, and the eyes of a person are not satisfied.
A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, and a person according to his praise.
Though you pound the fool in a mortar, among the grain with a pestle, his folly will not depart from him.
Know well the face of your flock; set your heart to the herds.
For wealth is not for ever, nor a crown to generation and generation.
The grass disappears and new growth appears, and the vegetation of the mountains is gathered in.
The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats the price of a field.
and enough goats' milk for your food, for the food of your household, and life for your young women.

proverbs_28.t: The wicked flee with no one pursuing, but the righteous are confident like a young lion.
By the transgression of a land its princes are many, but by a person of understanding, of knowledge, it lasts long.
A poor man who oppresses the poor — a sweeping rain, and there is no food.
Those who forsake law praise the wicked, but those who keep law contend with them.
People of evil do not understand justice, but those who seek YHWH understand everything.
Better a poor person who walks in his integrity than one perverse of two ways, and he is rich.
One who keeps law is a son of understanding, but one who associates with gluttons shames his father.
One who increases his wealth by interest and usury gathers it for one who shows favour to the poor.
One who turns his ear from hearing law — even his prayer is an abomination.
One who leads the upright astray in an evil way will himself fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit good.
A rich person is wise in his own eyes, but a poor one who has understanding sees through him.
When the righteous rejoice there is great glory, but when the wicked arise, a person is searched for.
One who conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but one who confesses and forsakes them will be shown mercy.
How blessed is a person who fears continually, but one who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.
A roaring lion and a charging bear — a wicked ruler over a poor people.
A ruler lacking in discernment is great in extortions, but one who hates unjust gain will prolong his days.
A person weighed down by the blood of a life will flee to the pit; let no one support him.
One who walks blameless will be delivered, but one crooked of two ways will fall at once.
One who tills his ground will be satisfied with food, but one who pursues empty things will be satisfied with poverty.
A person of faithfulness will abound in blessings, but one who hastens to grow rich will not go unpunished.
To pay regard to faces is not good, and for a piece of bread a man will transgress.
A person evil of eye hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty will come upon him.
One who reproves a person after me will find more favour than one who makes the tongue smooth.
One who robs his father and his mother and says, "There is no transgression" — he is a companion to a person who destroys.
One arrogant of being stirs up strife, but one who relies on YHWH will be made fat.
One who trusts in his own heart is a dullard, but one who walks in wisdom will escape.
One who gives to the poor will have no lack, but one who hides his eyes will have many curses.
When the wicked arise, a person hides himself, but when they perish, the righteous increase.

proverbs_29.t: A person of reproofs who hardens his neck will suddenly be broken, and there will be no healing.
When the righteous increase, the people rejoice, but when a wicked person rules, a people sighs.
A person who loves wisdom makes his father glad, but one who associates with prostitutes destroys wealth.
A king by justice establishes a land, but a person of contributions tears it down.
A man who flatters his neighbour spreads a net for his footsteps.
In the transgression of an evil person is a snare, but the righteous cries aloud and rejoices.
A righteous person knows the case of the poor; a wicked one does not understand knowledge.
People of mockery inflame a town, but the wise turn away anger.
A wise person who enters into judgement with a fool — he rages and he laughs, and there is no quiet.
People of blood hate the blameless, and the upright seek his life.
A dullard sends out all his spirit, but a wise person keeps it back within.
A ruler who pays attention to a word of falsehood — all his servants are wicked.
A poor person and a person of oppressions meet together; YHWH gives light to the eyes of them both.
A king who judges the poor in truth — his throne will be established for ever.
A rod and reproof give wisdom, but a youth let loose shames his mother.
When the wicked increase, transgression increases, but the righteous will look on their downfall.
Discipline your son and he will give you rest, and he will give delights to your being.
Where there is no vision, a people is let loose, but how blessed is one who keeps law!
By words a servant is not disciplined, for he understands and there is no answer.
Do you see a person hasty in his words? There is more hope for a dullard than for him.
One who pampers his servant from youth — in the end he will be an heir.
A person of anger stirs up strife, and a master of rage is great in transgression.
A person's pride will bring him low, but one lowly of spirit will attain honour.
One who shares with a thief hates his own life; he hears the oath and does not tell.
The trembling of a person gives a snare, but one who trusts in YHWH will be set on high.
Many seek the face of a ruler, but a person's justice is from YHWH.
A person of injustice is an abomination to the righteous, and one upright of way is an abomination to the wicked.

proverbs_30.t: The words of Agur son of Jakeh. The oracle. The declaration of the man to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ukal.
For I am a brute, more than anyone, and the understanding of a person is not mine.
And I have not learned wisdom, but I know the knowledge of the holy ones.

Who has gone up to the heavens and come down? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has wrapped the waters in a cloak? Who has set up all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son's name, if you know?
Every speech of God is refined; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
Do not add to his words, lest he reprove you and you be proved a liar.
Two things I ask of you; do not withhold them from me before I die:
Put deceitfulness and a word of falsehood far from me; give me neither poverty nor wealth; let me devour the food of my allotment,
lest I be sated and deny, and say, "Who is YHWH?"; and lest I become poor and steal, and seize the name of my God.
Do not slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you and you be held guilty.
A generation that curses its father and does not bless its mother;
a generation pure in its own eyes and not washed from its filth;
a generation — how raised are its eyes, and its eyelids are lifted up;
a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaw-teeth are knives, to devour the afflicted from the earth and the needy from among humankind.
The leech has two daughters: "Give! Give!" Three things there are that are not satisfied, four that do not say "Enough":
Sheol, and a barren womb; land not satisfied with water, and fire, which does not say "Enough".
An eye that mocks a father and despises obedience to a mother — the ravens of the wadi will pluck it out, and the young of an eagle will eat it.
Three things there are that are too wonderful for me, and four that I do not know:
the way of an eagle in the heavens, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship in the heart of the sea, and the way of a man with a young woman.
Such is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth and says, "I have done no wickedness."
Under three things the earth quakes, and under four it cannot bear up:
under a servant when he becomes king, and a boor when he is filled with food;
under a hated woman when she is married, and a female servant when she dispossesses her mistress.
Four things there are, small on the earth, and they are wise, made wise:
the ants, a people not strong, yet they prepare their food in the summer;
rock badgers, a people not mighty, yet they make their home in the rock;
the locust has no king, yet it goes out, all of it in ranks;
the lizard you can grasp in your hands, yet it is in the palaces of a king.
Three things there are that step out well, and four that walk well:
a lion, mighty among the animals, which does not turn back before anything;
a strutting cock, or a he-goat, and a king whose army is with him.
If you have been foolish in exalting yourself, and if you have plotted — hand to mouth!
For the pressing of milk brings forth butter, and the pressing of the nose brings forth blood, and the pressing of anger brings forth strife.

proverbs_31.t: The words of Lemuel the king. An oracle, with which his mother instructed him.
What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?
Do not give your strength to women, or your ways to those who wipe out kings.
Not for kings, Lemuel, not for kings to drink wine, nor for rulers to crave strong drink;
lest he drink and forget what is decreed, and change the cause of all the sons of affliction.
Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to those bitter of being;
let him drink and forget his poverty, and remember his trouble no more.
Open your mouth for the dumb, for the cause of all the sons of passing away.
Open your mouth, judge righteousness, and plead the cause of the afflicted and the needy.
A wife of ability — who can find? Her price is far beyond corals.
The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks no gain.
She deals him good and not evil all the days of her life.
She seeks wool and flax and works with the delight of her hands.
She is like the ships of a trader; from far off she brings her food.
She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household, and an allotted portion to her young women.
She considers a field and takes it; from the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
She girds her loins with strength and makes her arms strong.
She perceives that her profit is good; her lamp does not go out at night.
She stretches out her hands to the distaff, and her palms grasp the spindle.
She spreads out her palm to the afflicted and stretches out her hands to the needy.
She does not fear the snow for her household, for all her household is clothed in scarlet.
She makes coverings for herself; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
Her husband is known in the gates, when he sits with the elders of the land.
She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies belts to the merchants.
Strength and honour are her clothing, and she laughs at a day to come.
She opens her mouth with wisdom, and law of kindness is on her tongue.
She watches over the ways of her household and does not eat the bread of laziness.
Her sons rise up and call her blessed; her husband, and he praises her:
"Many daughters have done ably, but you have gone up above them all."
Favour is deceptive and beauty is vapour; a woman who fears YHWH — she will be praised.
Give her from the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her in the gates.

psalms_1.t: How blessed the man who has not walked in the counsel of wicked ones, and in the way of sinners has not stood, and in the seat of mockers has not sat;
but rather in the law of YHWH is his delight, and in his law he mutters day and night.
And he shall be like a tree planted by channels of water, which gives its fruit in its time, and its leafage does not wither; and all that he does prospers.
Not so the wicked; but rather they are like the chaff that wind drives away.
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgement, nor sinners [stand] in the congregation of the righteous.
For YHWH is knowing the way of the righteous, and the way of the wicked perishes.

psalms_2.t: Why are the nations in tumult, and the peoples mutter a vain thing?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and rulers have taken counsel together against YHWH and against his anointed:
'Let us tear off their bonds, and let us throw off from us their cords.'
The one sitting in the heavens laughs; the Lord mocks at them.
Then he speaks to them in his anger, and in his fury he terrifies them:
'But I, I have installed my king upon Zion, the mountain of my holiness.'
Let me recount the decree of YHWH: he said to me, 'You are my son; I, today, I have begotten you.
Ask of me, and I will give the nations as your inheritance, and your possession the ends of the earth.
You shall break them with a rod of iron; like a potter's vessel you shall shatter them.'
And now, O kings, act prudently; be disciplined, O judges of the earth.
Serve YHWH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Kiss the son, lest he be angry and you perish [in the] way, for his anger burns in a little. How blessed are all who take refuge in him.

psalms_3.t: A psalm, of David, when he fled from before Absalom his son.
YHWH, how many are my foes! Many are rising against me.
Many are saying of my being, 'There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah
But you, YHWH, are a shield about me, my glory, and the one who lifts my head.
My voice — to YHWH I call, and he answered me from the mountain of his holiness. Selah
I lay down and I slept; I awoke, for YHWH sustains me.
I will not fear from ten thousands of people who all around have set themselves against me.
Arise, YHWH! Save me, my God! For you have struck all my enemies on the jaw; the teeth of the wicked you have broken.
To YHWH belongs the salvation; upon your people be your blessing. Selah

psalms_4.t: To the overseer, with stringed instruments. A psalm, of David.
When I call, answer me, O God of my righteousness! In distress you made room for me; be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
Sons of man, how long will my glory be for disgrace? [How long] will you love a vain thing, will you seek falsehood? Selah
And know that YHWH has set apart the loyal one for himself; YHWH hears when I call to him.
Tremble, and do not sin. Say [it] in your heart upon your bed, and be silent. Selah
Sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness, and trust in YHWH.
Many are saying, 'Who will show us good?' Lift up upon us the light of your face, YHWH!
You have put gladness in my heart more than at the time their grain and their new wine abound.
In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for you, YHWH, alone make me dwell in security.

psalms_5.t: To the overseer, to the nehiloth. A psalm, of David.
Give ear to my sayings, YHWH; consider my murmuring.
Attend to the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
YHWH, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I set [my case] in order for you, and I watch.
For you are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil does not sojourn with you.
Boasters do not take their stand before your eyes; you hate all workers of wrongdoing.
You destroy those who speak falsehood; a man of bloods and deceit YHWH abhors.
But I, in the abundance of your steadfast love, will come into your house; I will bow down toward the temple of your holiness in your fear.
YHWH, lead me in your righteousness because of those who watch me; make straight your way before me.
For there is nothing reliable in his mouth; their inward part is destructions; their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak smooth things.
Hold them guilty, O God! Let them fall from their own schemes. In the abundance of their transgressions banish them, for they have rebelled against you.
But let all who take refuge in you be glad; forever let them shout for joy; and may you shelter over them, and let those who love your name exult in you.
For you bless the righteous, YHWH; like a body-shield you surround him with good pleasure.

psalms_6.t: To the overseer, with stringed instruments, upon the sheminith. A psalm, of David.
YHWH, do not in your anger reprove me, and do not in your wrath discipline me.
Be gracious to me, YHWH, for I am withered; heal me, YHWH, for my bones are dismayed.
And my being is greatly dismayed; and you, YHWH — how long?
Return, YHWH! Rescue my being! Save me for the sake of your steadfast love.
For in death there is no remembrance of you; in Sheol, who gives you thanks?
I am weary with my groaning; I make my bed swim every night; with my tears I dissolve my couch.
My eye has wasted away from vexation; it has grown old because of all my adversaries.
Turn away from me, all workers of wrongdoing, for YHWH has heard the sound of my weeping.
YHWH has heard my supplication; YHWH accepts my prayer.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly dismayed; let them turn back, let them be ashamed in a moment.

psalms_7.t: A shiggaion, of David, which he sang to YHWH concerning the words of Cush, a Benjaminite.
YHWH my God, in you I have taken refuge. Save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,
lest he tear my being like a lion, tearing apart with no one delivering.
YHWH my God, if I have done this, if there is injustice in my palms,
if I have repaid evil to the one at peace with me, or have plundered my adversary without cause —
let an enemy pursue my being and overtake it, and let him trample my life to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah
Arise, YHWH, in your anger! Raise yourself against the rages of my adversaries, and awake for me — you have commanded judgement.
And let the congregation of peoples surround you, and over it return to the height.
YHWH gives judgement to the peoples. Judge me, YHWH, according to my righteousness and according to the integrity that is upon me.
Let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and establish the righteous, you who test hearts and kidneys, righteous God.
My shield is upon God, saviour of the upright of heart.
God is a righteous judge, and a God indignant every day.
If he does not turn back, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent his bow and made it ready.
And for him he has prepared instruments of death; his arrows he makes into burning ones.
Look — he is in labour with wrongdoing; he has conceived trouble and given birth to a lie.
A pit he dug, and he hollowed it out, and he has fallen into the ditch he was making.
His trouble returns on his own head, and upon his skull his violence comes down.
I will give thanks to YHWH according to his righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of YHWH Most High.

psalms_8.t: To the overseer, upon the gittith. A psalm, of David.
YHWH our Lord, how magnificent is your name in all the earth, you who have set your splendour above the heavens!
Out of the mouth of children and sucklings you have established strength, because of your adversaries, to put an end to enemy and avenger.
When I see your heavens, the works of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you have established —
what is a human being that you remember him, and a son of humankind that you attend to him?
And you have made him lack a little from heavenly beings, and with glory and majesty you crown him.
You make him rule over the works of your hands; everything you have put under his feet:
flocks and cattle, all of them, and also the animals of the field,
the bird of the heavens and the fish of the sea, whatever passes along the paths of the seas.
YHWH our Lord, how magnificent is your name in all the earth!

psalms_9.t: To the overseer, upon muth-labben. A psalm, of David.
I will give thanks to YHWH with all my heart; I will recount all your wonders.
I will be glad and exult in you; I will make music to your name, Most High.
When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish from before you.
For you have done my judgement and my case; you have sat on a throne, judging righteousness.
You have rebuked nations, you have destroyed the wicked; their name you have wiped out forever and ever.
The enemy — they have come to an end, perpetual ruins; and cities you have uprooted; their memory has perished, they themselves.
But YHWH sits forever; he has established his throne for judgement.
And he himself will judge the world in righteousness; he will give judgement to the peoples in uprightness.
And let YHWH be a high refuge for the oppressed, a high refuge in times of distress.
And those who know your name will trust in you, for you have not forsaken those who seek you, YHWH.
Make music to YHWH who dwells in Zion; declare among the peoples his deeds.
For the one who seeks out bloods has remembered them; he has not forgotten the cry of distress of the humble.
Be gracious to me, YHWH! See my affliction from those who hate me, you who lift me up from the gates of death,
so that I may recount all your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion; let me rejoice in your salvation.
The nations have sunk in the ditch they made; in the net that they hid, their own foot has been caught.
YHWH has made himself known; he has done judgement. By the work of his own hands the wicked is snared. Higgaion. Selah
The wicked shall return to Sheol, all the nations forgetful of God.
For the needy will not be forgotten in perpetuity; the hope of the afflicted will not perish forever.
Arise, YHWH! Let not a human being prevail; let the nations be judged before your face.
Set, YHWH, terror for them; let the nations know that they are human beings. Selah

psalms_10.t: Why, YHWH, do you stand at a distance? Why do you hide in times of distress?
In the pride of the wicked he hotly pursues the afflicted; let them be caught in the schemes that they have devised.
For the wicked has boasted over the desire of his being, and the one greedy for gain has blessed — he has spurned YHWH.
The wicked, according to the height of his nose, does not seek; 'There is no God' — that is all his thoughts.
His ways endure at every time. Your judgements are on high, away from before him; all his adversaries — he snorts at them.
He says in his heart, 'I shall not be shaken; from generation to generation [I am] one who is not in evil.'
His mouth is full of cursing and deceits and oppression; under his tongue are trouble and wrongdoing.
He sits in the ambush of the villages; in the hiding places he kills the innocent; his eyes lie in wait for the hapless.
He lies in wait in the hiding place like a lion in its lair; he lies in wait to seize the afflicted; he seizes the afflicted when he drags him off in his net.
He is crushed, he is bowed down, and the hapless fall by his mighty ones.
He says in his heart, 'God has forgotten; he has hidden his face; he will never see.'
Arise, YHWH! God, lift up your hand! Do not forget the humble.
Why has the wicked spurned God? He has said in his heart, 'You will not seek it out.'
You have seen — for you yourself observe trouble and vexation, to put it in your hand. The hapless abandons himself to you; the fatherless — you have been a helper.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil one; seek out his wickedness — you will find none.
YHWH is king forever and ever; the nations have perished from his land.
The desire of the humble you have heard, YHWH; you establish their heart, you make your ear attend,
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that a human being from the earth may no longer terrify.

psalms_11.t: In YHWH I have taken refuge. How can you say to my being, 'Flee to your mountain, bird!'?
For look — the wicked bend a bow; they have set their arrow on the string, to shoot in the dark at the upright in heart.
If the foundations are torn down, the righteous — what has he done?
YHWH is in the temple of his holiness; YHWH — his throne is in the heavens. His eyes see; his eyelids test the children of humankind.
YHWH tests the righteous; but the wicked and the one who loves violence — his being hates.
He will rain snares on the wicked, fire and sulphur and a scorching wind — the portion of their cup.
For YHWH is righteous; he loves righteous deeds. The upright will see his face.

psalms_12.t: To the overseer, upon the sheminith. A psalm, of David.
Save, YHWH, for the loyal one has come to an end; for the faithful have vanished from among the children of humankind.
Emptiness they speak, each with his neighbour; with a lip of flatteries, with a heart and a heart they speak.
May YHWH cut off all the lips of flatteries, the tongue that speaks great things —
those who have said, 'By our tongue we will prevail; our lips are with us — who is master over us?'
'From the devastation of the afflicted, from the groaning of the needy, now I will arise,' says YHWH; 'I will set in safety the one who pants for it.'
The speech of YHWH is pure speech, silver refined in a crucible on the ground, purged sevenfold.
You, YHWH, will keep them; you will guard him from this generation forever.
All around the wicked walk about, when vileness is exalted among the children of humankind.

psalms_13.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
How long, YHWH? Will you forget me in perpetuity? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I set counsels in my being, sorrow in my heart by day? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
Look at me, answer me, YHWH my God! Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
lest my enemy say, 'I have prevailed over him,' and my foes rejoice when I am shaken.
But I — in your steadfast love I have trusted; let my heart rejoice in your salvation.
I will sing to YHWH, for he has dealt bountifully with me.

psalms_14.t: The fool has said in his heart, 'There is no God.' They act corruptly, they make their deeds abominable; there is no one doing good.
YHWH from the heavens looked down upon the children of humankind, to see whether there is one acting prudently, one seeking God.
Everyone has turned aside; together they are tainted; there is no one doing good, there is not even one.
Do they not know, all the workers of wrongdoing, who devour my people as they eat bread? They do not call on YHWH.
There they feared a fear, for God is with the righteous generation.
You would put to shame the counsel of the afflicted, but YHWH is his refuge.
Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When YHWH restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.

psalms_15.t: YHWH, who shall sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on the mountain of your holiness?
One walking blameless and doing righteousness, and speaking truth in his heart;
he has not gone about slandering on his tongue, he has not done evil to his neighbour, and he has not lifted a reproach against his kinsman;
despised in his eyes is the rejected one, but those who fear YHWH he honours; he has sworn to his own hurt and does not change;
his money he has not given at interest, and a bribe against the innocent he has not taken. The one doing these things shall never be shaken.

psalms_16.t: Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in you.
I said to YHWH, 'You are Lord; my good is not beyond you.'
As for the holy ones who are in the land, they — and the magnificent ones — all my delight is in them.
Their sorrows increase — they have hurried after another; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, and I will not take up their names on my lips.
YHWH is the portion of my possession and my cup; you hold my lot.
The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, an inheritance is beautiful to me.
I will bless YHWH, who has counselled me; indeed, by night my kidneys instruct me.
I have set YHWH before me continually; because he is at my right hand, I shall not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; indeed, my flesh dwells in security.
For you will not forsake my being to Sheol; you will not give your loyal one to see decay.
You will make known to me the path of life; fullness of gladness is with your face, pleasant things at your right hand in perpetuity.

psalms_17.t: Hear, YHWH, righteousness! Attend to my cry of entreaty! Give ear to my prayer — from lips without deceit.
From before you let my judgement come forth; let your eyes see uprightness.
You have tested my heart, you have visited by night, you have refined me — you will find nothing. I have resolved: my mouth shall not transgress.
As for the deeds of humankind — by the word of your lips I have kept from the paths of the violent man.
My steps have held firm in your tracks; my footsteps have not been shaken.
I have called on you, for you answer me, God; incline your ear to me, hear my speech.
Make wonderful your acts of steadfast love, saviour of those who take refuge from those who rise up, by your right hand.
Keep me like the pupil, the daughter of the eye; in the shadow of your wings hide me,
from before the wicked who have assailed me, my enemies who with the being surround me.
Their fat they have closed up; with their mouth they have spoken in pride.
Our steps — now they have surrounded us; they set their eyes to stretch out upon the ground.
His likeness is like a lion that longs to tear, and like a young lion sitting in hiding places.
Arise, YHWH! Confront his face, make him bow down! Bring my being to safety from the wicked by your sword,

from men by your hand, YHWH, from men of the world whose portion is in this life, and whose belly you fill with your treasure; they are satisfied with sons, and they leave their abundance to their children.
As for me, in righteousness I shall see your face; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with your form.

psalms_18.t: To the overseer. Of the servant of YHWH, of David, who spoke to YHWH the words of this song on the day YHWH delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
And he said: I love you, YHWH, my strength.
YHWH is my rock and my fortress and the one who brings me to safety; my God is my Rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high refuge.
I call on YHWH, who is to be praised, and from my enemies I am saved.
The cords of death encompassed me, and the torrents of worthlessness overwhelmed me.
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the traps of death confronted me.
In my distress I called on YHWH, and to my God I cried for help; he heard my voice from his temple, and my cry for help before him came into his ears.
And the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; and they shook back and forth, because he was angry.
Smoke went up in his nostrils, and fire from his mouth consumed; coals burned from him.
And he stretched out the heavens and came down, and thick darkness was under his feet.
And he rode on a cherub and flew; and he soared on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his secret place, his shelter around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
From the brightness before him his thick clouds passed on, hail and coals of fire.
And YHWH thundered in the heavens, and the Most High gave forth his voice: hail and coals of fire.
And he sent out his arrows and scattered them; he shot lightning flashes and routed them.
And the channels of water appeared, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, at your rebuke, YHWH, at the breath of the wind of your nostrils.
He stretched out from on high, he took hold of me; he drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hate me, for they were stronger than I.
They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but YHWH became a support for me.
And he brought me out to a roomy place; he rescued me, for he delighted in me.
YHWH dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the purity of my hands he repaid me.
For I have kept the ways of YHWH, and I have not acted wickedly, away from my God.
For all his judgements have been before me, and his statutes I have not turned aside from me.
And I have been blameless with him, and I have kept myself from my iniquity.
And YHWH repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.
With the faithful one you show yourself faithful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless;
with the pure you show yourself pure, and with the crooked you show yourself twisted.
For you save an afflicted people, and lofty eyes you bring low.
For you light my lamp; YHWH my God brightens my darkness.
For by you I run at a raiding band, and by my God I leap a wall.
The God — his way is blameless; the speech of YHWH is refined; he is a shield to all who take refuge in him.
For who is God apart from YHWH, and who is a Rock except our God?
The God who girds me with might, and makes my way blameless;
who makes my feet like the does, and makes me stand on my high places;
who trains my hands for battle, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
And you gave me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand supported me, and your gentleness made me great.
You enlarged my step beneath me, and my ankles did not slip.
I pursued my enemies and overtook them, and I did not turn back until they were finished.
I shattered them, and they were not able to rise; they fell under my feet.
And you girded me with might for the battle; you made those who rose against me bow down beneath me.
And my enemies — you gave me the neck; and those who hate me, I destroyed them.
They cried for help, and there was no saviour — to YHWH, and he did not answer them.
And I crushed them like dust on the face of the wind; like the mud of the streets I poured them out.
You brought me to safety from the strivings of a people; you appointed me head of nations; a people I did not know serve me.
At the hearing of an ear they obey me; sons of a foreign land cringe to me.
Sons of a foreign land wither, and they come trembling from their strongholds.
YHWH lives! And blessed be my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be exalted —
the God who gives me vengeance, and subdues peoples beneath me,
who brings me to safety from my enemies — indeed, above those who rise against me you exalt me; from a man of violence you deliver me.
Therefore I will give thanks to you among the nations, YHWH, and to your name I will make music.
Making great the salvations of his king, and doing steadfast love to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, to perpetuity.

psalms_19.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
The heavens are recounting the glory of God, and the work of his hands the vault is telling.
Day to day pours forth utterance, and night to night shows forth knowledge.
There is no utterance and there are no words; their voice is not heard.
In all the earth their line has gone out, and their words to the end of the world. For the sun he has set a tent in them;
and it is like a bridegroom coming out from his chamber; it delights like a mighty man to run a path.
From the end of the heavens is its going out, and its circuit to their ends, and nothing is hidden from its heat.
The law of YHWH is perfect, restoring the being; the testimony of YHWH is reliable, making the simple wise.
The precepts of YHWH are upright, making the heart glad; the commandment of YHWH is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The fear of YHWH is clean, standing forever; the judgements of YHWH are truth — they are righteous altogether.
They are more desirable than gold, than much pure gold, and sweeter than honey and the drippings of the combs.
Also your servant is warned by them; in keeping them there is great consequence.
Errors — who discerns them? From hidden things acquit me.
Also from presumptuous ones keep back your servant; let them not rule over me. Then I shall be blameless, and I shall be acquitted of great transgression.
Let the sayings of my mouth and the murmuring of my heart be for acceptance before you, YHWH, my Rock and my redeemer.

psalms_20.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
May YHWH answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
May he send your help from the sanctuary, and from Zion may he support you.
May he remember all your grain offerings, and your burnt offering may he accept as fat. Selah
May he give to you according to your heart, and all your counsel may he fulfil.
Let us shout for joy at your salvation, and in the name of our God let us raise a banner. May YHWH fulfil all your requests.
Now I know that YHWH saves his anointed; he answers him from the heavens of his holiness with the mighty deeds of the salvation of his right hand.
These in chariotry and these in horses, but we — in the name of YHWH our God we bring to remembrance.
They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stood upright.
YHWH, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.

psalms_21.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
YHWH, in your strength the king is glad, and in your salvation how greatly he rejoices!
The desire of his heart you have given him, and the request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah
For you meet him with blessings of good; you set on his head a crown of refined gold.
Life he asked of you; you gave it to him — length of days forever and ever.
Great is his glory in your salvation; splendour and majesty you place upon him.
For you make him blessings forever; you make him rejoice with gladness with your face.
For the king is trusting in YHWH, and in the steadfast love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them like a furnace of fire at the time of your face; YHWH in his anger will swallow them, and fire will consume them.
Their fruit you will destroy from the earth, and their offspring from among the children of humankind.
For they stretched out evil against you; they devised a scheme — they will not succeed.
For you will make them a shoulder; with your bowstrings you will aim at their faces.
Be exalted, YHWH, in your strength! We will sing and make music of your might.

psalms_22.t: To the overseer, upon 'The Doe of the Dawn'. A psalm, of David.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my roaring.
My God, I call by day and you do not answer, and by night, and there is no silence for me.
And you are holy, sitting [upon] the praises of Israel.
In you our fathers trusted; they trusted, and you brought them to safety.
To you they cried out and they escaped; in you they trusted and they were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of humankind and despised of a people.
All who see me mock at me; they open wide with the lip, they shake the head:
'Roll it to YHWH — let him bring him to safety! Let him deliver him, for he delights in him!'
For you are the one who drew me out from the belly, making me trust upon my mother's breasts.
Upon you I was cast from the womb; from my mother's belly you have been my God.
Do not be far from me, for distress is near, for there is no helper.
Many bulls have surrounded me; strong ones of Bashan have encircled me.
They have opened their mouth wide against me, a lion tearing and roaring.
Like water I have been poured out, and all my bones have come apart; my heart has become like wax, melted in the midst of my inward parts.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue is made to cling to my jaws, and to the dust of death you lay me.
For dogs have surrounded me; a company of evildoers has encircled me; they pierced my hands and my feet.
I count all my bones; they look, they stare at me.
They divide my garments among themselves, and for my clothing they cast a lot.
But you, YHWH, do not be distant; my strength, hasten to my help!
Deliver my being from the sword, my only one from the hand of the dog.
Save me from the mouth of the lion — and from the horns of the wild oxen you have answered me!
I will recount your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear YHWH, praise him! All the offspring of Jacob, honour him! And be afraid of him, all the offspring of Israel!
For he has not despised nor detested the affliction of the afflicted, and he has not hidden his face from him; and when he cried for help to him, he heard.
From you is my praise in the great assembly; my vows I will pay before those who fear him.
The humble will eat and be satisfied; those who seek him will praise YHWH. May your heart live forever!
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to YHWH, and all the clans of the nations will bow down before you.
For the kingship belongs to YHWH, and he rules over the nations.
All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and bowed down; before him will bow all who go down to the dust, and he has not kept his own being alive.
Offspring will serve him; it will be recounted of the Lord to the generation.
They will come and declare his righteousness to a people yet to be born — that he has done it.

psalms_23.t: YHWH is my shepherd; I do not lack.
In pastures of grass he makes me lie down; by waters of rest he leads me.
He restores my being; he guides me in tracks of righteousness for the sake of his name.
Even when I walk in a valley of the shadow of death I will not fear evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
You arrange a table before me in front of my adversaries; you have made my head rich with oil; my cup is saturation.
Surely good and steadfast love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I shall return to the house of YHWH for length of days.

psalms_24.t: To YHWH belongs the earth and what fills it, the world and those who dwell in it.
For he founded it upon the seas, and upon the rivers he established it.
Who shall go up on the mountain of YHWH? And who shall stand in the place of his holiness?
One innocent of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his being to emptiness and has not sworn to deceit.
He will lift up a blessing from YHWH, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
This is the generation of those who seek him, those who seek your face — Jacob. Selah
Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
Who is this King of glory? YHWH strong and mighty, YHWH mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates! And lift up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
Who is he, this King of glory? YHWH of hosts — he is the King of glory. Selah

psalms_25.t: Of David.
To you, YHWH, I lift up my being.
My God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame; let my enemies not exult over me.
Also, all who wait for you will not be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be put to shame.
Your ways, YHWH, make known to me; your paths teach me.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I have waited all the day.
Remember your compassion, YHWH, and your acts of steadfast love, for they are from of old.
The sins of my youth and my transgressions do not remember; according to your steadfast love remember me — you, for the sake of your goodness, YHWH.
Good and upright is YHWH; therefore he teaches sinners in the way.
He leads the humble in judgement, and he teaches the humble his way.
All the paths of YHWH are steadfast love and faithfulness to those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
For the sake of your name, YHWH, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
Who is this, the man who fears YHWH? He teaches him in the way he should choose.
His being will lodge in good, and his offspring will possess the land.
The counsel of YHWH belongs to those who fear him, and his covenant, to make it known to them.
My eyes are continually toward YHWH, for he brings my feet out of the net.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am solitary and afflicted.
The distresses of my heart have made wide; from my straits bring me out.
Consider my affliction and my trouble, and lift away all my sins.
Consider my enemies, for they have become many, and with a hatred of violence they have hated me.
Keep my being and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in you.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I have waited for you.
Redeem Israel, God, from all its distresses.

psalms_26.t: Judge me, YHWH, for I have walked in my integrity, and in YHWH I have trusted; I shall not slip.
Test me, YHWH, and put me to the proof; refine my kidneys and my heart.
For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I have walked about in your faithfulness.
I have not sat with men of emptiness, and with those who conceal themselves I will not go.
I have hated the assembly of evildoers, and with the wicked I will not sit.
I wash my hands in innocence, and I go around your altar, YHWH,
to make heard the sound of thanksgiving, and to recount all your wonders.
YHWH, I love the habitation of your house, and the place of the dwelling of your glory.
Do not gather my being with sinners, nor my life with men of bloods,
in whose hands is depravity, and whose right hand is full of a bribe.
But I — in my integrity I will walk; redeem me and be gracious to me.
My foot has stood on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless YHWH.

psalms_27.t: YHWH is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear? YHWH is the stronghold of my life — of whom shall I be in dread?
When evildoers drew near against me to devour my flesh — my foes and my enemies against me — they themselves stumbled and fell.
If a camp encamps against me, my heart will not fear; if war rises against me, in this I am trusting.
One thing I have asked from YHWH — that I will seek: my dwelling in the house of YHWH all the days of my life, to gaze on the pleasantness of YHWH and to inquire in his temple.
For he will conceal me in his shelter in the day of evil; he will hide me in the secret place of his tent; on a rock he will raise me high.
And now my head will rise above my enemies around me, and I will sacrifice in his tent sacrifices of a shout; I will sing and make music to YHWH.
Hear, YHWH, my voice — I call; and be gracious to me and answer me.
Of you my heart has said, 'Seek my face.' Your face, YHWH, I will seek.
Do not hide your face from me; do not turn your servant aside in anger. You have been my help. Do not abandon me and do not forsake me, God of my salvation.
For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but YHWH will gather me.
Teach me your way, YHWH, and lead me in a path of level ground because of those who watch me.
Do not give me over to the being of my foes, for false witnesses have risen against me, and one breathing out violence.
Unless I had believed that I would look on the goodness of YHWH in the land of the living —
Wait for YHWH! Be strong, and let your heart show strength. And wait for YHWH!

psalms_28.t: To you, YHWH, I call — my Rock, do not be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent toward me, I become like those who go down to the pit.
Hear the sound of my supplications when I cry for help to you, when I lift up my hands toward the innermost room of your holiness.
Do not drag me away with the wicked and with the workers of wrongdoing, who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their heart.
Give to them according to their work and according to the wickedness of their deeds; according to the work of their hands give to them; turn back their recompense upon them.
For they do not consider the deeds of YHWH and the work of his hands; he will tear them down and not build them up.
Blessed be YHWH, for he has heard the sound of my supplications.
YHWH is my strength and my shield; in him my heart trusted, and I was helped; and my heart is jubilant, and from my song I give thanks to him.
YHWH is strength for them, and he is the stronghold of the salvation of his anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance; and shepherd them and carry them to perpetuity.

psalms_29.t: Ascribe to YHWH, sons of gods, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.
Ascribe to YHWH the glory of his name; bow down to YHWH in the majesty of holiness.
The voice of YHWH is over the waters; the God of glory thunders — YHWH is over many waters.
The voice of YHWH is with strength; the voice of YHWH is with majesty.
The voice of YHWH is breaking cedars; and YHWH shattered the cedars of the Lebanon.
And he made them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of YHWH is striking out flames of fire.
The voice of YHWH makes the wilderness tremble; YHWH makes the wilderness of Kadesh tremble.
The voice of YHWH makes the does writhe, and it strips the forests bare; and in his temple, all of it says: Glory!
YHWH sat at the flood, and YHWH sits as king forever.
YHWH will give strength to his people; YHWH will bless his people with peace.

psalms_30.t: A psalm. A song of the dedication of the house. Of David.
I will exalt you, YHWH, for you have drawn me up, and you have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
YHWH my God, I cried for help to you, and you healed me.
YHWH, you brought up my being from Sheol; you kept me alive from among those going down to the pit.
Make music to YHWH, his loyal ones, and give thanks to the remembrance of his holiness.
For a moment is in his anger, life is in his good pleasure; in the evening weeping lodges, and at the morning, a shout of joy.
And I, I said in my ease: 'I shall never be shaken.'
YHWH, in your good pleasure you made my mountain stand strong; you hid your face — I was dismayed.
To you, YHWH, I call, and to the Lord I make supplication:
'What profit is there in my blood, in my going down to destruction? Will the dust give you thanks? Will it declare your faithfulness?
Hear, YHWH, and be gracious to me; YHWH, be a helper for me.'
You turned my wailing into dancing for me; you loosened my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
so that glory may make music to you and not be silent. YHWH my God, forever I will give thanks to you.

psalms_31.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
In you, YHWH, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; in your righteousness bring me to safety.
Incline your ear to me, deliver me quickly; be for me a Rock of refuge, a house of strongholds, to save me.
For you are my rock and my fortress; and for the sake of your name you will guide me and lead me.
You will bring me out of the net that they hid for me, for you are my stronghold.
Into your hand I entrust my spirit; you have redeemed me, YHWH, God of faithfulness.
I have hated those who keep the breaths of emptiness, but I, in YHWH I trust.
I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, because you have seen my affliction; you have known the distresses of my being,
and you have not shut me up in the hand of an enemy; you have made my feet stand in a roomy place.
Be gracious to me, YHWH, for it is distress to me; my eye has wasted away with vexation, my being and my belly.
For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in groaning; my strength has failed through my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.
Because of all my adversaries I have become a reproach, and to my neighbours exceedingly, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
I have been forgotten like a dead man, out of the heart; I have become like a vessel that perishes.
For I have heard the slander of many — terror all around — when they set themselves together against me; they plotted to take my being.
But I — on you I have relied, YHWH; I said, 'You are my God.'
My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from my pursuers.
Make your face shine upon your servant; save me in your steadfast love.
YHWH, let me not be put to shame, for I have called on you; let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent to Sheol.
Let lips of falsehood be struck dumb, those speaking arrogance against the righteous with pride and contempt.
