How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you have done for those who take refuge in you, before the children of humankind!
You hide them in the secret place of your face from the conspiracies of man; you conceal them in a shelter from the strife of tongues.
Blessed be YHWH, for he has made his steadfast love wonderful to me in a besieged city.
And I, I said in my alarm, 'I have been cut off from before your eyes.' Nevertheless you heard the sound of my supplications when I cried for help to you.
Love YHWH, all his loyal ones! YHWH preserves the faithful, and repays in full the one who acts in pride.
Be strong, and let your heart show strength, all you who wait for YHWH.

psalms_32.t: How blessed is the one whose transgression is lifted away, whose sin is covered!
How blessed is the man to whom YHWH does not reckon iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no treachery!
When I kept silent, my bones wore away through my roaring all the day.
For by day and by night your hand was heavy upon me; my sap was turned by the dry heats of summer. Selah
My sin I made known to you, and my iniquity I did not cover. I said, 'I will confess my transgressions to YHWH' — and you, you lifted away the iniquity of my sin. Selah
For this let every loyal one pray to you at a time of finding; surely at the flood of many waters, to him they shall not reach.
You are a secret place for me; from distress you preserve me; with shouts of safety you surround me. Selah
I will make you prudent and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
Do not be like a horse, like a mule, without understanding, whose trappings are bridle and halter to restrain it, or it will not come near you.
Many are the pains of the wicked, but the one who trusts in YHWH — steadfast love surrounds him.
Be glad in YHWH and rejoice, righteous ones, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart!

psalms_33.t: Shout for joy in YHWH, righteous ones; praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to YHWH with the lyre; with the ten-stringed harp make music to him.
Sing to him a new song; play well with a shout.
For the word of YHWH is upright, and all his work is in constancy.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of YHWH.
By the word of YHWH the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.
Gathering the waters of the sea like a heap, putting the deeps in storehouses.
Let all the earth fear YHWH; let all the inhabitants of the world be afraid of him.
For he spoke and it was; he commanded and it stood.
YHWH has broken the counsel of the nations; he has frustrated the plans of the peoples.
The counsel of YHWH stands forever, the plans of his heart to generation and generation.
How blessed is the nation whose God is YHWH, the people he has chosen as an inheritance for himself!
From the heavens YHWH looks; he sees all the children of humankind.
From the place of his dwelling he gazes on all the inhabitants of the earth —
the one forming their hearts together, the one attending to all their deeds.
The king is not saved by great might; a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
The horse is a lie for salvation, and by its great might it does not let anyone escape.
Look — the eye of YHWH is toward those who fear him, toward those who wait for his steadfast love,
to deliver their being from death and to keep them alive in famine.
Our being has waited for YHWH; he is our help and our shield.
For in him our heart is glad, for in his holy name we have trusted.
Let your steadfast love, YHWH, be upon us, just as we have waited for you.

psalms_34.t: Of David, when he changed his sense before Abimelech, and he drove him away and he went.
I will bless YHWH at all times; continually his praise will be in my mouth.
In YHWH my being makes its boast; let the humble hear and be glad.
Magnify YHWH with me, and let us exalt his name together.
I sought YHWH and he answered me, and from all my terrors he delivered me.
They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces will not be abashed.
This poor man called and YHWH heard, and from all his distresses he saved him.
The messenger of YHWH encamps around those who fear him, and he rescued them.
Taste and see that YHWH is good; how blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!
Fear YHWH, his holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear him.
Young lions are in want and go hungry, but those who seek YHWH do not lack any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me; the fear of YHWH I will teach you.
Who is the man who desires life, who loves days to see good?
Guard your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of YHWH are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry for help.
The face of YHWH is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
They cry out and YHWH hears, and from all their distresses he delivers them.
YHWH is near to the broken-hearted, and the crushed in spirit he saves.
Many are the evils of the righteous, but from all of them YHWH delivers him.
He is keeping all his bones; not one of them is broken.
Evil will kill the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be held guilty.
YHWH is redeeming the being of his servants, and none who take refuge in him will be held guilty.

psalms_35.t: Of David.
Contend, YHWH, with those who contend with me; fight with those who fight with me.
Take hold of shield and body-shield, and arise as my help.
And draw out a spear and a javelin to meet my pursuers; say to my being, 'I am your salvation.'
Let them be put to shame and humiliated, those who seek my being; let them be turned back and abashed, those who plot my harm.
Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the messenger of YHWH driving them.
Let their way be darkness and slippery places, with the messenger of YHWH pursuing them.
For without cause they hid for me the ditch of their net; without cause they dug for my being.
Let destruction come upon him unawares, and let his net that he hid catch him; let him fall into it, in destruction.
And my being will rejoice in YHWH; it will delight in his salvation.
All my bones will say, 'YHWH, who is like you, delivering the afflicted from one stronger than he, and the afflicted and the needy from the one who robs him?'
Witnesses of violence rise up; what I do not know they ask me.
They repay me evil in place of good — bereavement to my being.
But I — when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my being with fasting, and my prayer returned to my own bosom.
As for a neighbour, as for a brother of mine, I went about; like one mourning a mother, in mourning I bowed down.
But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered; smiters gathered against me and I did not know; they tore and did not cease.
Like the godless, mockers for a cake, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you look on? Bring back my being from their ravages, my only one from the young lions.
I will give thanks to you in the great assembly; among a numerous people I will praise you.
Let not those who are my enemies falsely rejoice over me; let not those who hate me without cause wink the eye.
For they do not speak peace, and against the quiet ones of the land they devise words of deceits.
And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said, 'Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it.'
You have seen, YHWH — do not be silent; Lord, do not be distant from me.
Rouse yourself and awake for my judgement, my God and Lord, for my cause.
Judge me according to your righteousness, YHWH my God, and let them not rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their heart, 'Aha, our desire!' Let them not say, 'We have swallowed him.'
Let them be put to shame and abashed together, those who are joyful at my harm; let them be clothed with shame and disgrace, those who magnify themselves against me.
Let them shout for joy and be glad, those who desire my righteousness, and let them say continually, 'Let YHWH be great, who desires the welfare of his servant.'
And my tongue will murmur your righteousness, all the day your praise.

psalms_36.t: To the overseer. Of the servant of YHWH, of David.
A declaration of transgression to the wicked is in the midst of my heart: there is no dread of God before his eyes.
For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to find his iniquity and hate it.
The words of his mouth are wrongdoing and deceit; he has ceased to act prudently, to do good.
He plans wrongdoing upon his bed; he takes his stand on a way not good; he does not reject evil.
YHWH, your steadfast love is in the heavens, your constancy to the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgements are a great deep; humankind and animals you save, YHWH.
How precious is your steadfast love, God! And the children of humankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
They take their fill from the fatness of your house, and from the river of your delights you give them drink.
For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
Prolong your steadfast love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Let not the foot of pride come upon me, and let not the hand of the wicked make me a wanderer.
There the workers of wrongdoing have fallen; they were thrust down and were not able to rise.

psalms_37.t: Of David.
Do not fret yourself over evildoers; do not be jealous of those who do injustice.
For like grass they will quickly wither, and like the greenery of vegetation they will fade.
Trust in YHWH and do good; dwell in the land and graze on constancy.
And take delight in YHWH, and he will give you the requests of your heart.
Roll your way onto YHWH, and trust in him, and he will act.
And he will bring out your righteousness like the light, and your justice like the noonday.
Be still to YHWH and wait patiently for him; do not fret yourself over one who prospers in his way, over a man who carries out schemes.
Refrain from anger and forsake wrath; do not fret yourself — it leads only to doing evil.
For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for YHWH — they will possess the land.
And yet a little, and the wicked will not be; and you will look carefully at his place, and he will not be there.
But the humble will possess the land, and they will take delight in abundance of peace.
The wicked plots against the righteous, and gnashes his teeth at him.
The Lord laughs at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
The wicked have drawn a sword and bent their bow, to make the afflicted and the needy fall, to slaughter those upright in the way.
Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
Better is the little of the righteous than the wealth of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but YHWH is sustaining the righteous.
YHWH is knowing the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will be forever.
They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.
For the wicked will perish, and the enemies of YHWH are like the glory of the pastures: they come to an end, in smoke they come to an end.
The wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is gracious and gives.
For those blessed by him will possess the land, and those cursed by him will be cut off.
From YHWH the steps of a man are established, and he delights in his way.
Though he falls, he will not be thrown down, for YHWH is holding his hand.
I have been a young man, and I have also grown old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, or his offspring seeking bread.
All the day he is gracious and lending, and his offspring become a blessing.
Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever.
For YHWH is loving justice, and he will not forsake his loyal ones; forever they are preserved, but the offspring of the wicked is cut off.
The righteous will possess the land, and they will dwell forever upon it.
The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
The wicked is watching for the righteous and seeking to kill him.
YHWH will not leave him in his hand, and will not condemn him as guilty when he is judged.
Wait for YHWH and keep his way, and he will exalt you to possess the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
I have seen a wicked man, ruthless, and spreading himself like a luxuriant native tree.
And he passed away, and look — he was not; and I sought him, and he was not found.
Watch the blameless and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
But transgressors will be destroyed together; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
And the salvation of the righteous is from YHWH, their stronghold in a time of distress.
And YHWH helped them and brought them to safety; he brings them to safety from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

psalms_38.t: A psalm, of David, to bring to remembrance.
YHWH, do not in your displeasure reprove me, and in your wrath do not discipline me.
For your arrows have come down into me, and your hand has come down upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
My wounds stink, they fester, because of my folly.
I am bent down, I am bowed very low; all the day I have gone about mourning.
For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am numb and crushed very low; I roar from the groaning of my heart.
Lord, all my desire is before you, and my sighing is not hidden from you.
My heart palpitates, my strength has left me; and the light of my eyes — even they are not with me.
My friends and my neighbours stand back from my plague, and my kinsmen have stood far off.
And those who seek my being set traps; and those who seek my harm have spoken of destructions, and all the day they murmur deceits.
But I am like a deaf man — I do not hear; and like a mute who does not open his mouth.
And I have become like a man who does not hear, and in whose mouth there are no reproofs.
For for you, YHWH, I have waited; you will answer, Lord my God.
For I said, 'Lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.'
For I am ready for stumbling, and my pain is before me continually.
For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious because of my sin.
And my enemies are alive, they are numerous, and those who hate me falsely are many.
And those who repay evil in place of good accuse me, in place of my pursuing good.
Do not forsake me, YHWH; my God, do not be distant from me.
Hasten to my help, Lord, my salvation.

psalms_39.t: To the overseer, for Jeduthun. A psalm, of David.
I said, 'I will guard my ways from sinning with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth while the wicked is before me.'
I was dumb in silence; I was silent, away from good, and my pain was stirred up.
My heart grew hot within me; in my murmuring a fire burned; I spoke with my tongue:
Make known to me, YHWH, my end, and the measure of my days — what it is; let me know how fleeting I am.
Look — you have made my days handbreadths, and my lifespan is like nothing before you. Surely every human being standing is altogether a breath. Selah
Surely a man goes about in an image; surely they are in turmoil for a breath. He heaps up and does not know who will gather it.
And now, what do I wait for, Lord? My hope — it is in you.
From all my transgressions deliver me; do not make me the reproach of the fool.
I am dumb, I do not open my mouth, for you have done it.
Remove from upon me your plague; by the hostility of your hand I have come to an end.
With reproofs for iniquity you have disciplined a man, and you have melted away what he desires, like a moth. Surely every human being is a breath. Selah
Hear my prayer, YHWH, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be silent at my tears, for I am a sojourner with you, a resident alien like all my ancestors.
Look away from me, and let me be cheerful, before I go and am no more.

psalms_40.t: To the overseer. Of David, a psalm.
Waiting, I waited for YHWH, and he stretched out to me and heard my cry for help.
And he brought me up from a pit of roaring, from the mud of the mire, and he set my feet on a rock; he established my steps.
And he put in my mouth a new song, a praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and they will trust in YHWH.
How blessed is the man who has made YHWH his trust, and has not turned to the proud and those who fall away to falsehood.
Many things you have done, you, YHWH my God — your wonders, and your plans toward us; there is none to compare with you. I would declare and speak — they are too numerous to recount.
Sacrifice and grain offering you did not desire; ears you have dug for me; burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask for.
Then I said, 'Look — I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.
To do your will, my God, is my desire, and your law is within my inward parts.'
I have borne the news of righteousness in the great assembly; look — I do not restrain my lips. YHWH, you know.
Your righteousness I have not covered within my heart; your faithfulness and your salvation I have spoken; I have not concealed your steadfast love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.
You, YHWH, will not withhold your compassion from me; your steadfast love and your faithfulness will continually preserve me.
For evils have encompassed me until there is no number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I am not able to see; they are more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
Be pleased, YHWH, to deliver me; YHWH, hasten to my help.
Let them be put to shame and abashed together, those who seek my being to snatch it away; let them be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.
Let them be appalled at the consequence of their shame, those who say to me, 'Aha! Aha!'
Let them delight and be glad in you, all who seek you; let those who love your salvation say continually, 'YHWH is great!'
But I am afflicted and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and the one who brings me to safety; my God, do not delay.

psalms_41.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
How blessed is the one who considers the poor; in a day of evil YHWH will bring him off safe.
YHWH will keep him and preserve him alive; he will be called blessed in the land; and do not give him over to the being of his enemies.
YHWH will support him on a couch of illness; all his bed you have changed in his sickness.
I said, 'YHWH, be gracious to me; heal my being, for I have sinned against you.'
My enemies speak evil of me: 'When will he die, and his name perish?'
And if one comes to see me, he speaks emptiness; his heart gathers wrongdoing to itself; he goes outside, he speaks of it.
Together all who hate me whisper against me; against me they devise evil for me:
'A thing of worthlessness has been poured out on him, and the one who has lain down will not rise again.'
Also the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has made his heel great against me.
But you, YHWH, be gracious to me and raise me up, and let me repay them.
By this I know that you delight in me: that my enemy does not shout aloud over me.
And I — in my integrity you have held me, and you have set me before you forever.
Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. Amen and amen.

psalms_42.t: To the overseer. A maskil, of the sons of Korah.
As a deer pants for channels of water, so my being pants for you, God.
My being thirsts for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before the face of God?
My tears have been my food by day and night, while they say to me all the day, 'Where is your God?'

These things I will remember, and I will pour out my being upon myself: that I used to pass on with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the sound of a shout of joy and thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.
Why are you bowed down, my being, and in turmoil upon me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of his face.
My God, my being is bowed down upon me; therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, and the Hermons, from Mount Mizar.
Deep calls to deep at the sound of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have passed over me.
By day YHWH commands his steadfast love, and in the night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
I will say to God my rock, 'Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?'
With a shattering in my bones my adversaries have taunted me, while they say to me all the day, 'Where is your God?'
Why are you bowed down, my being, and why in turmoil upon me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

psalms_43.t: Judge me, God, and conduct my case against a nation that is not loyal; from a man of deceit and injustice bring me to safety.
For you are the God of my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?
Send your light and your truth — let them lead me; let them bring me to the mountain of your holiness and to your dwelling places.
And I will come to the altar of God, to God, the gladness of my rejoicing, and I will give thanks to you with the lyre, God, my God.
Why are you bowed down, my being, and why in turmoil upon me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

psalms_44.t: To the overseer. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil.
God, with our ears we have heard; our ancestors have recounted to us the deed you did in their days, in the days of old.
You — with your hand you dispossessed nations and planted them; you did harm to peoples and sent them away.
For not by their sword did they take possession of the land, and their own arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.
You are he, my King, God; ordain the salvation of Jacob.
By you we gore our foes; in your name we tread down those who rise against us.
For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me.
For you have saved us from our foes, and those who hate us you have put to shame.
In God we have boasted all the day, and we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah
Yet you have rejected and humiliated us, and you do not go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered for themselves.
You give us like sheep for food, and among the nations you have scattered us.
You sell your people for no wealth, and you have not made much by their price.
You make us a reproach to our neighbours, mockery and derision to those around us.
You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
All the day my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
from the sound of the one who taunts and reviles, because of the enemy and the avenger.
All this has come upon us, and we had not forgotten you, and we had not dealt falsely with your covenant.
Our heart had not turned back, and our steps had not turned aside from your path.
For you have crushed us in a place of jackals, and covered us over with deep darkness.
If we had forgotten the name of our God, and spread out our hands to a strange god,
would not God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
For on your account we are killed all the day; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us in perpetuity.
Why do you hide your face? Do you forget our affliction and our oppression?
For our being has sunk down to the dust; our belly has clung to the earth.
Arise as a help for us, and redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.

psalms_45.t: To the overseer, upon 'Lilies'. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil. A song of loves.
My heart is stirred with a good word; I am speaking my works to a king; my tongue is the stylus of a skilled scribe.
You are more handsome than the sons of humankind; grace has been poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword on your thigh, mighty one — your splendour and your majesty.
And in your majesty ride out prosperously on behalf of truth and humility and righteousness, and let your right hand teach you awesome things.
Your arrows are sharpened — peoples fall under you — in the heart of the king's enemies.
Your throne, God, is forever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.
Myrrh and aloes and cassia are all your garments; from palaces of ivory stringed instruments have made you glad.
Daughters of kings are among your noble women; the queen-consort stands at your right hand in the gold of Ophir.
Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear; and forget your people and your father's house,
and let the king desire your beauty; for he is your lord — bow down to him.
And the daughter of Tyre with a gift — the rich of the people will entreat your face.
All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of settings of gold.
In embroidered robes she is brought to the king; virgins behind her, her companions, are brought to you.
They are brought with gladness and rejoicing; they enter the palace of the king.
In place of your ancestors will be your sons; you will make them princes in all the land.
I will cause your name to be remembered in every generation; therefore peoples will give you thanks forever and ever.

psalms_46.t: To the overseer. Of the sons of Korah, upon alamoth. A song.
God is for us a refuge and strength, a help in distresses, very much found.
Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes, and when the mountains shake in the heart of the seas.
Its waters roar and foam; the mountains shake at its swelling. Selah
A river — its streams make glad the city of God, the holy place of the dwellings of the Most High.
God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the turning of the morning.
Nations were in a tumult, kingdoms shook; he gave forth his voice — the earth melted.
YHWH of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is a high refuge for us. Selah
Come, see the works of YHWH, who has set desolations on the earth.
making wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; he burns the carts in the fire.
'Desist, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
YHWH of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is a high refuge for us. Selah

psalms_47.t: To the overseer. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
All you peoples, strike the palm! Shout aloud to God with the sound of a shout of joy!
For YHWH Most High is to be feared, a great king over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
He chooses for us our inheritance, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. Selah
God has gone up with a shout, YHWH with the sound of a ram's horn.
Make music to God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
For God is the king of all the earth; make music — a maskil.
God reigns over the nations; God sits on the throne of his holiness.
The nobles of the peoples have gathered — the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

psalms_48.t: A song. A psalm, of the sons of Korah.
Great is YHWH and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, the mountain of his holiness.
Beautiful in elevation, the delight of all the earth, is Mount Zion, the far reaches of the north, the town of the great king.
God in her fortresses has made himself known as a high refuge.
For look — the kings assembled; they passed on together.
They saw — so they were astonished; they were terrified, they hurried away.
Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman giving birth.
With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of YHWH of hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her to perpetuity. Selah
We have reflected on your steadfast love, God, in the midst of your temple.
Like your name, God, so is your praise, to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion be glad; let the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of your judgements.
Go around Zion and encircle her; count her towers.
Set your heart to her rampart; walk through her fortresses, so that you may recount it to a later generation.
For this is God, our God, forever and ever; he will guide us unto death.

psalms_49.t: To the overseer. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all you inhabitants of the world,
both children of humankind and children of man, rich and needy alike.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the murmuring of my heart will be understanding.
I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my riddle with the lyre.
Why should I fear in days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels surrounds me,
those who trust in their wealth and boast in the abundance of their riches?
A brother — no one can ever redeem him; he cannot give to God his ransom.
and the redemption price of their life is costly, and he must cease forever —
that he should live on in perpetuity and not see destruction.
For he sees that wise men die; alike the stupid and the brutish perish, and they leave their wealth to others.
Their inward thought is that their houses are forever, their dwelling places to generation and generation; they have called lands by their own names.
And humankind in honour does not remain; he is like the animals that are destroyed.
This is their way — stupidity is theirs; and after them, in their mouth, they take delight. Selah
Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death shepherds them; and the upright rule over them in the morning, and their rock is for Sheol to consume, away from its lofty dwelling.
Surely God will redeem my being from the hand of Sheol, for he will take me. Selah
Do not fear when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases,
for in his death he will take nothing; his glory will not go down after him.
For in his life he blesses his being — and they praise you when you do well for yourself —
it will go to the generation of his ancestors; to perpetuity they will not see light.
Humankind in honour, and he does not understand — he is like the animals that are destroyed.

psalms_50.t: A psalm, of Asaph.
God, God, YHWH has spoken and summoned the earth, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.
Our God comes and does not keep silent; fire consumes before him, and around him it is very tempestuous.
He summons the heavens above, and the earth, to judge his people:
'Gather to me my loyal ones, those who cut my covenant over a sacrifice.'
And the heavens declared his righteousness, for God is judge himself. Selah
'Hear, my people, and let me speak; Israel, and let me warn you — God, your God, am I.
Not for your sacrifices do I reprove you, and your burnt offerings are before me continually.
I will not take a young bull from your household, goats from your folds.
For every living creature of the forest is mine, the animals on a thousand hills.
I know every bird of the mountains, and the moving creatures of the field are with me.
If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world and what fills it are mine.
Do I eat the flesh of strong ones, or drink the blood of goats?
Sacrifice to God a thanksgiving, and pay your vows to the Most High,
and call on me in the day of distress; I will rescue you, and you will honour me.'
But to the wicked God says: 'What is it to you to recount my statutes, and to take up my covenant on your mouth?
And you — you hate discipline, and you have thrown my words behind you.
If you saw a thief, you were pleased with him, and your portion was with adulterers.
You let your mouth loose in evil, and your tongue harnesses deceit.
You sit, you speak against your brother; against your mother's son you give out a fault.
These things you have done and I kept silent; you imagined that I was altogether like you. I will reprove you and set it in order before your eyes.
Consider this, please, you who forget God, lest I tear, and there be no deliverer.
The one who sacrifices a thanksgiving honours me, and the one who sets a way — I will let him look on the salvation of God.'

psalms_51.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
Be gracious to me, God, according to your steadfast love; according to the abundance of your compassion wipe out my transgressions.
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and from my sin cleanse me.
For I myself know my transgressions, and my sin is before me continually.
Against you, you alone, I have sinned, and the evil in your eyes I have done, so that you may be just when you speak, blameless when you judge.
Look — in iniquity I was brought forth, and in sin my mother conceived me.
Look — you desire truth in the covered places, and in a hidden place you make me know wisdom.
You will purify me from sin with hyssop, and I shall be clean; you will wash me, and I shall become whiter than snow.
Make me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and wipe out all my iniquities.
Create for me a clean heart, God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Do not cast me away from before you, and do not take the spirit of your holiness from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and let a willing spirit sustain me.
I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will return to you.
Deliver me from bloods, God, God of my salvation; let my tongue shout for joy of your righteousness.
Lord, you will open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
For you do not desire sacrifice, or I would give it; you are not pleased with a burnt offering.
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and crushed heart, God, you will not despise.
Do good in your good pleasure to Zion; you will build the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will delight in sacrifices of righteousness, burnt offering and whole offering; then they will offer up young bulls on your altar.

psalms_52.t: To the overseer. A maskil, of David. When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, 'David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.'
Why do you boast in evil, mighty man? The steadfast love of God is all the day.
Your tongue plots destructions, like a sharpened razor, you worker of treachery.
You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah
You love all words of swallowing, a tongue of deceit.
Also God will tear you down to perpetuity; he will snatch you up and tear you away from a tent, and root you out from the land of the living. Selah
And the righteous will see and fear, and they will laugh at him:
'Look — the man who did not make God his stronghold, and trusted in the abundance of his riches, who was strong in his own destruction.'
But I am like a luxuriant olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever, because you have acted; and I will wait for your name, for it is good, before your loyal ones.

psalms_53.t: To the overseer, upon mahalath. A maskil, of David.
The fool has said in his heart, 'There is no God.' They act corruptly and they make injustice abominable; there is no one doing good.
God from the heavens looked down upon the children of humankind, to see whether there is one acting prudently, one seeking God.
All of it has turned back; together they are tainted; there is no one doing good, there is not even one.
Do they not know, the workers of wrongdoing, who devour my people as they eat bread? They do not call on God.
There they feared a fear where there was no fear, for God has scattered the bones of the one who encamped against you; you have put them to shame, for God has rejected them.
Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God turns back the captivity of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.

psalms_54.t: To the overseer, with stringed instruments. A maskil, of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, 'Is not David hiding himself among us?'
God, by your name save me, and by your might give judgement for me.
God, hear my prayer; give ear to the sayings of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless men have sought my being; they have not set God before themselves. Selah
Look — God is a helper for me; the Lord is among those who sustain my being.
May he bring back the evil to those who watch me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, YHWH, for it is good.
For from every distress he has delivered me, and my eye has looked on my enemies.

psalms_55.t: To the overseer, with stringed instruments. A maskil, of David.
Give ear to my prayer, God, and do not hide yourself from my supplication.
Attend to me and answer me; I am restless in my complaint and I moan,
because of the voice of an enemy, because of the pressure of the wicked; for they drop wrongdoing on me, and in anger they are hostile to me.
My heart trembles within me, and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
Fear and trembling come upon me, and shuddering has covered me.
And I said, 'Who will give me wings like a dove? I would fly away and settle down.'
Look — I would be far away in flight; I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
I would hasten a place of escape for myself from the rushing wind, from the storm.
Confuse, Lord; divide their tongue, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Day and night they go around it upon its walls, and wrongdoing and trouble are in its midst.
Destructions are in its midst, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its public square.
For it is not an enemy who taunts me — then I could endure it; it is not one who hates me who has magnified himself against me — then I could hide myself from him.
But it is you, a man according to my own rank, my close friend and my acquaintance,
who together with me made counsel sweet; in the house of God we walked about in a crowd.
May death deceive them; may they go down to Sheol alive, for evils are in their sojourning-place, in their inner being.
As for me, I will call to God, and YHWH will save me.
Evening and morning and noon I will complain and murmur, and he heard my voice.
He has redeemed my being in peace from the battle against me, for they were many against me.
God will hear and humble them — he who sits from of old, Selah — those who have no changes and do not fear God.
He has stretched out his hands against those at peace with him; he has violated his covenant.
The creamy things of his mouth were smooth, but war was his heart; his words were softer than oil, and they were drawn swords.
Cast your burden on YHWH, and he will provide for you; he will never permit the righteous to be shaken.
And you, God, will bring them down to the well of destruction; men of bloods and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.

psalms_56.t: To the overseer, upon 'The Dove among Terebinths Far Away'. Of David, a miktam. When the Philistines seized him in Gath.
Be gracious to me, God, for a human being has crushed me; all the day a fighter oppresses me.
My watchers have crushed me all the day, for many are fighting against me proudly.
On a day when I fear, I will trust in you.
In God I will praise his word; in God I have trusted, I am not afraid. What can flesh do to me?
All the day they twist my words; all their plans are against me for evil.
They stir up trouble, they lie hidden; they watch my heels, as they have waited for my being.
Because of wrongdoing, deliver them to safety? In anger bring down peoples, God.
My wandering you have taken account of; put my tears in your skin-bottle — are they not in your scroll?
Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call. This I know: that God is for me.
In God I will praise a word; in YHWH I will praise a word.
In God I have trusted, I am not afraid. What can a human being do to me?
Upon me, God, are your vows; I will pay thanksgivings to you.
For you have delivered my being from death — have you not delivered my feet from stumbling? — to walk about before God in the light of the living.

psalms_57.t: To the overseer, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam. When he fled from before Saul, in the cave.
Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for in you my being takes refuge; and in the shadow of your wings I take refuge until destructions pass by.
I call to God Most High, to the God who brings things to completion for me.
He will send from the heavens and save me; he has reproached the one who crushes me. Selah God will send his steadfast love and his faithfulness.
My being is among lions; I lie among those who devour the children of humankind. Their teeth are a spear and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
They prepared a net for my steps; my being was bowed down. They dug a pit before me; they have fallen into the midst of it. Selah
My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
Awake, my glory! Awake, harp and lyre! I will waken the dawn.
I will give thanks to you among the peoples, Lord; I will make music to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great to the heavens, and your faithfulness to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.

psalms_58.t: To the overseer, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam.
Do you really speak righteousness, O silence? Do you judge the children of humankind with uprightness?
Indeed, in the heart you do injustices; in the land you weigh out the violence of your hands.
The wicked are estranged from the womb; those who speak falsehood go astray from the belly.
Their venom is like the likeness of the venom of a serpent, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
which does not listen to the voice of charmers, of a skilful caster of spells.
God, break away their teeth in their mouth; break off the fangs of the young lions, YHWH.
Let them flow away like waters that go on their way; let him bend his arrows — let them be as though cut off.
Like a snail that goes on melting away, like a woman's miscarriage that has not seen the sun.
Before your pots perceive the thorn bush, whether green or burning, he will sweep it away.
The righteous will be glad when he sees vengeance; he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked.
And a human being will say, 'Surely there is fruit for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges in the earth.'

psalms_59.t: To the overseer, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam. When Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
Deliver me from my enemies, my God; set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of wrongdoing, and from men of bloods save me.
For look — they lie in wait for my being; fierce men stir up trouble against me, not for my transgression and not for my sin, YHWH.
Without iniquity they run and make themselves ready. Awake to meet me, and see!
And you, YHWH God of hosts, God of Israel, rouse yourself to visit all the nations; do not be gracious to any treacherous workers of wrongdoing. Selah
They return at evening; they growl like a dog and go around the city.
Look — they pour forth with their mouth; swords are on their lips, for 'Who is hearing?'
But you, YHWH, laugh at them; you mock at all the nations.
His strength — to you I will watch, for God is my high refuge.
The God of my steadfast love will meet me; God will let me look on my watchers.
Do not kill them, lest my people forget; make them wander by your might and bring them down, our shield, Lord.
The sin of their mouth is the word of their lips; let them be caught in their pride, and for the curse and the lying that they speak.
Make an end in wrath, make an end, and let them be no more; and let them know that God is ruling over Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah
And they return at evening; they growl like a dog and go around the city.
They wander about for food; if they are not satisfied, they pass the night.
But I will sing of your strength, and I will sing for joy in the morning of your steadfast love; for you have been a high refuge for me, and a place of flight in the day of my distress.
My strength, to you I will make music, for God is my high refuge, the God of my steadfast love.

psalms_60.t: To the overseer, upon 'The Lily of the Testimony'. A miktam, of David, to teach. When he struggled with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned and struck Edom in the Valley of Salt — twelve thousand.
God, you have rejected us, you have broken out against us; you have been angry — restore us!
You have made the land quake, you have split it open; repair its fractures, for it is shaking.
You have made your people see a hard thing; you have made us drink wine of staggering.
You have given a standard to those who fear you, to be displayed because of the bow. Selah
so that your beloved ones may be rescued. Save with your right hand, and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness: 'I will exult; I will divide up Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the stronghold of my head; Judah is my commander's staff.
Moab is my washing-pot; over Edom I throw my sandal; over me, Philistia, shout aloud!'
Who will bring me to a fortified city? Who has led me as far as Edom?
Have you not, God, rejected us? And you do not go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help from the foe, for the salvation of a human being is vain.
In God we will do might, and he will tread down our foes.

psalms_61.t: To the overseer, upon a stringed instrument. Of David.
Hear my cry of entreaty, God; attend to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart grows faint; lead me to a rock that is higher than I.
For you have been a refuge for me, a tower of strength from before the enemy.
Let me sojourn in your tent forever; let me take refuge in the secret place of your wings. Selah
For you, God, have listened to my vows; you have given the possession of those who fear your name.
Days upon the days of the king you will add; his years be like generation and generation.
May he sit forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness — let them preserve him.
So I will make music to your name forever, paying my vows day by day.

psalms_62.t: To the overseer, upon Jeduthun. A psalm, of David.
Only toward God is my being silence; from him is my salvation.
Only he is my Rock and my salvation, my high refuge — I shall not be greatly shaken.
How long will you attack a man? You will all be murdered, like a leaning wall, a pushed-down fence.
Surely from his height they have plotted to thrust him down; they take pleasure in falsehood. With his mouth they bless, and in their inner being they curse. Selah
Only toward God be silent, my being, for from him is my hope.
Only he is my Rock and my salvation, my high refuge — I shall not be shaken.
Upon God is my salvation and my glory; the Rock of my strength, my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at every time, you people; pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah
Surely the children of humankind are a breath, the children of man a falsehood; in the balances, to go up — they are together lighter than a breath.
Do not trust in extortion, and do not put vain hope in robbery; if wealth bears fruit, do not set the heart on it.
One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: that strength belongs to God,
and that to you, Lord, belongs steadfast love; for you repay to a man according to his work.

psalms_63.t: A psalm, of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
God, you are my God; I seek you earnestly. My being thirsts for you; my flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land without water.
So in the sanctuary I have seen you, to see your strength and your glory.
For your steadfast love is better than life; my lips will extol you.
So I will bless you in my life; in your name I will lift up my hands.
My being will be satisfied as with fat and fatness, and with lips of cries of joy my mouth will praise you.
When I have remembered you upon my bed, in the night-watches I murmur on you.
For you have been a help for me, and in the shadow of your wings I shout for joy.
My being clings after you; your right hand holds me.
But they, for ruin they seek my being; they will go into the lower parts of the earth.
They will pour him out by the hands of the sword; they will be the portion of foxes.
And the king will be glad in God; everyone who swears by him will boast, for the mouth of those who speak a lie will be shut.

psalms_64.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the dread of an enemy.
Hide me from the counsel of evildoers, from the unrest of the workers of wrongdoing,
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, who have bent their arrow — a bitter word —
to shoot at the blameless in the hiding places; suddenly they shoot at him and do not fear.
They strengthen for themselves an evil matter; they talk of hiding traps; they say, 'Who will see them?'
They search out injustices: 'We have completed a plot well plotted!' And the inner being of a man, and the heart, is deep.
But God shot at them an arrow — suddenly their wounds came.
And they made him stumble; their own tongue is against them; all who look on them shudder.
And all humankind will fear, and they will declare the work of God, and they will consider what he has done.
Let the righteous be glad in YHWH and take refuge in him, and let all the upright in heart boast.

psalms_65.t: To the overseer. A psalm, of David. A song.
To you silence is praise, God, in Zion; and to you a vow will be paid.
You who hear prayer, to you all flesh will come.
Matters of iniquities are too strong for me; our transgressions — you atone for them.
How blessed is the one you choose and bring near to dwell in your courts! Let us be satisfied by the goodness of your house, the holy place of your temple.
With awesome deeds in righteousness you answer us, God of our salvation, the trust of all the ends of the earth and of the distant sea,
who establishes the mountains by his strength, girded with might;
who calms the uproar of the seas, the uproar of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
And the inhabitants of the far ends fear because of your signs; you make the goings out of morning and evening shout for joy.
You have visited the earth and made it overflow; greatly you enrich it — the stream of God is full of water. You prepare their grain, for so you prepare it.
Watering its furrows, pressing down its ridges; with copious showers you soften it; you bless its growth.
You crown the year of your goodness, and your tracks drip fatness.
The pastures of the wilderness drip, and the hills gird themselves with rejoicing.
The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys cover themselves with grain; they shout aloud, they even sing.

psalms_66.t: To the overseer. A song. A psalm.
Shout aloud to God, all the earth!
Make music to the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
Say to God, 'How awesome are your works! Through the greatness of your strength your enemies cringe to you.'
All the earth will bow down to you and make music to you; they will make music to your name. Selah
Come and see the works of God — awesome in deed toward the children of humankind.
He turned the sea into dry ground; they passed through the river on foot. There let us rejoice in him,
ruling by his might forever; his eyes keep watch on the nations. Let the rebellious not exalt themselves. Selah
Bless our God, you peoples, and make the sound of his praise heard,
who has placed our being among the living, and has not permitted our foot to slip.
For you have tested us, God; you have refined us as silver is refined.
You brought us into the net; you put affliction on our hips.
You made a man ride over our head; we went into fire and into water, and you brought us out to abundance.
I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will pay you my vows,
which my lips opened and my mouth spoke in my distress.
Burnt offerings of fatlings I will offer up to you, with the smoke of rams; I will offer cattle with goats. Selah
Come, listen, and let me recount, all you who fear God, what he has done for my being.
To him I called with my mouth, and exaltation was under my tongue.
If I had considered wrongdoing in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
Nevertheless God has heard; he has attended to the sound of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not turned aside my prayer, nor his steadfast love from me.

psalms_67.t: To the overseer, with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
May God be gracious to us and bless us; may he make his face shine with us. Selah
so that your way may be known on the earth, your salvation among all nations.
Let the peoples give thanks to you, God; let all the peoples give thanks to you.
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with uprightness, and the nations on the earth you guide. Selah
Let the peoples give thanks to you, God; let all the peoples give thanks to you.
The earth has given its produce; God, our God, will bless us.
God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.

psalms_68.t: To the overseer. Of David. A psalm. A song.
Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, and let those who hate him flee from before him.
As smoke is driven about, drive them about; as wax melts before a fire, let the wicked perish before God.
But the righteous will be glad; they will exult before God, and they will be jubilant with gladness.
Sing to God, make music to his name; lift up a highway for the one who rides through the deserts — Yah is his name — and exult before him.
A father of the fatherless and a judge of widows is God in the dwelling of his holiness.
God makes the solitary dwell in a household; he brings out prisoners into prosperity. Only the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the desolate place, Selah
the earth quaked, the heavens also dropped rain before God — the One of Sinai — before God, the God of Israel.
A rain of free gifts you spread abroad, God; your inheritance, and it was weary — you established it.
Your community dwelt in it; you prepared in your goodness for the afflicted, God.
The Lord gives the utterance; the women who bear the news are a great host.
'Kings of armies flee, they flee!' And she who remains at home divides the plunder.
If you lie down among the sheepfolds — the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her pinions with the green sheen of gold.
When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it snowed on Zalmon.
A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; a mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
Why do you watch with envy, mountains of peaks, at the mountain God desired for his dwelling? Indeed, YHWH will dwell there in perpetuity.
The chariotry of God is twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them — Sinai, in the holy place.
You went up to the height, you took captives captive; you took gifts among humankind, and even from the rebellious — that Yah God might dwell there.
Blessed be the Lord day by day; he carries a load for us — the God of our salvation. Selah
The God for us is a God of saving acts, and to YHWH the Lord belong the escapes from death.
Surely God will shatter the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of the one who goes about in his guilt.
The Lord said, 'From Bashan I will bring back; I will bring back from the depths of the sea,
so that your foot may smash in blood, the tongue of your dogs its portion from the enemies.'
They have seen your processions, God, the processions of my God, my King, in the holy place.
The singers went in front, the musicians behind, among young women playing tambourines.
In the assemblies bless God, YHWH, from the fountain of Israel.
There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their throng, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
Your God has ordained your strength. Be strong, God — you who have acted for us!
From your temple above Jerusalem, kings will bring you a gift.
Rebuke the animal of the reeds, the herd of strong ones with the calves of the peoples, trampling on pieces of silver. He has scattered the peoples who delight in wars.
Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will hurry to stretch out its hands to God.
Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; make music to the Lord. Selah
to the one who rides in the heavens of heavens of ancient time. Look — he gives forth with his voice, a voice of strength.
Ascribe strength to God! His majesty is over Israel, and his strength is in the skies.
Awesome is God from your sanctuaries; the God of Israel — he gives strength and powers to the people. Blessed be God!

psalms_69.t: To the overseer, upon 'Lilies'. Of David.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to the neck.
I have sunk in deep mire, and there is no foothold; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a flood has overflowed me.
I am weary with my calling; my throat is parched; my eyes have failed, waiting for my God.
Those who hate me without cause are more than the hairs of my head; those who would destroy me, my enemies falsely, are numerous. What I did not steal, then I must restore.
God, you know my folly, and my guilt is not hidden from you.
Let not those who wait for you be put to shame through me, Lord YHWH of hosts; let not those who seek you be humiliated through me, God of Israel.
For on your account I have borne reproach; dishonour has covered my face.
I have become estranged from my brothers, and a foreigner to the children of my mother.
For the zeal of your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen upon me.
And I wept, in fasting, for my being; and it became reproaches for me.
And I made sackcloth my clothing, and I became a byword to them.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me, and the taunt-songs of drinkers of strong drink.
But as for me, my prayer is to you, YHWH, at an acceptable time; God, in the abundance of your steadfast love answer me, in the faithfulness of your salvation.
Deliver me from the mud, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me and from the depths of the waters.
Let not the flood of waters overflow me, and let not the deep swallow me, and let not the pit close its mouth over me.
Answer me, YHWH, for your steadfast love is good; according to the abundance of your compassion turn to me.
And do not hide your face from your servant, for it is distress to me; hurry, answer me.
Draw near to my being, act as kinsman for it; on account of my enemies redeem me.
You know my reproach and my shame and my disgrace; all my adversaries are before you.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick; and I waited for sympathy, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.
And they put poison in my food, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Let their table before them become a snare, and for their allies a trap.
Let their eyes grow dim from seeing, and make their loins shake continually.
Pour out on them your indignation, and let the burning of your anger overtake them.
Let their encampment be made desolate; in their tents let there be no one dwelling.
For they have harassed the one you struck, and they recount the pain of those you have fatally wounded.
Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not come into your righteousness.
Let them be wiped out from the scroll of life, and let them not be written down with the righteous.
But I am afflicted and in pain; let your salvation, God, set me on high.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
And it will be better to YHWH than an ox, a young bull with horns and hooves.
The humble have seen — let them be glad; you who seek God, let your heart live!
For YHWH listens to the needy, and he does not despise his prisoners.
Let the heavens and the earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
For God will save Zion and will rebuild the cities of Judah; and they will dwell there and take possession of it.
And the offspring of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell in it.

psalms_70.t: To the overseer. Of David, to bring to remembrance.
God, to deliver me! YHWH, hasten to my help!
Let them be put to shame and abashed, those who seek my being; let them be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.
Let them turn back because of their shame, those who say, 'Aha! Aha!'
Let all who seek you delight and be glad in you, and let those who love your salvation say continually, 'God is great!'
But I am afflicted and needy — God, hasten to me! You are my help and the one who brings me to safety; YHWH, do not delay.

psalms_71.t: In you, YHWH, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; incline your ear to me and save me.
Be for me a Rock of dwelling, to come to continually; you have given command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
My God, bring me to safety from the hand of the wicked, from the palm of the wrongdoer and the ruthless.
For you are my hope, Lord YHWH, my confidence from my youth.
Upon you I have supported myself from the womb; you were the one who cut me from my mother's inward parts; my praise is continually of you.
I have become like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.
My mouth is filled with your praise, all the day with your splendour.
Do not cast me away at the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
For my enemies speak of me, and those who watch for my being have taken counsel together,
saying, 'God has forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is no deliverer.'
God, do not be far from me; my God, hasten to my help.
Let the accusers of my being be put to shame and come to an end; let those who seek my harm cover themselves with reproach and disgrace.
But I will wait continually, and I will add to all your praise.
My mouth will recount your righteousness, all the day your salvation, for I do not know the numbers of them.
I will come with the mighty deeds of the Lord YHWH; I will bring to remembrance your righteousness, yours alone.
God, you have taught me from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.
And even to old age and grey hair, God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to a generation, your might to all who are to come.
And your righteousness, God, is to the height — you who have done great things. God, who is like you?
You who have made me see many distresses and calamities will return and preserve me alive, and from the depths of the earth you will return and bring me up.
May you increase my greatness, and turn and comfort me.
I also will praise you with the instrument of the harp — your faithfulness, my God; I will make music to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will shout for joy when I make music to you, and my being, which you have redeemed.
My tongue also will murmur your righteousness all the day, for they are put to shame, for they are abashed, those who seek my harm.

psalms_72.t: Of Solomon.
God, give your judgements to the king, and your righteousness to the son of the king.
He will judge your people with righteousness, and your afflicted ones with justice.
Let the mountains carry peace to the people, and the hills, in righteousness.
He will judge the afflicted of the people; he will save the children of the needy, and he will crush the oppressor.
They will fear you with the sun, and before the moon, generation of generations.
He will come down like rain on mown grass, like copious showers, a watering of the earth.
In his days let the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace until the moon is no more.
And may he rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
Before him let the desert-dwellers bow down, and let his enemies lick the dust.
The kings of Tarshish and the islands will bring back tribute; the kings of Sheba and Seba will bring near a gift.
And let all kings bow down to him; let all nations serve him.
For he will deliver the needy who cries for help, and the afflicted, and the one who has no helper.
He will have compassion on the poor and the needy, and the beings of the needy he will save.
From oppression and from violence he will redeem their being, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.
And may he live, and may he give him some of the gold of Sheba; and may prayer be made for him continually; all the day may he be blessed.
Let there be an abundance of grain in the land, on the top of the mountains; let its fruit wave like Lebanon, and let them blossom from the city like the vegetation of the earth.
Let his name be forever; before the sun let his name increase, and let them bless themselves by him; let all nations call him blessed.
Blessed be YHWH God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonders.
And blessed be the name of his glory forever, and let his glory fill all the earth. Amen and amen.
The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are finished.

psalms_73.t: A psalm. Of Asaph.
Surely good to Israel is God, to the pure of heart.
But as for me — like a little, my feet had turned aside; like nothing, my steps had been poured out.
For I was envious of the boastful; the well-being of the wicked I kept seeing.
For there are no pangs to their death, and their belly is fat.
In the trouble of humanity they are not, and with humankind they are not stricken.
Therefore pride is a necklace for them; a garment of violence covers them.
Their eye goes out from fat; the imaginings of the heart pass beyond.
They scoff and speak with evil; oppression from on high they speak.
They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walks about on the earth.
Therefore his people turn back here, and waters in full measure are drained by them.
And they say, How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?
Look — these are wicked, and, at ease for ever, they increase wealth.
Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and washed my hands in innocence.
And I have been stricken all the day, and my rebuke is to the mornings.
If I had said, I will recount it thus — look, the generation of your children I would have betrayed.
And I thought to know this — trouble it was in my eyes.
Until I came into the sanctuaries of God — I understood their end.
Surely on slippery places you set them; you make them fall to ruins.
How they have become a desolation in a moment! They come to an end, they are finished by terrors.
Like a dream after waking, Lord, on rousing you will despise their image.
When my heart was soured and I was pierced in my kidneys,
And I was brutish and did not know; a beast I was with you.
But I am continually with you; you have taken hold of the hand of my right.
By your counsel you guide me, and afterward to glory you will take me.
Whom have I in the heavens? And with you, I have desired nothing on the earth.
My flesh and my heart have come to an end; the Rock of my heart and my portion is God for ever.
For look, those far from you will perish; you have destroyed everyone who whores away from you.
But as for me — the nearness of God is good for me; I have made the Lord YHWH my refuge, to recount all your works.

psalms_74.t: A maskil. Of Asaph.
Why, God, have you cast off for ever? Does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?
Remember your congregation, you acquired of old, you redeemed the tribe of your inheritance, Mount Zion, this, in which you have dwelt.
Lift up your footsteps to the everlasting ruins — everything the enemy has done harm to in the sanctuary.
Your foes have roared in the midst of your appointed place; they set up their signs as signs.
It became known, like one bringing upward, into a thicket of trees, axes.
And now its carved work, all together, with axe and hatchets they smash.
They have sent your sanctuary into the fire; to the ground they have profaned the dwelling place of your name.
They said in their heart, Let us oppress them altogether. They burned all the appointed places of God in the land.
Our signs we have not seen; there is no longer a prophet, and there is not with us one who knows how long.
Until when, God, will the foe taunt? Will the enemy spurn your name for ever?
Why do you draw back your hand, and your right hand? From the midst of your bosom — destroy!
But God is my king from of old, working salvations in the midst of the earth.
You — you divided the sea by your strength; you shattered the heads of the sea creatures on the waters.
You — you crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him as food to a people, to desert-dwellers.
You — you split open spring and torrent; you — you dried up ever-flowing rivers.
Yours is the day, yours also the night; you — you established luminary and sun.
You — you set up all the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter — you, you formed them.
Remember this: an enemy has taunted, YHWH, and a foolish people have spurned your name.
Do not give to the beast the being of your turtledove; the life of your poor do not forget for ever.
Look to the covenant, for the dark places of the land are full — dwellings of violence.
Let not the crushed turn back humiliated; let the poor and the needy praise your name.
Arise, God, contend your contention; remember your reproach from a fool all the day.
Do not forget the voice of your foes, the uproar of those who rise against you, going up continually.

psalms_75.t: To the overseer. 'Do Not Destroy'. A psalm. Of Asaph. A song.
We give thanks to you, God, we give thanks — and your name is near; they recount your wonders.
When I take an appointed time, I myself will judge with uprightness.
The earth and all its inhabitants are melting away; I myself have set its pillars firm. Selah.
I said to the boastful, Do not boast, and to the wicked, Do not lift up a horn;
do not lift up your horn to the height; you would speak with an arrogant neck.
For not from the going out, nor from the setting, and not from the wilderness — lifting up.
For God is the one judging: this one he brings low, and this one he lifts up.
For a cup is in the hand of YHWH, and the wine foams, full of mixture, and he pours out from this; surely its dregs they will drain, they will drink — all the wicked of the earth.
But I will declare for ever; I will make music to the God of Jacob.
And all the horns of the wicked I will cut off; the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.

psalms_76.t: To the overseer. With stringed instruments. A psalm. Of Asaph. A song.
God is known in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
And his lair came to be in Salem, and his den in Zion.
There he shattered the flames of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.
Shining are you, more majestic than the mountains of prey.
The mighty of heart were plundered; they slumbered their sleep, and none of the men of strength found their hands.
From your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse lay stunned in sleep.
You — you are to be feared, and who will stand before you from the moment of your anger?
From the heavens you made a verdict heard; the earth feared and was still.
when God arose for judgement, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah.
For the wrath of humankind will give you thanks; the remainder of wrath you will gird on.
Make vows and pay them to YHWH your God; let all around him bring tribute to the one to be feared.
He cuts off the spirit of rulers; he is to be feared by the kings of the earth.

psalms_77.t: To the overseer. According to Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A psalm.
My voice is to God, and I will cry out; my voice is to God, and he will give ear to me.
In the day of my distress I sought the Lord; my hand at night was stretched out and did not grow numb; my being refused to be comforted.
I remember God, and I murmur; I complain, and my spirit faints away. Selah.
You held the eyelids of my eyes; I was troubled and did not speak.
I thought about days from of old, years of long ago.
I remember my song in the night; with my heart I complain, and my spirit searched.
Will the Lord reject for all ages, and not repeat showing favour again?
Has his steadfast love come to an end for ever? Has his utterance ceased for generation and generation?
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Or has he shut off his compassion in anger? Selah.
And I said, This is my grief — the changing of the right hand of the Most High.
I will remember the deeds of Yah, for I will remember your wonder from of old.
And I will meditate on all your work, and on your deeds I will complain.
God, your way is in holiness. Who is a great god like God?
You are the God who does wonder; you have made your strength known among the peoples.
You redeemed your people by an arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
The waters saw you, God, the waters saw you, they writhed; the deeps also trembled.
The clouds poured out water; the skies gave forth a sound; your arrows also went about.
The sound of your thunder was in the whirlwind; lightning flashes lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
Your way was in the sea, and your path in many waters, and your footprints were not known.
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

psalms_78.t: A maskil. Of Asaph.
Give ear, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the sayings of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in a parable; I will pour forth riddles from of old.
which we have heard and known, and our fathers have recounted to us.
We will not hide from their children, recounting to a later generation the praises of YHWH and his might and his wonders that he has done.
And he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers to make known to their children,
so that a later generation might know, children yet to be born; they would arise and recount them to their children,
and they would put their confidence in God, and not forget the deeds of God, and would observe his commandments;
and they would not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not set its heart firm, and whose spirit was not faithful with God.
The sons of Ephraim, equipped, shooters of the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
They did not keep the covenant of God, and in his law they refused to walk.
And they forgot his deeds and his wonders that he had shown them.
Before their fathers he did wonder in the land of Egypt, the region of Zoan.
He split open the sea and brought them through, and he made the waters stand like a heap.
And he guided them by the cloud in the daytime, and all the night by the light of a fire.
He would split open rocks in the wilderness and give drink abundantly, as from the deeps.
And he brought out streams from a rock and made water run down like the rivers.
But they repeated again to sin against him, rebelling against the Most High in the dry country.
And they tested God in their heart by asking food for their being.
And they spoke against God; they said, Is God able to lay a table in the wilderness?
Look — he struck a rock and waters flowed out, and torrents overflowed. Is he able to give bread as well? Or will he prepare meat for his people?
Therefore YHWH heard and was furious, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and anger also went up in Israel,
because they did not believe in God and did not trust in his salvation.
And he commanded the skies from above, and the doors of the heavens he opened,
and he rained down on them manna to eat, and the grain of the heavens he gave them.
Bread of the mighty each man ate; he sent them provision to satisfaction.
He led out an east wind in the heavens, and drove out a south wind by his strength.
And he rained down meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the seas.
And he made them fall in the midst of his camp, all around his dwelling places.
And they ate and were exceedingly satisfied, and he brought them their craving.
They had not turned away from their craving; their food was still in their mouth,
and the anger of God went up against them, and he killed among their strongest, and made the young men of Israel bow down.
In all this they sinned again and did not believe in his wonders.
And he brought their days to an end in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
When he killed them, then they sought him; they returned and searched earnestly for God.
And they remembered that God was their Rock, and God Most High their redeemer.
But they deceived him with their mouth, and with their tongue they lied to him.
And their heart was not steadfast with him, and they were not faithful in his covenant.
But he was compassionate; he made atonement for iniquity and did not destroy; and he multiplied turning back his anger, and did not stir up all his rage.
And he remembered that they were flesh, a wind that goes and does not return.
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, grieved him in a desolate place!
And they turned back and tested God, and pained the Holy One of Israel.
They did not remember his hand, the day when he ransomed them from the foe,
when he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in the region of Zoan,
and he turned their canals to blood, and their streams they could not drink.
He sent among them the swarm, and it devoured them, and frogs, and it ruined them.
And he gave their produce to the shearer-locust, and the result of their toil to the swarming locust.
He killed their vines with the hail, and their sycamore-figs with the frost.
And he delivered up their cattle to the hail, and their livestock to the flames.
He sent against them the burning of his anger, fury and indignation and trouble, a sending of messengers of calamities.
He made level a path for his anger; he did not keep back their being from death, and he delivered up their life to the pestilence.
And he struck every firstborn in Egypt, the first of their vigour in the tents of Ham.
And he led out his people like sheep, and drove them like a flock in the wilderness.
And he guided them in security, and they were not afraid, and the sea covered their enemies.
And he brought them to the territory of his holiness, this mountain that his right hand had acquired.
And he drove out nations from before them, and made them fall by a measuring-line of inheritance, and settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
But they tested and rebelled against God Most High, and his testimonies they did not keep.
And they turned back and acted treacherously like their fathers; they changed like a bow of deceit.
And they provoked him to anger with their high places, and with their carved images made him jealous.
God heard and was furious, and he utterly rejected Israel.
And he abandoned the dwelling place of Shiloh, the tent he had pitched among humankind.
And he gave his strength to captivity, and his splendour into the hand of the foe.
And he delivered up his people to the sword, and with his inheritance he was furious.
Fire consumed its young men, and its virgins were not praised.
Its priests fell by the sword, and its widows did not weep.
