And the Lord awoke like a sleeper, like a warrior overcome by wine.
And he struck his foes backwards; an everlasting reproach he gave them.
And he rejected the tent of Joseph, and the tribe of Ephraim he did not choose.
And he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
And he built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he founded for ever.
And he chose David his servant and took him from the sheepfolds.
From behind the nursing ewes he brought him to shepherd Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
And he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, and with the skill of his hands he guided them.

psalms_79.t: God, nations have come into your inheritance; they have made the temple of your holiness unclean; they have made Jerusalem into heaps of ruins.
They have given the corpses of your servants as food to the birds of the heavens, the flesh of your loyal ones to the beasts of the earth.
They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there was no one burying.
We have become a reproach to our neighbours, mockery and derision to those around us.
Until when, YHWH? Will you be angry for ever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Pour out your rage on the nations that do not know you, and on kingdoms that do not call on your name.
For it has consumed Jacob and devastated his habitation.
Do not remember against us the iniquities of former ones; quickly, let your compassion come to meet us, for we have become very low.
Help us, God of our salvation, on account of the glory of your name, and deliver us and make atonement for our sins for the sake of your name.
Why should the nations say, Where is their God? Let it be known among the nations before our eyes — the vengeance for the poured-out blood of your servants.
Let the groaning of the prisoner come before you; according to the greatness of your arm leave alive the sons of death.
And return to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they reproached you, Lord.
And we, your people and the sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks for ever; to generation and generation we will recount your praise.

psalms_80.t: To the overseer. To 'Lilies, Testimony'. Of Asaph. A psalm.
Shepherd of Israel, give ear, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned on the cherubim, shine out.
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might, and come for our salvation.
God, restore us, and make your face shine, and let us be saved.
YHWH, God of hosts, until when will you smoke at the prayer of your people?
You have fed them bread of tears, and made them drink tears by the third-measure.
You make us a contention to our neighbours, and our enemies mock among themselves.
God of hosts, restore us, and make your face shine, and let us be saved.
A vine you uprooted from Egypt; you drove out nations and planted it.
You cleared before it, and it took root its roots and filled the land.
The mountains were covered by its shade, and its boughs were the cedars of God.
It sent out its branches to the sea, and its young shoots to the River.
Why have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass along the road pluck it?
A boar from the forest gnaws at it, and what moves in the field grazes on it.
God of hosts, turn back, please; look down from the heavens and see, and attend to this vine,
and the stock that your right hand planted, and on the son you made strong for yourself.
It is burned with fire, cut down; from the rebuke of your face they perish.
Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of humankind you made strong for yourself.
And we will not turn back from you; give us life, and we will call on your name.
YHWH, God of hosts, restore us; make your face shine, and let us be saved.

psalms_81.t: To the overseer. According to the Gittith. Of Asaph.
Shout for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.
Lift up music and give the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Blow the ram's horn at the new moon, at the full moon, for the day of our festival.
For it is a statute for Israel, a judgement of the God of Jacob.
A testimony he established in Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt. A language I did not know I heard:
I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands passed away from the basket.
In distress you called, and I rescued you; I answered you in the hiding place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
Listen, my people, and let me warn you; Israel, if you would listen to me!
There shall not be among you a strange god, and you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
I am YHWH your God, the one who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
But my people did not listen to my voice, and Israel did not yield to me.
So I gave him over to the stubbornness of their heart; they walked in their own schemes.
If only my people were listening to me, Israel walking in my ways!
In a little while I would subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their foes.
Those who hate YHWH would cringe before him, and their time would be for ever.
And he would feed him from the fat of the wheat; and from a rock I would satisfy you with honey.

psalms_82.t: God takes his stand in the congregation of God; in the midst of the gods he judges.
Until when will you judge unjustly and lift up the face of the wicked? Selah.
Judge for the poor and the fatherless; vindicate the afflicted and the destitute.
Rescue the poor and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
They do not know and they do not understand; in darkness they walk about; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
I myself said, You are gods, and sons of the Most High, all of you.
Nevertheless like humankind you will die, and like one of the princes you will fall.
Arise, God, judge the earth, for you yourself will take all the nations as your inheritance.

psalms_83.t: A song. A psalm. Of Asaph.
God, let there be no silence for you; do not be deaf, and do not be still, God.
For look, your enemies are in an uproar, and those who hate you have lifted the head.
Against your people they make crafty counsel, and they consult together against your treasured ones.
They have said, Come, let us annihilate them from being a nation, and let the name of Israel be remembered no more.
For they have taken counsel with one heart together; against you they are cutting a covenant.
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre.
Assyria also has joined itself with them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah.
Do to them as to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin at the wadi of Kishon,
who were destroyed at En-dor, who became dung for the ground.
Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and like Zalmunna,
who said, Let us take possession for ourselves of the pastures of God.
My God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before a wind.
As a fire burns a forest, and as a flame sets mountains ablaze,
so pursue them with your storm, and terrify them with your storm-wind.
Fill their faces with shame, so that they may seek your name, YHWH.
Let them be ashamed and dismayed for ever; let them be abashed and perish,
and let them know that you — your name is YHWH, you alone — are the Most High over all the earth.

psalms_84.t: To the overseer. According to the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
How lovely are your dwelling places, YHWH of hosts!
My being has longed and even been spent for the courts of YHWH; my heart and my flesh shout for joy to the living God.
Even a bird has found a home, and a swallow a nest for herself, where she has put her young — your altars, YHWH of hosts, my king and my God.
How blessed are those who dwell in your house! They still praise you. Selah.
How blessed is the person whose strength is in you, in whose heart are the highways.
Passing through the valley of Baca, they make it a spring; the early rain also covers it with blessings.
They go from strength to strength; each appears before God in Zion.
YHWH, God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Selah.
Look on our shield, God, and attend to the face of your anointed.
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I have chosen to stand at the threshold in the house of my God rather than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
For YHWH God is a sun and a shield; favour and glory YHWH gives. He does not withhold good from those who walk in blamelessness.
YHWH of hosts, how blessed is anyone who trusts in you!

psalms_85.t: To the overseer. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
You showed favour, YHWH, to your land; you turned back the captivity of Jacob.
You lifted the iniquity of your people; you covered all their sin. Selah.
You withdrew all your fury; you turned back from the burning of your anger.
Restore us, God of our salvation, and break your vexation with us.
Will you be angry with us for ever? Will you prolong your anger to generation and generation?
Will you not turn back and give us life, so that your people may rejoice in you?
Show us your steadfast love, YHWH, and give us your salvation.
Let me hear what the God YHWH will speak; for he will speak peace to his people and to his loyal ones, and let them not turn back to folly.
Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Faithfulness springs up from the earth, and righteousness looks down from the heavens.
YHWH also will give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
Righteousness will go before him and will set his footsteps on the way.

psalms_86.t: Incline your ear, YHWH; answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Keep my being, for I am loyal; save your servant — you are my God — the one who trusts in you.
Be gracious to me, Lord, for to you I call all the day.
Make glad the being of your servant, for to you, Lord, I lift up my being.
For you, Lord, are good and ready to forgive, and abundant in steadfast love to all who call on you.
Give ear, YHWH, to my prayer, and attend to the sound of my supplications.
In the day of my distress I call you, for you will answer me.
There is none like you among the gods, Lord, and there are no works like yours.
All the nations that you have made will come and bow down before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.
For you are great and do wonders; you are God, you alone.
Teach me your way, YHWH; I will walk in your truth. Unite my heart to fear your name.
I will give you thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify your name for ever.
For your steadfast love is great toward me, and you have delivered my being from the lowest Sheol.
God, the arrogant have risen against me, and a company of the ruthless have sought my being, and they have not set you before them.
But you, Lord, are a God compassionate and gracious, long of nostrils and abundant in steadfast love and faithfulness.
Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your maidservant.
Do with me a sign for good, and let those who hate me see and be ashamed, because you, YHWH, have helped me and comforted me.

psalms_87.t: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.
His foundation is in the mountains of holiness.
YHWH loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken in you, city of God. Selah.
I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know me. Look — Philistia and Tyre with Cush: this one was born there.
And of Zion it will be said, Each and every one was born in her; and he himself will establish her, the Most High.
YHWH will count, when he records the peoples: this one was born there. Selah.
And singers as dancers: All my springs are in you.

psalms_88.t: A song. A psalm. Of the sons of Korah. To the overseer. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A maskil. Of Heman the Ezrahite.
YHWH, God of my salvation, by day I have cried out, in the night, before you.
Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry of entreaty.
For my being is surfeited with troubles, and my life has reached Sheol.
I am reckoned with those going down to the pit; I have become like a man with no strength,
free among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, and they are cut off from your hand.
You have put me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the depths.
Your rage has lain on me, and you have afflicted me with all your breakers. Selah.
You have removed my acquaintances far from me; you have made me abominations to them; I am shut up and cannot go out.
My eye is faint from affliction. I have called on you, YHWH, every day; I have spread out my hands to you.
Will you do wonder for the dead? Will the shades rise and give you thanks? Selah.
Will your steadfast love be recounted in the grave, your constancy in Abaddon?
Will your wonder be known in the darkness, and your righteousness in the land of forgetting?
But I — to you, YHWH, I cry for help, and in the morning my prayer comes to meet you.
Why, YHWH, do you reject my being? Why do you hide your face from me?
Afflicted I have been, and near death from my youth; I have borne your terrors; I am helpless.
Your burnings of anger have passed over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
They have surrounded me like water all the day; they have closed in on me altogether.
You have removed far from me the one who loves and the friend; my acquaintances — darkness.

psalms_89.t: A maskil. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.
The acts of steadfast love of YHWH I will sing for ever; to generation and generation I will make known your constancy with my mouth.
For I have said, Steadfast love is built for ever; the heavens — you establish your constancy in them.
I have cut a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant:
For ever I will establish your offspring, and build your throne to generation and generation. Selah.
And the heavens give thanks for your wonder, YHWH, your constancy also, in the assembly of the holy ones.
For who in the skies can be ranked with YHWH? Who is like YHWH among the sons of gods?
God is greatly to be dreaded in the council of the holy ones, and to be feared above all those around him.
YHWH, God of hosts, who is like you — mighty Yah — and your constancy is around you?
You rule over the swelling of the sea; when its waves rise, you still them.
You — you crushed Rahab like one slain; with the arm of your strength you scattered your enemies.
Yours are the heavens, yours also the earth; the world and what fills it — you founded them.
The north and the south — you created them; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at your name.
Yours is an arm with might; your hand is strong, your right hand is exalted.
Righteousness and judgement are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness come to meet your face.
How blessed is the people who know the shout! YHWH, in the light of your face they walk.
In your name they rejoice all the day, and in your righteousness they are exalted.
For you are the splendour of their strength, and in your favour our horn is exalted.
For our shield belongs to YHWH, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Then you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones and said: I have set help on a warrior; I have raised up a chosen one from the people.
I have found David my servant; with the oil of my holiness I have anointed him,
with whom my hand will be steadfast; my arm also will strengthen him.
An enemy will not exact from him, and a son of injustice will not afflict him.
And I will crush his foes before his face, and strike down those who hate him.
And my constancy and my steadfast love will be with him, and in my name his horn will be exalted.
And I will set his hand on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
He will call to me, You are my father, my God and the Rock of my salvation.
I also will make him firstborn, most high to the kings of the earth.
For ever I will keep my steadfast love for him, and my covenant will be faithful to him.
And I will set his offspring for ever, and his throne like the days of the heavens.
If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgements,
if they violate my statutes and do not keep my commandments,
then I will visit their transgression with a rod, and their iniquity with plagues.
But my steadfast love I will not break off from him, and I will not deal falsely with my constancy.
I will not violate my covenant, and what has gone out of my lips I will not change.
Once I have sworn by my holiness: if I lie to David —!
His offspring will be for ever, and his throne like the sun before me.
Like the moon it will be established for ever, and the witness in the skies is faithful. Selah.
But you — you have spurned and rejected; you have been furious with your anointed.
You have repudiated the covenant of your servant; you have profaned his crown to the ground.
You have broken through all his walls; you have made his strongholds a ruin.
All who pass along the road have plundered him; he has become a reproach to his neighbours.
You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
You also turn back the rock of his sword, and you have not raised him up in the battle.
You have made his lustre cease, and his throne you have thrown to the ground.
You have shortened the days of his youth; you have wrapped shame around him. Selah.
Until when, YHWH, will you hide yourself for ever? Will your rage burn like fire?
Remember — I, what is a lifespan? For what emptiness you have created all the children of humankind!
Who is the man who will live and not see death, who will deliver his being from the hand of Sheol? Selah.
Where are your former acts of steadfast love, Lord, which you swore to David in your constancy?
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, my bearing in my bosom all the many peoples,
with which your enemies have reproached, YHWH, with which they have reproached the footprints of your anointed.
Blessed be YHWH for ever. Amen and amen.

psalms_90.t: A prayer. Of Moses, the man of God.
Lord, a dwelling you have been for us in generation and generation.
Before the mountains were born, and you brought forth the earth and the world, from of old to for ever, you are God.
You return humankind to crushed matter, and you say, Return, children of humankind.
For a thousand years in your eyes are like a day of yesterday when it passes, and a watch in the night.
You flood them away; they are a sleep; in the morning, like the grass that sprouts up.
In the morning it flourishes and sprouts up; by the evening it withers and dries up.
For we come to an end in your anger, and by your rage we are terrified.
You have set our iniquities before you, our concealed things to the light of your face.
For all our days turn away in your fury; we finish our years like a sigh.
The days of our years — in them are seventy years, or by strength, eighty years; and their pride is toil and trouble, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
Who knows the strength of your anger, and your fury according to the fear of you?
To count our days — so teach us, that we may bring a heart of wisdom.
Turn back, YHWH — until when? — and have compassion on your servants.
Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, and let us shout for joy and rejoice in all our days.
Make us rejoice according to the days you afflicted us, the years we saw trouble.
Let your deed appear to your servants, and your majesty to their children.
And let the kindness of the Lord our God be upon us; and the work of our hands — establish it upon us; and the work of our hands — establish it.

psalms_91.t: One who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
I say of YHWH, My refuge and my stronghold, my God in whom I trust.
For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, from the plague of destructions.
With his pinion he will cover you, and under his wings you will take refuge; a shield and a wall is his faithfulness.
You will not be afraid of the dread of the night, of the arrow that flies by day,
of the plague that walks in the darkness, of the destruction that devastates at noon.
A thousand will fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; to you it will not draw near.
Only with your own eyes will you look and see the retribution of the wicked.
Because you — YHWH is my refuge — you have made the Most High your dwelling,
no harm will happen to you, and no plague will draw near your tent.
For he will command his messengers concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
On their hands they will lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.
On the lion and the cobra you will tread; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.
Because he has clung to me, I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he knows my name.
He will call me and I will answer him; I will be with him in distress; I will rescue him and honour him.
With length of days I will satisfy him, and I will show him my salvation.

psalms_92.t: A psalm. A song. For the day of the sabbath.
It is good to give thanks to YHWH, and to make music to your name, Most High,
to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your constancy in the nights,
on the ten-stringed and on the harp, on a melody with the lyre.
For you have made me rejoice, YHWH, by your deed; at the works of your hands I shout for joy.
How great are your works, YHWH! Your thoughts are exceedingly deep.
A brutish man does not know, and a fool does not understand this:
when the wicked flourish like vegetation and all who do wickedness blossom — it is that they may be destroyed for ever.
But you are on high for ever, YHWH.
For look, your enemies, YHWH, for look, your enemies will perish; all who do wickedness will be scattered.
But you have raised my horn like that of a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
And my eye has looked on my watchers; of the evildoers who rise against me, my ears have heard.
The righteous will flourish like the palm; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow.
Planted in the house of YHWH, in the courts of our God they will flourish.
They will still bear fruit in old age; they will be fat and fresh,
to declare that YHWH is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no injustice in him.

psalms_93.t: YHWH reigns; he is clothed with majesty; YHWH is clothed, he has girded himself with strength. The world also is established; it will not be shaken.
Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
The rivers have lifted up, YHWH, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.
More than the sounds of many waters, majestic are the breakers of the sea; majestic on high is YHWH.
Your testimonies are exceedingly faithful; holiness befits your house, YHWH, for length of days.

psalms_94.t: God of vengeances, YHWH, God of vengeances, shine out!
Raise yourself up, judge of the earth; return recompense to the proud.
Until when will the wicked, YHWH, until when will the wicked exult?
They pour forth, they speak arrogance; all who do wickedness boast.
Your people, YHWH, they crush, and your inheritance they afflict.
They kill the widow and the sojourner, and they murder the fatherless.
And they say, Yah does not see, and the God of Jacob does not perceive.
Understand, you brutish among the people; and you fools, when will you have insight?
The one who planted the ear — does he not hear? Or the one who formed the eye — does he not see?
The one who disciplines nations — does he not rebuke, the one who teaches humankind knowledge?
YHWH knows the thoughts of humankind, that they are a breath.
How blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and whom you teach from your law,
to give him quiet from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
For YHWH will not abandon his people, and his inheritance he will not forsake.
For judgement will return to righteousness, and after it all the upright of heart.
Who will rise up for me against evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against those who do wickedness?
If YHWH had not been a help for me, my being would soon have dwelt in silence.
If I said, My foot has slipped, your steadfast love, YHWH, supported me.
In the multitude of my disquieting thoughts within me, your consolations delighted my being.
Can a throne of destructions be joined to you, one that fashions mischief by a statute?
They band together against the being of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.
But YHWH has become a high refuge for me, and my God the Rock of my shelter.
And he has brought back on them their wickedness, and in their evil he will destroy them; YHWH our God will destroy them.

psalms_95.t: Come, let us shout for joy to YHWH; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
Let us come to meet his face with thanksgiving; with songs let us shout aloud to him.
For YHWH is a great God, and a great king above all gods.
In whose hand are the deep places of the earth, and the peaks of the mountains are his.
Whose is the sea, and he made it, and his hands formed the dry ground.
Come, let us bow down and kneel down; let us kneel before YHWH our maker.
For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture and the flock of his hand. Today, if you would listen to his voice —
Do not harden your heart as at Meribah, as on the day of Massah in the wilderness,
where your fathers put me to the test, they tested me, though they had seen my work.
Forty years I loathed a generation, and I said, They are a people who go astray in heart, and they have not known my ways.
so that I swore in my anger: If they enter my resting place —!

psalms_96.t: Sing to YHWH a new song; sing to YHWH, all the earth.
Sing to YHWH, bless his name; bear news of his salvation from day to day.
Recount his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
For great is YHWH and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but YHWH made the heavens.
Splendour and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Ascribe to YHWH, clans of the peoples, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.
Ascribe to YHWH the glory of his name; lift up an offering and come to his courts.
Bow down to YHWH in the adornment of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.
Say among the nations, YHWH reigns. The world also is established; it will not be shaken. He will judge the peoples with uprightness.
Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be glad; let the sea thunder, and what fills it.
Let the field exult, and all that is in it; then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy
before YHWH, for he is coming, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his constancy.

psalms_97.t: YHWH reigns; let the earth be glad; let the many islands rejoice.
Cloud and thick darkness are around him; righteousness and judgement are the foundation of his throne.
Fire goes before him and burns up his foes all around.
His lightning flashes lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.
The mountains melted like wax before YHWH, before the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens declared his righteousness, and all the peoples saw his glory.
Let all who serve a carved image be ashamed, those who glory in worthless idols. Bow down to him, all gods!
Zion heard and rejoiced, and the daughters of Judah were glad, because of your judgements, YHWH.
For you, YHWH, are Most High over all the earth; you are greatly exalted above all gods.
You who love YHWH, hate evil! He guards the beings of his loyal ones; from the hand of the wicked he delivers them.
Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright of heart.
Rejoice in YHWH, you righteous, and give thanks to the remembrance of his holiness.

psalms_98.t: Sing to YHWH a new song, for he has done wonders. His right hand has saved for him, and the arm of his holiness.
YHWH has made known his salvation; to the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.
He has remembered his steadfast love and his constancy to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Shout aloud to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and shout for joy and make music.
Make music to YHWH with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of music.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout aloud before the king, YHWH.
Let the sea thunder, and what fills it, the world and those who dwell in it.
Let the rivers clap the palm; together let the mountains shout for joy
before YHWH, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples with uprightness.

psalms_99.t: YHWH reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned on the cherubim; let the earth quake.
YHWH is great in Zion, and he is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them give thanks to your name — great and to be feared. Holy is he.
And the strength of a king — he loves judgement. You have established uprightness; judgement and righteousness in Jacob — you have done them.
Exalt YHWH our God, and bow down at the footstool of his feet. Holy is he.
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, and Samuel among those who call on his name; they were calling to YHWH, and he would answer them.
In a pillar of cloud he would speak to them; they kept his testimonies and the statute he gave them.
YHWH our God, you answered them; a forgiving God you were to them, and one avenging their deeds.
Exalt YHWH our God, and bow down at the mountain of his holiness, for YHWH our God is holy.

psalms_100.t: Shout aloud to YHWH, all the earth.
Serve YHWH with joy; come before him with a shout of joy.
Know that YHWH — he is God. He made us, and we are his, his people and the flock of his pasture.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; give thanks to him, bless his name.
For YHWH is good; his steadfast love is for ever, and his constancy to generation and generation.

psalms_101.t: Of steadfast love and judgement I will sing; to you, YHWH, I will make music.
I will give attention to a blameless way. When will you come to me? I will walk about in the integrity of my heart within my house.
I will not set before my eyes a thing of worthlessness. The doing of swerving deeds I hate; it will not cling to me.
A perverse heart will turn away from me; evil I will not know.
One who slanders his neighbour in secret — him I will destroy. The haughty of eyes and the wide of heart — him I cannot bear.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, to dwell with me; one who walks in a blameless way — he will serve me.
One who does deceit will not dwell within my house; one who speaks lies will not be established before my eyes.
Every morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off from the city of YHWH all who do wickedness.

psalms_102.t: A prayer. Of an afflicted person, when he grows faint and pours out his complaint before YHWH.
YHWH, hear my prayer, and let my cry for help come to you.
Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress; incline your ear to me; in the day I call, hurry, answer me.
For my days have come to an end in smoke, and my bones have been burned like a hearth.
My heart has been struck like the grass and has withered, for I have forgotten to eat my food.
From the sound of my groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
I am like a desert owl of the wilderness; I have become like an owl of the waste places.
I am wakeful, and I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
All the day my enemies have taunted me; those who mock me have sworn by me.
For I have eaten ashes like food, and mixed my drink with weeping,
because of your indignation and your wrath; for you picked me up and threw me away.
My days are like a lengthened shadow, and I wither like the grass.
But you, YHWH, sit for ever, and your remembrance is to generation and generation.
You will arise, you will have compassion on Zion, for it is the time to show her favour, for the appointed time has come.
For your servants take pleasure in her stones and show favour to her dust.
And the nations will fear the name of YHWH, and all the kings of the earth your glory,
for YHWH has built Zion; he has appeared in his glory.
He has turned to the prayer of the destitute and has not despised their prayer.
Let this be written for a later generation, and a people yet to be created will praise Yah.
For he has looked down from the height of his holiness; YHWH from the heavens has looked to the earth,
to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free the sons of death,
to recount in Zion the name of YHWH, and his praise in Jerusalem,
when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve YHWH.
He has humbled my strength on the way; he has cut short my days.
I said, My God, do not take me up in the middle of my days — your years are through a generation of generations.
Long ago you founded the earth, and the heavens were the work of your hands.
They will perish, but you will stand; and all of them will wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them, and they will pass away.
But you are he, and your years will not come to an end.
The children of your servants will dwell, and their offspring will be established before you.

psalms_103.t: Of David.
Bless YHWH, my being, and all that is within me, the name of his holiness.
Bless YHWH, my being, and do not forget all his benefits —
who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion,
who satisfies your ornament with good, so that your youth renews itself like the eagle.
YHWH does acts of righteousness and judgements for all who are oppressed.
He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the sons of Israel.
YHWH is compassionate and gracious, long of nostrils and abundant in steadfast love.
He will not contend for ever, and he will not keep his anger for all time.
He has not done to us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as the heavens are high above the earth, his steadfast love is strong over those who fear him.
As far as the east is from the west, he has removed our transgressions far from us.
As a father has compassion on children, YHWH has compassion on those who fear him.
For he knows our form; he remembers that we are dust.
Humankind — his days are like grass; like the flower of the field, so he flourishes.
For a wind passes over it and it is gone, and its place knows it no more.
But the steadfast love of YHWH is from of old and to for ever upon those who fear him, and his righteousness to the children of children,
to those who keep his covenant and to those who remember his precepts, to do them.
YHWH has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
Bless YHWH, his messengers, mighty in strength, who do his word, listening to the sound of his word.
Bless YHWH, all his hosts, his servants who do his will.
Bless YHWH, all his works, in all the places of his dominion. Bless YHWH, my being.

psalms_104.t: Bless YHWH, my being. YHWH my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendour and majesty,
wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,
who beams his upper rooms on the waters, who makes the clouds his chariot, who walks on the wings of the wind,
who makes winds his messengers, a flaming fire his servants.
He founded the earth on its foundations; it will not be shaken for ever and ever.
You covered it with the deep like clothing; the waters stood above the mountains.
At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away.
They went up mountains, they went down valleys, to the place that you established for them.
You set a boundary that they will not pass; they will not return to cover the earth.
He sends forth springs into the wadis; they go between the mountains.
They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys break their thirst.
Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; from between the foliage they give voice.
He waters the mountains from his upper rooms; from the fruit of your works the earth is satisfied.
causing grass to grow for the cattle, and vegetation for the labour of humankind, to bring forth food from the earth,
and wine that makes glad the heart of humanity, to make faces shine with oil, and food that sustains the heart of humanity.
The trees of YHWH are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted,
where the birds make nests; the stork — the fir trees are her home.
The high mountains belong to the mountain goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its setting.
You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it every beast of the forest moves about.
The young lions roar for the prey and seek their food from God.
The sun rises; they gather and lie down in their dens.
Humankind goes out to his work, and to his labour until evening.
How many are your works, YHWH! All of them you made with wisdom; the earth is full of your creatures.
This is the sea, great and wide of both hands; there are creeping things there without number, living creatures small with large.
There the ships go about; Leviathan, whom you formed to play in it.
All of them wait for you, to give their food in its time.
You give to them, they gather; you open your hand, they are satisfied with good.
You hide your face, they are terrified; you withdraw their breath, they die, and they return to their dust.
You send forth your spirit, they are created, and you renew the surface of the ground.
Let the glory of YHWH be for ever; let YHWH rejoice in his works.
who looks to the earth and it trembled, who touches the mountains and they smoke.
I will sing to YHWH while I live; I will make music to my God while I still am.
May my meditation be pleasing to him; I myself rejoice in YHWH.
Let sinners be finished from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless YHWH, my being. Hallelujah.

psalms_105.t: Give thanks to YHWH, call on his name; make known his deeds among the peoples.
Sing to him, make music to him; tell of all his wonders.
Glory in the name of his holiness; let the heart of those who seek YHWH rejoice.
Seek YHWH and his strength; seek his face continually.
Remember his wonders that he did, his signs and the judgements of his mouth,
offspring of Abraham his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is YHWH our God; his judgements are in all the earth.
He remembers his covenant for ever, the word he commanded to a thousand generations,
which he cut with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,
and he confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as a perpetual covenant,
saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the portion of your inheritance.
when they were men of number, few, and sojourners in it,
and they went about from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people,
He did not permit anyone to oppress them, and he rebuked kings on their account:
Do not touch my anointed ones, and to my prophets do no harm.
And he called a famine on the land; he broke every staff of bread.
He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold as a slave.
They afflicted his foot with the shackle; his neck came into iron.
until the time his word came, the speech of YHWH tested him.
A king sent and set him free, a ruler of peoples, and he released him.
He appointed him master of his household and ruler over all his possessions,
to bind his officials at his will, and to teach his elders wisdom.
And Israel came to Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
And he made his people very fruitful and made them stronger than their foes.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceptively with his servants.
He sent Moses his servant, Aaron, whom he had chosen.
They performed among them the words of his signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and made it dark, and they did not rebel against his word.
He turned their waters into blood and killed their fish.
Their land swarmed with frogs, in the rooms of their kings.
He spoke, and the swarm came, gnats in all their territory.
He made their rains hail, a fire of flames in their land.
And he struck their vines and their fig trees and broke the trees of their territory.
He spoke, and the locust came, and the young locust without number,
and it ate all the vegetation in their land, and it ate the fruit of their ground.
And he struck every firstborn in their land, the first of all their vigour.
And he brought them out with silver and gold, and among his tribes there was none who stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they went out, for the dread of them had fallen on them.
He spread out a cloud as a covering, and fire to give light by night.
He asked, and he brought quail, and with the bread of the heavens he satisfied them.
He opened a rock and waters flowed out; they went through the dry places, a river.
For he remembered the word of his holiness, Abraham his servant.
And he brought out his people with joy, his chosen ones with a shout of joy.
And he gave them the lands of nations, and they took possession of the labour of peoples,
so that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. Hallelujah.

psalms_106.t: Hallelujah. Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.
Who can tell the mighty deeds of YHWH, or proclaim all his praise?
How blessed are those who keep judgement, who do righteousness at every time!
Remember me, YHWH, with the favour of your people; visit me with your salvation,
to look on the good of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the joy of your nation, to glory with your inheritance.
We have sinned with our fathers; we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly.
Our fathers in Egypt did not consider your wonders; they did not remember the abundance of your acts of steadfast love, and they rebelled at the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.
But he saved them for the sake of his name, to make known his might.
And he rebuked the Sea of Reeds and it dried up, and he led them through the deeps as through the wilderness.
And he saved them from the hand of the one who hated, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
And the waters covered their foes; not one of them was left.
And they believed his words; they sang his praise.
They hurried, they forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
And they craved a craving in the wilderness and tested God in a desolate place.
And he gave them their petition and sent a wasting into their being.
And they were envious of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron, the holy one of YHWH.
The earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over the company of Abiram.
And fire burned among their company; a flame burned up the wicked.
They made a calf at Horeb and bowed down to a molten image.
And they exchanged their glory for the image of an ox that eats vegetation.
They forgot God their saviour, who did great things in Egypt,
wonders in the land of Ham, fearsome deeds at the Sea of Reeds.
And he said he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen one stood in the breach before him to turn back his rage from destroying.
And they rejected the desirable land; they did not believe his word.
And they murmured in their tents; they did not listen to the voice of YHWH.
And he raised his hand against them, to make them fall in the wilderness,
and to make their offspring fall among the nations and to scatter them among the lands.
And they joined themselves to Baal Peor and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
And they provoked to anger by their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
And Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
And it was reckoned to him as righteousness to generation and generation, for ever.
And they provoked wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses because of them,
for they rebelled against his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
They did not destroy the peoples, as YHWH had said to them,
but they mixed themselves with the nations and learned their works.
And they served their idols, and they became a snare for them.
And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons.
And they shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.
And they became unclean by their works and played the whore by their deeds.
And the anger of YHWH burned against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.
And he gave them into the hand of nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.
Many times he delivered them, but they rebelled by their plans and sank low in their iniquity.
But he saw when there was distress for them, when he heard their cry of entreaty.
And he remembered his covenant for them and relented according to the abundance of his acts of steadfast love.
And he gave them to compassion before all their captors.
Save us, YHWH our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to the name of your holiness, to glory in your praise.
Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Hallelujah.

psalms_107.t: Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.
Let the redeemed of YHWH say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the foe
and gathered from the lands, from east and from west, from north and from the sea.
They wandered in the wilderness, in a desolate place of a way; they found no city to dwell in.
Hungry and also thirsty, their being was fainting away within them.
And they cried out to YHWH in their distress; from their troubles he delivered them.
And he led them by a straight way, to go to a city to dwell in.
Let them give thanks to YHWH for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
for he has satisfied the longing throat and filled the hungry throat with good.
Those who sat in darkness and deep darkness, prisoners of affliction and iron,
because they had rebelled against the sayings of God and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
And he humbled their heart with trouble; they stumbled, and there was no helper.
And they cried aloud to YHWH in their distress; from their troubles he saved them.
He brought them out from darkness and deep darkness and tore their fetters apart.
Let them give thanks to YHWH for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
for he has broken gates of bronze and cut down bars of iron.
Senseless ones, because of the way of their transgression and because of their iniquities, were afflicted.
Their throat loathed all food, and they reached to the gates of death.
And they cried aloud to YHWH in their distress; from their troubles he saved them.
He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their pits.
Let them give thanks to YHWH for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
And let them sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving and recount his works with a shout of joy.
Those who go down to the sea in ships, doing business on the great waters —
they saw the works of YHWH and his wonders in the deep.
And he spoke and raised up a stormy wind, and it lifted up its waves.
They went up to the heavens, they went down to the deeps; their being melted away in the trouble.
They reeled and staggered like a drunkard, and all their skill was swallowed up.
And they cried out to YHWH in their distress, and from their troubles he brought them out.
He raised the storm into a calm, and their waves were still.
And they rejoiced because they were quiet, and he guided them to the harbour of their desire.
Let them give thanks to YHWH for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
and let them exalt him in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
He turns rivers into a wilderness, and springs of water into thirsty ground,
a land of fruit into saltiness, because of the evil of those who dwell in it.
He turns a wilderness into a pool of water, and a dry land into springs of water.
And he settles the hungry there, and they establish a city to dwell in;
and they sow fields and plant vineyards and produce a fruit of yield.
And he blesses them, and they multiply greatly, and he does not let their cattle grow few.
And they became few and were bowed down by the pressure of calamity and sorrow.
He pours out contempt on nobles and makes them wander in a wasteland with no way.
And he sets the needy on high, away from affliction, and makes families like a flock.
The upright see and rejoice, and all injustice shuts its mouth.
Who is wise? Let him observe these things, and let them consider carefully the acts of steadfast love of YHWH.

psalms_108.t: A song. A psalm. Of David.
My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing and make music — also my glory.
Awake, harp and lyre! I will waken the dawn.
I will give you thanks among the peoples, YHWH, and make music to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great above the heavens, and your faithfulness to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God, and your glory over all the earth.
So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide up Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the protection of my head; Judah is my commander's staff.
Moab is my washing pot; over Edom I throw my sandal; over Philistia I shout aloud.
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?
Have you not, God, rejected us? And you do not go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help from the foe, for the salvation of a human being is vain.
In God we will do valiantly, and he will tread down our foes.

psalms_109.t: To the overseer. Of David. A psalm.
God of my praise, do not be silent,
for the mouth of the wicked and a mouth of deceit have opened against me; they have spoken with me with a tongue of falsehood.
And with words of hatred they have surrounded me, and they have fought against me without cause.
In place of my love they accuse me, but I am prayer.
And they have put on me evil in place of good, and hatred in place of my love.
Appoint a wicked man over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he is judged, let him come out guilty, and let his prayer become sin.
Let his days be few; let another take his office.
Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
And let his children wander and wander and beg, and let them seek away from their ruins.
Let a creditor snare all that belongs to him, and let strangers plunder his property.
Let there be no one to prolong steadfast love to him, and let there be no one to show favour to his fatherless children.
Let his posterity be cut off; in the next generation let their name be wiped out.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before YHWH, and let the sin of his mother not be wiped out.
Let them be before YHWH continually, and let him cut off their memory from the earth,
because he did not remember to do steadfast love, but harassed a poor and needy man and one disheartened, to put him to death.
And he loved a curse, and it came to him; and he did not delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
And he put on a curse like his garment, and it came like water into his inward parts, and like oil into his bones.
Let it be for him like a garment he wraps himself in, and like a band he girds on continually.
This is the wage of my accusers from YHWH, and of those who speak evil against my being.
But you, YHWH the Lord, deal with me for the sake of your name; because your steadfast love is good, deliver me.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.
Like a shadow when it stretches out I have gone; I have been shaken off like the locust.
My knees have staggered from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean, without fat.
And I have become a reproach to them; they see me, they shake their head.
Help me, YHWH my God; save me according to your steadfast love,
and let them know that this is your hand, that you, YHWH, have done it.
Let them curse, but you — you will bless. They have risen and been ashamed, but your servant will rejoice.
Let my accusers be clothed with ignominy, and let them wrap themselves in their shame like a robe.
I will give thanks to YHWH greatly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise him.
For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his being.

psalms_110.t: The declaration of YHWH to my lord: Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
YHWH will stretch out the staff of your strength from Zion: Rule in the midst of your enemies!
Your people are freewill offerings on the day of your force; in majesties of holiness, from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you.
YHWH has sworn and will not relent: You are a priest for ever after the manner of Melchizedek.
The Lord is at your right hand; he shatters kings on the day of his anger.
He judges among the nations — it is full of corpses; he shatters the head over the wide earth.
From a wadi on the way he drinks; therefore he lifts up the head.

psalms_111.t: Hallelujah. I will give thanks to YHWH with all my heart, in the council of the upright and the congregation.
Great are the works of YHWH, studied by all who delight in them.
Splendour and majesty are his work, and his righteousness endures for ever.
He has made a remembrance for his wonders; YHWH is gracious and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear him; he remembers his covenant for ever.
The power of his works he has declared to his people, to give them the inheritance of nations.
The works of his hands are faithfulness and judgement; all his precepts are reliable.
They are sustained for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.
He sent ransom to his people; he ordained his covenant for ever. Holy and to be feared is his name.
The beginning of wisdom is the fear of YHWH; a good understanding belongs to all who do them. His praise endures for ever.

psalms_112.t: Hallelujah. How blessed is the man who fears YHWH, who delights greatly in his commandments!
His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures for ever.
Light rises in the darkness for the upright — gracious and compassionate and righteous.
Good is a man who shows favour and lends, who maintains his affairs with judgement.
For he will never be shaken; the righteous will be for a perpetual memory.
He will not be afraid of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in YHWH.
His heart is supported; he will not be afraid, until he looks on his foes.
He has scattered, he has given to the needy; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn will be exalted in honour.
The wicked will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

psalms_113.t: Hallelujah. Praise, servants of YHWH, praise the name of YHWH.
May the name of YHWH be blessed, from now and for ever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of YHWH is to be praised.
YHWH is exalted above all nations; his glory is above the heavens.
Who is like YHWH our God, who makes his seat on high,
who makes himself low to look on the heavens and on the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust; from the ash heap he lifts up the needy,
to seat him with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
He gives the barren woman of the house a home, a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

psalms_114.t: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominions.
The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like young of the flock.
What is it to you, sea, that you flee, Jordan, that you turn back,
mountains, that you skip like rams, hills, like young of the flock?
Tremble, earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turns the rock into a pool of water, flint into a spring of water.

psalms_115.t: Not to us, YHWH, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love, for the sake of your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, Where now is their God?
But our God is in the heavens; all that he desires he does.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of the hands of humankind.
They have a mouth, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see;
they have ears, but they do not hear; they have a nose, but they do not smell;
their hands, but they do not feel; their feet, but they do not walk; they make no sound in their throat.
Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.
Israel, trust in YHWH; he is their help and their shield.
House of Aaron, trust in YHWH; he is their help and their shield.
You who fear YHWH, trust in YHWH; he is their help and their shield.
YHWH has remembered us; he will bless. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear YHWH, the small with the great.
May YHWH add to you, to you and to your children.
Blessed are you by YHWH, maker of the heavens and the earth.
The heavens are the heavens of YHWH, and the earth he has given to the children of humankind.
The dead do not praise Yah, nor do any who go down into silence.
But we will bless Yah from now and for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_116.t: I love, because YHWH hears my voice, my supplications;
because he has inclined his ear to me, and in my days I will call.
The cords of death surrounded me, and the distresses of Sheol found me; I found trouble and sorrow.
And I called on the name of YHWH: I beg you, YHWH, deliver my being!
Gracious is YHWH and righteous, and our God is compassionate.
YHWH guards the simple; I had been brought low, and he saved me.
Return, my being, to your resting place, for YHWH has dealt bountifully with you.
For you have rescued my being from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
I will walk about before YHWH in the lands of the living.
I believed, for I spoke; I was greatly afflicted.
I said in my alarm, Every human being is a liar.
What shall I give back to YHWH for all his benefits to me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of YHWH.
My vows to YHWH I will pay, now, before all his people.
Precious in the eyes of YHWH is the death of his loyal ones.
I beg you, YHWH, for I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant. You have loosened my fetters.
To you I will sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and call on the name of YHWH.
My vows to YHWH I will pay, now, before all his people,
in the courts of the house of YHWH, in your midst, Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

psalms_117.t: Praise YHWH, all nations; extol him, all peoples.
For his steadfast love is strong over us, and the faithfulness of YHWH is for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_118.t: Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.
Let Israel say: His steadfast love is for ever.
Let the house of Aaron say: His steadfast love is for ever.
Let those who fear YHWH say: His steadfast love is for ever.
From the narrow place I called on Yah; Yah answered me in a broad place.
YHWH is for me; I will not be afraid. What can humankind do to me?
YHWH is for me among my helpers, and I will look on those who hate me.
It is good to take refuge in YHWH rather than to trust in humankind.
It is good to take refuge in YHWH rather than to trust in nobles.
All nations surrounded me; in the name of YHWH I fended them off.
They surrounded me, they also surrounded me; in the name of YHWH I fended them off.
They surrounded me like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in the name of YHWH I fended them off.
Pushing, you pushed me to fall, but YHWH helped me.
My strength and my might is Yah, and he has become for me salvation.
The sound of a shout of joy and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of YHWH does valiantly!
The right hand of YHWH is exalted; the right hand of YHWH does valiantly!
I will not die, for I will live, and I will recount the works of Yah.
Disciplining, Yah has disciplined me, but he has not given me over to death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter through them, I will give thanks to Yah.
This is the gate of YHWH; the righteous will enter through it.
I will give you thanks, for you answered me, and you have become for me salvation.
A stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.
From YHWH this has come; it is wonderful in our eyes.
This is the day YHWH has made; let us be glad and rejoice in it.
I beg you, YHWH, save now! I beg you, YHWH, grant success now!
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of YHWH; we bless you from the house of YHWH.
YHWH is God, and he has given us light. Bind the festival sacrifice with cords up to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I will give you thanks; my God, I will exalt you.
Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.

psalms_119.t: How blessed are those blameless of way, who walk in the law of YHWH.
How blessed are those who observe his testimonies, who seek him with all the heart.
They also do no injustice; in his ways they have walked.
You have commanded your precepts, to be kept diligently.
Would that my ways were steadfast, to keep your statutes!
Then I will not be ashamed when I look to all your commandments.
I will give you thanks in uprightness of heart, when I learn the judgements of your righteousness.
Your statutes I will keep; do not utterly forsake me.
How can a young man keep his path pure? By keeping it according to your word.
With all my heart I have sought you; do not let me stray from your commandments.
In my heart I have hidden your speech, so that I will not sin against you.
Blessed are you, YHWH; teach me your statutes.
With my lips I have recounted all the judgements of your mouth.
In the way of your testimonies I have exulted, as over all wealth.
On your precepts I will meditate, and I will look to your paths.
In your statutes I will delight myself; I will not forget your word.
Deal bountifully with your servant; I will live and keep your word.
Uncover my eyes, and I will look at wonders from your law.
I am a sojourner on the earth; do not hide your commandments from me.
My being is crushed with longing for your judgements at every time.
You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, who stray from your commandments.
Roll away from me reproach and contempt, for I have observed your testimonies.
Even officials sat and spoke together against me; your servant meditates on your statutes.
Your testimonies also are my delight, the men of my counsel.
My being clings to the dust; give me life according to your word.
I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your statutes.
Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wonders.
My being weeps from grief; raise me up according to your word.
Remove from me the way of falsehood, and favour me with your law.
The way of faithfulness I have chosen; your judgements I have set before me.
I have clung to your testimonies; YHWH, do not put me to shame.
The way of your commandments I will run, for you enlarge my heart.
Teach me, YHWH, the way of your statutes, and I will observe it to the end.
Make me understand, and I will observe your law and keep it with all the heart.
Lead me in the pathway of your commandments, for in it I delight.
Incline my heart to your testimonies, and not to unjust gain.
Take away my eyes from looking at worthlessness; in your ways give me life.
Fulfil for your servant your speech, which is for the fear of you.
Take away my reproach, which I dread, for your judgements are good.
Look, I have longed for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life.
And let your acts of steadfast love come to me, YHWH, your deliverance according to your speech,
and I will answer the one who taunts me a word, for I have trusted in your word.
And do not take away from my mouth a word of faithfulness utterly, for I have hoped for your judgements.
And I will keep your law continually, for ever and ever.
And I will walk about in a broad place, for I have sought your precepts.
And I will speak of your testimonies before kings and will not be ashamed.
And I will delight myself in your commandments, which I love.
And I will lift up my hands to your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.
Remember the word to your servant, on which you have made me hope.
This is my comfort in my affliction, that your speech has given me life.
The arrogant have utterly mocked me; from your law I have not turned aside.
I remember your judgements from of old, YHWH, and I comfort myself.
Burning indignation has seized me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.
Songs your statutes have been to me in the house of my sojournings.
I have remembered your name in the night, YHWH, and I have kept your law.
This has been mine, that I have observed your precepts.
My portion is YHWH; I have said I will keep your words.
I have entreated your face with all the heart; be gracious to me according to your speech.
I have thought about my ways and turned my feet back to your testimonies.
I have hurried and not delayed to keep your commandments.
The cords of the wicked have surrounded me; your law I have not forgotten.
At the middle of the night I rise to give you thanks for the judgements of your righteousness.
I am a companion of all who fear you and of those who keep your precepts.
Your steadfast love, YHWH, fills the earth; teach me your statutes.
You have done good with your servant, YHWH, according to your word.
Teach me good discernment and knowledge, for I have believed in your commandments.
Before I was afflicted I was going astray, but now I keep your speech.
You are good and you do good; teach me your statutes.
The arrogant have smeared falsehood on me; I, with all the heart, observe your precepts.
Their heart is insensitive like fat; I delight in your law.
It was good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn your statutes.
Better to me is the law of your mouth than thousands of gold and silver.
Your hands made me and established me; make me understand, and I will learn your commandments.
Those who fear you will see me and rejoice, for I have hoped for your word.
I know, YHWH, that your judgements are righteousness, and in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
Let your steadfast love be, please, to comfort me, according to your speech to your servant.
Let your compassion come to me, and I will live, for your law is my delight.
Let the arrogant be ashamed, for with falsehood they have subverted me; I will meditate on your precepts.
Let those who fear you turn to me, and those who know your testimonies.
Let my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that I will not be ashamed.
My being is spent for your deliverance; I have hoped for your word.
My eyes are spent for your speech, saying, When will you comfort me?
For I have become like a skin-bottle in smoke; your statutes I have not forgotten.
How many are the days of your servant? When will you do judgement on those who harass me?
The arrogant have dug pits for me, which are not according to your law.
All your commandments are faithfulness; with falsehood they have harassed me — help me!
They have almost made an end of me on the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
According to your steadfast love give me life, and I will keep the testimony of your mouth.
For ever, YHWH, your word stands firm in the heavens.
To generation and generation is your constancy; you established the earth, and it stands.
According to your judgements they stand this day, for all things are your servants.
If your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
For ever I will not forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; I will consider carefully your testimonies.
To every perfection I have seen an end; your commandment is exceedingly broad.
How I love your law! All the day it is my meditation.
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are mine for ever.
I have more insight than all my teachers, for your testimonies are a meditation to me.
I gain understanding more than elders, for I have observed your precepts.
From every evil path I have restrained my feet, so that I may keep your word.
From your judgements I have not turned aside, for you yourself have taught me.
How smooth your speech is to my palate, more than honey to my mouth!
From your precepts I gain understanding; therefore I hate every path of falsehood.
A lamp for my foot is your word, and a light for my pathway.
I have sworn and confirmed it, to keep the judgements of your righteousness.
I have been afflicted utterly; YHWH, give me life according to your word.
Accept, please, the freewill offerings of my mouth, YHWH, and teach me your judgements.
My being is in my palm continually, and your law I have not forgotten.
The wicked have set a snare for me, but from your precepts I have not gone astray.
I have inherited your testimonies for ever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I have inclined my heart to do your statutes, for ever, to the end.
The half-hearted I hate, but your law I love.
You are my hiding place and my shield; for your word I have hoped.
Turn aside from me, evildoers, and I will observe the commandments of my God.
Sustain me according to your speech, and I will live, and do not put me to shame because of my hope.
Uphold me, and I will be saved, and I will have regard for your statutes continually.
You reject all who stray from your statutes, for their deceitfulness is falsehood.
As dross you cause all the wicked of the earth to cease; therefore I love your testimonies.
My flesh trembles from dread of you, and I am afraid of your judgements.
I have done judgement and righteousness; do not abandon me to my oppressors.
Stand surety for your servant for good; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
My eyes are spent for your salvation and for the speech of your righteousness.
Do with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
I am your servant; make me understand, and I will know your testimonies.
It is time for YHWH to act; they have broken your law.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold and more than pure gold.
Therefore all the precepts of everything I approve; every path of falsehood I hate.
Wonders are your testimonies; therefore my being observes them.
The opening of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, according to the judgement for those who love your name.
Direct my footsteps by your speech, and let no wickedness have power over me.
Ransom me from the oppression of humankind, and I will keep your precepts.
Make your face shine on your servant, and teach me your statutes.
Streams of water have gone down my eyes, because they do not keep your law.
Righteous are you, YHWH, and upright are your judgements.
You have commanded your testimonies in righteousness and in great faithfulness.
My zeal has destroyed me, for my foes have forgotten your words.
Your speech is refined exceedingly, and your servant loves it.
I am small and despised; your precepts I have not forgotten.
Your righteousness is righteousness for ever, and your law is truth.
Distress and anguish have found me; your commandments are my delight.
Your testimonies are righteousness for ever; make me understand, and I will live.
I have called with all the heart; answer me, YHWH; your statutes I will observe.
I have called on you; save me, and I will keep your testimonies.
I was early in the twilight and cried for help; for your word I have hoped.
My eyes anticipated the night-watches, to meditate on your speech.
Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; YHWH, according to your judgements give me life.
Those who pursue wickedness have drawn near; from your law they are far.
You are near, YHWH, and all your commandments are truth.
Of old I have known from your testimonies that you founded them for ever.
See my affliction and rescue me, for your law I have not forgotten.
Contend my contention and redeem me; according to your speech give me life.
Salvation is far from the wicked, for they have not sought your statutes.
Your compassion is great, YHWH; according to your judgements give me life.
Many are those who harass me and my foes; from your testimonies I have not turned aside.
I saw the treacherous and felt disgust, because they did not keep your speech.
See that I love your precepts; YHWH, according to your steadfast love give me life.
The head of your word is truth, and every judgement of your righteousness is for ever.
Officials have harassed me without cause, but at your word my heart is in dread.
I am exulting over your speech, like one who finds much plunder.
Falsehood I hate and abhor; your law I love.
Seven times in the day I have praised you for the judgements of your righteousness.
Great peace belongs to those who love your law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
I have waited for your salvation, YHWH, and I have done your commandments.
My being has kept your testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.
I have kept your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
Let my cry of entreaty draw near before you, YHWH; according to your word make me understand.
Let my supplication come before you; according to your speech deliver me.
Let my lips pour forth praise, for you teach me your statutes.
Let my tongue sing your speech, for all your commandments are righteousness.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
I have longed for your salvation, YHWH, and your law is my delight.
Let my being live, and it will praise you, and let your judgements help me.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant, for your commandments I have not forgotten.

psalms_120.t: To YHWH in my distress I called, and he answered me.
YHWH, deliver my being from a lip of falsehood, from a tongue of deceit.
What will he give you, and what will he add to you, you tongue of deceit?
Sharpened arrows of a warrior, with burning coals of broom.
Woe to me, that I have sojourned in Meshech, that I have dwelt among the tents of Kedar!
Long has my being dwelt with one who hates peace.
I am peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

psalms_121.t: I lift up my eyes to the mountains: from where will my help come?
My help is from with YHWH, maker of the heavens and the earth.
He will not let your foot slip; he who guards you will not slumber.
Look, he will not slumber and will not sleep, the guardian of Israel.
YHWH is your guardian; YHWH is your shade at your right hand.
By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon in the night.
YHWH will guard you from all harm; he will guard your being.
YHWH will guard your going out and your coming in, from now and for ever.

psalms_122.t: A song of the ascents. Of David.
I rejoiced in those who said to me, Let us go to the house of YHWH.
Our feet have been standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem, which is built like a city that is joined together to itself,
where the tribes went up, the tribes of Yah, a testimony to Israel, to give thanks to the name of YHWH.
For there thrones sat for judgement, thrones for the house of David.
Ask for the peace of Jerusalem: may those who love you be at ease.
May peace be within your rampart, ease within your fortresses.
For the sake of my brothers and my friends I will say, please, Peace be within you.
For the sake of the house of YHWH our God I will seek good for you.

psalms_123.t: To you I have lifted up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.
Look — as the eyes of slaves are to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are to YHWH our God, until he shows us favour.
Show us favour, YHWH, show us favour, for we have been surfeited with contempt.
Long has our being been surfeited with the mockery of the complacent, with the contempt of the arrogant.

psalms_124.t: A song of the ascents. Of David.
If it had not been YHWH who was for us — let Israel say it —
if it had not been YHWH who was for us when humankind rose up against us,
then they would have swallowed us alive, when their anger burned against us;
then the waters would have overflowed us, a torrent would have passed over our being;
then they would have passed over our being — the raging waters.
Blessed be YHWH, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
Our being has escaped like a bird from the snare of fowlers; the snare was broken, and we escaped.
Our help is in the name of YHWH, maker of the heavens and the earth.

psalms_125.t: Those who trust in YHWH are like Mount Zion, which will not be shaken; it remains for ever.
Jerusalem — mountains are around her, and YHWH is around his people, from now and for ever.
For the sceptre of wickedness will not rest on the allotted portion of the righteous, so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands in injustice.
Do good, YHWH, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts.
But those who turn aside to their twisting ways — YHWH will lead them away with those who do wickedness. Peace be on Israel.

psalms_126.t: When YHWH restored the restoration of Zion, we were like those who dream.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, YHWH has done great things with these.
YHWH has done great things with us; we were joyful.
Restore, YHWH, our captivity, like stream-beds in the Negev.
Those who sow with tears will reap with a shout of joy.
Going, he will go and weep, carrying the bag of seed; coming, he will come with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves.

psalms_127.t: A song of the ascents. Of Solomon.
If YHWH does not build a house, its builders have toiled on it in vain. If YHWH does not watch over a city, the watchman has kept awake in vain.
It is in vain for you, you who rise early, who delay sitting down, who eat the bread of toils — for so he gives to his beloved sleep.
Look, sons are the inheritance of YHWH; the fruit of the womb is a reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are the sons of one's youth.
How blessed is the man who has filled his quiver with them! They will not be ashamed when they speak with enemies in the gate.

psalms_128.t: How blessed is everyone who fears YHWH, who walks in his ways.
The product of your hands — you will surely eat it; how blessed you are, and it will be well with you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house; your children like shoots of olive trees all around your table.
Look, for so will a man be blessed who fears YHWH.
May YHWH bless you from Zion, and may you look on the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
And may you see children of your children. Peace be on Israel.

psalms_129.t: Long have they opposed me from my youth — let Israel say it —
long have they opposed me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.
On my back plowmen have plowed; they have made their furrows long.
YHWH is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
Let them be ashamed and turned back, all who hate Zion.
