Let them be like the grass of the roofs, which withers before it is drawn out;
with which a reaper has not filled his hand, nor one who binds sheaves his bosom.
And those who pass by do not say, The blessing of YHWH be on you; we bless you in the name of YHWH.

psalms_130.t: From the depths I have called on you, YHWH.
Lord, hear my voice; let your ears be attentive to the sound of my supplications.
If you should keep iniquities, Yah, Lord, who could stand?
But with you there is forgiveness, so that you may be feared.
I have waited for YHWH; my being has waited, and for his word I have hoped.
My being is for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, watchmen for the morning.
Hope, Israel, in YHWH, for with YHWH is the steadfast love, and with him is abundant ransom.
And he will ransom Israel from all its iniquities.

psalms_131.t: A song of the ascents. Of David.
YHWH, my heart has not been lofty, and my eyes have not been raised, and I have not walked in things too great and too wonderful for me.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my being, like a weaned child on its mother; like the weaned child on me is my being.
Hope, Israel, in YHWH, from now and for ever.

psalms_132.t: Remember, YHWH, for David all his being afflicted,
how he swore to YHWH, vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
If I enter the tent of my house, if I go up on the couch of my bed,
if I give sleep to my eyes, slumber to my eyelids,
until I find a place for YHWH, dwelling places for the Mighty One of Jacob.
Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let us go to his dwelling places; let us bow down at the footstool of his feet.
Arise, YHWH, to your resting place, you and the ark of your strength.
Let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your loyal ones shout for joy.
For the sake of David your servant, do not turn away the face of your anointed.
YHWH swore to David in faithfulness — he will not turn back from it: One of the fruit of your body I will set on a throne for you.
If your sons keep my covenant and my testimonies that I will teach them, their sons also, for ever, will sit on a throne for you.
For YHWH has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his dwelling.
This is my resting place for ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
Her provision I will surely bless; her needy I will satisfy with food.
And her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her loyal ones will surely shout for joy.
There I will make a horn sprout for David; I have set in order a lamp for my anointed.
His enemies I will clothe with shame, but on him his crown will shine.

psalms_133.t: A song of the ascents. Of David.
Look, how good and how pleasant is the dwelling of brothers together!
Like the good oil on the head, running down on the beard, the beard of Aaron, that runs down on the mouth of his robes;
like the dew of Hermon that runs down on the mountains of Zion. For there YHWH commanded the blessing, life for ever.

psalms_134.t: Look, bless YHWH, all you servants of YHWH, who stand in the house of YHWH in the nights.
Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless YHWH.
May YHWH bless you from Zion, maker of the heavens and the earth.

psalms_135.t: Hallelujah. Praise the name of YHWH; praise, servants of YHWH,
who stand in the house of YHWH, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise Yah, for YHWH is good; make music to his name, for it is pleasant.
For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
For I know that YHWH is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
All that YHWH desires he does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the deeps.
He brings up clouds from the end of the earth; he makes lightning for the rain; he brings out wind from his storehouses.
who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, from humankind to beast;
he sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and against all his servants;
who struck down many nations and killed mighty kings —
Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.
YHWH, your name is for ever; YHWH, your remembrance is to generation and generation.
For YHWH will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of the hands of humankind.
They have a mouth, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see;
they have ears, but they do not give ear; also there is no breath at all in their mouth.
Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.
House of Israel, bless YHWH; house of Aaron, bless YHWH;
house of Levi, bless YHWH; you who fear YHWH, bless YHWH.
Blessed be YHWH from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

psalms_136.t: Give thanks to YHWH, for he is good; for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his steadfast love is for ever.
To him who alone does great wonders, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who made the heavens by understanding, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who spread out the earth on the waters, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who made the great lights, for his steadfast love is for ever;
the sun for dominion in the day, for his steadfast love is for ever;
the moon and stars for dominions in the night, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who struck Egypt in their firstborn, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and brought Israel out from among them, for his steadfast love is for ever;
with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who cut the Sea of Reeds into pieces, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and made Israel pass through the middle of it, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and shook off Pharaoh and his army in the Sea of Reeds, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who led his people in the wilderness, for his steadfast love is for ever;
to him who struck down great kings, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and killed mighty kings, for his steadfast love is for ever;
Sihon king of the Amorites, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and Og king of Bashan, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and gave their land as an inheritance, for his steadfast love is for ever;
an inheritance to Israel his servant, for his steadfast love is for ever;
who in our low condition remembered us, for his steadfast love is for ever;
and rescued us from our foes, for his steadfast love is for ever;
who gives food to all flesh, for his steadfast love is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for his steadfast love is for ever.

psalms_137.t: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and also wept when we remembered Zion.
On the poplars in its midst we hung up our lyres.
For there our captors asked us for words of a song, and our mockers for gladness: Sing for us one of the songs of Zion!
How can we sing the song of YHWH on foreign ground?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget.
Let my tongue cleave to my palate if I do not remember you, if I do not lift up Jerusalem above the chief of my joy.
Remember, YHWH, against the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem, those who said, Lay it bare, lay it bare, down to the foundation in it!
Daughter of Babylon, you who are to be destroyed, how blessed is the one who repays you the dealing you dealt to us!
How blessed is the one who seizes and smashes your infants against the rock!

psalms_138.t: I will give you thanks with all my heart; before the gods I will make music to you.
I will bow down to the temple of your holiness and give thanks to your name for your steadfast love and for your faithfulness; for you have made your speech great above all your name.
On the day I called, you answered me; you made me bold with strength in my being.
All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, YHWH, for they have heard the sayings of your mouth,
and they will sing of the ways of YHWH, for great is the glory of YHWH.
For YHWH is exalted, yet he sees the lowly, and the proud he knows from afar.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, you give me life; against the anger of my enemies you stretch out your hand, and your right hand saves me.
YHWH will accomplish for me; YHWH, your steadfast love is for ever — do not abandon the works of your hands.

psalms_139.t: To the overseer. Of David. A psalm.
YHWH, you have examined me and known.
You know my sitting down and my rising up; you understand my thought from afar.
My travelling and my lying down you sift, and all my ways you know intimately.
For there is not a word on my tongue — look, YHWH, you know all of it.
Behind and in front you have enclosed me, and you have laid your palm on me.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is set on high — I cannot reach it.
Where can I go from your spirit, and where can I flee from your face?
If I ascend to the heavens, you are there; and if I make my bed in Sheol, there you are.
If I take up the wings of the dawn, if I dwell at the end of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will grasp me.
And I said, Surely darkness will crush me, and the light around me will be night.
even darkness is not too dark for you, and night shines like the day; as the darkness, so the light.
For you created my kidneys; you wove me together in my mother's womb.
I will give you thanks, because I am fearsomely wonderful; your works are wonders, and my being knows it well.
My bones were not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place, embroidered in the lower parts of the earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed substance, and in your scroll all of them were written — days that were formed, and for it one among them.
And to me, how precious are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!
If I would count them, they are more than the sand; I awake, and I am still with you.
If only you would kill the wicked, God! Men of blood, depart from me —
who speak of you with wicked intent, your enemies lift up to falsehood.
Do I not hate those who hate you, YHWH, and loathe those who rise against you?
With a completeness of hatred I hate them; they have become enemies to me.
Examine me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my disquieting thoughts.
And see if there is a way of pain in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

psalms_140.t: To the overseer. A psalm. Of David.
Rescue me, YHWH, from an evil man; from a man of violence preserve me —
those who plan evil things in the heart, all day they stir up wars.
They sharpen their tongue like a serpent; the venom of a viper is under their lips. Selah.
Keep me, YHWH, from the hands of the wicked; from a man of violence preserve me, those who have planned to trip up my footsteps.
The proud have hidden a trap for me, and cords; they have spread a net beside the track; they have set snares for me. Selah.
I said to YHWH, You are my God; give ear, YHWH, to the sound of my supplications.
YHWH the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you covered my head in the day of weaponry.
Do not grant, YHWH, the desires of the wicked; do not promote his plot — they would be exalted. Selah.
The head of those who surround me — let the mischief of their lips cover them.
Let burning coals be dropped on them; let him make them fall into the fire, into pits, so that they do not rise.
Let a man of tongue not be established in the land; let evil hunt down a man of violence with blows.
I know that YHWH will maintain the cause of the poor, the justice of the needy.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name; the upright will dwell before your face.

psalms_141.t: YHWH, I call on you; hurry to me; give ear to my voice when I call to you.
Let my prayer be established as incense before you, the raising of my hands as the evening offering.
Set a guard, YHWH, for my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
Do not turn my heart to any evil thing, to practise practices in wickedness with men who do wickedness; and let me not eat of their delicacies.
Let a righteous man strike me — steadfast love; let him rebuke me — oil for the head; let my head not refuse it. For still my prayer is against their evil deeds.
Their judges have been thrown down by the hands of a rock, and they will hear my sayings, for they are pleasant.
Like one who plows and breaks open the earth, our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
For my eyes are toward you, YHWH the Lord; in you I take refuge — do not lay my being bare.
Keep me from the hands of the trap they have laid for me, and from the snares of those who do wickedness.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I pass by.

psalms_142.t: A maskil. Of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
With my voice I cry out to YHWH; with my voice I seek favour from YHWH.
I pour out my complaint before him; my trouble I tell before him.
When my spirit faints away upon me, you know my pathway. In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
Look to the right and see — there is no one who recognises me; a place of escape has been lost to me; no one cares for my being.
I cry out to you, YHWH; I say, You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.
Attend to my cry of entreaty, for I have been brought very low. Deliver me from those who harass me, for they are stronger than I.
Bring my being out of prison, to give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will deal bountifully with me.

psalms_143.t: YHWH, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplications; in your constancy answer me, in your righteousness.
And do not enter into judgement with your servant, for no one living is righteous before you.
For an enemy has pursued my being; he has crushed my life to the ground; he has made me dwell in dark places, like those long dead.
And my spirit faints away upon me; within me my heart is appalled.
I have remembered days from of old; I have meditated on all your deeds; on the work of your hands I muse.
I have spread out my hands to you; my throat is toward you like an exhausted land. Selah.
Hurry, answer me, YHWH; my spirit is spent. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like those who go down to the pit.
Make me hear your steadfast love in the morning, for in you I have trusted. Make known to me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my being.
Deliver me from my enemies, YHWH; to you I have covered myself.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your spirit is good — let it lead me on level ground.
For the sake of your name, YHWH, give me life; in your righteousness bring my being out of trouble.
And in your steadfast love cut off my enemies and destroy all who oppress my being, for I am your servant.

psalms_144.t: Blessed be YHWH my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle;
my steadfast love and my stronghold, my high refuge and my deliverer for me, my shield, and in him I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
YHWH, what is humankind, that you have known him, a child of humanity, that you have regarded him?
Humankind is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
YHWH, bend down your heavens and come down; touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Flash lightning and scatter them; send your arrows and rout them.
Stretch out your hands from on high; set me free and deliver me from many waters, from the hand of the sons of foreignness,
whose mouth speaks falsehood, and whose right hand is a right hand of deception.
God, a new song I will sing to you; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to you,
who gives deliverance to kings, who sets free David his servant from an evil sword.
Set me free and deliver me from the hand of the sons of foreignness, whose mouth speaks falsehood, and whose right hand is a right hand of deception —
so that our sons may be like plants grown up in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars, carved for the structure of a palace;
our granaries full, providing from kind to kind; our flocks bringing forth thousands, ten thousands in our open places;
our cattle laden; no breach and no going out, and no outcry in our open places.
How blessed is the people for whom it is so! How blessed is the people whose God is YHWH!

psalms_145.t: A praise. Of David.
I will exalt you, my God the King, and I will bless your name for ever and ever.
Every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name for ever and ever.
Great is YHWH and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is beyond searching out.
Generation to generation will extol your works, and they will declare your mighty deeds.
The majesty of the glory of your splendour, and the matters of your wonders, I will meditate on.
And the might of your fearsome deeds they will tell, and your greatness I will recount.
The remembrance of your abundant goodness they will pour forth, and of your righteousness they will shout for joy.
Gracious and compassionate is YHWH, long of nostrils and great in steadfast love.
YHWH is good to all, and his compassion is over all his works.
All your works will give you thanks, YHWH, and your loyal ones will bless you.
The glory of your kingdom they will tell, and of your might they will speak,
to make known to the children of humankind his mighty deeds and the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
Your kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and your dominion is in every generation and generation.
YHWH sustains all who fall and raises up all who are bent down.
The eyes of all wait for you, and you give them their food in its time.
You open your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
YHWH is righteous in all his ways and loyal in all his works.
YHWH is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He brings about the desire of those who fear him, and he hears their cry for help and saves them.
YHWH guards all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
The praise of YHWH my mouth will speak, and all flesh will bless the name of his holiness for ever and ever.

psalms_146.t: I will praise YHWH while I live; I will make music to my God while I still am.
Do not trust in nobles, in a child of humankind, who has no deliverance.
His breath goes out, he returns to his ground; on that day his plans perish.
How blessed is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is on YHWH his God,
who made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that is in them, who keeps faithfulness for ever,
who does justice for the oppressed, who gives food to the hungry. YHWH sets prisoners free;
YHWH opens the eyes of the blind; YHWH raises up those who are bent down; YHWH loves the righteous.
YHWH watches over sojourners; the fatherless and the widow he helps up, but the way of the wicked he makes crooked.
YHWH will reign for ever, your God, Zion, to generation and generation. Hallelujah.

psalms_147.t: Hallelujah. For it is good to make music to our God; for it is pleasant — praise is fitting.
YHWH is the builder of Jerusalem; he gathers the banished of Israel.
who heals the broken of heart and binds up their wounds,
who counts the number of the stars; to all of them he calls names.
Great is our Lord and abundant in power; to his understanding there is no number.
YHWH relieves the humble; he brings the wicked low to the ground.
Sing to YHWH with thanksgiving; make music to our God with the lyre,
who covers the heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes the mountains sprout grass.
who gives to the beast its food, to the young of the raven that cry out.
He does not delight in the strength of the horse; he does not take pleasure in the legs of a man.
YHWH takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope for his steadfast love.
Extol YHWH, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within you.
who makes your territory peace; with the fat of wheat he satisfies you.
who sends his speech to the earth; very swiftly his word runs.
who gives snow like wool; he scatters frost like ashes.
who throws down his ice like crumbs — before his cold, who can stand?
He sends his word and melts them; he makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.
He declares his words to Jacob, his statutes and his judgements to Israel.
He has not done so for any nation; and as for judgements, they have not known them. Hallelujah.

psalms_148.t: Hallelujah. Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise him in the heights.
Praise him, all his messengers; praise him, all his hosts.
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars of light.
Praise him, heavens of the heavens, and the waters that are above the heavens.
Let them praise the name of YHWH, for he commanded and they were created.
And he established them for ever and ever; he gave a statute, and it will not pass away.
Praise YHWH from the earth, sea creatures and all the deeps,
fire and hail, snow and smoke, stormy wind doing his word,
the mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
the beast and all livestock, creeping things and winged birds,
kings of the earth and all peoples, officials and all judges of the earth,
young men and also virgins, old people together with youths.
Let them praise the name of YHWH, for his name alone is exalted; his splendour is above earth and heavens.
And he has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his loyal ones, for the sons of Israel, a people near to him. Hallelujah.

psalms_149.t: Hallelujah. Sing to YHWH a new song, his praise in the assembly of the loyal.
Let Israel rejoice in its makers; let the sons of Zion be glad in their king.
Let them praise his name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to him.
For YHWH takes pleasure in his people; he glorifies the humble with salvation.
Let the loyal exult in honour; let them shout for joy on their beds.
The praises of God in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
to execute vengeance on the nations, punishments on the peoples,
to bind their kings with fetters and their honoured ones with shackles of iron,
to execute on them the judgement written — that is honour for all his loyal ones. Hallelujah.

psalms_150.t: Hallelujah. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in the firmament of his strength.
Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to the abundance of his greatness.
Praise him with a blast of the ram's horn; praise him with harp and lyre.
Praise him with tambourine and dancing; praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
Praise him with cymbals of sound; praise him with cymbals of shouting.
Let everything that breathes praise Yah. Hallelujah.

ruth_1.t: And it was, in the days of the judging of the judges, that there was a famine in the land. And a man went from Bethlehem of Judah to sojourn in the fields of Moab — he and his wife and his two sons.

And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Kilion — Ephrathites from Bethlehem of Judah. And they came to the fields of Moab and were there.
And Elimelech, the husband of Naomi, died. And she was left, she and her two sons.
And they took up for themselves Moabite wives — the name of the one was Orpah and the name of the second Ruth — and they dwelt there about ten years.
And the two of them also died — Mahlon and Kilion. And the woman was left from her two children and from her husband.
And she arose, she and her daughters-in-law, and she returned from the fields of Moab, for she had heard in the field of Moab that YHWH had visited his people to give them bread.
And she went out from the place where she had been, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go, return, each woman to the house of her mother. May YHWH deal with you in steadfast love, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
May YHWH give to you, and may you find rest, each woman in the house of her husband." And she kissed them, and they raised their voice and wept.
And they said to her, "No — with you we will return, to your people."
And Naomi said, "Go back, my daughters. Why should you go with me? Do I still have sons in my inward parts, that they should become husbands for you?
Go back, my daughters, go — for I am too old to belong to a man. If I said, 'I have hope,' and even if I belonged to a man tonight, and even if I bore sons —

— would you therefore wait until they grew up? Would you therefore shut yourselves off, not to belong to a man? No, my daughters — for it is far more bitter for me than for you, for the hand of YHWH has gone out against me."
And they raised their voice and wept again. And Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
And she said, "Look, your sister-in-law has returned to her people and to her gods. Return after your sister-in-law."
And Ruth said, "Do not press me to leave you, to turn back from after you. For to where you go, I will go; and where you lodge, I will lodge. Your people, my people; and your God, my God.
Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. Thus may YHWH do to me and thus may he add, if death itself separates between me and you."
And she saw that she was determined to go with her, and she ceased to speak to her.
And the two of them went until they came to Bethlehem. And it was, when they came to Bethlehem, that all the city was stirred over them, and they said, "Is this Naomi?"
And she said to them, "Do not call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has made it very bitter for me.
I — full — I went, and empty YHWH has brought me back. Why do you call me Naomi, when YHWH has testified against me and the Almighty has done me harm?"
And Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess her daughter-in-law with her, who returned from the fields of Moab. And they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.

ruth_2.t: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband's, a man mighty of ability, from the clan of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.
And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Let me go, please, to the field and glean among the ears of grain after the one in whose eyes I find favour." And she said to her, "Go, my daughter."
And she went, and she came, and she gleaned in the field after the harvesters. And her chance chanced upon the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and he said to the harvesters, "YHWH be with you." And they said to him, "May YHWH bless you."
And Boaz said to his young man who was stationed over the harvesters, "To whom does this young woman belong?"
And the young man who was stationed over the harvesters answered and said, "She is a Moabite young woman, the one who returned with Naomi from the fields of Moab.

And she said, 'Let me glean, please, and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.' And she came, and she has stood from then, the morning, and until now — this, her sitting in the house, a little."
And Boaz said to Ruth, "Have you not heard, my daughter? Do not go to glean in another field, and also do not pass on from this one; and so you shall stay close here with my young women.

Your eyes on the field which they are harvesting, and you shall go after them. Have I not commanded the young men not to touch you? And when you are thirsty, you shall go to the vessels and drink from what the young men draw."
And she fell on her face and bowed to the ground, and she said to him, "Why have I found favour in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, and I a foreigner?"

And Boaz answered and said to her, "It has surely been told to me, all that you have done with your mother-in-law after the death of your husband: that you left your father and your mother and the land of your kindred, and went to a people whom you did not know yesterday or the day before.
May YHWH repay your deed, and may your wages be full from YHWH the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."
And she said, "Let me find favour in your eyes, my lord, for you have comforted me and because you have spoken to the heart of your maidservant — and I am not like one of your maidservants."

And Boaz said to her at the time of the meal, "Come here and eat some of the bread and dip your morsel in the vinegar." And she sat beside the harvesters, and he held out roasted grain to her, and she ate and was satisfied and had some left over.
And she rose to glean, and Boaz commanded his young men, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not humiliate her.
And also you shall surely pull out for her from the bundles and leave them, and she shall glean, and you shall not rebuke her."
And she gleaned in the field until the evening, and she beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
And she lifted it and came to the city, and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave her what she had left over from her being satisfied.

And her mother-in-law said to her, "Where did you glean today, and where did you work? May the one who took notice of you be blessed." And she told her mother-in-law whom she had worked with and said, "The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz."

And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, "Blessed be he to YHWH, who has not forsaken his steadfast love with the living and with the dead." And Naomi said to her, "The man is near to us; he is one of our redeemers."
And Ruth the Moabitess said, "He even said to me, 'You shall stay close with the young men who are mine until they have finished all the harvest that is mine.'"
And Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, and that they do not set upon you in another field."
And she stayed close with the young women of Boaz to glean until the barley harvest and the wheat harvest were finished. And she dwelt with her mother-in-law.

ruth_3.t: And Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, shall I not seek a resting place for you, that it may go well for you?
And now, is not Boaz our kinsman, with whose young women you have been? Look — he is winnowing the threshing floor of barley tonight.

And you shall wash and anoint yourself and put your garments on yourself, and you shall go down to the threshing floor. Do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
And let it be, when he lies down, that you shall take note of the place where he lies, and you shall go and uncover his feet and lie down; and he will tell you what you shall do."
And she said to her, "All that you say to me I will do."
And she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law had commanded her.
And Boaz ate and drank and his heart was good, and he went to lie down at the end of the heap. And she came in secrecy and uncovered his feet and lay down.
And it was in the middle of the night that the man trembled and twisted himself, and behold — a woman lying at his feet.
And he said, "Who are you?" And she said, "I am Ruth, your slave woman. Spread your wing over your slave woman, for you are a redeemer."
And he said, "Blessed be you to YHWH, my daughter. You have made your latter steadfast love better than the former, in not going after the young men, whether poor or rich.
And now, my daughter, do not fear. All that you say I will do for you, for the whole gate of my people knows that you are a woman of ability.
And now, though it is true that I am a redeemer, yet there is also a redeemer nearer than I.

Stay the night, and it shall be in the morning: if he will redeem you, good — let him redeem. And if he is not willing to redeem you, then I myself will redeem you, as YHWH lives. Lie down until the morning."
And she lay at his feet until the morning, and she rose before a man could recognise his neighbour. And he said, "Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor."
And he said, "Bring the shawl that is on you and hold it out." And she held it, and he measured six of barley and set it on her; and he went to the city.
And she came to her mother-in-law, and she said, "Who are you, my daughter?" And she told her all that the man had done for her.
And she said, "These six of barley he gave to me, for he said to me, 'Do not go empty to your mother-in-law.'"
And she said, "Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter falls out, for the man will not be quiet unless he has finished the matter today."

ruth_4.t: And Boaz went up to the gate and sat there. And behold, the redeemer of whom Boaz had spoken was passing by. And he said, "Turn aside, sit here, So-and-so." And he turned aside and sat.
And he took ten men from the elders of the city and said, "Sit here." And they sat.
And he said to the redeemer, "The portion of the field that belonged to our brother Elimelech, Naomi — who returned from the fields of Moab — has sold.

And I said, I will uncover your ear, saying: Acquire it before those sitting here and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem, redeem; and if he will not redeem, tell me, that I may know, for there is no one but you to redeem, and I am after you." And he said, "I will redeem."
And Boaz said, "On the day you acquire the field from the hand of Naomi, you have also acquired Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead over his inheritance."
And the redeemer said, "I am not able to redeem it for myself, lest I ruin my own inheritance. Redeem for yourself my right of redemption — for I am not able to redeem."

And this was formerly in Israel concerning the redemption and concerning the exchange, to confirm every matter: a man drew off his sandal and gave it to his neighbour. And this was the attestation in Israel.
And the redeemer said to Boaz, "Acquire it for yourself." And he drew off his sandal.
And Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "You are witnesses today that I have acquired all that belonged to Elimelech and all that belonged to Kilion and Mahlon from the hand of Naomi.

And also Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have acquired for myself as a wife, to raise up the name of the dead over his inheritance, so that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today."

And all the people who were at the gate, and the elders, said, "Witnesses. May YHWH make the woman who is coming into your house like Rachel and like Leah, who together built the house of Israel. And do ability in Ephrathah, and proclaim a name in Bethlehem.
And may your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, from the offspring that YHWH gives you from this young woman."
And Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife, and he went in to her; and YHWH gave her conception, and she bore a son.
And the women said to Naomi, "Blessed be YHWH, who has not left you today without a redeemer. And may his name be proclaimed in Israel.
And he shall be for you a restorer of life and a sustainer of your old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him — she who is better to you than seven sons."
And Naomi took the child and set him in her bosom, and she became a nurse to him.
And the women neighbours called him a name, saying, "A son has been born to Naomi." And they called his name Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
And these are the generations of Perez. Perez fathered Hezron,
and Hezron fathered Ram, and Ram fathered Amminadab,
and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon,
and Salmon fathered Boaz, and Boaz fathered Obed,
and Obed fathered Jesse, and Jesse fathered David.

song of songs_1.t: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
Let him kiss me from the kisses of his mouth, for your loves are better than wine.
For fragrance your oils are good; poured-out oil is your name. Therefore young women love you.
Draw me after you — let us run. The king has brought me into his chambers. Let us rejoice and be glad in you; let us bring your loves to remembrance more than wine. Rightly do they love you.
I am black and lovely, daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
Do not look at me because I am blackish, because the sun has looked on me. My mother's sons were angry with me; they made me keeper of the vineyards — my own vineyard I have not kept.
Tell me, you whom my being loves, where you graze, where you make them lie down at noon. Why should I be like one veiled beside the flocks of your friends?
If you do not know for yourself, most beautiful among women, go out for yourself in the tracks of the flock and pasture your young goats beside the shepherds' dwellings.
To a mare among Pharaoh's chariots I liken you, my companion.
Your cheeks are beautiful with strings, your neck with beads.
Strings of gold we will make for you, with studs of silver.
While the king was at his table, my nard gave forth its fragrance.
A bag of myrrh is my beloved to me, lodging between my breasts.
A cluster of henna is my beloved to me, in the vineyards of En Gedi.
Here you are, beautiful, my companion; here you are, beautiful. Your eyes are doves.
Here you are, beautiful, my beloved, and pleasant. Our bed, too, is verdant.
The beams of our houses are cedars, our rafters cypresses.

song of songs_2.t: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
Like a lily among the thorns, so is my companion among the daughters.
Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the sons. In his shade I desired and I sat, and his fruit was sweet to my palate.
He has brought me to the house of the wine, and his banner over me is love.
Sustain me with raisin cakes, refresh me with apples, for I am weak with love.
His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or by the does of the field: do not awaken or arouse love until it pleases.
The sound of my beloved! Here he is, coming, leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills.
My beloved is like a gazelle or the fawn of the deer. Here he is, standing behind our wall, gazing in at the windows, peering through the lattices.
My beloved answered and said to me: Arise for yourself, my companion, my beautiful one, and come away for yourself.
For here, the winter has passed; the rain has passed away, it has gone.
The blossoms have appeared in the land; the time of singing has arrived, and the sound of the turtle-dove has been heard in our land.
The fig tree has ripened its early figs, and the vines in blossom have given fragrance. Arise for yourself, my companion, my beautiful one, and come away for yourself.
My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding place of the cliff, let me see your form, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your form is lovely.
Seize for us the foxes, the little foxes that ruin vineyards — and our vineyards are in blossom.
My beloved is mine and I am his, who grazes among the lilies.
Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved; be like a gazelle or the fawn of the deer on the mountains of Bether.

song of songs_3.t: On my bed in the nights I sought him whom my being loves; I sought him and did not find him.
Let me arise now and go about in the city, in the streets and in the open places; let me seek him whom my being loves. I sought him and did not find him.
The watchmen who go about in the city found me: Him whom my being loves — have you seen him?
Scarcely had I passed from them when I found him whom my being loves. I grasped him and would not let him go until I had brought him to my mother's house, to the room of her who conceived me.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or by the does of the field: do not awaken or arouse love until it pleases.
Who is this coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with every scent-powder of the trader?
Here is his couch — Solomon's: sixty warriors are around it, of the warriors of Israel,
all of them grasping a sword, trained for war, each with his sword on his thigh against dread in the nights.
A litter King Solomon made for himself from the wood of Lebanon.
Its pillars he made of silver, its back of gold, its seat of purple; its inside was fitted out with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem.
Come out and look, daughters of Zion, at King Solomon, at the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, and on the day of the rejoicing of his heart.

song of songs_4.t: Here you are, beautiful, my companion; here you are, beautiful. Your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats that have come down from Mount Gilead.
Your teeth are like a flock of the shorn ones that have come up from the washing, all of them bearing twins, and not one among them bereaved.
Like a thread of scarlet are your lips, and your mouth is lovely. Like a slice of pomegranate is your temple behind your veil.
Like the tower of David is your neck, built in courses; a thousand shields hang on it, all the bucklers of the warriors.
Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, that graze among the lilies.
Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
All of you is beautiful, my companion, and there is no blemish in you.
With me from Lebanon, bride, with me from Lebanon you shall come. You shall look down from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of lions, from the mountains of leopards.
You have taken my heart, my sister, bride; you have taken my heart with one of your eyes, with one bead of your necklace.
How beautiful are your loves, my sister, bride! How good are your loves — more than wine — and the fragrance of your oils more than all spices!
Your lips drip flowing honey, bride; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
A locked garden is my sister, bride, a locked spring, a sealed fountain.
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruit, henna with nard,
nard and saffron, cane and cinnamon, with all the trees of frankincense, myrrh and aloes, with all the choicest spices —
a spring of gardens, a well of living water, and streams from Lebanon.
Awake, north wind, and come, south wind; breathe upon my garden, let its spices flow. Let my beloved come to his garden and eat its choice fruit.

song of songs_5.t: I have come to my garden, my sister, bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice, I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey, I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, companions; drink and be drunk, lovers.

I was sleeping, but my heart was awake. The sound of my beloved, knocking: Open to me, my sister, my companion, my dove, my perfect one; for my head is filled with dew, my locks with the drops of the night.
I have taken off my tunic — how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet — how shall I soil them?
My beloved put his hand in through the opening, and my inward parts stirred for him.
I arose to open to my beloved, and my hands dripped myrrh, my fingers flowing myrrh, on the handles of the bolt.
I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned away, had gone. My being went out when he spoke. I sought him and did not find him; I called him and he did not answer me.
The watchmen who go about in the city found me; they struck me, they bruised me. They lifted my shawl from me, the watchmen of the walls.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem: if you find my beloved, what will you tell him? That I am weak with love.
How is your beloved more than a beloved, most beautiful among women? How is your beloved more than a beloved, that you adjure us so?
My beloved is dazzling and ruddy, conspicuous among ten thousand.
His head is gold, pure gold; his locks are curls, black as the raven.
His eyes are like doves beside channels of water, washing in milk, sitting on fullness.
His cheeks are like a bed of spice, towers of aromatic herbs. His lips are lilies, dripping flowing myrrh.
His hands are rods of gold set with beryl. His body is a plate of ivory covered with sapphires.
His legs are pillars of marble, founded on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as the cedars.
His mouth is sweetness, and all of him is desirable. This is my beloved and this is my companion, daughters of Jerusalem.

song of songs_6.t: Where has your beloved gone, most beautiful among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spice, to graze in the gardens and to gather lilies.
I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine, who grazes among the lilies.
You are beautiful, my companion, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, majestic as the bannered hosts.
Turn your eyes away from before me, for they have overwhelmed me. Your hair is like a flock of goats that have come down from Gilead.
Your teeth are like a flock of ewes that have come up from the washing, all of them bearing twins, and not one among them bereaved.
Like a slice of pomegranate is your temple behind your veil.
Sixty they are, queens, and eighty concubines, and young women without number.
One is she, my dove, my perfect one; one is she to her mother, pure is she to the one who bore her. Daughters saw her and called her blessed; queens and concubines, and they praised her.
Who is this who looks down like the dawn, beautiful as the full moon, pure as the sun, majestic as the bannered hosts?
To the nut garden I went down, to look at the green shoots of the wadi, to see whether the vine had budded, whether the pomegranates had bloomed.
I did not know — my being set me among the chariots of my princely people.
Turn, turn, Shulammite; turn, turn, that we may look at you. Why will you look at the Shulammite, as at the dance of the two camps?

song of songs_7.t: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, daughter of a noble! The curves of your thighs are like jewels, the work of a master craftsman's hands.
Your navel is a rounded bowl — may it not lack mixed wine. Your belly is a heap of wheat, fenced about with lilies.
Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
Your neck is like the tower of ivory. Your eyes are pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bath-rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon, looking towards Damascus.
Your head upon you is like Carmel, and the hair of your head like purple. A king is bound in the tresses.
How beautiful you are and how lovely, love, among the delights!
This your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts like clusters.
I said: Let me climb the palm tree, let me take hold of its fruit-stalks. Let your breasts be like the clusters of the vine, and the fragrance of your nose like apples,
and your mouth like the best wine, going down smoothly for my beloved, gliding over the lips of sleepers.
I am my beloved's, and his desire is towards me.
Come, my beloved, let us go out to the field; let us pass the night in the villages.
Let us rise early to the vineyards; let us see whether the vine has budded, whether the blossom has opened, whether the pomegranates have bloomed. There I will give you my loves.
The mandrakes have given fragrance, and over our doorways are all choice things, new as well as old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.

song of songs_8.t: Who would make you like a brother to me, one who nursed at my mother's breasts? I would find you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.
I would lead you, I would bring you to my mother's house — she would teach me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the juice of my pomegranate.
His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem: why would you awaken, why arouse love, until it pleases?
Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I roused you. There your mother was in labour with you; there she was in labour, she bore you.
Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm; for love is strong as death, jealousy is hard as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a flame of Yah.
Many waters cannot extinguish love, and rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man gave all the wealth of his house for love, despising they would despise him.
We have a little sister, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
If she is a wall, we will build on her a battlement of silver; and if she is a door, we will enclose her with a board of cedar.
I am a wall, and my breasts are like the towers. Then I became in his eyes like one who finds peace.
Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon. He gave the vineyard to keepers; each would bring for its fruit a thousand of silver.
My own vineyard is before me. The thousand is yours, Solomon, and two hundred for those who keep its fruit.
You who dwell in the gardens — friends are listening for your voice. Let me hear it.
Hasten, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or the fawn of the deer on the mountains of spices.

zechariah_1.t: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of YHWH came to Zechariah son of Berekiah son of Iddo the prophet, saying:
YHWH was angry toward your fathers with anger.
And you shall say to them: Thus says YHWH of hosts: Return to me — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — and I will return to you, says YHWH of hosts.

Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Thus says YHWH of hosts: Turn back, please, from your evil ways and your evil deeds. But they did not listen and did not pay attention to me — the declaration of YHWH.
Your fathers — where are they? And the prophets, do they live for ever?

But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets — did they not overtake your fathers? And they turned back and said: Just as YHWH of hosts planned to do to us, according to our ways and according to our deeds, so he has done with us.
On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month — that is the month of Shebat — in the second year of Darius, the word of YHWH came to Zechariah son of Berekiah son of Iddo the prophet, saying:
I saw in the night, and here — a man riding on a red horse, and he was standing among the myrtles that are in the hollow, and behind him horses: red, sorrel and white.
And I said: What are these, my lord? And the messenger who was speaking with me said to me: I will show you what these are.
And the man who was standing among the myrtles answered and said: These are the ones whom YHWH has sent to go about on the earth.
And they answered the messenger of YHWH who was standing among the myrtles and said: We have gone about on the earth, and here, all the earth is dwelling and undisturbed.
And the messenger of YHWH answered and said: YHWH of hosts, until when will you not have compassion on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, with which you have been indignant these seventy years?
And YHWH answered the messenger who was speaking with me — good words, comforting words.
And the messenger who was speaking with me said to me: Proclaim, saying: Thus says YHWH of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with great jealousy,
and with great anger I am angry toward the nations that are at ease; for I was angry a little, and they helped for evil.
Therefore thus says YHWH: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion. My house will be rebuilt in it — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — and a measuring-line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.
Proclaim again, saying: Thus says YHWH of hosts: My cities will again overflow with good, and YHWH will again comfort Zion and will again choose Jerusalem.
And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and here — four horns.
And I said to the messenger who was speaking with me: What are these? And he said to me: These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem.
And YHWH showed me four craftsmen.

And I said: What are these coming to do? And he said, saying: These are the horns that scattered Judah, so that no one lifted his head; and these have come to terrify them, to throw down the horns of the nations that lifted a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.

zechariah_2.t: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and here — a man, and in his hand a measuring cord.
And I said: Where are you going? And he said to me: To measure Jerusalem, to see how much is its breadth and how much its length.
And here, the messenger who was speaking with me was going out, and another messenger was going out to meet him.
And he said to him: Run, speak to this young man, saying: Jerusalem will remain as open regions, from the multitude of people and livestock in her midst.
And I myself will be for her — the declaration of YHWH — a wall of fire all around, and for glory I will be in her midst.
Alas, alas! Flee from the land of the north — the declaration of YHWH — for like the four winds of the heavens I have spread you out — the declaration of YHWH.
Alas, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.
For thus says YHWH of hosts — after glory he sent me to the nations who plundered you — for the one who touches you touches the pupil of his eye.
For here I am, brandishing my hand over them, and they will become plunder for their own slaves; and you will know that YHWH of hosts has sent me.
Shout for joy and rejoice, daughter of Zion, for here I am, coming, and I will dwell in your midst — the declaration of YHWH.
And many nations will join themselves to YHWH on that day, and they will become a people for me; and I will dwell in your midst, and you will know that YHWH of hosts has sent me to you.
And YHWH will take Judah as his portion for an inheritance on the holy ground, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
Hush, all flesh, before YHWH, for he has roused himself from his holy dwelling.

zechariah_3.t: And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the messenger of YHWH, and the accuser standing at his right hand to accuse him.
And YHWH said to the accuser: May YHWH rebuke you, accuser! And may YHWH rebuke you, he who has chosen Jerusalem! Is this not a brand plucked from the fire?
And Joshua was clothed in filthy garments and standing before the messenger.
And he answered and said to those standing before him, saying: Remove the filthy garments from him. And he said to him: See, I have made your iniquity pass from you, and I will clothe you in robes.
And I said: Let them put a clean turban on his head. And they put the clean turban on his head and clothed him in garments, and the messenger of YHWH was standing by.
And the messenger of YHWH admonished Joshua, saying:
Thus says YHWH of hosts: If you walk in my ways and if you keep my charge, then you also will govern my house and also guard my courts, and I will give you goings among these who are standing here.
Hear, please, Joshua the high priest, you and your companions who sit before you — for they are men of a sign — for here I am, bringing my servant, Branch.

For here is the stone that I have set before Joshua — on one stone are seven eyes. Here I am, engraving its engraving — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
On that day — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — you will invite each one his neighbour to under a vine and to under a fig tree.

zechariah_4.t: And the messenger who was speaking with me returned and roused me, like a man who is roused from his sleep.

And he said to me: What are you seeing? And I said: I see, and here — a lampstand, all of it gold, and a bowl on its top, and its seven lamps on it, seven and seven pipes for the lamps that are on its top.
And two olive trees are by it, one at the right of the bowl and one at its left.
And I answered and said to the messenger who was speaking with me, saying: What are these, my lord?
And the messenger who was speaking with me answered and said to me: Do you not know what these are? And I said: No, my lord.
And he answered and said to me, saying: This is the word of YHWH to Zerubbabel, saying: Not by strength and not by power, but by my spirit, says YHWH of hosts.
Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel — level ground! And he will bring out the top stone with shouts of Favour, favour to it!
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
The hands of Zerubbabel have founded this house, and his hands will finish it; and you will know that YHWH of hosts has sent me to you.
For who has despised the day of small things? And they will rejoice and see the tin stone in the hand of Zerubbabel. These seven are the eyes of YHWH; they are roving about in all the earth.
And I answered and said to him: What are these two olive trees, at the right of the lampstand and at its left?
And I answered a second time and said to him: What are these two clusters of the olive trees that are beside the two golden pipes, which are pouring out the gold from upon them?
And he said to me, saying: Do you not know what these are? And I said: No, my lord.
And he said: These are the two sons of the fresh oil, who stand by the Lord of all the earth.

zechariah_5.t: And I turned and lifted up my eyes and saw, and here — a flying scroll.
And he said to me: What are you seeing? And I said: I am seeing a flying scroll; its length is twenty by the cubit and its breadth ten by the cubit.

And he said to me: This is the curse that goes forth over the face of all the land; for everyone who steals has been purged away from this side according to it, and everyone who swears has been purged away from this side according to it.

I have sent it forth — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — and it will go into the house of the thief and into the house of the one who swears by my name falsely; and it will lodge in the midst of his house and destroy it, both its timbers and its stones.
And the messenger who was speaking with me went out and said to me: Lift up your eyes, please, and see what this is that goes forth.
And I said: What is it? And he said: This is the ephah that goes forth. And he said: This is their appearance in all the land.
And here — a round cover of lead was lifted, and this was one woman sitting in the midst of the ephah.
And he said: This is Wickedness. And he threw her into the midst of the ephah and threw the weight of lead onto its mouth.

And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and here — two women going forth, and wind was in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of the stork. And they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.
And I said to the messenger who was speaking with me: Where are they taking the ephah?
And he said to me: To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; and it will be prepared, and it will be set down there on its own stand.

zechariah_6.t: And I turned and lifted up my eyes and saw, and here — four chariots coming forth from between the two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
With the first chariot were red horses, and with the second chariot black horses,
and with the third chariot white horses, and with the fourth chariot dappled horses — strong ones.
And I answered and said to the messenger who was speaking with me: What are these, my lord?
And the messenger answered and said to me: These are the four winds of the heavens, going forth from presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.
The one with the black horses is going out to the land of the north, and the white have gone out after them, and the dappled have gone out to the land of the south.
And the strong ones have gone out and have sought to go, to go about on the earth. And he said: Go, go about on the earth. And they went about on the earth.
And he called out to me and spoke to me, saying: See, those going out to the land of the north have caused my spirit to rest in the land of the north.
And the word of YHWH came to me, saying:
Take from the exiles — from Heldai and from Tobiah and from Jedaiah — and you yourself shall go on that day, and you shall go to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah, who have come from Babylon.
And you shall take silver and gold and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest.
And you shall say to him, saying: Thus says YHWH of hosts, saying: Here is a man — Branch is his name — and from under him he will sprout, and he will build the temple of YHWH.

And he himself will build the temple of YHWH, and he himself will bear majesty, and he will sit and rule on his throne; and there will be a priest on his throne, and a counsel of peace will be between the two of them.
And the crowns will be for Helem and for Tobiah and for Jedaiah and for Hen son of Zephaniah, as a memorial in the temple of YHWH.
And distant ones will come and build in the temple of YHWH, and you will know that YHWH of hosts has sent me to you. And it will be, if you diligently listen to the voice of YHWH your God —

zechariah_7.t: And it was in the fourth year of Darius the king that the word of YHWH came to Zechariah, on the fourth of the ninth month, in Kislev.
And Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech and his men to entreat the face of YHWH,
to say to the priests who belonged to the house of YHWH of hosts, and to the prophets, saying: Shall I weep in the fifth month, consecrating myself, as I have done these many years?
And the word of YHWH of hosts came to me, saying:
Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying: When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month, and this seventy years — did you really fast for me, for me?
And when you eat and when you drink, is it not you who are the eaters and you who are the drinkers?
Are these not the words that YHWH proclaimed by the hand of the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and at ease, and her cities around her, and the Negev and the Shephelah were inhabited?
And the word of YHWH came to Zechariah, saying:
Thus says YHWH of hosts, saying: Judge a judgement of faithfulness, and do loyalty and compassion, each with his brother.
And do not oppress the widow and the fatherless, the sojourner and the poor; and do not plan the harm of each one's brother in your heart.
But they refused to pay attention and gave a stubborn shoulder, and they made their ears heavy from hearing.
And they made their heart flint, from hearing the law and the words that YHWH of hosts had sent by his spirit by the hand of the former prophets. And there was great anger from YHWH of hosts.
And it was: just as he called and they did not listen, so they called and I did not listen, says YHWH of hosts.

And I stormed them away over all the nations that they had not known, and the land was desolate behind them, with no one passing through and no one returning; and they made a land of desire into a waste.

zechariah_8.t: And the word of YHWH of hosts came, saying:
Thus says YHWH of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and with great rage I am jealous for her.
Thus says YHWH: I have returned to Zion and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and Jerusalem will be called the City of Faithfulness, and the mountain of YHWH of hosts the Holy Mountain.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Old men and old women will again sit in the open squares of Jerusalem, each with his staff in his hand from the abundance of days.
And the open squares of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing in her open squares.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: If it is too difficult in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, will it also be too difficult in my eyes? — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Here I am, saving my people from the land of the east and from the land of the going-in of the sun.
And I will bring them and they will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and they will become a people for me, and I myself will become God for them, in faithfulness and in righteousness.

Thus says YHWH of hosts: Let your hands be strong, you who are hearing in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets — from the day the house of YHWH of hosts was founded, the temple, to be rebuilt.

For before those days there was no wage for a person and no wage for the animal, and for the one going out and the one coming in there was no peace from the adversary; and I sent every person, each against his neighbour.
But now I am not as in the former days to the remnant of this people — the declaration of YHWH of hosts.

For the seed of peace: the vine will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce, and the heavens will give their dew; and I will give the remnant of this people all these things as an inheritance.
And it will be: just as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.
For thus says YHWH of hosts: Just as I planned to do harm to you when your fathers provoked me to anger, says YHWH of hosts, and I did not relent —
so I have turned back and planned in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Do not be afraid.
These are the things that you shall do: Speak truth, each with his neighbour; judge with faithfulness and a judgement of peace in your gates.
And do not plan in your heart the harm of each one's neighbour, and do not love a false oath; for all these are things that I hate — the declaration of YHWH.
And the word of YHWH of hosts came to me, saying:

Thus says YHWH of hosts: The fast of the fourth, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth will become joy and gladness for the house of Judah, and good appointed times. And love faithfulness and peace.
Thus says YHWH of hosts: Yet peoples will come, and the inhabitants of many cities;
and the inhabitants of one city will go to another, saying: Let us go, let us surely go, to entreat the face of YHWH and to seek YHWH of hosts. I will go, I too.
And many peoples and mighty nations will come to seek YHWH of hosts in Jerusalem and to entreat the face of YHWH.

Thus says YHWH of hosts: In those days, ten men from all the tongues of the nations will take hold — they will take hold of the skirt of a Jewish man, saying: Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.

zechariah_9.t: The oracle of the word of YHWH: It is against the land of Hadrach, and Damascus is its resting place; for to YHWH belongs the eye of humankind and all the tribes of Israel.
and also Hamath, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, for she is very wise.
And Tyre built a fortification for herself and heaped up silver like dust and gold like the mud of the streets.
Here, the Lord will dispossess her and strike her wealth into the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.
Ashkelon will see and be afraid, and Gaza, and she will writhe greatly, and Ekron, for her object of confidence has been shamed. And a king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
And a mixed people will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
And I will remove his bloods from his mouth and his detestable things from between his teeth; and he too will be left for our God, and he will be like a chief in Judah, and Ekron like a Jebusite.
And I will encamp at my house as a guard against the one passing through and the one returning, and no oppressor will pass over them again, for now I have seen with my own eyes.
Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout aloud, daughter of Jerusalem! Here, your king comes to you: righteous and saved is he, poor and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of she-donkeys.

And I will cut off chariotry from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations, and his dominion will be from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
Also you — by the blood of your covenant I have set your prisoners free from the pit in which there is no water.
Return to the stronghold, prisoners of the hope! Also today I am declaring: double I will restore to you.
For I have bent Judah for myself as a bow, I have filled it with Ephraim, and I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like the sword of a warrior.
And YHWH will appear over them, and his arrow will go forth like the lightning; and Lord YHWH will blow the horn and go in the storm winds of the south.
YHWH of hosts will shield them, and they will devour and subdue the sling-stones; and they will drink and be in an uproar as with wine, and be full like the basin, like the corners of the altar.
And YHWH their God will save them on that day as the flock of his people; for they are stones of a crown, glittering over his ground.
For how great is his goodness, and how great his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

zechariah_10.t: Ask rain from YHWH at the time of the spring rain — YHWH who makes thunder-clouds; and he gives them rain of downpour, to each one vegetation in the field.

For the teraphim speak wickedness and the diviners see falsehood, and they speak dreams of emptiness; with futility they comfort. Therefore they have set out like a flock; they are afflicted, for there is no shepherd.
My anger has burned against the shepherds, and I will visit upon the he-goats; for YHWH of hosts has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them like his horse of majesty in the battle.
From him a corner, from him a peg, from him a bow of war, from him will come forth every ruler together.
And they will be like warriors, treading down in the mud of the streets in the battle; and they will fight, for YHWH is with them, and they will put to shame the riders of horses.

And I will make the house of Judah strong, and the house of Joseph I will save, and I will restore them, for I have had compassion on them; and they will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am YHWH their God and I will answer them.
And Ephraim will be like a warrior, and their heart will be glad as with wine; and their children will see and be glad, their heart will rejoice in YHWH.
I will whistle for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them; and they will multiply as they multiplied.
And I will sow them among the peoples, and in the distant places they will remember me; and they will live with their children and return.
And I will bring them back from the land of Egypt, and from Assyria I will gather them, and to the land of Gilead and Lebanon I will bring them, and it will not be found enough for them.

And he will pass through the sea of trouble and strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt will depart.
And I will make them strong in YHWH, and in his name they will go about — the declaration of YHWH.

zechariah_11.t: Open your doors, Lebanon, and let fire consume your cedars!
Wail, cypress, for the cedar has fallen, for the majestic ones have been devastated! Wail, oaks of Bashan, for the impenetrable forest has come down!
The sound of the wailing of the shepherds, for their splendour has been devastated! The sound of the roaring of young lions, for the thicket of the Jordan has been devastated!
Thus says YHWH my God: Shepherd the flock of slaughter,
whose buyers kill them and are not held guilty, and whose sellers say: Blessed be YHWH, for I have grown rich! and their shepherds have no compassion on them.

For I will no longer have compassion on the inhabitants of the land — the declaration of YHWH. And here I am, delivering up each person into the hand of his neighbour and into the hand of his king; and they will crush the land, and I will not deliver it from their hand.
And I shepherded the flock of slaughter — therefore, the afflicted of the flock. And I took for myself two staffs: one I called Pleasantness, and one I called Bonds. And I shepherded the flock.
And I annihilated the three shepherds in one month. And my being grew short with them, and their being also loathed me.

And I said: I will not shepherd you. The one that is dying, let it die; and the one that is being destroyed, let it be destroyed; and those that survive, let them devour each the flesh of her neighbour.
And I took my staff, Pleasantness, and cut it up, to break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
And it was broken on that day. And so the afflicted of the flock, who were watching me, knew that it was the word of YHWH.
And I said to them: If it is good in your eyes, give my wages; and if not, refrain. And they weighed out my wages, thirty of silver.
And YHWH said to me: Throw it to the potter — the magnificence of the value at which I was valued by them. And I took the thirty of silver and threw it into the house of YHWH, to the potter.
And I cut up my second staff, Bonds, to break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
And YHWH said to me: Take for yourself again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

For here I am, raising up a shepherd in the land: those that are being destroyed he will not visit, the young he will not seek, and the maimed he will not heal; the one that stands firm he will not sustain; and the flesh of the fat one he will eat, and he will tear off their hooves.
Woe, my worthless shepherd, who abandons the flock! A sword against his arm and against his right eye! Let his arm wither utterly, and let his right eye grow dim entirely.

zechariah_12.t: The declaration of the word of YHWH concerning Israel — the declaration of YHWH, who stretched out the heavens and founded the earth and formed the spirit of a human within him:
Here I am, making Jerusalem a bowl of reeling for all the peoples all around; and also against Judah it will be, in the siege against Jerusalem.
And it will be on that day: I will make Jerusalem a stone of burden for all the peoples; all who carry it will surely injure themselves, and all the nations of the earth will gather against her.

On that day — the declaration of YHWH — I will strike every horse with bewilderment and its rider with madness; and over the house of Judah I will open my eyes, and every horse of the peoples I will strike with blindness.
And the chiefs of Judah will say in their heart: The inhabitants of Jerusalem are strength for me, by YHWH of hosts their God.

On that day I will make the chiefs of Judah like a pot of fire among wood and like a torch of fire among cut grain, and they will consume on the right and on the left all the peoples all around; and Jerusalem will remain again in her place, in Jerusalem.
And YHWH will save the tents of Judah first, so that the splendour of the house of David and the splendour of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not be great above Judah.
On that day YHWH will shield the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the one among them who stumbles will be like David on that day, and the house of David like God, like the messenger of YHWH before them.
And it will be on that day: I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

And I will pour out on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of favour and supplications; and they will look to me, the one whom they pierced through, and they will mourn over him as one mourns over an only son, and show bitterness over him as one shows bitterness over a firstborn.
On that day the mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
And the land will mourn, clan by clan, each apart: the clan of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the clan of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
the clan of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the clan of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
all the clans that remain, clan by clan, each apart, and their wives apart.

zechariah_13.t: On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for impurity.

And it will be on that day — the declaration of YHWH of hosts — that I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, and they will not be remembered again; and also the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness I will make pass from the land.

And it will be, when anyone still prophesies, that his father and his mother who begot him will say to him: You shall not live, for you have spoken falsehood in the name of YHWH. And his father and his mother who begot him will pierce him through when he prophesies.
And it will be on that day that the prophets will be ashamed, each of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not wear a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
And he will say: I am not a prophet; I am a man who tills the ground, for someone sold me from my youth.
And someone will say to him: What are these wounds between your hands? And he will say: Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

Sword, awake against my shepherd, and against the man of my community — the declaration of YHWH of hosts. Strike the shepherd, and let the flock be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
And it will be in all the land — the declaration of YHWH — that two parts in it will be cut off and perish, and the third will be left in it.

And I will bring the third into the fire and refine them as one refines silver, and test them as one tests gold. It will call on my name and I will answer it. I will say: It is my people; and it will say: YHWH is my God.

zechariah_14.t: Here, a day is coming for YHWH, and your plunder will be divided in your midst.

And I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem for the battle; and the city will be captured, and the houses plundered, and the women lain with; and half the city will go out into exile, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
And YHWH will go forth and fight against those nations, as on the day of his fighting, on a day of battle.

And his feet will stand on that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in half, from east to west, a very great valley; and half of the mountain will move northward and half of it southward.

And you will flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains will reach to Azal; and you will flee as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. And YHWH my God will come, all the holy ones with him.
And it will be on that day: there will be no light — the splendid ones will congeal.
And there will be one day — it is known to YHWH — not day and not night; and it will be that at the time of evening there will be light.
And it will be on that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea; in summer and in winter it will be.
And YHWH will become king over all the earth. On that day YHWH will be one, and his name one.

All the land will be changed like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will rise and remain in her place, from the Gate of Benjamin to the place of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king's winepresses.
And they will dwell in her, and there will be no more devoting to destruction; and Jerusalem will remain in security.

And this will be the plague with which YHWH will strike all the peoples that waged war against Jerusalem: he will make his flesh rot while he is standing on his feet, and his eyes will rot in their sockets, and his tongue will rot in their mouth.
And it will be on that day that a great panic from YHWH will be among them; and each will take hold of the hand of his neighbour, and his hand will go up against the hand of his neighbour.
