And Judah too will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about will be gathered — gold and silver and garments in very great abundance.
And so will be the plague of the horse, the mule, the camel and the donkey, and of all the livestock that will be in those camps — like this plague.
And it will be that everyone who remains of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year by year to bow down to the King, YHWH of hosts, and to keep the festival of booths.
And it will be that whoever does not go up, from the clans of the earth, to Jerusalem to bow down to the King, YHWH of hosts — on them there will be no rain.
And if the clan of Egypt does not go up and does not come, then not on them — there will be the plague with which YHWH strikes the nations that do not go up to keep the festival of booths.
This will be the sin of Egypt and the sin of all the nations that do not go up to keep the festival of booths.
On that day there will be on the bells of the horses: HOLY TO YHWH. And the pots in the house of YHWH will be like the basins before the altar.

And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to YHWH of hosts; and all who sacrifice will come and take some of them and boil in them; and there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of YHWH of hosts on that day.

zephaniah_1.t: The word of YHWH that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
Gathering, I will make an end of everything from off the face of the ground — the declaration of YHWH.

I will make an end of human and animal; I will make an end of the bird of the heavens and the fish of the sea, and the stumbling-blocks along with the wicked; and I will cut off humankind from off the face of the ground — the declaration of YHWH.

And I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off from this place the remnant of Baal, the name of the idol-priests along with the priests —
and those who bow down on the roofs to the host of the heavens; and those who bow down, who swear to YHWH and who swear by Milcom;
and those who turn back from following YHWH, and who have not sought YHWH and have not enquired of him.
Hush from before Lord YHWH! For the day of YHWH is near; for YHWH has prepared a sacrifice, he has consecrated his invited ones.
And it will be, on the day of the sacrifice of YHWH, that I will visit upon the princes and upon the sons of the king and upon all who are clothed in foreign clothing.
And I will visit, on that day, upon everyone who leaps over the threshold, those who fill the house of their lords with violence and deceit.
And it will be, on that day — the declaration of YHWH — the sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, and a wailing from the Second District, and a great crashing from the hills.
Wail, O inhabitants of the Mortar, for all the people of Canaan are destroyed; all who weigh out silver are cut off.

And it will be, at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will visit upon the men who are thickening on their lees, who say in their heart, "YHWH will not do good, and he will not do harm."
And their wealth will become plunder, and their houses a desolation; and they will build houses and not dwell in them, and plant vineyards and not drink their wine.
Near is the great day of YHWH, near and hurrying exceedingly. The sound of the day of YHWH is bitter; there a warrior cries out.
A day of fury is that day, a day of trouble and distress, a day of devastation and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and thick darkness,
a day of trumpet and battle-cry against the fortified cities and against the high corner-towers.
And I will bring distress on humankind, and they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against YHWH. And their blood will be poured out like dust, and their bowels like dung.

Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the day of the fury of YHWH. And in the fire of his jealousy all the earth will be consumed, for a complete destruction, and a terrible one, he will make of all the inhabitants of the earth.

zephaniah_2.t: Gather yourselves together and gather, O nation without shame —
before the decree gives birth — the day has passed like chaff — before the burning anger of YHWH comes upon you, before the day of the anger of YHWH comes upon you.
Seek YHWH, all you humble of the land, who have done his ordinance. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be hidden on the day of the anger of YHWH.
For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon a desolation; Ashdod — at noon they will drive her out, and Ekron will be uprooted.
Woe, inhabitants of the region of the sea, nation of the Kerethites! The word of YHWH is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines: "I will destroy you, so that there is no inhabitant."
And the region of the sea will become pastures, meadows for shepherds and folds for sheep.

And the region will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; on them they will graze; in the houses of Ashkelon in the evening they will lie down; for YHWH their God will attend to them and will turn back their captivity.
I have heard the reproach of Moab and the revilings of the sons of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their territory.

Therefore, as I live — the declaration of YHWH of hosts, the God of Israel — Moab will become like Sodom, and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah: a possession of nettles and a pit of salt, and a waste for ever. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the rest of my nation will take possession of them.
This will be theirs in place of their pride, because they reproached and magnified themselves against the people of YHWH of hosts.
YHWH will be terrible against them, for he will make lean all the gods of the earth; and they will bow down to him, each from his own place — all the coastlands of the nations.
You also, Cushites — slain by my sword are they.
And he will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria; and he will make Nineveh a waste, a dry place like the wilderness.

And herds will lie down in her midst, every animal of a nation; both the desert owl and the hedgehog will lodge on her capitals; a voice will sing in the window, desolation on the threshold, for he has laid bare the cedar-work.

This is the jubilant city that dwelt in security, that said in her heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me." How she has become a waste, a lying-place for animals! Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his hand.

zephaniah_3.t: Woe, filthy and defiled one, the city that oppresses!
She has not listened to a voice, she has not accepted discipline; in YHWH she has not trusted, to her God she has not drawn near.
Her princes in her midst are roaring lions; her judges are wolves of the evening that leave nothing to gnaw in the morning.
Her prophets are reckless, men of treacheries; her priests have profaned what is holy, they have done violence to law.
YHWH is righteous in her midst; he does no injustice. Morning by morning he gives his justice to the light; it does not fail. But the unjust one knows no shame.
I have cut off nations; their corner-towers are desolate. I have laid waste their streets, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, without anyone, with no inhabitant.
I said, "Surely you will fear me, you will accept discipline, and her dwelling will not be cut off — all that I have visited upon her." But they rose early, they corrupted all their deeds.

"Therefore wait for me — the declaration of YHWH — for the day I rise up as prey; for my judgement is to gather nations, for me to assemble kingdoms, to pour out on them my indignation, all my burning anger. For in the fire of my jealousy all the earth will be consumed."
For then I will turn to the peoples a purified lip, for all of them to call on the name of YHWH, to serve him with one shoulder.
From beyond the rivers of Cush my suppliants, the daughter of my scattered ones, will bring my offering.

On that day you will not be ashamed of all your deeds by which you transgressed against me; for then I will remove from your midst those who exult in your pride, and you will no longer be haughty again on my holy mountain.
And I will leave in your midst an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the name of YHWH.

The remnant of Israel will do no injustice and will not speak falsehood, and a tongue of deceit will not be found in their mouth; for they will graze and lie down, and there will be no one making them afraid.
Shout for joy, daughter of Zion; shout aloud, Israel; rejoice and exult with all the heart, daughter of Jerusalem!
YHWH has removed your judgements; he has cleared away your enemy. The king of Israel, YHWH, is in your midst; you will not fear evil again.
On that day it will be said to Jerusalem: "Do not fear, Zion; do not let your hands drop."
YHWH your God is in your midst, a warrior who saves. He will rejoice over you with joy; he will be silent in his love; he will be glad over you with a shout of joy.
Those grieved away from the appointed feast I will gather; they were from you — a burden upon her, a reproach.
Here I am, dealing with all who afflicted you at that time. And I will save the lame, and the outcast I will gather; and I will make them a praise and a name in all the earth where their shame was.

At that time I will bring you in, and at the time of my gathering you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, says YHWH.

1 corinthians_1.t: Paul, a called apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Sosthenes the brother,

to the assembly of God, the one being in Corinth, to those made holy in Christ Jesus, to called holy ones, with all those calling on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both their [Lord] and ours:
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and Lord Jesus Christ.
I give thanks to my God always concerning you upon the grace of God, the one given to you in Christ Jesus,
that in everything you were made rich in him, in all word and all knowledge,
as the witness of Christ was made firm in you,
so that you are not lacking in any gift, eagerly awaiting the revealing of our Lord Jesus Christ;
who also will make you firm until the end, unaccusable in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Faithful is God, through whom you were called into fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

But I call upon you, brothers and sisters, through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all say the same thing and there not be splits among you, but that you be mended together in the same mind and in the same opinion.
For it was made clear to me concerning you, my brothers and sisters, by those of Chloe, that there are strifes among you.
But I say this, that each of you says: I indeed am of Paul, and I of Apollos, and I of Cephas, and I of Christ.
Has Christ been divided? Paul was not crucified on your behalf, was he? Or into the name of Paul were you baptised?
I give thanks to God that I baptised none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
so that no one may say that into my name you were baptised.
But I baptised also the house of Stephanas; for the rest I do not know if I baptised any other.
For Christ did not send me to baptise but to proclaim good news, not in wisdom of word, so that the cross of Christ not be emptied.
For the word of the cross to those perishing is foolishness, but to us being saved it is power of God.
For it is written: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the understanding of the understanding ones I will nullify.
Where is a wise one? Where a scribe? Where a debater of this age? Did not God make foolish the wisdom of this world?
For since in the wisdom of God the world did not know God through the wisdom, God was pleased through the foolishness of the proclamation to save those trusting;
since both Jews ask signs and Greeks seek wisdom,
but we proclaim Christ crucified, to Jews a stumbling-block, to the nations foolishness,
but to those called themselves, both Jews and Greeks, Christ God's power and God's wisdom.
Because the foolish of God is wiser than humans, and the weak of God is stronger than humans.
For look at your calling, brothers and sisters, that not many wise according to flesh, not many powerful, not many well-born;
But the foolish things of the world God chose, so that he might shame the wise, and the weak things of the world God chose so that he might shame the strong things,
and the low-born things of the world and the despised things God chose, and the things not being, so that he might nullify the things being,
so that all flesh may not boast before God.
But out of him you are in Christ Jesus, who became wisdom to us from God, both righteousness and sanctification and redemption,
so that, just as it is written: the one boasting, let him boast in the Lord.

1 corinthians_2.t: And I, coming to you, brothers and sisters, came not according to superiority of word or of wisdom announcing to you the mystery of God.
For I judged not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and this one crucified.
And I in weakness and in fear and in much trembling came to be toward you;
and my word and my proclamation not in persuasive words of human wisdom but in demonstration of spirit and of power,
so that your trust may not be in wisdom of humans but in power of God.
But wisdom we speak among the complete ones, but wisdom not of this age nor of the rulers of this age who are being nullified;
But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the hidden, which God foreordained before the ages for our glory,
which none of the rulers of this age has known; for if they had known, they would not have crucified the Lord of the glory.
But just as it is written: what eye did not see and ear did not hear and upon heart of human did not come up, what God prepared for those loving him.
But to us God revealed through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God.
For who of humans knows the things of the human except the spirit of the human, the one in him? So also the things of God no one has known except the Spirit of God.
But we did not receive the spirit of the world but the Spirit the one out of God, so that we may know the things freely given to us by God.
which things also we speak not in taught words of human wisdom but in taught of Holy Spirit, interpreting spiritual things to spiritual ones.
But a soulish human does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for to him it is foolishness, and he is not able to know, because it is spiritually examined.
But the spiritual one examines all things, but he himself is examined by no one.
For who knew the mind of the Lord, who will instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.

1 corinthians_3.t: And I, brothers and sisters, was not able to speak to you as to spiritual ones but as to fleshly ones, as to infants in Christ.
Milk I gave you to drink, and not food; for you were not yet able. But neither yet now are you able,
For you are still fleshly. For where among you jealousy and strife and divisions, are you not fleshly and walking according to human?
For whenever someone says: I am of Paul, and another: I of Apollos, are you not humans?
What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? Servants through whom you trusted, and to each as the Lord gave.
I planted, Apollos watered, but God was growing it;
So that neither the one planting is anything nor the one watering, but the one growing, God;
But the one planting and the one watering are one, and each will receive his own wage according to his own labour.
For of God we are co-workers; of God a field, of God a building you are.
According to the grace of God given to me as a wise master-builder I laid a foundation, but another builds upon. But let each look how he builds upon.
For another foundation no one is able to lay beside the one lying, which is Jesus the Christ.
But if anyone builds upon the foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, grass, stubble,
of each the work will become visible; for the Day will make clear, because in fire it is revealed, and of each the work, what sort it is, the fire itself will test.
If anyone's work remains which he built upon, he will receive a wage.
If anyone's work is burned down, he will be damaged; but he himself will be saved, and so as through fire.
Do you not know that a temple of God you are, and the Spirit of God dwells in you?
If anyone corrupts the temple of God, God will corrupt this one; for the temple of God is holy, which you are.
Let no one deceive himself; if anyone thinks to be wise among you in this age, let him become foolish, so that he may become wise.
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness beside God. For it is written: the one grasping the wise in their craftiness;
and again: the Lord knows the reasonings of the wise, that they are empty.
So let no one boast in humans; for all things are yours,
whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, whether world or life or death, whether things present or things coming, all things are yours,
but you are of Christ, and Christ of God.

1 corinthians_4.t: So let a human reckon us as under-rowers of Christ and household-managers of the mysteries of God.
Here moreover it is sought in the household-managers that someone be found faithful.
But to me it is for a smallest thing that by you I be examined or by a human day; but neither do I examine myself.
For nothing against myself am I conscious of; but not in this have I been acquitted; but the one examining me is the Lord.

So do not before the season judge anything, until the Lord comes, who will both illuminate the hidden things of the darkness and will make visible the counsels of the hearts; and then the praise will come to each from God.

But these things, brothers and sisters, I transformed onto myself and Apollos for your sake, so that in us you may learn the 'not beyond what things are written', so that you may not be puffed up one for the one against the other.
For who distinguishes you? And what do you have which you did not receive? But if also you received, why do you boast as not having received?
Already you are satisfied; already you grew rich; apart from us you reigned; and would that indeed you reigned, so that we also might reign with you.
For I think, God exhibited us the apostles last as death-doomed, because we became a theatre to the world and to angels and to humans.
We fools on account of Christ, but you prudent in Christ; we weak, but you strong; you glorious, but we without honour.
Until the present hour we both hunger and thirst and are naked and are struck with fists and are unsettled,
and we labour working with our own hands; being reviled we bless, being persecuted we bear up,
being defamed we encourage; as scourings of the world we became, of all things a scraping, until now.
Not shaming you do I write these things, but as my beloved children admonishing.
For if ten thousand child-minders you have in Christ, but not many fathers; for in Christ Jesus through the good news I begot you.
I call upon you therefore, become imitators of me.
On account of this I sent to you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways, the ones in Christ Jesus, just as everywhere in every assembly I teach.
But as if I am not coming to you some were puffed up;
But I will come quickly to you, if the Lord wills, and I will know not the word of the ones having been puffed up but the power.
For not in word is the kingdom of God but in power.
What do you want? With a rod am I to come to you, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

1 corinthians_5.t: Altogether it is heard that among you there is sexual immorality, and such immorality as is not even named among the nations, so as for someone to have his father's wife.
And you are puffed up, and did you not rather mourn, so that the one having done this deed might be lifted out from your midst?
For I indeed, being absent in the body but present in the spirit, have already judged as being present the one having done this thus,
in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you having been gathered and my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
to hand over such a one to Satan for destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
Not good is your boast. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?
Clean out the old leaven, so that you may be a new lump, just as you are unleavened; for also our Passover was sacrificed, Christ.
So let us keep festival not in old leaven nor in leaven of badness and wickedness but in unleavened things of sincerity and truth.
I wrote to you in the letter not to mix together with sexually immoral ones,
and not at all with the immoral ones of this world or the greedy ones and swindlers or idolaters, since then you would be obliged out of the world to go.
But now I wrote to you not to mix together, if anyone named a brother is sexually immoral or greedy or an idolater or a reviler or a drunkard or a swindler; with such a one not even to eat together.
For what to me also to judge the ones outside? Do you not judge the ones inside,
but the ones outside God will judge? And remove the evil one from among yourselves.

1 corinthians_6.t: Does anyone of you, having a matter against the other, dare to be judged before the unjust and not before the holy ones?
Or do you not know that the holy ones will judge the world? And if in you the world is judged, are you unworthy of smallest tribunals?
Do you not know that we will judge angels? Not to say things of this life?
Tribunals of this life then if you have, those despised in the assembly, these you seat?
Toward shame for you I speak. So is there not among you not one wise, who will be able to judge between his brother?
But brother with brother is judged, and this before unbelievers.
Already indeed then altogether a defeat for you it is that judgments you have with yourselves. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
But you wrong and defraud, and this to brothers.
Or do you not know that unjust ones will not inherit God's kingdom? Do not be led astray: neither sexually immoral ones nor idolaters nor adulterers nor soft ones nor male-bedders
nor thieves nor greedy ones, not drunkards, not revilers, not swindlers will inherit God's kingdom.
And these things some of you were; but you washed yourselves off, but you were made holy, but you were justified in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.
All things to me are permitted, but not all things are advantageous; all things to me are permitted, but I will not be brought under authority by anything.
Foods for the belly and the belly for foods; but God will nullify both this and these. But the body not for immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body;
But God both raised the Lord and will raise us out through his power.
Do you not know that your bodies are limbs of Christ? Having taken then the limbs of the Christ shall I make them limbs of a prostitute? May it not be.
Or do you not know that the one being joined to the prostitute is one body? For it says, the two will be into one flesh.
But the one being joined to the Lord is one spirit.
Flee immorality. Every sin whatever a human may do is outside the body; but the one being sexually immoral sins into his own body.
Or do you not know that your body is a shrine of the in-you Holy Spirit, which you have from God, and you are not of yourselves?
For you were bought of a price; glorify then God in your body and in your spirit, which are of God.

1 corinthians_7.t: But concerning what things you wrote to me: good for a human not to touch a woman;
But because of the immoralities let each have his own woman, and each woman let her have her own man.
To the woman let the man give back the owed goodwill, and likewise also the woman to the man.
The woman of her own body does not have authority but the man; and likewise also the man of his own body does not have authority but the woman.

Do not deprive one another, except perhaps out of agreement for a season, so that you may have leisure for the fasting and the prayer, and again upon the same you may be, so that Satan may not test you through your lack of self-control.
But this I say according to concession, not according to command.
But I want all humans to be as also myself; but each has his own gift from God, the one thus, the other thus.
But I say to the unmarried ones and to the widows, good for them it is if they remain as also I.
But if they do not exercise self-control, let them marry; for better it is to marry than to be burned.
But to the ones having married I command, not I but the Lord, a woman from a man not to be separated;
But if also she is separated, let her remain unmarried or to the man be reconciled; and a man a woman not to send away.
But to the rest I say, I, not the Lord: if any brother has an unbelieving woman and this one consents to live with him, let him not send her away;
And a woman, if any has an unbelieving man and this one consents to live with her, let her not send away the man.
For the unbelieving man has been made holy in the woman, and the unbelieving woman has been made holy in the brother; since then your children are unclean, but now they are holy.
But if the unbelieving one is separated, let him be separated; the brother or the sister has not been enslaved in such things; but in peace God has called you.
For what do you know, woman, if the man you will save? Or what do you know, man, if the woman you will save?
Except to each as the Lord apportioned, each as God has called, thus let him walk; and thus in all the assemblies I arrange.
Having been circumcised was anyone called? Let him not draw over. In foreskin has anyone been called? Let him not be circumcised.
The circumcision is nothing and the foreskin is nothing but keeping of God's commandments.
Each in the calling in which he was called, in this let him remain.
A slave were you called? Let it not be a care to you; but if also you are able to become free, rather make use [of freedom].
For the one in the Lord called a slave is a freed one of the Lord; likewise the one called free is a slave of Christ.
Of a price you were bought; do not become slaves of humans.
Each in what he was called, brothers and sisters, in this let him remain beside God.
But concerning the virgins a command of the Lord I do not have, but an opinion I give as having been shown mercy by the Lord to be faithful.
I consider therefore this to be good on account of the present necessity, that good for a human the thus to be.
Have you been bound to a woman? Do not seek loosing. Have you been loosed from a woman? Do not seek a woman.
But if also you marry, you did not sin; and if the virgin marries, she did not sin; but affliction in the flesh such ones will have, but I spare you.
But this I say, brothers and sisters, the season has been drawn together; what remains is, so that also the ones having wives may be as not having,
and the ones weeping as not weeping, and the ones rejoicing as not rejoicing, and the ones buying as not holding down,
and the ones using the world as not using it up; for the form of this world is passing alongside.
But I want you to be without anxiety. The unmarried one is anxious about the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
but the one having married is anxious about the things of the world, how he may please the woman,

and he has been divided. And the woman the unmarried and the virgin is anxious about the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy both in the body and in the spirit; but the one having married is anxious about the things of the world, how she may please the man.
But this toward your own advantage I say, not so that a noose upon you I may throw, but toward the seemly and well-seated beside the Lord without distraction.
But if anyone thinks to behave unseemly toward his virgin, if she is past the peak, and thus it ought to happen, what he wants let him do; he does not sin; let them marry.
But he who has stood in his heart settled, not having necessity, but has authority concerning his own will, and this he has judged in his own heart, to keep his own virgin, he will do well.
So that also the one giving in marriage his own virgin does well, and the one not giving in marriage will do better.
A woman has been bound by law for as much time as her man lives; but if also her man is put to sleep, free she is to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord.
But happier she is if thus she remains, according to my opinion; and I think also I have God's Spirit.

1 corinthians_8.t: But concerning the idol-sacrificed things, we know that all of us have knowledge. The knowledge puffs up, but the love builds up.
But if anyone thinks to have known something, not yet did he know as it is necessary to know;
But if anyone loves God, this one has been known by him.
Concerning the eating then of the idol-sacrificed things, we know that nothing is an idol in the world and that there is no God other except one.
For even if indeed there are ones called gods, whether in heaven or upon the earth, just as there are many gods and many lords,
but to us one God the Father out of whom all things and we into him, and one Lord Jesus Christ through whom all things and we through him.
But not in all is the knowledge; but some by the custom until now of the idol eat as idol-sacrificed, and their conscience weak being is defiled.
But food will not present us to God; neither if we do not eat are we lacking, nor if we eat do we abound.
But look that not somehow this authority of yours a stumbling-stone becomes to the weak ones.
For if anyone sees you, the one having knowledge, in an idol-house reclining, will not his conscience, weak being, be built up so as to eat the idol-sacrificed things?
For the weak one is destroyed by your knowledge, the brother on account of whom Christ died.
But thus sinning against the brothers and striking their conscience being weak, against Christ you sin.
Therefore if food scandalises my brother, I will never eat meat into the age, so that I may not scandalise my brother.

1 corinthians_9.t: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least to you I am; for the seal of my apostleship you are in the Lord.
My defence to those examining me is this:
Do we not have authority to eat and to drink?
Do we not have authority to take about a sister as wife, as also the rest of the apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?
Or only I and Barnabas, do we not have authority not to work?
Who ever soldiers at his own rations? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat from its fruit? Or who shepherds a flock and does not eat from the milk of the flock?
Am I speaking these things according to a human? Or does not the law also say these things?
For in the law of Moses it is written: You shall not muzzle an ox threshing. Is it about the oxen that God is concerned?
Or does he say it altogether for our sake? For our sake it was written, that the one ploughing ought to plough in hope, and the one threshing — of his hope — in hope of sharing.
If we sowed for you the spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
If others share your authority, do not we more? But we did not use this authority, but we bear all things so that we may not give any hindrance to the good news of Christ.
Do you not know that those working the holy things eat the things from the temple, those sitting beside the altar share with the altar?
So also the Lord ordered those announcing the good news to live from the good news.
But I have used none of these things. And I did not write these things so that it might be so for me; for it is better for me rather to die than — my boast, that no one will empty it.
For if I announce good news, it is not a boast to me; for necessity lies upon me. For woe is to me if I do not announce good news.
For if I do this willingly, I have a wage; but if unwillingly, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.
What then is my wage? That announcing good news I may set the good news free of charge, so as not to use up my authority in the good news.
For being free from all, I enslaved myself to all, so that I might gain the more.
And I became to the Jews as a Jew, so that I might gain Jews; to those under law as under law, not myself being under law, so that I might gain those under law.
To the lawless as lawless, not being lawless of God but in-lawed of Christ, so that I might gain the lawless.
I became to the weak weak, so that I might gain the weak; to all I have become all things, so that by all means I might save some.
And I do all things because of the good news, so that I may become a fellow-sharer of it.
Do you not know that those running in a stadium all run, but one receives the prize? So run that you may take hold.
And everyone competing exercises self-control in all things — those indeed so that they may receive a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable one.
I therefore run so, as not without aim; I box so, as not beating air.
But I strike my body under the eye and lead it as a slave, lest having preached to others I myself become disqualified.

1 corinthians_10.t: For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers and sisters, that our fathers all were under the cloud and all went through the sea,
and all were baptised into Moses in the cloud and in the sea
and all ate the same spiritual food
and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they were drinking from a spiritual rock following them, and the rock was Christ.
But with the more of them God was not pleased, for they were strewn down in the wilderness.
And these things became types of us, for us not to be cravers of evil things, as also those craved.
Nor become idolaters, as some of them, as it is written: The people sat to eat and to drink, and stood up to play.
Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed it, and there fell in one day twenty-three thousand.
Nor let us test out the Christ, as also some of them tested, and they were being destroyed by the serpents.
Nor grumble, as also some of them grumbled, and they perished by the destroyer.
And these things happened to those typically, but they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages have come down.
So the one seeming to stand, let him watch that he does not fall.

A testing has not taken you except a human one; and God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tested beyond what you are able, but will make with the testing also the way out, for you to be able to bear up.
Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
As to thoughtful ones I speak; judge yourselves what I say.
The cup of the blessing which we bless, is it not a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a sharing of the body of Christ?
Because one bread, one body, the many we are; for we all share of the one bread.
Look at Israel according to flesh: are not those eating the sacrifices sharers of the altar?
What then do I say? That an idol-sacrifice is anything, or that an idol is anything?
But that the things the nations sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become sharers of the demons.
You are not able to drink a cup of the Lord and a cup of demons; you are not able to share a table of the Lord and a table of demons.
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
All things are lawful for me, but not all things are advantageous; all things are lawful for me, but not all things build up.
Let no one seek his own thing, but each the thing of the other.
Everything sold in the meat market eat, examining nothing on account of conscience;
for of the Lord is the earth and its fullness.
If any of the unbelieving ones invites you and you want to go, everything set before you eat, examining nothing on account of conscience.
But if anyone says to you: This is temple-sacrificed — do not eat, on account of that one who disclosed it and the conscience; for of the Lord is the earth and its fullness.
And conscience I say, not one's own but that of the other. For why is my freedom judged by another conscience?
If I share by grace, why am I spoken evil of over that for which I give thanks?
Whether therefore you eat or drink or whatever you do, do all things for the glory of God.
Become blameless both to Jews and to Greeks and to the assembly of God,
as I also please all in all things, not seeking my own advantage but that of the many, so that they may be saved.

1 corinthians_11.t: Become imitators of me, as I also of Christ.
And I praise you that you remember me in all things, and just as I handed over to you the traditions you hold them fast.
But I want you to know that of every man the head is the Christ, and head of woman is the man, and head of the Christ is God.
Every man praying or prophesying having down over the head shames his head.
And every woman praying or prophesying with the head uncovered shames her head; for it is one and the same thing as the woman having been shaved.
For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn; but if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.
For a man indeed ought not to cover the head, being image and glory of God; but the woman is glory of man.
For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
for indeed man was not created on account of the woman, but woman on account of the man.
On account of this the woman ought to have authority upon the head, because of the angels.
Nevertheless neither woman apart from man nor man apart from woman in the Lord;
For just as the woman is from the man, so also the man through the woman; and all things from God.
Judge among yourselves: is it fitting for a woman uncovered to pray to God?
Or does not nature itself teach you that a man, if he wears long hair, it is a dishonour to him,
but a woman, if she wears long hair, it is glory to her? Because the hair has been given to her instead of a wrapping.
But if anyone seems to be contentious, we do not have such a custom, nor do the assemblies of God.
But instructing this I do not praise, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
For first, when you come together in assembly, I hear divisions to be among you, and in part I believe it.
For there must also be factions among you, so that the approved ones may become visible among you.
Coming together therefore you in the same place, it is not to eat a Lord's supper;
For each takes his own supper first in the eating, and one is hungry, and another is drunk.
For do you not have houses for eating and drinking? Or do you despise the assembly of God and shame those not having? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you? In this I do not praise.
For I received from the Lord what I also handed over to you, that the Lord Jesus in the night in which he was being handed over took bread,
and having given thanks he broke it and said: Take, eat; this is my body, the one for you being broken; do this for my remembrance.
In the same way also the cup after dining, saying: This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, as often as you drink, for my remembrance.
For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the death of the Lord until he comes.
So whoever eats this bread or drinks the cup of the Lord unworthily, will be liable of the body and of the blood of the Lord.
But let a human test himself, and so let him eat from the bread and drink from the cup.
For the one eating and drinking eats and drinks judgement to himself, not discerning the body.
On account of this many among you are weak and sick, and a considerable number sleep.
But if we were discerning ourselves, we would not be judged.
But being judged by the Lord we are disciplined, so that we may not be condemned with the world.
So, my brothers and sisters, coming together to eat, wait for one another.
And if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, so that you may not come together for judgement. And the remaining things I will set in order whenever I come.

1 corinthians_12.t: Now concerning the spiritual things, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be ignorant.
You know that when you were nations, to the voiceless idols, however you were being led, being carried away.
Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in God's spirit says: Jesus is accursed, and no one is able to say: Lord Jesus, except in holy spirit.
And there are distributions of gifts, but the same spirit;
and there are distributions of services, and the same Lord;
and there are distributions of workings, but the same is God, the one working all things in all.
And to each is given the manifestation of the spirit toward what is advantageous.
For to one through the spirit is given a word of wisdom, and to another a word of knowledge according to the same spirit,
and to another trust in the same spirit, and to another gifts of healings in the one spirit,
and to another workings of powers, and to another prophecy, and to another discernings of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.
And all these things the one and the same spirit works, distributing to each individually just as it wills.
For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body, so also is the Christ.
For also in one spirit we all were baptised into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we all were given one spirit to drink.
For indeed the body is not one member but many.
If the foot says: Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body — is it not on account of this any less of the body?
And if the ear says: Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body — is it not on account of this any less of the body?
If the whole body were an eye, where the hearing? If the whole hearing, where the smelling?
But now God placed the members, each one of them, in the body just as he willed.
And if all were one member, where the body?
But now many members indeed, but one body.
And the eye is not able to say to the hand: I have no need of you; or again the head to the feet: I have no need of you.
But much rather the members of the body seeming to be weaker are necessary,
and the things we think to be less honourable of the body, on these we place greater honour, and our unseemly parts have greater seemliness,
But our seemly parts have no need. But God mixed together the body, having given greater honour to the one lacking,
so that there may not be a tearing in the body, but the members may have the same care for one another.
And whether one member suffers, all the members suffer with it; whether one member is glorified, all the members rejoice with it.
And you are body of Christ and members from a part.
And whom God placed in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then powers, then gifts of healings, helps, steerings, kinds of tongues.
Not all are apostles? Not all prophets? Not all teachers? Not all powers?
Not all have gifts of healings? Not all speak in tongues? Not all interpret?
But be zealous for the greater gifts. And still according to excess I show you a way.

1 corinthians_13.t: If I speak in the tongues of humans and of angels, but do not have love, I have become a sounding bronze or a clanging cymbal.
And if I have prophecy and know all the mysteries and all the knowledge, and if I have all the trust so as to move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
And if I dole out all my possessions, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I am benefited nothing.
Love is long-tempered, is kind; love is not jealous, love does not vaunt, is not puffed up,
does not behave unseemly, does not seek the things of itself, is not sharpened, does not reckon the evil,
does not rejoice over the injustice, but rejoices together with the truth,
covers all things, trusts all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
Love never falls. And whether prophecies, they will be abolished; whether tongues, they will cease; whether knowledge, it will be abolished.
For in part we know and in part we prophesy;
but whenever the complete comes, then the thing in part will be abolished.
When I was an infant, I spoke as an infant, I thought as an infant, I reckoned as an infant; but when I became a man, I abolished the things of the infant.
For we see now through a mirror in an enigma, but then face to face; now I know in part, but then I will know fully, just as also I was fully known.
But now remain trust, hope, love, these three; and the greater of these is love.

1 corinthians_14.t: Pursue love; and be zealous for the spiritual things, but rather that you may prophesy.
For the one speaking in a tongue does not speak to humans but to God; for no one hears, but in spirit he speaks mysteries.
But the one prophesying speaks to humans building up and encouragement and comfort.
The one speaking in a tongue builds himself up, but the one prophesying builds up an assembly.

And I want you all to speak in tongues, but rather that you may prophesy; and greater is the one prophesying than the one speaking in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the assembly may receive building up.
But now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I benefit you, unless I speak to you either in revelation or in knowledge or in prophecy or in teaching?
Likewise the lifeless things giving a sound, whether flute or lyre, if they do not give a distinction to the notes, how will what is fluted or what is harped be known?
For indeed if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare himself for war?
So also you, through the tongue if you do not give a well-marked word, how will what is spoken be known? For you will be speaking into air.
There are, if it should happen, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is voiceless.
If therefore I do not know the force of the sound, I will be to the one speaking a barbarian, and the one speaking in me a barbarian.
So also you, since you are zealots of spirits, seek toward the building up of the assembly that you may abound.
Therefore let the one speaking in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
What then is it? I will pray in the spirit, but I will pray also in the mind; I will sing in the spirit, but I will sing also in the mind.
Since if you bless in spirit, the one filling the place of the untrained, how will he say the Amen at your thanksgiving? Since he does not know what you say.
For you indeed give thanks well, but the other is not built up.
I thank my God, I speak in tongues more than all of you.
But in an assembly I want to speak five words with my mind, so that I may instruct also others, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
Brothers and sisters, do not become children in your thinking, but be infants in evil, and in your thinking become complete.
In the law it is written that: In other-tongued ones and in lips of others I will speak to this people, and not even so will they hear me, says the Lord.
So that the tongues are for a sign, not to those trusting but to the unbelieving; but prophecy is not to the unbelieving but to those trusting.
If therefore the whole assembly comes together in the same place and all speak in tongues, and untrained ones or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are mad?
But if all prophesy, and some unbeliever or untrained one comes in, he is convicted by all, he is examined by all,
and so the hidden things of his heart become visible, and so having fallen on his face he will worship God, announcing that really God is in you.

What then is it, brothers and sisters? Whenever you come together, each of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation; let all things happen toward building up.
If anyone speaks in a tongue, by two or at most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
But if there is no interpreter, let him be silent in an assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
And let prophets speak two or three, and let the others discern.
But if it is revealed to another sitting, let the first be silent.
For you are able all to prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be encouraged.
And spirits of prophets are subjected to prophets.
For God is not of disorder but of peace. As in all the assemblies of the holy ones,
let the women be silent in the assemblies; for it is not permitted to them to speak, but let them be in submission, as also the law says.
But if they want to learn something, let them question their own husbands at home; for it is shameful for a woman to speak in an assembly.
Or did the word of God go out from you, or did it come down to you only?
If anyone seems to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognise the things I write to you, that it is a command of the Lord.
But if anyone is ignorant, he is ignored.
So, my brothers and sisters, be zealous to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
But let all things happen decently and according to order.

1 corinthians_15.t: And I make known to you, brothers and sisters, the good news which I announced to you, which also you received, in which also you stand,
through which also you are being saved, by what word I announced to you if you hold fast, unless you trusted in vain.
For I handed over to you among the first things what also I received: that Christ died for our sins according to the writings,
and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the third day according to the writings,
and that he was seen by Cephas, then by the twelve.
Then he was seen by more than five hundred brothers at once, of whom the majority remain until now, but some also have fallen asleep.
Then he was seen by James, then by all the apostles.
And last of all, as to the miscarriage, he was seen also by me.
For I am the least of the apostles, who am not sufficient to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
But by grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me did not become empty, but more abundantly than all of them I laboured — yet not I, but the grace of God with me.
Whether therefore I or those, so we proclaim and so you trusted.
But if Christ is proclaimed that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of dead ones?
And if there is no resurrection of dead ones, neither has Christ been raised;
and if Christ has not been raised, then empty also is our proclamation, and empty also your trust.
And we are found also false witnesses of God, because we witnessed against God that he raised the Christ, whom he did not raise, if indeed dead ones are not raised.
For if dead ones are not raised, neither has Christ been raised;
and if Christ has not been raised, futile is your trust, you are still in your sins;
Then also those having fallen asleep in Christ perished.
If in this life in Christ we are ones having hoped only, we are more pitiable than all humans.
But now Christ has been raised from the dead, firstfruit of those having fallen asleep.
For since through a human is death, also through a human is resurrection of dead ones.
For just as in Adam all die, so also in the Christ all will be made alive.
But each in his own rank: firstfruit Christ, then those of the Christ at his arrival.
Then the end, whenever he hands over the kingdom to the God and Father, whenever he abolishes every rule and every authority and power.
For he must reign until he puts all the enemies under his feet.
Last enemy is abolished, death.
For he subjected all things under his feet. But whenever it says that all things have been subjected, it is clear that it is except the one having subjected all things to him.
But whenever all things are subjected to him, then also the Son himself will be subjected to the one having subjected all things to him, so that God may be all things in all.
Since what will they do, the ones being baptised on behalf of the dead? If dead ones are not raised at all, why also are they baptised on behalf of them?
Why also are we in danger every hour?
Daily I die — by the boasting of you, brothers, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.
If according to a human I fought beasts in Ephesus, what is the benefit to me? If dead ones are not raised, let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
Do not be led astray: bad companionships corrupt good habits.
Sober up rightly and do not sin; for some have ignorance of God; toward your shame I speak.
But someone will say: How are the dead raised? And with what sort of body do they come?
Fool, what you sow is not made alive unless it dies;
and what you sow, you do not sow the body that will be, but a naked grain, if it should happen, of wheat or of some of the rest;
But God gives to it a body just as he willed, and to each of the seeds its own body.
Not all flesh is the same flesh, but one flesh of humans, and another flesh of animals, and another of birds, and another of fish.
And bodies heavenly and bodies earthly; but different is the glory of the heavenly ones, and different that of the earthly.
One glory of sun, and another glory of moon, and another glory of stars; for star differs from star in glory.
So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in decay, it is raised in incorruption;
it is sown in dishonour, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;
it is sown a soulish body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a soulish body, there is also a spiritual one.
So also it is written: The first human Adam became into a living soul; the last Adam into a life-making spirit.
But not first the spiritual but the soulish, then the spiritual.
The first human from earth, dusty; the second human the Lord from heaven.
As the dusty one, such also the dusty ones; and as the heavenly one, such also the heavenly ones.
And just as we bore the image of the dusty one, we will also bear the image of the heavenly one.
And this I say, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood is not able to inherit a kingdom of God, nor does the decay inherit the incorruption.
Behold, a mystery I tell you: we shall not all sleep, but we all shall be changed,
in an indivisible moment, in a blink of an eye, at the last trumpet; for it will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
For this decaying must put on incorruption, and this dying must put on deathlessness.
But whenever this decaying puts on incorruption and this dying puts on deathlessness, then will happen the word that is written: Death was swallowed up into victory.
Where of you, death, the victory? Where of you, death, the sting?
And the sting of death is the sin, and the power of the sin is the law.
But to God be thanks, the one giving us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
So, my beloved brothers and sisters, become settled, unmoved, abounding in the work of the Lord always, knowing that your labour is not empty in the Lord.

1 corinthians_16.t: And concerning the collection for the holy ones, just as I ordered the assemblies of Galatia, so also you do.
According to one of the sabbath, let each of you put aside by himself, storing up whatever he may be prospered in, so that whenever I come, then collections do not happen.
And whenever I arrive, whomever you approve, these I will send through letters to carry away your grace to Jerusalem.
And if it is worthy for me also to go, they will go with me.
And I will come to you whenever I pass through Macedonia; for I am passing through Macedonia,
and with you perhaps I will remain or even winter, so that you may send me forward wherever I go.
For I do not want to see you now in passing; for I hope to remain some time with you, if the Lord permits.
And I will remain in Ephesus until the Pentecost;
for a door has opened to me great and effective, and there are many opposing.
And if Timothy comes, see that he becomes fearless with you; for the work of the Lord he works, as I also.
Let no one therefore despise him; and send him forward in peace, so that he may come to me; for I await him with the brothers.
And concerning Apollos the brother, much I urged him that he come to you with the brothers; and it was altogether not the will that he come now, but he will come whenever he has opportunity.
Be watchful, stand in the trust, act like men, be strengthened.
Let all things of you happen in love.
And I urge you, brothers and sisters — you know the house of Stephanas, that it is a firstfruit of Achaia, and they appointed themselves for service to the holy ones —
that also you be subjected to such ones, and to everyone working together and labouring.
And I rejoice at the arrival of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because these filled up your lack.
For they rested my spirit and yours. Recognise therefore such ones.
The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca greet you much in the Lord, with the assembly at their house.
All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
The greeting by my hand, of Paul.
If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Marana tha.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ with you.
My love with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

1 john_1.t: That which was from beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with the eyes of us, that which we beheld and the hands of us handled, concerning the word of the life —
and the life was made visible, and we have seen and we witness and we announce to you the life the eternal which was toward the Father and was made visible to us —
That which we have seen and we have heard we announce also to you, that also you partnership might have with us; and the partnership and the ours with the Father and with the Son of him Jesus Christ.
And these things write we, that the joy of us might be having been filled full.
And is this the message which we have heard from him and we announce to you, that the God light is and darkness in him not is, none.
If we should say that partnership we have with him and in the darkness we should walk, we lie and we do not do the truth.
If but in the light we should walk as he is in the light, partnership we have with one another and the blood of Jesus Christ the Son of him cleanses us from all sin.
If we should say that sin not we have, ourselves we lead astray, and the truth not is in us.
If we should confess the sins of us, faithful he is and righteous that he might forgive us the sins and might cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
If we should say that not we have sinned, a liar we make him and the word of him not is in us.

1 john_2.t: Little children of me, these things I write to you that not you might sin; and if anyone should sin, an advocate we have toward the Father, Jesus Christ righteous.
and he is propitiation concerning the sins of us, not concerning ours only but also concerning the whole world.
And in this we know that we have known him, if the commandments of him we should keep.
The one saying that I have known him and the commandments of him not keeping, a liar is, and in this one the truth not is.
Whoever but might keep of him the word, truly in this one the love of the God has been completed; in this we know that in him we are.
The one saying in him to remain ought, just as that one walked, also himself thus to walk.
Beloved, not a commandment new I write to you but a commandment old which you had from beginning; the commandment the old is the word which you heard from beginning.
Again a commandment new I write to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the light the true already shines.
The one saying in the light to be and the brother of him hating, in the darkness is until now.
The one loving the brother of him in the light remains, and a stumbling-block in him not is.
The one but hating the brother of him in the darkness is and in the darkness walks and not knows where he goes, because the darkness blinded the eyes of him.
I write to you, little children, because have been forgiven to you the sins on account of the name of him.
I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one from beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have conquered the evil one.

I wrote to you, little children, because you have known the Father. I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known the one from beginning. I wrote to you, young men, because strong you are and the word of the God in you remains and you have conquered the evil one.
Not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone should love the world, not is the love of the Father in him.
because all the in the world, the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the boastfulness of the livelihood, not is from the Father but from the world is.
And the world is passing away and the desire of it; the one but doing the will of the God remains into the age.
Little children, last hour it is, and just as you heard that the antichrist comes, also now antichrists many have come, from where we know that last hour it is.
From us they went out but not they were from us; if for from us they were, they would have remained with us; but that they might be made visible that not they are all from us.
And you an anointing have from the holy one, and you all know.
Not I wrote to you because not you know the truth but because you know it and because every lie from the truth not is.
Who is the liar except the one denying that Jesus not is the Christ? This one is the antichrist, the one denying the Father and the Son.
Everyone the one denying the Son neither the Father has; the one confessing the Son also the Father has.
You therefore what you heard from beginning in you let it remain; if in you should remain what from beginning you heard, also you in the Son and in the Father will remain.
And this is the promise which he promised to us, the life the eternal.
These things I wrote to you concerning the ones leading astray you.

And you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and not need you have that anyone should teach you; but as the of him anointing teaches you concerning all things, and true it is and not is a lie, and just as it taught you, remain in him.
And now, little children, remain in him, that if he should be made visible we might have boldness and not be shamed from him in the coming of him.
If you should know that righteous he is, you know that also everyone the one doing the righteousness from him has been born.

1 john_3.t: See what kind of love has given to us the Father, that children of God we should be called, and we are. Because of this the world not knows us, because not it knew him.
Beloved, now children of God we are, and not yet was made visible what we will be; we know but that if he should be made visible, like him we will be, because we will see him just as he is.
And everyone the one having the hope this upon him purifies himself just as that one pure is.
Everyone the one doing the sin also the lawlessness does, and the sin is the lawlessness.
And you know that that one was made visible that the sins of us he might take away, and sin in him not is.
Everyone the one in him remaining not sins; everyone the one sinning not has seen him nor has known him.
Little children, no one let lead astray you; the one doing the righteousness righteous is just as that one righteous is.
The one doing the sin from the devil is, because from beginning the devil sins. For this was made visible the Son of the God, that he might loose the works of the devil.
Everyone the one having been born from the God sin not does, because seed of him in him remains; and not he is able to sin, because from the God he has been born.
In this visible are the children of the God and the children of the devil: everyone the one not doing righteousness not is from God, and the one not loving the brother of him.
Because this is the message which you heard from beginning, that we should love one another;

Not just as Cain from the evil one was and slaughtered the brother of him; and on account of what did he slaughter him? Because the works of him evil were, the ones but of the brother of him righteous.
And not marvel, brothers and sisters of me, if hates you the world.
We know that we have passed over from the death into the life, because we love the brothers; the one not loving the brother remains in the death.
Everyone the one hating the brother of him a person-killer is, and you know that every person-killer not has life eternal in him remaining.
In this we have known the love, because that one on behalf of us the soul of him laid down; and we ought on behalf of the brothers the souls to lay down.
Whoever but might have the livelihood of the world and might behold the brother of him need having and might shut the inward parts of him from him, how the love of the God remains in him?
Little children of me, not let us love in word nor in the tongue but in deed and truth.
And in this we will know that from the truth we are, and before him we will persuade the heart of us,
That if should condemn us the heart, that greater is the God of the heart of us and knows all things.
Beloved, if the heart of us should not condemn us, boldness we have toward the God,
And whatever we should ask we receive from him, because the commandments of him we keep and the pleasing things before him we do.
And this is the commandment of him, that we should trust in the name of the Son of him Jesus Christ and should love one another just as he gave commandment to us.
And the one keeping the commandments of him in him remains, and he in him. And in this we know that he remains in us, from the Spirit whom to us he gave.

1 john_4.t: Beloved, not every spirit trust, but test the spirits whether from the God it is, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
In this you know the Spirit of the God: every spirit which confesses Jesus Christ in flesh having come from the God is.

And every spirit which not confesses the Jesus Christ in flesh having come, from the God not is; and this is the of the antichrist which you have heard that it comes, and now in the world it is already.
You from the God are, little children, and you have conquered them, because greater is the one in you than the one in the world.
They from the world are; because of this from the world they speak and the world them hears.
We from the God are; the one knowing the God hears us; who not is from the God not hears us. From this we know the spirit of the truth and the spirit of the wandering.
Beloved, let us love one another, because the love from the God is, and everyone the one loving from the God has been born and knows the God.
The one not loving not knew the God, because the God love is.
In this was made visible the love of the God in us, because the Son of him the only one has sent the God into the world that we might live through him.
In this is the love, not because we have loved the God but because he loved us and sent the Son of him atonement concerning the sins of us.
Beloved, if thus the God loved us, also we ought one another to love.
God no one ever yet has beheld; if we should love one another, the God in us remains and the love of him in us having been completed is.
In this we know that in him we remain and he in us, because from the Spirit of him he has given to us.
And we have beheld and we witness that the Father has sent the Son Saviour of the world.
Whoever should confess that Jesus Christ is the Son of the God, the God in him remains and he in the God.
And we have known and have trusted the love which has the God in us. The God love is, and the one remaining in the love in the God remains and the God in him remains.
In this has been completed the love with us, that boldness we might have in the day of the judgement, because just as that one is, also we are in the world this.
Fear not is in the love, but the complete love outside throws the fear, because the fear punishment has; the one but fearing not has been completed in the love.
We love him, because he first loved us.

If anyone should say that I love the God and the brother of him should hate, a liar he is; for the one not loving the brother of him whom he has seen, the God whom not he has seen not is able to love.
And this the commandment we have from him, that the one loving the God should love also the brother of him.

1 john_5.t: Everyone the one trusting that Jesus is the Christ from the God has been born, and everyone the one loving the one having fathered loves the one having been fathered from him.
In this we know that we love the children of the God, whenever the God we should love and the commandments of him we should do.
For this is the love of the God, that the commandments of him we should keep; and the commandments of him heavy not are.
Because all the having been born from the God conquers the world; and this is the victory the one having conquered the world, the trust of us.
Who and is the one conquering the world except the one trusting that Jesus is the Son of the God?
This is the one having come through water and blood, Jesus the Christ; not in the water only but in the water and in the blood; and the Spirit is the one witnessing, because the Spirit is the truth.
Because three are the ones witnessing:
the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three into the one are.
If the witness of the humans we receive, the witness of the God greater is, because this is the witness of the God that he has witnessed concerning the Son of him.

The one trusting into the Son of the God has the witness in himself; the one not trusting the God a liar has made him, because not he has trusted into the witness which has witnessed the God concerning the Son of him.
And this is the witness, that life eternal gave to us the God, and this the life in the Son of him is.
The one having the Son has the life; the one not having the Son of the God the life not has.
These things I wrote to you, to the ones trusting into the name of the Son of the God, that you might know that life you have eternal.
And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that if anything we should ask according to the will of him, he hears us.
And if we know that he hears us whatever we should ask, we know that we have the requests which we have asked from him.

If anyone should see the brother of him sinning a sin not toward death, he will ask and he will give to him life, to the ones sinning not toward death. There is a sin toward death; not concerning that one I say that he should ask.
All unrighteousness sin is, and there is sin not toward death.
We know that everyone the one having been born from the God does not sin, but the one having been fathered from the God keeps him, and the evil one not touches him.
We know that from the God we are and the world whole in the evil one lies.

We know and that the Son of the God has come and has given to us understanding that we might know the true one, and we are in the true one, in the Son of him Jesus Christ. This one is the true God and the life eternal.
Little children, guard yourselves from the idols. Amen.

1 peter_1.t: Peter, apostle of Jesus Christ, to chosen sojourners of a dispersion of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,
according to foreknowledge of God the Father, in setting-apart of spirit, for obedience and sprinkling of blood of Jesus Christ: grace to you and peace be multiplied.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the one who according to his much mercy caused us to be born again into a living hope through resurrection of Jesus Christ out of dead ones,
into an inheritance imperishable and undefiled and unfading, having been kept in heavens for you,
the ones being guarded in power of God through trust for a salvation ready to be revealed in a last time.
In which you exult, a little now, if it is necessary, having been grieved in various trials,
in order that the tested-genuineness of your trust, more precious than gold which perishes but is tested through fire, may be found for praise and glory and honour at a revelation of Jesus Christ;
Whom not having seen you love, into whom now not seeing but trusting you exult with joy unspeakable and glorified,
receiving the end of your trust, salvation of souls.
Concerning which salvation prophets sought out and searched out, the ones having prophesied concerning the grace for you,
searching for what or what sort of time the spirit of Christ in them was making clear, testifying beforehand the sufferings for Christ and the glories after these things,

To whom it was revealed that not to themselves but to you they were ministering them, which now were announced to you through those having brought good news to you in holy spirit sent from heaven, into which things angels desire to stoop and look.
Therefore, having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober, hope completely upon the grace being brought to you at a revelation of Jesus Christ.
As children of obedience, not being conformed to the former desires in your ignorance,
but according to the holy one having called you, you yourselves also become holy in all conduct,
because it has been written that 'You shall be holy, because I am holy.'
And if you call upon as Father the one judging impartially according to the work of each, conduct yourselves in fear for the time of your sojourning,
knowing that not with perishable things, silver or gold, were you ransomed out of your futile conduct handed down from fathers,
but with precious blood as of a lamb unblemished and unspotted, of Christ,
having been foreknown before a foundation of a world, but having been manifested at the last of the times for you —
the ones through him trusting toward God, the one having raised him out of dead ones and having given him glory, so that your trust and hope are toward God.
Having purified your souls in the obedience of the truth for unhypocritical brotherly love, from a clean heart love one another fervently,
having been born again not out of perishable seed but imperishable, through a word of God living and remaining,
Because 'all flesh is as grass, and all its glory as a flower of grass; the grass was withered, and the flower fell off,
but the utterance of the Lord remains into the age.' And this is the utterance that was proclaimed as good news to you.

1 peter_2.t: Having therefore put away all evil and all deceit and hypocrisies and envies and all slanders,
as newborn infants long for the reasonable unadulterated milk, in order that by it you may grow into salvation,
if you tasted that the Lord is kind.
Coming toward whom, a living stone, by humans indeed having been rejected but with God chosen, precious,
you yourselves also as living stones are being built a spiritual house for a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices well-received by God through Jesus Christ.
Because it is contained in the scripture, 'Behold, I lay in Zion a cornerstone, chosen, precious, and the one trusting upon him shall never be put to shame.'
To you therefore the honour, to those trusting; but to those disbelieving, 'a stone which the builders rejected, this one became for a head of a corner',
and 'a stone of striking and a rock of stumbling'; who strike against the word, disobeying, for which also they were appointed.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for possession, so that you may proclaim the excellences of the one having called you out of darkness into his marvellous light;
who once were not a people but now are a people of God, the ones not having been shown mercy but now having been shown mercy.
Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and sojourners to abstain from the fleshly desires, which campaign against the soul.
Having your conduct among the nations good, in order that in what they speak against you as evildoers, out of the good works, observing them, they may glorify God in a day of visitation.
Be subjected to every human creation on account of the Lord, whether to a king as being above,
or to governors as through him being sent for vengeance of evildoers but praise of good-doers.
Because so is the will of God, doing good to muzzle the ignorance of the senseless humans;
As free, and not as having the freedom for a covering of evil, but as servants of God.
Honour all; love the brotherhood; fear God; honour the king.
The household slaves, being subjected in all fear to the masters, not only to the good and gentle but also to the crooked.
For this is grace, if on account of consciousness of God someone bears up griefs, suffering unjustly.
For what kind of glory is it if, sinning and being struck with fists, you will endure? But if, doing good and suffering, you will endure, this is grace with God.
For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered on your behalf, leaving behind for you a writing-copy in order that you might follow after in his tracks.
'Who did not do sin, nor was deceit found in his mouth';
Who being reviled did not revile back, suffering did not threaten, but handed over to the one judging justly;
Who himself bore up our sins in his body upon the wood, in order that, having come away from the sins, we might live to righteousness; by whose bruise you were healed.
For you were as sheep being led astray, but you have now been turned back upon the shepherd and overseer of your souls.

1 peter_3.t: Likewise the wives, being subjected to their own husbands, in order that even if any disobey the word, through the conduct of the wives without a word they may be won,
having observed your pure conduct in fear.
Of whom let it be not the outward adorning of braiding of hair and putting round of gold pieces or putting on of garments,
but the hidden person of the heart in the imperishable thing of the meek and quiet spirit, which before God is very costly.
For so once also the holy women hoping in God adorned themselves, being subjected to their own husbands,
as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; whose children you became, doing good and not fearing any terror.
The husbands likewise, dwelling together according to knowledge as with a weaker vessel, the female, assigning honour as also to fellow heirs of a grace of life, for your prayers not to be hindered.
And the end: all of one mind, sympathetic, brother-loving, tender-hearted, humble-minded,
Not paying back evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing, because for this you were called, in order that you may inherit blessing.
For 'the one wishing to love life and to see good days, let him stop his tongue from evil and lips not to speak deceit;
and let him turn aside from evil and do good, let him seek peace and pursue it.
Because the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous and his ears toward their petition, but a face of the Lord against those doing evil.'
And who is the one who will harm you if you become zealous for the good?
But even if you should suffer on account of righteousness, blessed. But do not fear their fear nor be troubled,
but set apart the Lord, the Christ, in your hearts, always ready for a defence to everyone asking you a word concerning the hope in you,
but with gentleness and fear, having a good conscience, in order that in what you are spoken against, those reviling your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.
