For it is better, doing good, if the will of God should will it, to suffer, than doing evil;

Because Christ also once suffered concerning sins, righteous on behalf of unrighteous ones, in order that he might bring you to God, having been put to death in flesh but having been made alive in spirit,
In which also to the spirits in prison, having gone, he proclaimed,
to those having disobeyed formerly when the long-temper of God was waiting out in days of Noah, an ark being prepared, into which a few, that is eight souls, were brought safely through water.
Which also, an antitype, now saves you, baptism — not a putting away of filth of flesh but a request to God of a good conscience — through resurrection of Jesus Christ,
who is at a right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to him.

1 peter_4.t: Christ therefore having suffered in flesh on our behalf, you also arm yourselves with the same thought, because the one having suffered in flesh has ceased from sin,
for the no longer to human desires but to a will of God to live the remaining time in flesh.
For sufficient is the time having gone by to have worked out the will of the nations, having walked in licentiousness, desires, wine-drinkings, carousings, drinking bouts, and unlawful idolatries.
In which they are astonished that you do not run together into the same outpouring of wastefulness, blaspheming,
who will give back a word to the one having in readiness to judge living and dead.
For to this end also to dead ones was good news announced, in order that they might be judged indeed according to humans in flesh, but might live according to God in spirit.
But the end of all things has drawn near; be of sound mind therefore and be sober for the prayers.
Before all things having the fervent love among yourselves, because love covers a multitude of sins.
Hospitable toward one another without grumbling;
Each as he received a gift, ministering it to yourselves as good stewards of a varied grace of God;

if anyone speaks, as oracles of God; if anyone ministers, as out of strength which God supplies; in order that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory and the power into the ages of the ages. Amen.
Beloved, do not be made strangers by the burning among you happening to you for a testing, as though a strange thing were befalling you,
But according as you share in the sufferings of the Christ, rejoice, in order that also at the revelation of his glory you may rejoice exulting.

If you are reproached in a name of Christ, blessed, because the spirit of the glory and the spirit of God rests upon you; on the one hand according to them he is blasphemed, but on the other according to you he is glorified.
For let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as an overseer of what belongs to another;
But if as a Christian, let him not be ashamed but let him glorify God in this name.
Because the time is for the judgement to begin from the house of God; and if first from us, what is the end of those disobeying the good news of God?
And 'if the righteous with difficulty is saved, the ungodly and sinner — where will he appear?'
So that also those suffering according to the will of God, let them entrust their souls to a faithful Creator in good-doing.

1 peter_5.t: Elders therefore among you I urge, the fellow elder and witness of the sufferings of the Christ, the sharer also of the glory about to be revealed:
Shepherd the flock of God among you, overseeing not by compulsion but willingly according to God, nor for shameful gain but eagerly,
nor as lording it over the allotments, but becoming types of the flock.
And the chief shepherd having been manifested, you will receive the unfading crown of the glory.
Likewise younger ones, be subjected to elders; and all of you toward one another put on humility, because 'God opposes the arrogant, but to the lowly he gives grace.'
Be humbled therefore under the mighty hand of God, in order that he may exalt you in due time,
having cast all your anxiety upon him, because it matters to him concerning you.
Be sober, be watchful; your adversary, a devil, as a roaring lion walks about seeking someone to swallow down;
whom stand against, firm in the trust, knowing the same things of the sufferings to be accomplished in your brotherhood in the world.
But the God of all grace, the one having called you into his eternal glory in Christ Jesus, having suffered a little, himself will restore you, will strengthen, will make strong, will found.
To him the glory and the power into the ages of the ages. Amen.
Through Silvanus to you the faithful brother, as I reckon, through few things I wrote, urging and testifying this to be a true grace of God, into which stand.
She in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and Mark my son.
Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all, those in Christ Jesus. Amen.

1 thessalonians_1.t: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the assembly of Thessalonians in God Father and Lord Jesus Christ: grace to you and peace from God our Father and Lord Jesus Christ.
We give thanks to God always concerning all of you, making mention of you at our prayers unceasingly
remembering your work of the trust and labour of the love and endurance of the hope of our Lord Jesus Christ before our God and Father,
knowing, brothers and sisters having been loved by God, your choosing;
because our good news did not become to you in word only but also in power and in Holy Spirit and in much full assurance, just as you know what sort we became among you because of you;
And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction with joy of Holy Spirit,
so that you became a pattern to all the ones trusting in the Macedonia and in the Achaia.
For from you has sounded out the word of the Lord, not only in the Macedonia and in the Achaia, but also in every place your trust toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to speak anything.
For they themselves report about us what sort of entrance we had toward you, and how you turned toward God from the idols to slave for a living and true God
and to await his son out of the heavens, whom he raised out of the dead ones, Jesus the one rescuing us out of the coming wrath.

1 thessalonians_2.t: For you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, our entrance the one toward you, that it has not become empty;
but having suffered before and having been insulted, just as you know, in Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak to you the good news of God in much contest.
For our exhortation is not out of error nor out of uncleanness nor in guile,
but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the good news, thus we speak, not as pleasing humans but God the one testing our hearts.
For neither at any time did we come in word of flattery, just as you know, nor in pretext of greed — God is witness —
nor seeking glory out of humans, neither from you nor from others,
being able in weight to be as Christ's apostles; but we became gentle in the midst of you, as if a nurse should warm her own children,
thus yearning for you we were well pleased to give over to you not only the good news of God but also our own souls, because beloved to us you became.
For you remember, brothers and sisters, our labour and toil: for night and day working, toward not burdening any of you, we proclaimed to you the good news of God.
You are witnesses, and God, how devoutly and justly and blamelessly to you the ones trusting we became,
just as you know, how each one of you as a father his own children —
calling upon you and encouraging and testifying, for you to walk worthily of the God, the one calling you into his own kingdom and glory.

And because of this we also give thanks to God unceasingly, that having received a word of hearing from us, of God, you received not a word of humans but just as it truly is, a word of God, which also works in you the ones trusting.

For you became imitators, brothers and sisters, of the assemblies of God the ones being in the Judea in Christ Jesus, because the same things you also suffered by your own countrymen, just as also they by the Jews
the ones having killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and having driven us out, and not pleasing God, and contrary to all humans,
hindering us from speaking to the nations so that they may be saved, for the filling up of their sins always; but the wrath of God came upon them to the end.
But we, brothers and sisters, having been orphaned from you for a season of an hour, in face not in heart, more abundantly hastened to see your face with much desire.
Therefore we wanted to come to you, I indeed Paul both once and twice, and Satan hindered us.
For what is our hope or joy or crown of boasting? Or is it not also you, before our Lord Jesus Christ at his arrival?
For you are our glory and the joy.

1 thessalonians_3.t: Therefore no longer covering it, we were well pleased to be left behind in Athens alone,
and we sent Timothy our brother and servant and our co-worker of God in the good news of the Christ, for the strengthening of you and to encourage you on behalf of your trust,
for no one to be moved in these afflictions; for you yourselves know that for this we are laid down;
For indeed when we were toward you we were telling you beforehand that we are about to be afflicted, just as also it happened and you know.
Because of this I also, no longer covering it, sent for the knowing of your trust, lest somehow the one tempting tempted you and our labour became into emptiness.
But now Timothy having come to us from you and having brought good news to us of your trust and love, and that you have good remembrance of us always, longing to see us just as also we you,
because of this we were encouraged, brothers and sisters, over you upon all our necessity and affliction through your trust,
because now we live, if you stand in the Lord.
For what thanksgiving are we able to give back to God about you, over all the joy with which we rejoice because of you before our God,
night and day beyond all measure begging for the seeing of your face and to complete the lacks of your trust?
And may he himself, our God and Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, straighten our way toward you;
And you may the Lord make to increase and to abound in the love toward one another and toward all, just as also we toward you,
for the strengthening of your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the arrival of our Lord Jesus with all his holy ones.

1 thessalonians_4.t: For the rest then, brothers and sisters, we ask you and urge in the Lord Jesus that just as you received from us the how it is necessary for you to walk and to please God, just as also you walk, that you may abound more;
For you know what charges we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
For this is a will of God, your holiness: for you to abstain from the sexual immorality,
for each of you to know to acquire his own vessel in holiness and honour,
not in passion of desire just as also the nations the ones not knowing God;
for the not overstepping and taking advantage of his brother in the matter, because an avenger is the Lord concerning all these things, just as also we told before to you and solemnly witnessed.
For God did not call us upon uncleanness but in holiness.
Therefore the one setting aside does not set aside a human but God, the one also giving his Holy Spirit into you.
But concerning the brotherly love you do not have need to write to you, for you yourselves are God-taught for the loving of one another;
for indeed you do it toward all the brothers, the ones in the whole Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to abound more,
and to be ambitious to be quiet and to practise your own things and to work with your own hands, just as we charged you,
so that you may walk becomingly toward the ones outside and may have need of nothing.
But we do not want you to be ignorant, brothers and sisters, concerning the ones sleeping, so that you may not grieve just as also the rest the ones not having hope.
For if we trust that Jesus died and rose, thus also God the ones having been put to sleep through Jesus will bring with him.
For this to you we say in a word of the Lord, that we the living, the ones remaining to the arrival of the Lord, will certainly not precede the ones having been put to sleep;
because the Lord himself in a command, in a voice of an archangel and in a trumpet of God, will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first,
then we the living, the ones remaining, together with them will be snatched away in clouds for a meeting of the Lord into air; and thus always with the Lord we will be.
So then encourage one another in these words.

1 thessalonians_5.t: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers and sisters, you have no need for it to be written to you,
for you yourselves accurately know that the day of the Lord thus comes as a thief in night;
For whenever they say: peace and security, then sudden destruction stands upon them just as the birth-pang on the one having in the womb, and they will certainly not escape.
But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness, so that the day should overtake you as a thief;
for all of you are sons of light and sons of day; we are not of night nor of darkness.
So then let us not sleep as also the rest, but let us keep awake and be sober.
For the ones sleeping sleep at night, and the ones getting drunk are drunk at night;
but we being of day, let us be sober, having put on a breastplate of trust and love and as a helmet a hope of salvation;
because God did not place us for wrath but for obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
the one having died on our behalf, so that whether we keep awake or sleep, together with him we may live.
Therefore encourage one another and build up one the one, just as also you do.
But we ask you, brothers and sisters, to know the ones labouring among you and standing before you in the Lord and admonishing you,
and to consider them beyond all measure in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
But we urge you, brothers and sisters, admonish the disorderly, console the small-souled, hold on to the weak, be long-suffering toward all.
See that no one may give back evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue the good both toward one another and toward all.
Always rejoice;
Unceasingly pray;
In everything give thanks; for this is a will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
Do not quench the spirit;
Do not despise prophecies;
But test all things; hold fast the good;
From every form of evil abstain.
And may he himself, the God of the peace, make you holy wholly complete, and may your whole spirit and the soul and the body blamelessly at the arrival of our Lord Jesus Christ be kept.
Faithful is the one calling you, who also will do it.
Brothers and sisters, pray also concerning us.
Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
I adjure you by the Lord for the letter to be read to all the holy brothers.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with you. Amen. [To Thessalonians first it was written from Athens.]

1 timothy_1.t: Paul, apostle of Lord Christ Jesus according to a command of God our Saviour and of Lord Christ Jesus our hope,
To Timothy, genuine child in trust: grace, mercy, peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
As I urged you to remain in Ephesus, going into Macedonia, so that you might charge certain ones not to teach otherwise,
nor to attend to myths and endless genealogies, which furnish speculations rather than a household-management of God that is in trust.
But the end of the charge is love out of a clean heart and a good conscience and unhypocritical trust,
from which some, having missed the mark, were turned aside to empty talking,
wanting to be law-teachers, not understanding either what they say or about what they insist.
But we know that the law is good, if anyone uses it lawfully,

knowing this, that law is not laid down for a righteous one, but for lawless and insubordinate ones, for ungodly and sinners, for unholy and profane, for father-killers and mother-killers, for man-slayers,
for sexually immoral ones, for male-bedders, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and if anything else opposes the healthy teaching,
according to the good news of the glory of the blessed God, with which I was entrusted.
And I have gratitude to the one having empowered me, Christ Jesus our Lord, that he considered me trustworthy, placing me into service,
being formerly a blasphemer and persecutor and insolent man; but I was shown mercy, because being ignorant I acted in a lack of trust.
but the grace of our Lord super-abounded with trust and love that is in Christ Jesus.
Trustworthy the word and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom first am I.
But because of this I was shown mercy, so that in me first Christ Jesus might show forth the entire long-suffering as a sketch of those about to trust upon him unto eternal life.
Now to the king of the ages, incorruptible, invisible, only wise God, honour and glory unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
This charge I place alongside you, child Timothy, according to the prophecies going before upon you, so that by them you might soldier the good soldiering,
having trust and a good conscience, which some, having pushed away, concerning the trust were shipwrecked,
of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan so that they might be disciplined not to blaspheme.

1 timothy_2.t: I urge therefore first of all that petitions, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings be made on behalf of all humans,
on behalf of kings and all those being in eminence, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
For this is good and acceptable before our Saviour God,
who wants all humans to be saved and to come into full knowledge of truth.
For God is one, one also mediator of God and humans, a human, Christ Jesus,
the one having given himself a ransom-in-exchange on behalf of all, the witness at its own seasons,
for which I was placed a herald and apostle — truth I speak in Christ, I do not lie — a teacher of nations in trust and truth.
I intend therefore the men to pray in every place, lifting up holy hands apart from wrath and disputing;
likewise also the women in orderly attire with modesty and soundness of mind to adorn themselves, not with braidings and gold or pearls or costly clothing,
but — which is fitting for women professing reverence for God — through good works.
Let a woman learn in quietness in all subjection.
But to teach I do not permit a woman, nor to have authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
For Adam first was formed, then Eve.
And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been utterly deceived, has come into transgression.
But she will be saved through the childbearing, if they remain in trust and love and holiness with soundness of mind.

1 timothy_3.t: Trustworthy the word: if anyone reaches out for overseership, he desires a good work.
It is necessary therefore the overseer to be irreproachable, a man of one woman, sober, sound-minded, orderly, hospitable, apt at teaching,
not given to wine, not a striker, not greedy of shameful gain, but forbearing, not contentious, not a money-lover,
presiding over his own house well, having children in subjection with all dignity
But if anyone does not know to preside over his own house, how will he care for an assembly of God?
not newly-planted, so that having been puffed up he might not fall into a judgement of the slanderer.
But it is necessary for him also to have a good witness from those outside, so that he might not fall into reproach and a snare of the slanderer.
Servants likewise dignified, not double-worded, not attending to much wine, not greedy of shameful gain,
holding the mystery of the trust in a clean conscience.
And let these also first be proved, then let them serve, being unaccusable.
Wives likewise dignified, not slanderers, sober, trustworthy in all things.
Let servants be men of one woman, presiding well over children and their own houses.
For those having served well acquire for themselves a good step and much boldness in the trust that is in Christ Jesus.
These things to you I write, hoping to come to you quickly,
but if I delay, so that you might know how it is necessary to conduct oneself in a house of God, which is an assembly of a living God, pillar and buttress of the truth.

And confessedly great is the mystery of godliness: who was manifested in flesh, was vindicated in spirit, was seen by messengers, was proclaimed among nations, was trusted in the world, was taken up in glory.

1 timothy_4.t: But the spirit expressly says that in later seasons some will depart from the trust, attending to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons,
in hypocrisy of false-speakers, having been branded in their own conscience,
forbidding to marry, to abstain from foods which God created for reception with thanksgiving by the trusting ones and those having fully known the truth.
because every creature of God is good and nothing to be thrown away, being received with thanksgiving;
for it is made holy through God's word and intercession.
Setting these things before the brothers you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being nourished by the words of the trust and of the good teaching which you have followed closely.
But the profane and old-womanish myths refuse; and exercise yourself toward godliness.
For the bodily exercise is useful toward little, but godliness is useful toward all things, having a promise of life, of the now and of the coming one.
Trustworthy the word and worthy of all acceptance.
For unto this we both toil and struggle, because we have hoped upon a living God, who is Saviour of all humans, especially of trusting ones.
Let no one despise your youth, but become a pattern of the trusting ones, in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in trust, in purity.
Until I come, attend to the reading, to the exhortation, to the teaching.
Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying-on of the hands of the eldership.
These things practise, in these things be, so that your progress may be manifest in all.
Hold to yourself and to the teaching; remain in them, for doing this you will both save yourself and those hearing you.

1 timothy_5.t: An elder do not strike at, but exhort as a father, younger men as brothers,
elder women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in all purity.
Honour widows, the really widows.
But if some widow has children or descendants, let them first learn to be godly toward their own house and to give back recompense to their forebears; for this is good and acceptable before God.
But the really widow and having been left alone has hoped upon God and remains at the petitions and the prayers night and day;
but the one living luxuriously, living, has died.
And these things charge, so that they may be irreproachable.
But if anyone does not provide for his own and especially for household members, he has denied the trust and is worse than an untrusting one.
Let a widow be enrolled having become not less than sixty years, a woman of one man,
being witnessed to in good works, if she reared children, if she received strangers, if she washed feet of holy ones, if she relieved afflicted ones, if she followed after every good work.
But younger widows refuse; for when they grow wanton against Christ, they want to marry,
having judgement, because they set aside the first trust.
And at the same time also idle they learn, going about the houses; and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, speaking the things not necessary.
I intend therefore younger ones to marry, to bear children, to rule a house, to give no starting-point to the opposing one for the sake of reviling;
for already some were turned aside after Satan.
If any trusting man or trusting woman has widows, let him relieve them, and let the assembly not be burdened, so that it may relieve the really widows.
The elders having presided well let them be counted worthy of double honour, especially those toiling in word and teaching.
For the writing says: "An ox treading you shall not muzzle," and, "Worthy the worker of his wage."
Against an elder do not receive an accusation except upon two or three witnesses.
But those sinning reprove before all, so that also the rest may have fear.
I solemnly witness before God and Lord Christ Jesus and the chosen messengers, that you guard these things apart from prejudgement, doing nothing according to partiality.
Hands quickly on no one lay, nor share in others' sins; keep yourself pure.
No longer drink water, but use a little wine on account of your stomach and your frequent weaknesses.
Of some humans the sins are evident beforehand, going before into judgement; but for some they also follow after.
Likewise also the good works are evident beforehand, and those having it otherwise cannot be hidden.

1 timothy_6.t: As many as are slaves under a yoke, let them consider their own masters worthy of all honour, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be blasphemed.

But those having trusting masters, let them not despise, because they are brothers; but rather let them serve as slaves, because they are trusting and beloved, those taking hold of the good work. These things teach and exhort.
If anyone teaches otherwise and does not come to healthy words, those of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the teaching according to godliness,
he has been puffed up, knowing nothing, but ailing about disputes and word-fights, out of which come envy, strife, blasphemies, wicked suspicions,
constant frictions of humans corrupted in the mind and deprived of the truth, supposing godliness to be a means of gain. Stand away from such ones.
But godliness with self-sufficiency is a great means of gain.
For nothing we brought into the world; clear that neither are we able to carry anything out.
But having sustenance and coverings, with these we will be satisfied.
But those intending to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and many senseless and harmful desires, which sink humans into ruin and destruction.
For a root of all the evils is the love of money, reaching for which some were led astray from the trust and pierced themselves through with many pains.
But you, O human of God, flee these things; and pursue righteousness, godliness, trust, love, endurance, gentleness of feeling.
Struggle the good struggle of the trust; lay hold of the eternal life, into which also you were called and confessed the good confession before many witnesses.
I charge you before God who makes all things alive, and Christ Jesus who witnessed before Pontius Pilate the good confession,
that you keep the commandment spotless, irreproachable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
which at its own seasons he will show, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of the ones reigning and Lord of the ones ruling,
the one alone having immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no one of humans saw nor is able to see; to whom honour and eternal might. Amen.
To the rich in the now age charge not to be high-minded nor to have hoped upon uncertainty of wealth but upon the living God, the one furnishing us all things richly for enjoyment,
to do good, to be rich in good works, to be good at distributing, ready to share,
treasuring up for themselves a good foundation for the coming thing, so that they might lay hold of the really life.
O Timothy, guard the deposit, turning away from the profane empty utterances and oppositions of the falsely-named knowledge,
which some professing missed the mark concerning the trust. The grace with you. Amen. [To Timothy first, written from Laodicea, which is metropolis of Phrygia of Pacatiana.]

2 corinthians_1.t: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through God's will, and Timothy the brother, to the assembly of God that is in Corinth, with all the holy ones who are in the whole of Achaia:
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of the mercies and God of all comfort,
the one comforting us upon all our pressure, toward our being able to comfort those in every pressure, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God;
because just as the sufferings of the Christ overflow into us, so through the Christ our comfort also overflows.
And whether we are pressured, it is for your comfort and rescue; whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which is at work in endurance of the same sufferings which we also suffer,
knowing that as you are partners of the sufferings, so also of the comfort.

For we do not want you to be ignorant, brothers and sisters, concerning our pressure that came to be to us in Asia, that beyond measure, beyond strength, we were weighed down, so as for us to despair even of living;
but we ourselves have had in ourselves the verdict of death, so that we might not be ones having trusted upon ourselves but upon God, the one raising the dead;
who out of so great a death rescued us and will rescue; upon whom we have hoped that he will also still rescue,
you also joining in working together on our behalf by petition, so that from many faces the gift toward us might be given thanks for through many on our behalf.

For our boasting is this, the witness of our conscience, that in singleness and sincerity of God, and not in fleshly wisdom but in grace of God, we conducted ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
For we do not write other things to you than what you read or also recognise; and I hope that until the end you will recognise,
just as you also recognised us in part, that we are your boast, just as you also are ours in the day of our Lord Jesus.
And in this confidence I was intending to come to you earlier, so that you might have a second grace,
and through you to pass into Macedonia and again from Macedonia to come to you and by you to be sent forward into Judea.
Therefore, intending this, did I then use lightness? Or the things I plan, do I plan according to flesh, so that with me there might be the Yes yes and the No no?
But God is faithful, that our word toward you is not Yes and No;
For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, the one proclaimed among you through us, through me and Silvanus and Timothy, did not become Yes and No, but Yes has come to be in him.
For as many as are promises of God, in him is the Yes; therefore also through him is the Amen to God, toward glory through us.
But the one confirming us with you into Christ and having anointed us is God,
who also sealed us and gave the deposit of the Spirit in our hearts.
But I call God as witness upon my soul that sparing you I did not yet come to Corinth.
Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers of your joy; for by faith you stand.

2 corinthians_2.t: For I judged this for myself, not to come to you again in grief.
For if I grieve you, and who is the one gladdening me except the one being grieved by me?
And I wrote this same thing, so that coming I might not have grief from those from whom I ought to rejoice, having been persuaded about all of you that my joy is that of all of you.
For out of much pressure and constriction of heart I wrote to you through many tears, not so that you might be grieved but so that you might know the love which I have more abundantly toward you.
But if anyone has grieved, he has not grieved me but in part — so that I may not weigh it down — all of you.
Sufficient for such a one is this censure by the many.
So that on the contrary you should rather forgive and comfort, lest somehow by the more abundant grief such a one be swallowed down.
Therefore I urge you to ratify love toward him.
For toward this also I wrote, so that I might know your provenness, whether in all things you are obedient.
And to whom you forgive anything, I also; for also what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, is for your sake in the face of Christ,
so that we might not be taken advantage of by the Satan; for we are not ignorant of his thoughts.
And having come into the Troad for the good news of the Christ, and a door having been opened to me in the Lord,
I have had no relief in my spirit at my not finding Titus my brother, but having taken leave of them I went out into Macedonia.
But grace to God, the one always leading us in triumph in the Christ and making manifest the smell of the knowledge of him through us in every place.
because we are Christ's sweet smell to God among those being saved and among those perishing,
to these a smell out of death into death, and to these a smell out of life into life. And toward these things, who is sufficient?
For we are not as the many, peddling the word of God, but as out of sincerity, but as out of God, before God in Christ we speak.

2 corinthians_3.t: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we not need, as some, commendatory letters to you or from you?
Our letter you are, having been inscribed in our hearts, being known and read by all people,
being made manifest that you are a letter of Christ served by us, having been inscribed not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not in stone tablets but in tablets, hearts of flesh.
And such confidence we have through the Christ toward God.
Not that from ourselves we are sufficient to reckon anything as out of ourselves, but our sufficiency is out of God,
who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of letter but of spirit; for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.

And if the service of death in letters, having been engraved in stones, came to be in glory, so that the sons of Israel were not able to gaze into the face of Moses because of the glory of his face, the one being brought to nothing,
how shall the service of the spirit not rather be in glory?
For if in the service of condemnation there is glory, much more does the service of righteousness overflow in glory.
For indeed what has been glorified has not been glorified in this respect, on account of the surpassing glory.
For if the thing being brought to nothing was through glory, much more the thing remaining is in glory.
Therefore having such hope we use much boldness of speech,
and not just as Moses would put a veil upon his face, toward the sons of Israel not gazing into the end of the thing being brought to nothing;
But their thoughts were hardened. For until today the same veil remains upon the reading of the old covenant, not being unveiled, because in Christ it is brought to nothing;
But until today, whenever Moses is read, a veil lies upon their heart;
But whenever it turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
And the Lord is the spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
And we all, with unveiled face beholding-as-in-a-mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory into glory, just as from the Lord, spirit.

2 corinthians_4.t: Because of this, having this service just as we were shown mercy, we do not grow weary,

but we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor falsifying the word of God, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves toward every conscience of humans before God.
And if also our good news is veiled, it is veiled among those perishing,
among whom the god of this age blinded the thoughts of the unbelieving, toward the illumination of the good news of the glory of the Christ, who is the image of God, not dawning on them.
For we do not proclaim ourselves but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants through Jesus.
Because God, the one having said, Out of darkness light shall shine, is who shone in our hearts toward the illumination of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
But we have this treasure in earthenware vessels, so that the surpassing greatness of the power may be God's and not from us;
In everything being pressured but not being hemmed in, being at a loss but not being utterly at a loss,
being persecuted but not being forsaken, being thrown down but not being destroyed,
always carrying about the putting-to-death of Jesus in the body, so that also the life of Jesus may be made manifest in our body.
For we, the living, are always being handed over into death because of Jesus, so that also the life of Jesus may be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
So then death is at work in us, but the life in you.
And having the same spirit of faith according to what has been written, I trusted, therefore I spoke, we also trust, therefore we also speak,
knowing that the one having raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and will present us with you.
For all things are for your sake, so that the grace, having increased through the greater number, might make the thanksgiving overflow toward the glory of God.
Therefore we do not grow weary; but even if our outer human is being destroyed, yet our inner is being renewed day by day.
For the momentary lightness of our pressure is working out for us according to excess unto excess an eternal weight of glory,
we not looking at the things being seen but the things not being seen; for the things being seen are temporary, but the things not being seen eternal.

2 corinthians_5.t: For we know that if our earthly house of the tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not hand-made, eternal, in the heavens.
For indeed in this we groan, longing to put on over ourselves our dwelling from heaven,
if indeed also having stripped off we shall not be found naked.
For indeed we, being in the tent, groan, being weighed down, upon which we do not want to strip off but to put on over, so that the mortal may be swallowed down by the life.
And the one having worked us out for this same thing is God, the one having also given to us the deposit of the Spirit.
Therefore always being confident and knowing that being at home in the body we are away from home from the Lord —
for through faith we walk, not through appearance —
but we are confident and are well pleased rather to be away from home out of the body and to be at home toward the Lord.
Therefore also we are ambitious, whether being at home or being away from home, to be well-pleasing to him.

For it is necessary for us all to be made manifest before the judgment seat of the Christ, so that each may be recompensed for the things through the body according to what he practiced, whether good or worthless.
Therefore knowing the fear of the Lord we persuade people, but to God we have been made manifest; and I hope also to have been made manifest in your consciences.
Not again do we commend ourselves to you, but giving you an occasion of boasting on our behalf, so that you may have it toward those boasting in face and not in heart.
For whether we were beside ourselves, it is to God; whether we are sober-minded, it is to you.
For the love of the Christ holds us together, having judged this, that one died on behalf of all; therefore all died.
And on behalf of all he died, so that those living might no longer live for themselves but for the one having died and having been raised on their behalf.
So then we from now on know no one according to flesh; and if we have known Christ according to flesh, but now we no longer know him.
So then if anyone is in Christ, new creation; the ancient things passed away, behold, all things have come to be new.
And all things are out of God, the one having reconciled us to himself through Christ and having given to us the service of the reconciliation,
as that God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having placed in us the word of the reconciliation.
Therefore on behalf of Christ we are ambassadors, as God urging through us; we beg on behalf of Christ, Be reconciled to God.
For the one not having known sin he made sin on our behalf, so that we might become righteousness of God in him.

2 corinthians_6.t: And working together we also urge you not to receive the grace of God in vain;
For he says, In an acceptable time I heard you and in a day of salvation I helped you. Behold, now is a well-acceptable time, behold, now a day of salvation.
giving not one occasion of stumbling in anything, so that the service may not be found fault with,
but in everything commending ourselves as God's servants, in much endurance, in pressures, in necessities, in constrictions,
in blows, in prisons, in disturbances, in labors, in sleeplessnesses, in fastings,
in purity, in knowledge, in long-suffering, in kindness, in a holy spirit, in unhypocritical love,
in a word of truth, in power of God, through the weapons of righteousness of the right and of the left,
through glory and dishonor, through ill repute and good repute, as deceivers and true,
as being unknown and being recognised, as dying and behold we live, as being disciplined and not being put to death,
as being grieved but always rejoicing, as poor but making many rich, as having nothing and holding all things.
Our mouth has been opened toward you, Corinthians, our heart has been widened;
You are not being constricted in us, but you are being constricted in your inward parts;
And as the same recompense — I speak as to children — be widened, you also.
Do not become unequally yoked with unbelievers; for what partnership have righteousness and lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light toward darkness?
And what concord has Christ toward Beliar? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

And what agreement has a temple of God with idols? For we are a temple of the living God, just as God said, I will dwell in them and will walk among them, and I will be their God and they shall be my people.
Therefore come out from the midst of them and be separated, says the Lord, and do not touch an unclean thing; and I will receive you in,
and I will be to you for a father and you shall be to me for sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

2 corinthians_7.t: Therefore having these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of flesh and spirit, completing holiness in fear of God.
Make room for us; we wronged no one, we corrupted no one, we took advantage of no one.
I do not speak toward condemnation; for I have said before that you are in our hearts for dying together and living together.
Much is my boldness of speech toward you, much my boasting on your behalf; I have been filled with the comfort, I am overflowing with the joy upon all our pressure.
For indeed, we having come into Macedonia, our flesh has had no relief, but in everything being pressured — outside fights, inside fears.
But the one comforting the lowly, God, comforted us by the arrival of Titus;
and not only by his arrival but also by the comfort with which he was comforted over you, reporting to us your longing, your lamentation, your zeal on my behalf, so that I rejoiced the more.
Because if also I grieved you in the letter, I do not regret it; if also I was regretting it — for I see that that letter, if also for an hour, grieved you —
now I rejoice, not that you were grieved but that you were grieved into a change of mind; for you were grieved according to God, so that in nothing you might suffer loss from us.
For the grief according to God works out a change of mind into salvation, not to be regretted; but the grief of the world works out death.

For behold this same thing, your being grieved according to God, how much diligence it worked out in you — but defense, but indignation, but fear, but longing, but zeal, but vengeance! In everything you commended yourselves to be pure in the matter.

So then, if also I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one having wronged nor on account of the one having been wronged, but on account of your diligence on our behalf being made manifest to you before God.
Because of this we have been comforted. And upon our comfort we rejoiced the more abundantly rather at the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all;
because if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not put to shame, but as we spoke all things to you in truth, so also our boasting before Titus came to be truth.
And his inward parts are more abundantly toward you, remembering the obedience of all of you, how with fear and trembling you received him.
I rejoice that in everything I am confident in you.

2 corinthians_8.t: And we make known to you, brothers and sisters, the grace of God that has been given among the assemblies of Macedonia,
that in much testing of pressure the abundance of their joy and their down-to-the-depth poverty overflowed into the wealth of their singleness.
because according to power, I witness, and beyond power, of their own choosing,
with much urging begging of us the grace and the fellowship of the service toward the holy ones,
and not just as we hoped, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and to us through God's will,
toward our urging Titus that just as he began before, so also he might complete toward you also this grace.
But just as in everything you overflow, in faith and word and knowledge and all diligence and the love from us in you, so that also in this grace you may overflow.
Not according to command do I speak, but through the diligence of others also testing the genuineness of your love;
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that on account of you he became poor, being rich, so that you by that one's poverty might become rich.
And I give an opinion in this; for this is profitable for you, who not only the doing but also the willing began beforehand from last year.
But now also complete the doing, so that just as there was the readiness of the willing, so also the completing out of the having.
For if the readiness lies before, it is well acceptable according to whatever anyone may have, not according to what he does not have.
For it is not that to others there be relief and to you pressure, but out of equality;
in the present time your surplus toward their lack, so that also their surplus may come to be toward your lack, so that there may come to be equality,
just as it has been written, The one with the much did not have more, and the one with the little did not have less.
But grace to God, the one giving the same diligence on your behalf in the heart of Titus,
because the urging he received, and being more diligent, of his own choosing he went out to you.
And we sent together with him the brother whose praise in the good news is through all the assemblies,
and not only so, but also having been hand-elected by the assemblies as our fellow traveler with this grace being served by us toward the glory of the Lord himself and our readiness.
avoiding this, lest anyone should find fault with us in this abundance being served by us;
for we take forethought for good things not only before the Lord but also before people.
And we sent together with them our brother whom we tested in many things many times as being diligent, and now much more diligent by much confidence toward you.
Whether on behalf of Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker toward you; whether our brothers, they are apostles of assemblies, a glory of Christ.
Therefore show forth to them the demonstration of your love and of our boasting on your behalf, and toward the face of the assemblies.

2 corinthians_9.t: For concerning the service toward the holy ones it is excessive for me to write to you;
for I know your readiness, which on your behalf I boast to Macedonians, that Achaia has been prepared from last year, and your zeal stirred up the greater number.
But I sent the brothers, so that our boasting on your behalf might not be emptied in this respect, so that, just as I was saying, you might be prepared;
lest somehow if Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we should be put to shame — that I may not say you — in this confidence.

Therefore I considered it necessary to urge the brothers that they should go before to you and prepare beforehand your previously announced blessing, this to be ready thus as a blessing and not as greediness.
And this: the one sowing sparingly shall also reap sparingly, and the one sowing upon blessings shall also reap upon blessings.
Each just as he has chosen beforehand in the heart, not out of grief or out of necessity; for God loves a cheerful giver.
And God is able to make all grace overflow toward you, so that in everything always having all sufficiency you may overflow toward every good work,
just as it has been written, He scattered, he gave to the poor, his righteousness remains into the age.
And the one supplying seed to the one sowing and bread for eating will supply and will multiply your seed and will increase the produce of your righteousness.
in everything being made rich toward all singleness, which works out through us thanksgiving to God;
because the service of this liturgy is not only filling up the lacks of the holy ones but is also overflowing through many thanksgivings to God,
through the provenness of this service glorifying God upon the subjection of your confession toward the good news of the Christ and upon the singleness of the fellowship toward them and toward all,
and by their petition on your behalf, longing for you on account of the surpassing grace of God upon you.
And grace to God upon his indescribable gift.

2 corinthians_10.t: And I myself, Paul, urge you through the meekness and gentleness of the Christ, who face to face indeed am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
And I beg that being present I may not be bold with the confidence with which I reckon to dare against some, those reckoning us as walking according to flesh.
For walking in flesh we do not war according to flesh —
for the weapons of our campaign are not fleshly but powerful to God toward demolition of strongholds, arguments demolishing
demolishing reasonings and every height being lifted up against the knowledge of God, and taking captive every thought into the obedience of the Christ,
and being in readiness to avenge every disobedience whenever your obedience is fulfilled.
You look at the things according to face. If anyone has been persuaded in himself to be of Christ, let him reckon this again upon himself, that just as he is of Christ, so also are we.
For even if I should boast somewhat more abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building up and not for your demolition, I shall not be put to shame;
so that I may not seem as if to terrify you through the letters.
Because the letters indeed, he says, are weighty and strong, but the presence of the body weak and the word despised.
Let such a one reckon this, that what sort we are in word through letters being absent, such also being present in deed.
For we do not dare to class or compare ourselves with some of those commending themselves; but they, measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves with themselves, do not understand.
But we shall not boast into the immeasurable things but according to the measure of the canon which the God of measure apportioned to us, to reach as far as even you.
For not as not reaching to you do we overextend ourselves; for as far as even you we arrived first in the good news of the Christ,
not boasting into the immeasurable things in others' labors, but having hope, your faith growing, to be magnified among you according to our canon into abundance,
to bring good news into the parts beyond you, not to boast in another's canon in things already prepared.
And the one boasting, let him boast in the Lord;
for not the one commending himself, that one is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

2 corinthians_11.t: Would that you were bearing with me in a little foolishness; but indeed you do bear with me.
For I am jealous over you with a jealousy of God; for I betrothed you to one man, to present you a pure virgin to Christ.
But I fear lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, your thoughts should be corrupted from the singleness and the purity toward the Christ.

For if indeed the one coming proclaims another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit which you did not receive, or a different good news which you did not accept, well do you bear with it.
For I reckon to have fallen short in nothing of the super-excessive apostles.
But even if unskilled in speech, yet not in knowledge; but in everything having made it manifest among all toward you.
Or did I commit sin humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because freely the good news of God I announced to you?
Other assemblies I robbed, taking provision toward your service,

and being present with you and having lacked, I did not numb anyone; for my lack the brothers having come from Macedonia filled up, and in everything I kept myself unburdensome to you and will keep myself.
The truth of Christ is in me, that this boasting shall not be fenced off toward me in the regions of Achaia.
Why? Because I do not love you? God knows.
But what I do, I also will do, so that I may cut off the occasion of those wanting an occasion, so that in what they boast they may be found even as we.
For such ones are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ;
and no wonder, for Satan himself transforms himself into an angel of light;
so it is no great thing if also his servants transform themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end shall be according to their works.
Again I say, let no one think me to be a fool; but if otherwise, even as a fool receive me, so that I also may boast a little.
What I speak, I do not speak according to the Lord but as in foolishness, in this substance of boasting.
Since many boast according to flesh, I also will boast.
For gladly you bear with the foolish, being wise.
For you bear with it if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours, if anyone takes, if anyone lifts himself up, if anyone strikes you in the face.
According to dishonor I speak, as that we have been weak; but in whatever anyone dares — in foolishness I speak — I also dare.
Are they Hebrews? I also. Are they Israelites? I also. Are they seed of Abraham? I also.
Are they servants of Christ? — being out of my mind I speak — I above: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in blows exceedingly, in deaths often.
By Jews five times I received forty less one;
three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, a night and a day I have done in the deep;

in journeyings often, in dangers of rivers, in dangers of robbers, in dangers from my own race, in dangers from nations, in dangers in a city, in dangers in a wilderness, in dangers in a sea, in dangers among false brothers;
in labor and hardship, in sleeplessnesses often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness;
apart from the things outside, the thing pressing upon me daily, the anxiety of all the assemblies.
Who is weak and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I am not set on fire?
If it is necessary to boast, I will boast of the things of my weakness.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, the one being blessed into the ages, knows that I do not lie.
In Damascus the ethnarch of Aretas the king was guarding the city of the Damascenes to seize me,
and through a window in a basket I was let down through the wall and escaped his hands.

2 corinthians_12.t: To boast is necessary — not profitable indeed — but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
I know a human in Christ fourteen years ago — whether in body I do not know, whether outside the body I do not know, God knows — such a one having been snatched up as far as a third heaven.
And I know such a human — whether in body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows —
that he was snatched up into the paradise and heard unspeakable utterances which it is not permitted for a human to speak.
On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on behalf of myself I will not boast except in the weaknesses.
For if I should want to boast, I shall not be foolish, for I will say truth; but I spare, lest anyone should reckon toward me above what he sees me to be or hears anything out of me,

and by the excess of the revelations. Therefore, so that I might not be lifted up, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan, so that it might beat me, so that I might not be lifted up.
Concerning this three times I urged the Lord that it might depart from me.

And he has said to me, Sufficient for you is my grace, for the power is completed in weakness. Most gladly therefore rather will I boast in my weaknesses, so that the power of the Christ may tent upon me.
Therefore I am well pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in persecutions and constrictions, on behalf of Christ; for whenever I am weak, then I am powerful.
I have become foolish; you compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you; for in nothing did I fall short of the super-excessive apostles, even if I am nothing.
The signs of the apostle were worked out among you in all endurance, in signs and wonders and powers.
For what is it in which you were made inferior beyond the remaining assemblies, except that I myself did not numb you? Forgive me this wrong.

Behold, this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not numb you; for I do not seek the things of you but you. For the children ought not to treasure up for the parents but the parents for the children.
And I most gladly will spend and be utterly spent for your souls. If more abundantly loving you, am I loved less?
But let it be, I did not weigh you down; but being crafty, by guile I took you.
Not anyone of those whom I have sent to you — through him did I take advantage of you?
I urged Titus and sent with him the brother; Titus did not take advantage of you, did he? Did we not walk in the same spirit? In the same steps?
For a long time you have been thinking that to you we are making a defense. Before God in Christ we speak; and all things, beloved, are on behalf of your building up.

For I fear lest somehow having come I should find you not such as I want, and I should be found by you such as you do not want; lest somehow there be strife, jealousy, angers, selfish ambitions, slanders, whisperings, puffings-up, disorders;

lest coming again my God should humble me toward you and I should mourn many of those having sinned beforehand and not having changed their mind over the uncleanness and sexual immorality and licentiousness which they practiced.

2 corinthians_13.t: This third time I am coming to you. Upon the mouth of two witnesses and of three every word shall be established.

I have said beforehand and I say beforehand, as being present the second time and being absent now, I write to those having sinned beforehand and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare;
since you seek a proof of the Christ speaking in me, who toward you is not weak but is powerful among you.
For indeed he was crucified out of weakness, but he lives out of power of God; for indeed we are weak in him, but we shall live with him out of power of God toward you.
Test yourselves whether you are in the faith; prove yourselves. Or do you not recognise yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you? — unless indeed you are unproven.
But I hope that you will know that we are not unproven.
And we pray to God that you do nothing evil — not so that we may appear proven, but so that you may do the good, and we may be as unproven.
For we are not able to do anything against the truth but on behalf of the truth.
For we rejoice whenever we are weak and you are powerful; and this also we pray for, your being made complete.
Because of this, being absent I write these things, so that being present I may not use severity according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for demolition.
For the rest, brothers and sisters, rejoice, be made complete, be comforted, think the same thing, be at peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.
Greet one another with a holy kiss. Greet you all the holy ones.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit with all of you. Amen. [To Corinthians second, written from Philippi of Macedonia through Titus and Luke.]

2 john_1.t: The elder to a chosen lady and to the children of her, whom I love in truth, and not I only but also all the ones having known the truth,
On account of the truth the one remaining in us, and with us it will be into the age.
Will be with us grace, mercy, peace from God Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
I rejoiced exceedingly because I have found from the children of you walking in truth, just as commandment we received from the Father.
And now I ask you, lady, not as a commandment new writing to you but which we had from beginning, that we should love one another.
And this is the love, that we should walk according to the commandments of him. This the commandment is, just as you heard from beginning, that in it you should walk.
Because many deceivers went out into the world, the ones not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh; this one is the deceiver and the antichrist.
See yourselves, that not you might lose what we worked, but a wage full you might receive.
Everyone the one going ahead and not remaining in the teaching of the Christ, God not has; the one remaining in the teaching, this one both the Father and the Son has.
If anyone comes toward you and this the teaching not bears, not receive him into a house and rejoice to him not say.
The one saying for to him rejoice, shares in the works of him the evil ones.
Many things having to you to write, not I wanted through paper and ink, but I hope to become toward you and mouth toward mouth to speak, that the joy of you having been filled full might be.
Greet you the children of the sister of you the chosen.

2 peter_1.t: Simeon Peter, servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those having obtained by lot a trust of equal honour with ours in righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:
Grace to you and peace be multiplied in full knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
As his divine power has granted to us all the things toward life and godliness through the full knowledge of the one having called us by his own glory and excellence,
Through which he has granted to us the precious and greatest promises, in order that through these you may become sharers of a divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world in desire.
And for this same reason also, having brought in all diligence, supply in your trust the excellence, and in the excellence the knowledge,
and in the knowledge the self-control, and in the self-control the endurance, and in the endurance the godliness,
and in the godliness the brotherly love, and in the brotherly love the love.
For these things being present to you and abounding, they render you not idle nor unfruitful into the full knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For the one to whom these things are not present is blind, being short-sighted, having received forgetfulness of the cleansing of his former sins.
Therefore rather, brothers and sisters, be diligent to make firm your calling and choosing; for doing these things you will never stumble at any time.
For thus richly will be supplied to you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Therefore I will intend always to remind you concerning these things, even though knowing them and having been established in the present truth.
But I consider it righteous, for as long as I am in this tent, to rouse you in a reminder,
knowing that swift is the putting off of my tent, even as also our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
And I will be diligent also, on each occasion, for you to have after my exodus the recollection of these things to make.
For not having followed after cleverly devised myths did we make known to you the power and arrival of our Lord Jesus Christ, but having become eyewitnesses of that one's majesty.
For having received from God the Father honour and glory, such a voice having been carried to him by the Magnificent Glory: 'My Son, my beloved, this one is, into whom I took delight.'
And this voice we ourselves heard carried out of heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.
And we have more firm the prophetic word, to which you do well giving heed as to a lamp shining in a squalid place, until day should dawn and a light-bearer should rise in your hearts;
knowing this first, that every prophecy of scripture does not come to be of one's own unloosing.
For not by will of a human was prophecy carried at any time, but being carried by holy spirit humans spoke from God.

2 peter_2.t: But there arose also false prophets among the people, as also among you there will be false teachers, who will bring in alongside destructive sects and, denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
And many will follow after their licentiousnesses, on account of whom the way of the truth will be blasphemed;
And in greed with moulded words they will make merchandise of you, for whom the judgement from of old is not idle and their destruction does not slumber.
For if God did not spare angels having sinned, but having cast them into Tartarus handed them over to chains of gloom, being kept for judgement,
and an ancient world he did not spare, but as eighth he guarded Noah, a herald of righteousness, having brought a flood upon a world of ungodly ones,
and cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, having reduced to ashes, he condemned to an overthrow, having placed an example of things about to be for the ungodly,
and righteous Lot, being worn down by the conduct in licentiousness of the lawless ones, he rescued;
for by sight and by hearing the righteous one, dwelling among them, day by day was tormenting a righteous soul with lawless deeds;
the Lord knows to rescue godly ones out of trial, but unrighteous ones to keep for a day of judgement being punished,
and especially those going after flesh in desire of defilement and despising lordship. Daring, self-pleasing, they do not tremble blaspheming glories,
where angels, being greater in strength and power, do not bring against them a blasphemous judgement from the Lord.
But these, as irrational animals, natural, having been born for capture and corruption, blaspheming in what things they are ignorant of, in their corruption also will be corrupted,
being wronged as a wage of wrongdoing, considering pleasure the revelling in a day, spots and blemishes, revelling in their deceits, feasting together with you,
having eyes full of an adulteress and unceasing from sin, baiting unestablished souls, having a heart trained in greed, children of a curse;
Having left a straight way, they were led astray, having followed after the way of Balaam of Bosor, who loved a wage of wrongdoing,
but had a rebuke of his own lawbreaking: a voiceless beast of burden, having uttered in a human voice, hindered the madness of the prophet.
These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of the darkness has been kept.
For speaking overswollen things of emptiness, they bait in desires of flesh, in licentiousnesses, those barely escaping from the ones conducting themselves in error,
promising them freedom, themselves being slaves of the corruption; for by what anyone has been overcome, to this he has also been enslaved.

For if, having escaped the defilements of the world in full knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, but being again entangled in these they are overcome, the last things have become for them worse than the first.
For it were better for them not to have fully known the way of righteousness than, having fully known, to turn back out of the holy commandment handed over to them.
There has happened to them the thing of the true proverb: 'A dog having returned upon its own vomit,' and 'a washed sow into a rolling of mire.'

2 peter_3.t: This already, beloved, a second letter I write to you, in which I rouse up your sincere mind in a reminder,
to remember the words having been spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of your apostles, of the Lord and Saviour;
knowing this first, that there will come in the last of the days with mockery mockers, going according to their own desires,
and saying, 'Where is the promise of his arrival? For from which time the fathers fell asleep, all things remain thus from a beginning of creation.'
For this escapes them, willing it: that heavens were of old and an earth out of water and through water having been composed by the word of God,
through which the then world, having been flooded with water, perished.
But the now heavens and the earth by the same word have been treasured up, being kept for fire for a day of judgement and destruction of the ungodly humans.
But let this one thing not escape you, beloved, that one day with the Lord is as a thousand years and a thousand years as one day.
The Lord is not slow concerning the promise, as some consider slowness, but is long-tempered toward you, not willing any to perish but all to come to a change of mind.
But there will come a day of the Lord as a thief, in which the heavens with a rushing noise will pass away, and elements burning will be dissolved, and earth and the works in it will be found.
All these things thus being dissolved, what sort ought you to be in holy conduct and godlinesses,
expecting and hastening the arrival of the day of God, on account of which heavens being set on fire will be dissolved and elements burning are melted?
But new heavens and a new earth according to his promise we expect, in which righteousness dwells.
Therefore, beloved, expecting these things, be diligent to be found by him spotless and unblemished in peace,
And the long-temper of our Lord consider salvation, even as also our beloved brother Paul according to the wisdom given to him wrote to you,

as also in all the letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which are some things hard to understand, which the unlearned and unestablished twist, as also the rest of the scriptures, to their own destruction.
You therefore, beloved, knowing beforehand, guard yourselves, in order that, having been carried away by the error of the lawless, you may not fall out of your own steadfastness.
But grow in grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him the glory both now and to a day of an age. Amen.

2 thessalonians_1.t: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the assembly of Thessalonians in God our Father and Lord Jesus Christ:
grace to you and peace from God Father of us and Lord Jesus Christ.

We ought to give thanks to God always concerning you, brothers and sisters, just as it is worthy, because your trust is growing exceedingly and the love of each one of all of you toward one another is increasing,
so that we ourselves boast in you in the assemblies of God over your endurance and trust in all your persecutions and the afflictions which you bear up under,
a demonstration of the just judgement of God, for you to be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, on behalf of which also you suffer;
if indeed it is just beside God to repay affliction to the ones afflicting you,
and to you the ones being afflicted, relief with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with angels of his power,
in fire of flame, giving out vengeance to the ones not knowing God and to the ones not obeying the good news of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who will pay a penalty, eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,
whenever he may come to be glorified in his holy ones and to be marvelled at in all the ones having trusted, because our witness to you was believed, in that day.
For which also we pray always concerning you, that our God may count you worthy of the calling and may fulfil every good pleasure of goodness and work of trust in power,
so that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and Lord Jesus Christ.

2 thessalonians_2.t: But we ask you, brothers and sisters, concerning the arrival of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together upon him,
for you not to be quickly shaken from the mind nor to be alarmed, neither through a spirit nor through a word nor through a letter as through us, as that the day of the Lord has come.
Let no one deceive you according to any manner, because unless the falling-away comes first and the human of the lawlessness is revealed, the son of the destruction,
the one opposing and lifting himself over every one called god or object of reverence, so that he in the temple of God as God sits, displaying himself that he is God.
Do you not remember that still being toward you these things I was telling you?
And now you know the thing restraining, for him to be revealed in his own season.
For the mystery already works of the lawlessness — only the one restraining just now until out of the midst he may come;
and then will be revealed the lawless one, whom the Lord Jesus will take away by the spirit of his mouth and will render useless by the manifestation of his arrival;
whose arrival is according to a working of the Satan in all power and signs and wonders of falsehood,
and in every deceit of unrighteousness for the ones perishing, in return for which they did not receive the love of the truth for them to be saved;
And because of this God sends to them a working of error, for them to trust the falsehood,
so that all may be judged, the ones not having trusted the truth but having taken pleasure in the unrighteousness.

But we ought to give thanks to God always concerning you, brothers and sisters having been loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruit for salvation in holiness of Spirit and trust of truth,
for which also he called you through our good news, for obtaining of glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So then, brothers and sisters, stand and hold fast the traditions which you were taught, whether through word or through our letter.
And may he himself, our Lord Jesus Christ, and God our Father, the one having loved us and having given eternal encouragement and good hope in grace,
encourage your hearts and strengthen in every good work and word.

2 thessalonians_3.t: For the rest, pray, brothers and sisters, concerning us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified just as also toward you,
and that we may be rescued from the out-of-place and evil humans; for the trust is not of all.
But faithful is the Lord, who will strengthen you and will guard from the evil one.
And we have been persuaded in the Lord upon you that what things we charge you both you do and you will do.
And may the Lord straighten your hearts into the love of God and into the endurance of the Christ.

But we charge you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, for you to withdraw from every brother walking disorderly and not according to the tradition which they received from us.
For you yourselves know how it is necessary to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you,
nor freely did we eat bread from anyone, but in labour and toil night and day working toward the not burdening any of you;
not that we do not have authority, but so that we might give ourselves as a pattern to you for the imitating us.
For indeed when we were toward you, this we were charging you, that if anyone does not want to work, neither let him eat.
For we hear certain ones walking among you disorderly, working at nothing but working around.
And to such ones we charge and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ that with quietness working they may eat their own bread.
But you, brothers and sisters, do not lose heart doing good.
And if anyone does not obey our word through the letter, mark this one and do not mix together with him, so that he may be turned in on himself;
And do not consider him as an enemy, but admonish as a brother.
And may he himself, the Lord of the peace, give you the peace through everything in every manner. The Lord with all of you.
The greeting by my hand, of Paul, which is a sign in every letter; thus I write.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with all of you. Amen. [To Thessalonians second it was written from Athens.]

2 timothy_1.t: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through God's will, according to a promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
To Timothy, beloved child: grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
I have gratitude to God, whom I serve from forebears in a clean conscience, as unceasing I have the remembrance about you in my petitions night and day,
longing to see you, having remembered your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,
having received a reminder of the unhypocritical trust in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that also in you.
For which cause I remind you to rekindle the gift of God which is in you through the laying-on of my hands;
for God did not give us a spirit of timidity but of power and of love and of sound-mindedness.
Therefore do not be ashamed of the witness of our Lord nor of me his prisoner, but suffer together for the good news according to God's power,
the one having saved us and having called with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace given to us in Christ Jesus before eternal times,
but having been manifested now through the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, having nullified death and having illuminated life and incorruptibility through the good news,
for which I was placed a herald and apostle and teacher of nations.
For which cause also these things I suffer, but I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have trusted and I have been persuaded that he is able to guard my deposit unto that day.
A sketch have of healthy words which from me you heard, in trust and love that is in Christ Jesus.
The good deposit guard through holy spirit dwelling in us.
You know this, that all those in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, because often he refreshed me and my chain he was not ashamed of;
but having come to be in Rome, diligently he sought me and found;
May the Lord give him to find mercy from the Lord in that day. And how much in Ephesus he served, you know better.

2 timothy_2.t: You therefore, my child, be empowered in the grace that is in Christ Jesus,
and what things you heard from me through many witnesses, these place before trustworthy humans, who will be competent also to teach others.
You therefore suffer together as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No one soldiering entangles himself in the affairs of life, so that he may please the one having enlisted him.
And if anyone also competes, he is not crowned unless he competes lawfully.
The toiling farmer must first partake of the fruits.
Consider what I say; for the Lord will give you understanding in all things.
Remember Jesus Christ having been raised from dead ones, from seed of David, according to my good news,
in which I suffer evil unto bonds as an evildoer; but the word of God has not been bound.
Because of this all things I endure on account of the chosen ones, so that they also may obtain salvation, the one in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
