The one conquering, I will give to him to sit with me on my throne, as I also conquered and sat with my Father on his throne.
The one having an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

revelation_4.t: After these things I saw, and behold a door having been opened in heaven, and the first voice which I heard as of a trumpet speaking with me, saying: Come up here, and I will show you what things must happen after these things.
And immediately I came to be in spirit, and behold a throne was set in heaven, and upon the throne one sitting.
And the one sitting was like in appearance to a jasper stone and a sardius, and a rainbow around the throne like in appearance to an emerald.
And around the throne thrones twenty and four, and upon the thrones I saw the twenty and four elders sitting, having been clothed in white garments, and they had upon their heads golden wreaths.
And out of the throne go out lightnings and voices and thunders, and seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven spirits of God,
And before the throne as a glassy sea, like crystal, and in the midst of the throne and around the throne four living ones full of eyes in front and behind.
And the first living one like a lion, and the second living one like a calf, and the third living one having the face as of a human, and the fourth living one like a flying eagle.

And the four living ones, one by one of them having six wings apiece, around and within they are full of eyes, and rest they do not have day and night, saying: Holy holy holy Lord God the all-holder, the he-was and the one who is and the one coming.
And whenever the living ones will give glory and honour and thanksgiving to the one sitting upon the throne, to the one living into the ages of the ages,
the twenty and four elders will fall before the one sitting upon the throne and will bow to the one living into the ages of the ages, and will throw their wreaths before the throne, saying:
Worthy are you, the Lord and our God, the holy one, to receive the glory and the honour and the power, because you created all things and because of your will they were and were created.

revelation_5.t: And I saw upon the right of the one sitting upon the throne a book having been written within and behind, having been sealed down with seven seals.
And I saw a strong messenger heralding in a great voice: Who is worthy to open the book and to loose its seals?
And no one was able in heaven above nor upon the earth nor underneath the earth to open the book nor to see it.
And I was weeping much because no one worthy was found to open and to read the book nor to see it.
And one out of the elders says to me: Do not weep; behold he conquered, the lion the one out of the tribe of Judah, the root of David, the one to open the book and to loose its seven seals.

And I saw and behold, in the midst of the throne and of the four living ones and in the midst of the elders a little lamb standing as having been slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, the ones having been sent into all the earth.
And he came and has taken the book out of the right of the one sitting upon the throne.
And when he took the book, the four living ones and the twenty-four elders fell before the little lamb, having each a lyre and golden bowls full of incenses, which are the prayers of the holy ones.

And they sing a new song saying: Worthy are you to take the book and to open its seals, because you were slaughtered and you bought us for God in your blood out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation,
And you made them for our God a kingdom and priests, and they will reign upon the earth.
And I saw and heard as a voice of many messengers around the throne and of the living ones and of the elders, and the number of them was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
saying in a great voice: Worthy is the little lamb, the one having been slaughtered, to receive the power and the wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.

And every creature which is in heaven and upon the earth and underneath the earth and upon the sea and the things which are, and all the things in them, I heard saying: To the one sitting upon the throne and to the little lamb the blessing and the honour and the glory and the might into the ages of the ages, amen.
And the four living ones were saying: The amen. And the twenty-four elders fell and bowed to the one living into the ages of the ages.

revelation_6.t: And I saw when the little lamb opened one out of the seven seals, and I heard one out of the four living ones saying as a voice of thunder: Come and see.
And I saw and behold a white horse, and the one sitting upon it having a bow, and a wreath was given to him, and he went out conquering and so that he might conquer.
And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living one saying: Come and see.

And another horse went out, fiery, and to the one sitting upon it, to him it was given to take the peace out of the earth, and so that they will slaughter one another; and a great short-sword was given to him.
And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living one saying: Come and see. And I saw and behold a black horse, and the one sitting upon it having a yoke in his hand.
And I heard as a voice in the midst of the four living ones saying: A choinix of wheat for a denarius, and three choinikes of barley for a denarius; and the oil and the wine do not harm.
And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard a voice of the fourth living one saying: Come and see.

And I saw and behold a pale-green horse, and the one sitting on top of it, a name to him: Death. And Hades was following with him, and authority was given to them over the fourth of the earth, to kill by broadsword and by famine and by death and by the beasts of the earth.
And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of the ones having been slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the witness of the little lamb which they had.
And they cried in a great voice saying: Until when, the master, the holy one and the true one, do you not judge and avenge our blood out of the ones dwelling upon the earth?

And there was given to them, to each, a white robe, and it was said to them that they should rest still a little time, until whenever their fellow slaves and their brothers should be fulfilled, and the ones about to be killed as also they themselves.
And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and behold a great shaking happened, and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became as blood,
and the stars of heaven fell into the earth as a fig tree throws its unripe figs, being shaken by a great wind,
and heaven was parted away as a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island were moved out of their places,

And the kings of the earth and the great ones and the commanders of thousands and the rich and the strong and every slave and every free one hid themselves into the caves and into the rocks of the mountains,
and they say to the mountains and to the rocks: Fall upon us and hide us from the face of the one sitting upon the throne and from the wrath of the little lamb,
because the great day of their wrath came, and who is able to stand?

revelation_7.t: And after this I saw four messengers having stood upon the four corners of the earth, holding fast the four winds of the earth so that a wind might not blow upon the earth nor upon the sea nor upon any tree.

And I saw another messenger going up from the rising of the sun, having a seal of the living God, and he cried in a great voice to the four messengers to whom it was given to them to harm the earth and the sea,
saying: Do not harm the earth nor the sea nor the trees until we seal the servants of our God upon their foreheads.
And I heard the number of the ones having been sealed: a hundred and forty-four thousands having been sealed out of every tribe of sons of Israel;
out of the tribe of Judah twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Gad twelve thousands having been sealed,
out of the tribe of Asher twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousands having been sealed,
out of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Levi twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousands having been sealed,
out of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousands having been sealed, out of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousands having been sealed.

After these things I saw, and behold a great crowd, which to number it no one was able, out of every nation and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the little lamb, having been clothed — accusative, where the standing is nominative — in white robes, and palms in their hands.
And they cry in a great voice saying: The salvation to our God, to the one sitting upon the throne, and to the little lamb.
And all the messengers had stood around the throne and of the elders and of the four living ones, and they fell before the throne upon their faces and bowed to God,
saying: Amen; the blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanksgiving and the honour and the power and the strength to our God into the ages of the ages, amen.
And one out of the elders answered saying to me: These, the ones having been clothed in the white robes, who are they and from where did they come?

And I have said to him: My lord, you know. And he said to me: These are the ones coming out of the great affliction, and they washed their robes and whitened those robes in the blood of the little lamb.
Because of this they are before the throne of God and they serve him day and night in his sanctuary, and the one sitting upon the throne will tabernacle over them.
They will not hunger still nor thirst still, nor shall the sun ever fall upon them nor any burning heat,
because the little lamb, the one up in the midst of the throne, will shepherd them and will lead them upon springs of waters of life, and God will wipe out every tear out of their eyes.

revelation_8.t: And whenever he opened the seventh seal, there came to be silence in heaven as of half an hour.
And I saw the seven messengers who have stood before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

And another messenger came and stood upon the altar having a golden censer, and there was given to him many incenses so that he will give it to the prayers of all the holy ones upon the golden altar, the one before the throne.
And the smoke of the incenses went up to the prayers of the holy ones out of the hand of the messenger before God.
And the messenger has taken the censer and filled it out of the fire of the altar and threw it into the earth, and there came to be thunders and voices and lightnings and a shaking.
And the seven messengers, the ones having the seven trumpets, prepared themselves so that they might trumpet.

And the first messenger trumpeted, and there came to be hail and fire having been mixed in blood, and it was thrown into the earth, and the third of the earth was burnt down, and the third of the trees was burnt down, and all green grass was burnt down.
And the second messenger trumpeted, and as a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and the third of the sea became blood,
And the third of the creatures, the ones in the sea, the ones having souls, died, and the third of the ships were destroyed.
And the third messenger trumpeted, and there fell out of heaven a great star burning as a lamp, and it fell upon the third of the rivers and upon the springs of the waters.
And the name of the star is said: The Wormwood. And the third of the waters became into wormwood, and many of the humans died out of the waters because they were made bitter.

And the fourth messenger trumpeted, and the third of the sun was struck and the third of the moon and the third of the stars, so that the third of them might be darkened, and the day might not shine the third of it, and the night likewise.

And I saw and heard one eagle flying in mid-heaven saying in a great voice: Woe woe woe to those dwelling upon the earth — accusative, where woe takes the dative — from the remaining voices of the trumpet of the three messengers, the ones about to trumpet.

revelation_9.t: And the fifth messenger trumpeted, and I saw a star having fallen out of heaven into the earth, and there was given to him the key of the well of the abyss.
And he opened the well of the abyss, and there went up smoke out of the well as smoke of a great furnace, and the sun was darkened and the air out of the smoke of the well.
And out of the smoke there came out locusts into the earth, and there was given to them authority as the scorpions of the earth have authority.
And it was said to them that they will not harm the grass of the earth nor any green thing nor any tree, except the humans alone, whoever do not have the seal of God upon their foreheads.
And it was given to them that they should not kill them, but that they will be tortured five months, and their torture as torture of a scorpion whenever it strikes a human.
And in those days the humans will seek death and shall never find it, and they will desire to die, and death flees from them.
And the likenesses of the locusts were like horses having been prepared for war, and upon their heads as wreaths like gold, and their faces as faces of humans,
And they had hair as hair of women, and their teeth were as of lions,
And they had breastplates as iron breastplates, and the voice of their wings as a voice of chariots of many horses running into war,
And they have tails like to scorpions, and stings there was; and in their tails also the authority they have of theirs to harm the humans five months.
They have over them a king, the messenger of the abyss; a name to him in Hebrew Abaddon, and in the Greek he has a name Apollyon.
The one woe went away; behold there comes still two woes after these things.
And the sixth messenger trumpeted, and I heard one voice out of the four horns of the golden altar, the one before God,
saying to the sixth messenger, the one having the trumpet — nominative, describing a dative — Loose the four messengers, the ones having been bound at the great river Euphrates.
And the four messengers were loosed, the ones having been prepared for the hour and for the day and month and year, so that they might kill the third of the humans.
And the number of the armies of the cavalry two myriads of myriads; and I heard the number of them.

And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and the ones sitting upon them having breastplates fiery and hyacinth-blue and sulphurous, and the heads of the horses as heads of lions, and out of their mouths goes out fire and smoke and sulphur.
From these three plagues were killed the third of the humans, out of the fire and out of the smoke and out of the sulphur, the one going out of their mouths.
For the authority of the horses is in their mouth and in their tails; for their tails are like to serpents, having heads, and in them they harm.

And the rest of the humans, who were not killed in these plagues, neither changed their minds out of the works of their hands, so that they will not bow to the demons and the idols, the golden ones and the silver ones and the bronze ones and the stone ones and the wooden ones, which are able neither to see nor to hear nor to walk,
And they did not change their minds out of their murders nor out of their drugs nor out of their sexual immorality nor out of their thefts.

revelation_10.t: And I saw another strong messenger coming down out of heaven, having been wrapped in a cloud, and the rainbow upon his head, and his face as the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire,
and having in his hand a little scroll having been opened. And he placed his right foot upon the sea, and the left upon the earth,
and he cried in a great voice just as a lion roars. And when he cried, the seven thunders spoke their own voices.
And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write their voices, and I heard a voice out of heaven saying to me: Seal what things the seven thunders spoke, and do not write them.
And the messenger whom I saw having stood upon the sea and upon the earth raised his right hand into heaven
and swore in the one living into the ages of the ages, who created the heaven and the things in it and the earth and the things in it and the sea and the things in it, that delay will no longer be.
But in the days of the voice of the seventh messenger, whenever he is about to trumpet, and the mystery of God was completed, as he announced good news to his own servants the prophets.

And the voice which I heard out of heaven again speaking with me and saying — nominative subject, accusative participles, no main verb — Go, take the book, the one having been opened in the hand of the messenger, the one having stood upon the sea and upon the earth.
And I went away toward the messenger telling him to give me the little scroll. And he says to me: Take and eat it down, and it will embitter your belly, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.
And I took the little scroll out of the hand of the messenger and ate it down, and it was in my mouth as honey sweet; and when I ate it, my belly was made bitter.
And they say to me: It is necessary for you again to prophesy about peoples and about nations and tongues and many kings.

revelation_11.t: And there was given to me a reed like to a staff, saying: Rise and measure the sanctuary of God and the altar, and the ones bowing in it.
And the court, the one outside the sanctuary, throw outside and do not measure it, because it was given to the nations; and the holy city they will trample forty-two months.
And I will give to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy a thousand two hundred sixty days, having been clothed in sackcloth.
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, the ones standing before the Lord of the earth.
And if anyone wants to harm them, fire goes out of their mouth and devours their enemies; and if anyone should want to harm them, thus it is necessary for him to be killed.

These have the authority to shut the heaven, so that rain may not rain the days of their prophecy, and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth in every plague as often as they may want.
And whenever they complete their witness, the beast, the one coming up out of the abyss, will make war with them and will conquer them and will kill them.
And their corpse upon the broad street of the great city, which is called spiritually Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
And they look, out of the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations, at their corpse three days and a half, and their corpses they do not permit to be placed into a tomb.
And the ones dwelling upon the earth rejoice over them and are made glad, and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tortured the ones dwelling upon the earth.
And after the three days and a half, a spirit of life out of God entered in them, and they stood upon their feet, and great fear fell upon the ones beholding them.
And they heard a great voice out of heaven saying to them: Come up here. And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies beheld them.

And in that hour there came to be a great shaking, and the tenth of the city fell, and there were killed in the shaking names of humans, seven thousands; and the rest became full of fear and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second woe went away; behold the third woe comes quickly.

And the seventh messenger trumpeted, and there came to be great voices in heaven saying — masculine participle, feminine noun — The kingdom of the world became our Lord's and his Christ's, and he will reign into the ages of the ages.
And the twenty and four elders, the ones before the throne of God, who are sitting upon their thrones, fell upon their faces and bowed to God,
saying: We give thanks to you, Lord the God the all-holder, the one who is and the he-was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

And the nations were angered, and your wrath came, and the season of the dead to be judged, and to give the wage to your servants the prophets and to the holy ones and to the ones fearing your name, the small ones and the great ones, and to destroy the ones destroying the earth.

And the sanctuary of God, the one in heaven, was opened, and there was seen the ark of his covenant in his sanctuary; and there came to be lightnings and voices and thunders and a shaking and great hail.

revelation_12.t: And a great sign was seen in the heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon underneath her feet, and on her head a wreath of twelve stars,
and having in the belly, and she cries out, being in labour and being tormented to give birth.
And another sign was seen in the heaven, and look — a great fiery-red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems,

and his tail drags the third of the stars of the heaven, and he threw them to the earth. And the dragon has stood before the woman who is about to give birth, so that when she gives birth he might devour her child.
And she bore a son, a male, who is about to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod. And her child was snatched away to God and to his throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has there a place prepared from God, so that there they might feed her a thousand two hundred sixty days.
And there came to be war in the heaven: Michael and his angels — the to make war with the dragon. And the dragon made war, and his angels,
and he was not strong enough, nor was a place found of them any longer in the heaven.

And the great dragon was thrown, the ancient serpent, the one called Devil and the Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world — he was thrown to the earth, and his angels were thrown with him.

And I heard a great voice in the heaven saying: Now has come to be the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ, because the accuser of our brothers was thrown down, the one accusing them before our God day and night.
And they themselves conquered him through the blood of the Lamb and through the word of their witness, and they did not love their life until death.

Because of this, be glad, the heavens and the ones tenting in them. Woe to those inhabiting the earth and the sea, because the devil went down to you having great rage, knowing that he has little time.
And when the dragon saw that he was thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who bore the male.

And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, so that she might fly into the wilderness into her place, where she is fed there a time and times and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
And the serpent threw out of his mouth behind the woman water like a river, so that he might make her river-carried.
And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed the river which the dragon threw out of his mouth.
And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went off to make war with the rest of her seed, those keeping the commandments of God and having the witness of Jesus Christ.
And he stood upon the sand of the sea.

revelation_13.t: And I saw out of the sea a beast coming up, having ten horns and seven heads, and on its horns ten diadems, and on its heads names of blasphemy.
And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like a bear's, and its mouth like a lion's mouth. And the dragon gave to it his power and his throne and great authority.
And I saw one of its heads as though slaughtered to death, and the wound of its death was healed. And there was wonder in whole the earth after the beast,
and they worshipped the dragon because he gave the authority to the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying: Who is like the beast, and who is able to make war with it?
And there was given to it a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies, and there was given to it authority to make war forty-two months.
And it opened its mouth for blasphemies toward God, to blaspheme his name and his tent — those tenting in the heaven.
And there was given to it to make war with the holy ones and to conquer them, and there was given to it authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
And all those inhabiting on the earth will worship it — of whom his name has not been written in the book of the life of the Lamb slaughtered from the founding of the world.
If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
If anyone gathers into captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone by sword to be killed — it is necessary for him by sword to be killed. Here is the endurance and the trust of the holy ones.
And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb and it was speaking like a dragon.
And all the authority of the first beast it does before it, and it makes the earth and those inhabiting in it that they will worship the first beast, whose wound of its death was healed.
And it does great signs, so that it even makes fire come down out of the heaven to the earth before the humans.

And it deceives my own, those inhabiting on the earth, through the signs which were given to it to do before the beast, saying to those inhabiting on the earth to make an image for the beast who has the wound from the sword and lived.

And it was given to it to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak, and might make it that as many as do not worship the image of the beast might be killed.
And it makes all, the small and the great and the rich and the poor and the free and the slaves, that they should give them a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
and so that no one might be able to buy or to sell except the one having the mark, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
Here is the wisdom. Let the one having the mind calculate the number of the beast, for it is a number of a human, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.

revelation_14.t: And I saw, and look — the Lamb standing on the Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
And I heard a voice out of the heaven like a voice of many waters and like a voice of great thunder, and the voice which I heard was like harpers harping on their harps.

And they sing as it were a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders, and no one was able to learn the song except the hundred forty-four thousand, the ones purchased from the earth.

These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones following the Lamb wherever he goes. These were purchased from among the humans, a firstfruit to God and to the Lamb,
And in their mouth was found no falsehood; for they are blameless.
And I saw another angel flying in mid-heaven, having an eternal good news to announce as good news upon those sitting on the earth, and upon every nation and tribe and tongue and people,
saying with a great voice: Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgement came, and worship the one who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and springs of waters.
And another angel, a second, followed, saying: Fell, fell Babylon the great, she who from the wine of the rage of her sexual immorality has made all the nations drink.
And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice: If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
he himself also will drink of the wine of the rage of God, the one mixed unmixed in the cup of his wrath, and he will be tormented in fire and sulphur before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
And the smoke of their torment goes up into ages of ages, and they do not have rest day and night, those worshipping the beast and its image, and if anyone receives the mark of its name.
Here is the endurance of the holy ones, here, those keeping the commandments of God and the faith in Jesus.

And I heard a voice out of the heaven saying to me: Write: Blessed the dead who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, so that they will rest from their labours, for their works follow with them.
And I saw, and look — a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden wreath and in his hand a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out from the sanctuary, crying with a great voice to the one sitting on the cloud: Send your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap came for you, because the harvest of the earth was dried.
And the one sitting on the cloud threw his sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.
And another angel came out from the sanctuary that is in the heaven, having, he too, a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out from the altar, the one having authority over the fire, and he called with a great voice to the one having the sharp sickle, saying: Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because her grapes reached their peak.
And the angel threw his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth and threw it into the winepress of the rage of God, the great one.
And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as far as the bridles of the horses, from one thousand six hundred stadia.

revelation_15.t: And I saw another sign in the heaven, great and marvellous: seven angels having seven plagues, the last ones, because in them was completed the rage of God.
And I saw as it were a glassy sea mixed with fire, and those conquering out of the beast and out of its image and out of the number of its name, standing on the glassy sea, having harps of God.

And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb, saying: Great and marvellous are your works, Lord God the Almighty. Righteous and true are your ways, the King of the nations.
Who will not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? Because you alone are holy, because all the nations will come and will worship before you, because your righteous acts were made visible.
And after these things I saw, and look — the sanctuary of the tent of the witness in the heaven was opened.
And the seven angels having the seven plagues came out from the sanctuary, who were clothed in clean and bright linen and girded around the breasts with golden belts.
And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the rage of God who lives into the ages of the ages.
And the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one was able to enter into the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

revelation_16.t: And I heard a great voice out of the sanctuary saying to the seven angels: Go and pour out the seven bowls of the rage of God into the earth.
And the first went off and poured out his bowl into the earth, and there came to be a bad and evil sore upon the humans, those having the mark of the beast and those worshipping its image.
And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead person, and every soul of life died, the things in the sea.
And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and into the springs of the waters, and it became blood.
And I heard the angel of the waters saying: Righteous are you, Lord, the one being and the one was and the holy one, because you judged these things,
because they poured out blood of holy ones and prophets, and blood you have given them to drink; they are worthy.
And I heard another out of the altar saying: Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgements.
And the fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given to it to scorch the humans with fire.
And the humans were scorched a great scorching, and the humans blasphemed the name of God who has the authority over these plagues, and they did not change their mind to give him glory.
And the fifth angel poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkened, and they were chewing their tongues from the pain,
and they blasphemed the God of the heaven from their pains and from their sores, and they did not change their mind from their works.
And the sixth angel poured out his bowl upon the great river, the Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from the rising of the sun might be prepared.
And I saw out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs.
for they are spirits of demons doing signs, which go out upon the kings of the earth and of the whole inhabited world, to gather them to the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
Look, I come as a thief. Blessed the one keeping watch and keeping his garments, so that he may not walk naked and they see his shame.
And he gathered them into the place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.
And the seventh angel poured out his bowl upon the air, and a great voice came out from the sanctuary of the heaven, from the throne, saying: It has come to be.

And there came to be lightnings and voices and thunders, and there came to be a great earthquake, such as did not come to be from when the humans came to be upon the earth — so great an earthquake, so great.
And the great city came to be into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the rage of his wrath.
And every island fled, and mountains were not found.
And great hail as of a talent weight comes down out of the heaven upon the humans. And the humans blasphemed God from the plague of the hail, because its plague is exceedingly great.

revelation_17.t: And one of the seven angels having the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying to me: Come, I will show you the judgement of the great prostitute who sits on the many waters,
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those inhabiting the earth were made drunk from the wine of her sexual immorality.
And he carried me away into a wilderness in spirit. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and precious stone and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and the unclean things of her sexual immorality.
And on her forehead a name written: Mystery, Babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of the holy ones and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And I marvelled, seeing her, a great marvel.
And the angel said to me: Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast carrying her, the one having the seven heads and the ten horns.

The beast which you saw was and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and goes off into destruction. And those inhabiting on the earth will marvel, of whom the name has not been written upon the book of the life from the founding of the world, seeing the beast, that it was and is not and will be present.
Here is the mind having wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, where the woman sits on them; and they are seven kings;
The five fell, and the one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, it is necessary for him to remain a little.
And the beast which was and is not, and he himself is an eighth and is of the seven, and goes off into destruction.
And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but receive authority as kings one hour with the beast.
These have one mind, and they give their power and their authority to the beast.
These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with him are called and chosen and faithful.
And he says to me: The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds and nations and tongues.
And the ten horns which you saw and the beast — these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her fleshes and will burn her up with fire.
For God gave into their hearts to do his mind and to do one mind and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God will be completed.
And the woman whom you saw is the great city having a kingdom over the kings of the earth.

revelation_18.t: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of the heaven, having great authority, and the earth was lit up from his glory.

And he cried out with a strong voice, great, saying: Fell, fell Babylon the great, and she became a dwelling of demons and a guard-house of every unclean spirit and a guard-house of every unclean bird and a guard-house of every unclean and hated beast,

because from the wine of the rage of her sexual immorality all the nations have drunk, and the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her luxury.
And I heard another voice out of the heaven saying: Come out of her, the my people, so that you might not share together in her sins, and so that you might not receive from her plagues;
because her sins were glued as far as the heaven, and God remembered her wrongs.
Give back to her as she also gave back, and double to her the double things according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix for her double.
As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, so much give her torment and grief, because in her heart she says that I sit a queen and I am not a widow and I will certainly not see grief.
Because of this in one day her plagues will come, death and grief and famine, and she will be burned up with fire, because strong is the Lord God who judged her.
And the kings of the earth will weep and will beat themselves over her, those who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
standing from afar because of the fear of her torment, saying: Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon the strong city, because in one hour your judgement came.
And the merchants of the earth weep and grieve over her, because no one buys their cargo any longer;

cargo of gold and of silver and of precious stone and of pearls and of fine linen and of purple and of silk and of scarlet, and every citron wood and every ivory vessel and every vessel of most precious wood and of bronze and of iron and of marble,
and cinnamon and spice and incense and ointment and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep, and of horses and of carriages and of bodies, and souls of humans.
And the fruit of the desire of your soul went away from you, and all the fat things and the bright things perished from you, and they will certainly not find them any longer.
The merchants of these things, those who grew rich from her, will stand from afar because of the fear of her torment, weeping and grieving,
and saying: Woe, woe, the great city, the one clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and precious stone and pearl,
because in one hour so much wealth was made desolate. And every shipmaster and everyone sailing to a place, and the crowd, and sailors and as many as work the sea, stood from afar
and they were crying out, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying: What is like the great city?

And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and grieving and saying: Woe, woe, the great city, in which all those having the ships in the sea grew rich from her costliness, because in one hour she was made desolate.
Be glad over her, heaven, and the holy ones and the apostles and the prophets, because God judged your judgement from her.
And one strong angel lifted a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying: So with violence will Babylon the great city be thrown, and will certainly not be found any longer.

And a voice of harpers and of musicians and of flute-players and of trumpeters will certainly not be heard in you any longer, and every craftsman of every craft will certainly not be found in you any longer, and a voice of a millstone will certainly not be heard in you any longer,

and a light of a lamp will certainly not shine in you any longer, and a voice of a bridegroom and of a bride will certainly not be heard in you any longer, because your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because by your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
And in her was found blood of prophets and of holy ones and of all those slaughtered on the earth.

revelation_19.t: After these things I heard as it were a great voice of a numerous crowd in the heaven, saying: Hallelujah! The salvation and the glory and the honour and the power to the Lord of our God,
because true and righteous are his judgements, because he judged the great prostitute who was corrupting the earth with her sexual immorality, and he avenged the blood of his servants from her hand.
And a second time they have said: Hallelujah! And her smoke goes up into the ages of the ages.
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell and worshipped God who sits on the throne, saying: Amen, Hallelujah.
And a voice came out from the throne saying: Praise our God, all his servants and those fearing him, the small and the great.
And I heard as it were a voice of a numerous crowd and as it were a voice of many waters and as it were a voice of strong thunders, saying: Hallelujah, because the Lord our God the Almighty reigned.
Let us rejoice and let us exult and let us give the glory to him, because the wedding of the Lamb came, and his wife prepared herself.
And it was given to her that she should be clothed in fine linen, bright and clean; for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the holy ones.
And he says to me: Write: Blessed those called to the supper of the wedding of the Lamb. And he says to me: These are the true words of God.

And I fell before his feet to worship him, and he says to me: See — no. I am your fellow servant and of your brothers, those having, having the witness of Jesus. Worship God. For the witness of Jesus is the spirit of the prophecy.
And I saw the heaven opened, and look — a white horse, and the one sitting on it called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war;
and his eyes as a flame of fire, and on his head many diadems, having names written and a name written which no one knows except himself,
and clothed with a garment dipped in blood, and his name has been called: the Word of God.
and the armies in the heaven were following him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

And out of his mouth goes out a sharp two-edged sword, so that with it he might strike the nations. And he himself will shepherd them with an iron rod, and he himself treads the winepress of the wine of the rage and of the wrath of God the Almighty.
And he has on the garment and on his thigh a name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.
And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried out with a great voice, saying to all the birds flying in mid-heaven: Come, and be gathered to the great supper of God,

so that you may eat fleshes of kings and fleshes of commanders and fleshes of strong ones and fleshes of horses and of those sitting on them, and fleshes of all, both free and slaves and small and great.
And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to make the war with the one sitting on the horse and with his army.

And the beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who did the signs before it, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those worshipping its image. Living, the two were thrown into the lake of the fire that burns with sulphur.
And the rest were killed by the sword of the one sitting on the horse, the sword that came out of his mouth. And all the birds were filled from their fleshes.

revelation_20.t: And I saw an angel coming down out of the heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain upon his hand.
And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is Devil and the Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world, and he bound him a thousand years,

and he threw him into the abyss and shut and sealed above him, so that he might not deceive the nations any longer until the thousand years were completed. After these things it is necessary for him to be loosed a little time.

And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgement was given to them — and the souls of those beheaded because of the witness of Jesus and because of the word of God, and whoever did not worship the beast nor its image and did not receive the mark upon the forehead and upon their hand. And they came to life and reigned with the Christ the thousand years.
But the rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

Blessed and holy the one having a part in the first resurrection. Over these the second death does not have authority, but they will be priests of God and of the Christ, and they will reign with him the thousand years.
And when the thousand years are completed, the Satan will be loosed out of his prison,
and he will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, the Gog and the Magog, to gather them to the war, of whom their number is as the sand of the sea.
And they went up upon the breadth of the earth and encircled the camp of the holy ones and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of the heaven and devoured them.
And the devil who deceives them was thrown into the lake of the fire and sulphur, where also the beast and the false prophet, and they will be tormented day and night into the ages of the ages.
And I saw a great white throne and the one sitting upon it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled, and a place was not found for them.

And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is of the life. And the dead were judged out of the things written in the books, according to their works.
And the sea gave the dead who were in it, and the death and the Hades gave the dead who were in them, and they were judged each according to their works.
And the death and the Hades were thrown into the lake of the fire. This is the second death, the lake of the fire.
And if anyone was not found written in the book of the life, he was thrown into the lake of the fire.

revelation_21.t: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth. For the first heaven and the first earth went away, and the sea is not any longer.
And I, John, saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of the heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

And I heard a great voice out of the throne saying: Look — the tent of God with the humans, and he will tent with them. And they themselves will be his peoples, and he himself, God with them, will be their God.
And God will wipe away every tear out of their eyes, and the death will not be any longer, nor grief nor crying, nor will pain not be any longer; because the first things went away.
And the one sitting on the throne said: Look — I make all things new. And he says to me: Write, because these words are faithful and true.
And he said to me: They have come to be. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to the one thirsting out of the spring of the water of the life freely.
The one conquering will inherit these things, and I will be God to him, and he himself will be the son to me.

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and sinful and detestable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all the false ones — their part is in the lake burning with fire and sulphur, which is the second death.
And there came to me one of the seven angels having the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues, and he spoke with me saying: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.
And he carried me away in spirit onto a great and high mountain, and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, coming down out of the heaven from God,
having the glory of God. Her radiance was like a most precious stone, as a jasper stone, crystal-clear;
having a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel;
from the east three gates, and from the north three gates, and from the south three gates, and from the west three gates.
And the wall of the city having twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
And the one speaking with me had a measure, a golden reed, so that he might measure the city and her gates and her wall.
And the city lies four-square, and her length is as much as also the breadth. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; the length and the breadth and her height are equal.
And he measured her wall, a hundred forty-four cubits, a measure of a human, which is of an angel.
And the structure of her wall was jasper, and the city pure gold, like clear glass.
And the foundations of the wall of the city adorned with every precious stone. The first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates twelve pearls; each one of the gates was of one pearl. And the street of the city pure gold, like transparent glass.
And a sanctuary I did not see in her; for the Lord God the Almighty is her sanctuary, and the Lamb.
And the city has no need of the sun nor of the moon, that they might shine in her; for the glory of God lit her, and her lamp is the Lamb.
And the nations of the saved will walk through her light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and their honour into her.
And her gates will certainly not be shut by day; for night will not be there.
And they will bring the glory and the honour of the nations into her.
And there will certainly not enter into her anything common and the one doing an abomination and a falsehood, except those written in the book of the life of the Lamb.

revelation_22.t: And he showed me a clean river of water of life, bright as crystal, going out from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

In the middle of her street and of the river, on this side and on that, a tree of life producing twelve fruits, according to one month each yielding its fruit, and the leaves of the tree for the healing of the nations.
And every curse will not be any longer, and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in her, and his servants will serve him,
and they will see his face, and his name on their foreheads.
And night will not be any longer, and they have no need of light of lamp and of light of sun, because the Lord God will shine upon them. And they will reign into the ages of the ages.
And he said to me: These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things which must come to be quickly.
And look, I come quickly. Blessed the one keeping the words of the prophecy of this book.
And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
And he says to me: See — no. For I am your fellow servant and of your brothers the prophets and of those keeping the words of this book. Worship God.
And he says to me: Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, because, for the time is near.
The one doing wrong, let him do wrong still; and the filthy one, let him be filthy still; and the righteous one, let him do righteousness still; and the holy one, let him be made holy still.
Look, I come quickly, and my wage is with me, to give back to each as his work is.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
Blessed those washing their robes, so that their authority will be over the tree of the life, and by the gates they may enter into the city.
Outside: the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone loving and doing falsehood.
I, Jesus, sent my angel to witness these things to you upon the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star.
And the Spirit and the bride say: Come. And let the one hearing say: Come. And let the one thirsting come; let the one willing take the water of life freely.
I witness, I, to everyone hearing the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds upon them, God will add upon him the plagues written in this book.
And if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of the life and out of the holy city, from the things written in this book.
The one witnessing these things says: Yes, I come quickly. Amen. Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with all of the you. Amen.

romans_1.t: Paul, servant of Christ Jesus, called apostle, having been set apart for good news of God,
which he promised beforehand through his prophets in holy writings
concerning his Son, the one having come to be out of seed of David according to flesh,
the one having been marked out Son of God in power according to spirit of holiness out of resurrection of dead ones, Jesus Christ our Lord,
through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations on behalf of his name,
among whom are also you, called ones of Jesus Christ;
to all those being in Rome, beloved of God, called holy ones: grace to you and peace from God our Father and Lord Jesus Christ.
First indeed I thank my God through Jesus Christ concerning all of you, that your trust is proclaimed in the whole world;
For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the good news of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you,
always at my prayers asking if somehow now at last I shall be given a good journey in the will of God to come to you.
For I long to see you, that I may share with you some spiritual gift, for you to be made firm,
and this is to be encouraged together among you through the trust in one another, both yours and mine.

But I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers and sisters, that often I proposed to come to you and was prevented until the present, that I might have some fruit also among you just as also among the remaining nations.
To Greeks and to barbarians, to wise and to unthinking, I am a debtor;
so the eagerness as regards me is to announce good news also to you who are in Rome.
For I am not ashamed of the good news, for it is power of God unto salvation to everyone trusting, both to Jew first and to Greek.
For righteousness of God in it is revealed out of trust into trust, just as it has been written: 'But the righteous one out of trust will live.'
For wrath of God is revealed from heaven upon all irreverence and unrighteousness of humans who hold down the truth in unrighteousness,
because the knowable of God is manifest among them, for God manifested it to them.
For the invisible things of him from creation of world, being understood by the things made, are clearly seen, both his everlasting power and divinity, for them to be without defence.
because knowing God they did not glorify him as God or give thanks, but were made futile in their reasonings, and their uncomprehending heart was darkened;
asserting to be wise they were made foolish,
and they exchanged the glory of the imperishable God in likeness of image of perishable human and of birds and of four-footed and of creeping things.
Therefore God also handed them over in the desires of their hearts to uncleanness, for their bodies to be dishonoured among them,
who exchanged the truth of God in the lie, and revered and served the creation rather than the one having created, who is blessed unto the ages, amen.
Because of this God handed them over to passions of dishonour; for both their females exchanged the natural use into the one contrary to nature,

and likewise also the males, having left the natural use of the female, were burned up in their craving toward one another, males with males working out the indecency and receiving back in themselves the recompense which was necessary of their straying.
And just as they did not approve to have God in recognition, God handed them over to an unapproved mind, to do the things not proper,
having been filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, greed, badness, full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity, whisperers,
slanderers, God-hated, insolent, arrogant, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
without understanding, without covenant, without natural affection, without truce, without mercy.
who, having recognised the righteous decree of God, that those practising such things are worthy of death, not only do them but also give hearty approval to those practising them.

romans_2.t: Therefore you are without defence, O human, everyone judging; for in what you judge the other, you condemn yourself, for you practise the same things, the one judging.
But we know that the judgement of God is according to truth upon those practising such things;
But do you reckon this, O human judging those practising such things and doing them, that you will escape the judgement of God?
or do you despise the wealth of his kindness and the forbearance and the patience, not knowing that the kind thing of God leads you into change of mind?
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you store up for yourself wrath in a day of wrath and revelation of righteous judgement of God,
who will render to each according to his works,
to those on the one hand according to endurance of good work seeking glory and honour and imperishability, eternal life;
but to those out of selfish ambition and disobeying the truth but obeying the unrighteousness, wrath and rage,
affliction and narrowness upon every soul of a human working out the evil, both of Jew first and of Greek;
but glory and honour and peace to everyone working the good, both to Jew first and to Greek;
For there is no receiving of face beside God.
For as many as sinned lawlessly will also perish lawlessly, and as many as sinned in law will be judged through law;
for not the hearers of law are righteous beside God, but the doers of law will be justified.
For whenever nations, the ones not having law, by nature do the things of the law, these not having law are to themselves law,
who show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience witnessing together and among one another the reasonings accusing or even defending,
in a day when God judges the hidden things of humans according to my good news through Christ Jesus.
But if you are named a Jew and rest upon law and boast in God
and know the will and approve the things differing, being instructed out of the law,
and you have been convinced yourself to be a guide of blind ones, a light of those in darkness,
an instructor of foolish ones, a teacher of infants, having the form of the knowledge and of the truth in the law;
the one therefore teaching another, do you not teach yourself? The one proclaiming not to steal, do you steal?
The one saying not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? The one detesting the idols, do you rob temples?
who boast in law, through the transgression of the law you dishonour God?
For the name of God because of you is blasphemed among the nations, just as it has been written.
For circumcision indeed benefits if you practise law; but if you are a transgressor of law, your circumcision has become foreskin.
If therefore the foreskin keeps the righteous requirements of the law, will not his foreskin be reckoned unto circumcision?
And the foreskin by nature, completing the law, will judge you, the transgressor of law through letter and circumcision.
For not the one in the open is a Jew, nor the circumcision in the open in flesh,
but the one in the hidden is a Jew, and circumcision of heart in spirit not letter, of whom the praise is not out of humans but out of God.

romans_3.t: What then is the superiority of the Jew, or what the benefit of the circumcision?
Much according to every manner. For first indeed that they were entrusted with the oracles of God.
For what if some were unfaithful? Their unfaithfulness will not nullify the faithfulness of God, will it?
May it not be. But let God be true, and every human a liar, just as it has been written: 'That you may be justified in your words and will conquer in your being judged.'
But if our unrighteousness commends righteousness of God, what shall we say? The God bringing on the wrath is not unrighteous, is he? I speak according to a human.
May it not be; since how will God judge the world?
But if the truth of God in my lie abounded unto his glory, why still am I also judged as a sinner?
and not just as we are blasphemed and just as some claim us to say that 'Let us do the evil things that the good things may come'? Of whom the judgement is deserved.
What then? Do we hold before? Not at all. For we previously charged both Jews and Greeks all to be under sin,
just as it has been written that 'There is not a righteous one, not even one;
there is not the one understanding, there is not the one seeking out God.
all turned aside, together they were made useless; there is not the one doing kindness, there is not until one.
an opened grave is their throat, with their tongues they were deceiving; venom of asps is under their lips;
of whom the mouth is full of cursing and bitterness;
swift are their feet to pour out blood;
ruin and misery are in their ways,
and a way of peace they did not know.
There is not fear of God before their eyes.'
But we know that whatever the law says it speaks to those in the law, that every mouth may be fenced and all the world become liable to God;
because out of works of law all flesh will not be justified before him; for through law is recognition of sin.
But now apart from law righteousness of God has been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets,
and righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all and upon all those trusting; for there is no distinction;
for all sinned and are lacking the glory of God,
being justified as a gift by his grace through the redemption in Christ Jesus,
whom God set forth a propitiation through trust in his blood, unto demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of the previously occurred sins in the forbearance of God;
toward the demonstration of his righteousness in the now time, for him to be righteous and the justifier of the one out of faith in Jesus.
Where then is the boasting? It was excluded. Through what sort of law? Of the works? No, but through law of trust.
For we reckon a human to be justified by trust apart from works of law.
Or of Jews is God only? Not also of nations? Yes, also of nations,
if indeed one is God who will justify circumcision out of trust and foreskin through the trust.
Law therefore do we nullify through the trust? May it not be, but we establish law.

romans_4.t: What then shall we say Abraham our forefather to have found according to flesh?
For if Abraham out of works was justified, he has a boast, but not toward God.
For what does the writing say? 'And Abraham trusted God, and it was reckoned to him unto righteousness.'
But to the one working the wage is not reckoned according to grace but according to debt;
but to the one not working but trusting upon the one justifying the irreverent, his trust is reckoned unto righteousness.
just as also David says the blessedness of the human to whom God reckons righteousness apart from works:
'Blessed are those of whom the lawlessnesses were forgiven and of whom the sins were covered over;
blessed is a man of whom the Lord will by no means reckon sin.'
This blessedness therefore, is it upon the circumcision or also upon the foreskin? For we say that 'To Abraham the trust was reckoned unto righteousness.'
How then was it reckoned? Being in circumcision or in foreskin? Not in circumcision but in foreskin;

and a sign he received of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the trust in the foreskin, for him to be father of all those trusting through foreskin, for the righteousness to be reckoned also to them,
and father of circumcision to those not out of circumcision only but also to those walking in line in the footsteps of the trust in foreskin of our father Abraham.
For not through law is the promise to Abraham or to his seed, the to be him heir of world, but through righteousness of trust.
For if those out of law are heirs, the trust has been emptied and the promise nullified;
For the law works out wrath; but where there is not law, neither transgression.

Because of this out of trust, that according to grace, for the promise to be firm to all the seed, not to the one out of the law only but also to the one out of trust of Abraham, who is father of all of us,
just as it has been written that 'A father of many nations I have placed you', before whom he trusted, God, the one making alive the dead and calling the things not being as being;
who beyond hope upon hope trusted, unto the to become him father of many nations according to the thing having been said: 'Thus will be your seed.'
and not having weakened in the trust he did not consider his own body already having been put to death, being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of the womb of Sarah;
but unto the promise of God he was not divided by unbelief but was empowered in the trust, having given glory to God,
and having been fully assured that what he has promised he is able also to do.
Therefore also it was reckoned to him unto righteousness.
But it was not written because of him only that it was reckoned to him,
but also because of us, to whom it is about to be reckoned, to those trusting upon the one having raised Jesus our Lord out of dead ones,
who was handed over because of our trespasses and was raised because of our justification.

romans_5.t: Having been justified therefore out of trust, we have peace toward God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
through whom also we have had the access by the trust into this grace in which we have stood, and we boast upon hope of the glory of God,
and not only, but also we boast in the afflictions, knowing that the affliction works out endurance,
and the endurance testedness, and the testedness hope;
and the hope does not shame, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through Holy Spirit given to us.
For still Christ, we being weak, still according to time died on behalf of irreverent ones;
For scarcely on behalf of a righteous one will anyone die; for on behalf of the good one perhaps someone even dares to die;
But God commends his own love unto us, that while we were still sinners Christ died on behalf of us.
Much more therefore having been justified now in his blood we will be saved through him from the wrath.
For if being enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more having been reconciled we will be saved in his life;
and not only, but also boasting in God through our Lord Jesus Christ through whom now we received the reconciliation.
Therefore just as through one human the sin entered into the world and through the sin the death, and thus into all humans the death passed through, because all sinned —
for until law sin was in world, but sin is not reckoned there not being law;
but the death reigned from Adam until Moses even upon those not having sinned upon the likeness of the transgression of Adam, who is a type of the coming one.

But not as the trespass thus also the gracious gift; for if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more the grace of God and the gift in grace, the one of the one human Jesus Christ, abounded unto the many.
And not as through one having sinned is the gift; for the judgement on the one hand out of one unto condemnation, but the gracious gift out of many trespasses unto a righteous verdict.

For if by the trespass of the one the death reigned through the one, much more those receiving the abundance of the grace and of the gift of the righteousness in life will reign through the one, Jesus Christ.
So then as through one trespass unto all humans unto condemnation, thus also through one righteous act unto all humans unto justification of life.
For just as through the disobedience of the one human the many were appointed sinners, thus also through the obedience of the one the many will be appointed righteous.
But law came in alongside, that the trespass might increase; but where the sin increased, the grace superabounded,
that just as the sin reigned in the death, thus also the grace might reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

romans_6.t: What then shall we say? Shall we remain in the sin that the grace may increase?
May it not be. We who died to the sin, how still shall we live in it?
Or are you ignorant that as many of us as were baptised into Christ Jesus were baptised into his death?

We were buried together therefore with him through the baptism into the death, that just as Christ was raised out of dead ones through the glory of the Father, thus also we in newness of life might walk.
For if grown-together we have become in the likeness of his death, but also of the resurrection we shall be;
knowing this, that our old human was crucified together, that the body of the sin might be nullified, for us no longer to be slaves to the sin;
for the one having died has been freed from the sin.
But if we died together with Christ, we trust that also we shall live together with him,
knowing that Christ having been raised out of dead ones no longer dies, death of him no longer rules.
For what he died, he died to the sin once for all; but what he lives, he lives to God.
Thus also you reckon yourselves to be dead ones on the one hand to the sin, but living ones to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Let not the sin therefore reign in your mortal body, for the to obey it in its desires;
nor present your members to the sin as weapons of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as living out of dead ones and your members weapons of righteousness to God.
For sin of you will not rule, for you are not under law but under grace.
What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it not be.
Do you not know that to whom you present yourselves slaves unto obedience, slaves you are to whom you obey, whether of sin unto death or of obedience unto righteousness?
But thanks to God that you were slaves of the sin, but you obeyed out of heart unto which you were handed over pattern of teaching.
And having been freed from the sin you were enslaved to the righteousness.

A human thing I say because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented your members slaves to the uncleanness and to the lawlessness unto the lawlessness, thus now present your members slaves to the righteousness unto holiness.
For when slaves you were of the sin, free you were to the righteousness.
What fruit therefore were you having then, upon which things now you are ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
But now having been freed from the sin and having been enslaved to God, you have your fruit unto holiness, and the end eternal life.
For the rations of the sin are death, but the gracious gift of God eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

romans_7.t: Or are you ignorant, brothers and sisters, for to those knowing law I speak, that the law rules the human for as long a time as he lives?
For the under-a-man woman to the living man has been bound by law; but if the man dies, she has been nullified from the law of the man.

So then while the man lives an adulteress she will be designated if she becomes to another man; but if the man dies, free she is from the law, for her not to be an adulteress having become to another man.

So that, my brothers and sisters, also you were put to death to the law through the body of the Christ, for you to become to another, to the one out of dead ones having been raised, that we might bear fruit to God.
For when we were in the flesh, the passions of the sins which were through the law were working in our members unto the to bear fruit to the death.
But now we were nullified from the law, having died in what we were held down, so that we serve as slaves in newness of spirit and not in oldness of letter.
What then shall we say? The law is sin? May it not be; but the sin I did not know except through law; for indeed the desire I had not known if the law were not saying: 'You shall not desire.'
But base having taken, the sin through the commandment worked out in me all desire; for apart from law sin is dead.
But I was living apart from law once; but the commandment having come, the sin lived again,
and I died, and was found to me the commandment, the one unto life, this one unto death;
for the sin base having taken through the commandment thoroughly deceived me and through it killed;
So that the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy and righteous and good.

The good therefore to me became death? May it not be; but the sin, that it might appear sin, through the good working out death to me, that the sin might become excessively sinful through the commandment.
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshen, having been sold under the sin.
For what I work out I do not know; for not what I want this I practise, but what I hate this I do.
But if what I do not want this I do, I agree together with the law that it is good.
But now no longer I work it out but the dwelling in me sin.
For I know that there does not dwell in me, that is in my flesh, good; for the to want lies beside me, but the to work out the fine thing not.
For not what I want I do, good, but what I do not want, evil, this I practise.
But if what I do not want, this I do, no longer I work it out but the dwelling in me sin.
I find then the law, to me wanting to do the fine thing, that to me the evil lies beside.
For I delight together with the law of God according to the inner human,
but I see another law in my members warring against the law of my mind and taking me captive in the law of the sin being in my members.
Wretched I, a human; who will rescue me out of the body of this death?
But thanks to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then, I myself on the one hand with the mind serve as slave to law of God, but with the flesh to law of sin.

romans_8.t: Nothing therefore now is condemnation to those in Christ Jesus not according to flesh walking but according to spirit.
For the law of the spirit of the life in Christ Jesus freed you from the law of the sin and of the death.
For the impossible of the law, in which it was weak through the flesh, God, his own Son having sent in likeness of flesh of sin and concerning sin, condemned the sin in the flesh,
that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, the ones not according to flesh walking but according to spirit.
For those according to flesh being, the things of the flesh they mind; but those according to spirit, the things of the spirit.
For the mindset of the flesh is death, but the mindset of the spirit life and peace;
because the mindset of the flesh is enmity unto God; for to the law of God it does not submit, for neither is it able;
and those in flesh being are not able to please God.
But you are not in flesh but in spirit, if indeed spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone does not have spirit of Christ, this one is not of him.
But if Christ in you, the body indeed dead because of sin, but the Spirit life because of righteousness.

But if the spirit of the one having raised Jesus out of dead ones dwells in you, the one having raised Christ out of dead ones will make alive also your mortal bodies through his indwelling spirit in you.
So then, brothers and sisters, debtors we are, not to the flesh, of the to live according to flesh;
For if according to flesh you live, you are about to die; but if by spirit the practices of the body you put to death, you will live.
For as many as by spirit of God are led, these are sons of God.
For you did not receive a spirit of slavery again unto fear, but you received a spirit of placement as a son, in which we cry: Abba, the Father.
The spirit itself witnesses together with our spirit that we are children of God.
But if children, also heirs; heirs on the one hand of God, but co-heirs of Christ, if indeed we suffer together that also we may be glorified together.
For I reckon that not worthy are the sufferings of the now time toward the about-to-be-revealed glory unto us.
For the eager-watching of the creation eagerly awaits the revelation of the sons of God;
For to futility the creation was subjected, not willing but because of the one having subjected, upon hope
that also itself the creation will be freed from the slavery of the corruption into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.
For we know that all the creation groans together and travails together until the now;
and not only, but also ourselves the firstfruit of the spirit having, we also ourselves in ourselves groan, placement as a son eagerly awaiting, the redemption of our body.
For by the hope we were saved; but hope being seen is not hope; for what someone sees, why does he also hope for?
But if what we do not see we hope for, through endurance we eagerly await.

And likewise also the spirit takes hold together with our weakness; for the what we should pray according to what is necessary we do not know, but itself the spirit intercedes on behalf of us with unspoken groans;
But the one searching the hearts knows what the mindset of the spirit is, because according to God it intercedes on behalf of holy ones.
But we know that to those loving God all things God works together unto good, to those according to purpose being called.
because whom he foreknew, also he marked out beforehand conformed to the image of his Son, for him to be firstborn among many brothers.
But whom he marked out beforehand, these also he called; and whom he called, these also he justified; but whom he justified, these also he glorified.
What then shall we say toward these things? If God is on behalf of us, who is against us?
who indeed his own Son did not spare but on behalf of us all handed him over, how will he not also together with him all things to us graciously give?
Who will call a charge against chosen ones of God? God is the one justifying;
Who is the one condemning? Christ Jesus the one having died, but rather also having been raised out of dead ones, who also is at right hand of God, who also intercedes on behalf of us.
