Who will separate us from the love of the Christ? Affliction or narrowness or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
just as it has been written that 'For your sake we are being put to death the whole day, we were reckoned as sheep of slaughter.'
But in these things all we hyper-conquer through the one having loved us.
For I have been persuaded that neither death nor life nor angels nor rulers nor things present nor things about to be nor powers
nor height nor depth nor any other creation will be able us to separate from the love of God, the one in Christ Jesus our Lord.

romans_9.t: Truth I speak in Christ, I do not lie, my conscience witnessing together with me in holy spirit,
that grief to me is great and unceasing anguish in my heart.
For I was praying to be anathema myself, I, away from the Christ, on behalf of my brothers, my kin according to flesh;
who are Israelites, whose is the placement as a son and the glory and the covenants and the law-giving and the service and the promises,
whose are the fathers and out of whom the Christ according to flesh, the one being over all, God blessed into the ages, amen.
But not such as that the word of God has fallen out. For not all those out of Israel, these are Israel;
nor because they are seed of Abraham are all children, but: in Isaac seed will be called for you.
This is: not the children of the flesh, these are children of God, but the children of the promise are reckoned into seed.
For of promise is this word: according to this season I will come and there will be to Sarah a son.
And not only, but also Rebecca, having conception from one, Isaac our father;
for they not yet having been born nor having done anything good or worthless, in order that the purpose of God according to selection might remain,
not out of works but out of the one calling, it was said to her that the greater will be slave to the lesser;
as it has been written: the Jacob I loved, but the Esau I hated.
What then will we say? Not injustice alongside God? May it not be.
For to Moses he says: I will show mercy on whom I show mercy, and I will show compassion on whom I show compassion.
So then not of the one willing nor of the one running but of the merciful God.
For the scripture says to Pharaoh that for this very thing I raised you up, so that I might show forth in you my power and so that my name might be announced in all the earth.
So then whom he wills he shows mercy, and whom he wills he hardens.
You will say to me therefore: why does he still blame? For who has withstood his purpose?
O human, on the contrary, who are you, the one answering back to God? Will the thing moulded say to the one having moulded: why did you make me thus?
Or does the potter not have authority of the clay, out of the same lump to make one vessel into honour and one into dishonour?
But if God, willing to show forth the wrath and to make known his power, bore in much patience vessels of wrath having been fitted for destruction,
and in order that he might make known the riches of his glory upon vessels of mercy which he prepared beforehand for glory?
whom also he called, us, not only out of Jews but also out of nations,
as also in Hosea he says: I will call the not-my-people my people and the not-having-been-loved having-been-loved.
And it will be in the place where it was said to them: not my people you — there they will be called sons of God living.
But Isaiah cries out on behalf of Israel: if the number of the sons of Israel be as the sand of the sea, the remainder will be saved;
For completing and cutting short a word, because a word having been cut short the Lord will do upon the earth.
And as Isaiah has said before: if the Lord Sabaoth had not left behind seed for us, as Sodom we would have become and as Gomorrah we would have been made like.
What then will we say? That nations, the ones not pursuing righteousness, laid hold of righteousness, but righteousness the one out of trust;
but Israel, pursuing law of righteousness, did not arrive at law of righteousness.
Through what? Because not out of trust but as out of works of law; for they struck against the stone of the striking,
as it has been written: behold I place in Zion a stone of striking and a rock of snare, and everyone trusting upon him will not be shamed.

romans_10.t: Brothers and sisters, the good pleasure of my heart and the petition to God on their behalf is for salvation.
For I witness to them that they have zeal of God but not according to recognition.
For being ignorant of the righteousness of God and seeking to establish the own righteousness, to the righteousness of God they did not subject themselves.
For end of law is Christ, for righteousness to everyone trusting.
For Moses writes the righteousness the one out of the law that the human having done them will live in them.
But the out of trust righteousness thus says: do not say in your heart: who will ascend into the heaven? this is, Christ to bring down;
or: who will descend into the abyss? this is, Christ out of dead ones to bring up.
But what does it say? Near you the word is, in your mouth and in your heart; this is the word of the trust which we proclaim,
that if you confess the word in your mouth, that Lord Jesus, and trust in your heart that God raised him out of dead ones, you will be saved.
For with heart it is trusted into righteousness, and with mouth it is confessed into salvation.
For the scripture says: everyone trusting upon him will not be shamed.
For there is not a distinction of Jew and also of Greek; for the same Lord of all, being rich into all the ones calling upon him.
For everyone whoever calls upon the name of the Lord will be saved.
How then might they call upon whom they did not trust? And how might they trust of whom they did not hear? And how might they hear apart from one proclaiming?
And how might they proclaim if they are not sent? As it has been written: how timely the feet of the ones bringing good news of peace, of the ones bringing good news of the good things.
But not all obeyed the good news; for Isaiah says: Lord, who trusted our hearing?
So the trust out of hearing, and the hearing through word of Christ.
But I say: did they not hear? On the contrary, into all the earth went out their sound and into the limits of the inhabited world their words.
But I say: did Israel not know? First Moses says: I will provoke you to jealousy over a not-nation, over a nation without understanding I will provoke you to anger.
But Isaiah dares and says: I was found among the ones not seeking me, I became manifest among the ones not enquiring after me.
But toward Israel he says: the whole day I spread out my hands toward a disobeying and contradicting people.

romans_11.t: I say therefore: did God push away his people? May it not be. For I also am an Israelite, out of seed of Abraham, of tribe of Benjamin.
God did not push away his people whom he foreknew. Or do you not know in Elijah what the scripture says, as he pleads to God against Israel, saying?
Lord, your prophets they killed, and your altars they dug down, and I was left behind alone, and they seek my soul.
But what does the oracle say to him? I left behind for myself seven thousand men who did not bend a knee to the Baal.
Thus therefore also in the now time a remainder according to selection of grace has come to be.
But if by grace, no longer out of works, since the grace no longer becomes grace; but if out of works, no longer is it grace, since the work is no longer work.
What then? What Israel seeks after, this it did not obtain, but the selection obtained; but the rest were hardened,
as it has been written: God gave to them a spirit of stupefaction, eyes of the not to see and ears of the not to hear, until the today day.
And David says: let their table become into a snare and into a hunt and into a stumbling block and into a repayment for them;
let their eyes be darkened of the not to see, and their back through everything bend down.
I say therefore: did they stumble in order that they might fall? May it not be. But by their trespass the salvation to the nations, for the provoking them to jealousy.
But if their trespass is riches of world and their defeat riches of nations, how much more their fullness?
But to you I speak, to the nations; upon as much therefore as I am apostle of nations, my service I glorify,
if somehow I might provoke to jealousy my flesh and save some out of them.
For if their casting away is reconciliation of world, what the receiving if not life out of dead ones?
But if the firstfruit is holy, also the lump; and if the root is holy, also the branches.
But if some of the branches were broken off, and you being a wild olive were grafted in among them and became a co-sharer of the root and of the fatness of the olive,
do not boast against the branches; but if you boast against, you do not bear the root but the root you.
You will say therefore: branches were broken off in order that I might be grafted in.
Well; by the unbelief they were broken off, but you by the trust have stood. Do not think high things but fear;
For if God did not spare the according-to-nature branches, neither somehow will he spare you.
See therefore kindness and severity of God: upon the ones having fallen severity, but upon you kindness of God, if you remain in the kindness; since you also will be cut out.
And those also, if they do not remain in the unbelief, will be grafted in; for able is God again to graft them in.

For if you out of the according-to-nature wild olive were cut out and beside nature were grafted into a cultivated olive, how much more these the according-to-nature ones will be grafted into their own olive?

For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers and sisters, of this mystery, so that you may not be wise among yourselves, that a hardening from part to Israel has come to be until which the fullness of the nations comes in,
and thus all Israel will be saved, as it has been written: the one delivering will come out of Zion, he will turn away ungodlinesses from Jacob;
and this to them the covenant from me, whenever I take away their sins.
According to the good news enemies through you, but according to the selection beloved through the fathers;
For without regret are the gifts and the calling of God.
For just as you also once disobeyed God but now were shown mercy by the disobedience of these,
thus also these now disobeyed by the mercy to you, in order that they also now might be shown mercy.
For God shut up together the all into disobedience, in order that the all he might show mercy.
O depth of riches and of wisdom and of knowledge of God; how unsearchable his judgements and untrackable his ways.
For who knew the mind of the Lord? Or who became his counsellor?
Or who gave beforehand to him, and it will be repaid to him?
Because out of him and through him and into him the all things; to him the glory into the ages, amen.

romans_12.t: I appeal to you therefore, brothers and sisters, through the compassions of God, to present your bodies a sacrifice living holy well-pleasing to God, your reasoned service.
And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind, for the testing by you what the will of God is, the good and well-pleasing and complete.

For I say through the grace given to me to everyone being among you, not to think above beyond what it is necessary to think, but to think for the thinking soberly, to each as God apportioned a measure of trust.
For just as in one body many members we have, but the members all do not have the same practice,
thus the many one body we are in Christ, but each one members of one another.
But having gifts according to the grace given to us differing, whether prophecy according to the proportion of the trust,
whether service in the service, whether the one teaching in the teaching,
whether the one exhorting in the exhortation, the one sharing in simplicity, the one standing before in diligence, the one showing mercy in gladness.
The love unhypocritical. Abhorring the evil, being glued to the good;
In the brotherly love toward one another tenderly loving, in the honour one another going before,
In the diligence not hesitant, in the spirit boiling, for the Lord slaving,
In the hope rejoicing, in the affliction enduring, in the prayer persevering,
To the needs of the holy ones sharing, the love of strangers pursuing;
Bless the ones persecuting you; bless and do not curse.
To rejoice with rejoicing ones, and to weep with weeping ones.
The same thing toward one another thinking, not the high things thinking but with the lowly being carried along; do not become wise among yourselves.
To no one evil in place of evil giving back, taking forethought for good things before all humans,
If possible, the from you, with all humans being at peace;
Not avenging yourselves, beloved, but give place to the wrath; for it has been written: to me vengeance, I will repay, says the Lord.
But if your enemy hungers, feed him; if he thirsts, give him drink; for doing this coals of fire you will heap upon his head.
Do not be conquered by the evil but conquer in the good the evil.

romans_13.t: Let every soul be subject to authorities holding above. For there is not authority if not by God, and the ones being have been ordered by God.
So that the one setting himself against the authority has withstood the ordering of God; but the ones having withstood will receive judgement for themselves.
For the rulers are not a fear to the good work but to the evil. But do you want not to fear the authority? The good do and you will have praise out of it;
for of God a servant it is to you for the good. But if the evil you do, fear; for not in vain does it bear the sword; for of God a servant it is, an avenger for wrath to the one practising the evil.
Therefore necessity to be subject, not only through the wrath but also through the conscience.
For through this also you pay taxes; for public servants of God they are, persevering for this very thing.
Give back therefore to all the debts: to the one the tax the tax, to the one the duty the duty, to the one the fear the fear, to the one the honour the honour.
To no one nothing owe except the to love one another; for the one loving the other has fulfilled law.

For the you shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness, you shall not desire, and if any other commandment, in this word it is summed up, in the you shall love your neighbour as yourself.
The love to the neighbour evil does not work; fullness therefore of law is the love.
And this knowing the season, that hour already for you out of sleep to be raised; for now nearer of us the salvation than when we trusted.
The night advanced, but the day has drawn near. Let us therefore put away the works of the darkness, and let us put on the weapons of the light.
As in day, becomingly let us walk, not in revels and drunkennesses, not in beddings and licentiousnesses, not in strife and jealousy.
But put on the Lord Jesus Christ and of the flesh do not make forethought for desires.

romans_14.t: But the one being weak in the trust receive, not for disputes of reasonings.
One trusts to eat all things, but the one being weak eats vegetables.
The one eating the not eating let him not despise, and the one not eating the one eating let him not judge; for God received him.
You, who are you, the one judging another's household slave? To the own lord he stands or falls; but he will be stood, for able is the Lord to stand him.
For one judges a day beyond a day, but one judges every day; let each in the own mind be fully carried.

The one minding the day to the Lord minds, and the one not minding the day to the Lord does not mind; and the one eating to the Lord eats, for he gives thanks to God; and the one not eating to the Lord does not eat and gives thanks to God.
For none of us to himself lives and none to himself dies.
For both if we live, to the Lord we live, and if we die, to the Lord we die. Both if therefore we live and if we die, of the Lord we are.
For into this Christ both died and rose and lived, in order that both of dead ones and of living ones he might be Lord.
But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you also, why do you despise your brother? For all we will stand before the judgement seat of God.
For it has been written: I live, says the Lord, that to me will bend every knee and every tongue will confess out to God.
So then each of us concerning himself will give account to God.
No longer therefore let us judge one another; but judge this rather, the not to place a stumbling block for the brother or a snare.
I know and have been persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing common through itself, except to the one reckoning something to be common, to that one it is common.
For if through food your brother is grieved, no longer according to love you walk. Do not by your food destroy that one on behalf of whom Christ died.
Let not therefore be blasphemed your good.
For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking but righteousness and peace and joy in holy spirit.
For the one in this slaving for Christ is well-pleasing to God and approved to humans.
So then the things of the peace let us pursue and the things of the building up the toward one another.
Not for the sake of food destroy the work of God. All things indeed clean, but evil to the human eating through a stumbling block.
Good the not to eat meats nor to drink wine nor in what your brother strikes against or is snared or is weak.
You, the trust which you have according to yourself have before God. Blessed the one not judging himself in what he tests.
But the one doubting if he eats has been condemned, because not out of trust; and everything which is not out of trust is sin.

romans_15.t: But we ought, we the able ones, the weaknesses of the unable ones to bear and not ourselves to please.
For each of us let him please the neighbour for the good toward building up.
For also the Christ did not please himself but as it has been written: the reproaches of the ones reproaching you fell upon me.
For as much as was written before, all for our teaching was written, in order that through the endurance and through the exhortation of the scriptures we might have the hope.
But the God of the endurance and of the exhortation may he give to you the same thing to think among one another according to Christ Jesus,
in order that with one passion in one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Therefore receive one another, just as also the Christ received you into glory of God.
For I say Christ to have become a servant of circumcision on behalf of truth of God, for the confirming of the promises of the fathers,
but the nations on behalf of mercy to glorify God, as it has been written: through this I will confess out to you among nations and to your name I will sing.
And again it says: be glad, nations, with his people.
And again: praise, all the nations, the Lord, and let all the peoples praise him.
And again Isaiah says: there will be the root of Jesse, and the one rising up to rule nations; upon him nations will hope.
But the God of the hope may he fill you with all joy and peace in the trusting, for the abounding of you in the hope in power of holy spirit.

But I have been persuaded, my brothers and sisters, also I myself concerning you, that also you yourselves are full of goodness, having been filled with all the knowledge, able also one another to admonish.
But more boldly I wrote to you, brothers, in part as reminding you again through the grace given to me by God,

for the to be me a public servant of Christ Jesus into the nations, working as a priest the good news of God, in order that the offering of the nations might become well-received, having been made holy in holy spirit.
I have therefore the boasting in Christ Jesus the things toward God;
For I will not dare to speak anything of the things which Christ did not work through me for obedience of nations by word and work,
in power of signs and portents, in power of spirit of God, so that me from Jerusalem and in a circle as far as Illyricum to have fulfilled the good news of the Christ.
But thus being ambitious to bring good news not where Christ was named, in order that not upon another's foundation I might build,
but as it has been written: to whom it was not announced concerning him they will see, and the ones who have not heard will understand.
Therefore also I was being hindered the many times of the to come to you.
But now no longer place having in these climates, but longing having of the to come to you from many years,
as whenever I journey into Spain I will come to you; for I hope journeying through to see you and by you to be sent forward there, if of you first in part I may be filled.
But now I journey into Jerusalem serving the holy ones.
For Macedonia and Achaia were well pleased a certain sharing to make for the poor of the holy ones the ones in Jerusalem.
For they were well pleased, and debtors they are of them; for if in their spiritual things the nations shared, they owe also in the fleshly things to serve them as public servants.
This therefore having completed and having sealed for them this fruit, I will go away through you into Spain.
But I know that coming to you in fullness of blessing of Christ I will come.
But I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the spirit, to struggle together with me in the prayers on my behalf toward God,
in order that I may be delivered from the ones disobeying in Judea and in order that my service the one for Jerusalem well-received to the holy ones may become,
in order that in joy having come to you through will of God and I may rest together with you.
But the God of the peace with all of you, amen.

romans_16.t: But I commend to you Phoebe our sister, being also a servant of the assembly the one in Cenchreae,

in order that her you may receive in the Lord worthily of the holy ones and may stand beside her in whatever matter of you she may need; for also she herself a patroness of many became and of me myself.
Greet Prisca and Aquila my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
who on behalf of my soul their own neck laid down, to whom not I alone give thanks but also all the assemblies of the nations,
and the according to their house assembly. Greet Epaenetus my beloved, who is firstfruit of Asia into Christ.
Greet Mary, who laboured much for you.
Greet Andronicus and Junia my kinspeople and my fellow captives, who are notable among the apostles, who also before me have come to be in Christ.
Greet Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.
Greet Urbanus our fellow worker in Christ and Stachys my beloved.
Greet Apelles the approved in Christ. Greet the ones out of the ones of Aristobulus.
Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet the ones out of the ones of Narcissus, the ones being in the Lord.
Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa the ones labouring in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who laboured much in the Lord.
Greet Rufus the chosen in the Lord and his mother and mine.
Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the brothers with them.
Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister and Olympas and all the holy ones with them.
Greet one another in a holy kiss. All the assemblies of the Christ greet you.
But I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, to watch the ones the divisions and the snares alongside the teaching which you learned making, and turn away from them.
For such ones for our Lord Christ do not slave but for their own belly, and through the smooth speech and blessing they deceive the hearts of the guileless.
For your obedience to all arrived; over you therefore I rejoice, but I want you to be wise indeed toward the good, and unmixed toward the evil.
But the God of the peace will crush the Satan under your feet quickly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with you.
Timothy my fellow worker greets you, and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater my kinspeople.
I greet you, I Tertius the one having written the letter, in the Lord.
Gaius greets you, my host and of the whole assembly. Erastus greets you the steward of the city, and Quartus the brother.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with all of you. Amen.
[Now to the one being able you to strengthen according to my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to revelation of a mystery in eternal times having been kept silent,]
[but having been made visible now, and through prophetic writings according to command of the eternal God for obedience of trust unto all the nations having been made known,]
[to the only wise God through Jesus Christ, to whom the glory unto the ages, amen.] [To Romans written from Corinth through Phoebe the servant of the assembly in Cenchreae.]

titus_1.t: Paul, servant of God, and apostle of Jesus Christ, according to trust of God's chosen ones and full knowledge of truth that is according to godliness,
upon hope of eternal life, which the unlying God promised before eternal times,
but he manifested at his own seasons his word in a proclamation with which I was entrusted according to the command of our Saviour God,
To Titus, genuine child according to a common trust: grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.
For this cause I left you behind in Crete, so that the things lacking you might set straight and might appoint city by city elders, as I ordered you:
if anyone is unaccusable, a man of one woman, having trustworthy children, not in an accusation of wildness or insubordinate.
For it is necessary the overseer to be unaccusable as God's household-manager, not self-pleasing, not irascible, not given to wine, not a striker, not greedy of shameful gain,
but hospitable, good-loving, sound-minded, righteous, holy, self-controlled,
holding to the trustworthy word according to the teaching, so that he may be able both to exhort in the healthy teaching and to reprove those speaking against.
For there are many also insubordinate, empty-talkers and mind-deceivers, especially those out of the circumcision,
whom it is necessary to stop the mouth of, who overturn whole houses, teaching what is not necessary, for the sake of shameful gain.
Said someone of them, their own prophet: "Cretans always liars, evil beasts, idle bellies."
This witness is true. For which cause reprove them severely, so that they may be healthy in the trust,
not attending to Jewish myths and commandments of humans turning away from the truth.
All things clean to the clean ones; but to the defiled and untrusting ones nothing is clean, but both their mind and the conscience have been defiled.
God they profess to know, but by the works they deny, being detestable and disobedient and unapproved toward every good work.

titus_2.t: But you speak what things are fitting for the healthy teaching.
Elder men to be sober, dignified, sound-minded, healthy in the trust, in the love, in the endurance.
Elder women likewise in demeanour reverent, not slanderers, nor to much wine having been enslaved, teachers of good,
so that they may bring the young women to sound mind to be husband-loving, child-loving,
sound-minded, pure, workers at home, good, being subjected to their own husbands, so that the word of God may not be blasphemed.
The younger men likewise exhort to be sound-minded,
concerning all things showing yourself a pattern of good works, in the teaching incorruption, dignity,
a healthy word, uncondemnable, so that the one from the opposite side may be shamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
Slaves to their own masters to be subjected, in all things to be well-pleasing, not talking back,
not pilfering but all good trust showing forth, so that the teaching of our Saviour God they may adorn in all things.
For appeared the grace of God, saving, to all humans,
disciplining us so that having denied ungodliness and the worldly desires, soundly and righteously and godly we might live in the now age,
awaiting the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and Saviour of us, Jesus Christ,
who gave himself on behalf of us so that he might ransom us from all lawlessness and might cleanse for himself a people of special possession, zealous of good works.
These things speak and exhort and reprove with all command; let no one disregard you.

titus_3.t: Remind them to be subjected to rulers, to authorities, to obey, toward every good work to be ready,
no one to blaspheme, to be uncontentious, forbearing, all gentleness showing forth toward all humans.
For we also were once senseless, disobedient, being deceived, serving as slaves to desires and various pleasures, in malice and envy passing our life, hateful, hating one another.
But when the kindness and the human-loving of our Saviour God appeared,
not out of works that are in righteousness which we did, but according to his mercy he saved us, through a washing of re-genesis and renewing of holy spirit,
which he poured out upon us richly through Jesus Christ our Saviour,
so that having been justified by that one's grace we might become heirs according to hope of eternal life.

Trustworthy the word, and concerning these things I intend you to insist, so that those having trusted God may take thought to preside over good works. These things are good and useful for the humans.
But foolish disputes and genealogies and strifes and legal battles stand away from; for they are unprofitable and futile.
A factious human after a first and second admonition refuse,
knowing that such a one has been turned inside out and sins, being self-condemned.
When I send Artemas to you or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me into Nicopolis; for there I have decided to winter.
Zenas the lawyer and Apollos diligently send forward, so that nothing may be lacking to them.
And let our own also learn to preside over good works for the necessary needs, so that they may not be unfruitful.
Greet you all those with me. Greet those loving us in trust. The grace be with all of you.
